text.body: <1> pālane vimalasattvavṛttaye janmakarmaṇi rajojuṣe, laye|| tāmasāya jagataḥ parākṛtadvaitajālavapuṣe namaḥ sate||1|| yasyāḥ prasādamavalambya jagadgurūṇāmapyaskhaladbahuguṇāḥ prasaranti vācaḥ|| sā vedaśāstraparinirmitavandyadehā bhūyāt samagravaradaiva sarasvatī naḥ||2|| vighnābhitāpamahatya madīyakṛtyabījaṃ pravṛddhamadanugrahavarṣapātaiḥ| samprārthitaḥ sitataro'pi gaṇeśameghaḥ siñcannabhīṣṭaphalamaṅkurayatvamogham||3|| śyāmo'pi śrutikamalāvabodharāgaḥ śāntaḥ sannayati tamovināśamantaḥ|| nīrūpaṃ prathayati yo'pi gosahasraiḥ taṃ vyāsaṃ namata jagatyapūrvabhānum||4|| uddhṛtya vedapayasaḥ kamalāmivābdhe rāliṅgitākhilajagatprabhavaikamūrtim|| vidyāmaśeṣajagatāṃ sukhadāmadādyaḥ taṃ śaṅkaraṃ vimalabhāṣyakṛtaṃ namāmi||5|| vande tamātmasambuddhasphuradbrahmāvabodhataḥ| arthato'pi na nāmnaiva yo'nanyānubhavo guruḥ||6|| prakāśātmā yatiḥ samyakprāptavidyāśuśutsayā| yathāśrutaṃ yathāśakti vyākhyāsye pañcapādikām||7|| viditasakalavedyairna praśaṃsanti loke grathitamapi mahadbhiḥ kiṃ punarmādṛśena|| iti viphalasame'smin vāgvyaye'haṃ pravṛttaḥ svamativimalatāyai kṣantumarhanti santaḥ||8|| prāripsitasya granthasyaavighnena parisamāptipracayagamanābhyāṃ śiṣṭācāraparipālanāya ca abhilaṣitadevatāpūjānamaskāraḥ kartavyaḥ, śāstrārthaśca tattvampadārthavivekopāyalabhyaḥ pratyagbrahmaṇorekatvalakṣaṇaḥ saṅkṣepato darśanīyaḥ kṛtsnasya bhāṣyasya tatra tātparyakathanāya, iti tadubhayaṃ śrutyarthābhyāṃ saṅkṣepato darśayati -- anādyānandakūṭasthajñānānāntasadātmāne abhūtadvaitajālāya sākṣiṇe brahmaṇe namaḥ iti| kṛtsnasya bhāṣyasya brahmātmaikatve tātparyaṃ atra darśitam| uttaratra vibhajya tātparyadarśanāt|| atra devatāguruviṣayā pūjānamaskārādyupabṛṃhitā bhaktiḥ vaktuḥ uktaprayojanasampādinyapi śrotṛṇāmapi vidyāṅgabhāvaṃ pratipadyate iti vāṅmanaḥkāyapraṇidhānaiḥ gurūnabhipūjayati namaḥ śrutiśiraḥpadmaṣaṇḍamārtaṇḍamūrtaye ityādibhiḥ ślokaiḥ| yatkāryamuddiśya maṅgalācaraṇaṃ sampāditaṃ, tat nirdaśati -- padādivṛntabhāreṇa iti|| nanu -- nedaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyānapadavīmupāroḍhumarhati, bhāṣyalakṣaṇābhāvāt, "sūtrārtho varṇyate yatra vākyaiḥ sūtrānukāribhiḥ| svapadāni ca varṇyante bhāṣyaṃ bhāṣyavido viduḥ" iti hi bhāṣyalakṣaṇaṃ vadanti| tatra "athāto brahmajijñāsā" iti sūtre anuvādaparihārāya śāstre puruṣapravṛttisiddhaye ca kartavyā iti padamadhyāhartavyam| tatra jijñāsāpadena antarṇītaṃ vicāramupalakṣya anuṣṭhānayogyatayā sādhanacatuṣṭayasampannasya brahmajñānāya vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti sūtravākyasya śrauto'rthaḥ sampadyate, arthāt adhikāriviśeṣaṇamokṣasādhanaṃ brahmajñānamiti sidhyati, sannidhānācca vedāntavākyavicāraḥ iti śrutyarthābhyāṃ sādhanacatuṣṭayasampannasya mokṣasādhanabrahmajñānāya vedāntavākyavicāraḥ kartavya iti sūtravākyasya tātparyeṇa pratipādyo'rtho'vagataḥ| tatra idaṃ bhāṣyaṃ na sūtrārthakalāmapi pratipādayati, ato na vyākhyānārhaṃ -- ityetaṃ, śaṅkitaṃ doṣaṃ pariharan bhāṣyakhaṇḍasya sūtreṇa arthādupāttaviṣayaprayojanapratipādane tātparyaṃ darśayati -- "yuṣmadasmatpratyayagocarayoḥ" ityādi aha"midaṃ mamedamiti naisargiko'yaṃ lokavyavahāraḥ" ityantaṃ bhāṣyaṃ "asyānarthahetoḥ prahāṇāya ātmaikatvavidyāpratipattaye sarve vedāntā ārabhyante" ityanena bhāṣyeṇa paryavasyat, śāstrasya viṣayaḥ prayojanaṃ ca arthāt prathamasūtreṇa sūtrite iti pratipādayati iti| tatra "naisargiko'yaṃ lokavyavahāraḥ" ityantaṃ bhāṣyam iti granthaḥ "śāstrasya viṣayaṃ prayojanaṃ ca pratipādayati" ityuttareṇa sambadhyate|| nanu kathaṃ bhāṣyadvayameva viṣayaprayojane pratipādayati śāstrārambhanimittaviṣayaprayojanasiddhihetoḥ adhyāsasya upasthāpakatvāt iti brūmaḥ; hetuvacanaṃ hi pratijñātārthameva sādhayati|| tathā hi -- etat śāstraṃ, ārambhaṇīyam, sambhāvitaviṣayaprayojanavatvāt, kṛṣyādyārambhavat ; śāstraṃ ca, sambhāvitaviṣayaprayojanam, avidyātmakabandhapratyanīkatvāt, jāgradbodhavat iti|| tadevaṃ śāstrasyārambhanimittaviṣayaprayojanavattvapratyanīkasya bandhasya avidyātmakatvaṃ nirdiśat bhāṣyadvayaṃ viṣayayojane pratipādayati iti|| nanu bandhasyāvidyātmakatvalakṣaṇo heturasiddhaḥ, kathamasiddhaṃ asiddhena sādhyate iti ata āha -- sarve vedāntā ārabhyante ityanena bhāṣyeṇa paryavasyat iti| viṣayādisiddhihetoḥ adhyāsasya siddhihetubhūtāni lakṣaṇasambhāvanāsadbhāvapramāṇāni pratipādayatā bhāṣyeṇa saha lakṣaṇādibhiḥ svārthaṃ adhyāsaṃ sādhayitvā viṣayaprayojane sādhayati ityarthaḥ| ata eva vyavadhānāvyavadhānābhyāṃ viṣayādeḥ sādhakatvāt etadantam anena paryavasyat iti bhāṣyasya vibhāgena upādānaṃ kṛtam|| nanu tarhi "sarvalokapratyakṣaḥ" ityanena paryavasyat iti vaktavyam| satyam;"asyānarthahetoḥ" iti bhāṣyasya viṣayaprayojanayoḥ vedāntavākyasambandhakathanadvāreṇa vicāraśāstrasambandhapratipādanaparatvāt vicāraśāstrīyaviṣayaprayojanasādhane savyavadhānatvasāmyena pūrvabhāṣyeṇa saha upādānaṃ kṛtam|| nanu -- evamapi asūtrasambandhinī viṣayaprayojane kimiti pratipādyete iti ata āha -- viṣayaḥ prayojanaṃ ca arthāt prathamasūtreṇa sūtrite itīti| itiśabdo hetau| yasmāt prathamasūtreṇa arthāt sūtrite tasmāt pratipādayati iti|| kaḥ punarasyasūtrasya prasaṅgaḥ ucyate; nityenava adhyayanavidhinā adhītasvādhyāyaḥ vedāntavākyeṣu āpātadarśanena idamavagacchati -- "atmanastu kāmāya sarvaṃ priyam" ityupakramāt sarvato viraktasya ātmaprepsoḥ "ātmani vijñāte sarvamidaṃ vijñātam" "etāvadare khalvamṛtatvam" ityupasaṃhārāt amṛtatvasādhanaṃ ātmadarśanaṃ "draṣṭavyaḥ" ityanūdya tādarthyena manananididhyāsanābhyāṃ phalopakāryāṅgābhyāṃ saha śravaṇaṃ nāma aṅgi vidhīyate iti| sa ca -- tatra kiyadviśeṣaṇaparyantaḥ adhikārī ko vā asau vedāntavākyavicāraḥ anyataḥ prāptaḥ aprāpto vā kathaṃ ca ātmajñānaṃ mokṣasādhanam kimpramāṇakaṃ ca tat kiṃ vā tat ātmatattvam kimpramāṇakaṃ ca iti jijñāsate| taṃ ca jijñāsuṃ puruṣārthakāmaṃ upalabhamāno bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ sādhanacatuṣṭayasampannasya mokṣasādhanabrahmajñānāya vedāntavākyavicāraṃ vidadhato vidheḥ apekṣitādhikāriviṣayaphalānubandhatrayaṃ āgamikamapi nyāyena nirṇetuṃ sūtrayāmāsa -- "athāto brahmajijñāsā" iti; śrutisūtrayoḥ aikarūpyāvagamāt| manananididhyāsanayośca śravaṇāṅgatvaṃ uttaratra vakṣyāmaḥ|| nanu "śrotavya" iti vidhiḥ mokṣasādhanabrahmātmajñānāya vedāntavākyavicāraṃ sādhanacatuṣṭayasampannasya vidhātuṃ na śaknoti; śravaṇādīnāṃ viṣayāvagamaṃ prati anvayavyatirekasiddhasādhanatvāt, na ca avaghātādivat ubhayārthatā sambhavati; dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprakāradvayasādhyāpūrvavat iha adṛṣṭasādhyasyābhāvāt, ātmāvagamasya dṛṣṭopāyamātrasādhyatvāt -- iti, naitat sāram; ātmatattvāparokṣyasya sarvādṛṣṭasādhyatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt avaghātādivat ubhayarthatayā vidhānopapatteḥ| nanu vidhiparatve vedāntānāṃ tanniṣṭhatayā brahmasvarūpasya asiddhyādidoṣaprasaṅgāt nāsti śravaṇādividhānaṃ iti bhāṣyakāraireva darśitam, satyam jñānavidhiḥ tatra nirākṛtaḥ, na śravaṇādividhiḥ; tatra uktadoṣaprasaṅgābhāvāt| katham darśanavidhāne hi brahma karmatayā guṇabhūtaṃ prasajyate, brahmadarśanamuddiśya vicāravidhāne tu svapradhānaphalabhūtadarśanaviśeṣaṇatayā brahmāpi svapradhānaṃ bhavati, na tu guṇabhūtaṃ iti, vedāntaiḥ brahmaṇi svapradhāne pratipādyamāne taddarśanāya śravaṇādividhānaṃ naiva virudhyate|| nanu evamapi upakramopasaṃhārābhyāṃ ekasmin ātmapratipādanapare vākye kathaṃ avāntaravākyaiḥ śravaṇādividhānaṃ kalpyate iti avāntaravākyabhedena '"vividiṣanti" iti yajñādīnāṃ jñānasaṃyogavidhānavat, "upari hi devebhyaḥ" iti uparidhāraṇavidhānavat, malavadvāsaso vratakalāpavidhānavacceti brūmaḥ| athavā -- "tasmād brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityaṃ nirvidya" ityādivākyaṃ śravaṇādividhāyakamastu; tasya tatparatvāt, sūtrakāreṇa ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt| sarvathā tāvat manananididhyāsanābhyāṃ aṅgabhūtābhyāṃ saha śravaṇavidhānaṃ astyeva| ataḥ tadapekṣitānubandhatrayanirṇayāya sūtramārabdham| kartavye ca adhikāriṇā mokṣasādhanabrahmajñānāya vedāntavākyavicāre prathamasūtreṇa pratipādite, sa ca kartavyo vicāraḥ janmādisūtramārabhya pravartiṣyata iti| tatra vidhyapekṣiteṣu adhikāriviṣayaphalānubandheṣu viṣayaphalayoḥ upapādanāya bandhasya mithyātvaṃ atra varṇyate iti sūtrasaṅgatamevedaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyeyaṃ iti|| nanu yadi arthāt viṣayaprayojane sūtrite, tarhi bhāṣyakāreṇa sūtrasya tatra vyāpāraṃ darśayitvā ākṣepasamādhānapūrvakaṃ sākṣādeva pratipādanīye viṣayaprayojane; anyathā sūtrakārabhāṣyakārayoḥ tatra tātparyābhāvaprasaṅgāt iti, tatrāha -- etacca tasmād brahma jijñāsitavyamityādibhāṣye spaṣṭataraṃ iti|| bhāṣyakāreṇoktam iti prajarśayiṣyāmaḥ ityadhyāhāraḥ| prathamaganthoktamevārthaṃ ākṣepasamādhānapūrvakaṃ atitarāṃ spaṣṭīkartuṃ codayati -- atrāha yadyevam iti|| nanu "asyānarthahetoḥ" iti bhāṣyavat pūrvabhāṣyamapi viṣayādikameva pratipādayati, kutaḥ tatra paryanuyogaḥ iti netyāha -- ahaṃ manuṣya iti dehendriyādiṣu ityādinā iti|| atra vicārakartavyātāviṣayaprayojanādhyāsānāṃ uttarottareṇa pūrvapūrvasya sādhyatvasya sūtreṇaiva sūcitatvāt adhyāsasādhanadvāreṇa viṣayaprayojane sādhayitvā vicārakartavyatā sādhanīyā iti kramaniyamaṃ vivakṣan āha -- "ucyata" ityārabhya "vakṣyati caitat" ityataḥ prāktanena granthena|| nanu brahmajñānaprayojanāṃ vicārakartavyatāṃ sūcayatā sūtreṇa kathaṃ bandhanivṛttiḥ vicāravijñānayoḥ prayojanatvena sūtritā iti tatrāha -- brahmajñānaṃ hi sūtritaṃ anarthahetunibarhaṇam iti|| vicārasādhyajñānasya prayojanaṃ ākāṅkṣan vicāravidhiḥ adhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṃ prayojanatvena pramimīte ityarthaḥ| nanu anarthaḥ narakapātādilakṣaṇaḥ anye eva, śarīrādipratibhāsasya ca mithyātvaṃ sādhyate, iti kiṃ kena saṅgatamiti netyāha anarthaśca pramātṛtāpramukhaṃ kartṛtvabhoktṛtvam iti|| nivartyatāṃ tarhi jñānena vastubhūtameva pramātṛtvakartṛtvabhoktṛtvamiti netyāha -- tadyadi vastukṛtam iti|| tathā hi -- citrāvayavini nīlaviśiṣṭadravyajñānaṃ svaviṣayaṃ vā svaviṣayasamavetaṃ vā rasādikaṃ virodhinaṃ vā pītimādiguṇaṃ na nivartayati, svaviṣayānavabodha eva kevalaḥ tena nivartyate| svāśrayagataṃ vastu jñānena nivartata iti cet, na; ghaṭādijñānena ātmagatadharmādharmādiguṇānivṛtteḥ| na ca āśrayaviṣayobhayasambandhi vastu jñānena nivartate; ātmanaḥ śarīraviṣayajñānena dehātmasambandhādyanivṛtteḥ iti| nanu na dṛṣṭasāmarthyāt jñānāt bandhanivṛttiḥ, yena avidyātmatvaṃ varṇyeta, kiṃ tu āgama eva jñānāt bandhanivṛttiṃ śrāvayati| nanu śrutopapattyarthameva bandhasya avidyātmatvaṃ varṇanīyameva; yathā āgneyādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ yāgānāṃ adhikārāpūrvaviṣayatayā apūrvakaraṇabhāve śrute'pi kālāntarabhāvipradhānāpūrvasādhanatvopapattyarthaṃ kramabhāviyāgakarvajanyāni madhyavartīni avāntarāpūrvāṇi kalpyante, yathā vā śrutasyaiva svargasādhanatvasyopapattaye'pūrvaṃ kalpyate, tadvat| nanu tatra kṣaṇikānāṃ karmaṇāṃ kālāntaravartiphalasādhanatvābhāvavyāptiniyamāt loke, vede'pi svargāpūrvasiddhyai madhye apūrvāṇi kalpyante śrutopapattaye iti| tarhi ihāpi vyāptiniyatiḥ asti ityāha -- yato jñānaṃ ajñānasyaiva nivartakam iti|| ataḥ sūtrasyaiva bandhasya avidyātmakatve vyāpārāt sūtrārthavicārakartavyatopapatyarthaprayojanasādhanāya adhyāso varṇanīyaḥ ityāha -- tat yadi ityādinā sūtrārthopapatyupayogitā ityantena granthena|| nanu sūtreṇa prathamapratipannaṃ pratipādyaṃ arthaṃ ullaṅghya kimiti caramapratipannaṃ ārthikārthameva bhāṣyakāraḥ prathamaṃ varṇayati iti tatrāha -- sakalatantropodghātaḥ iti|| pratipādyamarthaṃ buddhau saṃgṛhya prāgeva tadarthamarthāntaravarṇanaṃ upodghātaḥ| pratipādyaṃ bahireva pratijñāya paścāt tatsiddhihetūpavarṇanaṃ pratipādanaṃ iti vibhāgaḥ| tantraṃ iti tantrārtho brahmātmaikatvamucyate| nanu bhavatu prayojanasiddhiheturadhyāsaḥ, kathaṃ tantrārthasiddhihetuḥ ityāśaṅkya tatkathanāya tantrārthaṃ prathamaṃ kathayati -- tathācāsya śāstrasya iti||aidamparyaṃ pratipāditaṃ ityuttareṇa sambandhaḥ| tadeva aidamparyaṃ darśayati -- sukhaikatānetyādinā|| ayamarthaḥ -- brahmātmaikatve vedāntāḥ paryavasyanti iti yadidaṃ vedāntaśāstrasya aidamparyaṃ, tat sūtrabhāṣyābhyāṃ pratipāditaṃ iti| tantrārthaṃ pradarśya tasya adhyāsasiddhyadhīnatayā adhyāsasya prathamavarṇanīyatāṃ darśayati -- taccāhaṃ kartā sukhī duḥkhī iti|| nanu śāstrameva pratyakṣābhimatamapi bandhaṃ ābhāsīkṛtya brahmātmaikatvaṃ pratipādayiṣyati, kiṃ pṛthak adhyāsavarṇanena iti tatrāha -- tāvat jaradgavādivākyavat iti|| nanu śāstrārthasiddhiḥ adhyāsaparādhīnā cet, sa eva tarhi adhyāsaḥ sūtrakāreṇa mukhato varṇanīyaḥ; tasya prādhānyāt, anyathā tatra atātparyaprasaṅgāt, iti tatrāha -- vakṣyati ca etat iti|| tarhi upodghātatvāt prathamamevādhyāsaviṣayaṃ sūtraṃ praṇetavyamiti codayati -- yadyevaṃ iti|| arthanirṇayapradhānatvāt vādakathālakṣaṇāyāṃ pratipādanaprakriyāyāṃ pravṛttaḥ sūtrakāraḥ na upodghātaprakriyāyāṃ iti pariharati -- maivaṃ arthaviśeṣopapatteḥ iti|| tarhi bhāṣyakāreṇāpi yathāsūtrakramameva pravartitavyaṃ na tu sūtrakramamatilaṅghya iti tatrāha -- bhāṣyakārastu iti|| sukhapratipattyartham-pravṛttyaṅgabhāvāya ityarthaḥ|| evamapi na vyākhyeyamidaṃ bhāṣyam; śāstrādau maṅgalācaraṇābhāvāt, vighnopasaṃsṛṣṭatayā śāstrārthe'pratipattyanyathāpratipattivipratipattisaṃbhavāt, śiṣṭācāraparipālanahīnatayā ca anāptapraṇītatvaprasaṅgāt iti codayati -- nanu ca granthakaraṇādikāryārambhe iti|| nanu śiṣṭānāṃ niṣṭhīvanādipravṛttiḥ kimanyena anusaraṇīyā iti netyāha -- śiṣṭācāraśca naḥ pramāṇaṃ iti|| ācāraḥ-dharmaḥ ityevānuṣṭhīyamānaṃ karma| pramāṇaṃ-kartavyaṃ ityarthaḥ| nanu prayojanābhāvāt kiṃ maṅgalācaraṇena iti netyāha -- prasiddhaṃ ca maṅgalācaraṇasya iti|| nanu atra vighna eva nāsti alpārambhatvāt iti netyāha -- mahati ca iti|| nanu sambhāvanāmātrāt na pravṛttiḥ vighnaśāntaye, kintu niścayāt iti atrāha -- prasiddhaṃ ca iti|| nanu lokaprasiddhiḥ nirmūlā na vighnaniścayahetuḥ, iti ata āha -- vijñāyate ca iti|| upasaṃharati -- tat kathaṃ iti|| "sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu nāsti teṣāmamaṅgalam| yeṣāṃ hṛdistho bhagavān maṅgalāyatanaṃ hariḥ||" iti smṛteḥ śiṣṭācārapratipālanāya vighnopaśāntaye ca viśiṣṭadevatātattvānusmaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ maṅgalācaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ ityāha -- atrocyate iti|| kiṃ tatra pramāṇaṃ iti ata āha -- yuṣmadasmadityādi iti|| ityantameva bhāṣyaṃ pramāṇaṃ ityarthaḥ, maṅgalācaraṇaṃ iti vā| kathamidaṃ viśiṣṭadevatānusmaraṇaṃ gamayati iti tatrāha -- asya ca ayamarthaḥ iti|| nanu neha viśuddhātmatatvadevatā anusmaryate, kiṃtu adhyāsābhāvo varṇyate iti; satyam tādarthyena tattvamapyanusmaryate ityāha -- tat kathaṃcana iti|| nanu anyaparatvāt devatānusmṛtiḥ avivakṣitā na kāryakarī iti, netyāha -- tadanyaparādeva iti|| anyārthamapi devatānusmaraṇaṃ svabhāvādeva vighnopaplavaṃ dhakṣyati, dhūmārtha iva vahniḥ tṛṇādikaṃ ityabhiprāyaḥ| vyākhyeyatvaṃ pratipāditamupasaṃharati -- tasmāt iti|| anyārthapravṛttena "yuṣmadasmadi"tyādipadadvayamarthādvyākhyātam|| uttarapadaṃ vyākhyātuṃ bhāṣyamādadāti -- viṣayaviṣayiṇoḥ ityādinā|| tatra dvividho virodhaḥ, dvividhā ca itaretarabhāvānupapattiḥ; katham dvayoḥ padārthayorekadeśakālāvasthānasāmarthyābhāvaḥ padārthadharmo virodhaḥ; tannimitto avasthānalakṣaṇakāryābhāva itaretarabhāvānupapattirityekaḥ skandhaḥ| aparastu padārthayoritaretarātmatāsāmarthyābhāvaḥ padārthadharmo virodhaḥ ; tannimitta itaretarātmatālakṣaṇakāryānupapattirityato dvaividhyāt pṛcchati -- ko'yaṃ virodhaḥ ityādinā|| tatra prathamaṃ pakṣaṃ dūṣayati -- yadi tāvat ityādinā|| tatra prathamaṃ pakṣaṃ dūṣayati -- yadi tāvadityādinā sahāvasthānamuktaṃ ityantena granthena|| tatra tamaḥprakāśaśabdābhyāṃ chāyātapaśītoṣṇagrahaṇamaṅgīkṛtya tatrāpi sahāvasthānamuktaṃ veditavyam| idānīṃ dvitīyaṃ pakṣamavalambate -- ucyate parasparānātmatālakṣaṇo virodhaḥ ityādinā|| nanu tamo nāma ālokābhāvamātraṃ iti kecit, rūpadarśanābhāvamātraṃ ityanye, tat kathaṃ dṛgdṛśyayoḥ bhāvarūpayoḥ idaṃ dṛṣṭāntena ādriyate iti ucyate -- upacayāpacayādyavasthābhedaviśeṣaviśiṣṭaṃ rūpavattayā ca upalabhyamānaṃ tamaḥ kathaṃ dvayīmabhāvavidhāṃ āsīdet bahulālokavitate'pi deśe nimīlitanayanasya golakāntaravartitamodarśanaṃ andhakāropalabdhiḥ pihitakarṇapuṭasya āntaraśabdopalabdhivat na virudhyate| ālokavināśitasya ca tamasaḥ punaḥ mūlakāraṇādeva jhaṭiti mahāvidyudādijanmavat janma siddhyati|| nanu rūpavato dravyasya sparśavattvaniyamāt tadrahitaṃ tamaḥ kathaṃ rūpavat dravyaṃ avagamyeta naiṣa doṣaḥ; -- vāyoranyatra sparśavaddravyasya rūpavattvaniyame'pi rūparahitasyasparśavato vāyorabhyupagamāt, tadvat darśananiyamādeva sparśahīnasya rūpavattamasaḥ siddheḥ| dhūmasya ca rūpavataḥ cakṣuḥpradeśādanyatra sparśānupalabdhiḥ, tadvat sarvasparśahīnaṃ tamaḥ kiṃ na syāt savitṛkiraṇavitate'pi deśe pradīpālokajanmavināśayoḥ prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvetaretarābhāveṣu tamobuddhyadarśanāt nālokabhāvamātraṃ tamaḥ| sarvālokābhāvaścet sarvālokāsannidhāne tarhi na nivarteta| bahulāndhakārasaṃvṛtāpavarakāntaravasthitasyāpi bahiḥ rūpadarśanena saha apavarakāntaḥ tamodarśanāt na rūpadarśanābhāvamātraṃ tamaḥ iti alamatiprasaṅgena|| nanu dṛgdṛśyayoḥ itaretarabhāvānupapattiḥ tayoḥ vibhramanimittaṃ tādātmyāvabhāsaṃ na niruṇaddhi, śuktikārajatayorapi hi tādātmyahīnayoreva vibhramanimittaṃ aikādhikaraṇyamavabhāsate, tadvat ihāpi syāt iti codayati -- kathaṃ iti|| satyaṃ; idamaṃśamātrasya adhiṣṭhānasya rajatasya ca adhyasyamānasya kvacit tādātmyamastyeva, tataśca adhiṣṭhānasāmānyāṃśasya adhyasyamānaviśeṣāṃśasya ca kvacit sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena vā guṇaguṇibhāvena vā samānādhikṛtasya anyatra anyatarāṃśavataḥ padārthasya darśanāt anyatarāṃśādhyāso vibhramo dṛṣṭaḥ,tadvat iha adhiṣṭhānasya citaḥ adhyasyamānasya ca anātmano nāsti ityāha -- svataḥ tāvat viṣayiṇaḥ cidekarasatvānna yuṣmadaṃśasambhavaḥ ityādinā|| ayamāśayaḥ -- draṣṭuḥ acidaṃśaḥ svābhāviko vā syāt āgāntuko veti| na svābhāvika ityāha -- svata iti|| cetyaṃ hi jaḍaṃ caitanyasya karmakārakatayā avabhāsate| tat kathamekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ kartuḥ viparītasthānagataṃ karmakārakaṃ ātmā syāt ityabhiprāyaḥ| āgantukaścet, saheturaheturvā| nirhetuścet, tatrāha -- apariṇāmitvāt iti|| na hi niravayavaṃ vastu svataḥ sāvayavākāreṇa pariṇamamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ityabhiprāyaḥ| na sahetuḥ ityāha -- nirañjanatvāt iti|| na hi niravayavamākāśaṃ hetūparāgān pariṇamamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ityarthaḥ| tarhyanātmaiva adhiṣṭhānaṃ ātmāṃśātmakaṃ kvacit dṛṣṭaṃ iti , netyāha -- viṣayasyāpi iti|| samatvāt iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- yathā draṣṭuḥ draṣṭrantaraṃ na pratyakṣagocaraḥ, anumeyameva tat, evaṃ viṣayo'pi syāt iti| parato'pi na anātmanaḥ cidākārapariṇāmaḥ; jaḍopādānasyāpi kāryasya jaḍatvāt, tarhi ātmacaitanyameva anātmā svāṃśatvena svīkaroti iti cet, tatrāha -- citeḥ apratisaṃkramatvāti iti| tasmāt kvacidapi tādātmyādarśanāt anyatra anyatarāṃśadarśanena anyatarāṃśādhyāso nopapadyate iti| taddharmāṇāmapi sutarāṃ ityārabhya ābhāva evādhyāṃsasya yuktaḥ ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| nanu ahaṅkārādiṣu śarīrānteṣu ahamityeva pratyayaḥ, na tu idamiti kathameṣāṃ yuṣmatpratyayagocaratvaṃ iti tatrāha -- tadbalanirbhāsitatayā iti|| tasya -- asmatpratyayagocarasya caitanyasya balena nirbhāsyatvāt ahaṅkārādeḥ pratibhāsato yuṣmadarthatvābhāvepi aparokṣatayā avabhāsasyatvena lakṣaṇena yuṣmadarthabhāvo yujyate ityarthaḥ| apṛthaktve'pi caitanyāt pṛthagiva avabhāsante iti|| antaḥkaraṇavṛttyupādhau nāneva avabhāsante ityarthaḥ|| bhūyo'vayavasāmānyasādṛśyābhāvāt ātmani kartṛtvādeḥ ahaṅkārādyupādhinimittabhramatve'pi, śarīrādyadhyāsasya sopādhikabhramatvābhāvāt| draṣṭari ahaṅkārādiśarīrāntapadārthādhyāsasya sambhavaṃ prāptaṃ aṅgīkaroti -- yadyapyevaṃ iti|| nirupādhikabhramakāryadarśanameva guṇāvayavasāmānyābhāve'pi ketakīgandhasadṛśaḥ sarpagandhaḥ itivat sādṛśyāntaraṃ vā śaṅkhapītimādāviva kāraṇāntaraṃ vā kalpayati ityāha -- "tathāpi" ityādinā "evamadhyāsasyāpi" ityabhiprāyaḥ ityantena granthena|| naisargikaśabdārthamāha -- pratyakcaityanyasattāmātrānubandhī iti|| katham ātmani kartṛtvabhoktṛtvadoṣasaṃyoga eva adhyāsaḥ| tatra bhoktṛtvādhyāsaḥ kartṛtvādhyāsamapekṣate; akarturbhogābhāvāt, kartṛtvaṃ ca rāgadveṣasaṃyogādhyāsamapekṣate; tadrahitasya kartṛtvābhāvātsa, doṣasaṃyogaśca bhoktṛtvamapekṣate; anupabhutte atañjātīye vā rāgādyanupapatteḥ, evaṃ bījāṅkuravat hetuparamparayā anāditvāt adhyāsasya naisargikatvaṃ iti| lokavyavahāraśabdaḥ adhyāsābhidhāyīti darśayati -- lokaḥ iti manuṣyo'haṃ ityādinā|| vyavahāraḥ -- abhijñā abhivadanaṃ upādānaṃ arthakriyā iti caturvidhaḥ| ato manuṣyo'haṃ iti jñānābhidhāne vyayavahāraśabdaṃ arhataḥ iti bhāvaḥ| anyasya anyātmatāvabhāsaḥ avidyā ityukte "śuklaḥ paṭaḥ" ityādipratyayānāṃ avidyātvaprasaṅgo mā bhūt iti satyasya vastuno mithyāvastusambhedāvabhāso avidyā iti svasiddhāntamaṅgīkṛtya "satyānṛte mithunīkṛtya" ityuktam, tat vyācaṣṭe -- satyaṃ anidaṃ caitanyaṃ ityādinā|| nanu ktvāpratyayopādānāt arthataḥ kriyābhedaḥ pūrvāparabhāvaśca aṅgīkartavyaḥ, tat kathaṃ adhyāsamithunīkaraṇalokavyavahārāṇāṃ ekārthatvaṃ iti netyāha -- adhyasya mithunīkṛtya ityādinā|| nanu kimiti svarūpamātraparyavasānam kriyābheda eva ktvāpratyayasāmarthyādupādīyatāṃ iti, netyāha -- upasaṃhāre ca iti|| na hi padamātravaiyarthyabhayāvākyārtho naisargikatvaguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ viśeṣyapadārthaḥ adhyāsaḥ upakramopasaṃhārayoḥ bhettuṃ yuktaḥ ityabhiprāyaḥ| kiṃ tarhi ktvāpratyayāvalambanaṃ iti pratipattitaḥ kriyābhedapūrvāparībhāvo ityāha -- ataḥ caitanyaṃ puruṣasya svarūpaṃ itivadvyapadeśamātraṃ iti|| upacāramātraṃ ityarthaḥ| katham eko'pyadhyāsaḥ anyonyātmatā satyānṛte ahamidaṃ mamedaṃ iti ca viśeṣaṇabhedāt viśiṣṭaḥ paropādhau bhidyate; viśiṣṭārtha pratyayāśca krameṇa vaktuḥ bhavanti iti, pratipattitaḥ pūrvāparībhāvaṃ viśeṣaṇabhedācca viśiṣṭakriyābhedaṃ ca aṅgīkṛtya ktvāpratyayaḥ iti| tatra ajñānaṃ ityukte bhrāntijñānaṃ iti syāt, tadubhayavyāvṛttyarthaṃ nirucya padārthau darśayati -- mithyā ca tat ajñānaṃ ca ityādinā|| nanu kathaṃ mithyājñānaṃ adhyāsasya upādānam tasmin sati adhyāsasya udayāt asati ca anudayāt iti brūmaḥ|| nanu adhyāsasya pratibandhakaṃ tattvajñānaṃ tadabhāvaśca ajñānaṃ iti pratibandhakābhāvaviṣayatayā ajñānasya adhyāsena anvayavyatirekau anyathāsiddhau, naitat sāram;puṣkalakāraṇe hi sati kāryotpādavirodhi pratibandhakam| na ca adhyāsapuṣkalakāraṇe sati tattvajñānodayaḥ| tasmānnājñānādayavyatirekau pratibandhakābhāvaviṣayau| tathāpi virodhisaṃsargābhāva iti cet, na;kāryasya kāraṇāpekṣā hi prathamamutpadyate, na virodhisaṃsargābhāvāpekṣā| tasmāt prathamāpekṣitakāraṇaklṛtpimeva anvayavyatirekau nyāyasahitau kurvāte| nanu klṛptaṃ viṣayendriyādidoṣaḥ kāraṇaṃ iti| satyam; nimittaṃ tu tat, upādānāpekṣāyāṃ ajñānamanupraviśati; sarvaṃ ca kāryaṃ sopādānam, bhāvakāryatvāt, ghaṭādivat, ityanumānāt, kriyāguṇāderapi sāśrayasyaiva utpatteḥ utpadyamānāśrayasyaiva upādānatvāt| nanu ātmā antaḥkaraṇaṃ vā bhrāntijñānopādānaṃ bhaviṣyati na; ātmanaḥ apariṇāmitvāt; antaḥkaraṇasya ca indriyasaṃyogādisāpekṣatvāt na; mithyārthe ca pratyayamātraviparivartini tadayogāt, adhiṣṭhānajñānena anyathāsiddhatvācca tadanvayavyatirekayoḥ| antaḥkaraṇasya jaḍatvāt ajñātṛtvāt, ātmanaḥ abhrāntatvaprasaṅgācca| tasmāt mithyarthatajjñānātmakaṃ mithyābhūtaṃ adhyāsaṃ upādānakāraṇasāpekṣaṃ anāśrayasthānatayā kācidinimittakāraṇeṣu bhidyamāneṣu mithyābhūtasyaiva sarvakāryasvabhāvānukūlasya sarvatra anugamāt ajñānasya ātmāśrayatayā bhrāntijñānāśrayakoṭinikṣiptatvācca mithyājñānameva adhyāsopādānam, na ātmāntaḥkaraṇakācādidoṣāḥ iti sūktam| atmāśrayādhyāsasya śuktikāsaṃsargovibhrama iti vakṣyate| ekasyaiva adhyāsasya naisargikatvaṃ naimittikatvaṃ ca viruddhaṃ iti codayati -- kathaṃ punaḥ iti|| tatra prathamaṃ tāvat adhyāsapravāhajanmanā upādānakāraṇarūpeṇa naisargikatvaṃ kāryavyaktirūpeṇa naimittikatvaṃ iti avirodhaṃ darśayituṃ ātmani bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ sādhayati -- avaśyameṣā avidyāśaktiḥ iti|| 'avaśyaṃ' iti "eṣā iti" ca pramāṇadvayavattāmāha| pratyakṣaṃ tāvat; "ahamajñaḥ" "māmanyaṃ ca na jānāmi" ityaparokṣāvabhāsadarśanāt| nanu jñānābhāvaviṣayaḥ ayamavabhāsaḥ, na;aparokṣāvabhāsatvāt ahaṃ sukhī itivat, abhāvasya ca ṣaṣṭhapramāṇagocaratvāt, pratyakṣābhāvavādino'pi na ātmani vijñānābhāvāvagamaḥ sambhavati; "mayi jñānaṃ nāsti" iti pratipattau atmani dharmiṇi pratiyogini vā arthe avagate tatra jñānasadbhāvāt jñānābhāvapratipattyayogāt, anavagate'pi dharmyādau sutarāṃ abhāvānavagamāt, ṣaṣṭhapramāṇagocare phalaliṅgābhāvānumeye'pi jñānābhāve, ātmādau avagate anavagate'pi ātmani jñānābhāvapratipattyayogāt| iha ca "tvaduktamarthaṃ saṃkhyāṃ vā śāstrārthaṃ vā na jānāmi" iti viṣayavyāvṛttamajñānamanubhūya tacchravaṇādau pravartate| bhāvarūpājñānapratyakṣavāde tu satyapi āśrayapratiyogijñāne jñānābhāvasyeva bhāvāntarasyāpi na anupapattiḥ niyantuṃ śakyate| na ca āśrayapratiyogijñānabhūtamapi sākṣicaitanyaṃ bhāvāntarasya ajñānasya nivartakam; tasya ajñānaviṣayapratibhāsatvāt| na hi svajñānenaiva svayaṃ nivartate| nanu ajñānasya vyāvartako viṣayaḥ kathaṃ sākṣicaitanyena avabhāsyate pramāṇāyattatvāt viṣayasiddheḥ iti, ucyate;sarvaṃ vastu jñātatayā vā ajñātatayā vā sākṣicaitanyasya viṣaya eva| tatra jñātatayā viṣayaḥ pramāṇavyavadhānamapekṣate, anyastu sāmānyākāreṇa viśeṣākāreṇa vā ajñānavyāvartakatayā sadā bhāsate iti upapattisahitaṃ ajñānapratyakṣaṃ bhāvarūpameva ātmani ajñānaṃ gamayati iti siddham|| anumānamapi -- vivādagocarāpannaṃ pramāṇajñānaṃ, svaprāgabhāvavyatiriktaviṣayāvaraṇasvanivartyasvadeśagatavastvantaraṃpūrvakaṃ bhavitumarhati, aprakāśitārthaprakāśakatvāt, andhakāre prathamotpannapradīpaprabhāvat iti| tataśca jñānena samānāśrayaviṣayaṃ bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ siddham| śaktiriti ātmaparatantratayā ātmanaḥ sarvakāryopādānatvasya nirvoḍhṛtvamāha| tatsvarūpam -- ātmatattvam, tatsattāmātrānubandhinī ityarthaḥ| kiṃca arthāpattirapi bhāvarūpājñānasadbhāve pramāṇaṃ ityāha -- anyathā mithyārthāvabhāsānupapatteḥ iti|| viśuddhabrahmātmani śuktikāyāṃ ca ahaṅkārarajatādhyāsasya arthajñānātmakasya mithyābhūtasya mithyābhūtameva kiṃcit upādānamanveṣaṇīyam; satyopādānatve kāryasya kāraṇasvabhāvatayā adhyāsasyāpi satyatvaprasaṅgāt, tasyāpi mithyopādānasya sāditve tathāvidhopādānāntarakalpanāprasaṅgāt anādyeva tat mithyopādānaṃ iti kalpanīyam| yacca anādi svayaṃ mithyā mithyopādānaṃ ātmasanbandhi ca tat ajñānaṃ iti mithyādhyāsa eva tathāvidhājñānopādānaṃ kāraṇaṃ antareṇa anupapadyamānaḥ tat kalpayati ityuktam|| nanu yena yasya atiśayaḥ utpadyate, sa tasya viṣayaḥ, na ca ajñānena anātmani āvaraṇātiśayajanma; pramāṇābhāvāt, arthānupapatteśca| na tāvat agavate nīlārthe tatra āvaraṇakṛtyamavagantuṃ śakyate, anavagate tu na tarām| nanu avagate sati pūrvaṃ āvṛtaṃ ityavagamyatām, na;dhārāvāhikavijñānagamye'rthe pūrvamavagatasyāpi paścādavagamadarśanāt| nanu idānīmeva avagatatvaṃ pūrvamanavagatiṃ sādhayati, na;pūrvānavagatimavijñāya idānīmeva avagataṃ ityavadhāraṇāyogāt| nanu pūrvāparapratyabhijñāyāṃ madhye anavagatiravagamyate iti, na pratyabhijñānupapattiḥ madhye anavagatiṃ sādhayati; dhārāvāhike'pyātmani sadāvagate taddarśanāt, madhye jñānasmṛtyabhāvāt anavagatiravagamyate iti cet, na;avagate'pi smṛtiniyamābhāvāt| tathāpi viṣayānavagatiḥ pratīyate iti cet, satyam viṣayaiḥ saha sākṣicaitanye ajñānādhyāsāt pratibhāsaḥ, na ca adhyastasya āvaraṇamasti; dvicandrādivat pramāṇagamyatvābhāvāt| tasmāt nāsti anātmani āvaraṇe pramāṇam| na ca svayameva prakāśahīnasya jaḍasya āvaraṇārtho'pi sambhavati| tasmāt atiśayābhāvāt na ajñānaviṣayaḥ anātmā iti, tatrāha -- sā ca na jaḍeṣu vastuṣu tatsvarūpāvabhāsaṃ pratibadhnāti iti|| kiṃ tu anyadeva anātmani atiśayakāryaṃ kṛtvā tadviṣayamajñānaṃ iti vakṣyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| tatra hetuḥ -- pramāṇa vaikalyādeva iti|| athavā caitanyaprakāśena jaḍānāṃ nityavadanvayāt nityavat prakāśe prāpte, sambhavatyeva anātmasu āvaraṇakṛtyaṃ ityāśaṅkya āha -- pramāṇavaikalyādeva iti|| anātmapramāṇasya caitanyasya vaikalyāt -- āvaraṇādeva viṣayānavagatisiddheḥ na viṣaye pṛthagāvaraṇaṃ kalpanīyaṃ ityarthaḥ| itaśca na anātmani āvaraṇaṃ ityāha -- rajatapratibhāsāt iti|| yadi ātmāśrayaṃ ajñānaṃ anātmāvaraṇaṃ syāt, tadā, āvaraṇavināśamantareṇa viṣayāvabhāsāyogāt viṣayajñānena ātmājñānaṃ nivarteta| ataḥ satyāmeva ātmani avidyāyāṃ triṣvapi kāleṣu viṣayasvarūpapratibhāsadarśanāt, na anātmāvaraṇaṃ ajñānaṃ iti bhāvaḥ| nanu śuktikāviṣayaṃ ajñānaṃ anyadeva, tajjñānāt tat nivartate, anyacca ātmaviṣayaṃ ajñānaṃ ātmani dṛśyamānaṃ iti, tanna; ātmāśrayaṃ ātmaviṣayaṃ ca ajñānaṃ antareṇa anātmasu prativiṣayaṃ bhāvarūpājñānasadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt, viṣayāgrahaṇasya pramāṇavaikalyādapi upapatteḥ| Bkiṃ ca tarhi atiśayaṃ ajñānajanyaṃ āśritya bāhyādhyātmikeṣu vastu iti anātmaviṣayamajñānaṃ darśitaṃ iti tadāha -- ataḥ tatra rūpāntarāvabhāsahetureva kevalam iti|| nanu atrāpi anupapattiḥ samānā, katham śuktikājñānaṃ hi rūpāntarāvabhāsaṃ nivartayan tadupādānaṃ ajñānamapi nivartayati iti te matam, tatra kathaṃ śuktikājñānāt sahājñānena adhyāse nivartyamāne punaḥ ātmani ajñānaṃ dṛśyate ataḥ prativiṣayamajñānabhedaḥ, adhyāsasya ajñānānupādānatvaṃ vā, upādānanivṛttimantareṇa adhyāsanivṛttirvā samāśrayaṇīyā iti, ucyate;asmin pakṣe śuktikādijñānena rajatādyadhyāsānāṃ svakāraṇe pravilayamātraṃ kriyate musalaprahāreṇeva ghaṭasya| athavā -- mūlājñānasyaiva avasthābhedā rajatādyupādānāni śuktikādijñānaiḥ sahādhyāsena nivartante iti kalpyatām| kathaṃ punaḥ loke sahājñānenādhyāsasya tattvajñānāt nivṛtteḥ apratipattau brahmajñānāt sahājñānena adhyāsasya nivṛttiḥ dṛṣṭadvāreṇa kalpyate iti naiṣa doṣaḥ; tattvāvabhāsavirodhinaḥ agrahaṇamithyājñānādeḥ tattvajñānena nivṛttidarśanāt ihāpi tattvāvabhāsavirodhitayaiva bhāvarūpājñānādeḥ kalpyamānatvāt tasya brahmajñānāt nivṛtteḥ upapatteḥ| na ca āvaraṇapakṣoktadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ ; viṣayavyāvṛttarūpāntarasya bhrāntijñānena avagamāt| nanvevaṃ ātmanyapi ajñānanimittaṃ āvaraṇakṛtyaṃ nāsti, katham na tāvat āvaraṇaṃ prakāśavilopaḥ ; svarūpasya anapāyāt, nāpi sata eva prakāśasya kāryapratibandhaḥ ; jñānasya viṣayāvabhāsātmanā uditasya svakārye pratibandhapratīkṣayorabhāvāt, tasmāt naiva ātmanyapi bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ; anupayogāt iti tatrāha -- "pratyagātmani tu citisvabhāvatvāt svayaṃprakāśamāne"ityādinā "tasya anavabhāsaḥ"ityantena granthena|| ayamarthaḥ -- "asti, prakāśate" ityādyabhijñādivyavahāraṃ prati puṣkalakāraṇe sati -- "nāsti na prakāśate ca" iti yo'yaṃ ātmatattvālambano vyavahāraḥ, saḥ bhāvarūpeṇa kenacit ātmani āvaraṇamantareṇa nopapadyate; sati puṣkalakāraṇe asati ca āvaraṇe, sannihite dhaṭe "prakāśate" ityādivyavahāradarśanāt, ato "nāsti brahma, na prakāśate ca" iti vyavahāraḥ anyathānupapattyā bhāvarūpamajñānaṃ gamayati iti arthāpattiḥ anumānaṃ vā samudāyārthaḥ| tatsiddhyarthamātmani "prakāśate" ityādivyavahāraṃ prati puṣkalakāraṇatāṃ darśayati -- citisvabhāvatvāt iti|| kiṃ tarhi āvaraṇamiti tatrāha -- brahmasvarūpānavabhāsasya iti|| "nāsti na prakāśate" iti vyāvahārālambanayogyatvasya vyavahārakāryadarśanādeva kalpyamānasya ityarthaḥ| na ca adhiṣṭhānapratibandhamantareṇa tatra viparyayakāryamupapadyate| avidyāsambandhatvādeva āvaraṇasya anirūpatitākāratā ca yuktā iti bhāvaḥ| nanu pramāṇavaikalyādeva atrāpyagrahaṇamiti, netyāha -- ananyamanimittatvāt iti|| ataḥ anavabhāsāt puṣkalakāraṇe sati pariśeṣāt idamāyātaṃ ityāha -- tadgatanisargasiddhāvidyāśaktipratibandhādeva tasyānavabhāsaḥ iti|| mūrtadravyāntarasya asambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ| ataḥ kāryadarśanonneyaṃ āvaraṇakṛtyaṃ viparyayaṃ ca ātmani kurvāṇaṃ ajñānaṃ bhāvarūpameva ubhayakāraṇatvānyathānupapattyā kalpyate ityāha -- ataḥ sā pratyakciti iti|| nanu agrahaṇamithyājñānatatsaṃskārebhyaḥ anyat ajñānaṃ nāma na paśyāmaḥ, ta eva ca jīvasya svayaṃprakāśamānamapi brahmasvarūpāvabhāsaṃ pratibadhnanti iti, netyāha -- suṣuptādau ca iti|| tatrāpi avidyāśaktiḥ saṃskāraśeṣaṃ tiṣṭhatīti, na saṃskārādaya eva ajñānaṃ ityarthaḥ| katham na tāvat suṣuptādau svayamprakāśabrahmasvarūpānavabhāsaḥ puruṣāntarasaṃvedanavat draṣṭurbhinnatvāt iti śakyaṃ vaktum; ekatvaśruteḥ, nāpi mithyājñānapratibandhāt; tatra tasya abhāvāt, nāpi tatsaṃskārapratibandhāt; bhrāntisaṃskārāṇāṃ tattvāvabhāsapratibandhakatvābhāvāt, satsvapi rajatabhramasaṃskāreṣu śuktikāvabodhadarśanāt, nāpi agrahaṇapratibandhāt; svarūpagrahaṇasya nityatvāt svayaṃprakāśamāne saṃvedane tadviṣayakādācitkāgrahaṇasya apratibandhakatvāt, nāpi karmaṇāṃ svarūpāvabhāsavirodhitā; sarvadā aṇumātrasyāpi caitanyasya anavabhāsaprasaṅgāt, ajñāne'pi tulyaṃ iti cet, na; tasya svaviṣayacaitanyāvabhāsaṃ prati apratibandhakatvāt, na ca ajñānasyeva karmaṇāṃ nityavat sākṣicaitanyena avabhāsyatā, yena tadavabhāsakatayā sākṣicaitanyamapratibaddhaṃ prakāśeta| na ca karmāṇi svāśrayāvabhāsavirodhīni iti pramāṇamasti| saṃskāratvācca karmaṇāṃ bhrāntisaṃskāravat apratibandhakatā| tasmāt suṣuptādau svarūpānavabhāsavyavahāraḥ agrahaṇamithyājñānatatsaṃskārakarmabhyaḥ anyadeva kiṃcit pratibandhakaṃ ajñānaṃ kalpayatītyarthaḥ| nanu dravyāntarameva pratibandhakaṃ kalpyatāṃ, kimajñānakalpanayā iti, naitat;brahmajñānāt pratibandhanivṛttimantareṇa svaviṣayāvabhāsāyogāt, jñānanivartyasya ca ajñānatvāt|| atra kaścit bhedābhedābhyāṃ sarvasaṃkaravādī vedāntārthagahanasampradāyahīnaḥ durjaramaṇīyāṃ vācaṃ jalpati -- na kila agrahaṇamithyājñānatatsaṃskārebhyaḥ anyat sakalasaṃsārabījabhūtaṃ avasthātraye'pi anapāyi āsaṃsāravimokṣāt daṇḍāyamānamajñānaṃ nāma asti, kiṃ tu bhrāntijñānaṃ agrahaṇaṃ vā ajñānaṃ iti|| ayaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ -- keyaṃ bhrāntiḥ iti| ahaṃkārādiśarīraparyante anātmani ātmabuddhiḥ iti cet , aho vismaraṇaśīlatā sarvatra saṅgīrṇacetasaḥ| "khaṇḍo gauḥ" ityādibhedābhedapratyayaṃ pramāṇamupapādayan "ahaṃ manuṣyaḥ" iti pratyayaṃ bhedābhedaviṣayaṃ kimiti upekṣase "nāhaṃ manuṣyaḥ brahmāsmi" iti pratyayasāmarthyāt iti cet, tanna;"nāyaṃ khaṇḍo gauḥ, kiṃ tu muṇḍo gauḥ" iti pratyaye'pi khaṇḍamuṇḍābhyāṃ gotvasya abhedavat śarīrabrahmabhyāṃ jīvasya abhedapratyayasyāpi prāmāṇyopapatteḥ| idaṃrajatavat bhrāntiḥ iti cet, na;khaṇḍo gauḥ ityatrāpi tathātvaprasaṅgāt, "nāyaṃ khaṇḍo gauḥ, kiṃ tu muṇḍaḥ" iti vyaktyantare khaṇḍasya gotvopādhau niṣedhapratyayasāmarthyāt tatra vyavahārānucchedāt prāmāṇyaṃ iti cet, tat -- "ahaṃ manuṣyaḥ" ityatrāpi tulyam; mokṣāvasthāyāmapi sarvātmatvāt tava sarvaśarīrendriyādyabhimānavyavahārānucchedāt| jātivyakti guṇaguṇi kāryakāraṇa viśiṣṭasvarūpa aṃśāṃśi sabandhāḥ yatra vidyante, tatra bhedābhedau, na śarīrātmanoḥ; teṣāmabhāvāt iti cet, tarhi śarīraśarīrisambandho'pi guṇaguṇyādivat bhedanimittaṃ kiṃ na syāt anyathā sarvasaṅkaravāditayā kṣapaṇakaśiṣyatā cirakālasamupārjitā bādhyeta| asti ca cetanasvarūpaśarīrayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, cetanasvarūpāṃśasya brahmatvāt, ataḥ na te bhrāntirasti|| kiṃ ca, bhrāntijñānaṃ antaḥkaraṇapariṇāmaścet, tadā ātmāśrayā avidyā na syāt, antaḥkaraṇapariṇāma eva ātmani adhyasta iti cet, tathāpi anyathākhyātivādinaḥ saṃsargasya śūnyatvāt ātmāvidyāsambandho na syāt| na ca ātmapariṇāmo bhrāntiḥ; apariṇāmitvāt| na ca jñānaguṇasya dravyasya punaḥ jñānaguṇāntarākāreṇa pariṇāmaḥ sambhavati; avāntarajātīyasya ekasmin dravye guṇadvayasya yugapat samavāyāyogāt, na hi paṭe śauklyaṃ yugapat samavaiti| tasmāt anādisiddhamithyājñānānabhyupagame na kācitsarvasaṅkaravādino'vidyā sambhavati| anādimithyājñānasambandho'pi ātmani ajñānavat kālpanikatvāt ākāśakārṣṇyavat ātmanaḥ kūṭasthatāṃ na vihanti ityalamatiprasaṅgena| atra ca pratyakṣānumānārthāpattayaḥ anādibhāvarūpājñāne pramāṇatvena upanyastāḥ| tatra evaṃbhūtena kāraṇarūpeṇa kāryarūpeṇa ca naimittikatvanaisargikatve na viruddhe ityupasaṃharati -- ato naisargiko'pyahaṅkāra iti||"anyo'nyadharmāṃśca" ityādiḥ adhyāsasvarūpaṃ darśayati ityanto granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| niṣkalaṅkacaitanyaikatāne niraṃśānandaikarase ajñānādisākṣiṇi anādisiddhe'pi ajñānādhyāse, kādācitkamadhyāsamāśritya āha -- ahamiti tāvat prathamo'dhyāsaḥ iti|| nanu "idaṃ rajataṃ" itivat adhyāse "dvairūpyaṃ ahaṃ" ityatrāpi vaktavyam| "ahaṃ" iti ca ekarūpeṇāvabhāsate, ato nādhyāsaḥ iti codayati -- nanvahamiti niraṃśacaitanyamātraṃ iti|| yathā dvairūpyeṇādhyāsasambhavaḥ, tathā vakṣyata ityāha -- yathādhyāstāṃśāntarbhāvaḥ iti|| nanu antaḥkaraṇendriyāṇāmātmānaḥ pṛthaksattvopalabdhyabhāvāt adhyastatayaiva siddheḥ ātmatattvāvabodhena na svarūpato vilayaśravaṇāt svarūpeṇa saṃsṛṣṭarūpeṇa ca ātmanyadhyastatayā siddhistu, śarīraṃ punarindriyairidaṃbuddhigṛhītatvāt kevalasākṣivedyatvābhāvāt utkrānte'pyātmani pṛthagupalabdheḥ bhūteṣu layaśravaṇācca na adhyastatayā siddhaṃ iti codayati -- nanvidamityahaṃkartuḥ iti|| śarīravyatiriktaṃ mamabuddhigṛhītaṃ sutarāmanadhyastamityāha -- mamedamiti ca iti|| śarīrādipadārthasvarūpasya mithyākalpitakartṛbhoktṛpramātṛdoṣasaṃyuktātmārthatayaiva kāryatayā bhogyatayā prameyatayā dveṣyatayā ca tādarthyenaiva sṛṣṭatvāt svarūpeṇāpi mithyātvaṃ svapnadṛṣṭāntena anumātuṃ śakyate ityāha -- ucyate yadaivāhaṃkartā ityādinā|| dārṣṭāntikaṃ darśayati -- evamahaṃkartṛtvapramukhaḥ iti|| draṣṭari dṛṣyāvabhāsasyāvidyādhyāsattve śāstrīyaviṣayaprayojanasiddhiḥ phaliṣyati ityāha -- atastādṛgbrahmātmānubhavaparyantāt iti|| tādṛgbrahmātmānubhavo bandhanivṛttiśca upapadyate ityarthaḥ| viṣayaprayojanasiddhau kimāyātam iti| śāstrārambhakartavyatā siddhā ityāha -- tadarthaviṣayavedāntamīmāṃsārambhaḥ iti|| te eva-brahmātmānubhavabandhanivṛttī, arthaḥ-prayojanaṃ viṣayaśca yasya vedāntamīmāṃsārambhasya iti vigrahaḥ| "sarvalokapratyakṣa" ityantasya uttarabhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- āha ko'yaṃ iti|| idanīṃ vibhajya avāntaratātparyaṃ kathayati -- tatrāpi iti|| lakṣaṇasambhāvanāparabhāṣyamākṣipati -- yadyevaṃ iti|| kimiti lakṣaṇasambhāvane nāpekṣyete iti tatrāha -- na hyanirjñātarūpaṃ iti|| pramāṇameva hi prameyaṃ anyasya anyātmanā avabhāsamadhyāsaṃ vyavasthāpayat svadeśakālopādhau sambhāvitarūpaṃ sarvatovyāvṛttāsādhāraṇarūpaṃ ca vyavasthāpayati, kiṃ pṛthak lakṣaṇasambhāvanopanyāsena ityarthaḥ| nanu anumānādipramāṇanirjñāteṣu vastumātreṣu viśeṣalakṣaṇasambhāvane pṛthagapekṣyete, iti ata āha -- duḥsaṃpādaṃ iti|| viśeṣata iti|| asādhāraṇākāravyāvṛttatayā ityarthaḥ| tatra draṣṭuranyasya dṛśyena anyātmanā avabhāso vidyata ityetāvati pramāṇaṃ vakṣyate, na tasya avidyābhrāntyadhyāsamithyātve, ataḥ tatpramāṇena na sidhyati iti pariharati -- ucyate -- na dehendriyādiṣu ityādinā|| nanu anyasya anyātmanāvabhāsapramāṇenaiva tanmithyātvamapi sidhyati, prameyaikyāt iti codayati -- tat kasya hetoḥ iti|| nānubhavādeva iti pariharati -- loke iti|| nanu pramāṇe sati kimiti anubhavābhāvaḥ pramāṇabhedāt ityāha -- bādhe hi sati iti|| bādhānupapattirmithyātve pramāṇaṃ; pratyakṣānumānavyavahārānupapattyāgamā ātmanyanātmāvabhāse pramāṇaṃ iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ihāpi bādhanimittamitaretaravivekamantareṇa anyasyānyātmanā'vabhāso'yaṃ ityavagantuṃ na śakyate; anyathā svasyaiva svenātmanā avabhāsaḥ kiṃ na syāt iti netyāha -- neha sa vidyate iti|| yauktikajñānādinā parokṣavivekamāśritya parasparātmanā'vabhāsaniścayaḥ| aparokṣabādhasya bhrāntipratibhāsocchedino'bhāvāt na spaṣṭo mithyātvādhyavasāyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| ataḥ avidyātvaspaṣṭīkaraṇāya lakṣaṇameva vaktavyaṃ ityāha -- tasmādadhyāsasya iti|| tarhi lakṣaṇapramāṇābhyāmeva vastunirṇayasiddheḥ pramāṇenaiva asambhāvanānirākaraṇāt sambhāvanā pṛthak na vaktavyā iti codayati -- nanu evamapi iti|| satyapi pramāṇasāmarthye pratyakṣāvabhāsanamapi asambhāvyamānatayā nirākṛtamanubhūyate iti anubhavamevāvalambya pariharati -- satyamevaṃ iti|| autpātikaḥ iti|| adṛṣṭavyatiriktakāraṇaśūnyaḥ ityarthaḥ|| nanu pramāṇenaiva kvacidasambhāvanā tiraskriyate, yathā ākāśagamane pakṣiṇām; kvacidasambhāvanayā pratibhāsaḥ aparokṣo'pi nirasyate, yathā savitṛsuṣyādau; tatra ātmani anātmāvabhāsaḥ kaṃ pakṣamavalambatām iti asambhāvanāpakṣameva iti viśeṣaṃ darśayati -- evamaviṣaye'ṅge iti|| adhiṣṭhānasyādhyasyamānena saha ekajñānaviṣayatvaṃ vaktavyam, tadabhāvāt na adhyāsasambhavaḥ ityāha -- aviṣaye iti|| draṣṭurvyatiriktasya kṛtsnasya kāryakāraṇasaṃghātasya adhyāsātmakatvena draṣṭaryeva kācādivat doṣānuṣaṅgo vaktavyaḥ, tadabhāvāt na adhyāsasambhavaḥ ityāha -- asaṅge iti|| adhiṣṭhānasya adhyasyamānena guṇāvayavasādṛśyaṃ vaktavyam, tadabhāvāt na adhyāsasambhavaḥ ityāha -- kenacidapi guṇādinā iti|| adhiṣṭhānayāthātmyāvabhāsaḥ adhyāsavirodhī, tadbhāvācca na adhyāsasambhavaḥ ityāha niṣkalaṅkacaitanyatayā iti|| nanu ātmanyaviṣayādirūpe anavagate nāsambhavānābuddhiḥ, avagate tu nādhyāsa eva tiṣṭhati, kuto'sambhāvanābuddhiḥ iti| naitat sāram;ātmanyaviṣayādirūpe parokṣāvabhāso'sambhāvanābuddhihetuḥ aparokṣāvabhāso'dhyāsasya nivartakaḥ ityuktatvāt| upasaṃharati -- tat māśaṅki iti|| taducyate||tat- tritayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sambhāvanā pramāṇaṃ krameṇocyata ityarthaḥ| anantarabhāṣyasya tātāparyamāha -- āha ko'yaṃ iti|| tantreṇa iti| yugapadarthadvayavivakṣayā ityarthaḥ| ubhayasya ceha sambhavāt iti|| lakṣaṇapraśnasya sambhāvanākṣepasyā ca sambhavāt ityarthaḥ| ubhayamatraiva vivakṣitaṃ cet sambhāvanaiva prathamaṃ kiṃ na pradarśyata iti atrāha -- tatrāpi iti|| svarūpamākhyāya iti prāthamye hetuḥ|| nanu āha iti paroktikathanaṃ kimartham iti arthanirṇayapradhānatvāt vādakathā śāstram, tatra "pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambhaḥ siddhāntaviruddhaḥ pañcāvayavopapannaḥ pakṣapratipakṣaparigraho vādaḥ" iti vādiprativādibhyāṃ guruśiṣyābhyā vā pakṣapratipakṣaparigraheṇa kriyamāṇā arthanirṇayāvasānā vādakathā atra pravṛttā iti darśayituṃ paroktikathanaṃ ityāha -- tatraivambhūte viṣaye ityādinā|| tenākṣiptam ākṣepharūpaṃ api abhiprāyaṃ anena pṛṣṭaṃ eva iti matvā pratyuktaṃ punarasau ākṣeparūpeṇa vivṛṇoti iti ākṣepamavatārya iti vyākhyeyam| nanu śāstreṣu jalpavitaṇḍābhiprāyeṇāpi paroktirasti iti , netyāha -- sarvatraivaṃvidhe iti|| nanu lakṣaṇavākye lakṣyābhidhāyinaḥ padasyābhāvāt sākāṅkṣaṃ vacanamanarthakaṃ ityāśaṅkya vākyaṃ pūrayati praśnavākyasthitaṃ iti|| nanu parasya parātmanā avabhāso'dhyāsaḥ iti vakṣyati, tatra kathamekenaiva paraśabdena lakṣaṇaṃ pūryate iti atrāha -- tatra paratretyukte iti|| uttaro granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| nanu ghañādīnāṃ bhāve vidhānāt kathaṃ karmaparatayā smṛtiśabdo vyutpādyate iti tatrāha -- asaṃjñāyāmapi iti|| kartṛvyatiriktakārakeṣu saṃjñāyāmiva asaṃjñāyāmapi prayogo bhavati -- "akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām" iti sūtrāt ityarthaḥ|| nanu smaryate cet rūpaśabdaḥ kimartha iti asmaryamāṇe vastuni upamāsamāsārthaḥ ityāha -- smaryamāṇarūpamiva iti|| nanu kimupamāsamāsena smaryate eva "idaṃ rajatam" iti, netyāha -- na punaḥ smaryata eva iti|| nanu cakṣurādipramāṇābhāvāt pariśeṣāt smṛtiriti, netyāha -- spaṣṭaṃ puro'vasthitatvāvabhāsanāt iti|| yathā anyatra "idaṃ rajatam ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ" ityādāvitaretarasaṃsṛṣṭau sāmānyaviśeṣāvaparokṣāvavabhāsete, tathehāpi pratibhāsaḥ| na hi paramārthedaṃrajatasaṃvedanākārāvabhāsanyūnatāmantareṇa saṃsargasaṃvidaṃśābhāvaḥ śakyate vaktum|| arthābhāve kathamaparokṣā saṃviditi cet, na; yathāsaṃvidavabhāsādhīnatvādarthasattāniścayasya| na hi arthasattāniścayādhīnaḥ saṃvitsattāniścayaḥ| arthasattāniścayasyāpi niścayāntarādhīnatvaprasaṅgāt| nanu "nedaṃ rajatam" ityuttarasaṃvedanādarthābhāvo'pi niścitaḥ| na -- tatrāpi pūrvasaṃvedanena sadbhāvaviṣayeṇa virodhāt| idaṃrajatābhāvasaṃvedanānāmavivekakalpanayā uttarajñāne'pi saṃsargasaṃvidabhāvaḥ kiṃ na syāt vyavahārasaṃvādajñānāduttarajñāne saṃsargasaṃvitsadbhāvaścet, na -- arthakriyāsaṃvādajñānādarthasaṃvitsadbhāvaniścayaḥ iti vadataḥ saṃvitpratyakṣatvavādahānāt; arthakriyāsaṃvido'pi saṃvidantarādhīnasadbhāvaniścayaprasaṅgāt|| nanu sampratipannaḥ arthābhāvaḥ| na; yathāpratibhāsameva mithyārajatasya uttarajñānena nirasanayogyasya upagamāt, laukikaparamārthadṛṣṭarajatapratiyogikābhāvaviṣayatvāt rajate traikālyābhāvajñānasya iti saṃviddvayānurodhena vyavasthāsiddheḥ anyatarasaṃvidapahnavāyogāt| tathā ca ubhayasaṃvidviṣayānubhavaḥ "nāstyatra rajataṃ" "mithyaiva rajatamabhāt" iti| nanu aparokṣaśuktikājñānāvivekāt rajatamaparokṣatayā pratibhāsate iti; netyāha -- spaṣṭaṃ iti|| keyaṃ spaṣṭatā nāma vivekajñānasamaye'pi -- "etāvantaṃ kālamidaṃ rajatamiti abhāt" iti saṃsṛṣṭāvabhāsatvena pratyabhijñāyogyatā; anyathā "tat rajatametāvantaṃ kālamito'viviktaṃ" iti pratiyāt, athavā -- tajjñānāt tatra pravṛttiḥ iti padārthāṃśajñānatatpravṛttyoḥ niyamāt ihāpi saṃsargapravṛttinimittatā saṃsargajñānasya spaṣṭatā iti| "pūrvadṛṣṭāvabhāsaḥ" iti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| yadā jñānaviśiṣṭo'rtha evādhyāsaḥ, tadā smaryamāṇasadṛśaḥ anyātmanāvabhāsamāno'nyo'rtho'dhyāsaḥ ityevaṃlakṣaṇaparatayā vākyaṃ yojitam| yadā punaḥ arthaviśiṣṭaṃ jñānamevādhyāsaḥ, tadā smṛtisamānaḥ anyasyānyātmanāvabhāso'dhyāsaḥ ityevaṃlakṣaṇaparatayāpi tadeva vākyaṃ yojayituṃ śakyate ityāha -- yato'rthāt iti| arthāt-vākyasāmarthyāt ityarthaḥ| kathaṃ ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| nanu na smṛtiścet bhrāntiḥ, pratyakṣajñānavat na pūrvānubhavajanyatvaṃ ityāśaṅkya, saṃprayogamātrajanyajñānādanyeṣāṃ sarveṣāmaviśiṣṭaṃ pūrvapramāṇajanyatvaṃ anvayavyatirekasāmarthyāt ityāha -- na hyasaṃprayuktāvabhāsinaḥ iti|| nanu saṃskārajanyatvamupagataṃ cet, anyasamprayukte cakṣuṣi yadanantaramanyaviṣayaṃ jñānamutpadyate, sā smṛtireva, tadvyavadhānena tu yajjñānamutpadyate, tadanumānādi pramāṇaṃ iti, pramāṇasmṛtidvairāśyameva vijñānasya, na tṛtīyaṃ mithyājñānaṃ nāma asti iti akhyātivādī pratyavatiṣṭhate ityāha -- apara āha ityādinā|| nanu smṛtiścet gavādismṛtivat svārthaṃ gṛhyamāṇādvivicya smarāmi iti darśayet iti ; ata āha -- pramoṣastu iti|| nanu śuktikāsamprayoge rajataṃ kimiti smaryate sādṛśyāditi cet atisādṛśyāt śuktikāntarameva smaryatāmiti, netyāha -- indriyādīnāṃ iti|| nanu mā bhūt smṛteḥ pramoṣāt svārthavivecakatā, grahaṇaṃ tu svārthaṃ smaryamāṇāt vivecayediti, netyāha -- saṃprayuktasya ca iti|| nanu smṛtigrahaṇayoḥ yaugapadyābhāvāt kramavartitve pūrvajñānaṃ vyavadhānāt na pravṛttihetuḥ, na ca sāmānyamātrajñānāt viśeṣamātrajñānādvā pravṛttiḥ iti ata āha -- tena darśanasmaraṇayoḥ nirantarotpannayoḥ iti|| nirantarotpattireva pravṛttiheturityarthaḥ| nanu idaṃ rajatamityabhāti iti saṃsargapratyayaḥ pratyabhijñāyate iti, netyāha -- anutpanne evaikatvāvabhāse iti|| "janmāntarānubhūtaṃ na smaryate" iti bhāṣyavacanādasmaryamāṇatvācca bālasya tiktasmṛtiḥ kathaṃ iti codayati -- nanvānāsvāditatiktarasasya iti|| janmāntarānubhūtatiktasmṛtiḥ kalpyate ityāha -- ucyate iti|| janmāntarānubhavasyopakāritāmāha -- anyathā ananubhūtatveti|| kimiti tarhi janmāntarānubhūtaṃ kiñcideva smaryate na sarvaṃ iti doṣabalādityāha -- tasmāt pittameva iti|| kimiti tarhi doṣa eva janmāntarānubhūtaṃ sarvaṃ na smārayati iti ata āha -- kāryagamyatvāt iti|| nanu atattve tattvajñānamiti śāstrakāreṇaiva darśitaḥ saṃsargabhramaḥ iti, netyāha -- etenānyasamprayoge iti|| vaktavyaṃ ca pūrvavādinā'pyaviveke saṃsargajñānakalpanāgauravādakhyātireva yukteti bhāvaḥ|| ucyate -- keyamakhyātiḥ iti na tāvat khyātyabhāvamātram; anabhyupagamādatiprasaṅgācca| anyārthino'nyatra pravṛttihetuḥ jñānamiti cet -- yatra tarhi na pravṛttiḥ jhaṭiti, bādhaśca, tatra kathaṃ bhrāntiḥ atha aviviktānekapadārthajñānam, tarhi "idaṃ" iti "rajataṃ" iti cāpunaruktaśabdadvayasmṛtihetutayā viviktāvabhāsanāt na tasya sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ avivekabhramaḥ sambhavati| na ca bhedāvamarśena ekatvajñānamanabhyupagacchataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayoravivekaḥ sambhavati; viviktākāradvayāvabhāsanāt| itaretarābhāvabhedadvitvādisaṅkhyāviśiṣṭajñānaṃ vivekaḥ iti cet, "gāmānaya daṇḍena" iti godaṇḍayoḥ tatkārakatvayoścāviveko bhramaḥ syāt| tatrāpyānuṣaṅgikabhedādijñānamastīti cet, "idami"ti "rajatami"ti ca ihāpyapunaruktaśabdānuṣaktākāradvayāvabhāse dvitvādyavabhāso vidyata eva; anyathā sāmānyākārāt viśeṣākārasya vivekānavabhāsā"didami"tyeva syāt, "rajatami"tyeva vā syāt, "idaṃ rajata"miti| kiñca, pratīyamānakārayoḥ na avivekaḥ; apunaruktapratibhāsāt| apratīyamānākārāviveko na bhramaḥ; atiprasaṅgāt| tasmāt na aviveko bhramaḥ|| kiñca "khaṇḍo gauḥ" ityādipratyayāśca avivikātānekapadārthaviṣayā vibhramāḥ prasajyeran| na ca grahaṇasmaraṇāviveka eva bhramaḥ; "ahaṃ manuṣyaḥ" iti gṛhyamāṇāvivekasya bhramatvāt| sāmānyaviśeṣādau saṃsargajñānamevāstīti cet , tathāpi aviviktānekapadārthajñānāt bhramatvamapi syāt| na ca tatra saṃsargapratyayo'pi; aikyasya tadālambanasyābhāvāt| guṇaguṇyādisambandha evālambanamiti cet, na; pratyabhijñāyā aikyālambanatvāt| ihāpi sādṛśyasambandha eva idaṃ rajataṃ iti saṃsargapratyayālambanaṃ syāt| asti ca sāmānyaviśeṣādīnāmidaṃrajatayoriva vivekapratyayaḥ; "ghaṭasya śaiklyaṃ" iti vivekābhyupagamāt| kiñca grahaṇameva smaryamāṇāt svārthaṃ kiṃ na viviñcyāt viśeṣadarśanābhāvāditi cet; yadi gṛhītamātrasya rajatāt bhedo'sti, tat bhedāpekṣito viśeṣo dharmyākāraḥ pratiyogyākāro vā nānyaḥ iti gṛhīta eva bhedākāro viviktaḥ pratīyeta| atha dharmipratiyogyākāre gṛhīte'pi itaretarāpekṣayā tṛtīyameva jñānaṃ bhedaṃ grāhayatīti, tarhi sarvapadārthajñānānāṃ bhedagrahaṇāt prāgaviviktatvāt bhramatvaprasaṅgaḥ| atha na gṛhītamātrasya rajatāt bhedaḥ, tarhi aikyameveti saṃsargajñānasya sālambanatāsiddhiḥ|| kiñca smṛtirvā gavādismṛtivat gṛhyamāṇāt svārthaṃ kimiti na viviñcyāt smaraṇābhimānapramoṣāditi cet, tatrāha -- ko'yaṃ smaraṇābhimānaḥ iti|| na tāvat smṛtireva, tasyāḥ pramoṣe jñānasyaivābhāvaprasaṅgāt, smṛteranyaścet, kathamanyasya pramoṣe paripūrṇamutpannaṃ jñānaṃ svakāryamarthavivekaṃ na kuryāt na cānyaḥ smaraṇābhimāno dṛśyate iti bhāvaḥ| nanu pūrvānubhavataddeśakālānāmanyatamena "saḥ" ityākāreṇa vā smaryamāṇasya sambhedaḥ smaraṇābhimānaḥ iti, netyāha -- na tāvat jñānānuviddhatayā grahaṇaṃ iti|| "so'yaṃ" iti pratyabhijñābhrame hi sarveṣāmevaiṣāṃ "saḥ" ityākārasya pūrvānubhavadeśakālānāṃ ca smarāmītiparyantānāṃ sambhedāvagame'pi gṛhyamāṇenāvivekadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ| na ca pūrvānubhavasambhedaḥ smaryamāṇe sambhavati ityāha -- na hyativṛttasya iti|| arthasmṛtisaṃskārasya janakaṃ yat pūrvavijñānaṃ, tat svayaṃ grāhyaviśeṣaṇatayā svenaiva na viṣayīkriyate; arthamātraviṣayatvāt pūrvajñānasya| na ca pūrvajñānenāviṣayīkṛte viṣaye tatsaṃskārajanyā smṛtiḥ samutpadyate| tasmādarthamātraviṣayajñānajanyā smṛtirarthamātrameva viṣayīkaroti, na pūrvajñānenāviṣayīkṛtaṃ jñānamapi; anyathā nīlajñānāt pīte'pi smṛtiḥ syāt|| nanu smaryamāṇe pūrvānubhavasambhedaḥ svānubhavasiddhaḥ, satyam; yat pūrvānubhavasamaye arthāvabhāsaliṅgajanyamarthajñānasadbhāvaviṣayamanumānajñānamutpannaṃ tadanumānajñānasaṃskārajanitā smṛtiḥ anubhavasambhinnamarthaṃ gamayati, mūlajñānenāpi arthajñānaviṣayeṇa viśiṣṭārthaviṣayīkaraṇāt, yasmādarthasmṛtisamanantaramanubhavaviśiṣṭārthasmṛtyantarajananādarthasmṛtirevānubhavasambhinneti vibhramaḥ, tasmāt śuddhamevārthaṃ ityupasaṃharati -- śuddhamiti|| pūrvajñānena yāvanmātraṃ vastumātraṃ vā jñānasambhinnaṃ vā vastu viṣayīkṛtaṃ tāvanmātramevāvabhāsayati, na svamūlajñānasambhinnaṃ ityarthaḥ|| nanu arthasmṛtirvā jñānasambhinnaviṣayaṃ smṛtyantaraṃ vā ityatra ko vivekaḥ iti tatrodāharaṇamāha -- tathāca padāt padārthasmṛtau iti|| vākyārthapratyayavivakṣayā yāvadantyapadoccāraṇaparisamāptiḥ tāvat krameṇoccāryamāṇeṣu padeṣu ekaikasmāt padādekaikārthaviṣayāṇi jñānānyutpadyante; tāśca sambandhiśabdadarśanāt sambandhyantarārthaviṣayāḥ smṛtayaḥ ityabhihitānvayavādināmanvitābhidhānavādināṃ ca saṃmatam|| nanu ko'sau śabdasyārthena sambandhaḥ yataḥ śabdasya darśanādarthe smṛtirutpadyeta, arthabuddhijananasāmarthyalakṣaṇa iti cet, kiṃ smṛtijananasāmarthyalakṣaṇaḥ anyo vā nacānyaḥ, padānāṃ padārthāśeṣu smṛtivyatiriktakāryāntarābhāvāt, naca smṛtijananasāmarthyasambandhādeva smṛtijanma; anyatra sādṛśyādisambandhāntare sati anyataradarśane anyatarasmin smṛtidarśanāt| tasmāt na śabdādarthe smṛtiriti, ucyate; -- sambandhajñānasaṃskāraḥ śabdadarśanaṃ ca atra smṛtihetuḥ, nārthena sambandhaviśiṣṭaśabdajñānam; yena viśiṣṭe smṛtisāmarthyavyavasthāpanāt viśeṣaṇībhūtaṃ sambandhāntaramiṣyeta, sambandhaviśiṣṭānyataradarśanācca anyatarasmṛtau sambandhaviśeṣaṇatvenānyatarasyāpi smṛtiviṣayasya prāgeva buddhatā syāt, sādṛśyādimūlasambandhānāṃ buddhisāmarthyalakṣaṇatvābhāvāt sāmarthyasambandhādarthāntaratvaṃ na virudhyate| buddhisāmarthyasambandhāt buddhiḥ notpadyate iti ca svavacanavirodhaḥ| tasmāt padebhyaḥ padārthamātreṣu buddhisāmarthyasambandhāt smṛtayaḥ iti siddham| kutaḥ punaḥ tatra jñānasambhedābhāvaḥ iti tatrāha -- jñānasyāpi iti|| śabdasāmarthyaviṣayatayā sambandhitvena smṛtiviṣayatve jñānasyāpi śabdārthatvaprasaṅgāditi| tatheṣṭabhūbhāgaviṣayā ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu smṛtijñānasya trikoṇatvādivat svagataḥ kaścidviśeṣo dṛśyate, sa smaraṇābhimānaḥ iti ; netyāha -- nāpi svagato jñānasya iti|| nanu nityānumeye'pi liṅgaviśeṣāt hetuviśeṣānumānaṃ yuktamiti, ko'sau liṅgaviśeṣaḥ na tāvat grāhyaviśeṣaḥ ityāha -- nāpi grāhyaviśeṣanimittaḥ iti|| astu tarhi phalaviśeṣo liṅgaviśeṣaḥ iti,; netyāha -- nāpi phalaviśeṣanimittaḥ iti|| nanu smarāmi ityanubhavaḥ smaraṇābhimānaḥ iti ; ata āha -- yaḥ punaḥ kvacit kadācit iti|| yadi smṛtismāryasmartṛviṣayaśabdatrayānuṣakto'nubhavaviśeṣaḥ, tat smarāmi iti, yadi vā tritayaviṣayamanumānajñānāntarametat, ubhayathāpi grahaṇāditritayāt smaraṇāditritayasya prāgeva bhedāvagamamantareṇa grahaṇāditritayaśabdavyatiriktasmaraṇādiśabdānusmaraṇaṃ grahaṇānumānavyatirekeṇa smaraṇānumānaṃ ca na sambhavati; viśiṣṭābhidheyāvagamanimittatvāt viśiṣṭaśabdānusmaraṇasya, viśiṣṭāvagamānumānasya ca, iti prāgeva smarāmītyanubhavāt grahaṇasmaraṇayoḥ bhedo vaktavya iti bhāvaḥ| nanu smṛtyanubhavayorarthamātraviṣayatve ko bhedaḥ iti; ata āha -- tasmāt iti|| kāraṇaviśeṣādevetyarthaḥ|| kathaṃ vā tava smṛteḥ jñānānumānasya ca arthaviśiṣṭajñānaviṣayatve samāne vibhāgāvagamaḥ kāraṇabhedāditi cet ihāpi tat samānam| "saḥ ityākāreṇa smṛtiḥ jñānānumānāt bhidyāte iti cet, ko'yaṃ "saḥ" ityākāraḥ parokṣadeśakālaviśiṣṭatā iti cet, anumānādiṣvapi prasaṅgaḥ| pūrvānubhavasaṃbhinnateti cet, jñānānumāne pauruṣeyavākyajanyajñāne ca prasaṅgaḥ| tasmāt saṃskārajanyatvaṃ saḥ ityākāraḥ iti| astu tarhīhāpi tathāvidhaiva smṛtiriti, netyāha -- naceha iti|| na ca svapne ahaṃ nīlamiti gṛhyamāṇāvivekaḥ, smaryamāṇānāmanyonyāviveke parokṣameva sarvamasabhāsate; ato na pramāṇasmṛtidvairāśyameva jñānasya, kintu tṛtīyaṃ bhrāntijñānamapītyupasaṃharati -- ato nānyasaṃprayoge iti|| na cet smṛtiḥ kiṃ tarhi "idaṃ rajatami"ti nanu -- anyathākhyātireṣā| tathāhi -- śuktikāsaṃprayoge doṣopahatamindriyaṃ deśāntarādigataṃ rajatamabhigṛhṇāti| tacca svadeśādyavasthitaṃ doṣopahatendriyeṇa gṛhyamāṇaṃ śuktikātmanā gṛhyate| nanu ananubhūtamapi yat kiñcidapi doṣopahitamindriyaṃ kimiti na gṛhṇāti sādṛśyādidoṣasāmarthyāt iti vadāmaḥ| tasmāt grahaṇātmakamanyathājñānamiti|| ucyate; -- keyamanyathākhyātiḥ anyākāraṃ jñānamanyālambanaṃ vā vastuno vastvantarātmanāvabhāso vā anyathā pariṇate vastuni jñānaṃ vā na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ ityāha -- nanu evaṃ sati vaiparītyaṃ iti|| kuto vaiparītyamiti ata āha -- naitat savidanusāriṇāṃ iti|| sarvatra yadākāraṃ saṃvedanaṃ tadevālambanamiti niyame rajatākārasaṃvedanaviruddhaṃ śuktikālambanatvamityarthaḥ| nanu na saṃvidākāratā ālambanatā sarvatra, kintu saṃvitprayuktavyavahāraviṣayatā iti codayati -- nanu śukteḥ svarūpeṇāpi iti|| idaṃ tāvadayuktam; na hi vyāghrasarpādijñānāt daṇḍādiṣu ādīyamāneṣu vyāghrādijñānasya daṇḍādi ālambanam, na ca dravyaguṇādiṣu ādīyamāneṣu dravyādīnāmanyonyajñānālambanatvaṃ prasiddham; tasmāt tadākāra evālambanamiti nānyākāraṃ jñānamanyālambanamanyathākhyātiriti bahirevopasaṃhartavyam| astu tarhi vastuno vastvantarātmanāvabhāsaḥ iti; tatrāha -- atha tathārūpāvabhāsanaṃ iti|| na tāvadatyantabhedavādināṃ saṃsargaḥ paramārthaḥ, tataśca anirvacanīyānabhyupagamāt śūnya eva saṃsargaḥ prakāśeta| evaṃ "khaṇḍo gauḥ" ityādisaṃsargapratyayāḥ sarve eva vibhramāḥ prasajyeranniti, bahireva ekaḥ pakṣaḥ prativaktavyaḥ|| atha bhedābhedavādī saṃsargasatyatāṃ brūyāt, tatrāha -- yadi pāramārthikaṃ iti|| "khaṇḍo gau"rityādivat sarvasya bhedābhedāt na kvacidapi bhrāntibādhau, sarvatra vā tau syātāṃ ityarthaḥ| astu tarhi anyathāpariṇate vastuni khyātiḥ anyathākhyātiḥ, iti tatrāha -- atha śuktereva iti|| śukteḥ pariṇāmanirākaraṇagranthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| "atha punarduṣṭakāraṇajanyāyāḥ pratīteḥ" ityādinā anyathākhyātāveva pariṇāmaprakārabhedo nirākriyate, khyātyantaranirākaraṇaṃ vā; katham atrāha ātmakhyātivādī -- buddhereva rajatākāraḥ na bahiriti, kutaḥ saṃprayogavyatirekeṇāparokṣatvāt buddhivat, kathaṃ vijñānasya rajatākāraḥ prāptaḥ saṃskārasāmarthyāditi vadāmaḥ| tathāhi -- yasyāṃ jñānasantatau yadā kadācit pūrvaṃ rajatajñānamutpannaṃ tadeva saṃskāra ucyate| na ca vijñānajanyaḥ anyeṣāmiva sthāyī kṣaṇiko vā anyaḥ kaścit asya saṃskāro vidyate; vijñānamātravādāt| sa ca anekajñānavyavahito'pi kadācit sajjātīyaṃ rajatajñānāntaramutpādayati, śālibījamiva anekāṅkurādikāryavyavadhānena punaḥ sajātīyabījāntaranimittaṃ iti| athava -- tajjanyajñānasantāna eva saṃskāraḥ, sa ca tathāvidhajñānāntarāt iti anādivāsanāprāpitaṃ rajataṃ buddhyākāro bahirvadavabhāsate iti|| sa vaktavyaḥ -- kiṃ tadrajataṃ jāyate na vā iti| na cet, jāyamānasvarūpaṃ na syāt ākāśavat| jāyate cet, nā;rthāt arthāntarābhāvāt, atha jñānādeva duṣṭakāraṇajanyāt rajatotpādaḥ iti, tadāha -- atha punarduṣṭakāraṇajanyāyāḥ pratītereva rajatotpāda iti iti|| janakapratīteḥ rajatāt pūrvakālatvāt atadviṣayatvāt pratītyantarasyāduṣṭakāraṇasya tadviṣayatve sarvapratītiviṣayatvaprasaṅgāt, duṣṭakāraṇapratīteśca rajatajanyatayā tadālambanatve rajatasyārthakriyāvattayā sattvaprasaṅgāt atañjanyatve tadviṣayatvābhāvādapratītameva rajataṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| anyathākhyātiṃ nirākṛtya akhyātivādī svapakṣamupasaṃharati -- tadevaṃ pāriśeṣyāt iti|| akhyātidūṣaṇamapyuktamanusmārayati -- nanu smṛteḥ iti|| nanu na smṛtiḥ nāpi grahaṇaṃ cet, alaukikamidaṃ jñānaṃ kathaṃ iti codayati -- kā tarhi gatiriti| kiṃ sāmagryam tatrāha -- nendriyajajñānāt ityādinā|| nanu indriyasaṃskārau cetsāmagrī, samyagjñānamevedaṃ syāt, smṛtigrahaṇavaditi codayati -- kathametat iti|| doṣasahakṛtatvāt tṛtīyamidaṃ sāmagryamityāha -- ucyate kāraṇadoṣaḥ iti|| nanu doṣaḥ prāptakāryasya pratibandhakaḥ nādhikye heturiti, tatrāha -- kāryagamyatvāt iti|| na ca anādeḥ kāryānudayasya heturdoṣaḥ; kṛtyābhāvāt, kintu vyādhyādivat viparyayakāryaheturdoṣaḥ iti| nanu doṣaḥ saṃskārodbodhakṛccet na sāmagryāmantarbhavati iti na tṛtīyamidaṃ sāmagryamiti, tatrāha -- ataḥ saṃskāraduṣṭakāraṇasaṃvalitā iti|| atha jñānasyaikyaṃ codyate, tatrāha -- sā caikameva jñānaṃ iti|| nanu idamā saṃprayogādantaḥkaraṇapariṇāmajñānamekamutpadyate, na tat rajataṃ tatsaṃsargaṃ vā viṣayīkartumīṣṭe, mithyāvastuni deśāntarādigate vā saṃprayogānupapatteḥ, cakṣurunmīlanānvayavyatirekayoradhiṣṭhānajñānopakṣayādanyathāsiddheḥ, nāpi saṃskārāt rajatāṃśāvagamaḥ; smṛtyanabhyupagamāt, nāpi doṣaḥ svayameva kasya cij‌jñānasya heturdṛṣṭaḥ; jñānakāraṇānāmeva kāryaviśeṣanimittatvāt| ato na rajatatatsambhinnaśuktiviṣayamekaṃ jñānaṃ samāsti, kiṃ tu avidyaiva bāhyadoṣanimittakāraṇāpekṣayā rajatākāreṇa sākṣicaitanyasya rajatāvacchedajñānābhāsākāreṇa ca pariṇamamānā svakāryeṇa saha sākṣicaitanyasya viṣayabhāvaṃ pratipadyate iti te matam, tatra kathamekajñānatvaṃ iti tatrāha -- ekaphalaṃ iti|| viṣayāvacchinnaṃ hi phalamavabhāsate, na jñānāvacchinnam| viṣayaśca satyamithyāvastunoranyonyātmatayā ekatāmāpannaḥ, tena ekaviṣayāvacchinnaphalaikatvopādhau satyamithyājñānadvayamapi ekamityupacaryate iti bhāvaḥ| atha viṣayaḥ kathamiti tadāha -- tasya ca iti|| kuto rajatasya mithyātvaṃ iti ; ata āha -- tena mithyālambanaṃ iti|| bhāvābhāvajñānayoḥ mithyātvaprasiddhyabhāvāt idaṃ jñānasamavāyi mithyātvaṃ anirvacanīyārthatāmeva gamayatītyarthaḥ|| saṃprayukte'rthe saṃprayogo nirapekṣo jñānakāraṇam, saṃskāraśca pūrvānubhūtasmṛtau nirapekṣaḥ; tataśca nirapekṣakāraṇadvayajanyatvāt jñānadvayameva nirantarotpannaṃ iti akhyātivādī codayatī -- bhinnajātīyajñāneti| jñānabhede hi nirantarotpattāvapi na pravṛttikāryodayaḥ sambhavati; tatra yathā varṇajñāneṣu kramavartiṣu jñānakāryodayānyathānupapattyā pūrvapūrvavarṇasaṃskārasahitamantyavarṇajñānameva hetutvena kalpyate kāraṇayogapadyāya, tathā pravṛttikāryānupapattireva jñānaikyaṃ kalpayati kiṃ kāraṇabhedena iti pariharati -- naiṣa doṣaḥ iti|| nanu kāraṇabhedāt kāryabhedo'pyanumīyate iti, netyudāharaṇamāha -- dṛśyate hi iti|| nanu tatrāpi kāraṇabhedāt jñānabhedaḥ iti netyāha -- ubhayatrāpi iti|| nanu liṅgadarśanaṃ vyāptismṛtiśca liṅgajñānakāraṇaṃ, na saṃskāraḥ iti netyāha -- saṃskārānudbodhe iti|| jñānadvayayaugapadyābhāvādityarthaḥ| tasmāt ityupasaṃharati| nanu pratyabhijñāyāṃ saṃprayogaḥ pūrvānubhūtasmṛtiśca kāraṇaṃ, jñānadvayayaugapadyaprasaṅgābhāvāt na saṃskāraḥ iti tatrāha -- ayameva nyāyaḥ iti|| jñānājjñānāntarotpattau vyāptyādyabhāvāt saṃskāra eva kāraṇamityarthaḥ| nanu pramāṇāntareṣvayaṃ nirapekṣakāraṇasamāhāraḥ., nābhijñāpratyakṣe, abhijñāpratyakṣaṃ ca rajatajñānaṃ iti, tatrāha -- tathā bhinnajātīyajñānahetubhya iti|| nanu yatra saṃskāraḥ pramāṇakāraṇena saṃbadhyate, tatra smṛtigarbhapramāṇajñānameva dṛṣṭam, na tathedaṃ rajatajñānamiti, tatrāha -- tatra laiṅgikajñānetyādinā|| kiñca -- jñānadvayapakṣe akhyātau aparokṣāvabhāsinaḥ smaryamāṇatve, sarvatra pratipannopādhau viṣayasattvābhāve anyathākhyātau pratipannasya saṃsargasya śūnyatve purodeśapratipannasya rajatasya deśāntarasattve ca, ātmakhyātau bahiravabhāsasyāntaratve ca anubhavavirodhaḥ syāt, na tathā asmatpakṣe ityāha -- evaṃ ca sati nānubhavavirodhaḥ iti|| nanu tavāpi "asti" iti pratipannasyānirvacanīyatve anubhavavirodhaḥ samānaḥ, tanna idantāsaṃsargavat rajatasya śuktikāsattāsaṃsargo'yamavabhāsate, na rajatasyāparasattvam|| athavā -- trividhaṃ sattvaṃ paramārthasattvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, arthakriyāsāmarthyasattvaṃ māyopādhikamākāśādeḥ, avidyopādhikasattvaṃ rajatādeḥ sati paramārthasatt‌vāpekṣayā anirvacanīyamiti, nānubhavavirodhaḥ yathānubhavamarthasatt‌vābhyupagamāt|| yasmāt bhrāntitvavyavahāraḥ sadasajjñānayoranupapannaḥ, yataśca pakṣāntareṣvanubhavavirodhaḥ, yataśca jñānadvayapārokṣyasmṛtitvasmaraṇābhimāna pramoṣataddhetvavivekatannimittapravṛttayo janmāntarānubhūtasmṛtiśca iti apratipannamapūrvaṃ bahu kalpanīyamakhyātau, anyathākhyātau ca anyatra pratipannasyānyatra sattvaṃ indriyasya ca janmāntarānubhūtadeśakālavyavahitārthagrāhittvaṃ, doṣasya ca tathāvidhādṛṣṭasāmarthyaṃ saṃsargasya ca śūnyasya pratyakṣatā iti pramāṇaviruddhaṃ bahu kalpanīyaṃ, ataḥ sarvadoṣaparihārāya yathāpratipannasya mithyātvaṃ nāma ekaḥ svabhāvaḥ "nāsti rajataṃ, mithyaiva rajatamabhāt" ityanubhavasiddhaḥ samāśrayaṇīyaḥ, avidyopādānakalpanāyāśca anvayavyatirekasiddhatvādityāha -- ato māyāmayaṃ iti| satyasya vastuno mithyāvastusaṃbhedo'vabhāsamānaḥ māyā mithyā anirvacanīyakhyātiḥ; adhyāsa evāyaṃ ityarthaḥ|| atra kecidāhuḥ -- ato'vidyāmayamiti vaktavyaṃ, na māyāmayamiti| vibhramāṇāṃ tattvajñānanirākāryatayā avidyātmakatvāt, māyā'vidyayorbhedāt| tathā hi -- māyā svāśrayamavyāmohayantī karturicchāmanuvartate, na tathā avidyā| prasiddhaśca māyā'vidyayorbhedo laukikānām| na hi māyāvinirmitahastyaśvarathādāvavidyāśabdaṃ prayuñjate iti|| ucyate; -- lakṣaṇabhedāt, lokavyavahārasāmarthyādvā tayorbhedaḥ kathyate| na tāvat lakṣaṇabhedāt; anirvacanīyatayā tattvāvabhāsapratibandhaviparyayāvabhāsalakṣaṇasyāviśeṣāt| nanu mantrauṣadhādisatyavastveva māyā nānirvacanīyā, na;paridṛśyamānamithyāvastunyeva māyāśabdaprayogāt, pārśvasthasya mantrauṣadhādyaparijñānāt, tatra māyāśabdaprayogābhāvācca, mantrādeśca kācādivat nimittakāraṇatvāt adhyāsopādānāvidyāklṛptivat kādācitkamāyopādānanirvacanīyānādivastukalpanāt| tatra ca "māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ" iti śrutau prakṛtau māyāśabdaprayogāt prakṛtibhūtayormāyāvidyayoḥ tadvikārayośca adhyāsamāyayoḥ lakṣaṇābhedādekatvamavagamyate|| nanu svāśrayavyāmohāvyamohahetutvābhyāṃ lakṣaṇabhedo darśitaḥ, yadyāśrayo draṣṭā vyāmuhyatyeva pārśvastho māyāṃ paśyan; atha kartā, na tasya māyāvitvāt vyāmohābhāvaḥ, kintu bādhaniścayapratīkārajñānābhyām; anyathā pārśvasthavat kartāpi vyāmuhyedeva| athecchayā kartuṃ śakyate māyā na tathā avidyeti, na tadapi -- mantrauṣadhādau nimittakāraṇe kartuḥ svātantryāt, na māyāyām, avidyāyāmapi aṅgulyavaṣṭambhādinā dvicandrakeśoṇḍrakādibhramāḥ mantrauṣadhādiniṣevaṇāt svapnabhramāḥ tattvajñāne'pyanuvṛttapratibhāsāśca karturicchayā niṣpādyante|| na ca śāstravyavahārāt māyāvidyābhedaḥ; "tasyābhidhyānādyojanāttattvabhāvāt bhūyaścānte viśvamāyānivṛttiḥ" ityādiśrutau samyagjñānanivartyāvidyāyāṃ māyāśabdaprayogāt, "taratyavidyāṃ vitatāṃ hṛdi yasmin niveśite| yogī māyāmameyāya tasmai vidyātmane namaḥ||" ityādismṛtau māyāvidyayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena tattvajñānena tartavyatvābhidhānāt, "māyāmātraṃ tu kātrsnyenānabhivyaktasvarūpatvāt" iti sūtre sūtrakāreṇa svapne māyāśabdaprayogāt, bhāṣyakāreṇa ca avidyā māyā avidyātmikā māyāśaktiḥ iti tatra tatra nirdeśāt, ṭīkākāreṇa ca "avidyā māyā'kṣaram" ityuktatvāt| brahmasiddhikāreṇa ca -- "evameveyamavidyā māyā mithyāpratyayaḥ" ityuktatvāt| tasmāt lakṣaṇaikyāt vṛddhavyavahāre ca ekatvāvagamādekasminnapi vastuni vikṣepaprādhānyena māyā, ācchādanaprādhānyena avidyeti vyavahārabhedaḥ| icchādhīnatvatadvaiparītyena vā vyavahārabhedaḥ iti yuktaṃ māyāmayamiti|| astu tarhi pratipannopādhāveva yathāpratipatti paramārthasattvaṃ; kalpanāgauravādidoṣaparihārāditi, netyāha -- atha punaḥ iti|| nanu kāraṇadoṣavatāmeva tat dṛśyamiti, netyāha -- yato na hi iti|| tadabhāve na tatra iti|| sarvatra paramārtharajate ityarthaḥ| ātmāśrayāvidyātmakatve'pi sarvaireva gṛhyeteti ; netyāha -- māyāmātratve iti|| prasiddhamāyāvaditi bhāvaḥ| idamākārāvacchinnasākṣicaitanyasamāśritasya rajatasya śuktikāsaṃbhedo'pyavidyātmaka iti, sukhādivadananyavedyatvamiti bhāvaḥ| jñānasyaiva bhrāntitvaprasiddhyanupapattiḥ kalpanālāghavānubhavābhyāmanugṛhītā mithyārthajñānatāṃ gamayatītyuktam, idānīṃ bādhakapratyakṣaṃ svayameva rajatasya mithyātvaṃ pratipādayatītyāha -- kiñca nedaṃ rajataṃ iti|| nanu pratipannopādhau rajatāderabhāvaṃ bādho bodhayati na tasya mithyātvamiti codayati -- kathaṃ iti| pratipannopādhāvabhāvapratiyogitayā avabhāsate iti pratyakṣaṃ ityāha -- tena hi tasya iti| bādhakajñānasiddhasya pratipannopādhāvabhāvapratiyogitvalakṣaṇasya mithyātvasya punaḥ svaśabdena parāmarśācca bādhaviṣayo mithyātvamityāha -- nedaṃ rajataṃ mithyaiva iti| nanu deśakālāntarabuddhiṣu sattvādapi rajatasyaivaṃ bādhaḥ saṃpatsyate iti; netyāha -- naca tat kenacit rūpeṇa iti| nedaṃ rajataṃ kintu tadrajataṃ buddhirvā iti syāt parāmarśaḥ, na mithyaiva iti; smṛtigrahaṇāvivekatvādrogavayādāviva ityabhiprāyaḥ|| nanu -- koyaṃ bādho nāma anyārthino'nyatra pravṛttinirodhaḥ ! tarhi yatra rajatādau parivrājakādeḥ pravṛtterevānudayaḥ, tatra bādhaprasiddhiḥ na syāt; prasiddhaśca tatrāpi bādhaḥ| na pravṛttivicchedo bādhaḥ; kintu pravṛttiyogyatāvicchedaścet, na; punarapi tatraiva rajatāvivekādanyadā pravṛttidarśanāt yogyatā'vicchedāt, udakajñānācca pravartamānasya sarpacorādidarśanena pravṛttinirodhe sarpādijñānādudakajñānasya bādhaprasiddhiḥ syāt| aviviktatayā pratipannasya viveko bādhaḥ iti cet, na; sarvapadārtheṣu prathamamaviviktatayā pratipanneṣu pañcāditaretarāpekṣayā bhedajñānaṃ sarvatra bādhaḥ syāt| na ca padārthajñānameva bhedajñānam; gṛhītamātrasya sati bhede avivekābhāvaprasaṅgādityuktam| anyātmanā pratipannasya itaretarābhāvapratipattirbādhaḥ iti cet, śuklo ghaṭa iti pratipadya ghaṭasya śauklyaṃ na dravyaṃ guṇaḥ iti jñānaṃ sarvatra bādhaḥ syāt na tathā prasiddhirasti; samānau ca sarvatra bhedābhedau iti aikyaṃ pratipadya bhedapratipattiḥ sarvatra bādhaḥ syāt| na ca jñānasya pradhvaṃso bādhaḥ; svayaṃ kṣaṇikatvāt| arthasya ca saṃvidviṣayasyānyasya vā jñānena pradhvaṃsāyogāt, bādhasya ca lokaprasiddhatvāt| tasmāt na bādhaṃ paśyāmaḥ|| ucyate; -- ajñānasya svakāryeṇa vartamānena pravilīnena vā saha jñānena nivṛttirbādhaḥ, tathāvidhānavabodhanivṛttau bādhaprasiddheriti|| smṛtirūpaśabdena kāraṇatritayajanyatvamuktam| tatra kāraṇatritayajanyo'nyasyānyātmanāvabhāso lakṣaṇam, tadidaṃ lakṣyaṃ na vyāpnotīti codayati -- nanu na vyāpakaṃ iti|| kathaṃ lakṣaṇāṃśasyābhāvaḥ iti tatrāha -- na hi svapnaśokādau iti|| saṃprayogasya kāraṇāṃśasyādhiṣṭhānāṃśasya cābhāvādityarthaḥ| kastarhi svapnaḥ iti tadāha, ata eva iti|| tatra vāsanājanyasmṛtimātratve bhrāntiprasiddhiḥ gavayādismṛtivat na syāt iti pariharati -- na tāvat smṛtitvaṃ iti|| nanuB kāraṇatritayābhāvāt na jñānāntaramapītyāha -- nanu smṛtirūpatvamapi na iti|| kāraṇatritayajanyatvamanyasyānyātmanāvabhāsaṃ ca sampādayāmītyāha -- atrocyate iti|| samprayogābhāvādaparokṣāvabhāsitvāt grahaṇasmṛtimātratve pratyukte tṛtīyamidaṃ vijñānaṃ svayamevoktādhyāsalakṣaṇaṃ gamayituṃ samarthamiti vadituṃ prakārāntaraṃ paryudāsyati -- uktametat iti|| svapnaprapañcaviparītapramātrādivijñānasādhanasyāntaḥkaraṇasya nidrādidoṣapūrvānubhavasaṃskārasahitasya saṃpratipannakāraṇatritayatvāt yuktaṃ smṛtirūpaṃ bhrāntijñānamityāha -- tadiha nidrādidoṣopaplutaṃ iti|| kathaṃ paratra parāvabhāsaḥ iti tadāha -- tasya ca iti|| nidrādidoṣasaṃskāropaplutenāntaḥkaraṇena mithyādhyāsanimittakāraṇenāvacchinnacaitanyasthā avidyāśaktiḥ puṣkalanimittakāraṇasaṃsargādadhyāsaṃ prati puṣkalakāraṇatāmāpadyamānā mithyārthālambanākāreṇa vivartate iti, caitanyameva svāvidyāyā vivartate| ataḥ satyasya vastuno mithyāvastusaṃbhedāvabhāsa lakṣaṇaḥ paratra parāvabhāso vidyate iti bhāvaḥ| tathā jāgaraṇe'pi bāhyādhiṣṭhānāṃśasaṃsṛṣṭāntaḥkaraṇāvacchinnatayā bāhyādhiṣṭhānasaṃsṛṣṭacaitanyasyāvidyāśaktiḥ bāhyādhiṣṭhānasaṃsṛṣṭarajatādyākāreṇa vivartata iti, śuktikādyavacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ rajatādyālambanamiti bāhyālambanaṃ rajatādi kathyate| sarvatra tu caitanyameva sākṣādvā anyāvacchinnatayā vā vibhramālambanamiti, yuktaḥ "paratra parāvabhāsaḥ" ityarthaḥ|| ākāśavat sarvaviṣayoparaktatayā sarvatrāvabhāsamānamātmānamanādṛtya ahamityevāvacchinnamātmānamupādāya codayati -- nanvevaṃ satyantarameva iti|| ātmaivādhiṣṭhānaṃ cet, idaṃ rajataṃ itivat ahaṃ nīlaṃ ityeva svapnaprapañco bhāyādityarthaḥ| niṣkṛṣṭāhaṅkāraṃ caitanyamātramātmānamādāya cetyasya ca citsāmānādhikaraṇyāvabhāsaṃ sarvatrāṅgīkṛtya pariharati -- ko vā brūte iti|| punarapi ahaṅkārāvacchinnamātmānamādāya codayati -- nanu vicchinnadeśaḥ iti|| idamiti pṛthaktvāvabhāso'pyantarevetyāha -- nanu deśo'pi iti|| anavacchinnacaitanyasaṃsṛṣṭatayaiva bhedāvabhāso'pīti bhāvaḥ| ahaṅkārāvacchinnamādāya ahaṃ bhedaḥ ityapi pratīyādityāha -- ayamapi iti|| nigūḍhābhisandhireva pūrvamuttaramuktvā, idānīṃ sarvato viprasṛtaṃ caitanyaṃ sarvātmanā prakāśamānamātmānaṃ spaṣṭīkurvannāha naiṣa doṣaḥ jāgaraṇe'pi iti|| prātibhāsikabhedamantareṇa pramāṇato na bhidyate ityarthaḥ| nanu ahamavacchinnacaitanyādanyānyeva viṣayagatacaitanyāni kiṃ na syuḥ iti ata āha -- anyathā jaḍasya iti|| svayaṃ caitanyahīnā viṣayā ātmāvagatiprakāśenāpi na saṃsṛjyante cet mayāvagatāḥ iti sambandhāvabhāso na syādityarthaḥ|| sarvatra caitanyāvaguṇḍhane'pi -- "ahaṃ idaṃ" iti ca ātmānātmāno vibhaktāviti pratibhāsaḥ katham iti tatrāha -- yaḥ punaḥ iti|| nanu caitanyameva sarvatra antarbahirbhedādirūpeṇāvabhāsate cet, kathaṃ tasyākhaṇḍādvitīyatā iti cetyabhedoparāganimittabhedamantareṇa svarūpabhedānavagamāt ityāha -- tasya ca niraṃśasya iti|| niraṃśadravyasyāṇutvamanantatvaṃ vā syāt, madhyamaparimāṇaṃ cedaṃ caitanyaṃ sarvatrāvabhāsate; na ca niraṃśaṃ madhyamaparimāṇaṃ iti| paropādhiparimāṇaṃ caitanyamityarthaḥ| jāgaraṇepyevam| kimu vaktavyaṃ svapnasya caitanyādhiṣṭhānatvamityarthaḥ|| kevalasya manaso bahiḥpratyakṣasādhanatvābhāvāt atha vā iti aṅgīkaraṇavādaḥ| avyāptiḥ parihṛtā, idānīṃ mithyādhyāsabhrāntyavidyāprasiddhyabhāve'pi anyasyānyāvabhāso vidyate iti lakṣaṇasyātivyāptimāha -- kathaṃ tarhi nāmādiṣu iti|| anyasyānyātmatājñānaṃ adhyāsalakṣaṇam, iyaṃ tu anyasyānyatra mānasī kriyā iti ativyāptiṃ pariharati -- satyamata eva codanāvaśāt iti|| nanu jñānameva tatra vidhīyate iti, netyāha -- na hi jñānam iti|| vidhijanyapuruṣecchāprayatnanirapekṣameva sarvatra jñānasya puṣkalakāraṇam; anicchato'pyaniṣṭajñānadarśanāt, ato vidhānāt mānasī kriyeti bhāvaḥ|| "nanu smṛtijñānaṃ" ityārabhya "taṃ kecit" ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanvadhyāse vādivipratipattidarśanāt na ekarūpeṇa lakṣaṇaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyate ityāśaṅkya adhiṣṭhānādhyasyamānayoḥ svarūpatattvadeśakālaviśeṣeṣveva vādināṃ vipratipattiḥ, anyasyānyātmatāvabhāsamātre lakṣaṇe na vipratipattiḥ| tacca lakṣaṇaṃ laukikasāmānyaviśeṣādisaṃsargapratyayānāṃ bhramatvaprāptiparihārāya satyasya mithyāvastusambhedāvabhāsaḥ iti balādāpatati ityaṅgīkṛtya matāntarāṇyupanyasyati -- taṃ kecidityādinā|| prathamastu ātmakhyātyanyathākhyātiviśeṣayoḥ, dvitīyastu akhyāteḥ, tṛtīyastu śukteḥ svābhāvarajatātmanā khyātiriti śūnyakhyātyanyathākhyātiviśeṣayorupanyāsaḥ| kalpanāṃ ityasya vyākhyā avidyamānasyaivāvabhāsamānatāṃ iti| yallakṣaṇamavādiṣma iti pūrvalakṣaṇaśabdena yacchabdasya sambandhaḥ| akhyātivādināpi mānasaṃ saṃsargajñānaṃ saṃsargābhimāno vā vaktavyaḥ ityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu smṛtirūpatayā kāraṇatritayajanyatvamupekṣitamiti , netyāha -- pūrvadṛṣṭatveti|| nanu avidyādidoṣapūrvabhramasaṃskārābhyāmeva padārthamātrajñānāni jāyamānāni vibhramāḥ, na satyaṃ vastu tatsaṃprayogādi pramāṇakāraṇaṃ cāpekṣate vibhramaḥ iti, paratretipadamavivakṣitamiti śūnyavādī manyate, tatrāha -- smṛtirūpaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭāvabhāsaḥ iti|| na padārthamātrajñānaṃ vibhramaḥ; śūnyajñānasyāpi tathātvaprasaṅgāt, kintvanyatrānyajñānam; tataśca avibhrame'pi padārthajñāne lakṣaṇavyāpteḥ nirupapattikatvamiti| kathaṃ nirupapattiko'yaṃ ityādigranthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu saṃvidrajatayoritaretarādhiṣṭhānatvena sādhiṣṭhāne bhrame sambhavati na tṛtīyasya satyavastuno'dhiṣṭhānatvakalpanā yukteti codayati -- nanu rajate saṃviditi|| nanu adhyasyamānavyatirekeṇa adhiṣṭhānasya siddhirvaktavyā, tatra itaretarādhiṣṭhānatve satītaretarāpekṣasiddhitvādasamañjasaṃ syāditi, tatrāha -- bījāṅkurādivaditi|| na būjāṅkurādiṣvitaretarāśrayatā, kintu kāraṇaparamparayā anavastheti pariharati -- naitat sāramiti|| nanvihāpi kāraṇaparampareti, netyāha -- iha punaryasyāmiti|| nanvihāpi tarhi rajate saṃvit, rajataṃ pūrvasyāṃ saṃvidi sā ca svaviṣaye, tat ca pūrvasaṃvidi iti paramparāmevaṃ kalpayāmīti -- cet, yadi tāvat pūrvapūrvamuttarottarasyānvitatvenādhiṣṭhānaṃ syāt, tataḥ pūrvasya pūrvasyottarasminnuttarasminnadhyāse yugapadavasthānāt kṣaṇikatvahāniḥ| nanu bījāṅkurādāvanyonyopādānatve'pi na yugapadavasthānaṃ dṛśyate iti, tatrāha -- bījāṅkurādiṣvapīti|| abhimatavastusiddhiḥ-anvayikāraṇatvasiddhirityarthaḥ; ananviteṣu bījādiṣvanvayikāraṇākāṅkṣāyā anivṛttatvādityarthaḥ| ataḥ anvayidravyameva tatrāpyupādānam; bījāderanyo'nyanimittanaimittikateti bhāvaḥ| ihāpi tarhi pūrvasyottaraṃ pratyananvitatvenaivādhyāsanimittatā bījādivaditi, netyāha -- kuta idamevamiti paryanuyoge dṛṣṭatvādevamiti|| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- bījāṅkurayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasya dṛṣṭatvādadṛṣṭe'pi tayoreva kāryakāraṇaparamparā dṛṣṭaparamparātvāt na anavasthādoṣamāvahati, saṃvidrajatayoradhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭheyatayā nimittanaimittikabhāvasya prathamameva kalpyatvāt tayoreva pūrvapūrvanimittanaimittikabhāvakalpanā tu andhaparamparaiva syāditi| dṛṣṭaparamparāmeva darśayati -- dṛṣṭatvādevamiti|| tatraivadūraṃ veti|| nānavasthādoṣamativarteta iti|| andhaparamparāmevetyarthaḥ|| d‌vyākārāvabhāsattvāt sarvabhramāṇāṃ paratra parāvabhāsa eva bhramaḥ ityuktam| bhrāntijñānapratipannaviṣaye'rthe bhrāntyaṃśāntarābhāvaviśiṣṭāṃśāntarajñānasya bādhakatvācca sādhiṣṭhāno bhramaḥ ityāha -- api ca na kvaciditi|| nanu anumānāptavacanābhyāṃ sarpābhāvamātramapi kadācidgamyate, na tadabhāvaviśiṣṭamaṃśāntaramiti, tatrāha -- yatrāpyanumānāditi|| tatrāpyabhāvaviśiṣṭaṃ vastumātraṃ gṛhyate; viśeṣākāṅkṣādarśanāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu pradhānaṃ nāstītyādau na tadabhāvaviśiṣṭaṃ vastvantaraṃ gṛhyate, teṣāmanyatrānadhyastatvāditi, tatrāha -- pradhānadiṣvapīti|| athavā -- sarvabhramāvabhāseṣu ca sākṣicaitanyasyālambanasya vidyamānatvāt śaṅkyamānaniradhiṣṭhānaniravadhikabhramabādhe'pi sākṣyevādhiṣṭhānamavadhiśca vidyate ityāha -- atha vā sarvalokasākṣikamiti|| nanu arthabādhayā jñānasyāpi bādhāt bhramabādhe tadavabhāsisākṣicaitanyamapi bādhyeteti, tatrāha -- tadbādhe tadanuṣaṅga eveti|| adhiṣṭhānatvenāpi pariśeṣādati bhāvaḥ| ataḥ ityupasaṃhāraḥ| tadeva prapañcayati -- tena tanmātrasyeti|| sādhiṣṭhānabhramasādhanaprasaṅgenādhyastasyāpi śūnyatāṃ nirācaṣṭe -- nāpyadhyastamapyasaditi|| pratyakṣataḥ "rajataṃ" iti viśeṣapratibhāsāprayogaprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ; pratibhāsamātranirākaraṇe śūnyaṃ na bhāsate iti vākyasyābodhakatvaprasaṅgāt|| nanu adhyastaṃ sarvaṃ śūnyameveti te'pi matamiti codayati -- nanu iti|| śūnyāt vyāvṛttirapi bhramasya kathitaivetyāha -- ka evamāheti|| sadvyāvṛttimātraṃ bhramasyāsattvaṃ nāma, na śūnyatvam; niṣedhapratiyogitvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu -- bhramasya svakāle anirvacanīyatve'pi bādhādūrdhvaṃ śūnyatvamaviśiṣṭamiti śaṅkate -- atha punariti|| sarvavādināṃ sarvaṃ vastu svakāle vartamānamapi vināśādūrdhvaṃ śūnyameveti sammatam, ato na doṣaḥ ityāha -- kāmamiti|| nanu bhavatu nāma sarvasya vastuno vināśādūrdhvaṃ śūnyatā, na vibhramagṛhītaṃ vastu bādhādūrdhvaṃ śūnyaṃ bhavati, kintu deśāntarādigataṃ iti cet, tatra kiṃ bādhakajñānameva rajatāderdeśāntare sattvaṃ gamayati kiṃ vā iha bādhānupapattiḥ iti na tāvat bādhakajñānamityāha -- tathā ca bādhakājñānamiti|| nedaṃ rajataṃ kintu deśakālāntare buddhau vā ityanavagamāditi bhāvaḥ| yāvadabhidhānasāmarthyaṃ hi vākyamarthaṃ pratipādayati, deśāntaravartitvaṃ tu anabhihitaṃ na vākyārthaḥ ityarthaḥ|| evaṃ sati pratipannasya vastunaḥ atrābhāvaḥ anyatra sattvamantareṇānupapannaḥ, ityarthāpattyā vākyaṃ gamayiṣyatīti, netyāha -- nārthāpattyeti|| anyathākhyātau niṣiddhasya saṃsargasya ātmakhyātau bahiṣṭṛsya vā anyatra sattvamantareṇa niṣedhadarśanāt| akhyātāvapi ṛtvigvicchede sarvasvadānakartavyatābuddhau ṛtvigvicchedāntaranimittādakṣiṇayāgasamāptivijñānabādhitāyāṃ na sarvasvadānakartavyatā tatra pratipannā anyatra satīti kalpyate| pravṛttireva tatra nirudhyate iti cet, na -- pravṛttinirodho na bādhaḥ ityuktatvāt, yāgādiṣu ca pravartamānasya rājacorādipratibandhaniścayāt pravṛttinirodhe'pi yāgādibuddhau bādhaprasiddhyabhāvāt, satyāṃ cābādhitakartavyatābuddhau yadā kadācit pravṛttisiddheḥ|| kiñca loke'pi pratipannopādhāveva yasya niṣedhaḥ, tasya niṣedhopādhisajātīyopādhyantare sattvaṃ na kalpyate ityāha -- iha bhagnaghaṭābhāvavaditi|| yathā pratipannadeśe niṣiddhasya ghaṭasya na deśāntare sattvam, evaṃ pratipannadeśakālavastusarvopādhau niṣiddhasya na pratiyogittvenāpratipannasarvopādhau sattvasiddhirityarthaḥ| nanu kathaṃ sarvatra śūnyasya pratipattiḥ iti tatrāha -- tanmātreṇāpi tatsiddheriti|| atraiva anirvacanīyamithyāvastusadbhāvamātreṇāpi tasyāḥ pratīteḥ siddherityarthaḥ|| nanu tarhi "pūrvaṃ rajatamabhūdidānīṃ na" iti ghaṭavat kālabhedena niṣedhaḥ syāt,na -- laukikaparamārtharajatasyātra kālatraye'pi śūnyatvāt tadapekṣayā nirupādhikaniṣedhasiddheḥ| nirupādhika niṣedha sāmarthyācca pratipannaṃ mithyā rajatamiti bādhānantaraṃ parāmṛśyate -- "mithyaiva rajatamabhāt" iti; anyathā kālabhede satyarajatameva syāt "nāyaṃ sarpaḥ" ityabhāvamātraviṣayā hi pratyakṣapratipattiḥ na deśāntare sarpasattvaṃ gamayati, kimu vaktavyaṃ -- "rajjuriyaṃ" ityadhiṣṭhāne paryavasitā pratītiḥ na kalpayatīti darśayati -- yatrāpi sarpabādhapūrvakaḥ iti|| tadevaṃ ityādyupasaṃhāraḥ| yadyevaṃ paratra ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| satyaṃ vispaṣṭārthaṃ|| ityasya ayamarthaḥ -- smṛtirūpaśabdena kiṃ saṃskārajanyatvaṃ, pūrvānubhavasambhedo vā, smṛtyā sādṛśyaṃ bhrānterabhidhīyate iti viśaye saṃskārajanyatvameveti spaṣṭīkaraṇārthaṃ pūrvadṛṣṭasyāvabhāsaḥ na darśanasyetyuktamiti| pūrvadṛṣṭasajātīyetyarthaḥ; anirvacanīyarajatābhyupagamāt| bhrāntiścet satyasya vastuno; mithyāvastusambhedāvabhāsaḥ anyathā atiprasaṅgāt ityādyā yā yuktirabhihitā; lokānubhavasiddhatvādadhyāsasya| tathāpi yuktyā na prayojanamityāha -- tathā ca loke anubhavaḥ ityādinā|| nanu "śuktikā" "rajatavat iti" ca vacanaṃ na bhrāntyapekṣayā upapadyate; idaṃ rajataṃ ityevāvabhāsanāt| na ca bādhāpekṣayā, tatra vatkaraṇābhāvāt iti codayati -- nanu na śuktiketi|| bādhakajñānāpekṣayā śuktikā rajatavabhāsate iti lakṣaṇapradarśanaṃ bādhakajñānaviṣayatayā vā tatsāmarthyena vā siddhasyādhyāsamithyātvasya lakṣyasya vacchabdena abhidhānaṃ iti lakṣyalakṣaṇasaṅgatiranena vākyena tatra pradarśyate ityāha -- ucyate śuktikāgrahaṇamiti|| nanu mithyā rajatamiti viśeṣaṇādanyatra satyarajataṃ vaktavyamiti, netyāha -- mithyātvamapi rajatasyeti|| svarūpaparaṃ viśeṣaṇam nānyavyāvṛttiparamityarthaḥ| nanu rajatasya mithyātve taddharmatvādidantāyā api mithyātvāt sarvamithyātvena niradhiṣṭhānatāprasaṅgaḥ iti, netyāha -- tatrāsaṃprayuktatvāditi| kathaṃ tasyāsamprayuktasya rajatasyāparokṣatete, ata āha -- aparokṣāvabhāsastviti|| udāharaṇadvayasya tātparyamāha -- tatra śuktikodāharaṇenetyādinā|| asmadarthe-ahamiti pratibhāse ityarthaḥ| pratibhāsato yuṣmadarthatvābhāvepi cidavabhāsyatvaṃ nāma yuṣmadarthalakṣaṇamastītyāha -- tadabhāvasyatveneti|| advitīyacaitanyaprakāśātmani draṣṭari ahaṅkārādisaṅghātasyādhyastatvāt adhyasyamānavyatiriktamadhiṣṭhānamadhyāsādhiṣṭhānayāthātmyaviṣayapramāṇajñānaṃ dṛṣṭā ceti tritayamātmeti vaktavyam; tataśca adhiṣṭhānagato doṣaḥ, draṣṭurdoṣaḥ, pramākaraṇadoṣo vā sarvaṃ doṣajātamātmanyeveti vaktavyam; tadabhāvāt caitanyasyādhyāsaviṣayajñānasyājanyatvāt kāraṇatritayajanyavijñānasyātmanyanātmādhyāse'sambhavāt agṛhītaviśeṣasya sāmānyagrahaṇasyādhiṣṭhānatvanimittasyātmanyasambhavāt "paratre"tyayogāt ca na adhyāsalakṣaṇaṃ bahiruktamapyātmani sambhavatīti codayati -- nanu bahirarthe ityādinā ucyate ityataḥ praktanena granthena|| nanu ihāpi bahirarthavadagṛhītaviśeṣatvamarthatvasāmānyādanumīyatāmiti, netyāha -- na tviha kāraṇāntarāyatteti|| nanu svabhāvavabhāse'pi saṃvedanavadagṛhītaviśeṣāṃśo'pi syāditi; netyāha -- niraṃśasyeti| madhyamaparimāṇanirākaraṇādaṇurananto vā ātmā niraṃśaḥ iti|| nanu niraṃśo'pyākāśādivanna kātrsnyenāvabhāsate iti, tatrāha -- svayaṃjyotiṣa iti|| yāvatsattvamavabhāsabhāvādityarthaḥ| kutaḥ "atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ" "ātmaivāsya jyotiḥ" ityādiśruteḥ| nanu jyotiriti prakāśaguṇamātraṃ nābhidhīyate; ātmano guṇatvaprasaṅgāt, ataḥ prakāśaguṇavat dravyaṃ jyotiriti, janyajñānenāpi prakāśena ātmā prakāśaguṇa iti "jyotirātme"ti na virudhyate, naitatsāram; sarvabhāvānāmanyanimittaprakāśasaṃsargitvādātmanyapi tatprasaṅganirākaraṇāya svayaṃjyotiriti viśeṣaṇopapatteḥ, "ātmaivāsya jyoti"riti caivakārāt| nanu kārakāntarānapekṣatayā svayameva svātmani jñānaṃ janayatīti svayamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ kiṃ na syāt na; jyotiṣṭvasyaiva viśeṣyatvāt tatra kārakatvasya viśeṣyatayā apratibhāsāt|| kiñca jñānajanmaprayuktatvāt kārakāpekṣāyāḥ tadabhāve apekṣaiva nāstīti| nanu jñānaprayuktaṃ janmāpi vidyate, na prakāśaguṇatvaprayuktameva; dravyajanmavyatireke svadravyopādhau janmābhāvasya pradīpādau dṛṣṭatvāt, atrāpi jyotiḥśabdādātmani prakāśaguṇasya janmābhāvaniścayāt| na cāntaḥkaraṇe'pi prakāśaguṇodayo jñānapariṇāmaḥ; svabhāvata eva prakāśaguṇavaddravyasyāntaḥkaraṇasyaiva viśeṣapariṇāmasya jñānatvābhyupagamāt| na ca jñānamapi kvacijjanmavat dṛṣṭam| dṛṣṭamantaḥkaraṇe iti cet, na; jñāturarthaprakāśasya jñānatvāt, tasya cātmāśrayatvāt, antaḥkaraṇapariṇāme jñānatvopacārāt|
