na ca -- jñānamātmāśrayaṃ dravyamiti -- yuktam; tasyaiva prakāśaguṇattvenātmano jyotiṣṭvahānāt jaḍaprakāśaguṇo na janyaḥ, citprakāśaguṇo janya iti cet, na; prakāśatvaprayuktatvāt svadravyopādhau janmābhāvasya| darpaṇādau vidyamānaprakāśasyaiva tirodhānanirākaraṇaṃ kriyate, pradīpādiṣu tu dravyameva jāyate, na prakāśaguṇaḥ| prajñānaghanaśabdācca caitanyajyotirātmā na jaḍajyotiriti gamyate; "vijñānamānandaṃ" "prajñānaṃ brahma" ityādivacanācca| jñānamiti jñātṛtvamucyate, na bhāvārthaḥ iti cet, na -- bhāvārthe prasiddhivirodhāt śabdasya| kiñca pratikṣaṇaṃ prakāśaguṇakalpanāt varamekasyaiva guṇasya sthāyitvakalpanam| ātmani prakāśaguṇavyatirekābhāvācca nāgantukatve pramāṇamiti|| nanu ātmanyagṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvamanubhavasiddhaṃ iti codayati -- nanu brahmasvarūpamiti|| tarhi śuktikāyāmiva brahmaṇyevānavabhāsaviparyayau syātām, na jīve ityāha -- na tadanavabhāsanāditi|| nanu kāryakāraṇabhāvahīnayoḥ dravyayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamekadravyaniṣṭham; "soyaṃ devadatta" itivat, ato dravyaikatvāt jīvagatāvevānavabhāsaviparyayāviti codayati -- nanu na brahmaṇo'nyaḥ iti|| tarhi jñānaprakāśavirodhādāśrayaviṣayabhedābhāvācca nājñātatā brahmaṇa ityāha -- evaṃ tarhīti|| tatra advitīyādhiṣṭhānabrahmātmani pramāṇasya caitanyasyāvidyākāraṇadoṣasaṃsargaṃ prathamaṃ darśayati -- ucyate vidyate eveti|| pratyakṣānumānārthapattipradarśitājñānasya śrutitadarthāpattibhyāṃ pradarśanaṃ kriyate -- śrutistāvaditi|| suṣupte mithyājñānābhāvāt tatsaṃskārasya cāpratibandhakatvāt kādācitkagrahaṇābhāvasya ca svatassiddhagrahaṇavirodhitvābhāvāt svarūpacaitanyenaiva brahmasvarūpāvabhāse prāpte tadavabhāsapratibandhanimittamanṛtaṃ darśayati -- "anṛtena hi pratyūḍhāḥ" "ta ime satyāḥ kāmā anṛtāpidhānāḥ" iti| tataśca mithyājñānatatsaṃskārāgrahaṇakarmabhyo vyatiriktamanavabhāsanimittamanṛtaṃ mithyāvastu siddham| "anīśayā śocati muhyamānaḥ" iti svabhāvasiddheśvarasyānīśvaratvaṃ tadbhāvāpratipattireva; vastuno'napāyāt, tataśceśvarabhāvāpratipatteḥ śokasya ca nimittaṃ mohaṃ darśayati| ādiśabdāt "na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajānānyat yuṣmākamantaraṃ babhūva| nīhāreṇa prāvṛtā jalpyācāsutṛpa ukthaśāsaścaranti" iti| nīhāraṃ tamo'jñānamityanarthāntaram| tena prāvṛtatvameva jīvānāṃ brahmāparijñāne japlyatvādyadhyāse ca nimittaṃ darśayati| tathā "avidyāyāmantare vartamānā nānyacchreyo vedayante" iti śreyorūpabrahmāparijñāne kriyākārakādyadhyāse ca nimittabhūtāmavidyāṃ darśayantītyādyāḥ, "ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tena muhyantī"tyādyāḥ smṛtayo'pi draṣṭavyāḥ|| arthāpattirapi -- brahmajñānāt bandhanivṛttiḥ śrūyamāṇā brahmaṇi prāganavabodho'dhyāsasambandhaheturastīti kalpayatīti phalaśrutyanupapattiḥ, athavā "draṣṭavyaḥ" ityādidarśanavidhānānupapattirvā prāganavagamamantareṇeti, jīvasya brahmasvarūpānavabhāsanimittaṃ jīvāśrayādhyāsasambandhaheturajñānadoṣo vidyate ityuktam| atra ca sākṣivedyasyājñānasya pramāṇairabhāvavyāvṛttiḥ pradarśyate iti na tasya pramāṇavedyatvaprasaṅgaḥ iti| tatra codayati -- nanu na jīvo brahmaṇo'nya iti| kimatra jīvabrahmaṇorekatvāt paryanuyujyate kimekatvādāśrayaviṣayabhedānupapattiḥ kiṃ vā citsvabhāvasyāvidyāśrayatvavirodhaḥ brahmaṇo vā sarvajñatvādihāniḥ iti| na tāvadajñānamāśrayaviṣayabhedāpekṣam, kintu ekasminneva vastunyāśrayatvamāvaraṇañceti kṛtyadvayaṃ sampādayati; svāśrayāpavarakapradeśe kṛtyadvayasampāditamovat; akriyātmakatvādāvaraṇatvācca| na hi tamo vastudvayāpekṣamavabhāsate| ajñānamiti ca dvayāpekṣajñānaparyudāsenābhidhānāt dvayasāpekṣavadavabhāsate| yathā sthitiragamanaśabdenābhidhīyamānā kasya kiṃviṣayamagamanamiti karmasāpekṣavadbhāti; tadvat| tamovacca svāśrayāvaraṇamajñānaṃ svāśrayaikatvena na virudhyate| nāpi svāśrayacitprakāśena virudhyate ajñānam; svāvabhāsakena saṃvedanena citprakāśenājñānasyāviruddhatvāt, sākṣicaitanyasya cājñānāvabhāsakatvāt| ato na cidāśrayatvavirodhaḥ|| kiñca janyajñānenātmanyavasthātraye avabhāsamāne eva svaparaviṣayājñānāśrayatvaṃ sarvairevopagantavyamiti, nāvabhāsamāne ajñānāśrayatvavirodhaḥ| na ca prakāśamātramajñānavirodhi| svajñāne abhāvāt| naca svayaṃprakāśamāne ajñānasaṃsargavirodhaḥ kvacit dṛṣṭaḥ; viṣayāṇāṃ paraprakāśyānāmeva tatsaṃsargavirodhāt| saṃvedanasyātmasvarūpatvādeva tadāśrayājñānopagamāt na tadudāharaṇam| atha brahmaṇaḥ sarvajñatvavirodhādaikye sati nājñānamupapadyate iti, na;jīvāśrayatvopagamāt| nanu aikyamuktam, satyam; satyapyaikye pratibimbātmanyadhyastaśyāmatvādeḥ bimbe adarśanāt avadātatāyāścāvirodhadarśanāt, evaṃ sarvajñatvāvidyāśrayatvayoḥ satyapyaikye avirodhāt| tasmāt na aikyamavidyāśrayatvena virudhyate, kiṃtvavidyāmevopapādayatītyāha -- bāḍhamata evārthāditi|| aikye svayaṃprakāśatve sarvajñatve ca satyevānavabhāsadarśanādācchādikā avidyā kalpyate; anyathā bhedajāḍyakiṃcijjñatve grahaṇābhāvamātrameva syāt; tataśca tamo'nṛtanīhārājñānāvṛtatvādiśabdā anavabhāsādhyāsanimittabhāvarūpājñānapratipādakā bādhyeranniti|| nanvekadravyatve sati jīvabrahmavibhāgaḥ kiṃnibandhanaḥ yataḥ sarvajñatvāvidyāśrayatve vyavasthāpyete iti, antaḥkaraṇāvacchedāt kaścidbheda vakti, anyastvatirekāt, aparastu svabhāvādevāṃśāṃśibhāvāt, tat sarvaṃ vyāvartayati -- ato'nādisiddhāvidyāvacchinneti|| ātmāvaraṇamātmājñānameva jīvabrahmavibhāgādyadhyāsopādānaṃ yataḥ ato jīvāvacchedanimittamajñānamiti; avacchedasyāpi prātibhāsikādhyāsasya tadupādānatvāt| satyato niravayavasya dvaidhībhāvāyogāt, kartṛtvabhoktṛtvadoṣasaṃyogānāṃ bījāṅkuravadanādipravāhasya darśitatvāt| tadupādānamapyajñānamanādītyāha -- anādisiddheti|| anādijīvavibhāgādhyāsapravāhasyānādyavidyaiva kāraṇaṃ nāntaḥkaraṇādītyāha -- avidyāvacchinneti|| nacāntaḥkaraṇamavacchedakam; arthato vidāraṇābhāvāt, avacchedasya vibhramamātratvāt, ajñānasyaiva tadupādānatvāt, antaḥkaraṇasya ca samyagjñānanirasyatā avidyādhyāsatvāt, svakāraṇāvacchinnasyaivāvacchedakatvasaṃbhavāt, satyatve'pi sāderanādyavidyopāditvābhāvāt, suṣuptādau cāntaḥkaraṇābhāvādanavacchedaprasaṅgāt| tadāpi sūkṣmāvasthamantaḥkaraṇamavacchedakamiti cet, kiṃ tāvanniravayavatvāpattiḥ sūkṣmatā| sāvayavasyāvayavābhāve svarūpanāśāt, athāvayavāpacayamātraṃ sūkṣmatā na; avasthitāvayavinaḥ akāryatvaprasaṅgāt, kāraṇātmanā sthitiriti cet, kiṃ kāraṇameva sthitamityarthaḥ kāryamapīti vā pūrvasminnantaḥkaraṇābhāvāt, uttarasmin sthityavasthāto na viśeṣaḥ| tasmāt kāryasaṃskāraviśiṣṭaśaktimatkāraṇāvasthānameva sūkṣmatāpattiḥ| ato nāntaḥkaraṇamavavacchedakamasti| tasmāt klṛptāvidyāsāmarthyādeva jīvabrahmavibhāgasiddhau nātirekakalpanāvakāśaḥ| "jīvasya brahmaṇyavidyā" ityavidyā pūrvameva vibhāgamapekṣate iti cet, na; kasya kasmādatireka ityatirekasyāpi vibhāgapurassaratvapratīteḥ; yathā bhedādhīnopi dharmipratiyogibhāvo bhedenoparajyate, kasya kasmādbhedaḥ iti evaṃ atirekādhīno'pi jīvabrahmabhāvastasminnuparajyate jīvāt brahmaṇo'tirekaḥ iti cedavidyāyāmapi tulyametat|| niraṃśatvāt na aṃśāṃśibhāvena bhedaḥ saṃbhavati| tasmādavidyaiva bhedādhyāsanimittamiti|| nanu avidyā kiṃsaṃbandhinī bhedanimittam nanu darpaṇādidravyaṃ vā kiṃsaṃbandhi bimbabhedanimittam mukhamātrasaṃbandhīti cet, ihāpi citsvarūpamātrasaṃbandhyajñānaṃ tatra jīvabrahmavyavahārabhedaṃ pravartayati| kathaṃ punaḥ svarūpamātrasaṃbandhino'jñānasya brahmasvarūpaṃ parihṛtya jīvavibhāgaikapakṣapātitā Bdarpaṇaghaṭādermukhākāśabhede hetutayā mukhādisaṃsargiṇopi bimbākāśau parihṛtya pratibimbaghaṭākāśādipakṣapātitvavaditi vadāmaḥ|| nanu kimāśrayeyamavidyā na tāvadantaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭasvarūpāśrayā pramāṇābhāvāt, nanu "ahamajñaḥ" iti pratibhāsa eva viśiṣṭāśrayatve pramāṇam, na; ṭhaahamanubhavāmī"tyanubhavasyāpi caitanyaprakāśasya viśiṣṭāśrayatvaprasaṅgāt| nanu yathā "ayo dahatī"ti dagdhṛtvāyasorekāgnisaṃbandhāt parasparasaṃbandhāvabhāsaḥ, tathā anubhavāntaḥkaraṇayorekātmasaṃbandhāt tathāvabhāsaḥ nāntaḥkaraṇasyānubhavāśrayatvāditi -- cet, evamajñānāntaḥkaraṇayorekātmasaṃbandhā"dahamajña" ityavabhāsaḥ, nāntaḥkaraṇasyājñānasaṃbandhāditi tulyam; pratīteranyathāsiddhau parasparasaṃbandhakalpanāyogāt, ātmani avidyāsaṃbandhasya suṣupte'pi saṃpratipannatvācca| "atha" svarūpamātrāśrayatvānupapatteḥ viśiṣṭāśrayatvaṃ kalpyate iti -- cet, na; viśiṣṭe'pi svarūpasaṃbandhasya vidyamānatvāt, jaḍasya cājñānāśrayatve bhrāntisamyagjñānayorapi tadāśrayatvaprasaṅgāt| nanu svarūpe'pi brahmaṇyanupapattistulyā, satyam; anupapannadvayāśrayatvakalpanāt varaṃ saṃpratipannasvarūpāśrayatvopādānam; mokṣavasthāsaṃbandhina eva saṃbandhāśrayatvāt|| atra kaścit -- antaḥkaraṇasyaivājñānamiti jalpati| sa vaktavyaḥ -- kiṃ ātmā sarvajñaḥ kiṃcitjño veti kiṃcijjñatve kadācit kiṃcinna jānātīti viṣayānavabodhaḥ tvayaivātmano darśitaḥ| atha agrahaṇamithyājñānayorātmāśrayatve'pi bhāvarūpājñānamantaḥkaraṇāśrayamiti, kiṃ tat jñānādanyaccet ajñānaṃ, kācakāmalādīnāmapyajñānatvānna vivādaḥ, atha jñānanirodhīti, na; bhinnāśrayayoḥ jñānājñānayorekaviṣayayorapi virodhitvādarśanāt, karaṇāśrayamajñānaṃ kartrāśrayajñānena virudhyate iti cet, na; pramāṇābhāvāt| puruṣāntarasuṣuptau ca tadīyenāntaḥkaraṇena līyamānena karaṇabhūtena tannimittakarmānumāne'pi tadīyāntaḥkaraṇājñānanivṛtyadarśanāt| bhrāntinimittadoṣatvāt kācādivat karaṇāśrayamajñānamiti cet, na; cakṣurādāvapi prasaṅgāt| sāditvāt teṣāmanādyajñānāśrayatvānupapattiriti cet, antaḥkaraṇe'pi tulyam| satkāryavādāśrayaṇāt na sādyantaḥkaraṇamiti cet, cakṣurādāvapi tulyam| ato na tadanādyajñānāśrayamiti| anṛtanīhārādiśabdaiśca prāptajñānānāmagrahaṇavatāṃ cetanānāmevāvṛtatvābhidhānāt na antaḥkaraṇāśrayamajñānam, kiṃtu caitanyāśrayamityalamativistareṇa| tadetadāha -- avidyāvacchinnānantajīveti|| nyāyaḥ pradarśitaḥ| śrutistu -- "anyat yuṣmākamantaraṃ babhūva| nīhāreṇa prāvṛtāḥ" iti vyavadhāyakamajñānaṃ darśayati| "vibhedajanake'jñāne nāśamātyantikaṃ gate| ātmano brahmaṇo bhedamasantaṃ kaḥ kariṣyati|| iti smṛtiḥ| nanu brahmavyatiriktamanādivastu nāstīti, tatrāha -- tathāca smṛtiriti|| ataḥ ityupasaṃhāraḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| svayaṃprakāśasyāvidyāśrayatvamupapannamityuktam, idānīṃ prakāśamānasyāvidyāviṣayabhāvo nopapadyate ityākṣipati -- nanu pramāṇāvirodha iti|| nanu "tvaduktamarthaṃ na jānāmī"ti pratibhāsamānamevājñānasya vyāvartakamavabhāsate, nanu tatra viśeṣākārasyānavagatasya vyāvartakatā, na; anavabhāsamānasya vyāvartakatayā pratibhāsānupapatteḥ| nanu abhāsamānasyāpi tadvyāvartakatvamanupapannameva, na; ajñānasaṃbandhasya pratibhāsamātraśarīratvāt anupapatteralaṅkāratvāt, pratibhāsastu vidyata eva; tatra kathaṃ pratīyamānasyāvidyāviṣayatvānupapattiḥ ityākṣipati -- kiṃ tat pramāṇamiti|| niraṃśasyeti parihāraḥ| saṃvidabhedaḥ aparokṣaprakāśamānatā nāma| śarīrādbhedaśca svayaṃjyotiṣā ātmaprakāśenābhinnaḥ tatantro vā aparokṣa eva; tathāpi na prakāśata iti siddhāntī pariharati -- nanu bhokturiti|| nanu na bhoktā ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| padārthajñānameva bhedajñānaṃ, ataḥ ahamityātmapadārthajñānameva bhede'pi pratyakṣamiti mīmāṃsakaṃmanyaścodayati -- kathaṃ punarbhokteti|| saṃsargādhyāso hi bhedānavagamanimittamiti sarvatra vyāptamiti pariharati -- manuṣyohamitīti|| padārthapratyakṣeṇaiva bhede'pi pratyakṣe sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ gauṇāvabhāsaḥ iti codayitvā pariharati -- nanu gauṇaḥ ityādinā|| āha gauṇavādī -- nanvahamiti yadīti|| nanu pratyakṣāvabhāsaṃ bādhitvā agamānumānābhyāmeva vyatireko gṛhyatāmiti, netyāha -- āgamānumānayorapīti|| nanu mithyātvāt pratyakṣāvabhāsasya dvicandrāvabhāsasyeva tābhyāmeva bādhaḥ iti codayati -- mithyātvāttasyeti|| yatrāvicārapurassarameva pratyakṣāvabhāsamapyanumānādinā jhaṭiti bādhitamucchinnavyavahāraṃ bhavati tatra tathā bhavatu; yatra punaḥ vicārapadavīmupārūḍhayoḥ jñānayoḥ balābalacintayā na bādhaniścayaḥ, tatra nānumānādinā pratyakṣasya mithyātvasiddhiriti matvā āha -- kutastarhītyādinā ucyate ityataḥ prāktanena granthena|| spaṣṭārtho granthaḥ|| kimarthato vyatiriktātmaviṣayo'haṅkāraḥ ucyate kiṃ vā pratibhāsataḥ arthataścet, tatrāha -- yadyapi dehādivyatirikteti|| vyatirekapratibhāsa eva adhyāsavirodhitayā sāmānādhikaraṇyasya gauṇatvamāvahati natvarthamātramiti bhāvaḥ| nanu sāmānyena gṛhītasya viśeṣāgrahaṇādanyasaṃsargāvabhāso bhavati, ātmā tu viśeṣarūpeṇaṃ gṛhītaḥ, kathaṃ tatrādhyāsaḥ tatrāha -- dṛśyate hīti|| atha pratibhāsata evāhaṃpratyayo viviktātmaviṣaya iti śaṅkate -- atha punarekāntataḥ iti|| pariharati -- tatastatsadbhāve iti|| yoktikajñānasahakṛtenāhaṃpratyayenātmani vivikte pratipanne punaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ gauṇameva, tatsāmānyāpūrvamapi gauṇamevetyabhipretyāha -- jijñāsottarakālaṃ tarhīti|| vicāreṇāpi nāhaṃpratyayasya vyatiriktātmaviṣayatvamāpāditam, kiṃ tu sarvadā svarūpamātraviṣayo'haṃpratyayaḥ, yauktikajñānalabdhastu vyatirekaḥ, atastasyānanusaṃdhāne pūrvavadadhyāsa eveti pariharati -- na yuktaḥ iti|| tatrāpi nādhyāsaḥ iti codyam| anubhavavirodhaḥ iti parihāraḥ| akārasya vyatireke'pi hṛsvāderavyatirekādadhyāsa iti codayati -- nanvanubhava iti|| anyataravyatireke dvayorekatvādbhedasyetaretaravyatirekaḥ siddhyatītyāha -- tanneti|| nanu mahadetat ityādicodyaparihārau spaṣṭau|| kiṃ ca vivekānantaramadhyāso'haṃpratyayamātreṇa virudhyate ityucyate kiṃvā yauktikājñānena na tāvadahaṃpratyayamātreṇetyāha -- tathāhyahaṃpratyayasyetyādinā|| nanu pūrvamātmaviṣayo'pi yuktijñānasannidhānāt vyatiriktaviṣayo'haṃpratyaya iti, netyāha -- ato yuktyā viṣayavivecane'pīti|| nahi pratyakṣajñānaṃ jñānāntarasannidhānāt svaviṣayādadhikaviṣayaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| vicārajanyajñānasyānanusaṃdhānāt, anusaṃdhāne'pi parokṣatvāt na aparokṣādhyāsaḥ prāgavasthāto bhidyate ityupasaṃharati -- ato nyāyataḥ iti|| nanu pratyakṣe dohātmaikyādhyāse kiṃ aikyapratyayamapabādhya vyatireke pramāṇamuktamiti ucyate; -- yuktisahitāgamānumānāhaṃpratyayaiḥ dvicandrabādhayā ekatvavat vyatirekaḥ sidhyatītyuktaṃ bhavati -- tadevaṃ svayaṃjyotiṣaḥ iti|| dṛṣṭāntānuvādena dārṣṭāntikakathanaparau granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| svayaṃprakāśatve'pi avidyayā agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt ātmano'dhiṣṭhānayogyatvakathanena "paratra parāvabhāsaḥ" iti lakṣaṇāṃśo darśitaḥ| kāraṇatritaye'pi advitīyātmāvabhāsicaitanyapramāṇatadgatāvidyākāraṇadoṣau labdhau, saṃskāramidānīṃ lambhayati -- anāditvācceti|| nanu adhyasyamānādhiṣṭhānaviṣayaṃ kāraṇatritayajanyamekameva jñānaṃ vaktavyaṃ, tadabhāvānnādhyāsaḥ ityāśaṅkyāha -- pṛthagbhoktṛviṣayānubhavaphalābhāvāditi|| ātmacaitanyamevātmānātmasaṃbhedāvabhāsi svarūpeṇājanyatvepi viśiṣṭaviṣayoparaktākāreṇa janyate; bhrāntitvācca viṣayaviṣayiṇorekasmin pratyaye saṃbhedāvabhāsaḥ saṃbhavati iti kāraṇatritayajanyamātmanyanātmāvabhāsijñānamadhyāsaḥ siddhaḥ iti|| "kathaṃ punari"tyādibhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- koyamadhyāso nāmeti kiṃvṛttasyeti|| pṛṣṭamevānena, ākṣiptamapi mayā ityubhayatraivakārāpiśabdau prayoktavyau| adhyasyamānena samānendriyavijñānaviṣayatvamevādhiṣṭhānasya dṛṣṭam, iha tadabhāvāt na adhyāsasaṃbhavaḥ ityākṣepagranthārthaḥ| tatra ekasmin vijñāne dvayoḥ saṃbhinnatāya avabhāsa evāpekṣyate; viṣayatayā avabhāsaḥ iti viśeṣaṇāyogāt, iti manvānaḥ pariharati -- na tāvadayamekāntenāviṣayaḥ iti|| asmatpratyayaśabdenātmaviṣayaṃ jñānamuktamiti manvānaścodayati -- nanu viṣayiṇaḥ iti|| ekasyāṃ pratyakṣadarśanakriyāyāmekasyaiva kartṛsthāne tadaiva tadviparītakarmakārakasthāne cāvasthānamanupapannamiti bhāvaḥ| astu tarhyaṃśābhyāṃ tadbhāva iti, netyāha -- tat kathamekasyeti|| tatra sarvato viprasṛtasya savitṛprakāśasyākāśe viśeṣābhivyaktinimittadarpaṇādivat ātmacaitanyasya savikalpakatayā sphuṭīkaraṇavyavahāranimittaṃ bhāsvaradravyamātmanyadhyastamantaḥkaraṇamasmatpratyaya ityāha -- asmatpratyayā[yatvā]bhimito'haṅkāraḥ iti|| nanu idaṃ rajatamitivadadhyastatve -- "ahami"ti dvairūpyāvabhāso vaktavyaḥ ityata āha -- sa cedamanidamiti|" "ayo dahatī"ti dagdhṛtvaviśiṣṭasyāgnerayasaśca dvairūpyāvabhāsavat -- "ahamupalabhe" ityupalabdhṛtvaviśiṣṭasyātmano'ntaḥkaraṇasya cāstyeva dvairūpyāvabhāsaḥ, asādhāraṇakriyoparaktamātmādidravyameva vastvantaraviśiṣṭamavabhāsata iti bhāvaḥ| duḥkhipremāspadarūpeṇa pariṇāmitadāgamāpāyadraṣṭṛrūpeṇa ahaṅkāraviṣayādiṣvanusyūtacaitanyarūpeṇa "ahami"ti ca vyāvṛttarūpeṇa ca sarvalokasākṣikaṃ dvairūpyamityāha -- sarvalokasākṣikaḥ iti|| nanu viṣayasaṃvidaḥ āśrayaḥ ātmā, tatra ahaṃ jānāmīti saṃvidāśrayatvenāvabhāsamāno'haṅkāraḥ kathamidamaṃśaḥ syāditi codayati -- nanu kimatra vaditavyaṃ iti|| nanu "ayo dahatī"tyādāvayaḥpiṇḍādivadakartṛtvepi darśanakriyāśrayakoṭinikṣiptatayā ahaṅkārasyāvabhāsaḥ sambhavatīti, pūrvavādinaṃ siddhāntī codayati -- kathamiti|| ayaḥpiṇḍavyatirekeṇa vahneḥ dahanakriyāśrayatvadarśanavat ahaṅkāravyatirekeṇātmano jñānakriyā'darśanādaham evātmatvamityuttareṇa granthena pratipādayati|| tatra sāṅkhyāstu -- acidātmanyantaḥkaraṇe cidākārapratibimbāvabhāsaḥ tathāvidhabimbāntarapurassaraḥ, pratibimbatvāt, mukhapratibimbavaditi bimbabhūtamātmānam -- anumimate; naiyāyikavaiśeṣikāśca -- icchādayo guṇāḥ, pṛthivyādimahābhūtadravyavyatiriktasyaiva viśeṣaguṇāḥ teṣvadṛṣṭatve sati ekendriyagrāhyatayā viśeṣaguṇatvāt; bhūtacatuṣṭaye'dṛṣṭagandhavat, dikkālamanasāṃ viśeṣaguṇahīnatvāt pariśeṣādicchādiguṇavaddravyamanyadevātmeti anumimate; tathā saṃvedaneṣu viṣayākārapratibimbāvabhāsaḥ, tathāvidhabimbasannidhānapurassaraḥ, atasmin tadavabhāsatvāt, darpaṇasphaṭikādigatamukharaktatvādivaditi nityānumeyā viṣayāḥ iti sautrāntikāḥ kalpayanti| tān pratyāha -- pramātṛprameyapramitayastāvadaparokṣāḥ iti|| yadi sāṅkhyādayaḥ pratyakṣasiddhasyaivātmano'numānāni spaṣṭīkaraṇarthāni manyeran, tadā na kaścidvirodhaḥ| yadi nityānumeyamātmānamiccheyuḥ, tadā viṣayavadagamityaparokṣāvabhāsavirodhaḥ| sautrāntikasyāpi yadi viṣayānumānajñāne sākṣādviṣayā evāvabhāseran pratyakṣe'pyavabhāsantāṃ, kastatrāparādhaḥ ityanumānajñāne viṣayasyaivāvabhāsanādanaikānto hetuḥ| na cedanumānajñāne'pi bimbabhūtaviṣayāvabhāsaḥ, pratijñātārthasya binbapurassaratvasyāpratibhāsanāt anumānānudaya eva syāt| aparokṣavyavahārayogyaviṣayāvabhāsaviruddhaṃ cānumānamiti|| atra vijñānavādinastu -- vijñānābhedanimitta eva viṣayasyāparokṣāvabhāsaḥ ityāhuḥ, tān nirākaroti -- prameyaṃ karmatvenāparokṣamiti|| idaṃ paśyāmītyanubhavāt| na ca vijñānābhedādevāparokṣyamavabhāsate; bahiṣṭvasyāpi rajatāderāparokṣyāt, tadapi vijñānamiti cet, na; rajatavadbādhābhāvaprasaṅgāt| tasmādavyavadhānena saṃvidupādhitā aparokṣatā viṣayasyeti|| tatra -- "ātmā ātmamanassaṃyogajanyapratyakṣeṇāparokṣaḥ" iti vārtikakāranyāyavaiśeṣikānusāriṇaḥ kalpayanti| pramitistu ātmani saṃyuktasamavāyanimittajñānāntarādaparokṣeti nyāyavaiśeṣikau| prameyagatā pramitiḥ saṃyuktatādātmyāt jñānāntareṇāparokṣeti vārtikakārīyāḥ, tān pratyāha -- pramātṛpramiti punaraparokṣe eva kevalamiti|| na tāvadātmaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ jñānāntaraṃ manojanyamiti pramāṇamasti; sati manasi ātmadarśanādasati suṣupte cādarśanādanvayavyatirekau pramāṇamiti cet, na; viṣayānubhavenaivānyathāsiddhatvāt, viṣayānubhavasambandhādeva viṣayavadātmasiddhāvātmani jñānāntaraṃ parikalpya manaso'nvayavyatirekakalpanāyogāt| tasmāt viṣayatvamantareṇa ātmā aparokṣa eva|| na ca saṃyuktasamavāyādātmani viṣaye vā anubhavasya jñānāntaraviṣayatayā aparokṣatā; pratyakṣasya vartamānaviṣayāpekṣatvena yugapat phaladvayāvasthānaprasaṅgāt, saṃyuktasambandhādanubhavāvabhāse tadgataparimāṇarasādīnāṃ tenaiva jñānenāparokṣatāprasaṅgāt| anubhavasya ca svasattāyāṃ prakāśavyatirekādarśanācca jñānāntarāgamyatāsiddhiḥ| na ca ātmavyāpārāt viṣayānubhavajanma saṃbhavati; sarvagatasya kuṭhārādivat parispandābhāvāt, pariṇāmaphalasya ca ghaṭādivat kriyaikāśrayatvāt, saṃvidāśrayatve ca viṣayasyaiva cetanatvaprasaṅgāt| na ca tajjananavyāpārāvattvādātmanaścetanā; manādīnāmapi prasaṅgāt, viṣayāśrayatve cānubhavasya "mayedaṃ viditami"ti sambandhāvabhāsaḥ svātmani jñānakriyānumānaṃ ca na syāt; anubhavasyātmasambandhābhāvāt| tasmāt dvayorna karmatayā aparokṣatā|| nanu ubhayoḥ svayamprakāśatvakalpanā na yuktā; anyatarasya svayamprakāśatve ātmaiva svayaṃprakāśa iti cet, na ityāha -- pramitiranubhavaḥ iti|| athavā -- hānopādānopekṣāḥ pramāṇaphalamiti kecit, tatrāha -- pramitiranubhavaḥ iti|| na hi hānādīnāṃ itaretaravyabhicāriṇāṃ mānaphalatā yuktā avyabhicāriṇyanubhave satītyarthaḥ|| nanu saṃvedanamevārthasārūpyeṇa pramāṇam, pramīyate aneneti vyutpatteḥ, arthopalabdhyātmanā tadeva pramāṇaphalamiti sugatamatānusāriṇaḥ, tadvyāvartayati -- pramāṇaṃ tu iti|| pramāṇaṃ tu pramātṛvyāpāraḥ catuṣṭayasannikarṣa eveti prābhākarāḥ| nanu "ahamidaṃ jānāmī"tyātmānātmaviṣayāvanubhavau bhedena pratyakṣasiddhāviti netyāha -- tatrāhamidaṃ jānāmīti|| nanu yadavabhāsate tat jñānakarmatayaivāvabhāsate, iti viṣayeṣu niyamāt ātmāpyavabhāsate cet karmatayaiva nāśrayamātratayā iti codayati -- nanu nāyaṃ viṣayānubhavanimittaḥ iti|| nanu pratyakṣajñānasya viṣayajanyatvāt kārakatāpi viṣayasya vaktavyatā, tatra kathamekasyāṃ kriyāyāmekasyaiva kartṛtvena karmatvena ca viruddharūpadvayānvayaḥ kartuśca guṇabhāvāt karmaṇaśca prādhānyāt ekasya rūpadvaye vairūpyaprasaṅgaśceti, tatrāha -- tasmiṃśca dravyarūpatveneti|| tatra sāmānyāṃśasyātmanātmasādhāraṇyādātmatvāyogāt viśeṣāṃśasya niraṃśatvāt na kartṛkarmavyavastheti pariharati -- na caitadyuktamiti|| niravayavasya yugapat kāryadvayapariṇāmāyogācca ityāha -- apariṇāmitvāditi|| kiñca -- grāhakarūpasyāpi viṣayatayā siddhirasti vā na vā na cet, svayaṃprakāśatvasaṃvidāśrayatvasiddhayoranabhyupagamāt asiddhiprasaṅgaḥ, karmatayā siddhiścet, tatrāha -- prameyasya ceti|| tasmāt saṃvidbalādeva tritayasiddhau saṃvidāśrayapakṣapātitayā ahamaḥ siddheḥ na idamaṃśo'haṅkāraḥ ityupasaṃharati -- tasmānnīlādijñānaphalamiti|| ahaṃṅkārasyātmavyatiriktatvaṃ sādhayitumātmanaḥ svayaṃprakāśatvasādhanāya vikalpayati -- tatredaṃ bhavāniti|| uta so'pi anubhavo'pītyarthaḥ| tatra ātmā citsvabhāvaḥ, anubhavo jaḍaprakāśaḥ iti pakṣo nopapadyate ityāha -- tatra na tāvat iti|| nanu aprakāśamānameva pramāṇaphalaṃ cakṣurādivadviṣayamavabhāsayediti kuto viśvasyānavabhāsaḥ na; viṣayaprakāśajananena cakṣuṣaḥ prakāśakatvāt saṃvidvailakṣaṇyāt, saṃvedanaṃ tu svayaṃprakāśa eva, na prakāśāntarahetuḥ; ataḥ cakṣurādivailakṣaṇyāt pradīpavadavabhāsamāna evānubhavo'rtha prakāśayati| na ca pradīpālokasyārthānubhavajananenaiva cakṣurādivadarthasya prakāśakatā, kintu pṛthageva| tathāhi -- jñānaprakāśyatvādajñānavirodhino'nyadevālokaprakāśyatvaṃ tamovirodhitayā prasiddham tat avyavadhānena ālokena kriyate, na tadubhayaṃ karoti cakṣuḥ; ajñānatvādanālokatvācca| tasmādanubhavaḥ sajātīyaprakāśāntaranirapekṣaḥ prakāśamāna eva viṣaye prakāśādivyavahāranimittaṃ bhavitumarhati; avyavadhānena viṣaye prakāśādivyavahāranimittatvāt pradīpalokavat| na ca cakṣuṣā sajātīyaprakāśena pradīpasyālokeneva ghaṭasya prakāśyatā; svayameva prakāśaguṇatvāt| tadviṣayajñānaprakāśaṃ janayati cakṣuriti cet, tathāpi vijātīyajñānenaiva pradīpasya prakāśyateti na sajātīyālokāpekṣā| tasmāt vyavahitapradīpasyeva anubhavasyāpyaprakāśamānatve pradīpaprakāśasyeva viśvasyānavabhāsaprasaṅga iti|| nanu pramātṛcaitanyameva jaḍānubhavabalādātmānaṃ viṣayaṃ cāvabhāsayatīti codayati, -- maivam,pramātā cetanaḥ iti|| tatra yadi caitanyasya viṣayoparāgaheturanubhavaḥ parābhyupagatabuddhipariṇāmavadiṣyate, tat yujyate; cidātmaprakāśasya tu jaḍānubhavādhīnatā anupapannetyāha -- tanna svayaṃprakāśacaitanyasvabhāvo'pi sanniti|| cetayatikriyāpi pūrvānubhavaphalavajjaḍarūpānubhavaphalaṃ, cetanasyāpi pradīpasthānīyatvāt cetayatikriyānavastheti dūṣayati -- kiñca pramāṇaphaleneti|| ubhayacaitanyasvabhāvapakṣe puruṣadvayavat nānyonyādhīnasiddhitā, nāpi saṃvidātmasambandhāvagamaḥ ityāha -- dvitīye'pi kalpe iti|| nanu cidguṇamapi puruṣāntarasaṃvedanaṃ na puraṣāntarasya svayaṃprakāśam, tathā ātmā caitanyaguṇo'pi na svayaṃ prakāśate iti śaṅkate -- atha caitanyasvabhāvatve'pīti|| pariharati -- viśeṣe heturvācyaḥ iti|| anubhavo'pi tarhi na svayaṃprakāśaḥ syāt| puruṣāntarasaṃvedanavat, avyavadhānāt na iti cedātmanyapi tat samānamiti bhāvaḥ| kiñceti spaṣṭārthaḥ| astu tarhi jaḍātmanaḥ svayaṃprakāśānubhavāśrayatayā siddhiriti,; netyāha -- tṛtīye'pīti|| ayamarthaḥ -- saṃvedanaṃ nāma guṇo dravyaṃ karma vā bhavati karmatve prakāśatvaphalatvayoranupapattiḥ, dravyatve'pyaṇumadhyamānantaraparimāṇānāṃ aṇuparimāṇatve viṣaye'pi tāvanmātrāvabhāsaḥ syāt; na hi khadyotaprakāśamātrasaṃsṛṣṭasya ghaṭasya sarvātmanā avabhāsaḥ, mahāparimāṇatve tadāśrayatayā ātmano'pi sarvatrāvabhāsaprasaṅgaḥ; madhyamaparimāṇatve sāvayavatvena avayavaparatantratā syāt| guṇatve sati ātmaiva prakāśaguṇaḥ iti pradīpavadātmā svayaṃprakāśaḥ syāt| sa ca guṇaḥ svāśrayopādhau na jāyate; prakāśaguṇatvāt, ātmanyavyabhicārāt, ādityādiprakāśaguṇavat, iti ātmaiva svayaṃprakāśa iti, tadetadāha -- anicchato'pyātmaiva citiprakāśaḥ iti|| nanu madhyamaparimāṇameva svāvayavāśrayaṃ phalamastu, ātmaparatantratā tu ghaṭasyeva bhūtalatantratā iti, netyāha -- na tadatiriktatathāvidhaphalasadbhāve iti|| "pradīpena prakāśitami"tivat "mayā avagatami"tyanubhavādātmaiva citprakāśaḥ; anyathā kāṣṭhena prakāśitamitivadupacāraprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ| pramāṇāntarāpekṣayā pṛcchati -- kathamiti saṃvedanasya bhedāvabhāsaśūnyatvādanubhavādhīnasiddhikasya ca viṣayavadanātmatvādekaḥ sthāyyātmaivānubhavaḥ ityāha -- pramāṇajanyaścedanubhavaḥ iti|| sāmānyaviśeṣabhedakalpanāgauravādātmā eka evānabhuvaḥ ityāha -- sarvānubhavānugataṃ ceti|| svagatabhedapratibhāsaśūnyatāmeva prapañcayati -- na ca nīlānubhavaḥ iti|| nanu nīlasaṃvitsthitikāle pītasaṃvido'bhāvāt sthitivināśau dṛṣṭau dharmibhedaṃ kalpayataḥ iti codyamudbhāvya pariharati -- nanu vinaṣṭāvinaṣṭetyādinā|| nanu sādhanasannidhānāduttarasaṃvedanasya jātatvāt saṃviddvayayaugapadyāyogāt vinaṣṭā pūrvasaṃviditi cet, na; itaretarāśrayādityāha -- sā ca janyatve iti|| siddhasyaiva saṃvedanasya viṣayoparāganimittaṃ sādhanamiti kalpanaṃ laghīyaḥ viṣayoparaktasaṃvijjanmasādhanatvakalpanāditi bhāvaḥ|| satyapi saṃvidāṃ svagatabhede atisādṛśyāt jvālāyāmiva paropādhimantareṇa bhedo na vibhāvyate iti sugatāḥ kalpayanti, tānnirākaroti -- etenātisādṛśyāditi|| kiñca -- jñānāntaragamyatve bhedasya atisādṛśyādbhinneṣvabhedabhramajanma syāt, svayaṃprakāśasya tu bhedaḥ prakāśābhinnaḥ iti prakāśamānataiva yuktetyāha -- na hi citprakāśasyeti|| na ca yathā jīvasyeti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| ekatvena puṣkalaprakāśasyāpyavidyāpratibandhe pramāṇamuktam, iha tu apratibaddhapuṣkalakāraṇatvāt bhedaprakāśena bhavitavyamityāha -- abhihitaṃ tatreti|| nanu saṃvidaḥ, sādṛśyapratibaddhabhedāvabhāsāḥ, sthāyiprakāśabuddhivedyatvāt, jvālāvat ityanumātuṃ śakyate, tatrāha -- na hi sāmānyatodṛṣṭamiti|| pūrvāparaikarūpānubhavaḥ, bhedasya ca prakāśena bhavitavyam, ityanubhavayuktī| kathaṃ punarātmacaitanyasya nityasya viṣayānubhavatvamiti tadāha -- tasmāccitsvabhāva eveti|| nanu svayaṃprakāśamānātmacaitanyasya viṣayānubhavatve'pi viṣayānubhavameva nimittīkṛtya -- "ahami"ti draṣṭṛparāmarśādātmaivāhaṅkāraḥ saṃvṛttaḥ iti codayati -- bāḍhaṃ ata eveti|| draṣṭṛrūpeṇa parāmarśasya viṣayānubhavo nimittam; anyathā draṣṭrādivibhāgaśūnyaḥ cinmātrāvabhāsaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ|| maivam -- suṣuptāvātmanyavabhāsamāne'pyahaṅkārasyānavabhāsamānatvāt iti vyatirekapradarśanena pariharati -- satyamevamiti|| nanu viṣayānubhavanimitto draṣṭṛrūpāvabhāso'hamullekhaḥ, tadrahite suṣupte kathamasya prasaṅgaḥ iti codayati -- kathamiti|| viṣayānubhavanimitto viṣayāvabhāsaḥ syāt; jaḍatvāt, na tannimittaḥ cidātmaparāmarśaḥ iti pariharati -- nīlānuṣaṅgo yaścaitanyasyeti|| nanu suṣupte draṣṭṛrūpābhāve kathaṃ ahamiti tatpaparāmarśaḥ| netyāha -- tatra yadi nāmeti|| draṣṭṛtvaṃ sapratiyogirūpam, sa cedahamarthaḥ, anātmaivāhaṅkāraḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ|| nanu parāgvyāvṛttaṃ draṣṭṛrūpaṃ bhoktṛtvameva, tat suṣuptāvanubhūyate iti codayati -- nanvahamiti| na; ahaṅkārasya tvayā niṣpratiyogikātmamātratvābhyupagamāt iti pariharati -- naitat sāramiti|| nanu svarūpamapi viṣayānubhavādeva ahamiti vyajyatām ; netyāha -- naitacchakyamiti|| tataśca viṣayoparaktasapratiyogikasvabhāvasyāhaṅkārasyātmatvaṃ suṣuptāvanubhavaviruddhamidamāpatsyate ityāha -- tataśca viṣayoparāgeti|| ātmanastu sarvātmakatvāt na parāgvyāvṛttatā, ahamuparāgādeva vyāvṛttyavabhāsaḥ ityarthaḥ| bhavatyeva ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| yathā pūrvasmin dine ahamityabhimanyamāna evāsam, evamanubhūte smṛtiniyamābhāve'pi smaryamāṇātmamātratvādahaṅkārasya suṣupte'pi smṛtiḥ syādityarthaḥ| ahaṅkārādipratibhāsasya nityacaitanyarūpasyāvināśāt tajjanyasaṃskāraprasūtā smṛtiranupapanneti codayati -- avināśinaḥ saṃskārābhāvāditi|| parihāraḥ -- hyastano'pīti|| nanu siddhānte kathamahaṅ‌kārasmṛtiḥ tadavabhāsisākṣicaitanyasya nityatvāt, ucyate -- ahaṃvṛttyavacchinnamevāntaḥkaraṇaṃ caitanyasya viṣayabhāvamāpadyate, tadvṛttisaṃskārajanyasmaraṇāvacchinnamantaḥkaraṇaṃ punaḥ smṛtyanubhavāvacchedakamiti smaraṇopapattiḥ| nanu suṣuptāvanubhūtasukhasyāpyāśrayapakṣapātitayā ahamullekhādastyeva suṣupte'hamanubhavaḥ ityāha -- nanvastyeva suṣupte ahamanubhava iti|| nanu sukhamanubhūtaṃ cet tasya viṣayatvāt viṣayānubhavanimitta eva tatrāpyahamullekhaḥ syāt iti, netyāha -- nātmano'nyasyeti|| satyamasti ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu sukhāvamarśasya mukhyasukhālambanatvaṃ parityajya kathaṃ virodhiduḥkhābhāvaviṣayatayopacāraḥ kalpyate śābde hi jñāne lakṣaṇā syāt, pratyakṣastu sukhāvamarśo na lakṣaṇāmarhatīti codayati -- kathamiti|| mukhyasukhābhāvāt duḥkhābhāvasya lakṣyasya saṃpratipannatvāt iti pariharati -- svapne tāvadityādinā|| nanu parāmarśasāmarthyādeva mukhyameva sukhaṃ kalpyatāmiti, netyāha -- yadi punaḥ suptaḥ sukhamiti|| viśeṣataḥ iti|| viṣayaviśeṣoparaktatayaivetyarthaḥ| duḥkhābhāva eva parāmarśaviṣayaḥ ityatra liṅgamāha -- vyapadeśo'pīti|| nanu sukhānubhavasyāpi liṅgamasti prasannendriyatvādīti, tatrāha -- yat punaḥ suptotthitasyeti|| tadasaditi spaṣṭārthaḥ| uttarau ca codyaparihāragranthau spaṣṭārthau| tasmāt na suṣuptau bhoktṛtayā'pyahamullekho'nusmaryate iti| nanvanubhūte'pi na smṛtiniyamaḥ, satyam; ātmanyanusmaryamāṇe tāvanmātrasyāhaṅkārasya "ahami"tyeva smṛtiniyamaḥ syādityuktam|| nanu duḥkhābhāvo vidyamāno'pi nānubhavituṃ śakyate; pratiyogismaraṇābhāvāt, sambhavati ca mukhya eva svarūpānandānubhavaḥ| nanu tadapi sukhamavidyāvṛtaṃ na prakāśamarhati, na; anāvṛtasākṣicaitanyasukhāṃśasya prakāśopapatteḥ| jāgaraṇe tarhi kimiti nāvabhāsate bhāsate eva paramapremāspadatvalakṣaṇaṃ sukham, tīvravāyuvikṣiptapradīpaprabhāvat mithyājñānavikṣiptatayā na spaṣṭamavabhāsate, suṣuptau tu tadabhāvādadhikaṃ vyajyate iti|| nanu utthitasyā duḥkhābhāvaparāmarśo vidyate, sa kathaṃ pratiyogijñānābhāvādananubhūtaḥ parāmṛśyate ucyate -- anubhūtameva sukhamutthitasyānusmaryamāṇaṃ tatra virodhiduḥkhābhāvamarthāpattyā gamayati -- anubhūtaṃ cet sukham, nāsti duḥkhamiti; ato duḥkhābhāvo nānusmaryate, kiṃ tu pramīyate iti| evamutthitasya jñānābhāvaparāmarśo'pi| jñānavirodhino'jñānasyānubhūtatayā smaryamāṇasyānupapattyaiva pramīyate nānusmaryate|| nanu jāgaraṇe'pyanubhūyamānamajñānaṃ kathaṃ jñānavirodhi syāt na;avasthāviśeṣaviśiṣṭasyājñānasya suṣupte'nubhavāt, tasya ca jāgaraṇe'pi ghaṭādijñānavirodhitādarśanāt paṭāvagamasamaye| nanu asmaryamāṇatvādeva jñānānāṃ suṣuptau jñānābhāvo'numīyate, na; ativṛttajñānānāmapi satāmasmaryamāṇatvāt| prātargajābhāvo'pīdānīmanusmaryamāṇāt gajavirodhipadārthāt arthāpattyā pramīyate, na gajaviṣayasmṛtyanudayamātrāt, vyabhicāritvāt| tasmāt viśiṣṭājñānasukhānubhavānupapattigamyau jñānābhāvaduḥkhābhāvāviti mantavyam|| nanu ajñānasukhānubhavayoḥ sākṣicaitanyasya cāvināśinaḥ saṃskārābhāve kathamutthitasya trayāṇāmanusmaraṇaṃ syāt ucyate -- ajñānagatacaitanyābhāsajanmopādhitvādajñānasukhasākṣivikalpānubhavasya, ajñānāvasthābhedena caitanyābhāsānāṃ bhinnatvāt tadvināśasaṃskārajaṃ smaraṇamajñānasukhasākṣicaitanyākāramajñānaviśiṣṭātmāśrayameva sambhāvyate nāntaḥkaraṇāśrayamiti|| sarvathāpi suṣupte ajñānasukhānubhavasambhavāt asambaddhamidaṃ ṭīkākāreṇoktamiti, satyam; paramatamāśrityedamuktaṃ, na svamatamiti na doṣaḥ|| svayaṃprakāśatvāhaṅkārabhedāvuktāvupasaṃharati -- tadevaṃ nāyaṃ nīlādipratyayāditi|| ahaṅkārabhedasyāpyupalakṣaṇārtham yasmādātmano'haṅkāro, bhidyate tasmādāgamamūlaṃ bhāṣyavacanamupapannamityāha -- tasmāt brahmavidāmiti|| kaścāsāvāgamaḥ "sa evādhastāt sa evopariṣṭādi"ti bhūmākhyabrahmaṇaḥ sarvātmakatvamabhidhāya "athāto'haṅkārādeśaḥ" iti tasyāpi sarvātmakatvamuktvā "athāta ātmādeśaḥ" ityātmānaṃ ahaṅkārāt bhedena nirdiśati| nanu jīvabrahmaṇoḥ sārvātmyavyapadeśo yathā ekatvasiddhyarthaḥ, evamahaṅkārasyātmaikatvasiddhyartho vyapadeśaḥ syāt, tanna; -- dvayoḥ sārvātmyāyogāt| tatra yuktaṃ bhedena pratipannayoḥ jīvabrahmaṇorekatvasiddhyarthaḥ tadupadeśaḥ, ahaṅkārasya tu pūrvamevātmaikatvapratipatteḥ pṛthagupadeśo bhedasiddhyarthaḥ iti gamyate| brahmaṇaḥ parokṣasya pratyakṣatvasiddhaye ahamātmatvamupadiśya punaḥ tadvyudāsena mukhyātmatvamupadiśatītyarthaḥ| "mahābhūtānyahaṅkāraḥ" iti ca smṛtiḥ|| tarhi ayamahaṅkāraḥ kimupādānaḥ kiṃnimittaḥ kiṃsvarūpaḥ kiṃpramāṇakaḥ kiṅkāryaḥ kimiti suṣupte na bhāti iti codite sati -- taducyate ityādiparihāraḥ|| yeyaṃ ityādyupādānasaṅkīrtanam| avidyākarmapūrvaprajñeti|| bhrāntikarmapūrvānubhavasaṃskārāḥ ityarthaḥ| tasyā iti nimittakāraṇanirdeśaḥ| vijñānakriyāśaktidvayāśrayaḥ iti svarūpaṃ darśayati| kartṛtvabhoktṛtveti kāryapradarśanam| kūṭasthacaitanyeti pramāṇopanyāsaḥ| "yatsambhedādi"ti ātmani sarvātadāropanimittatvaṃ kāryāntaramāha| kimiti tarhi suṣupte na syādityata āha -- sa ca suṣupte iti|| ajñānakāryaliṅgaśarīrapravilayo hi suṣuptirityarthaḥ| nanu sati prāṇe kriyātmani kathamahaṅkārasya kriyāśakteḥ pravilayaḥ ucyate -- nāhaṅkāramātratvaṃ prāṇasya ucyate, kintu prāṇasya pṛthaksataḥ pañcadhā vyāpārahetoḥ ahaṅkārasya kriyāśaktirastītyetāvaducyate; mano'dhīnatādarśanāt prāṇavṛtteriti| prāṇalakṣaṇakriyāśaktyaṃśaṃ vā vihāya vijñānaśaktyaṃśasya layaḥ kalpyatām; sāṃśatvādantaḥkaraṇasya| svapnādivat dṛṣṭisṛṣṭimāśritya vā suṣuptapuruṣadṛṣṭyabhiprāyeṇa sarvasya tatra layo darśitaḥ; suṣuptaprāṇaśarīrādidarśanasya puruṣāntarasya vibhramatvāditi|| atra sāṅkhyā manyante -- yadyacetanaṃ māyāśabdādivācyaṃ antaḥkaraṇādyupādānamiṣṭaṃ syāt, tarhi tat ahaṅkāranirbhāse sākṣiṇi tacchaktitvena vā tadāśrayatvena vā tadadhiṣṭhānatvena vā anantarbhūtameva pradhānaṃ svatantrameva dharmalakṣaṇāvasthābhedaiḥ tridhā pariṇamate iti| tatra dharmapariṇāmo nāma mahadādikṛtsnakāryarūpeṇāvasthānam| tasyaiva ca dharmasyātītānāgatavartamānalakṣaṇarūpāpattiḥ lakṣaṇapariṇāmaḥ| tathā hi -- kāryamanāgatalakṣaṇāpannaṃ tat parityajya vartamānalakṣaṇamāpadyate, punaḥ tat parityajya atītalakṣaṇāpannaṃ bhavati, punaḥ tadeva āgāmilakṣaṇāpannaṃ bhavati| avasthāpariṇāmastu atītamatītataramatītatamamanāgatamanāgatataramanāgatatamamiti tatraiva nūtanacirantanādyavasthāpattiḥ; ato na cetanopādānena kṛtyamiti, netyāha -- na caivaṃ mantavyamiti|| kuta iti tadāha -- tathā satyapākṛtāhaṅkṛtasaṃsargaḥ iti|| ahamiti kṛtiḥ-karaṇaṃ yasmin, sa sākṣī ahaṃkṛtiḥ| ayamāśayaḥ -- cetanasyānātmanasambhedāvabhāso nākhyātiḥ, nāpyanyathākhyātiḥ, nāpi cātmakhyātirityuktam, idānīṃ cetanasyaiva svāvidyāvivartamānamithyāvastusambhedāvabhāsalakṣaṇānirvacanīyakhyātyanabhyupagame cetanācetanayoratyantaviviktāvabhāsa eva syāt, na sambhedāvabhāsaḥ iti|| atra naiyāyikā manyante -- ātmendriyaviṣayeṣu samavahiteṣu kadācit vijñānodayasāmarthyādātmāśrayajñānādivṛttīnāṃ kramajanane karaṇabhūtaṃ kiñcit manaḥkalpitam| tatra tadatirekeṇāntaḥkaraṇaṃ nāma jñānasukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayat‌nādivijñānakriyāvṛttyāśrayaṃ ayaḥpiṇḍavadagneḥ ādarśavat mukhasya appātravaccandrasya ātmāvacchedakatayā tasminnatadāropopādhibhūtaṃ kiñcit na paśyāmaḥ| buddhiriti cet, na -- "buddhirupalabdhiḥ jñānamityanarthāntara"mityakṣapādasūtravacanāt| jānāti buddhirātmopalabhate iti cet, na;pratidhātvarthaṃ dharmibhedaprasaṅgāt, tasmāt varṇitamantaḥkaraṇaṃ nāstīti, tatrāha -- sa ca pariṇāmaviśeṣaḥ iti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- "buddherguṇenātmaguṇena caiva ārāgramātro hyavaropi dṛṣṭaḥ" iti śrutau pariṇāmaguṇavattayā dravyamityavagratā buddhiḥ; tathā "yadā pañcaiva līyante jñānāni manasā saha| buddhiśca neṅgate tatra paramātmānamaśnute||" iti śrutau ceṣṭāśrayatvena dravyamityavagatā buddhiḥ; tathā "vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute" ityānandamayasyātmanaḥ pṛthagabhidhānāt vijñānaṃ buddhirityanarthāntaratvād buddhiḥ kriyāśrayatvena dravyamityavagatā; tathā "vijñānena vā ṛgvedaṃ vijānāti" "manasā hyeva paśyati" iti ca karaṇāntapātinoḥ vijñānamanasorekatvāt manasaśca kāmasaṅkalpādivṛttimattvaśravaṇāt ekamantaḥkaraṇaṃ vijñānakriyāśaktimat manaādiśabdavācyaṃ śrutiliṅgebhyaḥ prasiddham; tathā "buddherguṇenātmaguṇena caiva" "sadhīḥ svapno bhūtvā imaṃ lokaṃ sañcarati" "vijñānamayo manomayaḥ" ityādiśrutāvātmāvacchedakatayā svaguṇāropagamanāgamanādinimittatvaṃ cāvagatam; tathā "kasminnvahamutkrānte utkranto bhaviṣyāmi" iti śrutāvutkrāntyādyupādheḥ prāṇasyāpyantaḥkaraṇāṃśatvamavagatam; yugapadupādhidvayāyogāt| tataśca varṇitamantaḥkaraṇaṃ śrutiliṅgasiddhamiti| nanu arthavādaliṅgānāṃ nyāyāpekṣā vidyate, satyam; niraṃśasarvagatāsaṅgasyākāśasyeva nirupādheḥ gamanaparicchedādyanupapattireva nyāyaḥ ityalamatiprasaṅgena|| nanu ātmana eva vijñānakriyāpariṇāmaśaktī kiṃ na syātām iti niravayavasarvagatāsaṅgasya pariṇāmānupapatteḥ, pariṇāmyantaḥkaraṇasannidhānācca pratibhāsasyānyathāsiddheriti sadṛṣṭāntamāha -- tenāntaḥkaraṇoparāganimittamiti|| mithyātvaṃ sphaṭikalauhityasya; klṛptapratītisattayoḥ kāraṇābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| tadubhayābhāvamuttaragranthena sādhayati|| tatrākhyātivādī -- na sphaṭikagataṃ mithyālauhityamavabhāsate, kintu japākusumagatameva gṛhyamāṇaṃ sphaṭikādaviviktamevāvabhāsate iti codayati -- kathaṃ punaḥ sphaṭike iti|| naitadityāha -- yadi sphaṭikapratisphālitāḥ iti|| nanu doṣabalādindriyasya kusumasaṃyogābhāvāt na sanniveśagrahaṇamiti, netyāha -- na hi rūpamātraniṣṭhaḥ iti|| saṃyuktasamavāyāt saṃyogādvāguṇagrahaṇe dravyamapi saṃyuktamiti bhāvaḥ| anyathākhyātivādī-rūpamātraṃ pratibimbitaṃ sphaṭikātmanā pratibhātīti vakti, tannetyāha -- nāpi svāśrayamiti|| tarhi sphaṭikadeśe lauhityaṃ sadravyamevāviviktaṃ sphaṭikātmanā vā gṛhyate iti codayati -- nanvabhijātasyeveti|| tathāpyanyathākhyātau saṃsargamithyātvamityāha -- tathāpi svayamalohitaḥ iti|| akhyātivādino matamādadāti -- atha prabhaiva lohiteti|| tarhi sphaṭikagrahaṇe saṃyuktasamavāyakāraṇapauṣkalyādapratibaddhasaṃyogādvā rūpagrahaṇamapi syādityāha -- śauklyamapi tarhīti|| virodhiguṇayā prabhayā virodhiguṇasyāpasāraṇaṃ pratibandhau vā kṛtaḥ iti śaṅkate -- prabhayā'pasāritaṃ taditi|| apasāraṇe doṣamāha -- sa tarhi nīrūpaḥ iti|| pratibandhaśca dravyasyāpi samānaḥ| guṇadvārā virodhisāmyādityarthaḥ| rūpahīnamapi dravyaṃ rūpiprabhāsaṃyogāccākṣuṣaṃ syāt ityāśaṅkyāha -- na ca rūpisaṃyogāditi|| tarhi śauklyamapasārya lauhityasyotpannatvāt rūpavattayā cākṣuṣaḥ sphaṭikaḥ iti , netyāha -- na prabhānimittamiti|| abhyupagamya prabhāṃ ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| tataścoparaktāhaṅkāranimittamātmani kartṛtvādyoropaṇamityāha -- tadevamiti|| nanu ahaṅ‌kāradharmasyātmanyāropamātraṃ kriyate kiṃ vā mithyaiva dharmāntaramutpadyate iti| pūrvasmin nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, anyathākhyātiśca syāt, uttarasmin satyamithyākartṛdvayāvabhāsaḥ syāt, ucyate -- ahaṅkārasya svadharmasahitasyaivātmanyadhyastatayā mithyātvāt na anyathākhyātiprasaṅgaḥ, anyasannidhānādanyasmin mithyādharmāvabhāsaḥ ityetāvati dṛṣṭāntaḥ| atha vā -- kartṛtvadvaye'pi dharmiṇorekatvāpattyā dharmabhedāvabhāsaḥ ityavirodhaḥ| nanu "bhidyate hṛdayagranthiḥ" ityādau hṛdayagranthirātmani anarthaheturiti gamyate, tat kathamahaṅkārasyocyata iti tatrāha -- tataḥ saṃbhinnobhayarūpatvāditi|| nanu ātmā svātmanyuparaktāhaṅkārataddharmādīn nāvabhāsayet, uparaktatvasāmyāt sphaṭikādivaditi, tatrāha -- tatra jaḍarūpatvāditi|| jāḍyacaitanye avabhāsakatvānavabhāsakatvayornimitte, noparaktatvānuparaktatve ityarthaḥ| nanu cetanasyāpyuraktaviṣayajñānavyāpāraśūnyatvāt jāḍyādaviśeṣa iti tatrāha cidrapasya punariti|| avyavadhānena citsaṃsarga eva pratibhāsahetuḥ, na jñānavyāpāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ| nanu sākṣisvarūpavat vijñānakriyāvyavadhānamantareṇa ahaṅkārasya siddhau kathamidamaṃśatā iti tatrāha -- tena lakṣaṇataḥ iti|| arthasvabhāvata ityarthaḥ| arthataḥ citsvarūpatā anidamaṃśatā, caitanyakarmatā cedamaṃśatā, na jñānakriyāvyavadhānatetyarthaḥ| vyavahārataḥ punaḥ kathaṃbhūtasya idamaṃśatā iti tadāha -- vyavahārataḥ punariti|| yaduparāgāt-yasyāhaṅkārasyoparāgādityarthaḥ| tadātmana iti|| tadātmatāṃ ahaṅkārātmatāṃ āpannasyetyarthaḥ| tadvyāpāreṇa-ahaṅkāravyāpāreṇeti| vṛttivyavadhānasiddhireva śarīrendriyaviṣayāṇāṃ idamiti pratibhāsitā tadavyavadhānasiddhirevānidaṃpratibhāsiteti bhāvaḥ| nanu ajñānavyavahito'haṅkāraḥ, kathamavyavadhānādidaṃtāvabhāsābhāvaḥ syāditi atrāha -- ata eva ahaṃ iti|| anidantāpratibhāsādeva-ajñānamātravyavadhānādevetyarthaḥ| nanu arthato yuṣmadarthatve tathāpratibhāsābhāvo na yuktaḥ iti; atrāha -- dṛṣṭaśca lakṣaṇataḥ iti|| nanu tatra vimarśe'pimṛnmayavyavahāro na jāyate, iha tu vimarśe yuṣmadarthatā vyavahriyate, ato nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ ityata āha -- vyutpannamatayastviti|| ata eva nipuṇataramabhivīkṣya ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| yadi sphaṭikodāharaṇenaivātmanyanātmādhyāsaḥ siddho na tarhi darpaṇajalādyudāharaṇena vedāntavihitena kṛtyamiti ; tatrāha -- yat punaḥ darpaṇajalādiṣviti|| nanu pratyaṅmukhatābhedāvabhāsābhyāṃ vastvantare bimbāt pratibimbe pratyakṣe kathamekatvapramāṇamantareṇa tadeva tat iti codayati -- kathaṃ punastadeva taditi| vyaktipratyabhijñānāditi pariharati -- ekasvalakṣaṇatvāvagamāditi|| nanu abhijñāyāṃ bhedapratibhāsaḥ kathaṃ pratyabhijñayā bādhyate iti ; tatrāha -- na tadvastvantaratve iti|| nanu vyaktigatayoraikyabhedāvabhāsayoḥ kena kiṃ bādhyamiti viśaye vyaktibhedaḥ tatropapattiśūnyatvādbādhyate ityāha -- api ca arthādvastvantaratve iti|| darpaṇāvayavā eva vyaktyantarākāreṇa pariṇatāḥ iti vācyam, anyathā vyaktyut‌pattyupāyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu mukhalāñchitapratimudreyaṃ, na pariṇāma iti, netyāha -- viruddhaparimāṇatvāditi|| astu tarhi pariṇāma iti; netyāha -- tathā satīti|| nanu dṛśyate eva sarvadā, naivam; darpaṇasya tiryaṅnirīkṣaṇe pūrvotpannamukhadarśanābhāvāt|| nanu nimittakāraṇāpāye'pi kāryamapaiti, yathā vaiśeṣikāṇāmapekṣābuddhivināśe dvitvādivināśaḥ hastasaṃyogāpāye ca kaṭavivaraṇāpāyaḥ iti; netyāha -- na khalu saṃveṣṭitaḥ iti|| sarvatrāgnisaṃyuktadrutatāmrādāviva puṣkalakāraṇena viruddhakāryodayādeva pūrvakāryavināśaḥ, vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ ca prakriyāmātraṃ; taddvitvādervastusahabhāvitvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu saṃskārajanyakāryāntarodayāt pūrvakāryavināśaḥ, na nimittakāraṇāpāyāditi iti, tatrāha -- tathā ca yāvaditi|| nimittāpāyamātrāccedvivaraṇāpāyaḥ saṃskārābhāve saṃveṣṭeteti bhāvaḥ| ihāpi tarhi pūrvasaṃsthānasya cirakālaṃ saṃssthānasaṃskārabalādviruddhakāryodaye pratibimbāpāyaḥ iti cet, na; utpannadarpaṇamātre cirakālāvasthitamukhapariṇāmasaṃskāre'pi bimbāpāyamātrāt pratibimbāpagamadarśanādityāha -- evaṃ cirakāleti|| nanu cirakālāvasthitavikāsapariṇāmasaṃskārapracaye'pi savitṛkiraṇāpāye vikāsāpāyadarśanavaccirakālāvasthitapratibimbāpāyo'pi bimbāpāye syāditi ; netyāha -- yaḥ punaḥ kamalamukulasyeti|| nanu nimittakāraṇāpāya eva tatrāpi nimittaṃ, na pārthivādyavayavajanyā mukulateti ; tatrāha -- taduparame iti|| ādarśe'pi tarhi mukhaviparītakāryapariṇāmahetuḥ kalpyatāmiti ; netyāha nādarśe punariti|| kārukarmāpekṣaṃ cādarśatalajanmeti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca, satyapi bimbasannidhāne darpaṇadravya mukhākāraṃ kartuṃ dāhacchedādibahuprayatnadarśanāt, sparśagocaratvābhāvācca| avayavavyavadhāne cākṣuṣatvamapi na syāt ityabhyuccayaḥ| tatrāyaṃ prayogaḥ -- na darpaṇādau mukhavyaktyantaramasti, tajjanmakāraṇaśūnyatvāt; śaśamastake viṣāṇavaditi|| tarhi śuktikārajatavat mithyātvopapatteḥ na mukhaikatvamiti codayatyatrāheti|| nanu pratyabhijñayā ekatvamavagatamiti; netyāha -- śuktikārajatasyeti|| mithyārajate'pi pratyabhijñā dṛśyate -- "madīyamidaṃ rajatamitī"tyarthaḥ| uttaramāha -- maivaṃ; tatra hīti|| tatra "nedaṃ rajatami"ti rajatasvarūpameva bādhyate, "nātra rajataṃ kiṃ tu tadidaṃ rajatami"ti deśamātrabādhayā satyarajatenaikatayā na pratyabhijñāyate; ato rajate'bhijñābādhāt pratyabhijñā vibhrama ityarthaḥ| iha tu "nedaṃ mukhami"ti na svarūpeṇa bādhyate, kiṃ tu "nātra mukhaṃ, madīyameve"ti pratyabhijñāyate; na ca sā bādhyate, vyaktyantaratve ca "nātra mukhamastī"ti na bādhaḥ syādityarthaḥ| yaḥ punariti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu svamukhāvayavānāmacākṣuṣatvāt kathaṃ pratyakṣapratyabhijñā na; katipayāvayavadarśanādapi lokavadavayavinaścākṣuṣatvopapatteḥ| tattvamasivākyaṃ tvaṃpadārthabādhanimittam, saṃsāriṇo vināśamantareṇa mokṣānupapatteḥ, ato nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti codayati -- nanu tattvamasivākyāditi|| "so'yaṃ devadattaḥ itivat tādātmyaparaṃ, na parārthabādhaparamiti pariharati -- maivamiti|| kiṃ ca śāstrīyo'pīti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| "na vāristham" ityādityasya vāristhatopajīvyate|| akhyātivādī -- na bimbādanyatvena pratibimbaṃ nāma darpaṇagatamavabhāsate, kiṃ tu bimbameva darpaṇādaviviktaṃ prakāśate iti -- vadati, tadanuvadati -- yastu manyate iti|| spaṣṭapratyaṅmukhāvabhāsaṃ darpaṇāntaranupraviṣṭamiva svamātmānaṃ puruṣāntaravannirīkṣamāṇamivedaṃ yādṛgdṛśyamānaṃ mukhaṃ, tathā nāvabhāsate iti vadan kathamāptaḥ syādityāha -- tamanubhava eveti|| nanu mūrtadravyasya yugapat kātrsnyena deśadvayavartitvaṃ loke na kvacidapi dṛṣṭamiti codayati -- kathaṃ punaḥ paricchinnamiti|| ekamekadeśasthameva mukhaṃ saṃbhramādbhinnaṃ bhinnadeśasthaṃ ca avabhāsate ityāha -- na vayamiti|| kiṃ punaridamekasminnekadeśavastuni bhedabhinnadeśatvalakṣaṇaṃ vastu iti; tadāha -- vicchedastviti|| nanu māyayāpi pramāṇaviruddhaṃ kathamavabhāsate ityata āha -- na hi māyāyāmiti|| nanu vicchedāvabhāsaḥ kathamavidyāvijṛmbhitaḥ yāvatā ūrdhvāgro'pi spaṣṭamavabhāsamāno vṛkṣaḥ adho'gro jale pratīyate, na ca tatrājñānamastīti| ucyate -- na ca viṣayāvaraṇamajñānamadhyāsaheturityuktam| tatra aupādhikabhrameṣu upādhireva ātmāvidyāpariṇāme puṣkalakāraṇam| na cādhiṣṭhānayāthārthyasya jñānaṃ sopādhikabhrameṣvadhyāsavirodhi, kiṃ tu nirupādhikabhrameṣviti draṣṭavyam|| nanu sopādhikabhramatve bhedakartṛtvādyadhyāsasya, na tattvajñānādadhyāsanivṛttiḥ, kiṃ tu upādhimātranivṛttyeti codayati -- nanu satyeva bimbaikatāvagame iti|| coditadoṣaṃ parihartumāśaṅkāntaraṃ prathamaṃ nivartayati -- katham jīvaḥ pratibimbaścet, na bimbātmatāmavagantumalam, pratibimbatvāt, akṣipātragatadevadattapratibimbavat, ityetannirācaṣṭe -- devadattasyācetanāṃśasyeti|| acetanatvaprayuktā tatrānavagatiḥ, na pratibimbatvaprayuktā; ghaṭādiṣu tathā darśanāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu śarīrameva cetanamiti lokāyataḥ, tatrāha -- sacetanāṃśasyaiveti|| darpaṇajāḍyena pratibandhāt svabhāvajāḍyād‌vetyarthaḥ| devadattapratibimbasyācetanatve hetvantaramāha -- tathā cānubhavaḥ iti|| kadācit tasyāpi cetanatve svātantryāt tacceṣṭayā vināpīdaṃ ceṣṭatāmiti bhāvaḥ| nanu devadattasyaiva bimbasya bhramanivartakatattvajñānāśrayatvaṃ dṛṣṭam, evaṃ bimbatvād brahmaṇa eva bhramanirāsitattvajñānāśrayatvaṃ syāditi ; netyāha -- yasya hi bhrāntiriti|| na bimbatvakṛtaṃ tattvajñānāśrayatvāt, kiṃ tu bhrāntatvakṛtam, tadapyajñatvakṛtam, tadapi jīvatvanimittamiti bhāvaḥ|| nanu jīvalakṣaṇapratibimbātmatāmātmano brahma jānīyādvā na vā| na cet sarvajñatāhāniḥ, jānāti cet brahma svātmanyeva saṃsāraṃ paśyediti; netyāha -- yastu jānīte devadattaḥ iti|| devadatto hi svātmānamakṣipātre'lpatvādiguṇamavagacchannapi tattvajñānapratihatatvāt nānuśocati, evaṃ brahmāpi svātmani jīve pratibimbe saṃsāraṃ paśyadapi tattvajñānitvāt nānuśocati| tattvajñānasaṃsaraṇe cāvadātaśyāmatvādivat na itaretaratra vyavatiṣṭhete iti bhāvaḥ|| nanu ekatāvagame'pi na tatra vicchedavibhramo nivartate, satyam na pratibimbabhāvakṛtaṃ tat, kiṃ tu upādherajñānājanyatvājjñānānivartyatvakṛtamityāha -- nāpi jñānamātrāditi|| nanu jīvasyāpi tarhyupādhijāḍyenāskandanasambhavāt na bhrāntisamyagjñānāśrayatvaṃ, apratibimbatā ca tadāśrayatve syāditi, netyāha -- jīvaḥ punariti|| "rūpaṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūva" "ekadhā bahudhā caiva dṛśyate jalacandravat" "ata eva copamāsūryakādivat" iti ca śrutismṛtisūtraiḥ jīvasya pratibimbabhāvasya darśitatvāt, amūrtasya cākāśasya sābhranakṣatrasya jale pratibimbavadamūrtasya brahmaṇo'pi pratibimbasambhavāt, jānumātrapramāṇe'pi jale dūraviśālākāśadarśanāt, jalāntarākāśa evābhrādipratibimbayukto dṛśyata iti vaktumaśakyatvāt| tatpratibimbatvaṃ cidrūpatvaṃ ca śāstrapratipannaṃ pratyakṣapratipannaṃ ca na nirākartuṃ śakyate iti bhāvaḥ|| nanu ghaṭākāśavadupādhyavacchinno jīvaḥ kiṃ na syāt na -- sāmānyaviśeṣābhyāmupādhibhiraṇḍāntarvartibrahmaṇaḥ sarvātmanā jīvabhāvenāvacchinnatvādanavacchinnasya brahmaṇo'ṇḍādbahireva sadbhāvaprasaṅgāt, tatra sarvagatatvasarvaniyantṛtvādi brahmaṇo na syāt; avacchinnapradeśeṣvanavacchinnasya dviguṇīkṛtya vṛttyayogāt| svarūpāpekṣayā tat sarvaṃ, na bahisthitabrahmāpekṣayeti cet -- na -- "yo vijñāne tiṣṭhan" ityādau jīvavyatiriktasyaiva brahmaṇo jīvasaṃnidhānena vikārāntaravasthānaśravaṇāt, pratibimbapakṣe tu jalagatasvabhāvikākāśe satyeva pratibimbākāśadarśanādekatraiva dviguṇīkṛtya vṛttyupapatteḥ jīvāvacchedeṣu brahmaṇo'pi niyantṛtvādirūpeṇāvasthānamupapadyate iti pratibimbapakṣa eva śreyāniti mithyātattvajñānāśrayatvaṃ ca tatra pratyakṣamityāha -- sa cāhaṃkartṛtvamiti|| upādhisvarūpamapi bhrāntyaivāvabhāsate ityarthaḥ| ataḥ tattvajñānenopādhinivṛtteḥ vicchedāpāyaḥ itāyaha -- ato yukta iti|| nanu ajñānaṃ jīvāvacchedopādhiriti purastāduktam, tat kathamahaṃkāropādhitā jīvasyābhidhīyate iti| naiṣa doṣaḥ;caitanyasyāvacchedakavikalpatāratamyena vyavahāravikalpatāratamyāt| tathā hi -- nirvikalpakacaitanyamātraikarasaṃ avidyāsambandhādīṣadvikalpavyavahārālambanaṃ bhavati suṣupteḥ; tataḥ tadupādānāntaḥkaraṇāvacchedāt tadeva sthūlataravyavahārālambanaṃ bhavati svapne; punarantaḥkaraṇasaṃsṛṣṭasthūlaśarīroparāgāt sthūlatamaṃ bhavati jāgaraṇe| na copādhibhedāt jīvabhedaprasaṅgaḥ; pūrvapūrvopādhyavacchinnasyaivottarottareṇāvacchedāt| nirapekṣopādhibhede hi jīvabhedaḥ|| nanu sthūlaśarīropādānabhūtasūkṣmarūpasahitena liṅgaśarīrasaṃskāreṇoparaktamajñānaṃ suṣupte na jīvamavacchettumarhati; tatra bhrāntyabhāvāt, tallakṣaṇatvācca vibhāgasya| atha bhrāntijñānamanapekṣyaivārthagata eva vibhāgaḥ kalpyate, tatra vibhāgasya kāryatve suṣuptipralayādāvabhāvāt brahmaṇyeva avidyādisāṅkaryaṃ syāt, akāryatve vibhāgasyānāditvādavidyānimittatvaṃ na syāt, ucyate; -- brahmaṇyavidyādisāṅkaryaparihārāya suṣuptyādāvapi astyeva jīvabrahmavibhāgaḥ iti kalpyate| nanu arthagata eva tarhi vibhāgo na vibhramagataḥ, satyam; suṣuptyādigatavibhāgādanyatra jīvabrahmavibhāgo vibhramamātratayā avidyopādāna ucyate| nanu arthagato vibhāgastarhi nāvidyopādānaḥ; anāditvāt, avibhramatvācca, satyam; tathāpyavidyātantro vibhāgo'nāditvepī'pi brūmaḥ| yathā hi svātmāvidyāsambandho'vidyātantraḥ, nāvidyopādānaḥ; sambandhajananāt prāk svātantryeṇāvasthānānupapatteḥ, ajñānasyānāditvāccātmāvidyāsambandhasya nāvidyopādānatā|| nanu jīvabrahmāśrayo vibhāgaḥ kathamavidyātantraḥ syāt ucyate; -- anādyavidyāviśiṣṭaṃ caitanyamanādijīvabhāvena kālpanikānādibhedasya āśrayaḥ, na svarūpeṇa; tasyaikatvāt, ato viśiṣṭāśrayo vibhāgaḥ svarūpe'pi uparajyamāno viśeṣaṇāvidyātantrau viśiṣṭa ityavidyākṛto vibhāga ucyate| avidyātantrāṇāṃ cānirvacanīyatvamanāditvaṃ cāvidyāsambandhavanna virudhyate| loke ca darpaṇaghaṭādiviśiṣṭayoreva mukhākāśayoḥ mithyābhedāvabhāso na svarūpeṇa ityupādhitantratā bhedasyocyate; tasmādanādyavidyāpratibimbakṛtavibhāgasyaiva jīvasya tadutpannāhaṃkārādiviśeṣeṣu sthūlapratibimbāpekṣayā sarveṣāmupādhitvaṃ na virudhyate|| atra sarvasaṅkaravādī -- pratibimbasyāvastutvābhyupagamāt na jīvaḥ pratibimbamiti -- jalpati|| tatra mukhacitsvarūpayoḥ pratibimbeṣu nāvastutvamiṣyate| bhedaviparyāsādīnāmavastutvābhyupagame'pi na mukhacaitanyayoḥ kācit kṣatiḥ| mukhacitsvarūpayośca bimbātmatāṃ pramimīmahe mithyāṃśaparyudāsena| na ca mithyāṃśasya bandhamokṣau, kiṃ tu svarūpasyaiva; svarūpagatasyāpi sāṅkaryaparihārāyopādhibhedo darśitaḥ| tasmāt parasiddhāntāparijñānavilasito'yaṃ sarvasaṅkaravādino vibhramaḥ; "avastutvābhyupagamāt" iti|| ahaṃkāropādhinimitto jīvabrahmavibhāgo'nātmādhyāsaśca dṛṣṭāntadvayena siddhaḥ, tatra kiṃ rajjusarpodāharaṇena vedāntavihiteneti codite, tasya prayojanamāśaṅkāntaranivṛttirityāha -- nanu tatra vibhrāmyataḥ iti|| nirupādhikādhyāsapariniṣpannāhaṃkāropādhikaḥ kartṛtvādyadhyāsa iti kathayitumityarthaḥ|| nanu sarvatrādhiṣṭhānādhyasyamānavyatiriktopādhinimitta evādhyāso na nirupādhika iti codayati -- nanu tatrāpi yadi nāmeti|| pūrvānubhavasaṃskāramātropādhimātramihāpi vidyate, svatantropādhireva nirākriyate iti pariharati -- bāḍhamihāpīti|| na pūrvānubhavasaṃskāra eva bhramahetuḥ, na pūrvabhrāntisaṃskāraḥ iti niyamo'stīti bhāvaḥ|| nanu ātmani sopādhikasya nirupādhikasya cādhyāsasyodāharaṇatrayeṇaiva siddhatvāt na ghaṭākāśodāharaṇena vedāntavihitena kṛtyamastīti āśaṅkya, codyāntaranirākaraṇenāsaṅgatvasiddhiḥ prayojanamityāha -- tatra yadyapyanirvacanīyatayaiveti|| aruṇādinā sphaṭikādeḥ guṇuguṇitvena sambhede yogyasyāpyanirvacanīyatayā aruṇāderasambhedāvabhāsaḥ siddha ityanvayaḥ| kathaṃ punarghaṭākāśodāharaṇenāsaṅgatvasiddhiriti tatrāha -- tatra hīti|| nanu udāharaṇairevāvātmano'vikāritvaikatvāsaṅgatvānāṃ siddhatvāt na āgamena kṛtyamiti; netyāha -- etacca sarvamudāharaṇajātamiti|| pramāṇamantareṇodāharaṇamātrādarthasiddhyayogāt, pratyudāharaṇasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ|| "asmatpratyayaviṣayatvādi"ti bhāṣyamātmanyadhyāsopapattyartham| tatrāsmatpratyayaḥ tannimittādhyāsaśca darśitaḥ, viṣayaśabdārthamidānīmāha -- tadevaṃ yadyapīti|| gauṇyā vṛttyā viṣayaśabdaprayoge kiṃ guṇasāmyam iti; tadāha -- prameyasya ceti|| nanu savikalpakādhyāsasya savikalpakamevādhiṣṭhānaṃ vaktavyam; tathā darśanāt, na nirvikalpakacinmātram; tatra kathamahaṃkārādyadhyāsena savikalpake'haṃkārādhyāsaḥ iti codayati -- nanu vyavahārayogyatyatva iti|| nirvikalpe'pi savikalpādhyāsadarśanāt ajñānādhyāsena savikalpe pūrvāhaṃkārādhyāsena vā savikalpake cidavabhāse sambhavatyevottarāhaṃkārādhyāsaḥ ityāha -- nānāditveneti|| nanu avikāricaitanyaikatānasya niṣkalaṅkasvabhāvānandasyāsaṅgasya ātmano na pramātṛtvamupapadyate; pramāṇakriyāpariṇāmābhāvāt, na ca pramātṛtvahīnasya kartṛtvabhoktṛtve sambhavataḥ, iti pramātṛpramāṇaprameyakartṛkarmakāryabhoktṛbhogabhoktavyasaṃsargalakṣaṇasya vyavahārasyātmanyasambhavāt, ahaṃkārasya cācetanatayā tadāśrayatvāyogāducchinnavyavahāramidaṃ jagadāpadyeteti prāptam; atha svabhāvasiddhaicaitanyaprakāśenaiva viṣayaṃ prakāśayet, tarhyaviśeṣāt sarvagatatvācca sarvaṃ prakāśayedityavyavasthaiva| tasmāt vikārasamartha evātmeti, atra apara āha -- na tāvat sarvagatātmavādināmidaṃ codyaṃ sambhavati; katham yadi tāvadātmaviṣayendriyamanaścatuṣṭayasaṃnikarṣādinotpadyamānaṃ vijñānaṃ kriyā vā guṇo vā yāvadātmasamavāyyevotpadyeta; niravayave pradeśāśrayatvānupapatteḥ, tadā yugapat sarvamūrtadravyasaṃyogalakṣaṇatvāt sarvagatatvasya, svāśrayātmasaṃyuktavastunaḥ sarvasyāvabhāsi vijñānaṃ syāt; pradīpādiṣu kriyāprakāśaguṇayoḥ svāśrayasaṃyukte vastunyanurūpaprakāśādyatiśayahetutvāt, adṛṣṭena kvacideva viṣaye jñānaṃ niyamyate iti cet, na; pradīpādiṣu yāvatsaṃyuktavastvavabhāsiṣvadṛṣṭena vastusāmarthyamatikramya niyamādarśanāt, sukhaduḥkhādyanimittatṛṇādyupekṣaṇīyasarvaviṣayāvabhāsena cādṛṣṭaniyamānupapatteḥ| janakameva jñānaṃ prakāśayati, na sarvamiti cet, na; cakṣurādiṣu prakāśaprasaṅgāt, viṣayasya nirūpyamāṇatvāt viṣayatayā janakamiti viśeṣaṇāyogāt, pradīpādiṣu ca prakāśaguṇasya svāśrayasaṃyuktājanakaviṣayasyāpi prakāśakatvadarśanāt| kriyārūpe'pi vijñāne samānametat| iṣvādivyāpārāṇāmanuddiṣṭe'pi viṣaye svāśrayasaṃyoge satyatiśayahetutvadarśanāt| niravayavatvādātmano na sarvasayaṃgaḥ iti cet, na kiṃcidapi; prakāśeta; kriyāguṇayoḥ svāśrayamatilaṅghya anyatra saṃsargāyogādasaṃsargāt, asaṃsṛṣṭe cātiśayāyogāt|| atha śarīrāvacchinnātmapradeśasamavāyyeva jñānaṃ, na yāvadātmasamavāyīti matam, tarhi sāvayavatvamātmanaḥ, na vyavahitaviṣayāvabhāsaśca syāt; ātmāśrayaprakāśasya viṣayeṇāsaṃsargāt, na cāśrayātilaṅghanaṃ kriyāderityuktam| na ca anāśrayātmapradeśasaṃbandhādavabhāsaḥ; sarvasya avabhāsaprasaṅgāt| nanu abhicārakarma svāśrayātmapradeśāsaṃyukte puruṣāntare anarthaṃ janayati, tadvadihāpi syāt, naitat sāram; dṛṣṭakriyāsāmardhyādevādṛṣṭe'pyubhayātmapradeśasaṃyuktasya devatātmano vā īśvarasya vā hetvantarasya vā anumīyamānatvāt| na ca ātmasaṃyuktamanassaṃsṛṣṭendiyasaṃyuktaviṣaye atiśayaḥ puruṣāśrayajñānādupapadyate; viṣayasaṃyukte'pi vastvantare "prakāśate" iti vyavahārātiśayaprasaṅgāt, pūrvabhāvitvācca saṃyogapravāhasya jñānavatā viṣayasya vartamānasaṃyogapravāhābhāvāt| evamaṇudehaparimāṇātmavāde'pi tulyo doṣaḥ| tasmāt na sarvavādināṃ pramāṇādivyavahārasambhavaḥ iti|| satyam; asmatpakṣe tu kathaṃcit saṃbhavaṃ pradarśayiṣyāmītyāha -- tatraivaṃbhūtasyāhaṃkarturiti|| idamaṃśasya-antaḥkaraṇasyetyarthaḥ| vyāpāra iti pariṇāmo'bhidhīyate| prakāśasvabhāvaṃ sāvayavamantaḥkaraṇamadṛṣṭendriyādisahakṛtaṃ dhruvādiviṣayaparyantaṃ dīrghaprabhākāreṇa pariṇamate; tejasaḥ śīghrātidūragamanadarśanāt, pariṇāmadvāreṇa cakartṛkarmasambandho'vasthāviśeṣaḥ ityāha -- sa ca prāp‌notikriyāhiteti|| syādantaḥkaraṇasya svapariṇāmadvāreṇa viṣayasaṃbandhaḥ, ātmanastu viṣayaviśeṣāvabhāsaḥ katham iti tadāha -- tena viṣayaviśeṣasaṃbaddhamiti|| sarvatrāvidyāvṛtatayā anabhivyaktasvabhāvamapi caitanyaṃ, antaḥkaraṇaṃ yena yenāvasthāviśeṣeṇa vivartate, tena tenākāreṇa vyajyate; ayaḥpiṇḍeneva catuṣkoṇatvādyavasthāviśeṣamāpadyamānena kṛśānuḥ, iti viṣayasaṃsṛṣṭāntaḥkaraṇāvacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ tadākāramavabhāsate iti bhāvaḥ| nanu pramātṛrūpāvacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ tadrūpeṇa bhāsatām, kathaṃ caitanyasya viṣayāvacchedaḥ iti; tadāha -- karmakārakamapīti|| svavyāpārāviṣṭaṃ iti|| pariṇāmasaṃsargādāpannajāḍyābhibhavalakṣaṇayogyatvamucyate| antaḥkaraṇaṃ hi svasminneva svasaṃsargiṇyāpi caitanyābhivyaktiyogyatāmāpādayatīti bhāvaḥ|| nanu avacchedakabhede citprakāśabhedāt kathaṃ viṣayāvacchinnānubhavasya pramātṛrūpāvabhāsasaṃsargaḥ asaṃsarge vā kathaṃ "mayedamavagatami"ti pramātṛ prameyasaṃsargāvabhāsi saṃvedanaṃ syāt anubhavabhedāt, ekasmin saṃbandhāvagame padārthayoravabhāsāyogāditi, tatrāha -- pradhānakriyāhitapramātravasthāviśeṣāvacchinnāparokṣataikarūpāṃ iti|| ekāmityarthaḥ| pariṇāmasyobhayasaṃsargāt vyañjakābhedena vyaṅgyāvicchedaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ubhayatra caitanyābhivyaktyaviśeṣe ghaṭāvacchinnānubhavaḥ pramātā kiṃ vā antaḥkaraṇāvacchinnaḥ iti na viśeṣaḥ syāt iti, netyāha -- tataścātmano'ntaḥkaraṇāvasthāviśeṣopādhijanito viśeṣa iti|| pramāteti vākyaśeṣaḥ| karturhi pramātṛtā, na karmaṇaḥ| tatrāntaḥkaraṇasya kartṛtvāt tadavacchinnaḥ pramātetyarthaḥ| nanu caitanyasyaikatve pramātaiva phalamiti viruddhamāpannamiti, tatrāha -- viṣayānubhavasaṃśabdito viṣayasthāparokṣaikarasaḥ phalaṃ iti|| antaḥkaraṇāvacchinnatayā pramātā, viṣayāvacchinnatayā phalamiti bhāvaḥ|| nanu kriyāphalayorantaḥkaraṇātmasamavāyinoḥ bhinnāśrayatvam, ghaṭāntaḥkaraṇaviṣayatayā ca bhinnaviṣayatvamiti kriyāphalayorekāśrayatvaikaviṣayatvaniyamavirodhaḥ iti, netyāha -- iti kriyaikaviṣayatā phalasyeti|| "viṣaye"tyāśrayasyāpyupalakṣaṇam| antaḥkaraṇātmanoraikyādhyāsenaikāśrayatvaṃ, caitanyasyāpi ghaṭāvacchedādekaviṣayatvamiti| nanu "buddhisthamarthaṃ puruṣaścetayate" iti sāṅkhyāḥ, tadviruddhaṃ ātmā svacaitanyoparaktaṃ cetayate iti tatrāha -- evaṃ cāhaṃkarteti| prathamaṃ buddhisthamarthaṃ tadātmatāmāpannaḥ paścāccetayate ityarthaḥ| uktaṃ tāvat sarvagatasyāpyātmano'vidyāvṛtaprakāśasya paricchinnāntaḥkaraṇapariṇāmopādhyabhivyaktyapekṣayā viṣayaviśeṣaṃ prati pramātṛtvam|| nanu keyamabhivyaktiḥ āvaraṇābhibhava eva, na svarūpātiśayaḥ| nanu uktopādhiḥ kiṃpramāṇakaḥ| uktaṃ -- "hvīrghīrbhīrityetatsarvaṃ mana eva" iti| dhīśabdavācyajñānapariṇāmavat mano vijñānaṃ buddhiriti| tadevamupādhivaśāt niyame'pi tadajñānāt yaccoditaṃ -- caitanyasya sarvaviṣayāviśeṣitvāt sarvamasya yugapadavabhāseteti, tat pariharati -- tatra ca pramātuḥ svayaṃjyotiṣaḥ iti|| pariṇāmasaṃsṛṣṭakarmopādhiniyamāt na asaṃsṛṣṭeṣu caitanyābhivyaktiriti naikasya pramātuḥ sarvaviṣayāvabhāsaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| nanu karmakārake'pi caitanyamabhivyaktaṃ cet, sarvapramātṛsādhāraṇatayā sarveṣāmavabhāsatāmiti, netyāha -- karmakārakamapīti|| etatpramātṛcaitanyābhinnatayaivābhivyaktaṃ tadviṣayacaitanyaṃ na pramātrantaracaitanyābhedena abhivyaktam, ato na sarveṣāmavabhāsyatvamityarthaḥ|| nanu svayaṃprakāśamānasya pradīpādivat svasaṃsargyaśeṣavastuprakāśitve prāpte, kathamahaṃkāropādhiniyamaḥ kalpyate na cāntaḥkaraṇapariṇāmasaṃsṛṣṭaviṣayādanyatra caitanyamuparaktamapi na prakāśayatīti -- yuktam; prakāśasaṃsargasyaiva prakāśamānatābhidhānāt| viṣayāntareṣu caitanyasyāsaṅgitayā noparāgaḥ iti cet, antaḥkaraṇe'pi tarhyasaṅgitayā noparāgaḥ, iti tadupādhināpi na kiṃcidapi prakāśeta| syādetat -- antaḥkaraṇāvacchinno hi jīvaḥ pratibimbasthānīyaḥ paricchinnaḥ tatsaṃsṛṣṭameva viṣayaṃ prakāśayet, brahma tu bimbasthānīyaṃ sarvagatatvāt sarvamavabhāsayiṣyati| na ca brahmaṇi sarvadarśitvaṃ mukhāvadātatvavat jīvamanugacchati, jīvagataṃ vā kiñcijjñatvaṃ mukhaśyāmatvāt na brahmānugacchatīti sarvamupapannamiti, naitat sāram; tathā sati viṣayāvacchinnacaitanyasya brahmacaitanyatayā ahaṅkārāvacchinnajīvānuṣaṅgābhāvāt sarvajñatvamiva viṣayāvabhāso'pi jīvasya na syāt| nanu -- jīvopādherantaḥkaraṇasya viṣayasya ca parasparānvayādubhayāvacchinnamapi caitanyamanyonyasaṃsṛṣṭamiti yukto jīvasya viṣayāvabhāsaḥ iti, naitadyuktam; tathā sati sarvagatena brahmaṇā nityasaṃsṛṣṭamantaḥkaraṇamiti tadupādhau jīvabrahmacaitanyābhedābhivyakteḥ brahmasārvajñyaṃ jīvasya nityavat prakāśeta|| atha matam -- sarvagatamapi caitanyamavidyāvṛtatvāt svayamapi tāvat na prakāśate, na ca svayamaprakāśamānaḥ caitanyaprakāśaḥ pradīpavat prakāśyamavabhāsayituṃ kṣamaḥ; aṅgulimātreṇādityavat paricchinnenāpi ajñānena sarvagatamapi caitanyaṃ tirodhīyate| tatrāntaḥkaraṇoparāgeṇāvaraṇābhibhavāt tatraivābhivyaktaṃ caitanyaṃ kiṃcideva prakāśayatīti| tadapi na yuktam; kāryabhūtenāntaḥkaraṇena svopādanājñānābhibhavāyogāt| tasmāt na yuktaṃ kiñcijjñatve ahaṃkāropādhivarṇanamiti, atrocyate; -- yukta evāyamupādhiḥ sarvagatasyāpi jīvasyāsaṅgitayā sarveṇāsaṃyogāt| prakāśasya ca saṃyuktavastvavabhāsitvāt, brahma tu sarvopādānatayā svātmābhinnaṃ jagadātmānamivāvabhāsayati, na tu jīvaḥ; anupādānatvāt| kathaṃ punaḥ sarvavastudeśāvyavahitatayā sarvagatasya viṣayāntareṣvasaṅgitayā asaṃsṛṣṭasyāntaḥkaraṇasaṃsargitā saṃbhavet ucyate yathā gotvādayo jātiviśeṣāḥ kesarādimadvyaktayantarapradeśasaṃnihitā api svabhāvaviśeṣādaśvādivyaktyantarapradeśasaṃnihitā api svabhāvaviśeṣādaśvādivyaktyasaṅgitayā tairanabhivyaktā api sāsnādimatpiṇḍasaṅgitayā abhivyajyante; yathā vā pradīpaprabhā vāyvākāśarasagandhādipradeśavyāpinyapi svabhāvaviśeṣāt tāni na prakāśayantī rūpasaṃsargitayā tadeva prakāśayati, evaṃ caitanyamapi svabhāvaviśeṣādantaḥkaraṇe saṃsṛjyate, nānyatreti yuktam| yathā ca kevalena vahninā na dāhyamapi tṛṇādi, ayaḥpiṇḍasamārūḍhena dahyate; tathā ahaṃkārasamārūḍhenātmanā, kevalenāprakāśyā api viṣayāḥ prakāśyante iti yuktamahaṃkāropādhivarṇanam|| athavā -- sopādhikatvāt jīvaḥ paricchinno na sarvamavabhāsayati; jīvāvacchedanimittāntaḥkaraṇapariṇāmasaṃsargakṛtābhivyaktitvāt viṣayāvacchinnacaitanyasya, jīvacaitanyatā ca na virudhyate| brahmākārapariṇatāntaḥkaraṇasaṃsargābhāvācca na nityavat brahmaṇaḥ prakāśaprasaṅgaḥ| na ca antaḥkaraṇasvarūpamātrasaṃsargiṇo'bhivyaktiraṅgīkṛtā; tadgatadharmādīnāmapi prasaṅgāt jīvākārāhaṃvṛttipariṇatāntaḥkaraṇena ca jīvo'bhivyajyate; anyathā jīvasya suṣupteḥ| ataḥ paricchinnatvāt na sarvaviṣayāvabhāsitā| atha vā -- ajñānāvṛtaḥ svayamaprakāśamānatayā vividhaviṣayānavabhāsayan antaḥkaraṇoparāgādāvaraṇatirodhāne tatraivābhivyaktaḥ tatsaṃsṛṣṭyaiva viṣayamavabhāsayati| dṛṣṭaṃ ca vṛścikavṛkṣādikāryasya gomayamṛdādivikārasvabhāvatirodhāyakatvaṃ, iti siddhaivātmani pramātṛtvādivyavastheti|| viṣayasya caitanyavivartatvāt tadabhinnamapi caitanyamahamavabhāsaikarūpamuktam, tatra apasiddhāntaprasaṅgaṃ codayati -- nanu nīlādiviṣayo'pi cediti|| yatkiñcitsāmyādapasiddhāntasaṃkaraḥ syāt, asti cātra mahān siddhāntabhedaḥ| kṣaṇikādvijñānāt bhedenārthakriyāsāmarthyasattvaśūnyaṃ viṣayamāhurvijñānavādinaḥ, tattvadarśinastu, advitīyāt saṃvedanādabhede'pi viṣayasya bhedenāpyarthakriyāsāmarthyasattvaṃ sthāyitvaṃ cābādhitamastīti vadanti| tatra kathaṃ siddhāntasaṅkaraḥ iti vadituṃ saṃvedanaikyaṃ darśayati -- maivam; parasparavyāvṛttāviti|| astvekarūpatā pratyabhijñānāt, bhedo'pi "ghaṭasaṃvit" "paṭasaṃvidi"tyavabhāsate iti, tatrāha -- vicchedavabhāse'pīti|| svarūpapratyabhijñā paropādhivicchedena na bādhyate iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ekatve'pi saṃvidāṃ viṣayābhedaḥ kiṃ na syāt iti tatrāha -- yadi syāditi|| anuvṛttasya vyāvṛttāt nābhedaḥ; anuvṛttatvāt, ākāśaghaṭādivat ityanumānamuktam| idānīṃ pratyakṣo'pi viṣayasaṃvidbhedaḥ ityāha -- kiṃ ca tairapīti|| nīlātmakasaṃviditi nīlamevocyate; yugapadviṣayaviṣayisaṃviddvayānabhyupagamāt| pratyagavabhāsa iti ahaṃsaṃvedanamātram| "ahaṃ nīlaṃ paśyāmī"ti kartṛkarmatayā bhedaḥ pratyakṣaḥ ityarthaḥ|| atra vijñānavādī codayati -- naitat dvayorapīti|| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- saṃvido'nyaccennīlaṃ, na tat saṃvedane'vabhāseta| bhāsate cet, sarvaṃ kimiti nāvabhāsate viśeṣasaṃbandhābhāvāt nīlasya| saṃvido janakatā viśeṣasaṃbandhaḥ iti cet, na -- indriyasyāpi viṣayatāprasaṅgāt| tasmāt svābhāvikāsādhāraṇābhedasaṃbandhādeva vijñāne nīlamavabhāsate iti|| siddhāntī tu bhedāvabhāso'pi pratyakṣo yuktyā kathamabahnūyate ityāha -- kathaṃ punaridamahaṃ jānāmīti|| vijñānavādī tu naitat trayamekasaṃvitpratibhāsi, kiṃ tu saṃvittrayametat kramavartīti pariharati -- nāyaṃ tadavabhāsaḥ iti|| kramavartitve anyasaṃvitkāle anyate nāvabhāseta, idaṃ tu tritayaṃ yugapat pratyakṣamevāvabhāsate, tataḥ pratyakṣaviruddhaḥ kramaḥ ityāha siddhāntī -- kathaṃ punasteṣviti|| āha vijñānavādī -- tadvāsanāsametasamanantarapratyayasamutthamiti|| ahamityahaṃkalpanopārūḍhaṃ kadācidvijñānaṃ bhavati, anantaraṃ "cedami"ti viṣayavikalpitaṃ vijñānaṃ bhavati| te eva vijñāne vāsanā; sajātīyajñānasya pūrvavṛttasajātīyajñānameva vāsanā, nānyaḥ saṃskāraḥ ityuktam|| tatra vāsanādvayasametāt "jānāmī"ti kriyāvikalpapratyayāt kāraṇatritayānurūpeṇa -- "ahamidaṃ jānāmī"ti viṣayakriyāhaṃkalpanāvikalpitaṃ tryākāramekaṃ vijñānamutpadyate iti āha siddhāntī -- kiṃ punarevamiti|| na hi kevala"mahami"ti ca "idami"ti vā "jānāmī"ti vā pratyayā dṛṣṭāḥ, kiṃ tu prathamata eva pratyayaḥ "ahamidaṃ jānāmī"ti kartṛkarmānubhavātmako dṛṣṭaḥ| tasmāt yathāṃpratibhāsamevā"hami"ti vijñānāt bhinnamarthakriyāsamarthaṃ nīlavastvanumantavyamiti bhāvaḥ| satyaṃ nānubhavamāśritya saṃvedanādabhinnaṃ nīlaṃ brūmaḥ, kiṃ tu vijñānena nīlasya pratibhāsānyathānupapattyā| katham sthāyitve hi vijñānaviṣayayoḥ kriyānimittasādhāraṇaparasparasaṃbandhādasādhāraṇo viṣayāvabhāsaḥ syāt, kṣaṇikasya tu āgantukasambandhābhāve yadi svābhāvikābhedasaṃbandho'pi na syāt, tatra caitanyenāsaṃsṛṣṭasya pratibhāsa eva na syāt| ataḥ pratibhāsānupapattirabhedaṃ sādhayatīti vijñānavādī varṇayati -- kṣaṇavidhvaṃsinaḥ kriyānupapatteriti|| tatra pratyakṣeṇa vijñānānāṃ kṣaṇikatvamucyate kiṃ vā anumānena nanu -- pratyakṣeṇa; tathāhi -- vartamānāvabhāsijñānaṃ svātmano'vartamānāt vyāvṛttimapi gamayati, nīlajñānamivānīlavyāvṛttaṃ nīlam; ato vartamānakṣaṇamātraṃ vijñānaṃ pratyakṣamiti| na tāvat pratyakṣeṇa vijñānabhedāvabhāsaḥ ityāha -- yadyevamahamiti saṃvidaḥ iti|| nanu satyapi bhedāvabhāse atisādṛśyāt na spaṣṭamavabhāsate iti śaṅkate -- athātyantasādṛśyāditi|| ko'yamabhiprāyaḥ yadi tāvat saṃvido'nyo bhedo jñānāntaragamyaśca sādṛśyadoṣāt spaṣṭaṃ nāvabhāsate ityabhiprāyaḥ, tadā dharmipratiyogisaṃvidoḥ saṃvidantarāviṣayatvāt na tayoḥ bhedagrahaṇaṃ syāt, viṣayatve vā dharmipratiyogibhedākhyatritayamapi bhedasaṃvedane kalpitaṃ tadabhinnaṃ vā syāt, atha saṃvitsvarūpameva, bhedaḥ saṃvedanameva tajjñānamiti, tatrāha -- saṃvido'pi cediti|| api ca aikyapratibhāse sādṛśyakalpanaṃ pramāṇaviruddham, bhinnayoraikyabhramaśca sādṛśyakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇam, tadabhāvācca na sādṛśyasiddhirityāha -- api ca tadrūpapratibhāse iti|| nanu aikyāvabhāsasya vyāmohatvāt na sādṛśyakalpanā pramāṇaviruddhā, aikyabhramaśca bhinneṣu sādṛśyamantareṇa anupapanna ityarthāpattimūlā ca sādṛśyakalpanā; ataḥ siddhaṃ sādṛśyamityāha pūrvavādī -- tadrūpapratītervyāmohatvāditi|| maivam; aikyabhramasādṛśyasiddhayoritaretarāśrayatvāditi pariharati -- na itaretarāśrayatvāditi|| nanu aikyāvabhāsasya prāmāṇyaṃ na svataḥ siddhyati, kiṃ tu sādṛśyasya nirmūlatvapramāṇaviruddhatvāpekṣayā; sādṛśyasya ca nirmūlatvapramāṇaviruddhatvamaikyapratibhāsasya iti tulyaṃ tavāpi itaretarāśrayatvamiti codayati -- syādetat; avyāmohe'pīti|| aikyāvabhāso na sādṛśyābhāvāpekṣaḥ, kiṃ tu svata eva pramāṇamiti pariharati -- naitat svārasikamiti|| nanu sādṛśyamapi svata eva siddhamityāśaṅkyāha -- na tu sādṛśyakalpanā svata iti|| kutastarhi sādṛśyasiddhiḥ ityata āha -- aprāmāṇyapūrviketi|| aikyabhramo hi bhinneṣu sādṛśyaṃ kalpayatīti bhāvaḥ|| nanu keyaṃ pratyabhijñā nāma yatsāmarthyabalāt saṃvidaikyaṃ pratīyate, pūrvānubhavasaṃskārasahitādidānīṃtanavastupramitikāraṇāt jātamekasya kāladvayasambandhaviṣayakaṃ pratyakṣajñānaṃ pratyabhijñeti cet, na tarhyātmani sā saṃbhavati| katham vijñānasvabhāvasya hyātmanaḥ sthāyitve, svayaṃprakāśasya jñānāntarāgamyatvāt tadvināśasaṃskārābhāvāt, svarūpasya cāvināśādavināśinaḥ saṃskārābhāvāt svayaṃprakāśasya cedānīntanasvarūpavyatiriktapramāṇakāraṇābhāvācca na pratyabhijñākāraṇaṃ tāvadātmani sambhavati| na ca svarūpajñānameva pratyabhijñā; tasya pradīpaprabhāvat vartamānaprakāśinaḥ pūrvāparaparāmarśātmakatāyogāt; "so'hami"ti ca viṣayākārābhyupagame "saḥ" iti "ahami"ti ca ākārabhedena viṣayabhedāt jñānabhedasiddheḥ| tasmāt na ātmani pratyabhijñeti yuktyā vyāmohatva siddhiriti|| atrocyate -- antaḥkaraṇaviviśiṣṭe tāvadātmani pratyabhijñānaṃ brūmaḥ, na niṣkalaṅkātmasvarūpamātre; tasya mokṣāvasthāyinaḥ śāstraikagamyatvāt| saṃsārāvasthāyāmantaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭasvarūpānapāyāt tasyaiva pratyabhijñayā sthāyitvābhidhānāt| tatra cāntaḥkaraṇajanyāhaṃpratyayādhīnatvāt viśiṣṭātmābhivyakteḥ pūrvakālaviśiṣṭātmānubhavanimittāhaṃvṛttisaṃskārasahitamantaḥkaraṇameva idanīntanātmāvyaktinimittaṃ sat pūrvāparakālaviśiṣṭātmaviṣayaṃ pratyabhijñānamutpādayati|| nanu pūrvāparābhijñayoraviṣayatayā abhivyaktasyātmanaḥ kathaṃ pratyabhijñāviṣayatvaṃ iti| naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathā saṃvedanasya svasaṃviditarūpasyāpi kālāntare svasaṃskārajanitasmṛtiviṣayatvaṃ, tadvadihāpyabhijñāyāmaviṣayasyāpi pratyabhijñāviṣayatvaṃ na virudhyate|| nanu svayaṃprakāśasya viṣayataivānupapannā, naivam; deśakālāntaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭatayā viṣayopapatteḥ| yathā dharmasyāgamaikasamadhigamyasyāpi idānīṃ phaladānāyonmukhībhāvādilakṣaṇadharmaviśiṣṭatayā vartamāna phalodayaliṅgādigamyatvaṃ, tadvat| nanu ekasyaivātmanaḥ pratyabhijñāyāṃ kathaṃ kartṛkarmatayā yugapat viruddharūpadvayānvayaḥ nanu sarvavādināṃ dehavyatiriktādyanumānaviṣayatayā kartṛkarmabhāvaḥ saṃpratipannaḥ., tanna; anumānādau viṣayasya kārakatābhāvāt ākāramātratayā viṣayatvāt tatra kartṛtaivātmanaḥ, na karmatā, pratyakṣe tu punaḥ viṣayasyāpi svaviṣayajñānajanakatayā karmakārakatvāt prāptaivātmano yugapadekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ viruddharūpadvayāpattiriti|| ucyate -- antaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭatayā ātmano jñātṛtvaṃ, pūrvāparakālaviśiṣṭatayā ca jñeyatvamityupādhibhedādavirodhaḥ iti| "so'hami"ti ca pratyabhijñāyāḥ svānubhavasiddhatvāt yathākathaṃcinnimittaṃ kalpayitavyam; vyavahārāvisaṃvādāt bhrāntitvāyogāt| na ca "so'hami"tyākārabhedādarthabhedena jñānabhedo yuktaḥ; vijñānaṃ kṣaṇikamityākārabhedenārthabhedāt vijñānasya kṣaṇikatābhāvaprasaṅgāt, satyam; vijñāne kṣaṇikatvādidharnoparāgo vikalpavyavahāramātram, na satyato'stīti cet, tathā sthāyitvādivyavahārāśca kālādidharmopādhitvādvijñāne vikalpavyavahārā ityaviśeṣaḥ| iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ -- sati kāle sthāyitvādivikalpapratyayāḥ "so'ham" ityādyanubhavasiddhā vyavahārāvisaṃvādino'rthakriyāsamarthāśca dṛśyante, na tathā kṣaṇikatvādivyavahārāḥ iti|| atra prābhākarā manyante -- naivaṃ pratyabhijñāyāṃ viṣayatvenāyamātmā sidhyati, kiṃ tu āśrayatveneti, tadayuktam; pūrvāparakālaviśiṣṭasya ātmanaḥ kṣaṇamātravṛttipratyabhijñānāśrayatvāyogāt tadāśrayatayā sthāyitvasiddhyabhāvāt| nanu pūrvakālasaṃvedanamidānīmanusmaryamāṇaṃ svāśrayaṃ tadānīntanamātmānaṃ sādhayati, smṛtiśca svāśrayatayā idānīntanaṃ ātmānaṃ sādhayati, iti kāladvayaviśiṣṭātmasiddhiriti, naitat sāram; smṛtipūrvānubhavau hi tattatkālamātmānaṃ sādhayataḥ, amijñāpratyakṣadvayavat, ekasya kāladvayasaṃbandhaḥ kena sidhyatīti vaktavyam -- pūrvāparasaṃviddvayameva sādhayatīti cet, maivam; ghaṭādiṣvabhijñādvayavyatirekeṇa pratyabhijñopādānāt| kiṃ ca na tāvat svayameva saṃviddvayaṃ sādhayati; ekaikasya kāladvayavadātmāśrayatvābhāvāt, na ca saṃbhūya pūrvāparasaṃviddvayaṃ tadvantamātmānaṃ sādhayati ; anyonyasya anyonyasaṃvidviśiṣṭātmaśrayatvābhāvāt| atha saṃviddvayameva pūrvāparasaṃviddvayāśrayātmaikatvaviṣayasaṃvidantaramutpādayati, siddhaṃ tarhi pratyabhijñānamātmaviṣayam| kiṃ ca "anubhūtaṃ maye"tyāśrayaviśiṣṭapūrvasaṃvidanusmṛteḥ svānubhavasiddhatvāt smaryamāṇatayaiva idānīṃ pūrvānubhūtātmasiddhiḥ, na pūrvasaṃvedanāśrayatayā; tasyāvidyamānasyedānīmasādhakatvāt| svayaṃprakāśamāne hi saṃvedanamātmāśrayaṃ sādhayati, na smṛtiviṣayatayā paraprakāśyam; anyathā dharmādīnāmapi paratassiddhānāṃ svāśrayātmasādhakatvaprasaṅgāt| tasmāt siddhamātmani pratyabhijñānamiti|| syāt tarhi anumānāt kṣaṇikatvamiti ghaṭādau sādhayati -- athānte kṣayadarśanāditi|| ghaṭasya vināśānantarapūrvakṣaṇaviśiṣṭasattvamanta ityucyate| tasya svasattākṣaṇāduttarakṣaṇe vināśo dṛṣṭaḥ| tatrāntyakṣaṇāvacchinnaghaṭasattvāt pūrvapūrvakṣaṇāvatthinnaghaṭasattvānyādirityucyante| tānyapi, svasattākṣaṇāduttarakṣaṇe vināśavyāptāni, ghaṭasattvāt; antyakṣaṇāvacchinnaghaṭasattvavadityanumānam| tataśca sato'nantaraṃ vināśāt kṣaṇikatvasiddhiriti kṣaṇikeṣvaikyaṃ sādṛśyanibandhanamiti|| tatra pratyanumānamāha -- ādau sattādarśanāditi|| ādiriti ghaṭasattāvacchedakāḥ kṣaṇāḥ ucyante| anta iti vināśāvacchekatvena abhimatāḥ kṣaṇāḥ| tatra antyakṣaṇāḥ sarve ghaṭasattayā vyāptā iti sādhyate| kālatvāt sattāvacchedakakālavaditi pratyanumānam| abhāvānubhavaviruddhamante sattānumānamiti codayati -- kṣayānubhaveti| tarhi antyakṣaṇāt pūrvakṣaṇāvacchinnaghaṭasattvānāmanantarakṣayānumānamapi pratyabhijñāviruddhamiti pariharati -- ihāpi iti| kṣayānubhavo'bhijñā anumānaṃ bādhate, na pratyabhijñā anumānāt durbaleti; netyāha -- na hyubhayoriti|| sarve bhāvāḥ, kṣaṇikāḥ, arthakriyākāritvāt, yadakṣaṇikaṃ na tadarthakriyākāri; yathā śaśaviṣāṇamityanumānāntaraṃ darśayituṃ sthāyino'rthakriyānupapattimāha -- atha manyeta yo'sau sthiratvenābhimata ityādinā|| nanu sthirasyaiva nimittasaṃyogādanyathābhūtasya kriyāpūrvakaṃ kāryamutpādayituṃ sāmarthyaṃ, na kṣaṇikasyeti siddhāntī codayati -- kathamayoga iti|| itthamayoga ityādiḥ parihāraḥ| krameṇeti| anekāni sātatyena kuryādityarthaḥ| ekaṃ vā anekaṃ vā kāryaṃ sakṛt kṛtvoparamate ityāha -- yogapadyeneti| kramapakṣaṃ dūṣayati -- na tāvaditi| anekāni kāryāṇi kartuṃ samarthaścet, puṣkalakāraṇasya bhāvādekasya anekakāryadarśanācca sakṛdeva kuryāditi bhāvaḥ| dvitīyaṃ pakṣaṃ dūṣayati -- nāpi yaugapadyeneti|| arthakriyākāritvalakṣaṇatvāt sattvasyeti bhāvaḥ| ataḥ sakṛtkartuḥ kālāntare punaḥ kartṛtve nimittābhāvāt akartṛtve vā asattvāt sakṛdeva sattvamityupasaṃharati -- ato'rthakriyākāritvādeveti|| siddhāntī tu -- sthāyinaḥ sakṛdeva kāryaṃ kṛtvā tūṣṇīṃbhūtasyāpi na asattvaprāptiḥ; sattvasya arthakriyākāritvalakṣaṇatvābhāvādityupapādayati -- atha keyamityādinā|| tatrāha -- svaviṣayajñānajananamiti|| yuktaṃ bāhyārthānāmetādṛśaṃ sattvam, vijñānānāṃ tu svaviṣayavijñānājanakatvāt na sattvalakṣaṇamiti dūṣayati -- prāptaṃ tarhi sarvāsāmiti|| nanu ekasantānajñānānāmanyonyaviṣayaviṣayitā'bhāve'pi puruṣāntarajñānasya viṣayatayā puruṣāntarajñānaṃ janakamityarthakriyālābhaḥ saṃvidāmiti, netyāha -- na santānāntare'pīti| puruṣāntarajñānaṃ pratipuruṣāntarajñānasya apratyakṣatvādanumeyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| anumānajñānaviṣayatvāt tarhi santānāntarajñānasya santānāntarajñānaṃ janakamiti, netyāha -- anumāne'pīti|| pratyakṣamevārthajanyaṃ, nānumānādīti te matamityarthaḥ| nanu sarvaṃ saṃvedanajātaṃ sarvajñānasya viṣayatayā janakaṃ bhavati, tasya sarvaviṣayapratyakṣatvāt ityata āha -- na sārvajñe'pīti|| sākṣāditi|| saha vijñānopaplavaiḥ avyavadhānena sarvajñajñānoparaktatayā; tadabhedenetyarthaḥ| tatra hetuḥ -- saṃsārasaṃvidekarūpatvaprasaṅgāditi|| saṃvidviṣayayorabhedopagamāt saṃsārikajñānaiḥ sopaplavaiḥ sarvajñajñānaṃ dūṣitaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu sarvopaplavoparaktamapi tatvajñānena bādhitattvāt na doṣamāvahati, na tāvat tadeva jñānaṃ svopaplavaṃ bādhate; prāptibādhayorekasmin kṣaṇe anupapatteḥ, jñānāntarasya tu na pūrvajñānopaplavo viṣayaḥ, yena tadanuvādena bādhaḥ syāt, viṣayatve ca bādhakajñāne'pyupaplavānāmabhedaḥ syāt| tarhi vinaivopaplavaiḥ sārvajñe jñāne vijñānānyuparajyante iti, netyāha -- atadrūpatve iti|| sarvajñasya laukikopaplavānavabhāsanādupadeśāyogaḥ iti bhāvaḥ|| atha na svaviṣayajñānajananamarthakriyā, kiṃ tu sajātīyakṣaṇāntarotpādaḥ iti codayati -- atheti|| uttaramāha -- caramakṣaṇasyāsallakṣaṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- ahamiti saṃtānapatitāni vijñānāni sthāyitvānusandhānakalpanābhyāṃ rāgādidoṣaiḥ viṣayaiśca upaplutāni pūrvapūrvasajātīyaviṣayavijñānalakṣaṇasaṃskārebhyaḥ uttarottarāṇyutpadyante| tatra sarvamidaṃ kṣaṇikamiti bhāvanayā sthāyitvakalpanā nivartate; svalakṣaṇabhāvanayā dravyaguṇaśabdakarmaviśeṣaṇa viśeṣakalpana vinaśyati; duḥkhamiti bhāvanayā rāgādidoṣapravṛttisukhaduḥkhopaplavāḥ kṣīyante; śūnyamiti bhāvanayā viṣayopaplavavigamaḥ; tataśca bhāvanābhedaiḥ caturbhiḥ caturvidhopaplave krameṇa mandīkṛte, bhāvanāprakarṣaparyantāt samanantarapratyayāt sarvopaplavavirahi vijñānamutpadyate, tat saṃsārasantānasya antyatvāt caramamiti tasya kāryāntarābhāvāt asattvaprasaṅgāt krameṇa sarvamasadeva pūrvaṃ syāditi| nanu caramakṣaṇo'pi svasantānajñānāntarābhāve'pi sarvajñajñānaṃ viṣayatayā janayatīti, netyāha -- na ca sarvajñajñānajananeneti|| tulyasvabhāvayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāva eva ekasantānatā nāma, caramakṣaṇasārvajñajñānayoḥ viśuddhatayā tulyasvabhāvayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvādavicchinnaḥ santānaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| mā bhūt saṃtānavicchedaḥ iti, netyāha -- muktyabhāvaprasaṅgāditi|| santānavicchedo hi muktirabhipreteti bhāvaḥ| atha sarvajñasantānasya tulyasantānasya tulyasvabhāvatayā janakatvāt tatsantānaikyameva muktiriti, tarhi viṣayatayā janakatvameva nāstītyāha -- na ca saṃvit saṃvido viṣayaḥ iti|| pratyakṣatvaṃ viṣayaśabdenocyate; puruṣāntarasaṃvedanasyānumeyatvāt| athavā pratyakṣasyaiva saṃvedanasya dehāntarasambandha evānumīyate iti sarvapramāṇāviṣayaḥ saṃviditi, athavā -- saṃvidātmanā bhedābhāvāditi ayamarthaḥ -- saṃvit saṃvidantarāt na saṃvidākāreṇa bhidyate; pratiyogino'saṃvittvaprasaṅgādekā saṃvit syāt| asaṃvidākāreṇa bhede'pi saṃvidekaiva syāditi na saṃvidāṃ viṣayaviṣayibhāvaḥ iti|| kiṃ ceti|| arthakriyā nāma kāraṇasattve hetuḥ pratītinimittaṃ vā iti vikalpya, hetutve dūṣaṇamāha -- svakāraṇaniṣpannasyeti|| kāryāt prāgeva kāraṇasya niṣpannatvādityarthaḥ| na ca niṣpannamapyarthakriyātaḥ pūrvamasaditi śakyaṃ vaktum; śaśaviṣāṇatulyatvenākāraṇatvaprasaṅgāt| pratītipakṣe anavasthādūṣaṇamāha -- tatra tasyā anyataḥ iti|| nanu kāryamarthakriyā nāma, jñānāni ca pūrveṣāmuttarottarāṇi kāryāṇi svayaṃsiddhānīti na pratītyanavastheti codayati -- nanu svajñānārthakriyāyāḥ iti|| tarhi kāryakāraṇabhūtānāṃ jñānānāṃ svayaṃsiddhatvāt na arthakriyā sattāvagatinimittamityāha -- na tarhyarthakriyātaḥ iti|| mā bhūt kāraṇabhūtaṃ jñānaṃ kāryabhūtajñānādhīnaprakāśaṃ svayaṃprabhatvāt, tathāpi svayaṃ svenaivāvabhāsate iti svayameva svasyārthakriyeti netyāha -- na hi svarūpameveti|| tasmāt na arthakriyākāritvalakṣaṇaṃ satvam, kiṃ tu svābhāvikamiti sakṛt kāryaṃ kṛtvā tūṣṇīṃ bhūtasyāpi sthāyinaḥ sattvaṃ na virudhyate iti|| idānīṃ krameṇāpi kāryaṃ kṛtvā sattvaṃ na virudhyate ityāha -- yat punaḥ krameṇeti|| śaktasyāpi sahakārisannidhānaviśeṣakramāpekṣayā kāryakramo yujyate ityāha -- sthāyino'pīti|| śaktasya sahakārikāraṇāpekṣāmapalapati -- atha kāraṇasyeti|| gūḍhābhisandhiruttaramāha -- akāraṇasyāpi na tarāmiti|| mā bhūt tarhi śaktasyāśaktasya ca sahakāryapekṣeti, tatrāha -- asahakāri viśvaṃ syāditi|| śaktasyaiva sahakāryapekṣayā kāryakaratvānubhavavirodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ| aśaktā eva padārthāḥ sāmagrīlakṣaṇakāraṇotpattau parasparamapekṣante, iti nānubhavavirodha ityāśaṅkate -- athākāraṇaṃ kāraṇotpattya iti|| kāryaṃ pratyaśaktā api padārthāḥ sāmagrīkāraṇaṃ prati śaktā vā na veti vikalpayati -- ata tat kāraṇasyeti|| ubhayatra dūṣaṇaṃ -- kāraṇaṃ cediti|| atha nāpekṣā ityuktārtham|| nanu śaktāśaktayoḥ apekṣā'bhāve kathaṃ sahakāryanubhavaḥ kathyate nanuna kāryasyāpyasattvāviśeṣāt sarvasmājjanma kiṃ na syāt kāraṇasya vā viśeṣasambandhahīnasya sarvasya janakatā kiṃ na syāt ityavyavasthāyāṃ kathaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvamātraṃ tvayā vyavasthāpyate atha anvayavyatirekasāmarthyāt kāryakāraṇaniyamaḥ iti, sahakāriṇo'pi tathetyāha -- tasmādyathaiva hetoriti|| kva tarhi sahakāryupayogaḥ iti tatra matāntaramupanyasya pūrvavādinaṃ dūṣayati -- yastu manyate sahakārijanitaviśeṣa iti|| yaḥ sahakāriṇamapekṣate, sa svātmani viśeṣotpattau śakto vā na veti vikalpyāhetutve dūṣaṇamāha -- viśeṣotpattāviti|| na hyaśaktaṃ sahakārisahasrasannidhāne'pi kiṃcit kurvat dṛṣṭamityarthaḥ| hetutve dūṣaṇamāha -- atha heturiti|| tatra prathamaviśeṣasya viśeṣāntarāpekṣayā anavasthāprasaṅgadoṣaparihārāya kiṃcideva sahakāribhiḥ kāraṇe viśeṣo janyate kāryajananāya, kvacittu kāraṇe viśeṣajanmānapekṣameva sahakāribhiḥ kāryaṃ janyata ityavyavasthā svayameva darśayati -- atha mataṃ na sarvaṃ kāryamiti|| tāvatyevābhavat-ucchūnatāviśeṣe satyevetyarthaḥ| tarhi śaktimatā kāraṇena svātmanyanupakurvannapi sahakāryapekṣyate iti tvayaiva svapakṣo nirastaḥ iti pariharati -- anupakurvannapi tarhīti|| āha sākṣād kṣaṇikavādī -- nānukurvanniti|| sarvasya sahakāritvapa3saṅgādityarthaḥ| kva tarhyupakaroti tadāha -- svarūpe tu nopakarotīti|| kāryaṃ hi sahakāriṇā jāyamānamupakriyata ityarthaḥ| tarhi kṣaṇikasyeva kāryasyopakārāya na virudhyata iti pariharati -- nityo'pi tarhyanādheyātiśaya iti|| tadeva prapañcayati -- yathaiva kṣaṇiko bhāva iti|| sāmagrīsādhyatvāditi|| bahukārakavyāpārasādhyatvādityarthaḥ| punaścopakāryamevopakārakaṃ sahakāriṇamapekṣate, nānupakāryaṃ bhavati tadapekṣata iti sambandhaḥ| nitye'pi tarhi kāraṇe kāryamevopakārakaṃ sahakāriṇamapekṣite nānupakāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ ityāśaṅkate -- atha mataṃ kṣaṇiko'pi naivāpekṣata iti|| yadanyasaṃnidhau bhavati, tadapekṣata iti sambandhaḥ| nitye'pi tarhi kāraṇe kāryameva sahakāriṇamapekṣya krameṇa bhaviṣyatīti; netyāha -- nityasya tu janakasyeti|| sahakāriṇāṃ kāraṇasya ca sarvadā bhāvāt sarvadā kāryajananādityarthaḥ| nanu sahakāriṇāmapi saṃnidhānamapekṣata iti;
