netyāha -- ko heturiti|| kāraṇasahakāriṇorapi sambandhaḥ kāryaṃ cet, so'pi kāraṇasahakāribhyāṃ sadā bhavatīti kāryajanma sadā bhavedityarthaḥ| nanu kṣaṇikādapi sahakārisavyapekṣāt kimiti sadā kāryaṃ na jāyate viśeṣavati sattākṣaṇe kāryajanmābhāvāt, pūrvottarakālayoḥ viśeṣābhāvāditi , tatrāha -- kṣaṇikastu yo janaka iti|| idamayuktaṃ vartata iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- na tāvadagnisvalakṣaṇasyaiva dhūmasvalakṣaṇaṃ prati kāraṇatvamavagantuṃ śakyam; kṣaṇamātrāpavargiṇoranvayavyatirekabuddhidvayakālāvasthānāyogāt, kiṃ tu agnidhūmasantānayoranvayavyatirekābhyāmagnisvalakṣaṇāni dhūmasvalakṣaṇānāṃ kāraṇānīti sāmānyopādhau pramātavyam| tatra agnisvalakṣaṇānāṃ viśeṣābhāvādaṅgāragatādapyagnisvalakṣaṇāt dhūmajanma kiṃ na syāt kāṣṭhasvalakṣaṇābhāvāditi cet, na; tasyāpi svasaṃtāne vidyamānatvāt| agnikāṣṭhasvalakṣaṇasaṃsargāpekṣā vidyata iti cet, na; santānadvayanityatve tannimittasaṃnidhānasyāpi sadā prasaṅgāt, tatrāpyanyāpekṣeti cet, ihāpi| nitye'pisahakārisaṃnidhānasya kadācidbhāvānnityavatkāryajananaprasaṅgo na yukto vartata iti| nanu sahakārisannidhānādeva kāryodayaniyame'pi dhūmakāṣṭhasantānayoḥ na upakāryopakārakasambandhaḥ ityāha -- kimatrāyuktamiti| pariharati -- sati niyama iti|| sahakāriṇāṃ kāryeṇānvayavyatirekaniyame'pi nopakāryopakārakasambandha ityuktirviruddhetyarthaḥ| nanu anvayavyatirekaniyamasya upakāryopakārakasambandhavyāptiḥ kva dṛṣṭā iti ; dṛṣṭā kāryakāraṇayoḥ ityāha -- tathā hi yaḥ kaściditi|| upakāryopakārakasambandhābhāve jaladhūmayoriva anvayavyatirekaniyamānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ|| nanu yayoreva agnidhūmasvalakṣaṇayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ, tatraiva anvayavyatirekaniyamaḥ, na agnidhūmasantānayoḥ; yena aviśeṣāt sarvavahnisvalakṣaṇeṣu dhūmavasvalakṣaṇakāraṇeṣu kāṣṭhasaṃyogāsaṃyogābhyāṃ dhūmabhāvābhāvadarśanena sahakārikāraṇeṣu anvayavyatirekaniyamo'pekṣālakṣaṇopakāryopakārakalasambandhaśca syāt| tasmāt na kāryakāraṇasvalakṣaṇādanyatra sāmānyopādhau kāryakāraṇayogyatāprāptiriti, tatrāha -- evaṃ hi kāryakāraṇabhāvasiddhirityādinā|| sāmānyopādhau hi vyavahāro dṛśyata iti bhāvaḥ| astu sāmānyopādhau janyajanakayogyatāniyamaḥ, tataḥ kim iti; tatrāha -- tatra yadi na kṣaṇikaṃ kāraṇamiti|| tadeva sādhayati -- tathā hi hetuparamparāpratibandhāditi|| kāraṇasya svayaṃ śaktatvādityarthaḥ| nāpi kāryaṃ sahakāriṇamapekṣate iti|| kāraṇādeva jananādityarthaḥ| nanu vahnisvalakṣaṇāt dhūmajanmani kāṣṭhasaṃsargasyāpi saṃnidhānāt tadapi sahakāri kalpyata iti, tanna; prāgapi hi kṛśānusvalakṣaṇasya dhūmajananayogyasya kāṣṭhasaṃsargābhāvāt tadahetutvalakṣaṇasya vyatirekasya darśanamantareṇānvayamātrāt na sahakāritvasiddhirityāha -- kākatālīyamucyata iti|| tarhi mā bhūt sahakāryapekṣeti ; kāraṇamapi mā bhūdityāha -- tathā ca kāryakāraṇavyavahārā iti|| tasmāt kṣaṇikanityayoḥ sahakārisannidhānakramasyāviśeṣāt kāraṇatvamaviśiṣṭamityupasaṃharati -- tasmāt kṣaṇikasyāpīti|| ayamarthaḥ -- yathaikasmādagnisvalakṣaṇāt samānadeśe vahniḥ, upariṣṭāt dhūmaḥ, adhastādbhasma puruṣe vijñānamiti sahakāribheda ekasmādanekāni kāryāṇyutpadyante tathaikasmāt kāraṇāt kālabhedena sahakāribhedāt kāryabhedā iti|| tasmāt satyapi viṣayābhede ahaṃsaṃvedanasya yathāpratibhāsamadvitīyāt saṃvedanādbhedenāpyarthakriyāsamarthatayā sthāyitvamastīti mahadetat siddhāntavailakṣaṇyamastītyupasaṃharati -- tadevamahaṅkartuḥ sadaikarūpāvagamāditi|| yatkiñcitsāmyena ca siddhāntasāṅkarye mantrārthavādetihāsapurāṇaprāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt devatāsvargeśvaramokṣānabhyupagamāt kṣaṇikapramāṇasambandhasya kṣaṇikasyaiva sattvābhyupagamāt lokāyatabauddhāṃśadvayapariṇataḥ prābhākaraḥ, bhedābhedābhyupagamāt mantrādyaprāmāṇyācca lokāyatakṣapaṇakāṃśadvayapariṇato vārtikakāraḥ| yastu kaścit kṣapaṇakapādāvanataśirobimbaḥ tattvadarśanatanniṣṭhaparamahaṃsapradveṣatīvravāyuvikṣiptavivekavijñānalavaḥ svaparapakṣaguṇadoṣavibhāgadūrīkṛtavijñāno bhedābhedābhyāṃ bandhamokṣādisaṅkaramiva kurvan durjanaramaṇīyāṃ vācaṃ jalpati -- sugatavijñānavādasamāno'yaṃ vedāntavādaḥ iti, sa sampradāyaśravaṇaparicayaśūnyatayā darśanavivekamanavabuddhyamāno nāpavādyaḥ, kintu śocanīyaḥ ityupekṣaṇīyo vidvadbhiḥ|| nanu vijñāne prapañcasya kalpitatvaṃ tava tasya ca tulyam, satyam; vijñāne pratibhāsyamānatvaṃ ca tava tasya ca tulyaṃ, iti vijñānavādastvadīyaṃ darśanaṃ kiṃ na syāt satyapi pratibhāsyatve satyamithyāvibhāgaḥ astīti cet, ihāpi satyapi mithyātve arthakriyāsāmarthyasattvāsattvavibhāgo'styeva| kalpitatve neyaṃ vibhāgasiddhiriti cet, pratibhāsyatve'pi na satyamithyāvibhāgasiddhiḥ| dṛśyate'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ iti cet, tadeva vibhāgadarśanaṃ mama kiṃ na syāt ghaṭādermithyātvamaprasiddhamiti cet, na; pratibhāsyasatyatvasyāpyasiddhatvāt| śuktirajataghaṭayorarthakriyābhāvābhāvasattvāsattvavibhāgadarśanācca| dṛśyate ca māyā prītidveṣādikāraṇam, śrūyate ca devāsurasaṃgrāmādiṣu māyāvinirmitaśastrabhedānāṃ dāhacchedabhedādihetutvaṃ ityalamatiprasaṅgena|| nanu viṣayasyāpi caitanyavyañjakatayā aparokṣatve anumānādiṣvapi tathā syāt, na tathā dṛśyate iti codayati -- nanu nānumeyādiṣviti|| antaḥkaraṇapariṇāmasaṃsargakṛtayogyatvāpattyā viṣayasya caitanyaṃ prati vyañjakatvam, tadanumeyādiṣvavartamānatvasambhavāt teṣu vartamānadharmadvayotpattyayogāt nāparokṣateti pariharati -- nānumeyādiṣvaparokṣatvamiti|| avyāvṛpatatvāditi|| kārakatvavyañjakatvadharmadvayānupapatterityarthaḥ| na hi vinaṣṭe ghaṭe agnisaṃyogāt lauhityamutpādyate| nanu atītānāgatākāreṇa vṛṣṭyādeḥ vartamānatvamapi dṛśyate, na; vṛṣṭeḥ yugapadatītatvavartamānatvavāyogāt| atītatādharmasyāpi vartamānakālo ghaṭāderiva nānvayitayā avacchedakaḥ, kintu pratiyogitayepi ghaṭādivat na vartamānatāsiddhiḥ| kiṃ ca atītākāreṇa vartamānasya nedānīntanakriyāguṇāśrayatvamca atītākāratayā vartamānasya ghaṭasya vartamānalauhityagamanāśrayatvadarśanāt, ato nānumeyādiṣu kārakatvavyañjakatve yukte| pratyakṣe punarindriyasaṃyogasya guṇasya guṇivyāpāramantareṇāvyāpārāt yukto viṣayasya sāmagryantarbhāvaḥ iti| kathaṃ tarhi viṣayavyāpārābhāve anumeyādiṣu viṣayākāratā vijñānasya iti; tadāha -- liṅgādīnāmeveti|| nanu atīte vartamānaviṣayatvajanmavat kārakatvamapi syāditi, netyāha -- prameyasya ceti|| viṣayatvaṃ nāma anumeyeṣu suṣuptivyāvṛttiḥ| sā cābhāvaḥ taddharmo na bhavati| vijñānākāratāpi na viṣayavyāpāraḥ, kiṃ tu vijñānasyaiva iti nātīte arthakriyākāritvam| jānāteśca anumeyādiṣu phalāpekṣayā sakarmakatvaṃ, na karmakārakāpekṣeyeti; sakarmakatve ca pratyakṣavadaparokṣatāpi syāditi|| arthamupavavarṇyedānī"masmatpratyayaviṣayatvā"diti bhāṣyaṃ yojayati -- tadevamahaṃkāragranthiriti|| nanu "śārīraḥ" "kṣetrajñaḥ" ityādibahuvidhopādhisaṃsṛṣṭamātmānaṃ varṇayati śrutiḥ| tatra kathamahaṃkārasyaivopādhiteti codite, ahaṃkāratatsaṃskāroparaktājñānopādhikasyaiva ātmano'vasthātraye'pi bāhyabahuvidhopādhyantaranimitto'yaṃ vyapadeśaḥ ityāha -- sa punarevaṃbhūtaṃ jāgratsvapnayoriti|| gatāgatamācaran iti anekopādhyuparāgaḥ ucyate| savikalpake adhiṣṭhāne savikalpādhyāsa iti vadataḥ -- "asmatpratyayaviṣayatvādi"ti parihāra uktaḥ, idānīṃ nirvikalpake'pi savikalpādhyāsaḥ sambhavatītyāha -- kiṃ ca na kevalamiti|| nanu nityānumeya ātmā kathamaparokṣatayā siddhaḥ iti netyāha -- na hyātmanyaprasiddha iti|| svaparayoḥ "mayedaṃ viditami"ti kartṛkarmasambandhāvagamaśūnyatvāviśeṣāt| anubhavanimittajñānāśrayatvamanyatarasya viśeṣa iti cet, na -- ātmapadārthānubhavābhāve sambandhāvagamāyogāt, anubhavasambandhābhāvāviśeṣe anyatarāśrayajñānānumānāyogāditi bhāvaḥ| astu tarhi viṣayānubhavāśrayatayā siddhiḥ iti ; netyāha -- na ca saṃvedyajñāneneti|| nanu saṃvit svopādhiṃ sādhayati, na karmakārakamiti, na tāvadāśraya upādhiḥ; viṣaye'bhāvāt| āśrayaviṣaya upādhiriti cet, kiṃ viṣayatvaṃ nāma saṃvitprayuktavyavahārayogyatvamiti cet, na; ātmāpi tarhi viṣayaḥ syāt| āśrayavyatiriktatve sati saṃvidvyāvartakatvamiti cet, cakṣuṣo'pi prasaṅgaḥ| nacāśrayavyatiriktatve sati tatprayuktavyavahārayogyo viṣayaḥ; saṃvittadāśrayasambandhasyāpi viṣayatvaprasaṅgāt| na ca sambandho nāsti iti tava vaktum| tasmāt saṃprayuktādivastveva avabhāsyate iti| astu tarhyātmaviṣayajñānāntarāditi, netyāha -- na ca jñānāntareṇeti|| kutaḥ tacca jñānāntaraṃ viṣayānubhavasamakālaṃ vā bhinnakālaṃ vā vibhinnakālatve dūṣaṇamāha -- bhinnakālatve iti|| ekakālatvamiti cet, tatrāha -- na hyekakālamiti|| niravayavasya yugapadekadeśe vā bhinnadeśe vā pariṇāmadvayāyogādityarthaḥ| ekasya yugapat sāmastyena parispandadvayamanupapannam, pariṇāmastu sambhavatītyāha -- mā bhūditi|| pariṇāmadvayamapi kātrsnyena yugapanna sambhavatītyāha -- maivamiti|| yauvanasthāvirayoḥ kṛtsnaśarīravartatvāditi| na ca bhāgena pariṇāmaḥ, niravayavatvāditi bhāvaḥ| tasmāditi pariśeṣāt svayaṃprakāśatayā aparokṣatvopasaṃhāraḥ| adhyasyamānenaikendriyagrāhyatvamadhiṣṭhānasya vaktavyaṃ, nāparokṣatāmātreṇa kṛtyamityāśaṅkhya ākāśadṛṣṭāntaḥ iti bhāṣyatātparyamāha -- nanu na kvaciditi|| atra śabdasya bāhyaikendriyagrāhyatvāt gandhavat dravyavyatirekeṇa upalabdheḥ saṃbhavāt viśeṣaguṇatve vaktavye sparśādiguṇacatuṣṭayasahavṛttitvābhāvāt bāhyendriyagrāhyatvāt dikkālamanasāṃ viśeṣaguṇaśūnyatvāt bhūtacatuṣṭayātmadigādivyatiriktadravyasyaiva viśeṣaguṇaḥ śabdaḥ| tadguṇaścākāśa iti vaiśeṣikādayo'numimate| bauddhalaukāyatāśca anupalabdhiliṅgakaṃ mūrtadravyābhāvamātramākāśamanumimate| prābhākarāṇāṃ tu astyevākāśo'nupalabdhiliṅgaḥ, mūrtadravyābhāvamātratvāt, bhāvāntarasyaiva cābhāvatvāt| kṣapaṇakavārtikakārīyāstu cākṣuṣamākāśamicchanti| tathā sati sparśitvamapi syāt| astviti cet, na; rūpasparśavatyeva dravye cakṣurādipravṛttiniyamāt, cakṣuḥprasāraṇasya ca ākāśānumānaliṅgadarśane anyathāsiddhatvāt| tasmāt apratyakṣe'pi hyākāśa ityuktam|| athaveti| sākṣivedyatayā manomātragamyatayā vā aparokṣa ityarthaḥ| indranīlamiva nīlamityarthaḥ| evamaviruddhaḥ ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| pratipannopādhau nirasyamānamarthamavidyānvayavyatirekābhyāmavidyāṃ manyante ityarthaḥ|| na kevalamavidyānvayavyatirekasāmarthyādavidyopādānatayā avidyātvaṃ, kiṃtu vidyāviparītatvācca ityāha -- tadvivekeneti|| nanvavidyāmupavarṇya tasyā jñānanivartyatvapradarśanenādhyāsanivṛttisiddheḥ kimadhyāsopavarṇaneneti codayati -- yadyevamadhyāsa iti|| prakramyeti|| puruṣākāṅkṣāyā anarthanivṛttiviṣayatvādanarthasyaivāvidyātvena jñānanivartyatvaṃ vaktavyamiti pariharati -- naitat sāramiti|| anarthasyaivāvidyātmakatve tadāśraye viṣaye vā vastutaḥ tannimittaguṇadoṣābhāvāt jñānena sarvānarthanivṛttiḥ phaliṣyati ; tatphalavacanamuttarabhāṣyamityāha -- tadetadāha yatra yadadhyāsa iti|| avidyādhyāsaviṣayatvaprayuktastāvat guṇadoṣābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ|| atrādhyāsapariṇāmitayā āśrayatvaprayuktadoṣaguṇābhāvaḥ kathyate| katham anādyavidyādhyāsasya nityacaitanyāvabhāsatvāt na tatrādhyāsapariṇāmaḥ| kādācitkādhyāsapariṇāmasyāvidyopādānatvādavidyāsaṃbhedādātmāśrayatvādisiddhiriti| pratijñeti sūtrakārasya -- jñānena bandhanivṛtterarthāt sūtraṇamucyate|| vṛttasaṃkīrtanapūrvakamuttarabhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- evaṃ tāvadyuṣmadasmadityādineti|| atra ca pramātṛpramāṇaprameyakartṛkarmakāryabhoktṛbhogabhogyatvalakṣaṇasya vyavahāratrayasya śarīrendriyādiṣvahaṃmamādhyāsapurassaratvaṃ pratyakṣamiti pratyakṣopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ| nanu "vidhipratiṣedhaparāṇi śāstrāṇī"tyeva vaktavyaṃ, tanniṣṭhatvāt sakalaśāstrasya; kimidaṃ mokṣaparāṇīti tatrāha -- mokṣaparatvaṃ ceti|| "kathaṃ punari"tyādibhāṣyasyādhyāsopādānaṃ vyavahāratritayamityatra pramāṇāntarapraśnaviṣayatvaṃ darśayati -- bāḍhamuktalakṣaṇā avidyetyādinā|| "kathaṃ punari"tyākṣepārthaṃ darśayati -- pramātāramāśrayantīti|| avidyādhyāsapariniṣpannāhaṃkārātmasaṃpiṇḍitopādānatve pramāṇānāṃ prāmāṇyameva na siddhyatītyasminnarthe bhāṣyaṃ yojayati -- athavā kathamavidyāvadviṣayāṇīti|| avidyāvadupādānatve kā prāmāṇyānupapattiriti tadāha -- avidyāvadviṣayatve iti|| "ucyate -- dehendriyādi"ṣvityādiparihārabhāṣyaṃ avatārayati -- vastusaṃgrahavākyam, asyaiva prapañca iti|| vyavahāratritayamadhyāsopādānamityatrārthāpattivyatirekyanumānapradarśanāya| yatra yatrādhyāsābhāvaḥ saṃpatipannastatra vyavahārābhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ iti vyatirekavyāptibhāṣyārthaṃ darśayati -- na hi dehendriyādiṣviti|| dehādiśabdārthaṃ vibhāgenādhyāsaṃ ca kathayati -- yato dehe'hamabhimāna ityādinā|| pramaṇāntarapradarśanāya vyavahāratrayamūlādhyāse pratyakṣamuktamanuvadati -- sarvo hi manuṣyo'hamiti|| atrāyaṃ prayogaḥ -- devadattasya jāgratsvapnakālau, tasyaiva kartuḥ karaṇabhūtadehendriyādiṣvahaṃmamādhyāsapurassarapramātṛtvādivvayahāravantau, tasyaiva suṣuptikālādanyakālatvāt, yaḥ kālastathāvidhavyavahāravān na bhavati, na sa tasyaiva suṣuptikālādanyakālaḥ, yathā tasyaiva suṣuptikālaḥ iti| vyavahāratritayaṃ vā darśitādhyāsopādānamantareṇānupapannaṃ; adhyāsābhāve vyavahārādarśanāt suṣupte, ityarthāpattiḥ|| nanu kartṛkaraṇayoḥ saṃbandhamātraṃ vyavahāre apekṣyate, na tādātmyasaṃbandhaḥ, iti tatra pariśeṣānumānārthāpattidvaye saṃbandhāntarāṇi vyāvartayan na tāvatsvasvāmisaṃbandhaḥ ityāha -- na svatvena saṃbandhineti|| suṣupte'pi tasya bhāvāt ityabhyuccayaḥ| icchānuvidhāyitvameva vyavahāranimittaṃ; tadabhāvāt suṣupte vyavahāraviparyayaḥ, iti codayati -- apara āha ātmecchānuvidhāyitvamiti|| astvicchāmātreṇa viniyojyaviniyojakasaṃbandhaḥ, tataḥ kimiti tatrāha -- tata ātmana iti|| nanvetatsaṃbandhamūlo vyavahāra iti kimatra pramāṇamiti ata āha -- tathācottiṣṭhāmīti|| nanu bhṛtyādayo'pi tadicchānuvidhāyinaḥ, taccharīreṇāpi vyavahāraḥ syāditi ; netyāha -- na ca bhṛtyādiṣu tadastīti|| ucyate -- yadīcchānuvidhānayogyatāmātraṃ saṃbandhaḥ, suṣupte'pi tadastīti tatrāpi vyavahāraḥ syāt| athecchayā anuvidhīyamānatvaṃ saṃbandhaḥ, atyāture tadabhāvāt pramātṛtvādivyavahāro na syāt| atha dṛśyate ayaṃ saṃbandho vyavahāramūlamiti, netyāha -- naitat saṃvidi bahumānavato yuktamiti|| na ca gauṇatvam, mukhyānubhavavirodhādityāha -- gauṇītyādinā|| icchāpyadhyāsamūlaivetyāha -- api cecchā'pi pariṇāmaviśeṣa iti|| antaḥkaraṇādhyāsamūlaivecchetyāha -- api cecchā'pi pariṇāmaviśeṣa iti|| antaḥkaraṇādhyāsamūlaivetyatra pratyakṣamāha -- tathā cānubhava iti|| nacātmānātmanoḥ saṃyogasamavāyau vyavahāranimittam; suṣupte'pi bhāvāt; bhoktṛbhogyānvayasvakarmārabhyatvasvendriyādhiṣṭheyatvādīnāṃ bhogādyadhyāsāpekṣatvāt, bhṛtyādiśarīre ca bhāvāt| avyavadhānena bhogyatvaṃ mūlasaṃbandha iti cet yadi bhogayogyatā saṃbandhaḥ, suṣupte'pyasti; yadyavyavadhānena bhujyamānatvaṃ saṃbandhaḥ, tanna; ātmanaḥ sarvaśarīradeśakālāvyavadhāne satyatraiva bhogānvayasya mūlasaṃbandhānveṣaṇāt| tasmāt yatkiṃcidetat saṃbandhāntaram| ataḥ pariśeṣādarthāpattyanumānābhyāmadhyāsa eva vyavahāramūlaṃ siddha ityupasaṃharati -- ataḥ svayamasaṅgasyāpīti|| nanu sarvaśarīrasaṃnidhānāviśeṣe sati ātmanaḥ kathamasminneva śarīre adhyāsaniyama iti anādistāvadavidyādhyāsaḥ| tatpariṇāmatvālliṅgaśarīre, tatkāryabhūtasūkṣmaśarīrārabdhatvāt tatsaṃśleṣādvā sthūlaśarīre adhyāsaniyamo na virudhyate| nanu pramātaiva vyavahārāśrayo nādhyāsaḥ iti, na; pramātṛtvamevādhyāsapariniṣpannamityāha -- tena yadyapīti|| yattu adhyāsapariniṣpannāhaṃkārātmasaṃpiṇḍitopādānatve kāraṇadoṣādaprāmāṇyaṃ pramāṇānāmiti, tatra yadi pratipannopādhau kenāpi pramāṇenābādhyatvalakṣaṇatattvāvedanaprāmāṇyahānirucyate, tadaṅgīkṛtameva| athāgamena paramārthasatyatvāṃśe bādhyamāne vyavahārasamarthavastvaṅgatāprāmāṇyahānirucyate, na -- tatra bādhābhāvādityāha -- tathā nirapekṣāṇāmiti|| vidhimukhopadarśitamiti| vyavahārāṅgatāyāṃ pratyakṣeṇa adhyāsamūlatāyāṃ pratyakṣānumānārthāpattibhiḥ pradarśitamubhayamityarthaḥ| arthakriyāsamarthatvācca| śabdādipratyakṣāmavidyānivṛttibrahmāvagatilakṣaṇārthakriyāhetutvaṃ mithyātve'pi śabdādīnāṃ na virudhyate|| nanvarthakriyāsaṃvādāt prāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ, na -- jñānādevārthatathātvavadarthāvagamādevārthakriyāsāmarthyaniścayāt, anyathā tavāpi tathātvajñānāt prāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu brahmajñānasyāpyadhyāsopādānatvāt mithyātvamāpannam yadi tāvat svarūpamithyātvamucyate, aṅgīkṛtameva tat; atha viṣayamithyātvaṃ, na brahmaṇi; bādhābhāvāt| prapañcasyāpi bādhādeva mithyātvaṃ; nādhyāsopādānajñānagamyatvāt| nanu duṣṭakāraṇajanyasya viṣayato'pi mithyātvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti, netyāha -- doṣastvāgantuka iti| pramāṇakāraṇeṣu satsu paścādbhavan doṣo doṣa ityucyate, sa āgantuka ityuktaḥ| pramāṇakāraṇatvenaiva yo doṣo vyavatiṣṭhate, sa na doṣaḥ; kāraṇatvāt; avidyādhyāsastu caitanyasyādvitīyāvabhāsaṃ pratyeva doṣaḥ, na dvaitāvabhāsaṃ prati, tasya kāraṇatvāt, yathā kācādiḥ cakṣurādidoṣaḥ tathāvidhapāpadṛṣṭodayamanumāpayan tatra pramāṇatvāt na doṣaḥ, tadvadityarthaḥ| caitanyadoṣatvādeva tatprakāśyāvyavahāryabrahmaviparītaṃ vyavahārayogyaṃ vastu pradarśayati| doṣatvaṃ cāvidyāyāḥ caitanyasya tathā'vabhāsavirodhitayā anyathāpratibhāsanimittatvāt| kathamāgantuke doṣabuddhiḥ na naisargike ityetāvanmātre dṛṣṭāntamāha -- na ca sarvasādhāraṇe iti|| nanu bhāṣyakāreṇa doṣamātrameva viṣayato'pi jñānamithyātve heturukta iti; netyāha -- anaisargikaṃ ca doṣamiti|| nanu avivekivyavahāro'dhyāsamūlo bhaviṣyati, na vivekivyavahāra iti; netyāha -- itaścaitadevaṃ paśvādibhiśceti| paśvādidṛṣṭānte'dhyāsamūlatāṃ vyavahārasya darśayati -- tathā ca paśvādaya iti|| adhyāsānumāne hetubhūtavyavahārasya vivekiṣvapi pakṣadharmatāmāha -- tadekarūpayogakṣemā iti|| tatra hetudarśanāt hetumantamadhyāsamanumimīte -- atastadekarūpakāryadarśanāditi|| paśvādidṛṣṭānte'pyadhyāsasadbhāve pramāṇaṃ codayati -- nanu paśvādīnāmiti|| padārthadvayadarśane sati pratyakṣānumānāgamaiḥ bhedāpratipattau adhyāsaḥ pariśiṣyate ityāha -- prauḍhamatibhya iti|| svābhāvikapratyakṣeṇa vivekadarśane doṣamāha -- evameveti|| nanvanumānāgamavicārahīnānāmapyadṛṣṭārthaṃ vyavahāradarśanāt pratyakṣeṇaiva viveko gṛhyate iti codayati -- nanu gopālāṅganādaya iti|| na pratyakṣeṇa vivekagrahaḥ, kintvāptavacanādityāha -- na tadabhijñavyavahāreti|| pratyakṣaścedviveko viśeṣataḥ pratyagātmānaṃ pratipadyerannityāha -- tathā ca te pṛṣṭā iti|| ato nigamanavākyamupapannamityāha -- tasmādyuktamuktamiti|| tasya vyavahārasya kāla eva kālo yasyādhyāsasya so'dhyāsastatkālaḥ, sa ca paśvādibhirvivekināmapi samāna iti|| evaṃ tāvat pratyakṣādīni tyuktānuvādaḥ| "na tenānadhyastātmabhāvene"ti bhāṣyaṃ pūrvaṃ na vyākhyātaṃ, tadanuvādagranthe vyācaṣṭe|| tatreyamāśaṅkā -- bhavatvadhyāsasya vyavahāranimittatā, tathāpi rajatā divannimittakāraṇamevādhyāso vyavahārasya, ātmaiva kevalastu upādānamiti, tatrāha -- na tenānadhyastātmabhāvenāsaṅgasyeti|| ayamarthaḥ -- rajatādyadhyāsānāṃ vyavahārāśrayakoṭinikṣiptatvābhāvāt tadantareṇa cātmani pramātṛtvādivyavahāradarśanāt nimittakāraṇataiva yuktā, iha tu punarāśrayakoṭinikṣiptatvāt kevalātmani suṣupte vyavahārādarśanāt upādānakāraṇasyābhyarhitatvāt anvayavyatirekavato'dhyāsasyopādānakāraṇatvameva vyavahāraṃ prati kalpayituṃ yuktamiti| "śāstraṃ punaḥ" ityuttarabhāṣyasyāśaṅkā| tasyāpīti tātparyābhidhānam| śāstrīye tviti adṛṣṭārthapravṛttau vyatirekajñānamabhyanujānāti| abhyanujñāmākṣipati -- nanu phalanaiyamiketi|| phalacodanāya tāvat paśvādīnāmasminneva janmani labdhuṃ śakyatvāt, tajjanyasukhasya ca svargasya paśvādicodanāphalatvābhāvāt jyotiṣṭomādi phalatvopapatteḥ niratiśayaprīterapyatraiva sambhavāt na dehāntarasambandhinamātmānamāpādayati, naiyamikanaimittikacodanā tu sutarām; phalaśūnyatvāt| phalavattve vā dṛṣṭenaivopabhoktuṃ śakyatvāt| prāyaścittasya tu doṣanibarhaṇaphalatvāt, doṣaphalasyāsmiñjanmani bhoktuṃ śakyatvāt, janmāntarasya caitādṛśatvāt, phalādarśane ca kārīryādivadaṅgavaikalyapratibaddha sahakāryābhāvakalpanopapatteḥ, mantrauṣadhādisiddhenānenāpi śarīreṇa svargādibhogasambhavāt na dehavyatirekajñānopayoga iti| tatra devatādhikaraṇanayena mantrādiprāmāṇyādviśiṣṭadeśakālaśarīrādibhogyaṃ svargādiphalamaṅgīkṛtyedamuktamiti pariharati -- satyamevaṃ tathāpīti|| nanu mantrādisamanvayaprāmāṇyamanapekṣyaiva codanābhireva vyatiriktātmā apekṣyate, karmamātranirṇayapravṛttena bhāṣyakāreṇātmano nirūpitatvāditi, tatrāha -- tathā ca vidhivṛtteti|| vidhibhirevāpekṣitaścet, sūtreṇāpi bhavitavyamityarthaḥ| nanu anapekṣitasyāsūtritasya ca bhāṣyakāreṇa pratipādanamayuktamityākṣipati -- tat kasya hetoriti|| "tat pramāṇaṃ bādarāyaṇasyānapekṣatvāt" iti sūtrāvayavena mantrādiprāmāṇyadvāreṇa paramparayā sūtrita evatmeti pariharati -- dharmajijñāseti kāryārthavicāraṃ pratijñāyeti|| evaṃ sūtrārthaṃ paramparayā bhūte'pyarthe prāmāṇyamāśritya bhāṣyakāreṇātmavicāraḥ kṛtaḥ, na codanāsāmarthyamāśrityeti kathamavagamyate iti tatrāha -- tathā codanā hi bhūtamiti|| tarhi codanāpekṣitatvāt samanvayo'pyatraiva varṇanīya iti, netyāha -- sa ca svarūpāvagama iti|| nanu dharme prayatamāne nāpyapekṣitatvāt kartavya evātmavicāra iti, netyāha -- upayogābhāvāditi|| na hi dharmamātraṃ vyatiriktātmānamapekṣate, kintu phalamapekṣate, phale ca na prayatate jaiminirityarthaḥ| nanu phalamapyapekṣate cet, tatrāpi prayatno yukta iti, na; -- anyathāsiddhatvādityāha -- bhagavāṃstu punariti|| nanu brahmaiva tatra vicāritam, na codanāphalamiti, tatrāha -- tatra ca dehāntaropabhogya iti|| tacca sarvamiti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu samanvayasāmarthyādeva vyatiriktātmasiddherātmavicāraḥ piṣṭapeṣaṇamiti, netyāha -- tatsiddhiśceti|| nanu pramāṇāntarayogyasya tadabhāvavirodhayoḥ śabdasyāprāmāṇyāt na ātmasiddhiriti, tatrāha -- ataḥ tatsiddhau parākrāntavāṃsteneti|| virodhaparihāraphalena vicāreṇetyarthaḥ| "satyam vināpi tena sidhyedi"tyādinoktamarthaṃ saṃkṣepato darśayati -- asti tu taditi|| bhūte'rthe prāmāṇyam; svargādāvityarthaḥ| na tena vineti| vyatiriktātmanā vinetyarthaḥ| nanu sūtrakārabhāṣyakārābhyāṃ devatādhikaraṇe mukhata eva devatādiṣu mantrādiprāmāṇyaṃ nāstītyuktam, tat kathaṃ sūtrāvayavasāmarthyāt prāmāṇyamanumatamiti manyante, naiṣa doṣaḥ; tatra devatāyā vigrahavattve sannipatyopakārakatvaprasaṅgāt yogyānupalabdhivirodhāt, karmaṇi virodhaprasaṅgābhiprāyeṇoktatvāt, nāprāmāṇyābhiprāyeṇa, arthavādaliṅgānāmapi tatra tatra dvādaśalakṣaṇyāṃ pramāṇatvenodāhriyamāṇatvāditi| tathāpi na vedāntavedyam ityādibhāṣyavyākhyānaṃ spaṣṭārtham|tatra "aśanāyādyatītaṃ" ityādinā kartranvayādhikārānvayabhoktranvayāḥ krameṇa nirasyante| prāk cetyādibhāṣyavyākhyānaṃ -- "tattvamasī"tivākyārthāvagamāt ityādi|| kathaṃ punarvyatirekajñānenādhyāsasya sahavṛttiḥ parokṣāparokṣavibhāgāt candradvitvajñānavadavirodha iti kecit| sūkṣmaśarīrasya ātmāvidyākāryatvāt kāryakāraṇayoḥ bhedābhedabhāvāt sthūlaśarīrasya agnyayaḥpiṇḍavat sūkṣmaśarīreṇa saṃśleṣāt bhedajñāne'pyadhyāsaḥ ityapare| sarvathāpi yāvadaparokṣajñānamadhyāso na nivartate iti bhāvaḥ| tasmāt ityadhyāsapramāṇopasaṃhāraḥ| na ca kevalaṃ pratyakṣānumānārthāpattibhireva adhyāsasiddhiḥ, kiṃ tu āgamo'pi vidheḥ boddhāramadhikāriṇaṃ brāhmaṇādiśabdairanuvadan cetanācetanayoraikyāvabhāsaṃ darśayatītyāha -- tadeva darśayati tathā hīti|| yo jyogāmayāvī-ujjvalāmayavānityarthaḥ|| vṛttasaṅkīrtanapūrvakamadhyāso nāmeti lakṣaṇabhāṣyamavatārayati -- evamadhyāsasadbhāvaṃ prasādhyetyādinā|| kimiti punaratroktalakṣaṇānuvādaḥ iti tadāha -- kasya yuṣmadarthasyeti|| bhāṣyaṃ yojayati -- kasminnayuṣmadartha ityādinā|| "ātmānātmanoritaretarādhyāsaṃ puraskṛtye" ityādinā pratyakṣato darśitasyādhyāsasya vibhajya pradarśanāyottaraṃ bhāṣyamityāha -- tadāha tadyathā putrabhāryādiṣvityādi|| tathā antaḥkaraṇadharmā nityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| atrottarottarādhyāsaviśiṣṭe pūrvapūrvādhyāsaḥ iti kathayitumātmanyadhyasyatītyātmaśabdārthamāha -- asmadarthaśca ahampratyayisambhinna iti|| nanu śarīramapyadhyasyate, na dharmā evetyata āha -- dharmiṇo'pīti|| grahaṇamityadhyāhāraḥ| dharmaśūbdastarhi kimiti gṛhītaḥ ityata āha -- dharmaśabdastviti|| śāstrīyavyavahāramūlatvena prādhānyācca dharmādhyāsasya prādhānyena grahaṇamityāha -- tannimittaśceti|| nanu antaḥkaraṇadharmāḥ kāmādayo daṇḍyādivat sambandhitayā avagamāt nādhyāsamarhantīti netyāha -- tathā antaḥkaraṇadharmān kāmādīniti|| tathā hi -- satyantaḥkaraṇe bhāvādasati ca suṣupte teṣābhāvāt antaḥkaraṇadharmāḥ kāmādayaḥ sambandhitayā adhyasyante, na tādātmyena iti bhāvaḥ| nanu ātmasamavāyināmeva kāmādīnāmantaḥkaraṇasya ca anvayavyatirekau karaṇaviṣayatayā anyathāsiddhau, na; kāryasya kāraṇaparatantratāniyamāt, karaṇaniyamābhāvāt karaṇakalpanāt upādānakalpanasya abhyarhitatvāt, cakṣurādikaraṇāntarabhāvācca|| nanu "ahaṃ kāmī"tyādipratyakṣapratyayādātmāpyupādānāntaramastīti cet, na; daṇḍyādivat sambandhipratyayāt, upādānatve tādātmyā; "dahaṃ kāma" iti syāt| tasmāt nyāyasahakṛtānvayavyatirekau antaḥkaraṇasyaiva kāmādyupādānatvaṃ kalpayata iti bhāvaḥ| antaḥkaraṇamityahampratyayinaḥ ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| "aśeṣasvapracārasākṣiṇi" "pratyagātmani" iti padadvayaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- svaśabdenāhaṅkāragranthirityādinā|| sākṣiśabdārthamāha -- asaṅgitayā avikāritvenetyādinā|| kathaṃ punaḥ sarvāntarasya ātmanaḥ pratyagañcanam iti; dehādiṣu viprasṛtacaitanyasya cittasamādhānaviṣaye antaranupraveśabhramāpekṣayetyāha -- sa eva dehādiṣvidantayeti|| nanu na sākṣivedyamantaḥkaraṇam, kiṃtu ātmendriyāviṣayeṣu samavahiteṣu jñānotpādakramasāmarthyagamyamiti, na; anyathāsiddhatvāt; ātmana eva kramajñānajananasāmarthyakalpanayā anyathāsiddhaḥ kramajñānotpādaḥ| dravyāntaratatkramasāmarthyakalpanāgauravācca varaṃ prasiddhasyaiva ātmanaḥ kramasāmarthyakalpanālāghavam| nanu nārthāpattyā manaḥ kalpayāmi, yena anyathāsiddhiḥ syāt, kiṃ tvanumānena| tathā hi -- ātmanaḥ sarvaviṣayasannidhāne kramakāryotpādaḥ, kartuḥ kramakārisādhāraṇakaraṇāpekṣaḥ, sannihitabahuviṣayasya kartuḥ kramakāryotpādatvāt, sannihitabahucchedyasya devadattasya kuṭhārasāpekṣakramacchedanavaditi -- iti naitat sāram -- manasaḥ pratīndriyasaṃyogavyāpāre kramavartini sādhāraṇakāraṇāntaraśūnye anaikāntikatvāt, phalasya ca vṛkṣāt patataḥ kramavartini ākāśasaṃyoge kuṭhārādivyāpāre cānaikāntikatvāt indriyāṇāṃ prativiṣayasaṃyogavyāpāre cānaikāntikatvācca| atha matam -- viśeṣaguṇajanma, svāśraye dravyāntarasaṃyogalakṣaṇāsamavāyikāraṇāpekṣam, nityadravyaviśeṣaguṇajanmatvāt agnisaṃyogajanyaparamāṇugatapākajalauhityavadityanumānam, yattat dravyāntaraṃ, tat mana iti, naitat; śarīrendriyasaṃyogasya siddhatvāt dravyāntarasaṃyoge anumānāyogāt svapnasmṛtyādijñāneṣvapi śarīrādisaṃyogānapāyāt dravyāntarasaṃyogakalpanānupapatteḥ| tasmāt nānumānārthāpattī manasi pramāṇam| āgamācca prāgeva manaḥ siddham| na ca aindriyakatvam; aṇuparimāṇe paramāṇuvadayogyatvāt, anantaparimāṇe manasi yugapat saṃyogādyugapajjñānajanmaprasaṅgāt, madhyamaparimāṇe ca manasi svapnāvasthāyāmindriyābhāve'pi manodarśanāt "mama mano'nyatra gatam" ityanubhavācca sākṣivedyameva mana iti|| taṃ ca pratyagātmānamityātmanaḥ antaḥkaraṇādiṣvadhyāso darśitaḥ, tadayuktam; itaretarādhyāse dvayoradhyasyamānatvāt mithyātvāpātāt, dvayorapyadhiṣṭhānatve dvayorviśeṣāvabhāso na syāditi, tatrāha -- yadi yuṣmadarthasyaiveti|| ayamarthaḥ -- ekatarādhyāse anyatarasya sāmānyāvabhāsaḥ anyatarasyaiva viśeṣāvabhāsaśca syāt| atra cijjaḍarūpeṇa dvayoḥ viśeṣāvabhāso dvayoritaretarādhyāsaṃ gamayati; adhyāso viśeṣāvabhāsasyādhyasyamānatāprayuktatvāt| na ca dvayorapi mithyātvāpātaḥ; cetanasyācetane svarūpādhyāsābhāvāt saṃsṛṣṭatayaivādhyāsāt| na ca viśeṣāvabhāsādadhiṣṭhānatvavirodhaḥ; adhiṣṭhānadharmatayā viśeṣasya apratīteḥ, adhiṣṭhānāntaradharmatayā pratīteriti| granthastu spaṣṭārthaḥ| nanu dvayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣātmanā avabhāsamānayoḥ nādhyāsaḥ sambhavati, sāmānādhikaraṇyamasti cet, gauṇamiti, netyāha -- nātra vivaditavyamiti|| nanu viśeṣāvabhāse adhyāsavirodhaḥ uktaḥ, netyāha -- na hi dṛṣṭe anupapannamiti|| tadviparyayeṇa antaḥkaraṇādiṣvityādiśabdo viruddha ityāha -- nanvantaḥkaraṇa eva pratyagātmana iti|| antaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭasyaiva bahiradhyāsa iti kutaḥ iti tatrāha -- ata eva tadviparyayeṇeti|| nanu tasmin bhāṣye viśiṣṭasyaivādhyāsaḥ kathamuktaḥ iti| dharmagrahaṇasāmarthyādityāha -- anyathā caitanyamātraikarasasyeti|| yadyapi caitanyasya viṣaye adhyāse antaḥkaraṇamupādhiḥ, tathāpi caitanyameva viṣayāvacchinnaṃ prakāśaḥ, tenāntaḥkaraṇamiti pratibhāsābhiprāyeṇoktamityāha -- satyamāha bhavāniti|| tasyaiva viṣayasya ātmānaṃ prati kāryakaratvamāpadyetyarthaḥ| nanu bahirapyahaṅkārasya caitanyavat sambandho'vabhāsate "ahaṃ manuṣyaḥ" ityādau ityata āha -- ata eva buddhyādiṣviti|| cinmātrasyāvagamādeva sarvapadārtheṣvātmatvavibhrama ityarthaḥ; anyathā ahaṅkārasya caitanyāvyatirekāt sa eva ātmeti pratipattiḥ syāditi| nanu upanyāsakāle "naisargiko'yaṃ lokavyavahāraḥ" ityārabhya "kartṛtvabhoktṛtvapravartanaḥ" ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| atra sāṅkhyavyatiriktāḥ sarve vādinaḥ svata eva kartṛtvabhoktṛtvaśaktimataḥ pravṛttimātranimittamadhyāsa iti vadanti, tānnirākaroti -- tena kartṛbhoktṛśceti|| sarvalokapratyakṣaḥ ityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| asyānarthahetoriti bhāṣyasya vṛttasaṅkīrtanapūrvakaṃ tātparyamāha -- evaṃ tāvat sūtreṇārthādupāttayoriti|| nanu anarthasya grahāṇāyeti vaktavyaṃ, na hetoḥ prahāṇāyeti, ata āha -- hetoḥ prahāṇyā hīti|| prayojanabhāṣyamākṣipati -- nanu anarthaheturadhyāso'nādiriti|| nanu śāstraprāmāṇyānnivartatāmiti, na; pratyakṣavirodhādityāha -- tathā hi manuṣyatvādīti|| na hi sāditvamanāditvaṃ vā vināśāvināśayoḥ nimittam, kintu virodhisannipātā sannipātā iti pariharati -- nāyaṃ doṣa iti|| loke tāvadanādiḥ prāgabhāvo nivartate; sugatānāṃ tattvaparibhāvanāprakarṣeṇa anādivāsanāsantānānāṃ nivṛttiriṣṭā; naiyāyikādīnāmapyanādiḥ mithyājñānapravāhaḥ paramāṇuśyāmatā ca nivartate; sāṅkhyānāmapyaviveko'nādiḥ nivartate vivekena; mīmāṃsakādīnāmidānīṃtanadharmatattvajñānāprāgabhāvo'nādinivartate| anādibhāvarūpaṃ ātmavat na nivartate iti cet, na; anirvacanīyatvādajñānasya| anādirna nivartata iti sāmānyavyāptiḥ, jñānenājñānanivṛttiriti tu viśeṣavyāptiḥ; ataḥ saiva balavatī|| nanu svopādānagatottarāvasthā vināśaḥ, tatra kathamanādeḥ nirupādānasya vināśaḥ na; svāśrayagatottarāvasthetyetāvattvāt; anyathā aṇuśyāmatvādīnāmanivṛttiprasaṅgāt| abhāvavailakṣaṇyādātmavadajñānasya anivṛttiḥ iti cet, na; sadvailakṣaṇyāt prāgabhāvavannivṛttiḥ kiṃ na syāt kastarhi nirṇayaḥ jñānājñānakṛto viśeṣānvaya ityuktam|| yattu vyatirekajñāne'pyadhyāso na nivartate iti; tatrāha -- tattvamasītyādivākyāditi| nanu vyatirekabrahmātmajñānayoradhyāsanivṛttau ko viśeṣaḥ iti tatrāha -- taddhi brahmaṇo'vacchidyeti|| na ca vyatirekānavabodhanimittaḥ saṃsāraḥ, kiṃ tu brahmānavabodhanimittaḥ iti śrutitadarthāpattibhyāṃ darśitam| ataḥ tattvajñānānnivartate iti bhāvaḥ| nanu jñānamajñānasyaiva nivartakam, kathamadhyāsasya nivṛttiḥ iti; tatrāha -- tataḥ kāraṇanivṛttāviti|| nanu ahampratyayo'pyarthatastathābhūtabrahmaviṣaya eva, sa kimityajñānaṃ na nivartayati iti| brahmātmatānavabhāsakatvādityāha -- ahaṃpratyayaḥ punariti|| nanu vicārāt vivekajñānāntaramutpannaṃ niyartayediti na; apramāṇajñānatvādityāha -- nāpi jñānāntaramiti|| nanu nānarthanivṛttiḥ śāstrasya prayojanam, kiṃ tu niratiśayabrahmānandāvāptiriti punaḥ prayojanabhāṣyamākṣipati -- nanu niratiśayānandaṃ brahma śrūyata iti|| yathā śāstrajanyabrahmavidyāphalamānandāvāptiḥ tathā anarthanivṛttirapi śrutā, tatra kathaṃ prayojanākṣepaḥ ityāha -- nanu cānarthasyāpīti|| tarhi kṛtsnasya phalasya saṃkīrtanaṃ kartavyaṃ, na phalāṃśasyeti codayati -- ubhayaṃ tarhīti|| na; prayojanatvena vaktavyā ānandāvāptiḥ, viṣayatvanirdeśasāmarthyādeva puruṣākāṅkṣayā prayojanatvasiddheḥ śrutyarthābhyāṃ prayojanasampūrṇatāsiddhirviṣayanirdeśa lābhaśceti yukto'yaṃ vyapadeśaḥ ityāha -- na vaktavyamityādinā|| nanu brahmātmataiva viṣayo bhavatu ānandāvāptistu pṛthak prayojanatvena nirdiśyatāmiti; netyāha -- na ca sā viṣayādbahiriti|| brahmātmataiva ānandaprāptirityarthaḥ| nanu anarthanivṛtterapi phalavacanaviṣayatvāt sā'pi śāstraviṣaya iti, netyāha -- samūlānarthahāniriti|| brahmātmaikatvameva śāstraviṣayaḥ, phalaṃ tvarthasiddhamiti bhāvaḥ| tarhi brahmātmaikatvaśāstraviṣaya eva anarthanivṛttiḥ na phalavacanaviṣaya ityāha -- anarthahetugrahāṇamapi tarhīti|| nanu tattvamasyādivākye'pi anarthanivṛttiḥ viṣayatayā nāvagamyata iti; tatrāha -- yataḥ sarveṣu vedānteṣviti|| vākyārthasya bhāvarūpatve'pi brahmapadārthasya anarthābhāvaviśiṣṭatayaiva pratipādanāt so'pi viṣaya ityarthaḥ|| nanu na padārthapratipādakaṃ vākyamasti, kintu aikyapratipādakameva ityāśaṅkyāha -- tadyathā sadeva somyedamityādi| samarpayadekaṃ vākyamiti|| ayamarthaḥ -- alaukikatvāt brahmapadārthaṃ pratipādya tādātmyavākyenaikaṃ vākyamiti| nanu brahmaṇi niṣprapañce śāstraviṣaye jīvagatānarthanivṛttiḥ kathaṃ śāstraviṣayaḥ ityāśaṅkyāha -- tathā sati tādṛśena tatpadārtheneti|| evamapi svābhāvikaniṣprapañcatā śāstraviṣayaḥ, avidyātatkāryanirāsastu niṣprapañcabrahmātmatāvagatisāmarthyalabhyaḥ, na śāstraviṣayaḥ, avidyātatkāryapratibhāsābhāvasya tatpratibhāsavirodhādeva śāstreṇa pratipādayitumaśakyatvāditi pariharati -- yadyevaṃ brahmātmāvagatināntarīyakamiti|| nanu -- yathā prātibhāsikāvidyātatkāryavirodhāt na tadabhāvaviśiṣṭo vākyārthaḥ pratipattuṃ śakyate, tathā brahmaṇi prapañcāvabhāsavirodhāt niṣprapañcaṃ brahma ātmatvena nāvedayituṃ śakyaṃ asthūlādivākyairiti -- iti ucyate; na tāvat pratyakṣādisiddho brahmaṇi prapañcaḥ; tasya tadagocaratvāt, na ca prapañcasiddhimātreṇa brahmasambandhāvagamaḥ; kāraṇamātrakalpakatvāt tasya|| nanu "idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā" ityādisaprapañcavākyaiḥ brahmaṇi pratibhāsate prapañcaḥ, satyam; teṣāṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvopādānakāraṇatvasāmarthyasiddhasārvātmyānuvādena niṣedhyasamarpakatayā niṣedhakavākyairekavākyatayā anvayāt niṣprapañcavirodhitvābhāvāt| na ca sarvopādānatayā sarvātmabhāve siddhe saprapañcavākyaiḥ sarvātmatā pratipādayituṃ śakyate| na ca niṣedhavākyaiḥ niṣedhyākāṅkṣitasamarpaṇenaikavākyatāsambhave vākyabhedaṃ kṛtvā svātantryeṇa prayojanavanniṣprapañcaviruddhaṃ saprapañcaṃ prayojanaśūnyaṃ ca pramātuṃ śakyam| dṛṣṭaśca suṣupte cetanasya niṣprapañcatā puruṣārtha iti| śrutaṃ ca -- "aśabdamasparśamarūpamavyayaṃ nicāyya tanmṛtyumukhāt pramucyate" iti| dṛṣṭā ca cetanasya saprapañcatā anarthakarīti| na ca tatra śrūyate phalam| ato niṣedhairekavākyatā tyaktā| na ca niṣedhyaprapañcānuvādapratibhāso niṣprapañcapramitiṃ bādhate; tādarthyādanuvādasya| nanu -- aprāptaṃ prapañcaṃ brahmaṇi saprapañcavākyaiḥ prāpayya punaḥ tanniṣedho'narthaka eva; "prakṣālanāddhi paṅkasya dūrādasparśanaṃ varam" iti nyāyāt ucyate; advitīyabrahmapratipattyarthaṃ sarvajagadupādānatvapratipādanasāmarthyādeva prāptasya brahmaṇi prapañcasya advitīyapuruṣārthasiddhyarthamanūdya niṣedho yujyate|| nanu -- tarhi sarvopādānatvasāmarthyādeva saprapañcatāpramitiḥ prāptā, na; śrutisāmarthyaprāptasya saprapañcatvasya sākṣāt niṣedhaśrutivirodhe daurbalyāt| na tarhi sarvopādānatayā saprapañcatāprāptiḥ, na; yāvadbādhaṃ śrutopādānatvasāmarthyādeva śuktikārajatādivat saprapañcatāpratibhāsāt| pratipannameva tu balavatpramāṇena bādhyate, nāpratipannam, nāpi pramitam| na ca upāsanāprakaraṇapaṭhitasaprapañcavākyaiḥ brahma tathā pramīyate; anyaparāṇāṃ tatparavākyavirodhāt, āropitarūpeṇāpi upāsanāsambhavāt, sṛṣṭivākyairadvitīyabrahmapratipattaye niṣedhyaprāptiparaiḥ prāptatvācca| tasmāt niṣprapañcabrahmātmapramitau śābdī vā laukikī vā pramitiḥ na nirudhyate|| nanu jīvo'pi vākyārthapramitiviṣayaḥ, tasmin prapañce pratyakṣāvagate kathaṃ niṣprapañcavākyārthapramiti iti| ucyate; -- na tāvadanumānādigamyaḥ kartṛtvādiprapañcaḥ, aparokṣatvāt; nāpi cakṣurādigamyaḥ; pratyagātmano bāhyendriyāviṣayatvāt, mānasapratyakṣagamya iti cet, kiṃ tatra pramāṇam satyeva manasi ātmani bandhopalabdheḥ, asati ca suṣupte anupalabdheḥ anvayavyatirekau pramāṇamiti cet, na; anyathāsiddhatvāt, ātmani kartṛtvādiprapañcasattākāraṇatayāpi anvayavyatirekopapatteḥ, suṣupte kartṛtvādyānavabhāsaḥ kiṃ manaso'bhāvāt kiṃ vā svayamabhāvāt iti saṃdigdhavyatirekatvāt| pratītiḥ karaṇamapyapekṣate iti cet, na; ātmacaitanyenaiva avyavadhānāt pratibhāsopapatteḥ| nanu kartṛtvabhoktṛtvarāgadveṣasukhaduḥkhādayo'pyātmani svayaṃprakāśā iti bauddhaprābhākarāḥ kalpayanti, naitadyuktam; teṣāṃ dravyatve bahuprakāśaguṇakalpanayā tadviśiṣṭātmaprakāśakalpanādātmana evaikaṃ prakāśaguṇaṃ parikalpya tadanvayāditareṣāṃ prakāśakalpanāyā laghīyastvāt| teṣāṃ guṇatve sati guṇasya guṇāntarābhāvāt na svayaṃprakāśatā| ta eva prakāśaguṇā iti cet, na; prakāśaguṇasya svāśrayopādhāvādityādāvivānutpatteḥ| bandhasya svasattāyāṃ pratītivyatirekābhāvo'pi na svayaṃprakāśamānatāṃ kalpayati; nityātmaprakāśasaṃsargādapi tadupapatteḥ| na ca klṛptakāraṇābhāve'pi bandhāparokṣye pramāṇakāraṇāntaraṃ kalpayituṃ yuktam ; niṣprapañcāgamavirodhāt, "indro māyābhiri"ti mithyākāraṇāntaraklṛpteśca| tasmādajñānādisatyamithyāvastusādhāraṇena sākṣimātreṇa vedyatvāt prapañcasya satyato niṣprapañcabrahmātmapramitiḥ saprapañcapramityā na bādhyate| tasmāt avidyātatkāryaprapañcapratibhāsābhāvasya tadvirodhādeva brahmātmaviśeṣaṇatvena pramātumaśakyatvāt brahmātmāvagatināntarīyakatayā prātibhāsikabandhanivṛttiriti sūktam|| nanu anarthanivṛttiḥ na śāstraviṣayaścet, kathaṃ viṣayāvagatisāmarthyalabhyeti tatra kimanarthanirāsaḥ paryanuyujyate tannirāsapratibhāso vā yadi nirāsaḥ, tatrāha -- yuktaṃ caitaditi|| tattvāvabhāsavirodhitvāt avidyātatkāryatvācceti bhāvaḥ| nanu "nedaṃ rajatami"ti yatra vijñānaṃ, tatra "rajatami"ti viparyāsaṃ nivartayati, iha tu "ahaṃ brahmāsmī"ti vijñānaṃ vastusvarūpaniṣṭhaṃ na prapañcaniṣedhaviṣayam, tatra kathaṃ viparyāsanirāsaḥ iti codayati -- nanu ca nañādernirāsakṛta iti|| tatra dve jñāne viparyāsavirodhinīvirodhiśuktikādibhāvāntarātmajñānaṃ adhyastavastutattvābhāvajñānaṃ ca; tatra adhyastatattvābhāvajñānena adhyāsanirāse nañādyapekṣe na, virodhibhāvāntarajñāne iti pariharati -- nedaṃ rajatamiti yatreti|| brahmaṇi tu virodhibhāvāntarajñānādadhyāsanivṛttirityāha -- iha punarvijñānameva tādṛśamiti|| nanu sarvo hi vyāpāraḥ svaviṣayameva sādhayati, na nāntarīyakamarthāntaram; ato viparyāsanirāsaviṣayo jñānavyāpāro vaktavyaḥ, na bhāvāntaraviṣayaḥ iti neti, dṛṣṭāntamāha -- tulonnamanavyāpāra iveti|| anyaviṣayavyāpārādanyaviṣayasya nāntarīyakatāsiddhiṃ sādhayati -- tathā hyunnamanavyāpāra iti|| nanu vyāpāra evobhayaviṣaya ityubhayaṃ viṣayatayaiva sidhyati, nānyatarat nāntarīyakamiti, netyāha -- na connamanakārakasyeti|| bhavatu śuktibrahmātmajñānābhyāṃ rajatabandhayoḥ nāntarīyako nirāsaḥ nirāśapratipattistu katham iti; sāpi nāntarīyaketyāha -- tadevaṃ viparyāsagṛhīte vastunīti|| evamiti|| yathā nirāsaḥ tathā tatpratipattirapītyarthaḥ| abhinayena darśayati -- nāhaṃ kartā brahmāhamiti|| vyutkrameṇa sambandhaḥ| brahmāhamiti vākyārthabodhe ahaṃ brahmaiva cet, nāhaṃ kartā iti nāntarīyakabodhaḥ| "nedaṃ rajatami"tyatrāpyeṣaiva yojanā| nanu vākyameva hyarthaṃ kiṃ na syāt iti; netyāha -- tasmācchuktikeyamityeva nirākāṅkṣamiti|| anuvāda iti|| vākyārthajñānāntarīyakasiddhasya anuvāda ityarthaḥ| arthāntarajñānena arthāntarajñānasya nāntarīyakapratibhāse dṛṣṭāntamāha -- ata eva ākhyātapadasyeti|| vākyārthabhūtakriyāvācakatvādākhyātasya vākyatvam| kriyājñānasāmarthyādeva sarvasādhanānāṃ vikalpena kriyānvayapratipattau padāntarāṇyanyatamaniyamārthāni, nityavadanvayapratipattau anuvādamukhena anyanivṛttyarthānītyarthaḥ| sambhavati ca nityavadanvayapratipattiḥ, ekasya bahusādhanatopapatteḥ| "tathā cāhuḥ yajaticodane"tyādi udāharaṇāntaraṃ śrutārthāpattyaiva arthantarapratipattau| kathaṃ dravyadevatayoḥ yāgaśrutyanyathānupapattigamyatayā yajatyarthatā ityāśaṅkyāha -- kathaṃ kriyāmātravācina iti|| nanu yatra viparyāsagṛhītasya vastuno virodhibhāvāntarātmaviṣayaṃ vākyaṃ viparyāsaṃ nivartayati, tatra viparyāsanirāsapratipādane vākyasya sāmarthyābhāvāt nāntarīyakaṃ nirāsajñānamastu; yatra punaḥ pratyakṣabādhakaṃ tatra viparyāsanirāsaviśiṣṭabhāvāntarajñānameva bādhakam; na tatra viparyāsanirāsasya nāntarīyakajñānam| ihāpyaparokṣajñānāt bandhanivṛtteḥ ubhayaviṣayameva jñānam, nānyatarasya nāntarīyakatā, ityāśaṅkyāha -- pratyakṣabādhasyāpīti|| na tāvadanupalabdhigamyo rajatābhāvaḥ; purodeśe dṛśyamānatvāt; atha saṃprayogajanya iti; netyāha -- asaṃprayuktaviṣayatvāditi|| rajatatadabhāvau na saṃprayogayogyāvityarthaḥ| tadevaśābdaṃ ityupasaṃhāraḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu brahmavidyāphalamanarthahetunirāsaḥ, na vedāntārambhaphalam; tatra kathaṃ prahāṇāya vedāntāḥ ityāśaṅkyāha -- caturthīprayogo'pīti|| upādānaṃ -- vedāntārambha ityarthaḥ| tarhi brahmavidyāphalatvāt śāstrasya na anarthanirāsaḥ prayojanam, na; paramparayāpi puruṣākāṅkṣitaprayojanatvopapatterityāha -- prayojanatvaṃ ceti|| vidyāpratipattaye iti pratipattiśabdamākṣipati -- na hi vidyā gavādivaditi|| jñānaṃ hi vastutaḥpratītitaśca jñāturutpattyaiva āptamevetyarthaḥ| tatra pratyakṣāntareṣu svaviṣayeṇa saha aparokṣāvabhāsā vidyā bhavati, āptiśabdena ca viṣayeṇa sahāparokṣyaniścayo vivakṣyate, tadiha na saṃbhavatītyāha -- satyamevamanyatreti|| atra "vidye"ti śaktitātparyavicārasahakṛtācchabdāt yat pramāṇajñānamutpadyate, tadabhidhīyate| tasya pratiṣṭhā svaviṣayeṇa saha āparokṣyamiti| tatra asambhāvaneti|| cittasya brahmātmaparibhāvanāpracayanimittadekāgravṛttyayogyatocyate| viparītabhāvaneti śarīrādyadhyāsasaṃskārapracayaḥ|| nanu aparokṣāvabhāsanimittapramāṇagṛhīte vastuni nobhayavidhacittadoṣāt aparokṣaniścayābhāvadarśanamastīti tatrāha -- tathā ca loke'smin deśe kāle iti|| yathā dūradeśavartini ārdramarīcaphalādau tathāvidhavastudarśanasaṃskāraśūnyatayā viparītasaṃskāravattayā ca pratyakṣadṛṣṭe'pi na niścinoti| asambhāvitaviśeṣāṃśāparokṣaniścayo notpadyate ityarthaḥ| nanu pramāṇādaniścīyamānaḥ kathaṃ tarkapratyayānniścīyate iti; tatrāha -- ata eva pramāṇānāmiti|| prasiddhaiva sahakārisaṃpattau phalasiddhirityarthaḥ| nanu tarkasyāpi pramāṇatve kathaṃ pramāṇadvayādarthaniścayo bhavati apramāṇatve na tarāṃ iti manvāna āha -- atha ko'yamiti|| apramāṇamapi tarkaḥ sahakāryeva, pratyayaviśeṣavādityāha -- pramāṇaśaktiviṣayataditi|| teṣāṃ tattvaṃ tadityucyate| pramāṇāditattve sambhavāsambhavapratyayaḥ, tarkaḥ, na niścayarūpa ityarthaḥ|| tatredaṃ nirūpitaṃ prathame tantre -- jñānānāṃ prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyaṃ ca svata iti kecit| ubhayamapi parata ityanye| prāmāṇyaṃ parataḥ, aprāmāṇyaṃ svata ityapare| aprāmāṇyaṃ parataḥ, svataḥ prāmāṇyamiti vedavādinaḥ| tatra na tāvat jñānānāṃ prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyaṃ ca svata iti yujyate, virodhāt| nanu -- vyaktibhedena vyavasthā, satyamarthatastathaiva; pratītitastu pramāṇāpramāṇapratibhāsāviśeṣāt kasya kimityanavagamāt vyavahārābhāvaprasaṅgāt| na ca mūrtāmūrtavibhāgavat pramāṇāpramāṇavibhāgaḥ pratyakṣato'vabhāsate| arthatastu vyaktibhede na vyavasthīyate| nāpyubhayaṃ parataḥ; pramāṇāpramāṇavibhāgahīnasya jñānasya svarūpānavagamāt| nāpi prāmāṇyamarthaparicchedasāmarthyaṃ kāraṇaguṇajñānāt parato'vagamyate anavasthāpātāt| nāpi jñānakāraṇavyatiriktāt kāraṇāt prāmāṇyaṃ janyate | kṣaṇamātrāpavargiṇi jñāne tadayogāt, pratibhāsato bhrāntisamyagjñānayoḥ viśeṣābhāve cakṣurādiguṇajanyatvāvagamāt prāk prāmāṇyaniścayābhāvāt vvayahārābhāvaprasaṅgāt, prāmāṇyanimittacakṣurādiguṇajñānasyāpi guṇāntarajanyatvāvagamamantareṇa prāmāṇyaniścayanimittatvāyogāt| pratibhāsato bhrānteraviśeṣāt svato guṇajanyatvāniścayāt| jñānasya guṇānvayavyatirekayośca prāmāṇyapratibandhakadoṣābhāvaviṣayatayā anyathāsiddhatvāt| doṣanivṛttivyatirekeṇendriyādiṣu guṇādarśanācca anyato'pi prāmāṇyasya jñānena saha janmābhāvaḥ| arthakriyāsaṃvādajñānāt; prāmāṇyaniścaye'pi tulyo'navasthādidoṣaḥ| sādhanajñānānāmeva arthakriyāsaṃvādāt prāmāṇyaṃ, na phalajñānānām, arthakriyāntarābhāvāt, ato nānavastheti cet, tadvadeva sādhanajñānānāmapi tat svata eva syāt; anyathā pravṛttasya arthakriyātaḥprāmāṇyam, prāmāṇyācca pravṛttiḥ iti itaretarāśrayatvaṃ syāt| na ca prāmāṇyaniścayāya pravṛttiḥ; asandigdhārthatvāt jñānānām| rūpakaparīkṣādau pratyayacatuṣṭayāt dṛśyate arthaniścaya iti cet, na; prathamajñānasyaiva saṃśayādipratibandhanirāsitvāduttarajñānānām| tasmāt jñānotpattimātraprayuktārthavyavahāradarśanāt pratītito'rthataśca svata eva arthaniścayaḥ prāmāṇyam| aprāmāṇyajanma doṣasahitāt kāraṇāt tatpratītiḥ bādhāditi parata eva aprāmāṇyaṃ yuktam| na ca aprāmāṇyasya parato janma saṃbhavati, prāmāṇyaprāgamāvatvāditi cet, na; ajñānasaṃśayamithyā jñānānāmaprāmāṇyānāṃ bhāvarūpatvāt| nanu svataḥ pramāṇasya kathaṃ parato'prāmāṇyam svabhāva virodhāt iti cet, doṣapratibandhabalāt agneriva śaityasparśo na virudhyate| svataḥprāmāṇyādeva ca yāvaddoṣāvagamaṃ jñānādeva vyavahāradarśanam| tasmāt prāmāṇyatatpratītyoḥ guṇatatjjñānāntarādyanapekṣameva jñānaṃ svataḥ sattayaiva niścayavyavahāranimittamiti sthāpitam| tadetadvirudhyate tarkapratyayāpekṣayā jñānasya svaviṣayaṃ prati niścāyakatve iti codayati -- nanvevaṃ tarkasāpekṣaṃ svamarthamiti|| paraharati -- na syāt svamahimnaivetyādinā|| pramāṇādeva arthāparokṣyaniścaye tatpratibandhavigame tarkasya upayogāt nārthanirṇayahetutetyuktam|| nanu evaṃ bahirarthe pramāṇapratibandhasambhavāt tadvigamāya bhavatu tarkopakāraḥ, na tathā ātmani; svayaṃprakāśe, pratibandhābhāvāditi, tatrāha -- tathā ca tattvamasivākye tvampadārthaḥ iti|| "asambhāvaya"nniti, āparokṣyābhāva ucyate, "viparītami"ti ca pārokṣyamucyate| atrāyamāśayaḥ -- loke tāvadviṣayasyāparokṣatā saṃvidabhedādvā viṣayasyāvyavadhānatayā svasaṃvijjanakatvādvā pramāṇakāraṇendriyasamprayuktatvādvā bhavati; uktakāraṇatrayahīne anumeyādau parokṣatādarśanāt| tatra brahmaṇa eva sarvasaṃvidupādānatvāt brahmākāraśabdapramāṇajanyasaṃvedane'pi tadabhinnatayā vā tajjanakatayā vā brahmāpi prathamamevāparokṣatayā avabhāsate| tacca cittasyātisūkṣme anekāgratādoṣādviparyayasaṃskāradoṣācca pratibaddhaṃ bhrāntyā parokṣavadavabhāsate| tatrāparokṣajñānamuddiśya yajñādīnāṃ nididhyāsanādīnāṃ ca vidhānasāmarthyāt yajñādinibarhitakalmaṣapratibandhaṃ śamādiniruddhaviparītapravṛttidoṣaṃ, mananasaṃdarśitaprameyādisaṃbhāvanāguṇapradīpojjvalitaṃ atisūkṣmatarabrahmātmaviṣayanididhyāsanapracayaparinirmitatadekāgravṛttiguṇaṃ cendriyaṃ pārokṣyavibhramanimittapratibandhanirāsena śabdādevāparokṣaniścayanimittaṃ bhavatīti gamyate; loke ca atisūkṣmavastunirdhāraṇe cittaikāgryaviśeṣāpekṣāyā darśanāt| tarkaśabdena cātra etādṛśaṃ sarvapratibandhanirāsi cittadarpaṇamucyate; yoktikāsambhāvanāviparītabhāvanānirāsitarkāṇāṃ prathamajñāne antarbhūtatvāt| evaṃ ca "taṃ tvaupaniṣadam" iti taddhitapratyayena brahmāvagatihetutvaṃ śabdasya darśitamupapannaṃ bhavati; aparokṣāvagatereva samyagavatitvāditi|| anyanmatam -- na prathamotpannaṃ śābdajñānameva pratibandhavigamāpekṣayā aparokṣāvabhāsaṃ bhavati; kiṃ tu śabda eva prathamaṃ brahmaṇi parokṣajñānamutpādya punaḥ varṇitacittadarpaṇasahakāraṇāpekṣayā dvitīyamaparokṣajñānamutpādayati; śabdādīnāṃ taddhitapratyayādinā aparokṣajñāne viniyogasāmarthyāt, yathā saṃprayogo'bhijñāmutpādya punaḥ pūrvānubhavasaṃskārāpekṣayā pratyabhijñāmutpādayati tadvat| na ca svayamprakāśe brahmaṇi parokṣajñānaṃ vibhramaḥ; svayamprakāśe'pi puruṣāntarasaṃvedane parokṣānumānadarśanāditi| sarvathāpi āparokṣyasya prayatnāntaralabhyatvāt yuktaṃ pṛthak pratipattiśabdagrahaṇamityāha -- tataḥ prāgvidyoditāpīti|| kaiḥ punaḥ sahakāribhiḥ śabdapramāṇādāparokṣyaṃ labhyate iti ; tatrāha -- avāptiprakāraśca vedānteṣveva nirdiṣṭa iti|| nanu -- manananididhyāsanayoḥ kathaṃ śravaṇaṃ pratyaṅgatāvagam yāvatā brahmaṇyeva śaktitātparyaviśiṣṭavedāntaśabdāvadhāraṇācchravaṇaśabdābhidheyādātmanyavabuddhe paścānmananamarthasaṃbhāvanopapattiparyālocanādvārā janitā brahmaṇi pratyayāvṛttirutpadyate| tataśca pramāṇayuktisambhāvanābhyāṃ pariniścite'pi viṣaye tadekākāraṃ cittasamādhānaṃ nididhyāsanamutpadyate; tadevaṃ nididhyāsanasvarūpopakāritayā śravaṇamananayostadaṅgabhāve'vagate na yujyate śravaṇāṅgatā manananididhyāsanayoriti| atrocyate -- yasmin pakṣe śaktitātparyaviśiṣṭaśabdāvadhāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ brahmaṇi parokṣajñānamutpādya manananididhyāsanasaṃskāraviśiṣṭāntaḥkaraṇāpekṣayā aparokṣajñānamutpādayati, tatra brahmaṇi parokṣajñānasya nididhyāsanopakāritayā tadaṅgatve'pi tātparyaviśiṣṭaśabdāvadhāraṇādaparokṣajñānotpattau manananididhyāsane śravaṇasya phalopakāryaṅgatāmaśnuvāte| nanu aparokṣaphalodaye'pi nididhyāsanāṅgataiva śravaṇamananayoḥ kiṃ na syāt trayāṇāmapi sannipatyopakārāviśeṣāt, darśapaurṇamāsavat samapradhānatā vā kiṃ na syāt iti ; ucyate -- viśiṣṭaśabdāvadhāraṇaṃ prameyāvagamaṃ pratyavyavadhānena kāraṇaṃ bhavati; pramāṇasya prameyāvagamaṃ pratyavyavadhānāt| manananididhyāsane tu cittasya pratyagātmapravaṇatāsaṃskārapariniṣpannatadekāgravṛttikāryadvāreṇa brahmānubhavahetutāṃ pratipadyete, iti phalaṃ pratyavyavahitasya karaṇasya viśiṣṭaśabdāvadhāraṇasya vvayahite manananididhyāsane tadaṅge aṅgīkriyete| yadā tu punaḥ śabdādeva prathamamaparokṣānubhavaphalaṃ vijñānamutpannaṃ, bhrāntivikṣepasaṃskārasvacitāntaḥkaraṇadoṣāt arthe'pi parokṣānubhavaphalatayā vibhrāntyā avatiṣṭhate, tadā manananididhyāsane cittagatavikṣepādidoṣapratibandhanirāsena aparokṣaphalapratiṣṭhāhetutayā pramāṇasya phalopakāryaṅgamiti na virudhyate| na ca śabdakaraṇamantareṇa nididhyāsanādeva aparokṣānubhavaphalajanma saṃbhavati; tasya prāmāṇyāsiddheḥ| śabdāvagatabrahmātmaviṣayatvādaparokṣasya taddvāreṇa prāmāṇyaniścaya iti cet, naivam; utpannasya hi vijñānasya pramāṇāntarādhīnaviṣayasadbhāvaniścayādhīnaprāmāṇyakalpanāt varaṃ svasyaiva klṛptapramāṇajanyatvakalpanam; anyathā parataḥprāmāṇyāt itaratra svataḥprāmāṇyāt| tasmāt yuktaṃ śravaṇasya phalopakāryaṅgatā manananididhyāsanayoriti|| nanu brahmāparokṣajñānamapi nānarthanivṛttinimittam ; satyapi tasmin saṃsārānuvṛttidarśanāt, anyathā sadya eva śarīrapātaḥ syāt iti codayati -- nanvātmaikatvavidyāpratipattiriti|| nanu vyatirekajñānāt tattvajñānasya viśeṣo darśitaḥ, satyam; phalato na viśeṣa ityāha -- tathā hi jīvasyeti|| naitadyuktam; tattvāparokṣāt samūlādhyāsanivṛtteḥ anvayavyatirekaśāstrasiddhatvādityāha -- bhavatu tatrāvidyāyā iti| nanu adhyāsavirodhivyatirekāvagamavat tattvāvabodho'dhyāsaviruddho'pi tannāpanayatītyanumīyatāmiti ; netyāha -- na hi jīvasyeti| anavabodhaviruddhaṃ tattvajñānaṃ na vyatirekajñānamityarthaḥ| saśarīrendriyasyaivāparokṣāvagamāt tarhi sadya eva śarīrapātaḥ syāditi codayati -- nanu brahmajñānāditi|| tattvajñānādavidyānirodhe'pi punarvṛttiḥ yujyate ityāha -- na saṃskārāditi|| tadeva prapañcayati -- tathā hīti|| nanu kriyājñānayoreva saṃskāraḥ sambhavati, na ajñānatatkāryayoḥ, na; gandhādisaṃskāradarśanāt, pralayāvasthāyāṃ sarvakāryasaṃskāropagamāt| sarvatra ca vināśamātraprayuktasaṃskārajanmānumānāt, avidyātatkāryasya bhrāntijñānātmakatvāt, ajñānādau ca sākṣicaitanyāvacchedakajñānābhāsopagamāt saṃskārasiddheḥ| nanu saṃskārāt smṛtimātrahetoḥ kathamaparokṣadvaitāvabhāsaḥ syāt avidyāvat saṃskārasyāpi caitanyadoṣatvāditi vadāmaḥ| aparokṣāvabhāsakāraṇagato doṣo'parokṣabhramaheturiti siddhatvāt ātmamātrasyaiva avidyāśrayatvāt saṃskārāśrayatvopapatteśca, avidyāsaṃskāravyatiriktakāryāṇāmeva avidyopādānatvāt| ātmano mithyābhūtasaṃskāropādānatvābhāve'pi āśrayopādhitvasya avidyopādhitvavadavirodhāt| tattvajñānānusandhānādeva ca krameṇa saṃskāranivṛtteḥ kaṃcit kālamavasthāyaiva videhamuktiḥ na virudhyate, avidyāleśo vā tamoleśavat saṃskāraśabdenābhidhīyate iti niravadyam|| nanu na sarve vedāntā iti spaṣṭārthaḥ| tatra nirviśeṣabrahmapratipattyartheṣu vedanteṣu saguṇabrahmopāsanānāṃ tāvat prāsaṅgikatvaṃ darśayati -- satyam upāsanākarma tviti|| nanu nirviśeṣaṃ cet brahma pratipādyam, tasya kathaṃ saguṇopāsanālambanaṃ saprapañcaṃ brahma aṅgabhūtaṃ syāt yenāśritya vidhānamucyate iti; adhyāropāpavādanyāyamabhipretyetyāha -- taccāpākṛtāśeṣaprapañcamiti|| nirākriyamāṇe prapañce kathamupāsanāvidhānam nirākaraṇapratyayavirodhāt iti tatrāha -- asyāṃ cāvasthāyāmiti|| nanu āśritya vidhāne godohanavadadhikṛtādhikāratāpi syāditi mumukṣorevopāsanāsvapyadhikāraḥ syāditi -- ucyate; -- apāṃ praṇayanasya prakṛtatayā uddeśyatvāt na godohanavidhinā anuṣṭheyatayā siddhiḥ; ataḥ prāptoddeśanatvāt praṇayanasya, svatantrapaśukāmino'prāptatvāt, prāptapraṇayanasya darśapūrṇamāsādhikāriṇa eva paśukāmasya godohane'pyadhikāro darśitaḥ| saprapañcabrahmapratipattiśca āśrīyamāṇā mumukṣoramumukṣośca śabdādaviśeṣeṇa prāpteti tadāśritya vidhānaṃ amumukṣūṇāmapyupapadyate iti na mumukṣvadhikārakalpanā, kiṃ tu āśritya vidhānamātramiti niravadyam| ato mahātātparyaprakramo brahmapara ityupasaṃharati -- tasmāttadarthopajīvitvāditi|| nanvabrahmopāsanānyapi ityāderayamarthaḥ -- sākṣādvā paramparayā vā antaḥkaraṇaśuddhidvāreṇa brahmātmaikatvāvagatiparāḥ sarve vedāntā iti| vedāntaviṣayaprayojanayoreva vicāraśāstrasyāpi viṣayaprayojanatvamiti kathayitumāha -- yathā cāyamartha iti|| bhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- pratijñāte'rtha iti|| śarīramevetyādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| vedāntānāṃ śārīrakaparatve'pi vicārasya kathaṃ śārīrakaparatvamiti tadāha -- tadiha vedāntānāmiti|| nanu vicārakartavyatāmātraṃ sūtrārthaḥ, tatra viṣayaprayojanayorasūtritayorupādānaṃ vedāntatadvicārasambandhitayā nopapadyate, ityāśaṅkāmapanudya, vṛttasaṅkīrtanapūrvakamuttarabhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- mumukṣutve satyanantaramityādinā|| kathaṃ brahmajñānasya mokṣaḥ prayojanamarthasiddham iti ; tadāha -- puruṣārthavastukāmaneti|| pravṛttiriti pravṛttiviṣayeṣṭasādhanatā abhidhīyate| saiva hi vidhiriti vakṣyāmaḥ|| yasmin dhātvarthe pravṛtteḥ hitasādhanatā liṅgādipadairupadiśyate, sa dhātvarthaḥ sāmānyena hitasādhano'dhikāriviśeṣaṇena phalaviśeṣeṇa sāmarthyāt sambadhyate; sāmānyapratīteḥ viśeṣaparyavasānamantareṇa anupapatteḥ| tataśca vicāro hi sāmānyena hitasādhanatayā avagamyamānaḥ svasāmarthyasiddhajñānadvāreṇa adhikāriviśeṣaṇamokṣaviśeṣaphale paryavasyati ityarthaḥ|| nanu -- puruṣārthakāmino yatra niyoga upadiśyate, tatra niyogo dhātvarthasya puruṣārthasādhanatvaṃ kalpayati; tataśca vidhīyamāno vicāro niyogasāmarthyāt mokṣasādhanamiti kalpyatāṃca kimiṣṭasādhanatvavidhisāmarthyakalpanayā iti|| naitat sāram; anupapattyabhāvāt| tathāhi -- niyogasvarūpaṃ tāvat na phaladhātvarthasambandhamantareṇa anupapannam; anāptaniyoge naiyamike ca adarśanāt| pravartakatvamanupapannamiti cet, yadi phalakāmanāpi niyogena pravṛttāvapekṣyate, saiva tarhi pravṛttihetuḥ, na niyogaḥ; pratyakṣādiṣu tasyāḥ pravartane svātantryadarśanāt| atha nāpekṣyate kāmaḥ, tarhi phalakāmanāmanapekṣya balavadanilasalilaughanudyamāna iva puruṣe niyogena pravartyamāne na phalasambandhakalpanāvakāśaḥ, salilādinodane'pi prasaṅgāt| nanu phalakāmino niyogaḥ pramīyamāṇo'nupapannaḥ phalasambandhamantareṇa, anyathā phalakāminiyogo na syāt, ko'yamabhiprāyaḥ yadi tāvat phalakāmanā niyogādhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ na syāt phaladhātvarthasambandhamantareṇeti, tanna; jīvanādīnāmasādhyānāmapyadhikāriviśeṣaṇatvadarśanāt| sādhyasya viśeṣaṇatvamanupapannamiti cet, na tāvadanena sādhyatvaṃ siddhavatkartuṃ śakyate| svarūpeṇa sādhyatvaṃ cet na -- avivakṣitatvāt| tathā hi -- adhikāriviśeṣavyāvṛttimātraprayojanatayā viśeṣaṇapareṇa śabdena sādhyatā na vivakṣyate| nārthādapi sādhyatvavivakṣā ; tatra pramāṇasya adyāpyadarśanāt| kāmanaiva ca siddhasvarūpā adhikāriviśeṣaṇam| svargasya tadvyāvartakatvāt|| kiñca, anyasādhyasyāpi vyāpārāntare adhikāriviśeṣaṇatvaṃ dṛśyate -- "adhyetukāmo bhaikṣyaṃ caret" "parastrīkāmaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt" "grāmakāmobhuṅkṣva" ityādau| na cādhikāriviśeṣaṇatvamapi svargakāmanāyāḥ sambhavati ; ayogānyayogavyavacchedāsambhavāt| tathā hi -- svargakāmapadaṃ darśapūrṇamāsaniyogasya puruṣeṇa asaṃyogaṃ na vyavacchinatti ; nityavidhinaiva puruṣānvayasya siddhatvāt| nāpi niyogasya asvargakāmasambandhavyavacchedārthaṃ viśeṣaṇam; atrāpi darśapūrṇamāsanityavidhisambandhavirodhāt| na ca nityakāmyaniyogabhedaḥ ; sāṅgadarśapaurṇamāsaniyogasya aviśiṣṭatvāt adhikārimātrabhedāt| tasmāt "daṇḍī praiṣānanvāheti"vat viśeṣaṇasvargaparamidaṃ vacanaṃ na viśiṣṭapuruṣaparamiti phalavacanametat svargakāmapadam| arthāt svargakāmo'dhikārī bhavati| phalavacanaṃ ca sādhanavacanena anvitābhidhānamarhatīti na niyogābhidhānāvakāśaḥ| tataśceṣṭasādhanameva liṅgādiśabdārtho vidhiriti|| anye manyante -- viṣayaniyojyavyāvṛtte niyoge abhidhīyamāne viṣayaniyojyayoranvayaḥ sāmarthyādavagamyate; anyathā adhikāriṇo viṣayeṇa kartṛkarmānanvayena ananuṣṭhīyamāne viṣaye niyogasya nirvṛttyayogāt| tataśca adhikāriṇā dhātvartho'nvayīmānaḥ tadviśeṣaṇena svargeṇāpi anveti; viśiṣṭānvayasya viśeṣaṇenāpi anvayāt| tatra anvayo guṇapradhānabhāvādṛte nopapadyate iti svargaḥ prādhānyena karma guṇabhāveneti sampatsyate sādhyasādhanasambandha -- iti|| naitat sāram -- jīvanagṛhadāhādiviśeṣaṇenāpi yāgasya anvayaprasaṅgāt| ko doṣaḥ iti cet, jīvanādeḥ dhātvarthaṃ prati aṅgatvena anvaye vikṛtāvatideśaḥ prāpnuyāt| tatra "yāvajjīvaṃ sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet" iti syāt| prādhānyenānvaye jīvanāderapi karmasādhyatvaṃ syāt| tasmāt svargakāmapadaṃ phalaviśeṣaparatayā sāmānyena śreyasādhanavidhyabhidhāyināliṅādipadena anvitābhidhānaṃ karoti|| nanu śābde phalaviśeṣānvaye sāmānyena śreyassādhanatvāparyavasānasāmarthyāt viśeṣānvaya ityuktamayuktam, naiṣa doṣaḥ; viśeṣasākāṅkṣaśreyassāmānyasādhanatvavidhisāmarthyāt svargakāmapadaṃ phalaviśeṣaparaṃ kalpyate| vidhyākāṅkṣānibandhanatvāt padāntaratātparyasya| tataśca vidhisāmarthyāt phalasambandha ityuktam| nanu tiṅkṛttaddhitasamāsairanabhihita iti viśeṣaṇāt liṅā yāgasya karaṇatābhidhāne "jyotiṣṭomene"ti tṛtīyā nopapadyate iti, na; yāgajyotiṣṭomasāmānyaviśeṣaprakṛtyarthabhedoparaktakaraṇatvabhedādadoṣaḥ ityalamatiprasaṅgena|| viṣayasiddhiḥ katham iti; tadāha -- tathā sati kuta iti|| tadevaṃ ityādyuktānukīrtanam| "prathamaṃ tāvadi"ti bhāṣyasya tātparyakathanam| nanu viṣayaḥ samanvayalakṣaṇenaiva gamyate, prayojanaṃ ca caturthādhyāyenaiva pramīyate; tatra kimiti viṣayaprayojane prathamasūtreṇa sūcite iti; tatrāha -- śāstrasyādirayamiti|| nanu ekasya sūtravākyasya anekārthatvamayuktamiti; tatrāha -- sūtraṃ caitaditi|| tatra athaśabdaḥ ityādipadavyākhyānabhāṣyasya vṛttasaṅkīrtanapūrvakaṃ tātparyamāha -- evaṃ sūtrasyāditveneti|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakānanyubhavapūjyapādaśiṣyasvaprakāśānubhavabhagavataḥ kṛtau pañcapādikāvivaraṇe'dhyāsabhāṣyaṃ nāma prathamavarṇakaṃ samāptam|| <2> tatra uktastāvadvicāravidheḥ phalānubandho vyavahitaviṣayabrahmātmatānubandhaśca; idānīmavyavahitavicāraviṣayānubandhamanyata eva aprāptānuṣṭhānaṃ darśayituṃ prathamamākṣipati -- siddhaiva nanu brahmajijñāseti|| vedāntānāmarthanirṇayāpekṣito nyāyakalāpaḥ "athāto dharmajijñāsā" ityādisūtraiḥ sūtrita ityarthaḥ|| nanu vidhivākyārthanirṇayastatra pravṛttaḥ ityāśaṅkyāha -- sakalavedārthasya vicāritatvāditi| vedasya kāryamātraparatvādityarthaḥ| nanu -- vedāntatātparyāt brahmāvagamyate, na kāryam, anavagamyaṃ ca na vākyaprameyamiti, tatrāha -- brahmajñānasya ceti|| nanu kriyāvidhikalāpo nirūpitaḥ, jñānavidhinirūpaṇāyedamārabhyata iti, netyāha -- ataḥ siddhaiveti|| utpattiviniyogaprayogādhikārāṇāṃ vidhyapekṣitarūpāṇāṃ kriyāpratipattyoḥ aviśeṣeṇa nirūpitatvādityarthaḥ|| nanu -- yathā prathame'dhyāye vedasya prāmāṇyaṃ nirūpitam; dvitīye karmotpattividhibhedaḥ; tṛtīye vihitānāmaṅgāṅgibhāvo nirūpitaḥ; caturthe kratupuruṣārthaprayuktānuṣṭheyaparimāṇam; pañcame anuṣṭhānakramaḥ; ṣaṣṭhe vidhyapekṣito'dhikāranirṇayaḥ; iti pūrvaṣaṭkena prakṛtividhyapekṣito vicāraḥ kṛtaḥ| samagrāṅgasaṃyukto vidhiḥ prakṛtiḥ vikalāṅgasaṃyukto vikṛtirityucyate| tatra saptamena prakṛtyupadiṣṭānāmaṅgānāṃ vikṛtāvatideśo nirṇītaḥ| aṣṭame tu "āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ" ityādiprakṛtyupadiṣṭānāmaṅgānāṃ "sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet" ityādivikṛtau dravyadevatādisāmānyadvāreṇa viśeṣātideśo nirūpitaḥ; navame tu prakṛtyupadiṣṭamantrasāmasaṃskārakarmaṇāṃ vikṛtāvatidiṣṭānāṃ prakṛtivikṛtyordravyadevatābhede sati prakṛtigatadravyādiśabdaṃ vihāya vikṛtigatadravyādiśabdādhyāhāralakṣaṇa ūho darśitaḥ; yathā -- "agnaye juṣṭam" iti mantrasya vikṛtau "sūryāya juṣṭa"miti padaprakṣepaḥ; daśame tu vikṛtāvatidiṣṭānāmaṅgānāṃ prakṛtau sāvakāśānāṃ vikṛtigataviśeṣāṅgopadeśādinā bādho darśitaḥ, yathā prakṛteḥ vikṛtāvatideśaprāptānāṃ barhiṣāṃ "śaramayaṃ barhi"riti vikṛtau viśeṣopadeśena bādhaḥ; ekādaśe tu anekaśeṣividhiprayuktasya śeṣasya sakṛdanuṣṭhānādeva sarvaśeṣiṇāmupakārasāmyaṃ tantraṃ nāmoktam -- yathā "yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ" "upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati" "agnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālam" iti ca paurṇamāsakarmatrayaprayuktasya prayājādeḥ sakṛdanuṣṭhānādeva śeṣitrayopakāraḥ iti; dvādaśe tu ekaśeṣiprayuktasya śeṣānuṣṭhānasya aprayojakasāmarthyayuktaśeṣyantare'pi upakāraḥ prasaṅgo nāma darśitaḥ -- yathā paśuvidhiprayuktānāmaṅgānāṃ paśupuroḍāśe'pyupakāraḥ| tadevaṃ pratyadhyāyamāśaṅkāntaranirākaraṇena vidhyaṃśabhedo nirūpitaḥ, tathā pratipattavyasya brahmaṇaḥ pratyakṣādibhirasiddhatvāt pratipattividhyayogāśaṅkāyāṃ tannirākaraṇābhedamārabhyata iti, tatrāha -- adhikāśaṅkā'bhāvāditi|| yūpāhavanīyādivat brahmaṇaḥ siddhiḥ, asiddhau vā āropitarūpeṇaivopāsanasiddhirityarthaḥ|| atra pūrvavādī siddhāntyekadeśīyān dūṣayituṃ vedāntānāṃ vidhiniṣṭhatvamaṅgīkṛtyaiva yā abhyadhikāśaṅkā tannirākaraṇāyaiva teṣāmārambhaprakāraṃ darśayati -- atra keciditi|| nanu kvacideva vidhiśravaṇe'pi tadākāṅkṣitānubandhasamarpaṇena vyavahitamapi vedāntavākyajātaṃ tadekavākyatayā saṃbadhyate, kiṃ sarvatra vidhiśravaṇena ityāśaṅkyāha -- yatrāpi vidhiḥ śrūyata iti|| tatrāpi vidheranupapattiritibhāvaḥ|| nanu bhāvakarmaṇorvihitānāmapi kṛtyapratyayānāṃ "kṛtyāśca iti vidhau smaraṇāt tavyapratyayena jñānaṃ vidhīyate iti, tatrāha -- tatra yadyapi kṛtyā iti|| tathāpīha vidhirna sambhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu gantavyamiti gamanavidhānavat jñānaṃ vidhīyatām, satyam -- yuktaṃ bhāvaviṣaye tavyapratyaye vidhānamityāha -- yo bhāvābhidhāyīti|| bhāva iti dhātvarthamātramucyate| tat prādhānyena svatantraphalāya vidhātuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ| nanu karmābhidhāyitavyapratyayādapi dhātvarthaviṣayo vidhiravagamyate -- "svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ" iti, tatrāha -- yatra punaḥ karma prādhānyenocyata iti|| tatrāpi svatantraphalāya vā karma vidhīyate kiṃ vā karmakārakagataphalāya iti tatra na tāvat svatantraphalāyetyāha -- tatra dravye guṇabhūtāmiti|| atha karmakārakasamavāyiphalāya vidhiḥ tatrāha -- dravyaparatve iti|| nana ātmani vihitakriyāsāmarthyāt ajñānādharmādimalāpakarṣaḥ saṃskāraḥ syāditi, netyāha -- saṃskṛtasya ceti|| tatra "saktūn juhoti" iti kratuprakaraṇe śravaṇāt kratvaṅgatā saktuhomasya avagatā|| tatra aṅgāni ca dvividhāni -- arthakarmāṇi saṃskārakarmāṇi ca|| kratūpakārakāṇyanāśritya svātantryeṇa vihitāni prayājādīnyarthakarmāṇi, vrīhyādikārakaguṇabhūtāni saṃskārakarmāṇi| tatra na tāvat saktuhomasya arthakarmatā; saktudravyasya guṇabhūtatvāt prokṣaṇādivat| saṃskārakarma ca dvividham -- viniyuktasaṃskāraḥ -- yathā "vrīhibhiryajeta" iti viniyuktavrīhīnuddiśya prokṣaṇādisaṃskāraḥ, kaścidviniyokṣyamāṇasaṃskāraḥ -- yathā "āhavanīye juhoti" iti viniyokṣyamāṇasya ādhānena saṃskāraḥ; saṃskṛtasya viniyoga ityarthaḥ| tatra homena bhasmīkṛtānāṃ saktūnāmubhayathāpi kratau viniyogābhāvāt vaiyarthyāyogācca saṃskārakarmatvaṃ parityajya "saktūni"ti prādhānyaṃ ca vihāya saktubhiriti guṇabhāvena karmaprādhānyamupādāya arthakarmatā nirūpitā yathā; tathā "ātmānamiti" sādhyatayā prādhānyaṃ vihāya "ātmanopāsīta" iti guṇatvopagamena svatantraphalāyopāsanaṃ prādhānyena vidhīyatāmiti śaṅkate -- atha punarviparīta iti|| tatra yathā homaprādhānye'pi sakarmakatvāddhātoḥ saktava eva karmakārakatayā bhasmīkriyante, evamavagamasyāpi sakarmatvādarthataḥ karmābhāve na vidhānamiti pariharati -- tatrāpi na jñāyata iti|| śabdataḥ karaṇatve'pyarthataḥ karmatā ātmana evetyāśaṅkate -- atha jñāyata iti|| tarhi karmakārakatve sati ātmani kaścidatiśayo vaktavyaḥ, tadabhāvānniṣkarmakaṃ jñānaṃ na vidhātuṃ śakyata ityāha -- evaṃ tarhi tadevāyātamiti|| nanu avabhāsyatayā avāptirātmani vidheyakriyāphalamiti, netyāha -- tacca kṛtakaraṇamanarthakamiti|| nityacaitanyena pratītito'vāptatvāt na jñānakarmatā ityarthaḥ|| apare punaḥ ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| avidyādharmādinivṛttiḥ saṃskāraḥ, na ca saṃskṛtasya anyatra viniyogākāṅkṣā; svayaṃpuruṣārthatvāt puruṣārthasaṃskārasya ca viniyogāpekṣatvāt tadarthamārabhyate iti pṛthagārambhavādino matam|| apare punarevamārabhante ityāderayamarthaḥ -- pratipattividhyapekṣito'pi caturvidho nyāyaḥ prathamatantre nirūpitaḥ| tatra tadviṣayasya brahmaṇo nirūpaṇāya śāstramārabdhavyamsa, tacca na saṃbhavati ; brahmaṇi pramāṇābhāvāt iti|| atrocyate ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| adhikāriniyogaviṣayatayeti|| ayamarthaḥ -- jñānasya phalasambandho'vagamyate, tatphalakāminā tadanuṣṭheyam, niyogācca anuṣṭhānamiti phalakāminiyogaviṣayatā avagamāditi bhāvaḥ|| atrocyate ityādinā ārambhadvayaṃ pūrvavādī nirācaṣṭe| yadi loke kṛtyapratyayo na niyogaṃ gamayatīti śaṅkate tannāstītyāha -- tat svayameveti|| atha vede, tatrāha -- prasiddhaṃ caitaditi| ataḥ prathamasūtreṇa adhyayanavidhimaṅgīkurvatāṃ gata evāyaṃ vicāra ityarthaḥ| nanu caturvidhasya ityādiruktārthaḥ| karaṇatve'pi ca ātmana eva karmakārakatve svato'parokṣatayā nityasiddhasya vidheyakriyājanyapratibhāsāyogāt akarmatvāt niṣkarmakaṃ jñānaṃ na vidhātuṃ śakyamityuktamityāha -- tadapi neti|| ātmani caturvidhaphalābhāvādakarmatve'pi kartṛsamavāyimokṣaphalāya tadavabhāsijñānasantānaniyamavidhiḥ syāt;yathā "hiraṇyaṃ bibhṛyādi"ti pakṣe aprāptasya niyamavidhirabhyudayaḥ, tadvadityāha -- siddhasyaiveti|| nanu avasthātraye'pi jñānasantānāvicchedānna niyamavidhirityāha -- nanu na vidhānato'pīti|| tarhi anātmapratibhāsanivṛttaye parisaṅkhyāvidhiradṛṣṭārthaḥ syādityāha -- evaṃ tarhīti|| ato gatārthatvāt na adhikāśaṅketi bhāvaḥ| satyapi jñānavidhāne prayojanābhāvāt na śāstrārambha ityāha -- yat punarātmajñānādityādi|| na ca anarthanivṛttau svayamaheturapi jñānasantāno vidhānādanarthaṃ nivartayati; viśeṣābhāvādityarthaḥ| tarhi alaukikātmatattvajñānamavidyādidoṣanivṛttiphalaṃ vidhīyatāmityāśaṅkate -- atha punarahaṃpratyayāvaseyāditi|| na; atyantamasiddhamuddiśya vidhānānupapatterityāha -- tadasat; vidhirhīti|| yathā sāmānyaprasiddhaṃ yāgamuddiśya pūrvānubhūtayāgavyaktisadṛśaṃ vyaktyantaraṃ buddhisthameva vidhīyate, evamalaukikātmajñānaṃ sāmānyataḥ prasiddhamuddiśya pūrvānubhūtajñānavyaktisadṛśaṃ vyaktyantaraṃ buddhāvākalayya tat kartavyatayā vidheyamityarthaḥ| nanu jñānasāmānyasya loke siddhatvāt taduddeśena vidhāne tadvyaktitvena alaukikātmajñānaṃ kartavyatayā pratīyatāmiti, netyāha -- tadyadi nāma jñānamiti|| tādṛgātmajñānasya jñānasāmānyavyaktitvenāprasiddhatvāt tādṛśaṃ jñānaṃ kartavyatayā buddhāvaropayituṃ na śakyamityarthaḥ| atha tādṛgātmajñānaṃ siddham, kiṃ svātmani puruṣāntare vā puruṣāntare cet, anyasya adhikāriṇaḥ tadapratipatteḥ na tādṛśaṃ vyaktyantaraṃ kartavyatayā buddhāvāropayituṃ śakyam| atha svātmani tatrāha -- kiṃ vidhineti||| yadapi matāntaraṃ ityādiruktārthaḥ| tadvicārāya-brahmavicārāya śāstrārambha ityarthaḥ|| aparaṃ matamiti|| sa eva pratipattividhivādī svapakṣamupapādayati -- satyam, kāryaparādapi vedāt brahmaṇo'pi pratipatteḥ yuktaḥ pratipattividhirityāha -- nanu tāvanmātra iti|| nanu -- viruddhamidaṃ, arthāntaraparāt śabdādarthāntarapratipattiriti, tatrāha -- tasmin satīti|| vidhipramāṇāt vidhisaṃsṛṣṭatayā anye'pi padārthāḥ tadapekṣitāḥ pramīyante ityarthaḥ| yathā rūpaviṣayasya cakṣuṣaḥ tatsaṃsargi sarvaṃ viṣayaḥ iti dṛṣṭāntamāha -- yathā rūpe satīti|| nanu "draṣṭavyaḥ" ityādinā nāparokṣajñānaṃ vidheyam; sukhasaṃvedanatayā svargādivat puruṣārthasya avidheyatvāt, nāpi śābdajñānam; tatra vidheraśravaṇāt iti codayati -- kathamiti|| asti śābdajñāne vidhānamityāha -- ucyata iti|| nanu idaṃ vākyamātmanaḥ anātmarūpatāvidhānaparam; ato'puruṣārthatvānna vidheyamiti, netyāha -- na tāvat sarvarūpateti|| pratipannamuddiśya apratipannātmarūpasyaiva vidhānādityarthaḥ| dūṣaṇāntaramāha -- yadi sarvarūpatā ātmana iti|| kiṃ tarhi vidhīyate iti ata āha -- ataḥ sarvasyeti|| "netine"tyādivākyaparyālocanayāpyanātmopamardena ātmaiva vidheya ityāha -- anātmasvarūpavilayeneti|| nanu ātmano'dvitīyatvapratipādanaparamidaṃ vākyam, na tatra jñāne vastuni vā vidhiravagamyate ityāha -- nanu atra vidhirna śrūyata iti|| "pūṣā prapiṣṭabhāgaḥ" ityādāviva kalpyatāmityāha -- kalpyatāṃ tarhīti|| kiṃ pratīte vidhyarthe ityāderayamarthaḥ -- kālatrayānavamṛṣṭe anuṣṭhānayogye karmaṇi śabdasāmarthyāt pratipanne tadanyathānupapattyā ca kartavyarūpe niyoge avagate vidhāyakapadārthe paścādvidhirvidhāyakapadaṃ kalpyate kiṃ vā evaṃvidhārthe'pratipanne ananuṣṭheye vastumātre ca pratipanne vidhipadaṃ kalpyate iti pratīte cet, pramitaye anuvādāya vā padaṃ kalpyate nānuvādena prayojanam| pramitaye cet, tatrāha -- pratīte kalpanāvaiyarthyamiti|| pratipādakatayā liṅādipadakalpanāvaiyarthyamityarthaḥ| ananuṣṭheyavastupratipattau vidhikalpanāhetvabhāvāt na tatra padādanuṣṭheyapratipattirityāha -- athāpratīta iti|| arthavādasaṃsargeṣvapi kalpanāprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu vikalpaduṣaṇayoḥ sarvatra aviśeṣāt na kvacidapi vidhikalpanamiti manvānaścodayati -- nanu aśrūyamāṇeti|| tatra dravyadevatāsambandhaḥ kālatrayānavamṛṣṭaḥ pramīyamāṇaḥ svāvinābhūtaṃ yāgaṃ gamayati, yāgaśca svāvinābhūtaṃ niyogamiti śrutasāmarthyādeva vidhyarthaḥ pratipannaḥ, tatra vyavahāramātrāyā pūṣoddeśena piṣṭadravyatyāgaḥ kartavya ityupasaṃhriyate, na tatheha śrutasāmarthyādvityarthaḥ pratipanna ityāha -- satyam yuktaṃ tatreti|| nanu ihāpi śrutasya ātmanaḥ sāmarthyāt niyogaḥ pratipanna ityāha -- nanvihāpyātmapadamiti|| na; yāganiyogayoḥ niyogapratipattāramantareṇa anupapattivat pratipatturniyogamantareṇa anupapattyabhāvādityāha -- naitat sāram; niyogo hīti|| nanu yaḥ kaścit vede saṃsargaḥ pratipannaḥ, sa sākṣāt paramparayā vā niyogasaṃsṛṣṭa eva; "vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhaḥ" ityādāvapi paramparayā vidhisaṃsargābhyupagamāt, tatra sarvasya ātmasvabhāvatāpyavinābhāvāt vidhimupasthāpayatīti, tatrāha -- athāpi bhavatu nāmeti|| bhāvārthaviṣayatvāt niyogasya nāsau bhūtasaṃsargaviṣaya iti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ tarhi bhāvārtho'pi vidhiviṣaya saṃsargamātreṇa avinābhūtaḥ, iti so'pi kalpyatāmityāha -- dhātunaiva saha kalpyata iti|| sarvadhātvarthadoṣavivakṣayā pṛcchati -- ko'sāviti|| prathamaṃ sarvadhātvarthasāmānyātilaṅghane kāraṇābhāvāt kṛtidhātumusthāpayati -- yadi tāvat kartavyamiti|| tatra dūṣaṇamāha -- tatrānātmanasvabhāvateti|| prapañcavilayanenaiva hyātmadarśanamiti bhāvaḥ| dūṣaṇāntaramāha -- itikartavyatayā cet|| śamādayastu jñānetikartavyam, na prapañcavilayanetikartavyamityarthaḥ| dhātvantaramāha -- atheti|| dūṣayati -- evamapīti|| na hi yoṣidādiṣu agnyādibhāvena jñāyamāneṣu yoṣidādibhāvo nivartate; vidheyabuddheḥ aprāmāṇikatvāditi bhāvaḥ| ubhayathāpi dhātvarthavidhau dūṣaṇāntaramāha -- aśakyārthopadeśaśceti|| nanu yoṣidagnyādiṣu mānasī kriyā, jñānaṃ tu vidhīyamānamanātmānaṃ nivartayatīti, tatrāha -- na hi vastu vastvantarātmaneti|| tarhi puruṣasvarūpapravilayanena sthāṇuniścayapramāṇavat anātmapravilayena ātmano niścāyakaṃ pramāṇajñānamanyataḥ prāptamanūdyavidhimātramadhyāhriyate ityāha -- evaṃ tarhi jñātavya ityādinā|| tarhi vidhivākyārthamitivyatirekeṇa brahmasaṃvedanasya anyataḥ prāptasya anuvādo vaktavyaḥ, na ca pramāṇāntaramastītyāha -- kutaḥ prāpteriti|| nanu vidhāyakapadavyatiriktebhyo vedantābhidhānebhya ityāha -- abhidhānata iti|| tarhi vidhinimittapratipattimanapekṣya abhidhānapramāṇādeva brahmasaṃvedane siddhe na vidhinā kṛtyamityāha -- evaṃ tarhi vidhānamanarthakamiti|| nanu niṣpanne'pi saṃvedane punaḥ tādṛśaṃ vyaktyantaraṃ codyate ityāha -- punaḥ kartavyatayeti|| nanu kiṃ tena kāryam pūrveṇaiva prayojanasiddheriti, tatrāha -- yathā mantreṣviti|| ayamarthaḥ -- mantrāḥ svādhyāyavidhinaiva upāttā gṛhītapadapadārthasambandhasya svārthe pratyayamutpādya vyavasthitāḥ svārthasya ananuṣṭheyatvāt brāhmaṇavākyaiśca pramitatvāt pravṛttinivṛttiprayojanaśūnyā vyavatiṣṭhante| tatra -- "aindryā gārhapatyam" "barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi" "imāmagṛbhṇan raśanāmṛtasyetyaśvābhidhānīmādatte" ityādiśrutiliṅgavākyādibhiḥ vrīhyādivat karmāṅgabhāvena viniyuktāḥ pradhānāpūrvanirvṛttidvāreṇa prayojanavanto mantrā ityucyante| tatra mantrāḥ kena upakāreṇa apūrvasiddherupakurvantīti vīkṣāyāmadhyayanavidherarthajñānārthatvāt dṛṣṭopakāre sati adṛṣṭakalpanānupapatteḥ teṣu anuṣṭhānakāle pratipattyapekṣasya dravyadevatādeḥ pratipattimutpādya taddvāreṇa apūrvasya upakurvantīti kalpyate| tataśca mantrairevānusmṛtyānuṣṭhāne apūrvasiddhiḥ, na brāhmaṇavākyairiti, gamyate| tatra prayogavidhiḥ aṅgairapūrvopakāraṃ kārayan mantrairarthajñānaṃ kārayatīti| tatra yathā prayogavacano mantraiḥ prathamotpannajñānātiriktamapūrvopakāri jñānāntaramanuṣṭhāpayati, evaṃ brahmasaṃvedanamaparamanuṣṭhīyate mokṣaphalāyeti|| nanu yuktaṃ tatra svārthe pratyayamutpādya nivṛttānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ śrutyādiviniyogasāmarthyāt prayogavacanena jñānasya punaḥ kartavyatvam, na ca ātmajñāne prayogavacano'stītyāha -- prayogavacanastatra vidhāyaka iti|| ihāpi tarhi sa sampādyate ityāha pūrvavādī -- ihāpi prayogavacano vidhāyaka iti|| katham "vedāntavākyaiḥ ātmajñānaṃ kuryādi"ti vedāntaśabdakaraṇaviśiṣṭotpattividhistāvadadhyāhṛtaḥ "somena yajeta" itivat| sa ca vidhiḥ kathaṃ jñānaṃ kartavyamiti itikartavyatābhedamīkṣamāṇaḥ prakaraṇapaṭhitaśamādividhīn phalavadātmajñānavidhisannihitānitikartavyatātvena viniyojayan viniyogavidhiḥ sampadyate| punaśca sāṅge karmaṇi niyojyamadhikāriṇaṃ mamedaṃ kartavyamiti pratipattāramākāṅkṣan arthavādagataṃ mokṣaṃ rātrisatranyāyenopasaṃhṛtya mokṣakāmo vedāntavākyakaraṇaiḥ śamādītikartavyatānugṛhītairātmajñānaṃ kuryāditi sa eva viniyogavidhiradhikāravidhiḥ sampadyate| punaḥ sa eva sāṅgaṃ tattvajñānamadhikāriṇamanuṣṭhāpayan prayogavidhiḥ sampadyate iti| punaśca siddhāntī mantrebhyo vedāntānāṃ vailakṣaṇyamāha -- nanu mantreṣviti|| pratyayaparatvamiti| apūrvopakāripratyayamātre mantrāṇāṃ tātparyaṃ, nārthatathātve ityarthaḥ| tatra vedantānāṃ svārthavidhiparatvaṃ prayojanavadajñātārthāvagantṛtvāditi| tatra vidheyapratyayasamarpaṇena vidhiparatvamajñātārthaparatvaṃ cobhayaṃ na viruddhamityāha -- anyārthamapi prakṛtamiti|| nanu sthāyipadārthānāṃ krameṇa vā yugapadvā anekāni kāryāṇi sambhavanti, śabdasya tu tātparyāt sakṛt kāryahetoḥ kathamubhayaparatvam iti tatrāha -- yathā vā padārthānāmiti|| siddhāntī brahmaṇyābhidhānikaprathamapratyayopagamenaiva puruṣārthasiddheḥ na mantreṣviva vidhiśeṣatayā dvitīyapratyayāya utpattiviniyogādhikāraprayogavidhikalpanaṃ apekṣyate iti darśayituṃ mantrebhyo vailakṣaṇyamāha -- tadetadanirūpitamiveti|| vidhiviṣayasamarpaṇena vidhipramitaśeṣasya yoṣidagnyādivākyasya tajjanyajñānasya vā prameyaparatvādarśanāditi vākyaśeṣaḥ| nanu laukikapramāṇagamyatvāt prameyasya tatparatvābhāvaḥ, iha tu vidhibrahmaṇoralaukikatvādubhayaparatvaṃ syāditi, netyāha -- na ca yugapadubhayamiti|| jñānaṃ prati brahmaṇaḥ prameyatayā prādhānyam, vidheyajñānaviśeṣaṇatayā guṇabhāvaḥ, prameyatvādupādeyatā, vidhiṃ patyuddeśyatā, prameyatvādvidheyatā, vidhānāyānuvādyatā cet brahmaṇaḥ svajñānasya vidhiviṣayatayā tatpramitiśeṣatve ca prādhānyopādeyatvaprameyatvāni tadviruddhaguṇatvoddeśyatvānuvādyatvāni ca ekasyāṃ śabdajanyapramitau prasajyante| tadidaṃ vairūpyam|| nanu prathamajñānamarthaparaṃ dvitīyajñānaṃ vidhiviṣayatayā tatparamityavirodhaḥ kiṃ na syāt na;śabdasya ubhayaparatvābhāve tajjanyajñānasya asakṛjjanitasyāpi ubhayaparatvānupapatteḥ|| nanu vairūpyaprasaṅgo na doṣamāvahati, anyathā guṇakarmavidhānānupapatteriti codayati -- nanvevaṃ sati guṇakarmaṇāmiti|| kratvaṅgabhūtakārakasaṃskārārthāni karmāṇi guṇakarmāṇi| tatra kriyājanyātiśayaviśiṣṭameva karmakārakaṃ kārakavibhaktyabhidheyamityaṅgīkṛtya vairūpyamucyate| vrīhīṇāṃ tāvat pramāṇāntarasiddhatvāt kārakatvācca anuvādyatvaguṇatvoddeśyatvāni siddhāni| vidheyaprokṣaṇajanyātiśayavattayā sādhyatvāt upādeyatvaprādhānyavidheyatvāni vibhaktisāmarthyāt pratīyante ityekasyāṃ pramitau guṇakarmasu vairūpyamiti|| tatra na kriyājanyātiśayo vaibhaktikaḥ, kintu tadarthakriyāvidhyanupapattigamyaḥ; ataḥ śābdajñāne guṇatvoddeśyatvānuvādyatvānyeva pratīyante, prādhānyaprameyatvopādeyatvāni tvārthāpattipramityantare'vabhāsante, iti jñānabhedānna vairūpyadoṣa iti paraharati -- na nirākṛtaṃ syāditi|| ihāpi tarhi brahmajñānavidheyajñānayorbhedādviruddhatrikasya vyavasthayā avabhāsa iti, netyāha -- yatra punaḥ pramāṇāntarāditi|| nanu ihāpi jñānadvayameveṣyatām, kastarhi sāmagrībhedaḥ na caikasāmagrījanyajñānasahasrasyāpi prameyabhedaḥ sambhavati| astu tarhi vidhāyakapadavyatiriktapadasamudāyasya pṛthageva brahmasvarūpaṃ pratipādya punastadanuvādajñānaṃ janayitvā tasya vidhiviṣayatvasamarpaṇena punarvidhāyakapadena padaikavākyateti, netyāha -- na ca sa eva samanvaya iti|| nanu tarhi vidhipadena yāni padaikavākyabhūtāni, tadvyatiriktapadānāṃ pṛthaganvayena brahmapratipattiśeṣatetyāśaṅkate -- atha arthavādapadānīti|| nanu ihāpi bhūtārthatvāt arthavādajanyajñānavadvidhiśeṣateti, netyāha -- iha punaraparāmṛṣṭeti|| prayojanaparyantatvāya vidhiśeṣatā, na bhūtatvanimitteti bhāvaḥ| yadyapi śābdajñānāt agrahaṇaṃ nivartate; tathāpi mithyājñānattatsaṃskārāvidyānivṛttiraparokṣānubhavāt, tasya ca śābdajñānāt anutpadyamānaphalasya siddhaye jñānaṃ vidhīyate ityāśaṅkate -- atha punaḥ śābdajñānāditi|| tarhi vidhīyamānajñānasya vrīhyādivat karaṇakārakaṃ vaktavyam, tanna sambhavatītyāha -- kiṃ tajjñānamiti|| nanu pratyakṣādīnāmaparokṣajñānasādhanatvaṃ prasiddhamiti, na; pūrvajñānavadatatphalatvaprasaṅgādityāha -- śābdaṃ ceti|| nanu vidhīyamānaṃ śābdaṃ jñānamiti, kiṃ tajjñānaṃ vidhīyamānatayā parokṣaphalam prāthamikajñānam tatsantāno vā na tāvat prāthamikamityāha -- tadayuktaṃ yattāvaditi|| ubhayaparatve vairūpyasya darśitatvāditi| vākyaśeṣaḥ| nanu prathamajñānena avagate brahmaṇi taduddeśena pratyayasantāno vidhīyatām, tatsaṃskārapracayādaparokṣasiddheḥ iti śaṅkate -- atha punastadeva jñānamiti|| kimupāsanavidhisāmarthyādidamavagatam kiṃ vā "ātmanyevātmānaṃ paśyet" iti darśanavidhānasāmarthyāt iti na tāvadupāsane vidhiḥ śrūyate; "ātmetyevopāsīta" "ātmānameva lokamupāsīta" "tameva dhīro vijñāya" ityādeḥ svabhāvasiddhapratyayopādānena alaukikātmaviṣayapratipādanaparatvāt, evakāraviśeṣaṇaśravaṇāt vākyasya viśeṣaṇaparatvāt, ubhayapratipādane vākyabhedāt, "nididhyāsitavyaḥ" iti ca ātmapratipādanapare vākyabhedābhāvāya stutiparatvāt| atha darśanavidhisāmarthyāditi, netyāha -- tat kathaṃ labhyate upāstidhyāyatyoriti|| nanu jñānasya sarvatra pravāheṇa avinābhāvāt jñānavidhānena santānavidhiḥ lakṣyate iti, netyāha -- nāpi jñānenaiveti|| athāpi kathañcidupāsanavidhānaṃ kalpyeta nididhyāsanavidheḥ; tathāpyaparokṣaphalasya ahetutvāt upāsanasya na śābdajñānādviśeṣa ityāha -- nāpyabhyāsāditi|| abhyāsasya apramāṇatvāt viṣayasya asamprayuktatvācca na vastvāparokṣyamabhyāsāt, kiṃtu mithyā''parokṣyamityarthaḥ|| nanu "tatastu taṃ paśyate niṣkalaṃ dhyāyamānaḥ" iti dhyānamaparokṣaphalaṃ śrūyate satyam; ekatra cittasya samavadhānatā tadaikāgryanimittaṃ bhavati, tadekāgracetasā sahakāriṇā śabda eva -- "aupaniṣadami"ti taddhitapratyayasāmarthyāt aparokṣajñānamutpādayati; dhyāyamāno jñānaprasādena paśyatīti vākyasya anvayāt, cittaikāgryasya sūkṣmavastudarśananimittatvāt, dṛṣṭenaiva upakārasiddhāvadṛṣṭakalpanāyogāt, aparokṣakāmasya upāsanāyāṃ svayaṃpravṛtteḥ, dṛṣṭārthatvācca nididhyāsanavidhānasya ityuktam, tadetadāha -- nāpi śrūyata iti|| dṛṣṭasāmarthyānuvādatvāt vākyasya vidhirna śrūyate ityarthaḥ| nanu aikāgryadvāreṇa āparokṣyanimittatvād dṛṣṭadvāreṇāpi pravartatāmiti codayati -- nanu kimatra śravaṇeneti|| parihāragranthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| ato jñānadvayābhāvāt ekasya jñānasya ubhayārthatā'yogāt na brahmajñānaṃ vidheyamiti bhāvaḥ|| yatpunariti spaṣṭārthaḥ| na sthāyivastudṛṣṭāntena tātparyasāpekṣaśabdavyāpāranirṇaya ityāha -- yuktaṃ tatreti|| nanu "samidho yajati" "tanūnapātaṃ yajati" "iḍo yajati" "barhiryajati" "svāhākāraṃ yajati" iti pañca vākyāni pañca padārthān vidhāya teṣāṃ kramamapi vidadhāti| ataḥ śabdasyaiva dvaiyarthyamityuktamanuvadati -- yadapīdamuktamiti|| padārthā eva śabdagamyāḥ, kramastvarthāpattigamyo na śabdagamya iti pariharati -- yattāvat pratyekamiti|| ye tāvadityarthaḥ| teṣāmeva| na kramasya vidhānamityadhyāhāraḥ| kiṃ padārthebhyo'rthāntarabhūtasya kramasya vākyaiḥ pratipādanamucyate kiṃ vā kiṃ vā padārthamātrasyaiva kramasya pratipādanamiti na tāvat uttaraḥ kalpa ityāha -- nāpi te kramaśabdābhidheyā iti|| nanu vihitamaṅgaṃ bhavati, aṅgaṃ ca prayuṅkte prayogavidhiḥ; ataḥ prayogavacanaprayojyatvena kramasyāpi vidheyatve vākyebhya eva apadārthasyāpi kramasya vidhireṣṭavya iti, netyāha -- prayogavacano'pīti|| vihitasyaiva prayojyatvāt padārthānāmeva vihitatvādityarthaḥ| anyathā vihite prayogavidhiḥ, prayogavidhau na vidhikalpanā itītaretarāśrayāt| nanu padārthā eva kramaḥ, tasmāt padārthān prayuñjānaḥ kramamapi prayuṅkte iti, netyāha -- na te krama ityuktamiti|| apara āha -- na kramo nāma kaścidasti, ekaikasmin padārthe'darśanāt, anekapadārthāśrayatve padārthayaugapadyāt kramāyogāt, ayaugapadye ca ubhayāśrayadharmāyogāditi ; tatrāha -- na ca kramo nāmeti|| nanu saṃyogavat ubhayāśrayatve padārthayaugapadyamityuktam, tatrāha -- tatra kramo nāma vastubhūta iti|| kramatvādeva na yaugapadyāpekṣeti bhāvaḥ| nanu deśakālavastūpādhiparāmarśamantareṇa kramo na dṛśyate iti, tadāha -- ta eveti|| nanu anuṣṭheyapadārthānāmaniṣpannasvabhāvatvāt na deśakālavastukrama iti, tatrāha -- smṛtivijñānameveti|| pāṭhakrama eva smaryamāṇo'nuṣṭheyapadārtheṣūparajyate ityarthaḥ| sarvathe ityupasaṃhāraḥ| nanu kramasya vidhāyakaṃ vaktavyam, na;kramasya avidheyatvāt, kiṃtu anuṣṭheyaviśeṣaṇatayā pramīyate kramaḥ, na vidhīyate ; ananuṣṭheyatvāt| kena tarhi pramīyate ekasyānekapadārthaprayogānupapattyetyāha -- taccaikattvāt karturiti|| sannihitaṃ ceti|| arthakramābhāve pāṭhakrama ityarthaḥ| tasmāt sarvatra pramāṇadvayenaiva prameyadvayasiddhiriti prakaraṇārthaḥ| na tatheha jñānadvayaṃ ityārabhya vedo'vagamayati itiparyantaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| prativastusaṃprayogaṃ nirapekṣameva pramāṇaṃ cakṣuḥ, na tathā pratipadārthaṃ pramāṇaṃ śabdaḥ, kintu yatra tātparyaṃ, tatra sambhūyaiva pramāṇamityāha -- yuktaṃ tatra yadyadavabodhayatīti|| nanvābhidhānikamātmatattvajñānaṃ prameyaparameva mā bhūt, kintu vidhiviṣayatayā vidhāyakapadajanyavidhipramitiviṣayatvena vidhiśeṣa ityāha -- mā bhūditi|| kathaṃ tarhi brahmātmasiddhiriti tatrāha -- tasmin vihite'rthāditi|| nanu kasyānupapattyā tattvasiddhiriti tadāha -- saviṣayatvāditi|| avagamasidhyanyathānupapatyaivetyarthaḥ| pariharati -- evamapyavivakṣito'rtha iti|| ekasminviṣaye prathamapratipattirapramāṇaṃ, tasminneva dvitīyajñānaṃ pramāṇamiti-śrutiśca na pramāṇaṃ śrutyarthāpattiśca pramāṇamityādi viruddhamityarthaḥ| kiñcāvagamavidhānānupapattirnāvagamyasya vastutvaṃ gamayatītyāha -- naca niyogata iti nanu jñānasya svataḥpramāṇyāt tathābhūtārthataiva yuktā; anyathā āropitajñānasya vidhau prayojanābhāvāditi, tatrāha -- bhavanti hi parikalpitaviṣayā iti|| ābhidhānikapratyayasya vidhisaṃsargāt prāgapi svataḥprāmāṇyaṃ kiṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu vidheyajñānasyāpi svaviṣayapramitireva dṛṣṭaṃ phalam, tat parityajya āropitaviṣayatve adṛṣṭakalpanā syāditi, tatrāha -- etadevātra yuktimiti||
