sakalapramāṇavirodhena dṛṣṭakalpanādadṛṣṭakalpanameva yuktamityarthaḥ| "tasmāt kāryaniṣṭhe vede" iti anārambhavādī siddhāntyekadeśīyadūṣaṇamupasaṃharati|| nanu vedāntānāṃ dharmabrahmaviṣayatvābhāve adhyayanavidhyupāttānāmānarthakyaṃ syāditi, netyāha -- evaṃ ca satyayamātmā brahmetyādinā|| tatra ātmano vedāntasaṅkīrtitasamastaguṇaviśiṣṭasyopāsanotpattividhau śamādītikartavyopasaṃhāreṇa viniyogavidhau mokṣakāmaniyojyasambandhitayā cādhikāravidhau sāṅge karmaṇyadhikāriṇo'nuṣṭhāpakatayā ca prayogavidhau vedāntāḥ paryavasyanti; tacca sarvaṃ nirūpitamiti| atra kiṃ śabdānāṃ kāryānvitasvārthāvabodhasāmarthyāt sarvo vedaḥ kāryaparatayā nirūpita ityucyate kiṃ vā sūtrakārādyabhiyuktavacanasāmarthyāditi na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ; samanvayasūtre tasya nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt| abhiyuktavacanasāmarthyācceti, tatrāha -- syādetadevaṃ yadi sarva eva vedārtha iti|| nanu dharmasyaivopakrāntatve'pi prāsaṅgikatvenedaṃ brahma nirūpitamiti, netyāha -- vicāritaśceti|| kathamavagamyate ca vedārthopādho vicāraḥ pravṛtta iti sūtrabhāṣyavārtikakāravacanasāmarthyādityāha -- yāvatā kāryaniṣṭha eveti|| atrāyamāśayaḥ -- athāto dharmajijñāsā| dharmamīmāṃsāśāstra viṣayaḥ| tat kimārambhaṇīyaṃ na veti vicāraḥ| nārambhaṇīyamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ; vicāryamāṇārthanirṇaye pratyakṣādīnāmasādhanatvāt āmnāyasya cādhyayanavidhānā adṛṣṭārthatayā viniyogāt| tadarthamadhyayanavidhiḥ adṛṣṭārtho dṛṣṭārtho veti vicāryate| dṛṣṭasādhane vidherayogādadṛṣṭaniyamādvidheradṛṣṭārtha iti prāptam| nanu svādhyāyaḥ adhyayanakriyākarmatayā avagamyamānaḥ saṃskāryo vā, āpyo veti, dṛṣṭasambhave kathamadṛṣṭārthatā sambhavet na; saṃskṛtasya kratvantare viniyojakapramāṇābhāvāt| avāptasya ca niṣphalatvāt| nanu avāptādāmnāyāt phalavadarthāvabodhe dṛṣṭaphale nādṛṣṭaṃ kalpayituṃ śakyate, na;dṛṣṭaphalasādhane anyata eva pravṛtteḥ vidhivaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt| nanu karmakārakapradhānasyādhyayanasya kathaṃ svatantrādṛṣṭaphalatvaṃ kalpyate na;karmakārakasya vaiphalyāt saktunyāyena "svādhyāyenādhīyīte"ti vaiparītyakalpanāt| nanu na śrūyate phalamadhyayanasyārthavāde'pi, tanna; japādhyayanaphalasya ghṛtakulyāderadhyayanatvasāmānyena prathamādhyayane'pyatidiśya rātrisatranyāyena "ghṛtakulyādikāmaḥ svādhyāyenādhīyīte"ti phalavipariṇāmāt| saṃskārakarmatvābhāvācca na phalaśruterarthavādatā| nanvadṛṣṭārthatve'pi svābhāvikasyārthāvabodhasāmarthyasya kā hāniḥ na;viṣanirharaṇādikāryāntare viniyuktānāṃ mantrāṇāmarthavivakṣāpratibandhadarśanāt| tasmādāmnāyasyārthavivakṣā'bhāvāt pratyakṣādyaviṣayatvāt, pramāṇānugrāhakatvācca vicārasya nirālambano dharmavicāro nārabdhavya iti prāptam|| ārambhaṇīya evāyaṃ vicāra iti siddhāntaḥ; tasya svādhyāyādhyayanavidhipramitakartavyatvāt|| nanu nirālambanatvamuktam, na; āmnāyasya ālambanatvāt| nanu adṛṣṭārtho'sau darśitaḥ, na; adhyayanasya karmakārakapradhānatvāt svatantrādṛṣṭārthatvāyogāt| nanu karmakārake na kiñcit prayojanamasti ityuktam, na; ubhayasyāpyupapatteḥ -- adhyayanena dṛṣṭadvāreṇa āpyate, sāṅgādhyayanavidhisāmarthyāt saṃskriyate ca svādhyāya iti| nanu saṃskṛtasya viniyogābhāva uktaḥ, na; kratuvidhyupādānapramāṇādeva viniyogasiddheḥ| kratuvidhirhi svaviṣayāvabodhamākāṅkṣamāṇaḥ tasya janakatayā saṃskṛtaṃ svādhyāyamupādatte| nanu upādānapramāṇaṃ jñānasya janakatayā svādhyāyamātramādatte, na saṃskāramiti, satyam; adhyayanavidhisāmarthyādeva saṃskṛtasvādhyāyajanyaviśiṣṭajñānavataiva anuṣṭhito yāgo'pūrvaṃ janayatīti kalpyate| ataḥ vidhisāmarthyamīkṣamāṇaḥ kratuvidhiḥ svaviṣayajñānajanakatayā saṃskṛtaṃ svādhyāyamupādatte| nanu svatantrādṛṣṭaṃ kalpyatāmityuktam, na; dṛṣṭārthākṣarasvīkaraṇatajjanyajñānādisamavāyyadṛṣṭasampattau śrutavirodhena kārakavaiparītyamādāya svatantrādṛṣṭakalpanānupapatteḥ| ādhānavadanaṅgasyāpyadhyayanasya kratūpakāritvaṃ na virudhyate| nanu tavyapratyayena prakṛtyarthoparaktamapūrvameva svatantramabhidhīyate, tanna; apūrvābhidhāne'pi bhinnapadopāttaprakṛtyarthoparaktāpūrvābhidhānāt varamekapadopāttakarmakārakagatāpūrvābhidhānam| bhāvārthajanyamapūrvaṃ na dravyādijanyamityetāvat, samavāyastu yatra kvāpi sambhavati| adṛṣṭārthatayā ca svādhyāyasya arthavivakṣā'bhāve adhyayanavidhivākyasyāpyarthavivakṣā'bhāvāt adṛṣṭārthatayā adhyayanavidhānameva na syāt| tasmāt sāṅgādhyayanavidhiprayuktādṛṣṭasya svasamavāyitayā akṣaragrahaṇārthāvabodhakratupravṛttyādidṛṣṭaphalasāpekṣatvāt svādhyāyasya svabhāvanimittārthāvabodhapratibandhakatā'bhāvāt vivakṣitārthamāmnāyamavalambya dharmavicāraḥ kartavya iti| tadevamarthavivakṣādharmavicārāvasarapradarśanapare śāstrārambhe na sarvavedārthavicārasiddhiriti, prārabhyamāṇavicāro dharmaviṣayo na vedārthamātraviṣaya ityupapādayati -- tathā hi śāstrārambha iti|| nanu "vedavākyāni vicārayet" ityādibhāṣyaliṅgāt vedārthamātravicārārambho'vagamyate iti śaṅkate -- kathamiti|| sāmānyaprasiddhiviśeṣavipratipattyoḥ bhāṣyakāreṇa dharme pradarśitatvāt sa eva vicāryate ityāha -- dharmo nāma kaścit sādhayituriti|| evaṃ viṣayavipratipattī darśayitvā dharmaviṣaya eva pūrvapakṣaprāptiṃ darśayatītyāha -- tatrāgnihotrādilakṣaṇa eveti|| nakārastu pūrvaparayoḥ sambadhyate| "evamāśaṅkite" ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| evamāśaṅkite śāstrārambhe siddhāntasūtraṃ tatpratipādyārthakathanena avatārayati -- dharmāya vedavākyānīti|| yasya āmnāyasya arthavivakṣā, tasyaiva vicārāvasaraśceti tadarthavivakṣāvicārāvasarau| vivakṣāvicārāvasaradharmavicārān sūtrārthān sūtrayojanayā darśayati -- vedamadhītyānantaramiti|| tataḥ kimāyātam ityata āha -- evaṃ sthita iti|| kiṃ tatra vivakṣitaṃ gamyate iti tatrāha -- kiṃ tu dharmātirikta iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- vedasya arthavivakṣāpradarśanena vedārthavicāraḥ kartavya iti vaktavye dharmagrahaṇaṃ kurvan mā bhūt sarvavedārthavicārapratijñā, kiṃtvekadeśavicāro'yamiti manyate sūtrakāra iti gamyate|| nanu "athātaḥ"śabdānāṃ svādhyāyasya pūrvanirvṛttatayā vicārahetutvamucyate| svādhyāyo hi svārthavicāraheturbhavati, na dharmavicārahetuḥ; ataḥ athātaḥśabdavirodhāt na dharmavicāraḥ pratijñātuṃ śakyata iti codayati -- tat katham yattāvadidamiti|| sāmānyaviśeṣābhyāṃ vicāryamāṇapradhānābhidhāyidharmapadagrahaṇasāmarthyāt, tasyaiva vipratipattyā puruṣārthasādhanatayā ca jijñāsitatvāt, prāmāṇyapratipādanāt prāk vedārthe sāmānyapratipattiviśeṣavipratipattipuruṣārthasādhanatvādīnāṃ anavagamāt, jijñāsitatvāyogāt dharma eva vicāryata ityāha -- ucyate dharmo nāmetyādinā|| tatra dharme jijñāsāyogyatvapradarśanena vedārthe tadabhāvaṃ vivakṣati -- lokapravādāditi|| nanu dharmavicāre svādhyāyasya pūrvanirvṛttatayā hetutvam, arthavivakṣāyāḥ pradarśanaṃ ca anupayogi ityuktam| satyam; agnihotrāderapi dharmaskandhatvāt devagatyā ca dharmatvādupayoga ityāha -- agnihotrādirapi vedārtha iti|| yata iti|| vipratipattiskandhatvādityarthaḥ| tena vivakṣito'sau svādhyāya iti pradarśanīyamityarthaḥ| nanu puruṣārthatvācceddharmavicāraḥ, adhyayanenaiva tatsiddheḥ kiṃ dharmavicāreṇa iti netyāha -- na ca adhyayanamātrāditi|| ato na -- "athātaḥ"śabdavirodha ityāha -- ato'dhyayanānantaramiti|| kiṃ ca dharmaśabdasya pradhānatvāt athātaśśabdavirodhe'pi dharmavicāra eva yukta ityāha -- iti vadituṃ dharmagrahaṇaṃ yuktamiti|| puruṣā hi dharmameva jijñāsante na vedārtham; tasyāpi dharmatvaprayuktatvāt upādānasya ityāha -- yato na vedārtheti|| sāmānyagrahaṇaviśeṣavipratipattipuruṣārthasādhanatvadharmaśabdagrahaṇaiḥ dharmavicāraparaṃ prathamasūtramityuktam, dvitīyamapi sūtraṃ tathaivetyāha -- yat punaḥ dharmasyeti|| dharmalakṣaṇaparaṃ sūtraṃ, arthāt pramāṇapratijñeti prābhākarāḥ| mukhataḥ pramāṇapratijñā, arthāt dharmalakṣaṇatvamiti vārtikakārīyāḥ| sarvathāpyubhayaṃ vivakṣitamiti| tatra vedagrahaṇe prāpte sarvo vedo dharmaviṣayo mā bhūditi codanāmagrahīt iti gamyata ityāha -- tannūnamiti|| nanu codanāgrahaṇaṃ sarvavedasya dharme prāmāṇyaparihārāya na bhavati, kiṃ tvanyadeva prayojanamityāha -- nanu codanāgrahaṇasyeti|| ayamarthaḥ -- liṅādiśabdavyāpāraḥ puruṣapravṛttilakṣaṇārthabhāvanālakṣaṇabhāvyaniṣṭhaḥ svajñānakaraṇakaḥ stutinindārthavādādijñānetikartavyatāko liṅādiśabdena ākhyātatvasāmānyādarśabhāvanābhidhāyinā'pi liṅviśeṣeṇa abhidhīyamānaḥ śabdabhāvaneti kathyate| śabda eva vā pradarśitāṃśatrayaviśiṣṭaḥ śabdabhāvanā, śabdaguṇo vā| sarvatra hi karaṇamitikartavyatānugṛhītaṃ bhāvyanirvṛttidvāreṇaiva bhāvanāṃ prati karaṇaṃ bhavati| tatra śabdabhāvanāviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ liṅādiśabdajanyaṃ pravartakajñānatvāt stutyādijñānānugṛhītaṃ puruṣapravṛttinivṛttiheturiti, bhāvyanirvṛttidvāreṇa śabdabhāvanāṃ prati karaṇamucyate| sā ca śabdabhāvanā puruṣapravṛttimutpādayantī tasyāḥ puruṣārthaviṣayatvamantareṇa notpādayituṃ kṣamate ; apuruṣārthe puruṣasya apravṛtteḥ| tataḥ codanāprayuktapuruṣapravṛtteḥ samānapadopāttamapuruṣārthaṃ dhātvarthaṃ bhāvyaṃ vihāya puruṣaviśeṣaṇamapi svargādikaṃ bhāvyatvenopādāya dhātvarthakaraṇikā prayājādītikartavyatākā svargādibhāvyaniṣṭhā puruṣapravṛttirarthabhāvanā sampadyate| tat evaṃvidhārthabhāvanāniṣpattaye śabdabhāvanāyāḥ pravartakatvadyotanāya codanāgrahaṇamiti|| netat sāram; adhyayanavidhiḥ ityādiḥ parihāraḥ| tasyāyamarthaḥ -- "svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ" iti tavyapratyayavyāpāraḥ śabdabhāvanā adhyayane puruṣapravṛttilakṣaṇārthabhāvanābhāvyaniṣṭhā svaviṣayapravartakajñānakaraṇikā adhyayanaphalārthavādādivijñānetikartavyatākā bhavati| sā ca puruṣapravṛttilakṣaṇāmarthabhāvanāmadhyayanakaraṇikāṃ svādhyāyabhāvyaniṣṭhāṃ prāṅmukhatvādītikartavyatākāmutpādayati| sā ca bhāvyasya svādhyāyasya phalavadvijñānajanananimittatvamantareṇa arthabhāvanāmutpādayitumasamarthā svādhyāyagataliṅādiśabdābhidheyakratubhāvanānāṃ svargādiviṣayatvaṃ paramparayā kalpayati ityadhyayanavidhisāmarthyādeva vedasya viśiṣṭaphalaviṣayabhāvanānāṃ pratipādakatvaṃ siddham| ato vedagrahaṇenaiva bhāvanānāṃ dhātvarthaṃ vihāya svargādyālambanakatvaṃ sidhyatīti|| api ca codanāgrahaṇe vedāntānāmarthāntaraparatvāśaṅkā syāt, tannivṛttaye vedagrahaṇameva yuktamityāha -- api ca vedagrahaṇameveti|| saṃdehāntaramāha -- codanāgrahaṇe hīti|| nanu vedādhyayanānantaraṃ dharmavicāraṃ pratijñāya codanālakṣaṇa iti bruvan vaidikacodanāmeva bravīti, na; tatra viśeṣābhāvāt| anena ca sūtreṇa tatrāpi sarvacodanānantaryaṃ kiṃ na syāt prakārāntareṇa vaidikacodanāniyamamāha -- atha vedādhikaraṇe iti|| lakṣaṇasūtre prāptaṃ vedagrahaṇaṃ vihāya anyatra kurvan na buddhipūrvakārī syāditi pariharati -- so'yamābhāṇaka iti|| ato vedāntānāṃ dharmaparatvaparyudāsāya codanāgrahaṇamityāha -- ataścodanāgrahaṇāditi|| tasmāt sūtrabhāṣyavārtikakārābhiprāyeṇa brahmaparatvameva, na dharmaparatvamityāha -- tadevaṃ sūtrakāra iti|| nanu teṣāmeva kṛtsnasya vedasya dharme viniyojakaṃ vacanamastītyāha -- nanu dṛṣṭo hi tasyārtha iti|| satyam; dharmacodanāsūtraprakramasāmarthyāduttaraṃ sāmānyavacanaṃ prakṛtaviśeṣe upasaṃhriyate ityāha -- satyam; tatprakramabalāditi|| sāmānyena parihāramabhidhāya pratyekamāha -- api ca dṛṣṭo hīti|| nanu āmnāyaśabdena sakalavedasya dharmāvabodhe viniyogaḥ spaṣṭa iti codayati -- kathamiti|| na viniyogakātrsnyaparaṃ bhāṣyam, kiṃ tu āmnāyasyārthasadbhāvaparam; yathā "rūpaṃ pratyakṣami"tyukte na sarvapratyakṣasya rūpe viniyogaḥ, kiṃ tu rūpasya pratyakṣānvayamātraṃ kathyate, tadvat iti pariharati -- vedādhyayanānantaramityādinā|| ayogavyavaccheda iti|| vedasya karmāvabodhenāsaṃbanghaṃ nirākṛtya sambandhaḥ pratipādyata iti| nānyayogavyavaccheda iti|| vedasya arthāntarasambandho nāstīti nābhidhīyata ityarthaḥ| nanu karmaśabdaḥ prameyamātraparatayā dharmabrahmaṇoraviśiṣṭaḥ kiṃ na syāt iti netyāha -- karmaśabdena ceti|| kriyāyāṃ viṣayamātre ca prasiddhasya śabdasya kutaḥ kriyāparatvam iti prakaraṇādityāha -- yatastadavabodheti|| tasmāt ityupasaṃhāraḥ|| yat punaḥ ityuktānuvādaḥ| ānarthakyaśabdena abhidheyābhāvaḥ prayojanābhāvo vābhidhīyate na tāvadabhidheyābhāva ityāha -- tatra yadyānarthakyamarthābhāva ityādinā|| atheti niṣprayojanatvamanūdya dūṣaṇamāha -- bhavatu so'rodīditi|| nanu teṣāmapi "pūṣā prapiṣṭabhāgaḥ" ityādisaṃsargeṣviva prayojanaṃ kalpyatāmiti, netyāha -- ekavākyatvāditi|| nanu "adhastāt samidhaṃ dhārayannanudravedupari hi devebhyaḥ" ityuparidhāraṇasya pūrveṇa ekavākyasya vidhānavat saprayojano vidhiḥ kalpyatāmiti, netyāha -- kalpayituṃ cāśakyatvāditi|| vedāntavākyānyapi tarhi prayojanaśūnyatayā kriyārthānīti, netyāha -- yāni punarapāstāśeṣāśivamiti|| ataḥ sūtraṃ kriyāprakaraṇapaṭhitavākyaviṣayamityāha -- ataḥ svayamapuruṣārthatvāditi|| kriyāprakaraṇapaṭhitānāmeva prayojanaśūnyānāṃ stāvakatvena kriyānvayo darśitaḥ, na vedāntānāmityatra liṅgamāha -- tathā ca tadvidhānyeveti|| na vedāntavākyaṃ kiṃcidapyarthavādādhikaraṇe kriyāśeṣatvenodāhṛtamastītyarthaḥ|| yadapi keciditi prābhākarāṇāṃ śāstrārambhaprakāraṃ darśayati| ayamāśayaḥ -- adhyayanavidhirhi vicāraṃ vidadhāti| sa ca svādhyāyasya phalaparyantatāmākāṅkṣan vedārthavicārameva vidadhyāt, na dharmavicāramiti| nanu sāmānyapratipattiviśeṣavipratipattibhyāṃ jijñāsito'rtho vicāramarhati, na tathā vedārtha iti, tatrāha -- kiṃ tarhi adhītavedasyeti|| "udbhidā yajeta paśukāmaḥ" ityatra paśukāma ityatra paśukāmamuddiśya yāgo vidhīyate yāgavidhānaṃ voddiśya paśukāmādhikāraḥ kiṃ vā ubhayam iti tathā satre yajamānā evartvijaḥ, iti yajamānānuddiśya ṛtvigbhāvo vidhīyate kiṃ vā ṛtvija uddiśya yajamānabhāvo vidhīyate ityādivacanavyaktisaṃśayādvicāra iti|| "athāto dharmajijñāsā|" vedārthavicāro viṣayaḥ| sa kartavyo vā na veti vicāraḥ| neti tāvat prāptam; ālambanapramāṇābhāvāt| nanu āmnāyālambano vicāraḥ syāt, na; adhyāpanavidhiśeṣatayā āmnāyasya svārthavivakṣā'bhāvāt| katham adhyayanaṃ tāvat adhāyapanavidhiprayuktānuṣṭhānatvāt taccheṣatāmaśnute| svādhyāyo'pyadhyayananirvṛttidvāreṇa adhyāpananirvṛttiparo viṣanirharaṇādivākyavat na svārthavivakṣāmarhatīti kecit|| anye tu svādhyāyavidhivākye tavyapratyayena apūrvasya pratipādanāt tadaṅgatā tāvat svādhyāyasyādhigatā| tatra vihitāpyayanasya prayojakatvāt adhyāpanavidheḥ prathamāvagatāmapūrvāṅgatāmanapākṛtyaiva adhyayanena adhyāpanaṃ nirvartyate iti|| tataśca apūrvāṅgatvādavivakṣitārthatvādvicārānārambhaḥ prāptaḥ|| tatra ārambhaṇīyo vicāraḥ; svādhyāyasya vivakṣitārthatvāt| nanu adhyāpanavidhiśeṣaḥ svādhyāya ityuktam, na; prayuktimātreṇa aṅgatvānupapatteḥ| na hyādhānamuttarakratuprayuktimātrāt tadaṅgaṃ bhavati| nanu liṅgasaṃkhyāprayājādayaḥ kratuvidhiprayuktānuṣṭhānāḥ tadaṅgatāmaśnuvate, na; prakaraṇādiviniyogapramāṇasāmarthyādaṅgabhāvaḥ, tadaṅgatvācca tatprayuktānuṣṭheyatā| na tatheha viniyoge pramāṇamasti| na ca prayuktimātrādaṅgateti viśeṣaḥ| ataḥ svātantryāt vivakṣitārthaḥ svādhyāya iti| yattu adhyayanāpūrvāṅgateti, tatrāpi apūrvasya prayojanākāṅkṣāyāṃ, dṛṣṭe satyadṛṣṭakalpanānupapatteḥ svādhyāyasāmarthyajanyaṃ prayojanavadvijñānaṃ phalatvena kalpyate| nanu na naiyogikaṃ tat, kiṃ tu dṛṣṭasāmarthyajanyaṃ phalavijñānam, satyam; anaiyogikaphalasyaiva vijñānasya anuṣṭhānāṅgatayā apūrvopakāraḥ kalpyate; atha vā arthe tātparyaṃ vijñānasya naiyogikaphalatvādhīnamiti kalpyate| laukikatātparyanimittavivakṣādyabhāvāt| tadevaṃ vivakṣitārthatvād śāstramārambhaṇīyamiti|| tatra vedārthavicārārambhe'pi na vedāntānāṃ gatārthatvamiti pariharati -- tatrāpi na nikhilavedārtheti|| vedārthopādhivicāre'pi dharmagrahaṇasāmarthyāt tadekadeśo vicārita iti bhāvaḥ| nanu kṛtsnādhyayanavidhiprayukto vicāraḥ kathamekadeśaviṣayaḥ syāt iti codayati -- tatkathamiti|| pariharati -- tathā satyathāta iti|| prativākyādhyayanavicāraṃ vidhivyāpārabhedāt prayojanabhedavaśāt ekadeśavicāre'pi na vidhiprayojyatvavirodhaḥ; yathā cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ paśyediti vidhiprayuktyā rūpaikadeśanīladarśane'pi tatprayuktiḥ na virudhyate tadvadityarthaḥ| anyathā vidhyanusāreṇa kṛtsnavedārthavicāravivakṣāyāṃ dharmagrahaṇaṃ na syādityāha -- yato dharma iti kṛtveti|| dharmagrahaṇasya ca vedārthaikadeśavicāraparyudāsaḥ prayojanaṃ, kiṃ tu vedārthasya puruṣārthatāsiddhiḥ prayojanamiti śaṅkate -- satyam; tathāpi śāstrakārāṇāmiti|| pariharati -- evaṃ tarhīti|| dharmaśabdasya hi vedārthe prayoganimittaṃ vaktavyam, na tāvadrūḍhiḥ; caityavandanādāvapi prayogavipratipatteḥ| atha anvayavyatirekasiddhaḥśreyassādhanābhidhāyīdharmaśabdaḥ, tathābhūtatvāt vedārthasyāpi dharmaśabdaḥ tatra pravartata iti, evaṃ tarhi svādhyāyapāṭhādeva brahmaṇaḥ pratīyamānasya dharmaśabdābhidheyatvābhāvāt śreyorūpatvāt tasya arthāt paryudastatvāt dharma ityevaṃ kṛtvā vicāro yuktaḥ; anyathā āpātapratipannadharmabrahmasaṃgrahajñāpanāya vedārthajijñāseti vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ| na hi anuṣṭheyaśreyorūpamiti brahma padānvayamātrādeva vicārāt prāk na pratīyate iti śakyaṃ vaktum| lakṣaṇasūtramapi dharmaviṣayaṃ na vedārthaviṣayamityāha -- tathā cottaramapīti|| lakṣaṇaṃ hi lakṣyasya anyaprasaṅgavibhramanirāsaparam| tatra ca dharma eva caityavandanādau prasaktatayā vipratipannaḥ, na vedārthaḥ| ato lakṣaṇasya kṛtārthatvāya dharma eva lakṣyate ityāha -- dharmasvarūpavipratipattinirāsaparamiti|| nanu vedārthe'pi vipratipattayaḥ santi kimarthavādalakṣaṇo vedārthaḥ, kiṃ vā codanālakṣaṇaḥ iti; tannirāsāya lakṣaṇamucyata iti tatrāha -- itarathā vedārthavipratipattāviti|| mantrādiṣu kāryasya apratīteḥ yena yat pratīyate, sa tasya artha iti niyamāt naivaṃ vipratipattiriti bhāvaḥ| nanu dharmagrahaṇe'pyarthavādalakṣaṇatvaṃ nirākṛtya codanālakṣaṇatvaṃ vedārthasya kiṃ na sidhyati ityata āha -- yato na dharmagrahaṇe satīti|| vedārthavipratipattinirākaraṇapratibhāsābhāvāt dharmavipratipattinirāsapratibhāsāt apratipannavedārthavipratipattinirāsagrahaṇāyogādityarthaḥ|| atha dharmaśabdasya vedārthe prayogāt tadvipratipattinirāsa eva vivakṣyatāmiti codayati -- kathamiti|| tatra na tāvat rūḍhimāśritya dharmaśabdasya vedārthe prayoga ityuktam nāpi lakṣaṇayā; abhidheyāt anyasya lakṣyatvena vedārthasya adharmatvaprasaṅgāt| idānīṃ svārthaprakṣepeṇa vā tatra pravṛttiḥ śabdamātrasya vā saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhaparatayopayoga iti śiṣyate tatra na tāvat svārthaprakṣepeṇetyāha -- yattāvaccodanālakṣaṇo yo'rtha iti|| codanālakṣaṇatve, vedārthastvetāvāniti na nirṇītaṃ bhavati; codanādharmaśabdayoḥ vetadarthābhidhāyitvābhāvāt; yathā yaccākṣuṣaṃ tadrūpamityukte na sarvasya pratyakṣasya rūpamartha ityuktaṃ bhavati, tadvaditi bhāvaḥ| codanālakṣaṇe dharmasaṃjñāvidhiparatvaṃ sūtrasya nirākaroti -- atha punarityādinā|| aṅgīkṛtya dūṣaṇamāha -- athā kathacciditi|| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- codanālakṣaṇasya vedārthatve arthaśabdasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt; śyenādīnāmapi codanālakṣaṇatvādvedārthatvācca tadvyāvṛttyanupapatteḥ, acodanālakṣaṇatve avedārthatve ca tābhyāmeva śyenādinivṛtterarthaśabdasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, lakṣaṇavākye anuvādamātrānupapatteśca| pramāṇapratijñāyāmapyarthaśabdasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, dharmavicārapakṣe śyenādeḥ pratiṣedhacodanāviṣayasyānarthatvenādharmatvasiddhiḥ prayojanamiti| tathā codanāśabdo'pi kṛtsnavedalakṣaṇāparo vaktavyaḥ| katham codanāvyatirikto'pi vedabhāgosti vā na vā nāsti cet, codanālakṣaṇo'rthaḥ codanārtha iti lakṣyalakṣaṇayoraikyameva syāt| asti cet, so'pyarthavān vedabhāgaḥ nirarthako vā arthavāṃścet, kathaṃ codanāprameyo'codanābhāgasyārthaḥ syāt arthaśūnyaścet codanāvyatirikto vedabhāgaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi codanārtho'rthānarthavadbhāgadvayasamudāyavedārthaḥ syāt| tasmāt codanāśabdaḥ kṛtsnavedalakṣaṇāpara iti| codanālakṣaṇo vedārtha iti vākye śabdadvayadūṣaṇamabhipretya -- athāpi kathaṃcit ityuktam|| tathā sati vedasya prāmāṇyāt arthavattvaniścaye vicārāt prāgeva saṃjāte kiṃ vedārthaḥ codanālakṣaṇaḥ kiṃ vā arthavādādilakṣaṇaḥ iti viśaye, nārthavādādilakṣaṇaḥ kiṃ tu codanālakṣaṇo vedārthaḥ iti nirṇayaparaṃ sūtraṃ syāt| taccānupapannam; niścitatvādarthavattvasyetyāha -- tathā sati codanālakṣaṇa iti|| nanu prathamasūtre svādhyāyasya arthavivakṣāyāḥ pradarśitatvādarthavattvaniścayāt taduddiśya lakṣaṇavidhānaṃ yuktam, na; aniścite prāmāṇye arthavivakṣā'yogāt| tatra ca adhyayanavidhiprayuktāprāmāṇyamātranirākaraṇena arthavivakṣā darśitā, na tu pauruṣeyatvapramāṇāntarayogyaviṣayatvādinimittāprāmāṇyaṃ tatra nirākṛtya prāmāṇyaṃ vyavasthāpitam| tasmāt arthavattvāniścayāt vedārthaścodanālakṣaṇa iti niyantuṃ na śakyate| atha prathamasūtrasāmarthyādeva arthavattvamaṅgīkṛtya lakṣaṇavidhānamiti, tatrāha -- tatrānantaraṃ prāmāṇyapratipādanaṃ na yujyeteti|| nanu tasyaiva dṛḍhīkaraṇāya punaḥ pratipādanam, na -- arthavattve niścite dṛḍhīkaraṇaprayojanābhāvāt, aniścite ca lakṣaṇapravṛttyabhāvāt| nanu vedaprāmāṇyasyāpi vedārthatvādeva pratipādanaṃ na vedasya arthavattvaniścayāyeti, na; vedaprāmāṇyasyāpi vedārthatve, siddhe vastuni prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt| bhāṣyakāraśca dvitīyādhyāyamārabhamāṇo "vṛttaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇa"miti prathamādhyāyena vedasya prāmāṇyameva sādhitaṃ darśayati, tan‌ yujyate vedasya arthavattvaniściyapūrve vicāre| ato dharme pramāṇapratijñaiva lakṣaṇaṃ vā dvitīyasūtreṇa kriyata ityāha -- vṛttaṃ pramāṇalakṣaṇamiti ceti|| kiṃ ca asminneva sūtre mantrārthavādayordharme prāmāṇyanirākaraṇāt arthavādādhikaraṇamanapekṣitaṃ syādityāha -- mantrārthavādeṣu cet|| stāvakatvena anvayaprakārapratipādanārthamadhikaraṇamiti cet, na; atraiva dharme prāmāṇyanirākaraṇāddharmasya pratipādakatayā tatra pūrvapakṣānudayāt|| upasaṃharati -- ataḥ pūrvoktena nyāyena kāryaniṣṭha eva vedabhāgau vicāryatayā prakrānto vicāritaśca, na vastuniṣṭha ityato vastutattvaniṣṭhaṃ vedabhāgaṃ vicārayitumidamārabhyate| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakānanyānubhavapūjyapādaśiṣyasvaprakāśānubhavabhagavataḥ kṛtau pañcapādikāvivaraṇe dvitīyavarṇakaṃ samāptam|| <3> atha tṛtīyaṃ varṇakam "athāto brahmajijñāsetī"ti|| tatra loke'thaśabdasya catvavāro'rthā vṛddhavyavahāre prayogasāmarthyāt prasiddhāḥ -- ānantaryam, adhikāraḥ, maṅgalācaraṇam, prakṛtādarthādarthāntaratvaṃ ca| tatretaraparyudāsenānantaryamathaśabdenopādīyata ityasminnarthe "sati cānantaryārthatve" ityataḥ prāktanabhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- tatrāthaśabda ānantaryārthatve ityādinā|| katham jijñāsāśabdasyāvayavārthenārthavattve satīcchāyāḥ kartavyatayā prārambhānupapatteḥ, pratyadhikaraṇaṃ cāpratipādyatvānnādhikārārtho'thaśabdaḥ| brahmajñānecchāyā maṅgalācaraṇārthatvasya prasiddhataratvāt, aprasiddhatve'pi praśaṃsāparatayā'rthavādatvaprasaṅgāt sūtrasya na maṅgalācaraṇārthatā| icchāyāśca kutaścitprakṛtādarthādarthāntarabhāvasya prasiddhataratvānnābhidhānena kṛtyam, ityathaśabdasya na tadarthateti| nanu icchāyāḥ kutaścidānantaryamapi prasiddham, satyam; hetuphalabhāvenānantaryasya vivakṣitatvādānantaryābhidhānamukhena pūrvaprakṛtapuṣkalakāraṇamathaśabdenāvadyotyate| nanu brahmajñāne pravṛttiparyantecchodayasāmarthyādeva puṣkalakāraṇamanumīyate kimathaśabdena satyam; icchodayaprabhṛtīṣyamāṇajñānodayaparyantasya kāryasya puṣkalakāraṇatayā pūrvapravṛttasya śāstrīyasyādhikāriviśeṣaṇasya pratipattiparatvādathaśabdasya na doṣaḥ| tatpratipattiśceṣyamāṇajñāne pravṛttiparyantecchodayadvāreṇa pravṛttyaṅgabhāvaṃ bhajate, iti tenānantaryābhidhānamukhena pravṛttinimittaviśiṣṭecchodayaprabhṛterjñānodayaparyantasya kāryasya puṣkalakāraṇatayā pūrvanirvṛttasādhanacatuṣṭayāvadyotanāyānantaryārtho'thaśabda iti sūktam|| nanu jijñāsāśabdasya vicāre rūḍhasya kathamavayavārthenārthavattvamādīyate "rūḍhirhi yogamapaharatī"ti nyāyāt, ityākṣipati -- ayaṃ tu jijñāsāśabdo vicāravacana ityārabhyocyata ityataḥ prāktanena|| granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| ucyate nāyaṃ jijñāsāśabda ityādiḥ parihāraḥ| ayamāśayaḥ -- catvāraḥ śabdapravṛttiprakārāḥ| tatra rūḍhiḥ -- yathā vṛddhavyavahāre'bhidhānābhidheyavyatiriktamanapekṣyaiva prayogasāmarthyād akhaṇḍābhidhānasambandhaḥ, yogaḥ -- samāsādinaikapadyamāpannasya śabdasya svāvayavagatānekābhidhānaśaktidvāreṇa viśiṣṭārthābhidhānam; etaccobhayaṃ mukhyaṃ vṛttirityucyate| gauṇaḥ -- svābhidheyādarthādarthāntare guṇayogād lakṣaṇayā vṛttiriti| tatraikasyaiva śabdasyārthāntare rūḍhasyārthāntare ca yogavṛttisambhave "rūḍhiryogamaharatī"ti nyāyena yogaṃ parityajya rūḍhirūpādīyate| rūḍhiyogamukhyavṛttisambhave gauṇaḥ parityajyate; tatraikasminnarthe klṛptasāmarthyena śabdasya yogavṛttisambhave tatraiva tasyaiva śabdasya śaktyantakalpanānimittakāryāntarābhāvāt| nanu paṅkajaśabdādiṣu yogarūḍhiriti vṛttyantaraṃ kalpyata iti, na; tatrāpi yogavṛttyaivārthapratipatteḥ. nanu utpalādivastvantaraṃ vihāya paṅkajaśabdājhaṭiti tāmarase pratipattidarśanācchaktidvayameva kalpanīyam, na; prayogabāhulyādapi sāmarthyāviśeṣe prathamapratipattidarśanāt| yathā navasvartheṣu śaktyaviśeṣe'pi gośabdāt sāsnādimadākṛtau prayogabāhulyādeva prathamapratipattiḥ| tasmāt klṛptasāmarthyādeva prayogapratipattisambhave na śaktyantarakalpanetyāha -- nāyaṃ jijñāsāśabda iti|| kathamityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu avayavārthasaṃsarga eva yogavṛttyā'pi śabdena pratipādyate, vicārastu na jijñāsāśabdāvayavārthaḥ, kathaṃ tadavagamasya klṛptasāmarthyenaivānyathā siddhiriti codayati -- kathamanyathāsiddhatvamiti|| svayamavayavārthatvābhāve'pyavayavārthasaṃsargāvinābhāvādapi tallakṣaṇayā prayogapratyayopapattau na śaktyantakalpanā, ananyathāsiddhakāryābhāvāditi pariharati -- antarṇītavicārārthatvāditi|| nanu jñānamātramiṣyamāṇaṃ kathaṃ vicāreṇāvinābhūtamiti tadāha -- evaṃ prayogapratyayoriti|| jñānaṃ khalviṣyamāṇaṃ viṣayeṇa sahāvagatamiṣyate, anavagataviṣayecchāyogāt| tataśca pratipanne vastuni jñānamiṣyamāṇaṃ saṃdigdhe niścayaphalaṃ vā parokṣe'parokṣaphalaṃ veṣyate| taccobhayaṃ pramāṇādivicāraprayatnasādhyam, iti pratipanne vastuni viśiṣṭajñānamiṣyamāṇaṃ pramāṇādivicāramavinābhāvena gamayati, iti vicārasādhyajñāne prayoga pratyayāvityarthaḥ| nanu necchāmātraṃ sūtreṇa pratipādyate, prayojanābhāvāt, kiṃtviṣyamāṇajñānapradarśanamukhena tatsādhanaṃ vicāramantarṇītamupalakṣya sa eva tātaparyeṇa pratipādyate, ato vicārajñānabrahmaṇāmanyatamasya tātparyeṇa pratipādyasyārambhāyāthaśabda iti codayati -- nanvemapi kuta etaditi|| tadeva prapañcayati -- antarṇītaṃ vicāramāśrityeti|| arthalakṣaṇena prādhānyenāntarṇītaṃ vicāramāśrityeti sambandhaḥ| atastrayāṇāmanyatamasyādhikriyamāṇatvamaṅgīkṛtyeti yojanā| tatrāthaśabdenānantaryābhidhānamukhena śāstrīyasādhanacatuṣṭayasaṃpannādhikāriviśeṣasya nyāyataḥ samarpaṇābhāve vicārārambhārthatve ca kartavyatayā vidhīyamāno vicāro niradhikāro'nanuṣṭheyaḥ syāditi pariharati -- ucyate śāstrasyānārambhaprasaṅgāditi|| nanu vicāravidhireva viśvajinnyāyenādhikāriviśeṣaṃ kalpayitvā pravṛttiparyanto bhaviṣyati, kimathaśabdeneti nanu kartavyatayā'vagato vicāro'pi prārambhamarthād gamayati, kiṃ vicāraprārambhārthenāthaśabdena nanu vidhisāmarthyādubhayaprāptau kastatra nirṇayaḥ vidhyapekṣitopādhitvādānantaryābhidhānamukhenādhikārisamarpaṇameva yuktamityāha -- adhikārārthatve hyaprayojanamiti|| pravṛttidvāreṇa prayojanaparyantatāśūnyamityarthaḥ| nanu mokṣakāmaḥ kalpyate, na; prasajjyapratiṣedhaprasaṅgāt| tathāhi -- kartavya ityukte'viśeṣāt sarvādhikārapratipattau tadanupapattyā viśiṣṭādhikāraḥ kalpanīyaḥ| tato varaṃ śabdenaiva viśiṣṭādhikārisamarpaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu rātrisatranyāyenārthavādagatameva mokṣaṃ brahmajñānaṃ vā prayojanaṃ sādhyatvena pariṇamathya mokṣakāmo brahmajñānakāmo vā vicārayediti vidhipratipattisamaye'dhikāriviśiṣṭavidhipratiṣedha iti codayati -- nanu brahmajñānaṃ prayojanamiti|| tatredaṃ vaktavyam -- kiṃ sarveṣāṃ phalakāmitayā sarvādhikāraṃ śāstramucyate kiṃ vā viśiṣṭādhikāramiti viśiṣṭādhikāratve vidhipratipattyadhīnatvādasāmarthyalabhyādhikārikalpanāyāḥ prasajjyapratiṣedhavyāpāragauravaṃ tadavasthameva| ato'thaśabdena śrotavyādividhiprakaraṇapaṭhitasādhanacatuṣṭayasampannādhikāripratipattipūrvake vicāravidhyavagame nāsau doṣaḥ, ityathaśabdena śrautaviśeṣādhikārisamarpaṇameva yuktamiti| atha sarvādhikāraṃ śāstramiti, na prasajjyapratiṣedhaḥ, nāpi viśeṣādhikāra samarpaṇe śabdāpekṣeti, tatra vaktavyam -- kiṃ phalataḥ sarvādhikāraṃ śāstram kiṃ vā vidhitaḥ na tāvatphalataḥ; sarveṣāṃ phalārthitā'bhāvādityāha -- na brahmajñāne'rthatvānupapatteriti|| mā bhūd brahmajñānārthatetyataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu adhyayanavidhaistraivarṇikādhikāratvāt tatprayuktatvācca vicārasya vidhita eva sarvādhikāraṃ śāstramiti codayati -- mā bhūd brahmajñānārthateti|| nanu vidhirnāma svaviṣayasya tadupakārakasya vā'nuṣṭhānanimittaṃ bhavati, naca vicāro'dhyayanavidheyāvadarthāvabodhaphalaṃ vyāpārādvicāramapi phalaniṣpattaye'dhyayanavidhiranuṣṭhāpayatīti| nanu viṣayatadupakārivyatiriktasya vyāpārasya phalaniṣpattyapekṣayā vidhiprayuktānuṣṭhetvaṃ kva dṛśyate avaghātādiṣviti cet, na; vidheyāvaghātasyaiva phalaparyantamāvartyamānatvāt, vicārastu svatantrameva bhāvārthāntaraṃ kathaṃ vidhīyate, iti vaktavyam, naiṣa doṣaḥ; āvṛttiguṇasyāvihitasya vihitānupakārakasya ca vidheḥ phalaparyantatānupapattyā vidheyatvakalpanavad vicārasyāpi tadupapattiriti| tatra kiṃ vicārasādhyajñānamarthaniścayaphalamadhyayanasyānvayavyatirekasiddhaṃ dṛṣṭaphalam kiṃ vā taduddeśena vidhānādadhikāriviśeṣaṇatayā śāstrīyaṃ phalam kiṃ vā vidheḥ prayojanaparyantatāsāmarthyalabhyaṃ phalamiti na tāvad dṛṣṭaṃ phalam; adhyayanamātrādāvṛttiguṇakādapyarthaniścayānudayāt, āpātadarśanasya ca vicārānapekṣatvāt| ato nārthaniścayadṛṣṭaphalādhyayanakriyā syāditi| nanu tavyapratyayena svavyāpāraḥ śabdabhāvanā vidhirūpatayā'bhidhīyate, sā ca śabdabhāvanā'dhyayanakaraṇikāmarthabhāvanāṃ niṣpādayantī phalavadarthāvabodhaṃ puruṣārthamarthabhāvanābhāvyatvena kalpayati; apuruṣārthe puruṣapravṛttyayogāt, tataśca bhāvyāntaralābhāt samānapadoṣāttamadhyayanaṃ bhāvanāyāḥ karaṇatāmāpannaṃ bhāvyasyārthāvabodhasya nirvartakatayā karaṇaṃ bhavati; kuṭhārādīnāmapi kriyābhāvyadvaidhībhāvanirvartanadvāreṇa chidibhāvanākaraṇatvadarśanāt, ato'dhyayanavidheḥ pravartakatvānyathānupapattyaivārthabhāvanākaraṇasyādhyayanasyārthāvabodhaḥ phalamiti siddham; anyathā samānapadopāttatyādhyayanasyaiva bhāvyatayā svādhyāyāvāpterapi vidhiphalatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt, ityata āha -- sā hyadhīyamānāvāptiphalatvādakṣaragrahaṇānteti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- tavyapratyayena bhāvanākarmakārake'bhidhīyamāne svādhyāye svāvāptiphale ca na bhāvyāntaraṃ kalpanīyam; bhāvanākarmābhidhāyiśabdavirodhāditi| nanu na bhāvyamātreṇa puruṣapravṛttirvidhinā janyate, kintu puruṣārthabhāvyāpekṣayaiva; tataśca śabdavirodhe'pi bhāvanāniṣpattaye'rthāvabodhe bhāvya iti śaṅkate -- athākṣaragrahaṇaṃ niṣprayojanamiti|| pariharati -- bhavatu tarhi saktūnāṃ gatiriti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- arthanirṇayasyādhyayanamātrādaniṣpatteḥ, śrūyamāṇasya svādhyāyasya cāphalatvād adhyayanamātrasya cāprayojanatayā bhāvyatvāyogāt svādhyāyādhyayanena svargaṃ bhāvayediti kalpyata iti| nanu vyākaraṇasyāpyaṅgatvāt sāṅgādadhyayanād vidhīyamānādarthaniścayo dṛṣṭaphalatayā jāyate, tasya ca virodhaparihārāya vicāraḥ prayujyate; ato dṛṣṭe satyadṛṣṭakalpanā na nyāyyeti codayati -- tadapi na; akṣarebhyaḥ prayojanavaditi|| pariharati -- na tarhi niṣprayojanānīti|| śrūyamāṇasyādhyāyalakṣaṇāt karmaṇa evādhyayanabhāvanayā bhāvyamānāt phalavadarthāvabodhasiddheḥ paśvannādīnāṃ prayojanaṃ prati paramparayā sādhanānāmapi bhāvyatvadarśanāt śrūyamāṇasvādhyāyavāptiparyanta eva vidhivyāpāra iti bhāvaḥ| nanu akṣaragrahaṇaparyante vidhivyāpāre phalavadarthāvabodhasya nirnimittatā syāditi, tatrāha -- phalaprayukta evārthāvabodha iti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- laukikāptavākyānāṃ vidhimantareṇāpi phalavadarthāvabodhakatvadarśanāt saṅgācca karmaṇo vidhīyamānādavaghātādiṣvivādṛṣṭajanmaniyamād na vidhiphalamarthāvabodhaḥ, kintu svīkṛtasvādhyāyamātrajanyaṃ phalamiti| vidhestu dṛṣṭasamavāyyadṛṣṭameva kiṃcitphalam, iti dṛṣṭaphalāvirodhenādṛṣṭasiddhau na tadvirodhisvatantrādṛṣṭaṃ kalpayituṃ yuktamiti| kiṃca phalavadarthāvabodhaphale'dhyayanavidhau, yasya yasmin karmaṇyadhikāraḥ, tasya tadvākyādhyayanameva syāt, na vākyāntarādhyayanam; tatra pravṛttyādiphalābhāvāt, iti na kṛtsnavedādhyayanasiddhirityāha -- apicākṣaragrahaṇānto vidhiriti|| nanu kṛtsnasvādhyāyādhyayanasya nityatayā vidheyatve'pi sakalasvādhyāyāvāptisamavetasyādṛṣṭasyānadhikṛtakarmavākyagatasyārthāvabodhānuṣṭhānādidvāre'pi kathamapūrvasiddhihetuteti naiṣa doṣaḥ; prāyaścittajapādyapūrvopakāritvopapatteḥ| nanu adhyayanādakṣarāvāpteḥ| nanu adhyayanādakṣarāvāpteḥ ko viśeṣaḥ astyatra viśeṣaḥ; svādhīnoccāraṇakṣamatvaṃ nāmākṣaradharmo'vāptiḥ tadartho vāṅmanasavyāpāro'dhyayanamiti|| nanu adhikāriviśeṣaṇamarthāvabodhamuddiśyādhyayanaṃ vidhātavyam; niradhikāravidhānāyogāt, arthāvabodhamuddiśyaiva ca vihitaśabdoccāraṇe sati vākyatātparyasiddheḥ, arthāvabodhamuddiśya rāgaprayuktaśabdoccāraṇe loke tātparyadarśanāditi codayati -- nanu cāśrūyamāṇādhikāro'dhyayanavidhiriti|| adhikriyate'smin karmaṇyanenetyadhikāro vidhipuruṣasaṃbandhanimittaṃ jīvanakāmādirucyate| nanu viśvajinnyāyenādhikāri kalpyatām, athavā vājasaneyināṃ"brahmacaryamāgāmi"tyādinopanayanasya prakṛtatvādupanīto'dhikārīti prakaraṇapramāṇena kalpyatāmiti, netyāha -- dṛṣṭaścākṣaragrahaṇe'rthāvabodhaḥ, sa kalpanāmadhikārasya nirundhannityādinā|| bhavatu nāma "adhyayanenārthāvabodhaṃ bhāvayedarthāvabodhakāmaḥ" iti vidhiḥ, tathā'pi "vicāreṇārthāvabodhaṃ bhāvayedi"ti vicāre pravṛttiradhyayanavidhinā na vidhīyata iti, tatrāha -- dṛṣṭādhikāreṣu pratyakṣata iti|| tatra kimarthasāmarthyādevādhyayanasyārthāvabodhaḥ sākṣādvā paramparayā vā phalamityucyate kiṃ vā'rthāvabodhakāmamuddiśya vidhānataḥ ityabhipretyāha -- atrocyata iti|| prathamaḥ kalpo'ṅgīkṛtya ityāha -- bhavedadhyayanavidheriti|| dvitīyaḥ pakṣo'nupapanna ityāha -- nādhikārahetuteti|| adhyayanāt prāgarthāvabodhasyāpratipannasya kāmanāyogānnārthāvabodhakāmamuddiśya vidhānamityarthaḥ| nanu kathamarthāvabodhasyāpratipattiḥ adhyayanāt prāgvedārthasyāpratipatteḥ, viśeṣaṇāparijñāne tadviśiṣṭāvabodhānavagamāt| nanu vedasya vākyapramāṇatvādāptavacanavadartho vidyate, ityarthasadbhāvamātramanumānenāvagamyate, na; arthavattvajñānamātrasyānumānasiddhatvāt tajjñānakāmanā'yogāt, agnihotrādiviśiṣṭavākyārthānāmapratipannatayā tadviśiṣṭajñānakāmanā'yogāt; upadeśata evāgnihotrādivākyārthaviśeṣāḥ pratipannā iti cet, tarhi vākyārthaviśeṣajñānānāmapi siddhatvānna tatra kāmanā sambhavet| arthapadeśikajñānasyāpramāṇatvānnirṇayajñānaṃ kāmyata iti cet, aprāmāṇye niścite na tatra nirṇayajñānakāmanā, arthasya vibhramamātratvādaupadeśikajñānasya; sandigdhe pramāṇyavicārasyaivāvasaro nādhyayanasya| kiṃca -- sarvavākyārthajñānānāṃ yugapadekabuddhyoddeśanāsambhavāt, sāmānyenoddiśya śabdoccāraṇāyāmarthamātrajñāne śabdasya tātparyaprasaṅgāt, agnihotrādiviśeṣajñāne tātparyābhāvāt, vākyaśaktyanusāreṇa viśiṣṭārthe tātparyakalpanayā'rthajñānamuddiśyādhyayanavidhestātparyānimittatvaprasaṅgāt| tasmād viśeṣajñānānāṃ prāgasiddhatvānna tatkāmamuddiśya nidhānamityāha -- prāk cādhikārajñānena prayojanamiti|| kiṃcoddiśyavidhāne'pi nādhyayanamātrāt dṛṣṭaphalatayā'rthāvabodhasiddhiḥ; adarśanādityāha -- ato na vidheriti|| nanu arthāvabodhamuddiśya śabdoccāraṇāyāṃ tātparyaṃ loke dṛśyate, na tāvacchroturuccāraṇā tātparyanimittam; loke tadabhāvāt, na vakturuccākaṇā, vede'pauruṣeye tātparyābhāvaprasaṅgāt| tasmāt svabhāvata evārthapratipādanasamarthasya śabdasya puruṣasambandhakṛtadoṣaparihārāyārthajñānamuddiśya śabdoccāraṇā'pekṣyate, tātparyamapi śabdadharma eva ṣaḍvidhaliṅgagamyo na puruṣadharma iti vakṣyate|| idānīmadhyayanavidhernityādhikāratāṃ pratipādayitumadhikāriviśeṣaṇābhāvādanadhyayanamevetyadhyayanapravṛttimākṣipati -- yadyevamadhikārāśravaṇāditi|| tatra vidhirhi svaviṣaye pravartakatayā pratipannastadanyathānupapattyā "mamāyaṃ niyoga" iti pratipadya pravṛttisamarthamadhikāriṇaṃ kalpayati, yadā tu punarvidhiviṣayasya nimittāntarādanuṣṭhānaṃ sampadyate, tadā vidheḥ pravartakatvaṃ pratibadhyate| pratibaddhapravartakabhāvaśca vidhiḥ pravṛttisiddhaye na svāminamadhikāriṇaṃ kalpayitvā pravartayati| tatrādhyayanavidhirapi svaviṣayasyādhyāpanavidhiprayuktānuṣṭhānatvāt svayaṃ pratibaddhapravartakabhāvo nādhikāraṃ kalpayitvā pravartayatīti prābhākarāḥ pratyavatiṣṭhanta ityāha -- atra kecidāhuriti|| nanu -- "aṣṭavarṣa brāhmaṇamupanayīta" "tamadhyāpayīte"tiśrutāvadhyāpanavidhiraśrūyamāṇādhikāraḥ kathamadhyayanaṃ prayojayet; kalpyate'trādhikāra iti cet, na adhyayanepyadhikāraṃ kalpayitvā svavidhiprayuktirevādhyayanasya gṛhyatām; sannidhānāt, nanu -- kalpitādhikāre'dhyāpanavidhau tatprayuktānuṣṭhānatvādadhyayanasya na tatrādhikāraḥ kalpyata iti cet, viparīt kiṃ na syāt adhyayane kalpitādhikāre tatprayuktānuṣṭhānatvādadhyāpanasya na tatrādhikāraḥ kalpyata iti; nanu likhitapāṭhādadhyayanasiddhenādhyayanavidhiradhyāpanaṃ prayojayati, tarhi avihitādhyayanenāpyadhyāpanavidhisiddherna vihitamadhyayanamadhyāpanavidhiḥ prayojayet, athāpyadhyayanādhyāpanayormāṇavakasya prāṅmukhatvapavitrapāṇitvādyaṅgasāmyādvihitamevādhyayanamadhyāpanavidhiḥ prayuṅkta iti, adhyāpanasyādhyayanavidhiprayuktādi samānametat| kiṃca "ācāryādhīno vedamadhīṣve"ti niyamavidhānāllikhitapāṭho na yuktāḥ adhyāpanāduttarabhāvitvādācāryakaraṇavidhiprayuktaḥ -- "adhīṣve"tivākyārtha iti cet, "tad dvitīyaṃ janma tad yasmātsa ācārya" ityupanayanamātrādācāryatvaśravaṇāt "ācārān grāhayatī"ti vyutpattyā''cāryatvasya prāgeva siddheḥ, ācāryakaraṇavidhiprayukta ityadhyāhārāt śabdasya bhāvivṛttyāśrayaṇasyaiva laghīyastvāt| tasmādadhikārakalpanāsāmyāditaretaraprayuktisāmyācca svavidhiprayuktisambhave'dhyayanasya kathamadhyāpanavidhiprayuktiriti tatrāha -- ācāryakaraṇavidhiprayuktasyānuṣṭhānamiti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- "saṃmānanotsañjanācāryakaraṇajñānabhṛtivigaṇanavyayeṣu niyaḥ" iti saṃmānanādiṣu sādhyeṣu nayaterdhātorātmanepadaṃ vidhīyate; tatra "upanayīta, tamadhyāpayīte"tyekaprayogatāvagamādupanayanādhyāpanayormāṇavakasyādhyāpanaṃ prati karmakārakāṃśena guṇabhūtatvād māṇavakaḥ kenopakāreṇādhyāpanavidhi nirvartayediti vīkṣāyāmupagamenādhyayanaṃ kurvannadhyāpanavidherupakarotīti gamyate| tatro"panīyādhyāpayedi"ti prayogaikyakalpanāyāṃ nayatyarthasādhyamevācāryakaraṇamadhyāpanasyāpi phalaṃ gamyate| tataśco"panīyādhyāpayedācāryakaraṇakāmaḥ" iti śrutasyaivācāryatvasya phalasya kāmopabandhamātrakalpanāt sādhikāro'dhyāpanavidhiḥ sampadyate| athavā "upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣyaṃ vedamadhyāpayed dvijaḥ| sakalpaṃ sarahasyaṃ ca tamācāryaṃ pracakṣate" ityupanayanādhyāpanayoḥ prayogaikyādadhyāpane vidhiśravaṇādācāryatvaphalaśravaṇāccāryatvakāmo māṇavakamupanīyādhyāpayediti vidhirniṣpadyate, adhyayane tu nādhikāranimittaṃ kiñcit śrutamastīti viśeṣaḥ| nanu adhyāpanavidhiviṣayatadaṅgatābhāve'dhyayanasya svatantravidhyantaravihitasya kathaṃ svatantravidhyantaraprayuktānuṣṭhānateti tatrāha -- ādhānasyeva kāmaśrutiprayuktasyeti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- "brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīte"ti śrūyate| tatra na tāvatpuruṣamuddiśya svātantryeṇa nityamādhānaṃ vidhīyate; dravyaparatayā prokṣaṇādivat karmakārakasaṃskārakarmatāpratīteḥ, aśrūyamāṇaphalatvādeva na svatantrakāmyādhikāratā| naca saktunyāyena guṇapradhānavaiparītyānnityakāmyādhikāratā; "yadāhavanīye juhotī"ti saṃskṛtāgnīnāṃ kratvantare viniyogāt; tasmādubhayavidhāyikāraśūnyo nādhānavidhirādhāne pravartayituṃ kṣamaḥ| tarhyuttarakratuvidhiprayuktānuṣṭhānamādhānaṃ syāt, ucyate; na tāvannityadarśapūrṇamāsādividhiprayuktānuṣṭhānakamādhānam; āhavanīyasyoddeśyatayā'nupādeyatvāt, kratuvidhiprayuktānuṣṭheyatvāyogāt| upādeyameva hi vidhiranuṣṭhāpayati; anyathā svargakāmādīnāmapyanuṣṭheyatvaprasaṅgāt| tasmāduttarakāmyavidhiprayuktamevādhānasyānuṣṭhānamiti| nahi vidhiriva kāmo'pyupādeyamevānuṣṭhāpayati; kintu yadyaduddeśyamupādeyaṃ vā vinā kāmyamānaṃ na sidhyati tat sarve vidhiḥ sahakāritayā'nuṣṭhāpayati; evaṃ vidhirāgayorvibhāgadarśanāt| yathā "sauvarṇe pīṭhe samupaviśedi"ti vidhau tathāvidhapīṭhābhāve vidhirnānuṣṭhāpayati, rāgastu tathāvidhaṃ pīṭhamutpādyāpi tatra niveśayati; evamācāryakaraṇakāmanaivādhyayanamācāryapreraṇādvāreṇa māṇavakena nirvartayatyadhyāpanasiddhyarthamiti| atrādhyayanavidhireva nityādhikāreṇa sādhikāro'dhyayane pravartayatīti pratipādayitumadhyāpanavidhiprayuktiṃ nirākaroti -- taduyuktamityapara iti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- na tāvadācāryatvaṃ svayameva vidheyamiti yuktam; upanayanādhyāpanabhāvārthaviṣayatvād vidheḥ| nāpi vidhipadābhidheyatayā vidhirūpamāyaryatvam; ātmanepadamātrābhidheyatvāt| nāpi naiyogikaphalamācāryatvam; "ācārān grāhayatī"ti prayojakakartṛtvanibandhanasyācāryatvasya laukikatvāt| atha māṇavakaviṣayanayatyarthajanyamācāryatvamalaukikamiti, na tat; "yasmāt sa ācāryaḥ" iti smṛtau māṇavakasaṃskāraṃ prati hetukartṛtvasyaiva laukikasyācāryaśabdanimittatvāvagamāt, sahapaṭhitānāṃ ca saṃmānanādīnāmalaukikatvābhāvāt| ācāryatvasyālaukikatve'pyupanayananiyogaphalaṃ bhaviṣyati| tenādhyāpanavidheḥ kutaḥ sādhikāratā atha "tamadhyāpayītetye"kaprayogatā'vagamādupanīyādhyāpayīteti vidhiḥ pariṇamati iti, tathā'pyaṅgaphalasyārthavādasya na pradhānavidhyadhikāranimittatā kalpanīyāācāryakaraṇakāmo māṇavakamupanīyādhyāpayediti| tadevamadhyayanavidherapyupanayanaprakaraṇatvādvājasaneyinām, sarvasmṛtiṣu copanīto'dhīyīteti prakaraṇapramāṇāt sādhikāratvasiddheḥ svavidhiprayuktamevādhyayanamiti yuktam| yattu mānavaṃ vacanamuktam, tat svayameva vā mūlaśrutyanumānena vā nācāryakaraṇakāmasya kiṃcidvidadhāti, kintu yacchabdopabandhādupanayanādhyāpanānuvādena kartṛrācāryasaṃjñāmeva vidadhāti, "tamācāryaṃ pracakṣate" iti vacanāt, saṃjñāyāśca vakṣyamāṇanamaskārapūjādividhānāṅgatvāt| tasmādācāryakaraṇavidhiprayuktirayuktā -- iti|| nanu evamapyubhayatrādhikārakalpanā na yuktā; anyatareṇaivānyatarasya prayuktisiddheḥ, ataḥ kasyānyatarasya kalpyate iti vīkṣāyāṃ māṇavakasyāprabuddhatvāt svādhikāraṃ pratipadyānuṣṭhānumaśaktatvādadhyāpanavidhireva sādhikāro'dhyayanaṃ prayuṅkta iti codayati -- kathamiti|| tatrottaramāha -- aṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamupanayīteti|| yadyayamācāryasya niyoga iti|| ācāryakaraṇakāmasya niyoga ityarthaḥ| ayamabhisandhiḥ -- ācāryakaraṇavidhistāvannāvihitamadhyayanaṃ prayuṅkte; adhyayanānadhikāriṇāṃ tatra prayojanaśūnyatayā''cāryaguṇabhāvena pravṛttyayogāt| atha vihitamevādhyayanaṃ prayodayati, tatra vaktavyam -- kiṃ vidhiḥ svarūpanirdhāraṇopādhitvenādhikāriṇaṃ viṣayaṃ cāpekṣate na veti svarūpopādhitayā viṣayamapekṣate, nādhikāriṇam; pravartakatvopādhitvādadhikāriṇa iti cet, tarhyasyāyaṃ vidhiriti vihitasyādhyetṛviśeṣasyāparijñānād yaṃ kaścidadhyāpayet, tadetadāha -- māṇavako na niyukto bhavatītī|| atha svarūpopādhitvenaivādhikāriṇamapekṣate vidhiḥ, tarhi siddhamadhyayanavidheḥ sādhikāratvam| tatra prakaraṇādupanīto'dhikārī sampadyate| sādhikāratve cādhyayanavidheḥ prayojayitṛtvamapi sidhyati| paraprayuktānuṣṭānasambhave sādhikāro'pi vidhirna prayojayatīti cet, tatrāha -- aniyuktasya ca svādhyāyādhyayana iti|| aniyuktasyeti| svādhikāravidhinaivāpravartitasyetyarthaḥ| nanu ekasminnapravartamāne'pyanyaḥ pravartiṣyata iti srotorūpeṇādhyāpanasya siddhiriti, na; upanetṛtvasyāpi tadaṅgatvāt| svātmanaivopanayīta tamadhyāpayīta nānyenopanītam; anyathā'ṅgavaikalyādadhikārāniṣpatterācāryatvaphalasiddheḥ| tarhyanyānapyupanīyādhyāpayet, tanna; sarve ca māṇavakā na pravartante niṣprayojanavyāpāre, iti nādhyāpanaṃ sidhyati| nanu bālakasya kathaṃ svādhikārapratipattiḥ saṃdhyopāsanasamidāharaṇādikartavyatāpratipattivadupadeśasāmarthyādadhyayanakartavyatāpratipattiriti na virodhaḥ| kiṃñca anityena vidhinā nityasvādhyayanasyānuṣṭhāne taduparame nityamadhyayanaṃ sampādayituṃ na śakyata ityāha -- kiñcānyad ācāryakaraṇavidhiriti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- kāmyamānamācāryasya na tāvat svayameva puruṣārthaḥ; paramparayā ca sukhaduḥkhaprāptinivṛttyoreva puruṣārthatvāt| tatrācāryatvasyādhyāpanamātrasya vā prayojanākāṅkṣāyāṃ dṛṣṭe satyadṛṣṭakalpanānupapatterdravyārjananopāyatvena "ṣaṇṇāṃ tu karmaṇāmasya trīṇi karmāṇi jīvikā| yājanādhyāpane caiva viśuddhācca pratigrahaḥ"|| iti smaraṇāt, māṇavakasya cādhyayanāṅgatvena gurudakṣiṇādividhānāt, aṅginyadhyayane'nuṣṭhāpakasyādhyāpanavidherdakṣiṇāśuśrūṣādyaṅgeṣvanuṣṭhāpakatvād dravyārjanameva prayojanam| tatra prayojanavattayā kāmyatvānna nityavat prayoktṛtvasiddhiriti| upagamanādhyayane tarhyanitye iti, netyāha -- upanayanākhyastu saṃskāro nitya iti|| nanu prāyaścittasyāpyakaraṇe doṣaḥ śrūyate -- "atīte cirakāle tu dviguṇaṃ vratamarhatī"ti, tatra kathaṃ pratyavāyaśravaṇādupanayanasya nityatet ucyate; na prāyaścittākaraṇanimittadoṣanirāsāya dviguṇaṃ vratamucyate, kintu prāyaścittena nirākartavyasya pūrvadoṣasyaivātītacirakāle dviguṇavratāpekṣayaiva nirāsa ityucyate; anyathā prāyaścittānavasthāprasaṅgāt| nanu upanayanasaṃskārasya nityatve'pyadhyayanasya kathaṃ nityāsiddhiriti tatrāha -- saṃskāraśceti aṅgyupādhivihitatvādaṅgasyopahitāṅganityatā svopādheradhyayanasyāpi nityatvaṃ kalpayatīti| nanu -- adhyayanamanārabhyādhīyamānamupanayanaphalaṃ kathamadhyayanāṅgaṃ syāt nacopanayanasaṃskāravidhimātramevāvupapattyā śeṣitvenādhyayanaṃ kalpayati; śrutyādiviśeṣasambandhanimittapramāṇābhāve'dhyayanaviśeṣeṇa sambandhāsiddheḥ, yathā "hiraṇyaṃ dhāryami"ti vidhiḥ pratītito hiraṇyasaṃskārārtho'pi śrutyādiviśeṣasambandhapramāṇābhāvāt saṃskāryahiraṇyapadārthasāmarthyāt kratusambandhe sarvakratusambandhaprasaṅgād ekasya saṃskārasya sarvakratūpakāritvānupapatteścacānyāṅgatāmanaśnuvānaḥ saṃskārakarmatvaṃ parityajyābhyudayaphalaḥ svatantro vidhirabhyupagataḥ, evamupanayanavidhirapi śrutyādipramāṇavirahāt saṃskāryamāṇavakasāmarthyāt kratusambandhaprasaṅgādanyāṅgatāmanaśnuvānaḥ saṃskārakarmatvaṃ parityajya svatantra evābhyudayaphalaḥ syāt| karmasvarūpavidhirhi sarvaḥ svabhāvasāmarthyādevāṅgāṅgibhāvaṃ sāmānyena pramimāṇaḥ śrutyādisahakṛta eva viśeṣasambandhaṃ pramimīte, iti nopanayanasya saṃskārakarmatā sidhyati -- iti|| atrocyate -- adhyayanavidhireva śrutyādipramāṇānapekṣatayā cāturthikena pramāṇenopagamanamātmīyāṅgatvena svīkaroti; "ācāryādhīno vedamadhīṣve"tyādiniyamavidhānāllikhitapāṭhādipratiṣedhe satyācāryopagamanamantareṇa māṇavakādhyayananirvṛttyayogāt| nanu dṛṣṭamācāryopagamanamadhyayanavidhisāmarthyādupādīyatām, adṛṣṭaspūpanayanasaṃskāraḥ kathamaṅgatayopādīyata iti ucyate -- ācāryopagamanavidhireva nānāvidhetikartavyakalāpānugṛhīto'dṛṣṭaṃ saṃskāramutpādayati| sa ca vidhirvidhiprayuktaprayojanamīkṣamāṇo dṛṣṭopagamanadvāreṇādhyayanavidhyupakāre sambhavati nādṛṣṭaṃ kalpayati; dṛṣṭe satyadṛṣṭakalpanānupapatteḥ| dṛṣṭaphalātiśaye'dṛṣṭe saṃbhavati, svatantrādṛṣṭakalpanānupapatterityarthaḥ| tadevamadhyayanavidhisāmarthyādupādīyamāne satyācāryopagamane tadāśritopanayanavidhijanyasaṃskārasyāpi taddvāreṇādhyayanavidhisambandhasyopanayanavidhisāmarthyādeva siddherubhayavidhyupādānasāmarthyādadhyayanāṅgamupanayanamiti siddham| nanu upanayanasya saṃskārakarmatāyā siddhāyāṃ saṃskāravidheḥ prayojanākāṅkṣā, tataścādhyayanavidhyākṣiptācāryopagamanadṛṣṭadvāreṇopanayanavidhiradhyayanāṅgatāmātmanaḥ sāmarthyāt pramimīte| nacopanayanasya saṃskārakarmatve pramāṇamiti, atrocyate -- parasparopādānasāmarthyādevopanayanādhyayanayoraṅgāṅgibhāve siddhe kimupanayanaṃ prokṣaṇādivat saṃskārakarmatayā'ṅgam kiṃ vā prayājādivadadhyayanaphalopakāryaṅgam iti viśaye saṃskārakarmatayā'ṅgatvamupādīyate; aṅgisvarūpopakāralābhāt sannipatyāṅgatvāt, phalopakāryaṅgānāṃ viprakṛṣṭatayā'bhāvāt, viprakarṣāt sannikarṣagrahaṇasya yuktatvāt| ato māṇavakasaṃskāratayopanayanamadhyayanasvarūpopakāryaṅgamubhayavidhyupādānasāmarthyāt siddham| kiṃca "aṣṭavarṣo brāhmaṇa upagacchet" "so'dhīyīte"ti vākyavipariṇāmasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt tacchabdaśrutirevopanayanasaṃskṛta māṇavakamādāya svādhyāyādhyayane niyuṅkte, iti śrutyanugṛhīta evopanayanavidhiradhyayanāṅgatāmātmanaḥ pratipādayati| tacchabdena saṃskāro na parāmṛśyate, kiṃtu māṇavaka eveti na yuktaṃ vaktum; anantaraprakṛtatvāt saṃskārasya, upanayanādhyayanayoḥ parasparasākāṅkṣatvasya darśitatvāt, ākāṅkṣitasamarpaṇatvācca śruteḥ, avibhakterapi prātipadikasyānvitābhidhāyitayā sambandhapratipādakatvāt| tasmāt śrutyanugṛhīta eva vidhiraṅgāṅgibhāvaṃ pramimīta iti| kiñca vājasaneyināṃ sarvasmṛtyanumitaśrutiṣu copanayanaṃ prakṛtyādhyayanavidhānāt phalavadadhyayanaprakaraṇānugṛhīta evopanayanavidhiradhyayanāhgatāmātmanaḥ pratipādayati| tasmād yuktam -- saṃskāraśca svādhyāyādhyayananārtha iti| nanu kāmyatvepyācāryakaraṇavidhirnityasamīhitaphalatvānnitya eva| tataśca na nityānityasaṃyogavirodha iti codayati -- nanu kathamācāryakaraṇetyādinā|| phalasya nityasamīhitatvamaṅgīkṛtya pariharati -- bhavedevaṃ nityatā phalavaśena, na śabdāditi|| nanu phalasāmarthyādvā śabdasāmarthyādvā'nuṣṭheyaṃ nityakartavyaṃ cet, kiṃ pramāṇaviśeṣeṇa hīyata iti tatrāha -- tathāpi phalasya nityasamīhitatvāditi|| vāstavī-phalavastusāmarthyanibandhanetyarthaḥ| nanu adhyāpane kvacit phalasādhanakāmanādhīnākartavyatāpratipattiḥ, anyatra tu śābdakartavyatāpratipattyadhīnā'dhyāpane phalasādhanecchā, kimatrādhyāyapanasya nityakartavyatāpratipatterāyātamiti tatrāha -- śābdyāṃ hi nityakartavyatāpratipattāviti astyatra viśeṣaḥ, katham adhyāpanavidhirhi śabdānnityatayā pratipanno viśeṣeṇa svādhikāropādhau sarvadā sarvān pratyanuṣṭheyecchāmutpādya pravartayati; prāmāṇikakartavyatāpratipatteḥ svopādhau saṃkocābhāvāt, icchādhīne tu kartavyatāvagame tatsaṅkocādeva kartavyatāvagamasaṅkocād na nityavadadhyāpanasiddhiriti| nanu prāmāṇikanityakartavyatādhīnā'pīcchā kvaciddeśe kāle vastuni ca kārakasāmarthyābhāvādivaśenaucityāt pratihanyate, tatra kathaṃ nityakartavyatādhīnanityecchādvāreṇa nityavadanuṣṭhānamiti tatrāha -- aucityādibhāve'pīti|| pramāṇatastāvannityo'dhyāpanavidhiḥ pratyavāyabhayādiva yāvacchakyamicchādidvāreṇādhikāriṇamanuṣṭhāpayatītyarthaḥ| teneti spaṣṭārthaḥ| nanu pramāṇato vidhinityatvavatadicchāto'pi kartavyatānityatvaṃ kiṃ na syāditi netyāha -- phalavaśāttu kartavyatāpratipattāviti anityaiva sā syādityadhyāhāraḥ|| nanu arthasya nityasamīhitatvāt kartavyatāpratipattinimittakāmo'pi nitya evetyata āha -- yadyapīti|| upeyanityatve'pyupāyabhedādadhyāpanakartavyatā'pyanityaivetyarthaḥ| nanu kasyacidupāyāntarāsamarthasya tadekopāyatvānnityakartavyateti, tatrāha -- tadekopāyatve'pīti|| ato nityānityasaṃyogavirodha iti| idānīṃ svato nityatvābhāve'pi nityaputrotpādanavidhiśeṣatayopanayanādhyāpanayornityatvānna nityānityasaṃyogavirodha iti codayati -- nanu pituḥ putrotpādanavidhiriti|| tatra putrotpādanavidheḥ pitṛṇāṃ paralokagatānāmasmin loke piṇḍapitṛyajñādyanuṣṭhānadvāreṇa tṛptisampādanaṃ prayojanam| nacopanayanādhyāpanārthajñānādivyatireṇānuṣṭhānaṃ sambhavati| tataśca nityasya putrotpādanavidheḥ phalaparyantatāpekṣitamanuśāsanaṃ taccheṣatayā vidadhāti "tasmātputrami"ti vākyam| tataśca nityaputrotpādanavidhisāmarthyādupanayanādividhīnāṃ nityatvaṃ prāptam| tataścārthajñānaparyantatvādanuśāsanasyādhyayanamapyarthajñānaphalamityāha -- kathaṃ vā'dhyayanasyeti|| pariharati -- nānena putrānuśāsanaṃ vidhīyata iti|| "athātaḥ saṃpattiryadā prauṣyanmanyate'tha putramāha tvaṃ brahma tvaṃ yajñatvaṃ lokaḥ" iti vedatadartha tatphalānāṃ svānuṣṭheyānāṃ putre samarpyamāṇānāṃ "sa putraḥ pratyāha aha brahmāhaṃ yajño'haṃ lokaḥ" iti putreṇānuṣṭheyatayā svīkaraṇaṃ saṃpattikarma| tatra ca pūrvānuśāsanamantareṇākasmādeva sakalakartavyasaṃgrahānupapatteḥ phalaparyantaputrotpādanavidhinākṣiptamanuśāsanaṃ pūrvanivṛttamevārthavādatayā'nuvadatyetadvākyamiti bhāvaḥ| mā bhūt tadetadvākyamanuśāsanāvidhāyakam; tathā'pi nityaputrotpādanavidhisāmarthyādeva piturupanayanādyanuśāsanavidhirnitya eva prāpta iti, tatrāha -- garbhāṣṭavarṣeṇetyādinā|| ayamarthaḥ -- nityaputrotpādanavidhyadhikāriṇaḥ piturāyurniyamābhāvādanuśāsanaparyantamavasthānānupapatteḥ kartavyarthopadeśanamevānuśāsanam, nānuṣṭhāpanam| ato nityaputrotpādanavidhyākṣiptatayā'pi nopanayanādividhernityateti| nanu pituḥ kartavyopadeśanamevānuśāsanam, nopanayanādyanuṣṭhāpanamiti kathamavagamyate tadāha -- tathāca liṅgaṃ śvetaketuriti|| tataśca nityānityasaṃyogavirodhastadavastha evetyāha -- tadevanityeneti|| nanu māṇavaka eva ekasminnācārye maraṇādīnāṃ nivṛtte punarācāryāntaramāhūya nityamadhyayanaṃ sampādayiṣyatīti, netyāha -- kiṃ cācārye preta iti|| na tāvanmāṇavaka eva svaniyogena preryamāṇaḥ svādhikāraṃ nirvartayitumācāryāntaraṃ sampādayati; anaṅgīkaraṇāt, nāpyācāryaniyogena; adhikāriṇo'bhāve niyogasya kartavyatāpratipattyabhāvāt, akartavyānuṣṭhānena sādhanasaṃpādanāyogāditi| nanu -- sādhanāntarapratinidhyupādānavadadhikāriṇo'pi pratinidhyupādānena kartavyaṃ māṇavakaḥ sampādayediti, netyāha -- nacādhikārī pratinidhīyata iti|| avaśyakartavyasya hyananuṣṭhāne pratyavāyāt tadanuṣṭhānāya hi mukhyābhāve pratinidhirādīyate; adhikāryabhāve "mamedami"ti sambandhānavagamādakartavye niyoge kasyāvaśyānuṣṭhānāya pratinidhirādīyate na tāvanmṛtasya; tasya vidhisambandhanimittanivṛtteḥ kartavyatvābhāvāt, nāpi pratinidheḥ; ācāryasyedaṃ kartavyam, tasya kartavyasidhyuttarakālatvāt| tasmānnādhikāriṇaḥ pratinidhisambandhaḥ| na tarhi sarvatra pratinidhivārtāvakāśa iti, tadāha -- adhikārī svādhikārasidhyarthamiti|| nanu ācārye prete'nyaḥ kaścidācāryaḥ svādhikāraṃ nirvartayituṃ māṇavakaṃ svīkariṣyati, kiṃ māṇavakasyācāryāntarakaraṇavyāpāreṇeti na; punarupanayanābhāvāt, upanetṛtvāṅgasyāpi siddherna māṇavakāntarasvīkāraḥ, anupanītaṃ vā'dhyāpayīta; aṅgasya nirvṛttatvāt| vṛttyupacayārthaḥ saṃgraha iti cet, na; daridrasya māṇavakasyāgrahaṇaprasaṅgāt, alpavyavahitagrāmavāsināṃ ca māṇavakānāmācāryasaṃpādanārthaṃ grāmāntaragamanaṃ na syāt| na hi tatra tatrādhyāpayitāraḥ śrotriyāśca dṛśyante| tathāca māṇavakasyopanayādi sidhyarthaṃ svayamevācāryagamanaṃ śrūyate -- satyakāmo hi vai jābālo brahmacaryaṃ bhagavati vatsyābhyupeyāṃ bhagavantamityādiśrutau| upasaṃharati -- evameṣā bahudoṣeti|| nanu svavidhiprayuktatve satyupagamanādhyayanayostatprayuktatayopanayanādhyāpanasiddhestatra vidhānamanarthakamiti, nāyaṃ prayojakavyāpārayorvidhiḥ, kiṃtūpagamanādhyayanayoḥ kartṛvyāpārayorvidhirityāha -- tasmānmāṇavakasyaiva niyoga iti|| nanu ṇijarthasaṃsṛṣṭatvārthābhidhāyini vidhipade kartṛvyāpāke vidhisaṃsargo vākyapramāṇaviruddha iti codayati -- kathaṃ guṇakartṛvyāpārasambandha iti|| kiṃ nyāyavirodha ucyate kiṃvā śabdavirodhaḥ na tāvacchabdavirodhaḥ, anyatrāpi darśanāt, ityāha -- yathaitayā grāmakāmamiti|| nāpi nyāyavirodhaḥ; grāmānuvādenāprāptavidhānāt, ityāha -- grāmakāmasya yāgo vidhīyata ityādinā|| nanu adhyāpanayājanayoḥ kartṛprayojakavyāpāradvayāvagamādanyatarānuvādenānyataro vidhīyata iti yuktam, upanayane tu dhātvarthasya prayojakavyāpāratvādanabhidhīyamānaḥ kartṛvyāpāraḥ kathaṃ vidhīyate iti codayati -- yuktaṃ vājayedityādinā|| nanu upanayane mā bhūnmāṇavakavyāpāravidhiḥ, adhyayane tu bhaviṣyati, tanna; vākyasārūpyādityāha -- tadevamācāryakaraṇavidhiprayuktatvāditi|| tatra prayojakavyāpārābhidhāyinā'pi nayatidhātunā māṇavakavyāpārasyānabhidhīyamānasyāpi gamyamānatvāt sa eva dhātunā lakṣaṇayopādāya vidhīyate, na prayojakavyāpāraḥ ; svayaṃ prāpteriti pariharati -- ucyate māṇavakasyaivāyamiti|| nanu māṇavakavyāpāro gamyamānatayā vā kathaṃ pratīyate kathaṃ vā prayojakavyāpāraḥ prāptānuvāda iti codayati -- kathaṃ yattāvaditi|| māṇavakavyāpārasya gamyamānatāmupapādayituṃ prathamamācārya vyāpārasyāvidheyatāmupapādayati -- upanayītetyasyābhidhānato nyāyataśceti|| "māṇavakamupanayīte"tyukte māṇavakasya svātmasamīpagamanamabhidhānataḥ pratīyate, na svasya māṇavakasamīpagamanam; anyathā māmavakamupagacchediti vacanaṃ syāt| nyāyataśca pratīyate -- yathā bālānakṣarāṇi śikṣayalaṃlaukikaḥ puruṣo na bālaguṇabhāvaṃ gacchati, kiṃtu bālāneva svayamātmaguṇabhāvaṃ nayati| nanu evamapyācāryavyāpāro na prāptānuvādaḥ, katham śuśrūṣādyaṅgasahite'dhyayane māṇavakasya vihite svavidhiprayukte cādhyayane vṛttayarthatayā''cāryapravṛttiḥ prāpnoti, vṛttyarthapravṛttau ca prāptāyāṃ tadanuvādena māṇavakavyāpāro'dhyayanādirvidhātuṃ śakyate, itītaretarāśrayaprasaṅgāt| nanu -- "grāmakāmaṃ yājayedi"tyatrāpi samāno'yaṃ doṣaḥ, atha svavidhiprayukteṣu yāgāntareṣu sāmānyena vṛtyarthatayā prāptaṃ prayojakavyāpāramanūdya grāmakāmasya yāgaviśeṣo vidhīyata iti, tarhīhāpyadhyayanāntareṣu sāmānyaprāptaprayojakavyāpāranuvādena māṇavakavyāpāra upagamanādhyayanādirvidhīyatām| athavā -- māṇavakavyāpāravidhisāmarthyādeva prayojakavyāpāra prāpsyate, na prayojakavyāpāravidhānādeva bhāvinīṃ prāptimanūdya māṇavakavyāpāraḥ kadācidapyaprāpto vidhīyata iti, tadetadāha -- etacca sarvaṃ vṛttyarthatvena brāhmaṇasyānyata eva prāptamiti|| nanu prayojakavyāpāraṃ prāptamevānūdya guṇādhikārādiviśeṣavidhiparaṃ vākyaṃ kiṃ na syāditi na tāvadadhikāravidhiparaṃ vākyam ; jīvanādinityakāmyādhikāraśravaṇāt, ato guṇavidhireva "dadhnā juhotī"tyādivat pariśiṣyata ityāha -- tatra kamadhyāpayediti|| bhavatu tarhi guṇavidhiriti, netyāha -- tatra prāpte vyāpāra iti|| ayamāśayaḥ yadā viśeṣyo'pi padārthaḥ pramīyate, tadā nānāvidhaguṇa viśiṣṭatayā sa eko viśiṣṭaḥ padārthaḥ pramīyate, iti na vākyabhedaḥ syāt ; yadā tu viśeṣyamanūdya viśeṣaṇāni pramīyante, tadā viśeṣaṇānāmanyonyaviśiṣṭatayaikatvāpattyabhāvādanyonyānapekṣatayā pratyekaṃ prameyatve prameyabhedāt vākyaṃ bhidyata iti| nanu sarvatra viśeṣyaṃ sāmānyadvāreṇānuvādyameva, satyam; viśeṣaṇānyapi tathā, kintu viśeṣākāreṇānyonyaviśiṣṭatayā padārthāḥ pramīyanta iti| tasmādutpattyadhikāraguṇavidhayaḥ prayojakavyāpāre na sambhavantītyupasaṃharati -- ato nācāryasyeti|| tatra māṇavakavyāpārasya gamyamānasyaiva dhātunā lakṣaṇayopādāya vidheyatvaṃ darśayituṃ codayati -- nanu māṇavakasyāpīti|| pariharati -- astīti brūma ityādinā|| nanu kartureva vyāpāro gamanādiṣu dṛśyate, na karmakārakasya grāmādeḥ; māṇavakaśca nayatyarthakarmabhūtaḥ kathaṃ gamyamānavyāpāraḥ iti codayati -- kathamiti|| pariharati -- yadaivopanayīteti|| upanayanasaṃskāryo'pīti-upagantā'pītyarthaḥ| nayatyarthakarmaṇo nīyamānasya gamanavyāpāraḥ suprasiddha iti bhāvaḥ| nanu tarhi māṇavakasya gamanaṃ prayojakavyāpārādeva sidhyati, kimiti tad vidhīyata iti na; vidhānamantareṇāsiddherityāha -- tasya ca prekṣāvata iti|| nanu vidhāne'pi kāmyavidhiḥ syāditi, netyāha -- vidyamānasyāpīti kathaṃ tarhi vidhiriti pariśeṣānnityavidhirityāha -- vidhito'vaśyakartavyatāmiti|| kathaṃ tarhi vākyaṃ pariṇamyata iti tadāha -- tenāṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamiti|| nanu nityatayā vidheyatve'pi vidhipuruṣasaṃbandho vā vidhipuruṣasambandhanimittaṃ vā pravṛttirvā'dhikāraśabdārtho na labhyata iti codayati -- nanu evāmapyadhikāro na labhyata iti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- nanu sāmānyena gamyamānasyopagantuḥ "aṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇami"ti viśeṣaṇaśravaṇādidamevādhikāranimittaṃ saṃpatsyate, naivam; ekaikasya viśeṣaṇasyādhikāranimittatvānupapatteḥ, viśeṣaṇayośca parasparaviśiṣṭatā'bhāvāt| ekaikasya viśeṣaṇasyābhidhānike kriyāsaṃbandhe'pyaruṇayaikahāyanyādivadarthāt parasparaviśiṣṭatayā'dhikāranimittateti cet, na; vidhi puruṣasaṃbandhanimittasyāśābdatvaprasaṅgāt -- iti| pariharati astyatrādhikāraheturnityaṃ nimittamiti|| vidhipuruṣasaṃbandhasya pravṛtterna heturityarthaḥ| nityamiti|| jīvataḥ puruṣaviśeṣasya niyatabhāvītyarthaḥ| naca śābdameva sarvatrādhikāranimittam; sāṅgakarmānuṣṭhānasāmarthyasyāpyaśābdasyādhikāranimittatvāt, śaktasyādhikārāditi| athavā -- kriyāsaṃbandhābhidhānamukhena viśiṣṭasamarpaṇe śabdadvayatātparyakalpanādadhikāranimittasya śābdatvaṃ na hanyate| evamapi viśiṣṭasya nādhikāranimittateti codayati -- nanu jātivayasī viśeṣaṇamupādeyasyeti|| ayamabhisandhiḥ -- upādeyaṃ nāma sākṣādvā paramparayā vā vidhiviṣayatayā'nuṣṭheyaṃ tadviśeṣaṇaṃ ca kriyākārakatadguṇasamudāya ityarthaḥ| tatropādeyaviśeṣaṇāni "daṇḍī praiṣānanvāha" "lohitoṣṇīṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracarantī"ti kartṛviśeṣaṇāni, "vrīhibhiryajete"tyādau bahutvādīni karaṇaviśeṣaṇāni, "indrāya svārājñe" ityādīni saṃpradānaviśeṣaṇāni| nacopādevaviśeṣaṇamadhikārasaṃbandhanimittam; anuṣṭheyakārakaviśeṣaṇatayā vidhiṃ prati guṇabhūtatvāt, adhikāriṇastu vidhiṃ prati svāmitayā prādhānyenānvayāt| kathaṃ punaratra māṇavakasyopādeyatvamavagamyate ucyate; -- prayojakavyāpāraṃ prati māṇavakasya karmatābhidhāyinī dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ svavyāpāraṃ prati kartṛtvaṃ gamayati; kartṛviṣayatvāt prayojakavyāpārasya| tatra prāptaprayojakavyāpārānuvādena kartṛvyāpāre vidhisaṃbandhamātraṃ pariṇamyate, na śabdaprāptamāṇavakakartṛtvaṃ parākriyate, ityupādeyamāṇakaviśeṣaṇasya jātiviśiṣṭasya vayaso nādhikāranimittateti| kasya punaradhikāranimittateti ata āha -- anupādeyaviśeṣaṇamadhikāraheturiti|| vidhiprayuktānuṣṭheyatadviśeṣaṇavyatirekeṇa vidhisaṃbandhyanupādeyaḥ; yathā jīvan gṛhadāhavān svargakāma iti| apasiddhāntena parihartuṃ niyogapakṣamaṅgīkaroti -- satyam; astīyaṃ sthitiriti|| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- yatra liṅādipadena niyogo vākyārthatayā pratipādyate, tatra vākyārthabhūtaniyogākāṅkṣānimittatvāt padārthāntarasaṃbandhānāṃ niyogasya ca, kasya kasmin iti svarūpopādhitvenaivādhikāriviṣayasāpekṣatvāt svargakāmādiniyogākāṅkṣayā'dhikāritvena saṃbadhyate -- mamāyaṃ niyoga iti|| svāmitayā'nvayitvaṃ niyojyatvamadhikāritvaṃ nāma| tatra prathamaṃ "mamāyaṃ niyogaḥ" iti pratipadya niyogasya kāryatāvagamādanuṣṭhānāya dhātvarthaviṣaye paścāt kartṛtayā'nveti| niyogo hi sādhyatayā'vagamyamānaḥ prathamānvayino'dhikāriṇo "mamāyaṃ niyogaḥ" iti pratipatturniyoganirvṛttisamarthe dhātvarthe kartranvayamantareṇānupapadyamānastadanvayamarthāpattyā pratipādayati, ityadhikārānvayapuraḥsaraḥ kartranvaya iti prābhākarā manyante| tatra bhavatvanupādeyaviśeṣaṇamadhikārahetuḥ, bhāvanāvāde tu punarupādeyaviśeṣaṇamapyadhikāraheturityāha -- kiṃ tu karturadhikāra ityapi sthitā nyāyavida iti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- liṅādipratyayairyadā puruṣapravṛttirbhāvanā vākyārthatayā pratipādyate, tadā pradhānākāṅkṣānimittatvāt saṃbandhasya, kriyāyāśca svarūpopādhitvena kartṛkaraṇakarmāpekṣaṇīyatvāt, puruṣārthadhātvarthayośca bhāvyatatkaraṇatvenānvayāt pariśeṣāt svargakāmādayaḥ kartṛtvenānvīyante| tataśca kartṛviśeṣaṇatayā tanniyamārthāni jīvanagṛhadāhatvenānvayāt pariśeṣāt svargakāmādayaḥ kartṛtvenānvayaṃ pratipādya kartṛreva phalasambandhād "madīyamidaṃ phalasādhanaṃ karme"ti karmasvāmitvalakṣaṇamadhikārānvayaṃ paścādanubhavati| karmaphalabhoktṛtvameva hi karmaṇi svāmyanvaya iti| tataśca kartṛviśeṣaṇānyeva tasyaiva phalabhoktṛtayā karmaṇi svāmyanvayaṃ niyamayantīti kartṛradhikārasthitiḥ| evaṃ bhāvanā vākyārthopādānenāpi māṇavakasyādhikārasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ| athavā yathā rājasūye rājatvaṃ kartṛviśeṣaṇamanyenādhikāriṇā rājatvasya kartṛviśeṣaṇatayā sampādayitumaśakyatvādadhikāriviśeṣaṇamapi sampadyate, tadvadihāpi syāditi| nanu -- nāyaṃ parihāra upapadyate; śreyaḥsādhanasya liṅgādipratyayairvākyārthatvenābhidhīyamānatvāt, tasya ca prathamamadhikārānvayāpekṣatvāt, katham śreyo hi bhoktāramapekṣate, atastatsādhanamapi bhoktranvayi bhavati; "kasyedaṃ śreyaḥsādhanam mamedamabhilāṣitasādhanami"ti ca svāmyanvayākāṅkṣādarśanāt, "kasyāyaṃ niyogaḥ", mamāyamitivat, bhāvanā tu kriyā kartrāśrayatayā'vagamyamānā tamapekṣate| nanu kṛtiyogyameva śreyaḥsādhanaṃ vidhiḥ; karturiṣṭābhyupāyo vidhirityabhyupagamāt, tataśca kṛtiḥ kartāramapekṣata iti, tarhi niyogasyāpi kāryatayā'vagamāt kṛtinimittakartranvaya eva syāt| nanu -- kṛtirniyogopasarjanatayaiva śabdenābhidhīyate; nacopasarjanākāṅkṣayā padārthānvayaḥ, kintu pradhānakāṅkṣayā; tataśca pradhānaniyogākāṅkṣayā prathamamadhikārānvayaḥ -- iti, samānametadiṣṭasādhane'pi; kṛterupasarjanatayā'bhidhānāt| nanu śreyaso'pyupasarjanatvāt tatsāmarthyalabhyabhoktranvayaḥ kathaṃ sādhanasya syāt naiṣa doṣaḥ; sādhanatvasvarūpopādhitvāñchreyasaḥ, tasya ca niyamena bhoktranvayāt kartṛbhoktṛsādhāraṇaśya sādhanasya svopādhiśreyo'nusāreṇa bhoktranvayaniyamasiddheḥ| tasmād mamābhilaṣitasādhanamiti prathamamadhikārānvayo vākyārthabhūtena vidhinā śreyaḥsādhanenāpekṣyate paścādabhilaṣitasādhanatvasyāśraye dhātvarthaviṣaye vidhisāmarthyādeva kartranvayaṃ pratipadyata iti| evamapi tatra na virodha ityāha -- kiceha na māṇavako jātivayoviśiṣṭa upādeva iti|| yadaivopanayanādhyayanādimāṇavakavyāpārasya sāmānyenābhilaṣitasādhanatvalakṣaṇo vidhiḥ śabdena pratipādyate, tadā sāmānyasya śreyoviśeṣākāṅkṣāyāṃ paramparayā puruṣārthasādhanamupanayanasaṃskāraṃ māṇavakagataṃ śreyoviśeṣaṃ parikalpya tatsādhanatvalakṣaṇo vidhirmāṇavakavyāpāre pratipādito bhavati; tataḥ saṃskāraphalabhoktṛtayā vidhau māṇavakaḥ svāmitvenānveti; tatra ca svāminiyamārthaṃ brāhmaṇyādiviśeṣaṇaṃ tasyaiva paścādabhilaṣitasādhanatvaviṣaye māṇavakavyāpāre kartranvayaṃ niyamayatīti granthārthaḥ| nanu prayojakavyāpāraviṣayatayā kartṛtvenaivānvayo vākyātpratipannaḥ, satyam, tatra vidhisaṃbandhasāmarthyād bhoktranvayaṃ pratipadya kartranvayaniyamaḥ kalpyate|| nanu evamapyadhyayanasya na sādhikāratāsiddhiriti, tatrāha -- tadevamupanayanasyādhyayanārthatvāditi|| prasiddhaṃ ca sarvasmṛtiśāstreṣūpanayamadhyayanāṅgamiti| vājasaneyināṃ copanayanaṃ prakṛtyadhyayanaṃ vidhīyate| vidhidvayasāmarthye copādānapramāṇadarśitam| ihāpi "tamadhyāpayīte"tyupanītaṃ tacchabdena parāmṛśati, aṅgāṅginoścaikādhikāratvādupanīto brāhmaṇo'dhīyīteti saṃpadyate; aṅgādhikāranimittasya kālasya sarvatrāṅginyanvayaniyamābhāvād vayaso nādhyayanādhikāranimittateti| nanu nityādhikāreṇādhyayanavidhinā'rthāvabodho bhāvyatāmiti, netyāha -- akṣaragrahaṇamātreṇa ceti|| nanu sakṛdadhyayanādeva nityādhyayanavidhisiddherāvṛttiḥ kena labhyate arthāvabodhaphalapakṣe vā kathaṃ labhyate phalāvasānānupapatteriti cet, ihāpi samānam; akṣarāvāpteḥ phalatvāt| nanu adṛṣṭameva vidhiphalamityuktam, samānamarthāvabodhapakṣe'pi|| nanu -- adṛṣṭasamavāyidṛṣṭaṃ phalamarthāvabodhaḥ, tasya cākṣarasvīkaraṇavicārādyapekṣatvāt tadarthamāvṛttisiddhiḥ -- iti, na, śākhāntarīyapaurūṣeyavākyebhyo'pyabhyastīkṛtebhyo'rthāvabodhadarśanād na tadarthamāvṛttyapekṣā yuktā, japasvādhyāyavidhisāmarthyāccākṣarasvīkaraṇāyāvṛttiḥ kalpyate, nārthāvabodhasāmarthyāt| adhyayanaśabda eva vā'dhīyamānāvāptiparyantavyāpārasya mukhyayā vṛttyā'bhidhāyakaḥ sakṛduccāraṇādau, gauṇa ityāvṛttisiddhiriti| nanu vedasyaivānyanirapekṣatayā vicārahetutvaṃ vadan bhāṣyakāro'dhyayanavidhereva vicārahetutvamāheti codayati -- nanu caivamadhītīto veda iti|| satyam, vicārasya prayojakottaravidhipradarśanadvāreṇa vicārahetuḥ svādhyāyaḥ, nādhyayanavidhividheyatādvāreṇeti pariharati -- satyam, tathaiva tadityādinā|| nanu svādhyāyādāpātapratipannottaravidhiraniścitaḥ kathaṃ vicāraṃ prayuṅkta iti tadāha -- adhītavedo hyavaśyakaraṇīyānīti|| āpātapratipannānāmuttaranityavidhīnāmanuṣṭheyanirṇayajñānasāpekṣatvāt tannirṇayāya vicāraprayojakatvamiti| kāmyavākyavicāramapyādhānavat phalakāmanaiva prayuṅkte| nanu anekavidhiprayuktikalpanād varamadhyayanavidhiprayuktikalpanaṃ vicārasya, na; vidheyatadupakārivyatiriktasya vicārasyāprayojakatvādadhyayanavidherityuktatvād arthāvabodhaphalatvābhāvāt, avaghātāvṛttivat phalāpekṣayā'pi na vicāravidhirityuktatvāt, uttaravidhividheyopakāritvād vicārasya tatprayuktiḥ sambhavati| prativākyaṃ nirṇayajñānabhedācca vidhibhedo na virudhyate; anyathā yāgādyanuṣṭhānasyāpyadhyayanavidhiprayojyatvaṃ syāt, svargādisiddhiparyantatvādadhyayanavidhiphalasya| nanu adhyayanamapyuttaravidhiprayuktaṃ syāt, adhyayanamantareṇa vicāranirṇāyakatvānuṣṭhānādyasiddhiriti, tatrāha -- ataḥ prāgadhyayanādapratipatteriti|| prāgadhyayanāduttaravidhīnāmapratipatternādhyayanaprayojakatvamityarthaḥ| adhyayanavidhiśca sandhyopāsanādividhivat pitrādibhyaḥ śrūyamāṇaḥ pravartayati| naca sakalottaravidhīnāmadhyayanāt prāk śravaṇaṃ sambhavatītyuktam| astu tarhi brahmajñānasyāpi traivarṇikādhikṛtottaranityavidhiprayukta eva vicāra iti, netyāha -- na tathā brahmajñānamiti|| naca dharmabrahmavibhāgasidhyarthaṃ nityāgnihotrādividhireva brahma vicārayati; āpātadarśanenaiva viviktabhūtavastuviṣayatvāt| "tasmādi"tyavāntaraprakaraṇopasaṃhāraḥ| "tadevami"ti mahāprakaraṇopasaṃhāraḥ|| nanu -- "oṃkāraścāthaśabdaśca dvāvetau brahmaṇo mukhāt| kaṇṭhaṃ bhitvā viniryātau tasmānmāṅgalikāvubhau||" iti maṅgalārthatvādathaśabdasya śāstrārambhe ca śiṣṭācāraparipālanāya vighnopaśāntaye ca maṅgalācaraṇaṃ kartavyam, iti tadartho'thaśabda iti, netyāha -- maṅgalasyāpīti|| na tāvanmaṅgalaṃ brahmajijñāsāyāḥ kartṛkaraṇakarmabhāvena vākyārthe'nveti; kartrādyanyatamabhāve pramāṇābhāvāt, kārakāntarāṇāṃ vidyamānatvācca| nāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvayaḥ -- "brahmajijñāsā maṅgalami"ti; praśaṃsāparatayā'rthavādatvaprasaṅgāt| nanu kartavyameva maṅgalācaraṇamiti, tatrāha -- śrutimātropayogāditi|| nanu prakṛtādarthādarthāntaravivakṣayā'pyathaśabdaḥ prayujyate, yathā'rthāntare'bhihite'rthāntare'bhihite'rthāntaravivakṣayā bravīti -- "athaivaṃ manyase" iti, tadartho'thaśabda iti codayati -- nanu prakriyamāṇāditi|| hetuphalabhāvenānantaryābhidhāne prakṛtādarthādarthāntaratvamantarṇītatayā sidhyati, iti na pṛthagvaktavyamiti pariharati -- nānantaryād vyatiricyata iti|| nanu arthāntaratvamevābhidhāyānantaryamantarṇītaṃ kimiti na gṛhyate iti codayati -- kathamiti|| tatra kiṃ niyamena pūrvavṛttatayā hetubhūto vastuviśeṣo'vadyotyate kiṃ vā yatkiṃcidvastu pūrvavṛttamapekṣyata iti tatra na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ; ānantaryābhidhānamantareṇa hetutayā pūrvavṛttavastuviśeṣaniyamāsiddherityāha -- evam tatprakiyamāṇasya niyamena pūrvavṛttamiti|| athottaraḥ kalpaḥ tatrāha -- anyathā yasmin kasmiṃściditi|| nanu ānantarye'pi hetutayā pūrvavṛttaṃ nāvagamyate, satyam; puṣkalakāraṇāt phalasyānantaryameva mukhyaṃ bhavati; avyavadhānāt, avyabhicārācca, ahetuphalayostvānantarya kadācid vyabhicarati kadācid vyavadhīyate ca, iti gauṇameva syāt| tasmād mukhyānantaryābhidhānena pūrvavṛtte puṣkalakāraṇe'vadyotite, arthāntarabhāvo'pyantarbhavati, nārthāntarābhidhāne mukhyamānantaryamantarbhavatītyupasaṃharati -- ato hetubhūto'rtho'pekṣitavya iti|| ukte'rthe bhāṣyamavatārayati -- tadetadāheti|| nanu phalaṃ ced dṛśyate, kiṃ puṣkalakāraṇāvagamena na; adhikāriviśeṣaṇatvena phalaparyantecchāyā vicārādi pravṛttau pratipattyapekṣatvādityāha -- sati cānantaryārthatva iti || nanu prajñātameva pūrvavṛttaṃ dharmajijñāsā ityāśaṅkyāha -- svādhyāyādhyayanānantaryaṃ tu samānamiti|| bhāṣyārthe vivṛṇoti -- yena vinā niyamenetyādinā|| yojanāntaramāha -- athaveti|| na puṣkalakāraṇamityarthaḥ|| nanu ekādhyayanavidhiprayuktasvādhyāyādhyayanasyaikamokṣaprayojanatve vaktavye'dhyayanavidhiprayuktatvābhāve'pi kṛtsnavedārthavicārasyaikaphalaprayuktatvād dharmabrahmavicārayoranyonyopakāryopakārakabhāvenaikaphalaśeṣatvādupakārakadharmāvabodhānantaryamupakāryabrahmāvabodhasyocyata iti codayati -- nanviha karmāvabodhānantarya viśeṣa iti|| dharmabrahmavicārayorupakāryopakārakabhāvaṃ darśayati -- tathā ca vṛttyantare varṇitamiti|| adhikāraḥ-pravṛttiḥ| saṃskāraḥ-phalam| pravṛttiparamparayā phalaparamparayā cetyarthaḥ| athavā "saṃskāraḥ" iti karmabhiḥ puruṣasaṃskāro'bhidhīyate| "śabdataḥ" iti ca tatra pramāṇamucyata iti| adhigatānantaram-dharmādhigatyanantaramityarthaḥ| asminnarthe śāstrakārasaṃvādāntaramāha -- anyairapi svavṛttau varṇitamityādinā|| ekaphalavattvaṃ tāvat tiṣṭhatu, na tāvad dharmabrahmajijñāsayorupakāryopakārakabhāva ityāha -- 2na; dharmajijñāsāyāḥ prāgapyadhītavedāntasyeti|| bhāṣyaṃ vivṛṇoti -- || na vedāntādhyayanaṃ yadyapītyādanā|| nanu dharmajijñāsāyāṃ vyutpannavedapramāṇyapadapadārthavākyārtha tadapekṣitanyāyasyaiva brahma vicārayituṃ śakyam, iti codayati -- kathamiti| anupakāraṃ darśayituṃ dharmajijñāsāṃ vibhajate -- tatra tāvaddharmajijñāsāyāṃ trayaṃ vṛttamiti|| kiṃ taditi tadāha -- dvādaśalakṣaṇa ityādinā|| tatra nyāyasahasrasyānupakāraṃ darśayituṃ nyāyamapi vibhajate -- tatra yaḥ prathamasūtra ityādinā|| adhyayanavidherdṛṣṭārthāvabodhaphalaparyantatāpekṣito nyāyo'thaśabdasūcitaḥ, prathamena pādena ca yāvān vedaprāmāṇyāpekṣito nyāyaḥ, sūcita eva, kutaḥ prathamapādāpekṣeti satyam; aṅgīkṛtyaitaduktamiti na virodhaḥ| nanu śrutiliṅgādipramāṇānāmihāpyapekṣyamāṇatvāditaro'pi nyāyaḥ pūrvavṛttatayā'pekṣita iti, netyāha -- itarasya tu punariti|| utpattiviniyogaprayogādhikāravidhikāryāpekṣito hi nyāyastatra pratipāditaḥ| nacānanuṣṭheyabhūtavastupratipādane'sānupayujyate; kāryārthasāmye'pi pratyadhyāyamavāntaraprameyabhedena nyāyabhedo'pekṣyate, kimu vaktavyamakāryabhūtavastuprameyabheda iti bhāvaḥ| śrutyādayastu lokaprasiddhā evopādīyante| nanu kāryaśeṣatayā brahmāpi tatra nirṇītamiti, netyāha -- yato na nirastāśeṣeti|| apratijñātasyāpyapekṣitanyāyo'nyārthatvena darśita iti, netyāha -- na tatpratipādana iti|| nanu guṇopasaṃhāreṇa vidhyapekṣito'pi nyāya upajīvya iti, tatrāha -- yatpunaḥ prathamamantrasiddheti|| nanu saguṇavidyā'pi jñānameveti ata āha -- tatra ca mānasī kriyeti|| tadevamityupasaṃhāraḥ|| mā bhūd dharmajijñāsānantaryamathaśabdārthaḥ, vedaprāmāṇyavicārānantaryaṃ syāditi, netyāha -- yatpunaḥ svādhyāyasyārthāvabodhopayoga iti|| na ca "vedāḥ pramāṇami"tyetāvatā brahmavicāre'nekāyāsabahule kaścitpravartata ityarthaḥ| tarhi dharmanirṇayajñānaṃ brahmajijñāsādhikāraheturiti, netyāha -- yaḥ punariti|| upabhujyamāno dharmanirṇayo brahmavicārapravṛttuyapayogī syāt kiṃ vā brahmanirṇayopayogī iti vaktavyam na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpa ityāha -- na hyanyaviṣayaṃ jñānamiti|| nāpi dvitīya ityāha -- tadapīha nāstīti|| kāryakāraṇasaṃbandhe prapañcenāpi brahmānumānād na dharmanirṇayāpakṣeti bhāvaḥ| pariśeṣāt karmaṇāmupayoga ityāha -- ataḥ karmaṇāmupayogaḥ pariśiṣyata iti|| tadapi na sambhavati keṣu citpakṣeṣviti bhāvaḥ| tatrādhikāraparamparā brahmajñānopakāraśca na sambhavatītyāha -- keyamadhikāraparampareti|| nanu anuṣṭhānaparampareyam, tathāhi -- saṃdhyopāsanamārabhya pūrvapūrvālpatarakarmaprahāṇenottarottaramahattarakarmopādānāt sahasrasaṃvatsarairniratiśaye karmaṇyavasitaḥ pariśeṣād brahmajñāne'vataratīti, netyāha -- yathā tāvat prāsādamārurukṣoriti|| uttarakarmopādānāt pūrvakarmaparityāge pariśeṣād brahmajñānāvatāre ca prāmāṇābhāvāditi| tarhi paramparayā kṛtsnakarmaphalāvāptau, tatra kāmanābhāvānnivṛttakāmaḥ paramānandakāmanayā tatrāvataratītyāśaṅkate -- atha kāmopahatamanā iti|| tadeva prapañcayati -- tathāca sārvabhaumatyādīti|| adhikāraparamparayā-phalaparamparayetyarthaḥ| pariharati -- karmānuṣṭhānānantaryaṃ tarhi vaktavyamiti|| karmānuṣṭhānaphalaprāptyanantarabhāvitvād brahmavicārasya na manuṣyādhikāraṃ śāstraṃ syādityarthaḥ| kiṃca karmāṇyapi brahmajñānasyānyathopakurvanti, na kāmapravilayanadvāreṇetyāha -- kathaṃ vā kāmāvāptiḥ kāmopaśamaheturiti|| satyamityataḥ prāktanaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| hairaṇyagarbhādibhogānāṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ kṣīyamāṇatvādanāgatabhoganicayakāmanopapatterna kāmavilayanena brahmajñāne'vatāra ityāha -- satyaṃ yuktam; yadi hairaṇyagarbho bhoga iti|| kutastarhi sarveṣāṃ kāmavilaya iti tadāha -- ato viṣayasya kṣayādidoṣadarśanāditi|| "tasmāt sarvatre"tyupasaṃharati|| kiṃca nikhilaviṣayāptau kāmopaśamaḥ śāstrasāmarthyāducyate kiṃvā'nvayavyatirekasāmarthyāt nādya ityāha -- nacaivaṃlakṣaṇa āgama iti|| tarhyanvayavyatirekasāmarthyāditi codayati -- nanu kāmāvāptāviti|| parihāragranthastu spaṣṭārthaḥ|| vaidikaśabdāḥ sarve saṃbhūya dehātmatvādiprapañcapravilayapramitiparā iti tṛtīyo'dhikāraḥ| sa ca pratītivirodhādeva nirasta iti|| nanu tarhi karmāṇyanuṣṭhīyamānāni puruṣasaṃskāratayā brahmajñānakāryāṇi, ato dharmānuṣṭhānānantaraṃ brahmajijñāseti codayati -- bhavatu tarhi saṃskāradvāreṇeti|| nanu -- "sarvaṃ ete puṇyalokā bhavantī"ti svatantrapuruṣārthasādhanānāṃ karmaṇāṃ kathaṃ saṃskārakarmatayā prokṣaṇādivad guṇakarmatā smṛtisāmarthyāditi cet, na; śrutivirodhāt| nanu -- saṃskāro nāma guṇādhānaṃ malāpakarṣo vā tatra "dharmeṇa pāpamapanudati" "yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvā''tmaśuddhaye" iti cātmani malāpakarṣasaṃskāraḥ sidhyati, vidhyanyathānupapattyā vā''tmanyapūrvaguṇādhānaṃ gamyate| ataḥ śrutyavagatameva saṃskārakarmatvam; "idaṃ me'nenāṅgaṃ saṃskriyate" iti ca śruteḥ| naca kratvaṅgadravyasaṃskāratayā nityakarmaṇāmitikartavyatocyate, yena svatantraphalavirodhaḥ syāt, kintu dravyārjanavidhivadupakāramātramiti, satyam; pāpakṣayāpūrvalakṣaṇasaṃskārādabhyudayaphale śrutyavagate na brahmajñānaśeṣatā śakyā'vadhārayitum; smṛtisāmarthyāt -- iti, ucyate; nityanaimittikakarmānuṣṭhānaiḥ saṃskṛtasyātmano yadi śravaṇamananadhyānābhyāsādīni jñānasādhanāni sampadyante, tadā saṃskārakarmāṇi sahakāriviśeṣādātmajñānamavatārayanti, yadā tu sahakārikāraṇavirahaḥ, tadā'bhyudayaphalamiti vyavasthopapatterna śrutismṛtyoḥ parasparavirodhaḥ| nanu "yasyaite'ṣṭācatvāriṃśat saṃskārāḥ" ityataḥ "sa brahmaṇaḥ sāyujyaṃ sālokyaṃ ca gacchatī"ti sālokyaliṅgād hiraṇyagarbhāvāptiḥ saṃskārakarmaṇāṃ phalaṃ gamyate, na parabrahmāvāptiḥ, yena sahakārisāmarthyāt karmaṇāṃ puruṣasaṃskāradvāreṇa mokṣaphalatā syāt, ucyate; -- saṃskāraśabdastāvad dadhivrīhisaṃskāravat svatantraphalasādhanāṅgabhūtadravyaśeṣatāṃ karmaṇāṃ pratipādayati| tatra sarvakarmaṇāṃ saṃskāratayā'nvayāt pariśeṣārthapattyā tattvajñānaśeṣatayā mokṣaphalatā kalpyate; "brahmaṇaḥ sāyujyaṃ sālokyami"ti ca phaladvayopādānāt; tathāhi bhagavān -- "sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ" "siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathā''pnoti nibodha me" iti coktvā, "budhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyā''tmānaṃ niyamya ca| dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ| tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram||" iti ca bruvan nityakarmabhiḥ saṃskṛtasya siddhiśabdābhidheyaviśuddhāntaḥkaraṇasya dhyānayogādisahakārisampattau tattvajñānajanmadvāreṇa mokṣaṃ -- darśayati| "sve sve karmaṇī"ti ca nityakarmāṇyucyante| saṃsiddhiśabdena cātmavaimalyaṃ brahmajñānayogyatāpattirucyate; paramasiddheruttaratrābhidhānāt, "yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvā''tmaśuddhaye" ityuktatvācca| tathā "mahāyajñaiśca yajñaiśca brāhmīyaṃ kriyate tanuḥ" "jñānamutpadyate puṃsāṃ kṣayāt pāpasya karmaṇaḥ" "kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravartate" iti ca| tasmāt saṃskāraśabdasāmarthyāt smṛtyantarācca nityakarmāṇi malāpakarṣaguṇādhānalakṣaṇapuruṣasaṃskāradvāreṇātmajñānayogyatāmāpādya, tattvajñānajanakatayā mokṣe jñānena saha samuccīyante; yathā vrīhiprokṣaṇādīni saṃskārakarmāṇi darśapūrṇamāsasvarūpotpattihetutayā svarge samuccīyanta iti|| nanu prokṣaṇādivadekādhikāritayā guṇakarmataiva nityakarmaṇāṃ prāptā, na; brahmajñānasyāvidheyatvāt, ātmanaḥ saṃskriyamāṇasya vidheyakarmaguṇatvābhāvāt| na tarhi saṃskārakarmatā; vihitāṅgadravyasaṃskārakarmasu tatprasiddheḥ; na; avihitabhojanāṅgadadhisaṃskāraprasiddheḥ| nanu vidhyupaddeśe karaṇatayā vihitānāṃ nityakarmaṇāṃ karaṇatāvirodhinā dadhyādisaṃskāravadātmajñānetikartavyatayā prāptā, naiṣa doṣaḥ; agniṃ citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta" "vājapeyenoṣṭhvā bṛhaspatisavena yajete"ti sautrāmaṇīṃ bṛhaspatisavayoranyatra karaṇatayā svatantravidhyantaravihitayoragnicayanavājapeyāṅgatayetikartavyatādarśanāt| tatra karaṇetikartavyatāvidhivākyapramāṇabhedāt yuktaṃ sautrāmaṇyāderubhayathātvamiti cet, satyam; arthavirodhābhāve sati nityavidhisāmarthyāt saṃskārasmṛtyanumitaśrutisāmarthyācca karaṇatayā saṃskāratayā ca svatantraphalaśeṣatā''tmajñānetikartavyatā cetyubhayathātvamihāpi kalpyatām| nacānyārthadravyasaṃskāramātratvāditikartavyatā; ādhāne'darśanāt| saṃskṛtāgneruddeśyatvād tatrānaṅgateti cet, ihāpi saṃskṛtaṃ viśuddhāntaḥkaraṇaṃ viraktaṃ vividiṣumuddiśya jñānasādhanavidhānādavirodhaḥ| pratyakṣeṇa viśuddhiṃ pratyakpravaṇatāṃ ca cittasya karmaphalamavagacchan janmāntarānuṣṭhitaṃ karmānumāya jñānasyāntaraṅgasādhaneṣu pravartiṣyata iti| tasmād yathaiva svatantravidhyantaravihitadravyārjanasya sahakārikāraṇasampattibhedāt kratubhogayoḥ śeṣatvam, tadvannityakarmaṇāmapi sahakāribhedādātmajñānābhyudayayoḥ śeṣatvaṃ na virudhyata iti| yo'pi kaścit sarvasaṃskāravādī vedāntārthasūkṣmadūrīkṛtavijñāno vedāntārthadūṣako na saṃskārārthāni nityāni karmāṇīti vakti, sa śāstrārthavibhāgajñānaśūnyatvādupekṣaṇīya iti| athavā -- sarvāṇyeva karmāṇyutpattividhivihitāni saṃyogabhedena jīvanakāmanādyadhikāravidhyantaravad "brahmānubhavakāmo yajñādīnyanutiṣṭhedi"tyadhikārāntaravidhividheyāni bhaviṣyantītyāha -- yajñena dānenetyādinā|| katham ātmatattvāparokṣānubhavastāvadiṣyamāṇatayā svargādivadbhāvanāsādhyo'vagamyate; puruṣārthatvāt, śābdajñāne tu saṃjāte tatkāmanāyogāt, asaṃjāte viṣayānavagamādeva tatra kāmanāyogāt śabdāvagate'parokṣajñānamiṣyata iti yuktam| tacca prayatnāntarasādhyamiti purastād darśitam| tatra yajñādīnāmicchopasarjanatayā''khyātasamīritabhāvanākaraṇatayā'vagatānāṃ sādhyenaivānvayād yajñādīni brahmānubhavasādhanānyavagatāni| tataśca -- "ātmānubhavakāmo yajñādīnyanutiṣṭhedi"ti vidhiḥ pariṇamate| nacecchāmātreṇa saṃyogaḥ; tasyā asādhyamānatāvagamāt| naca "vividiṣantī"ti vartamānatāvirodhaḥ, leṭparigraheṇa vidherevāvagamāt| naca nitya kāmyavikārāntaravirodhaḥ; ekasya karmaṇo'nekādhikāravidhisambandhāvagamāt| nanu kuṇḍapāyināmayane "māsamagnihotraṃ juhvatī"tyagnihotrasya prakaraṇāntaratvāt prasiddhāgnihotrāt karmāntaratvavad vividiṣāvākyasya ca prakaraṇāntaratvād na prasiddhāgnihotrādīnāmatra viniyogaḥ kalpayituṃ śakyate; ataḥ karmāntarāṇyevehotpattyadhikārābhyāṃ saha vidhīyante, naitadyuktam; kuṇḍapāyināmayane'gnihotraśabdasyālaukikābhidhānatvādākhyātaparatantratayā taduktārthābhidhāyinaḥ svātantryeṇa pradeśāntaravihitāgnihotraparāmarśakatvānupapatterākhyātasya ca juhoteḥ sāmānyavācinaḥ svasannihitaḥ kārakāginirūpitaṃ karmāntaraṃ vihāya vyavahitāgnihotraparāmarśitvāyogāt karmāntarameva māsaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ nidhīyata ityuktam, iha tvadhyayanayajñadānatapo'nāśakaśabdānāṃ laukikābhidhānatayā svātantryāt pradeśāntaravihitādhyayanādiparāmarśopapattestānyeva karmāṇi saṃyogabhedena vidhīyanta ityupapadyate|| nanu evamapi brahmajñānaṃ dṛṣṭapramāṇasāmagrījanyatvād nādṛṣṭamapekṣate; sati pramāṇakāraṇe yajñādyabhāvād jñānodayādarśanābhāvāt, naitat, dṛṣṭakāraṇaklṛptau anvayavyatirekapramāṇāntarbhūtatvāt kevalavyatirekasya tadapekṣā yujyate, iha tu mukhasya dṛṣṭakāraṇasampattau kevalavyatirekābhāve'pi vidhānādevādṛṣṭasāpekṣatvavat samyagjñāne'pi vidhānādevādṛṣṭasāpekṣatvamupapadyate| nanu -- karmaṇāṃ vijñāne viniyogadvārābhāvād vijñānaphale mokṣe viniyogaḥ kalpyate -- iti, ucyate; -- yathā yāgādikarmaṇāṃ svargādyuddeśena vihitānāṃ tadupapattaye vidhisāmarthyādeva madhyavartyapūrvāṇi kalpyante, evamihāpyantaḥkaraṇaśuddhicittaikāgryādidvāraṃ kalpyatāmiti| kiñca -- sākṣācchrutaḥ jñānasādhanatvānupapattau tatphalasādhanatvakalpanād varaṃ paramparayā'pi tatsādhanatvakalpanam, karaṇavibhakteḥ "kāṣṭheḥ pacatī"ti paramparayā sādhane'pi darśanāt, phalasādhanatve'pi tadayogāt| nacāsmin vākye yajñādisādhyo mokṣaḥ śrūyate, ātmā tu jñākarmatayā tatsādhyo'vagamyate, na yajñādisādhyaḥ| kiñca -- pramāṇāntaravirodhaṃ parihṛtyaiva śrutaparityāgenāśrutakalpanā yuktā, asti ca "nānyā panthā vidyate" "na karmaṇā na prajaye"tyādinā karmaṇāṃ mokṣasādhanatvaniṣedhaḥ| kiñca -- paramparayā sādhanatvakalpanā pramāṇāntaramadhyanutaratītyāha -- yena kenacana yajetetyādi|| antaḥkaraṇaśuddhiparavākyajātopalakṣaṇārthaḥ| nanu -- viśuddhidvāreṇa jñānahotutve saṃskāravividiṣāpakṣayoḥ ko vivekaḥ ucyate -- śravaṇamananadhyānābhyāsādisahakārikāraṇasampattāveva saṃskāro vijñānaṃ sādhayati, tadabhāve satyabhyudayameva, vividiṣāyāṃ tu vijñānasya karmaphalatvāt phalaparyantaṃ sādhanāni vijñānaṃ janayantīti viśeṣaḥ| atra kaścidvedānte'pi sarvasaṃkaravādī bhedābhedamukharatājaḍavacano vividiṣāvākyādeva karmaṇāṃ mokṣasādhanatvaṃ kalpayati, sa ca nyāyāgamābhijñānaśūnyatvādupekṣyata iti| "aśvena
