jigamiṣatī"tyatrāśvasya punarāvṛttiparyantatā'pi kvacid dṛṣṭā, iti nāsau karmaṇāṃ mokṣasādhanatve dṛṣṭāntaḥ| nyāyāgamābhyāṃ tu jñānameva sadvāraṃ sādhyamityuktam, vyavahitaphaleṣu karmasu na phalaparyantamanuṣṭhānaprāptiḥ; cittasya pratyakpravaṇatādvāraphalamavagamyoparamasiddherityevaṃ varṇite pūrvavādinā, siddhāntayati -- satyamevam; yadi samānajanmānuṣṭhitameveti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- pravṛttiparyantecchodayaprabhṛtyanubhavaparyantaviṣaye pravṛtyadhikāropādhitayā pūrvakṣaṇe pratipattavyādhikāriviśeṣaṇapratipādanārtho'yamathaśabdaḥ| tatrājñātatayaivānekajanmavyavahitaphalahetuṣu karmasu phalapravṛttisamakālapratipattyanapekṣeṣu na tatpratipattyartho'pyathaśabda iti| nanu -- samānajanmānuṣṭhitakarmāvagamo'pi brahmajijñāsādhikāraheturbhavati; etajjanmaprayuktatvādṛṇasambandhasya, apākṛtarṇatrayasyaiva ca mokṣādhikārāditi, tatrāha -- etena ṛṇāpākaraṇadvāreṇāpīti|| nanu -- "ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niveṣayet| anapākṛtya mokṣaṃ tu sevamāno vrajatyadhaḥ"|| iti smaryate, satyam; śrutivirodhādapasmṛtirityāha -- tathāca śrutismṛtī "yadi vetarathā brahmacaryādeve"ti|| nanu -- "jāyamāno vai brāhmaṇastribhirṛṇavā jāyate" iti śrutirasti, satyam; arthavādo vidhiśrutivirodhe bādhyate| kiñca ṛṇaśabdena putrayajñabrahmacaryāṇyevocyante kiṃ vā tadvidhaya iti na tāvad jāyamānasya putrādisambandho yujyate; yogyānupalabdhivirodhāt, nāpi tadvidhisambandhaḥ; vidhipratipattisāmarthyavikalasyādhikārābhāvāt, sāmarthyasya cādhikāriviśeṣaṇatvāt| gṛhastho jāyamānastribhirṛṇavā jāyata iti cet, na; tathā kalpanāyāṃ "gṛhāt pravrajedi"ti vidhivirodhāt| tatrāpi ca putrādijanmasambandhitayā gṛhasthajanmani yogyānupalabdhivirodhaḥ samānaḥ| naca putrādividhyanuṣṭhānasāmarthyābhāvād gṛhasthajanmasamaye tadvidhisambandho yujyate| janmārabhya putrādyadhikārasampatteḥ prāgvirodhividhyantarasambandhaparihārārthamidaṃ vacanamiti cet, na; tathākalpanāyāṃ saṃnyāsavidhyantaravirodhāt| tasmādarthavādamātrametat| nanu "brahmacaryaṃ samāpya gṛhī bhavedi"ti vidhivirodhe kathaṃ brahmacaryādeva saṃnyāso vidhīyate na; viraktamumukṣuviṣayatvāt saṃnyāsasya sāmānyavidhivirodhābhāvāt| nanu karmānadhikṛtāndhapaḍgvādiviṣayaḥ saṃnyāsaḥ kiṃ na syāt na; "brahmacaryāt gṛhād vanādvā pravrajedi"tyaviśeṣaśravaṇāt, "atha punaravratī vā vratī vā asnātako vā snātako votsannāgniko ve"tyanadhikāriṇāmāśrambhyaḥ pṛthageva saṃnyāsādhikāritvenopādānāt, andhādīnāmapi putrapañcamahāyajñādikarmādhikārādanadhikṛtatvāsiddheḥ, andhādīnāmapyaviraktānāṃ saṃnyāsānadhikārāt tadeva saṃnyāsanimittam| "śarīraṃ me vicarṣaṇam| jihvā me madhumattamā| karṇābhyāṃ bhūri viśruvam|" "annaṃ prāṇaṃ cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ mano vācami"tyādinā''tmajñānāya śarīrendriyādipāṭavasya prārthyamānatvāt, ātmajñānaśeṣatvācca saṃnyāsasya "dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādani"tyādismṛteśca paṭutarendriyasyaiva saṃnyāsādhikāraḥ| sarvatrātmajñānaprakaraṇe saṃnyāsasya vihitatvāt śravaṇādyaṅgatayā''tmajñānaphalatā ca saṃnyāsasya siddhā| kathaṃ punaḥ karmaṇāṃ tattyāgasya cātmajñānaphalatā śakyā'vadhārayitum ṣoḍaśigrahaṇayoriva kratvaṅgatayeti vadāmaḥ| krameṇa vā karmatattyāgayorātmajñānopakāritayā samuccayaḥ kalpyate; dvāropakārabhedāt, nibarhaṇīyakalmaṣasyācānantatvāt| brahmakṣatrādibhedena vā vyavasthā kalpyate|| kiyatpunaratra parityajyate svaśarīravyatiriktaṃ sarvam| nanu upavītādi na tyāgamarhati, na; agnihotrādibhiraviśeṣāt| nanu saṃnyāsakratvaṅgatayā karmaparityāge'pyupavītādi paścādupādīyatām, na; jābālaśrutau "pravrajedi"tyagnihotrādibhiraviśeṣāt sahopavītādinā kṛtsnaparityāgaṃ vidhāya -- "atha parivrāḍ vivarṇavāsā muṇḍo'parigrahaḥ" ityāśramadharmavidhisamaye -- "ayajñopavīti kathaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ" iti praśnapūrvakam -- "idamevāsya tad yajñopavītaṃ ya ātme"tyevakāreṇa brāhmayajñopavītādi vyāvartya, ātmana eva yajñopavītatvasampādanāt|| atra sarvasaṅkaravādī -- purastād yajñopavītatyāgasyānirdiṣṭatvāt -- "brāhmaṇaḥ kathamayajñopavītī"ti praśnasya prasaṅgābhāvāt prakṣiptamidaṃ vākyamiti -- jalpati, tasya tattvadarśanatanniṣṭhaparamahaṃsaparivrājakadveṣa evāparādhyate; purastādvidhisāmarthyalabdhasarvaparityāgenopavītādityāgaprasaṅgāparijñānasya svābhāvikatvāt| tathāca -- "atha parivrāḍekaśāṭīparivīto muṇḍo darapātryaparaṇyanityo bhikṣārthī grāmaṃ praviśedāsāyaṃ pradakṣiṇenāvicikitsaṃ sārvavarṇikaṃ bhaikṣyacaryamabhidastapatitavarjamayajñopavīti śaucaniṣṭhaḥ kāmamekaṃ vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍamādadīte"ti parivrājakamevoddiśya maitrāyaṇī śrutiḥ| tathāca bodhāyano'pi -- "ata ūrdhvaṃ yajñopavītamāsanaṃ śikhā yaṣṭayaḥ śikyaṃ jalapavitraṃ kamaṇḍalupātrami"tyetāni varjayitvā'tha daṇḍamādatte sakhā mā gopāye"ti saṃnyāsādūrdhvameva darśayati| tasmādukta evātmajñānāṅgabhūtaḥ saṃnyāsaḥ| "tasmātsādhūktami"ti bhāṣyopasaṃhāraḥ|| nanu nānantaryābhidhānamukhenādhikāriviśeṣapratipattyartho'yamathaśabdaḥ, kiṃ tu tadabhidhānamukhena kramapratipattyarthaṃ iti codayati -- athāpi syānna hetutveneti|| tatra vaktavyam -- kiṃ svayameva kramaṃ pratipādayati āhosvit pramāṇāntarapratipannakramāpekṣitanyāyaṃ sūcayati iti, na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpa ityāha -- tadetadayuktam -- nyāyasūtra iti|| āgamābhāvādityarthaḥ| āgamatvābhāvādityarthaḥ| dvitīye vikalpe dharmabrahmajijñāsayoḥ kramāpekṣānimittasyaikavidhiprayuktyanuṣṭhānatvasyābhāvānna tadarthaṃ ityāha -- api caikakartṛkāṇāmityādi|| ukte'rthe bhāṣyamavatārayati -- tadidamāheti|| atra kaścit -- "dharmabrahmajijñāsayori"ti viśeṣopādānamavagacchannapi jyotiṣṭhomodgīthajñānayoradhikṛtādhikāratvaṃ khalu vidyata iti -- prativakti, sa khalu mandabhāgya eva| udgīthādyupāsanānāṃ dharmaviśeṣāṇāmeva nirūpitavidhicatuṣṭayānāṃ brahmaprakaraṇe pratyayatvasāmyāt prāsaṅgikatvena bhedādimātrasyaiva nirūpitatvāt śāstratātparyāvagamyasya brahmajñānasya karmaṇyadhikṛtādhikāritvābhāvāt| nanu mā bhūdekavidhiprayuktyanuṣṭheyatayā''kṣiptakramaviśeṣāpekṣitanyāyānusaraṇaparo'thaśabdaḥ, kiṃtvekaphalaprayuktyanuṣṭheyatayaikaprameyajijñāsyaprayuktyanuṣṭheyatayā vā sādhanadvaye kartraikyāt kramasyākṣepa ityuttarabhāṣyasyāśaṅkāmāha -- yathā''gneyādīnāmityādinā|| "cedanāpravṛttibhedācce"tyataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| ayamatrāśayaḥ -- na dharmabrahmajñānayorekaphalatve pramāṇamasti, artho'pi na yujyate, katham na tāvad vividiṣāvākyasya śabdasāmarthyanyāyaparīkṣāyāṃ samuccaye prāmāṇyamityuktam| naca "vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca yastadvedobhayaṃ sahe"ti samuccayavidhiḥ; "avidyayā mutyuṃ tīrtvā vidyayā'mṛtamaśnute" iti phalabhedāvagamāt, nāpi "tenaiti brahmavitpuṇyakṛcce"ti jñānakarmaṇorekasmin puruṣe samuccayavidhiḥ; brahmavitpuṇyakṛtoḥ puruṣayormārge samuccayāvagamāt, anvācayārthena ca cakāreṇa pratyekaṃ nirapekṣamārgānvayopapatteḥ, puṇyakṛcchabdena cā'mānavapuruṣādarcirādinā gacchatāṃ pratīkālambanānāmabhidhānāt, iṣṭādikāriṇāṃ dhūmādimārgaśravaṇācca|| naca "tānyācaratha niyataṃ satyakāmāḥ" iti samuccayavidhiravagamyate; kevalakarmaṇāmeva śravaṇāt, satyaśabdena ca "eṣa vaḥ puṇyaḥ sukṛto brahmalokaḥ" iti vākyaśeṣāt satyalokābhidhānāt, "plavā hyete adṛḍhā yajñarūpā nāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtene"ti ca karmanindayā "tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchedi"ti ca vijñānavidhānāt| "satyena labhyastapasā hyeṣa ātme"ti na samuccayavidhiḥ; tapaḥśabdasya "manasaścendriyāṇāṃ caikāgryaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ" iti dhyānasyaivābhidhānāt| tasmānna samuccaye pramāṇamasti| pratiṣedhācca; "nānyaḥ panthā vidyateyanāya" "nāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena" "na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena" "nānyairdevaistapasā karmaṇā vā" "hitvā'vidyāṃ dhiyaiveyāt tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padami"ti ca| kevalakarmaṇāṃ pratiṣedha iti cet, na; aviśeṣāt, samuccayavidhāyipramāṇābhāve sarvakarmaṇāṃ pratiṣedhopapatteśca| jñānāṅgatayā sarvakarmasanyāsavidhānācca na samuccayaḥ| saṃnyāsāśramadharmaiḥ samuccaya iti cet, na; taddharmāṇāṃ dhyānādīnāṃ jñānasvarūpopakāritvāt| nityakarmavidhānānupapattireva jñānasahakāritayā karmaṇāṃ mokṣaphalatvaṃ kalpayatīti cet, na; nityakarmaṇāṃ phalanirekṣatvāt, sāpekṣatve ca viśvajinnyāyāvatārāt, saṃskāradvāreṇa ca viniyogasya darśitatvāt, karmaṇāmeva ca vidhyanupapattyā mokṣasādhanatvakalpanāt samuccayāsiddheḥ, karmapratiṣedhasyoditahomapratiṣedhavajjñānastutyarthatvopapatterjñānakarmaṇorvikalpena mokṣasādhanatvaprasaṅgāt| nanu brahmajñānamevetikartavyatayā karmaṇāṃ mokṣasādhanatvaṃ kalpyatīti cet, na; śamādītikartavyatāntarabhāvāt, karaṇatayā vidhyuddeśaprasiddhānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ vidhivirodhāt| arthaśca virudhyate| kaśca karmaṇāṃ sādhyo'rtha iti vaktavyam na tāvad brahmātmaikatvam; tasyāsādhyatvāt, nāpyavidyābhedāṃśādhyāsa karmaṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ ; "bhidyate hṛdayagranthiḥ" "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavatī" tyādau brahmadarśananivartyatvāvagamāt| nahi"tasmin dṛṣṭe" ityukte karmāṇi sahakāritvenāvagamyante| nāpyupādhidvayanivṛttiḥ karmaṇāṃ phalam| tathā "vidvānnāmarūpādvimuktaḥ" "evamevāsya paridraṣṭurimāḥ ṣoḍaśa kalāḥ puruṣāyaṇāḥ puruṣaṃ prāpyāstaṃ gacchantī"ti ca brahmadarśananivartyatvāvagamāt, ajñānamātropādānatvasya darśitatvācca karmopādhīnām| kiñca samuccayavādino na vijñānasādhyamapi phalamasti ; karmopādhīnāṃ satyavastutayā vijñānānivartyatvāt, mithyādhyāsasya ca kṣaṇikatayā svayameva nivṛtteḥ, pravāhasya ca pravāhinivṛttimantareṇa pṛthagucchedābhāvāt, astutvācca, mithyājñānasaṃskārasya śuktikāditatvajñānenāvirodhadarśanādanivartyatvāt, brahmātmabhāvasya ca svayaṃprakāśatayā vijñānāprakāśyatvāt, tattvajñānābhyāsasaṃskārācca, mithyājñānasaṃskāranivṛttau tattvajñānānmuktiśrutivirodhāt| tasmāt sarvānarthopādānānādimithyājñānanivṛttyaiva vijñānaṃ phalavat, iti na samuccayāvakāśaḥ|| tatra sarvasaṅkaravādī brahmavicārāpekṣitādhikāramapyajñānan samuccayasāmarthyādeva dharmāvabodhānantaraṃ brahmāvabodhaṃ jalpati|| tatra sati vā samuccaye viparītaṃ kiṃ na syāditi nirūpaṇīyam| tathāhi -- jñānavataivānuṣṭhitāni karmāṇi mokṣaṃ sādhayanti, iti prathamaṃ brahmāvabodhamutpādya tadvataiva brahmacāriṇā dharmavicārādi sarvaṃ svāśramadharmānuṣṭhānaṃ kartuṃ yuktam, iti viparīta eva kramaḥ syāt; anyathā tvādāveva mumukṣorādharmavicāraparisamāpteranuṣṭhīyamānakarmaṇāmānarthakyaprasaṅgāt| dṛśyante ca prathamāśrama eva mumukṣavaḥ| sarvasādhāraṇatvāddharmavicāra eva prathamaḥ kartavya iti cet, devānāṃpriya ! na sarvasādhāraṇaṃ kartumayaṃ pravṛttaḥ, kintu kāmyamānasādhanamavaśyānuṣṭheyaṃ vā nirvatayituṃ pravṛttaḥ| tatra yadi vicāradvayaṃ kāmyamānamokṣasādhanamithyeta, tarhi vyutkrama eva śreyānityuktam| atha nityādhyayanavidhiḥ karmavicāraṃ prayojayati, ato'vaśyānuṣṭheyavicārāntaraṃ kāmyamānabrahmavicāraḥ prayujyata iti cet, naitat sāram; kāmyamānabrahmavicārānantaramapi nityadharmavicāropapatteḥ| nanu adhyayanānantaraṃ karmavicārānanuṣṭhāne pratyavāyaḥ syāt, satyam; nityavadalpānuṣṭhāne'pi pratyavāyaparihārāt| kiṃca tāvanmātramupeyātām; viduṣā'nuṣṭhīyamānabrahmacāridharmāṇāmapi mokṣasādhanatvalābhāt, vedānuvacanādiṣu pratyekaṃ nirapekṣakaraṇavibhaktiśravaṇādvā, āśramakarmaṇāṃ vikalpena mokṣasādhanatvopapatteḥ, brahmacaryādeva saṃnyāsavidhānācca| dharmāvabodho nityatayā'nuṣṭhito'pi na brahmavicārahotuḥ, ananuṣṭheyaśca dharmavicāraḥ, agnihotrādivyatiriktasaṃnyāsadharmāṇāmapi jñāne samuccayāṅgīkaraṇāt| kiṃca adhyayanavidhiḥ karmavicāraṃ prayuñjāno brahmavicāraṃ kimiti na prayuṅkte iti vaktavyam, "śrotavyaḥ" iti vidhyantaraśravaṇāditi cet, aśrutamīmāṃsāvṛttānto devānāṃpriyaḥ, dharmavicāre klṛptapravartakabhāvenānenaivādhyayanavidhinā brahmavicārasyāpi prayogasambhave śrotavya iti vidherviniyogādhikāraprayogavidhikalpanayā pravartakatvakalpanā'yogāt| brahmajñānasya kāmyamānasādhanatayā tadvicārasyāpi kāmyatvād na nityādhyayanavidhiprayuktateti cet, karmavicāre kāmyamānakarmavākyavicārasyāpyetatprayuktatvaprasaṅgaḥ|| syādetat -- brahmavicārasya vairāgyaśamadamopasadanādisādhanaviśeṣāṇāmaṅgatvena vidhānādadhyayanavidheḥ karmavicāre śamādyaṅgaśūnyasya brahmavicāre tadaṅgānāmākṣepakatvānupapatteḥ sāṅgavidhyantaraṃ kalpyata iti, so'yamanurūpitavidhivyāpāro vāvadūkaḥ; svādhyāyavidhiḥ khalu śirovratabhūbhojanādyaṅgavikalameva vākyāntarādhyayanaṃ vidadhāno muṇḍaka kārīryādyadhyayanaṃ śirovratādyaṅgākṣepapuraḥsarameva vidadhāti| vicāraṃ ca prayuñjānaḥ prativākyaṃ dṛṣṭatayaivāṅgabhūtān nyāyabhedānākṣipyaiva vicāraṃ prayuṅkte| darśapūrṇamāsavidhiśca nityādhikāro yathāśaktyaṅgānuṣṭhānaṃ prayuṅkte, kāmyādhikārastu sarvāṅgānuṣṭhānamiti| tathā sa eva vidhirupāṃśuyāje karmaṇyājyāvekṣaṇādyaṅgamākṣipati, yāgāntareṣvavaghātādyaṅgamiti| evamadhyayanavidhirbrahmavicāre śamādyaṅgamākṣipet netaratreti na virudhyate| nacādhikāriviśeṣaṇatvāt śamādīnāmanupādeyatvādanākṣepaḥ; adhyayanavidhyadhikāriṇa eva tatprayuktavicāre'pyadhikāritvāt| tasmāt pradhānavidhirdṛṣṭādṛṣṭāṅgānāmupakāraviśeṣāpekṣayā yatra kvacana yatkiñcidaṅgaṃ prayojayatīti sarvatra samadhigatametat| tasmādekādhyayanavidhiprayuktatvād vicāradvayasya kramāpekṣāyāṃ brahmavicārānantaraṃ dharmavicāro yuktaḥ; vicārādīnāmapi mokṣasādhanatvalābhāt| tasmād na phalaikyādapi dharmajijñāsānantaraṃ brahmajijñāseti| prativākyaṃ ca tātparyabhedāt prameyabhedasiddhiḥ| tatra hetvantaramāha -- codanāpravṛttibhedāditi|| etad vivṛṇoti -- idamaparamityādinā|| codaneti śabdabhāvanāṃ kurvañchabdo'bhidhīyate| sā ca codanāṃ'śatrayaviśiṣṭāmarthabhāvanāṃ kurvatī tasminnanavabuddhe puruṣapravṛttyayogādarthabhāvanāmapi pratipādayatīti bhāvaḥ| nanu brahmāvabodhe bhāvye puruṣaṃ prerayantī codanā'vabodhavyāvṛttāṃ bhāvanāṃ pratipādayatīti, netyāha -- nāvabodhe puruṣaḥ preryata iti|| nanu avabodhaḥ puruṣaprayatnasādhya iti, netyāha -- avabodho hi yathāvastviti|| anicchato'prayatamānasyāpi durgandhādijñānadarśanādityarthaḥ|| ucyate nityānityavastuviveka ityataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| śāstrīyasya vidheḥ śāstrīyamevādhikāranimittaṃ vaktavyamityabhipretyāha -- nityānityavastuviveka ityādi|| "so'nveṣṭavya" iti vidhiprakaraṇe -- "tadyatheha karmacito lokaḥ kṣīyata evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ dhīyate" iti nityānityavastuviveko darśitaḥ; "parīkṣya lokān karmacitān" "ātmanastu kāmāya sarve priyaṃ bhavatī"ti ca jñānaśravaṇavidhiprakaraṇa ihāmutrārthabhogavirāgo darśitaḥ; "śānto dāntaḥ" iti ca darśanavidhiprakaraṇe śamādayo darśitāḥ; "tadvijijñāsasve"ti vicāravidhiprakaraṇe "varuṇaṃ pitaramupasasāre"ti gurūpasadanaṃ darśitam; sarvatra ca phalaśrutayaḥ kāmanotpādanadvāreṇa mumukṣoradhikārapradarśanārthāḥ; anyathā sādhanānuṣṭhānādeva saṅkīrtanavaiphalyāt| jñānasyāvidheyatvāt tadvidhayo'pi tatsādhanavidhiparāḥ; tatra sarvaśākhāpratyayanyāyena vidhīnāmekatvopapatteḥ| sa caiko vidhiradhikāramīkṣamāṇaḥ prakaraṇasāmarthyāt saṅkīrtanavaiphalyaparihārācca varṇitaṃ dharmakalāpamadhikāranimittatvena svīkaroti; niradhikārasya vidheḥ pravṛttiparyantatvāyogāt| nanu eṣu vākyeṣu vicāro vidhīyata iti kathamavagamyate ucyate -- "vijijñāsitavyaḥ" "vijijñāsasve"ti cāntarṇīto vicāro vidhīyate; iṣyamāṇajñānasyecchāyāśca vidheyatvāyogāt| "śrotavyaḥ" iti ca svayameva vicāro vihitaḥ; "tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchedi"ti jñānasya sādhyatāvagamāt| gurūpasadanavidhānācca tatsādhanaśravaṇādividhiḥ kalpyate| "ātmanyevātmānaṃ paśyedi"ti jñānavidhānāyogāt tatsādhane vidhirūpādīyate, iti sarvatra manananididhyāsanābhyāṃ saha śravaṇaṃ nāmāṅgividhīyata iti siddham|| nanu phalasādhanavidhau phalakāmanaiva puṣkalādhikāranimittaṃ bhavati, kimitaradharmakalāpeneti satyam śāstrīye'dhikāranimitte saṅkīrtanādeva jīvanagṛhadāhādivadadhikāranimittamiti gamyate| nanu sādhanakalāpasyānuṣṭheyatayā tatra vidhiṃ parikalpya prayājādivat phalopakāryaṅgatvameva kalpyatām satyam aṅgasyāpipradoṣādikālavadadhikāraviśeṣaṇatvaṃ na virudhyate; śāntyādiguṇo bhūtvā paśyedityādiliṅgāt, dīkṣāyā apyuttarakratvadhikāranimittatādarśanāt| tasmād yuktamuktam -- nityānityavastuviveka iti|| "teṣu hi satsvi"tyuttaraṃ bhāṣyaṃ sādhanakalāpasya brahmānubhavaparyantavicārādisādhanapravṛtteranvayavyatirekasiddhadṛṣṭahetutāṃ pratipādayati| tad vyāvarṇayituṃ mumukṣutvamantareṇa tāvanna pravṛttirityāha -- uktaṃ purastādadhikārārthatva ityādinā|| tasmād mumukṣutvaṃ tāvadiṣyamāṇasādhane pravṛttinimittamityarthaḥ| nanu phalakāmanāyāṃ satyāmitaradharmābhāvāt phalasādhane pravṛttyabhāvo na dṛśyate, satyam; pūrvasya pūrvasyottarottarasvarūpopādhitvena pratipannatayā mumukṣutvopādhitvādadhikāranimittatetyāha -- tasmād yāvadasya hiraṇyagarbhāvāptiparyantasyetyādinā|| nanu sarvam, anityameva, sattvāt; svapnavaditi, netyāha -- vinaśyadapīdamiti|| naca nirūpādānaṃ kiñcit kāryamavagamyate; kāryasya ca kāryāntaropādānatve pūrveṣāṃ kṛtsnakāraṇānāmuttarasmin kārye'nvayaḥ syāt; ananvayino'nupādānatvāt, ataḥ pratikāryapravāhamanāditvādanādyanekopādānakalpanād varamekasyaivānādeḥ sarvakāryopādānatvakalpanam| taccāvikārikūṭastham; anyathā kāryatvaprasaṅgāt| tathā sarve kāryam, kadācit kātrsnyena vinaśyati, ekopādānatvāt, suṣuptāvātmagatamukhādivat, iti sarvasya ca vināśastathāvidhavastuparyanta eva; anyathā pūrvakalpasya śūnyatāparyantaṃ vinaṣṭasya svopādānaśeṣatayā svasaṃskārāvasthānābhāvāt tatsajātīyākāreṇa punarjanmābhāvavad vartamānasyāpi nirūpādānatayā janmābhāvaprasaṅgāditi| bhogān bhuñjānasya bhoktuḥ saha bhogairabhimukhavināśadarśanāditi yojanā| atraivamanvayaḥ -- yāvadanityatvaṃ nāvaiti, tāvannityaṃ vastu na pratipadyata ityadhyāhāraḥ| yāvacca nityānityavastuviveko na jāyate, tāvadvirakto na jāyata ityadhyāhāraḥ| "yāvaccābhimukhavināśe"tyatra yāvacchabdo nakāramadhyāhṛtya viraktaśabdena saṃbadhyate, yāvacca na virakta iti| tāvanmumukṣutvaṃ nālambata ityadhyāhāraḥ| yāvacca mumukṣutvaṃ nālambate, tāvad brahmajijñāsāṃ kaḥ pratipadyeta iti sādhanakalāpābhāve na vicārapravṛttiriti vyatireko'yaṃ darśitaḥ| nanu nāsti vyatirekaḥ, sādhanakalāpābhāve'pi pravṛttidarśanādityāśaṅkyāha -- kathaṃcidvā daivavaśāditi|| śūdrayāgādivat phalaparyantatā na syādityarthaḥ| vyatirekaniyamādevānvayamapi siddhavat karotītyāha -- tasmādvarṇitavastukalāpānantaryamiti|| ukte'rthe bhāṣyamavatārayati -- tadāha bhāṣyakāra iti|| tadevaṃ sādhanakalāpasya vidheyatayā vijñānāṅgatve'pi śāstrayuktibhyāmadhikāriviśeṣaṇatvalābhād varṇitasādhanasaṃpattyanantaraṃ brahmavicāre siddhe'pi kaścitpramāṇavyāpāravārtānabhijño devānāṃpriyaḥ śāstrārthapradveṣadoṣadhūyamānacetāḥ sarvasaṃkaravādī yatkiñcidatra jalpati -- vicārakartavyatāṃ pratipadyamānasya kila sūtrakārasya śamādayo na buddhisamārūḍhāḥ, nacābuddhisamārūḍhamarthamadhikāriviśeṣaṇatayā'thaśabdenopādātumarhati; dharmavicārastu buddhigato'dhikāriviśeṣaṇatayopādīyata iti, naitadyuktam; nahi pūrvāparavākyaparāmarśaprajñāvikalastvamiva sūtrakāraḥ| tathāhi -- śrautaṃ vicāravidhi sūtrayituṃ pratipadyamāne vidhiprayuktamadhikāryanubandhamīkṣamāṇaḥ svaprakaraṇapaṭhitamanvayavyatirekapramāṇagamyaṃ cādhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ pratipadyāthaśabdena kimiti na sūtrayet kiṃca sādhanakalāpasyāthaśabdopādānatvābhāve'pyavaśyaṃ brahmaṇi pravṛttyaṅgatā tāvad vaktavyā; rāgādyākṣiptasya tatra pravṛttyanupapatteḥ, avaśyāpekṣaṇīyatve ca tadevādhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ vaktavyam| naca dharmajijñāsā dṛṣṭadvāreṇa vā śāstrīyatā vā'dhikāriviśeṣaṇatāmanugacchati; pramāṇābhāvāt| ata eva na buddhisthā'pi sā, athaśabdena ca nopādānamarhati; vyavahitācca buddhisthāt svavākyagatameva saṃnihitataraṃ buddhisthaṃ ca sādhanacatuṣṭayamupādānamarhati| tasmād yatkiṃciddetaditi|| ataḥ śabdo hetvarthaḥ| nanu -- athaśabda evānantaryābhidhānamukhena hetutayā pūrvanirvṛttamevārthaṃ gamayatītyuktam, nanu hetutvamārthikam, tannābhidheyamathaśabdasya, satyam; ārthikārye tātparyāt, ānantaryamātre vaiphalyāt, "yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa vākyaprayoge śabdārthaḥ" ityathaśabdenaiva hetutvasiddhernātaśśabdo'pekṣyata iti| ataḥśabdābhāve māṅgalyādīnāmanyatamārthatā'thaśabdasya prasajyata iti cet, na; nirākṛtatvāt, dharmamīmāṃsāyāṃ satyapyathaśabdenā'pi tasya hetutvamuktamiti cet, andhagolāṅgūlanyāyaikaśaraṇo'yaṃ sarvasaṃkaravādī| nahyanyatra vidyamānaḥ punaruktidoṣo'smābhirapyanusaraṇīyaḥ; tasmādataḥśabdavaiyarthyamiti -- prāptam, atrāthaśabdaparigṛhītasyaiva hetutvasya hetvantareṇāpavādāśaṅkāyāṃ tannirākaraṇaṃ punarathaśabdoktahetutvābhidhāyinā'taḥśabdena kriyata iti darśitam -- yasmādveda evāgnihotrādīnāmityādibhāṣyeṇa|| tatra tāmāśaṅkāṃ darśayati -- syādetat kṛtakatvaparicchedāvityādinā|| yadā tu kṛtakatvādyanumānamanaikāntikam, tadā karmaphalasyāpi kṛtakasyānityatvaniyamābhāvānnityapuruṣārthakāminastatrāpi pravṛttiḥ syāt| ato nityānityavastuviveko na brahmaṇyeva niyamena pravṛttiheturityarthaḥ| nanu karmaphalasyaikāntato'nityatā'bhāve'pi nityatve na pramāṇamiti, tatrāha -- vede'pyakṣapyaṃ ha vai cāturmāsyayājina iti|| nanu evamapi brahmaṇi pravṛtteḥ kimāyātamiti tatrāha -- ato viṣayabhogānna niyamena virāga iti|| tato na brahmaṇi pravartata ityarthaḥ| virajyan vā cāturmāsyādivyatiriktaviṣayād viraktastatraiva pravartata iti| mā bhūd brahmaṇyeva pravṛttiniyamaḥ; tatrāpi brahmaṇyapi vikalpena pravṛttiḥ syāditi, netyāha -- nāpi kūṭasthanityavastvavaṣṭambheneti|| nanu viruddhapadārthatādātmyābhāve'pi saṃyogalakṣaṇā brahmaprāptiḥ syāditi, netyāha -- na tadavāptiriti|| nanu brahmānandopabhodo vidyate, na; svāśrayasukhopalabdherupabhogatvāt, naca brahmadharmasya sukhasya jīvāśrayatayopalabdhiḥ saṃbhavati| nanu sukhāparokṣyamātramupabhogaḥ, na svāśrayasukhāparokṣyam; viśeṣaṇāyogāt, tathā'pi bhedenāvasthāne jīvabrahmaṇorloke puruṣāntarasukhasya puruṣāntaraṃ pratyāparokṣyādarśanānnopabhogaḥ| nanu ātmaiva sukhasaṃvitsvabhāvaḥ, tadrūpāvasthānaṃ ca mokṣa iti, na; yogyānupalabdhivirodhāt| naca devādyānandaparityāgena nirānandātmanā'vasthānaṃ mokṣaṃ kaścit prārthayate| tasmānna sādhanacatuṣṭayasaṃpannasya brahmaṇi pravṛttiḥ, kintu karmaphala ityupasaṃharati -- ato'jīrṇabhayādityādinā|| tatroktāśaṅkānirākaraṇahetuvacanaṃ bhāṣyamavatārayitumataḥśabdena sādhanacatuṣṭayasya hetutvābhidhāyinā kathamāśaṅkānirākaraṇahetubhūtaṃ pramāṇaṃ sūcitamiti pṛcchati -- kathamiti|| tadāha -- yasmādveda evāgnihotrādīnāmiti|| brahmavyatiriktapuruṣārthajātasyānityatāṃ darśayatītyarthaḥ| nanu "tadyatheha karmacito lokaḥ" iti sāmānyaśrutiścārturmāsyādiviśeṣādanyatraiva vartatāmiti codayati -- nanu puṇyasyeti|| tatra tāvaccāturmāsyaśrutiḥ sukṛtasyākṣayyatvamāha, na tatphalasya; satyapi sukṛte phalasyānupabhogavat kṣayopapatteḥ| tatra vākyasya śrutārthe parityajya phalākṣayaviṣayatvakalpanā pramāṇaviruddhetyāha -- na tasya vastubalapravṛtteti|| vyāptibalapravṛttetyarthaḥ| anumānānugṛhītaśrutivirodha iti yojayitavyam| "hiraṇyadā amṛtatvaṃ bhajante" iti śrutirvartamānāpadeśād yogyānupalabdhiviruddhā bhavati| bhajiṣyanta iti kalpanā pūrvavatpramāṇaviruddhā, anumānānugṛhītadevasargapralayaśrutiviruddhā| "apāma somami"ti śrutiḥ, "sa ya ātmānameva lokamupāste na hāsya karma kṣīyate" iti śrutirna phalasya nityatāṃ darśayati, vākyasya phalaviṣayatvakalpanā tu pūrvavat pramāṇaviruddhā; avirodhāpekṣatvāt kalpanāyāḥ| kiñca "yadi ha vā apyanevaṃvid mahatpuṇyaṃ karma karoti, taddhāsyāntataḥ kṣīyate" ityupakramya "sa ya ātmānameva lokamupāste na hāsya karma kṣīyate" iti vacanādātmopāsanākarmaṇa evāparokṣānubhavadvāreṇākṣayāvidyānivṛttiphalatvāt -- "na karma kṣīyate" ityupāsanākarmapraśaṃsāmātrametadupādīyate| anevaṃvidaḥ karmakṣayasya śravaṇādevaṃvidā'nuṣṭhitasyāgnihotrādereva mokṣaphalatayā'kṣayo vidhīyata iti cet, na; liṅgasya "nānyaḥ panthā vidyate" "kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇī" tyādiniṣedhaśrutivirodhāt| tasmād brahmavyatiriktapuruṣārthe'nityatayā vairāgyamupapannamiti| nanu doṣasya tulyatvānna brahmaṇyapi pravṛttikāraṇametadityuktam, tatrāha -- yatpunarmumukṣutvābhāva iti|| viruddhapadārthatādātmyamanupapannam, ityanumānaṃ "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavatī"tyādiśrutiviruddham; kintu bimbapratibimbayoriva tādātmyamuktam| naca -- sukhānubhavābhāvādapuruṣārtha iti -- yuktam; brahmānandānubhavāt| nanu tādātmye "ahaṃ sukhami"tyanubhavaḥ syāt, "nāhaṃ sukhī"ti, "ahaṃ sukhī"ti cānubhavo loke puruṣārtha iti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; sukhāparokṣyamātrasya puruṣārthatvāt| nanu svāśrayaṃ sukhameva puruṣārtho na sukhāparokṣyamiti, na; upalabdhānāmeva sukhasādhanānāṃ puruṣārthatvādiṣṭatvāviśeṣāt sukhamapyupalabhyamānameva puruṣārtha iti gamyate| tatra sādhanapāratantryānityatvādivad viṣayasukhasyātmano bhedo'pyānuṣaṅgiko nāvabhāsate'haṃ sukhīti, na puruṣārthatayā, ityato brahmānando'pyaparokṣāvabhāsaḥ puruṣārtha iti| nanu nāsti nityaṃ sukhamiti naiyāyikādayaḥ, satyam; nāstyeva janyamapi sukham| nanu sādhanopādānād janyatā'vagamyate, na; siddhasyaiva sukhasyābhivyaktihetutvāt, anyathā sukhasantānajanmapratibhāsayogyatvayoḥ sādhanādhīnatākalpanāgauravāt sādhyāntarāśeṣatayā vā'vyabhicāritvena vā nirupādhikapremātpadatvena vā sukhaduḥkhāvasthayoraviśeṣeṇa sukharūpa ātmā pratyakṣeṇāvabhāsate| yasmādataḥśabdena śaṅkhānirākaraṇahetusūcanadvāreṇa sādhanakalāpasya hetutvaṃ samarthitam, tasmādyathoktasādhanetyupasaṃhāraḥ| tatrecchāprādhānyena sūtravākyārtho darśitaḥ| sādhanacatuṣṭayasyāvaśyārambhakatvaṃ vyatirekamukhena darśitam, idānīmanvayamukhena tadeva pratipādayati -- yato dvaitānuṣaṅgādityādinā|| nanu sādhanakalāpavad dharmajijñāsā'pi niyamenārambhiketi, netyāha -- evaṃ satyarthāditi|| āgamārthāpattibhyāmeva dharmakalāpasyāvaśyārambhakatve'siddhe tadubhayapramāṇavikalasya dharmavicārasya na hetutetyarthaḥ|| brahmaṇo jijñāseti bhāṣyam| nanu dharmāya jijñāsetivat caturthīsamāsaḥ kiṃ na syāditi atrāha -- antarṇītavicārārthānvaye hīti|| icchāprādhānye hīcchāyāḥ karmaprayojanayoraikyāt prādhānyāt karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ syāt, vicāraprādhānye tu karmaprayojanabhedāt prayojanavivakṣayā tu caturthīsamāso'pi syāditi| nanu kiṃ tad brahma yadicchāyāḥ prayojanatayā karmatvena vartata iti, tadāha -- brahmaśabdasyārthanirdeśāvasara iti|| "tatra yadanyairi"tyārabhya "brahmaṇa iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī"tyataḥ prāktanena granthena jātijīvakamalāsanaśabdarāśīnāṃ brahmaśabdābhidheyatayā jijñāsāṃ prati kartṛtvena karmatvena vā pratipādanānupapatterasmin prayoge na brahmaśabdasya jātyādyarthateti darśitam|| tatra "brahmaṇa iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī"tyārabhya kiñca śāstrapravṛttirevetyataḥ prāktanena granthenāpradhānavicārān śabdena mukhyayā vṛttyopādāya pradhānasyārthākṣepakalpanād varaṃ mukhataḥ pradhānavicāramevopādāyāpradhānavicārāṇāmarthākṣepakalpanamiti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī darśitā| śeṣa iti saṃbandhasāmānyamucyate, na kārakapañcakavyatiriktāḥ saṃbandhaviśeṣā ucyante| tatra yathā devadattasya svamiti ṣaṣṭhī viśeṣasaṃbandhe'pyanvitābhidhānamarhati, evaṃ "devadattasya gacchati" "devadattasya gamyate" ityādikārakasaṃbandhaviśeṣe'pyanvitābhidhānaṃ nārhati, kiṃtvabhihitasaṃbandhasāmānye; sāmarthyād, kvacit kārakasaṃbandhaviśeṣaścārthato'vagamyata iti| etāvatā "ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe" ityuktam, nārthādapi kārakasaṃbandhāpratibhāsa ityuktamiti pūrvavādino matam| "kiṃca śāstrapravṛttirevetyārabhya jñātumicchā jijñāse"tyataḥ prāktanena granthena sādhikāraviṣayasya vicāravidheḥ pratipādake vākye brahmaṇaḥ karmakārakatvaṃ nirdiṣṭam, sūtrasya ca tadekārthatvāt tatrāpi brahmaṇaḥ karmatvamevameva śabdena vaktavyamiti darśitam|| jñātumicchetyādi bhāṣyam| tatrāvagataviṣayatvādicchāyā brahmaṇyavagate tajjñānecchānupapatteranavagate sutarāmiti kathaṃ brahmajñāneccheti ata āha -- tataścecchāyāḥ phalaviṣayatvāditi|| kā ceyamiṣyamāṇā'vagatiriti tadāha -- sākṣādanubhava iti|| nanu prathamamevāvagatirutpadyate, tatrāha -- jñānaṃ tu parokṣa iti| śabdāt parokṣatayā'vagate'parokṣajñānamiti ityarthaḥ| yadā punaḥ śabdādaparokṣajñānamutpadyate, tatrāha -- sannihite'pīti|| pramāṇenāvagantumati-aparokṣaniścayānubhavenetyarthaḥ|| nanu kimiha jñānamityucyate saṃvedanameva pramāṇaphalaṃ vijñānamiti sugataprabhākaravaiśeṣikanaiyāyikāḥ| naca saṃvedanaphalacatuṣṭayasannikarṣādi sāmagryaṃ cāntareṇa pramātṛvyāpāro nāma jñānamastīti| vārtikakārīyāṇāṃ tu pramātṛvyāpāraḥ saṃvijjanako jñānamiti| kṣapaṇakalokāyatikānāṃ cātmacaitanyameva jñānam| sāṅkhyavedāntināṃ karaṇavyutpattyā buddhivṛttirjñānam, bhāvavyutpattyā saṃvedanamiti| tatra na tāvat sthāyinyātmani saṃvitphalodayaḥ kartṛvyāpāramantareṇopapadyate| nanu yataḥ kāraṇāt kartṛvyāpārajanma, tata evānubhavajanma syāt, ātmanaḥ parispandavyāpārānupapatteriti| ayamatra vaktavyaḥ kiṃ loke kartṛvyāpārāt phalajanma pratyakṣeṇāvagatam na veti na ced vyāptigrahaṇābhāvādapratyakṣatvācca na sarvatra kartṛvyāpārāvagamaḥ syāt| avagamyate ca loke kartṛvyāpāraḥ| atha loke phalahetutayā pratyakṣasiddhaḥ kartṛvyāpāraḥ, tarhyātmanyapi tadanumīyate; vyāptiniyamāt| nanu na pariṇāmo nāma vyāpāro'sti, ārambhābhyupagamāditi vaiśeṣikādayaḥ, tarhi prayatnavyāpārajanyaṃ phalamastu, kartṛvyāpāravyāptiniyamātphalasya| nanu manaḥsaṃyogādevāsamavāyikāraṇād vyāpāramantareṇa jñānamutpadyate, na; karaṇasaṃyogavyatirekeṇa phalajanmani kartṛvyāpāradarśanāt| atra sarvasaṅkaravādī vilapati -- pākādiṣu phalasya kartṛvyāpārādhīnatādarśanāt tatra tathā'vagamyatām, iha tu taddarśanābhāvānna kartṛvyāpāraḥ -- iti, sa cānumānaprakriyāyāmanabhijña ityapekṣyate| sugatānāmapi nityātmasādhanādeva saṃvidāṃ kartṛvyāpārāpekṣā'numīyate| kṣapaṇakānāmapi svarūpacaitanyasya nirupādhikasya viṣayāvabhāsitve sarvadā sarvaviṣayāvabhāsaḥ syāt| lokāyatasya ca janyasaṃvedanatvāt tadvyāpārānumānam| nanu sarvagatasya niravayavasyātmano na parispandapariṇāmau yuktau, satyam; adhyāsapariniṣpannāntaḥkaraṇasampiṇḍitasyātmano jñānākārapariṇāmāt| naca saṃvedanākāreṇa pariṇāmaḥ; tasya nityasiddhatvāt; ato'ntaḥkaraṇapariṇāmaviśeṣaścaitanyasya viṣayāvacchedopādhiḥ karaṇavyutpattyā jñānam, bhāvavyutpattyā tu saṃvedanamevārthaprakāśo jñāptirjñānamityucyate| tatrārthopādhi, aparokṣasaṃvidavacchedakaṃ jñānamaparokṣam, iti tatrāvayavārthavyutpādanenāparokṣāvagamecchāyā vākyārthatvamuktam| iṣyamāṇajñānaphalopadeśamukhenāntarṇītaṃ tatsādhanaṃ vicāraṃ kartavyatayā vākyārthaṃ pratipādavatyuttaraṃ bhāṣyam| tasya tātparyaṃ darśayitumāśaṅkāntaraṃ nivartayati| katham nāsya sūtrasya vākyārtho varṇanīyaḥ| tathāhi -- asya sūtrasya śāstrāntarbhūtatve vicārārambhakartavyatā| vicārasūtrasya kenārambhaḥ kriyate svenaiva cet, ātmāśrayatāpattiḥ; sūtrāntareṇa cet, anavasthāpātaḥ, athānantarbhūtam, tarhi prathamasūtrasyāśāstratayā'nārambhaprasaṅga iti, tatrāha -- tadetacchāstrāntarbhūtaṃ sūtramiti|| āpātapratipannottaravicāravidhireva svāpekṣitavicārāya prathamasūtramārambhayati| vidhau ca vicārite vidhiviṣayavicārasūtrāṇi paścādārambhayatītyekaśāstratve'pi nānavasthā| śrotavyādivākyānāṃ svārthe samanvayadvāreṇa vicāryamāṇavedāntavākyānāmapi brahmaṇi samanvayanimittatvāsamanvaye ca saṃbandha iti| atra ca śrutyā kiṃ pratipāditamiti tadāha -- anena ceti|| "prayojyaḥ" ityadhikārī| ekasyā iti|| sādhanakalāpasyeti| tasya kāraṇāntaramadṛṣṭaṃ yajñādi dṛṣṭañca vyāptyanusaṃdhānādi| arthādupāttamiti|| ānantaryābhidhānasāmarthyāditi| ataḥ śabdasya mukhato hetutvābhidhāyino'pyāśaṅkhāntaranivṛttau tātparyādarthāddhetutvamuktam, ityanuvāde prayojanābhāvāt kartavyapadamadhyāhṛtya jijñāsā kartavyatayā śrutyā'bhihitā| nanu icchāsaṃyogād jñānasya sādhyatāvagamāt tadeva kartavyamastviti, netyāha -- tatra jānātyeveti|| iṣyamāṇasya sādhyatā svayaṃ siddhā, na śabdamapekṣate; sukhasaṃvedanatvādityarthaḥ| kiṃ tarhi vidhīyata iti tadāha -- upāyaṃ tu na vedeti|| anavagatābhilaṣitopāya eva vidhiśabdaiḥ pratipādyata ityata ityarthaḥ| adṛṣṭopāyatve'pyaparokṣānubhavaṃ pratyadṛṣṭopāyatā'pi darśitā śravaṇādividheḥ| nanu -- padārthavyākhyānādeva svayameva vākyārthaṃ pratipadyate, kiṃ vākyārthakathanena satyam; saṃbandhādīnāmarthāt pratibhāso vākyārthakathanena bhavatītyāha -- śāstrasya saṃbandhābhidheyaprayojanānīti|| mumukṣuṇā brahmānubhavāya vicāraḥ kartavya iti vākyārthaḥ| kathamatrārthāt saṃbandhādipratipattiḥ tadāha -- etaduktaṃ bhavatītyādinā|| nanu brahmajñānadvāreṇa kāmyamānamokṣasādhanaṃ vicāraḥ, iti phalasaṃbandhe siddhe'pi kathaṃ viṣayādisiddhiriti tatrāha -- arthācchāstrasyeti|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakānanyānubhavapūjyapādaśiṣyasvaprakāśānubhavabhagavataḥ kṛtau pañcapādikāvivaraṇe prathamasūtrārthavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyavarṇakaṃ samāptam|| <4> atha turīyaṃ varṇakam "tatpunarbrahma prasiddhami"tyādibhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- prayojanaviṣayasaṃbandhānākṣipatīti|| nanu vidhisāmarthyādeva prayojanādiṣvavagateṣu kathamākṣepaḥ iti codayati -- kathamiti|| pariharati -- prasiddhaśabdenetyādinā|| nanu pratipannaṃ śabdenānūdya pratipādayituṃ śakyatvāt kathamaviṣayaḥ ityāha -- kasmāditi|| anadhigatārthatābhāvāditi pariharati -- pratipādyatveneti|| viṣayāvagamadvārā prayojanasya pūrvāvagamenaiva siddhatvād nāsya prayojanamapītyāha -- tataścānenānavagamāditi|| "athe"tyaprasiddhapakṣe saṃbandhaṃ prayojanaṃ cākṣipati| nanu anadhigatārtha eva pramāṇena pratipādyate, prayojanaṃ ca tatraiveti codayati -- kathamiti|| pariharati -- yanna kadācidapīti|| pratyakṣādipramāṇairvicārānapekṣairatyantānadhigata eva pratipādyate| yatra vicārāpekṣayā pramāṇena vastu pratipādyate, tatrāpratipannamuddiśya vicārānupapatteḥ, pratipanne vimarśādarśanānna vicārāpekṣapramāṇenānadhigatāvagama ityarthaḥ| nanu aprasiddhapakṣe saṃbandhaḥ kathamākṣiptaḥ na prasiddhapakṣa iti tatrāha -- prasiddhaṃ punaryadi nāmeti|| "avijñāte tattve kāraṇopapattitastatvajñānārthamūhastarkaḥ" ityakṣapādasūtravacanāt sāmānyapratipannasya vā viśeṣarūpeṇa viśeṣato'pyāpātadarśanagocarasya vā viśeṣanirṇayāya pramāṇānugrāhakastarkaḥ, iti brahmaṇo'pyaniścitaviśeṣapratibhāsagocaratayā vicārayogyatvapradarśanena tritayamapi samādhatta iti bhāṣyasya tātparyamāha -- asti tāvad brahmetyādineti|| nanu samanvayādhyāyanirūpaṇena brahmaiva viṣayaḥ pratipādye ceti sidhyati, phalādhyāyena tu phalaviśeṣaḥ, iti na tritayamatra pratipādanīyamiti, tatrāha -- śrotṛpravṛttyarthamiti|| "nanu prekṣāvate"tyādicodyaparihārau spaṣṭau|| nanu prayojanaviśeṣa eva pravṛttyaṅgaṃ bhavati, na viṣaya saṃbandhāviti codayati -- evamapi prayojanaviśeṣa eveti|| nanu sādhanamapi pravṛttiviṣayaṃ śakyasādhyaṃ cānavagamya phalajñānāt kutra pravartata iti tatrāha -- naca viṣayabhāvamanāpannamiti|| nanu phalasādhanaṃ pravṛttiviṣayaḥ, na phalamiti, tatrāha -- chidikriyāviṣaya eveti|| prayojanasamavāyi vastu karmakārakatayā viṣayo bhavati| tataśca prayojanapratipattau viṣayo'pyantarbhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu kulāladaṇḍādivyāpāro mṛdviṣayaḥ, ghaṭaśca prayojanam, iti viṣayaprayojanayorbheda iti, tatrāha -- daṇḍāderapīti|| satyaṃ prayojanasamavāyī viṣayaprayojanabuddhāvantarbhavati, kiṃtu prayojanaṃ prati karaṇalakṣaṇasya puruṣavyāpāraviṣayasyānanyasādhāraṇatayā śakyapratipādyatayā ca viṣayabhāve darśite prayojanasādhane niyamena pravṛttirbhavati, netaratheti pariharati -- satyamevaṃ tathāpītyādinā|| tatra pravṛttiniyamāyānanyasādhāraṇatayā vicāratajjanyajñānayoranubhūyamānatayā prayojanamapi brahma svarūpeṇa viṣayatayā pṛthag vaktavyamiti darśayituṃ vipakṣe dṛṣṭāntāha -- yathā cikitsājñānasyeti|| viṣayasya saṃbandhirūpatayā'ntargarbhitasaṃbandhatvād na pṛthaksaṃbandho vaktavya iti, tatrāha -- saṃbandho'pi vaktavya ityādinā|| tatrānanyapratipādyatvāt sādhanāntaranivṛttirūpādanyatvāt saṃbandhasya, so'pi pṛthagvaktavya iti darśayituṃ vipakṣe dṛṣṭāntamāha -- yathā sādhuśabdaparijñānamityādinā|| ayamarthaḥ -- vyākaraṇārambhāt prāk cikitsāvyāpārād vyāpārāntarairasādhyamapi sādhuśabdajñānaṃ na cikitsāvyāpārasya viṣayaḥ; saṃbandhābhāvāt, kiṃtu vyākaraṇena saṃbandhāttasya viṣayo bhavati| atastadarthī na kvaciditi|| cikitsāvyāpāra ityarthaḥ| nanu evamapyanyatamābhidhānenānyatamasyārthasiddhatvānna pṛthagabhidhānena kṛtyamiti, netyāha -- tena puruṣārtharūpatetyādinā|| bhidyanta iti|| pṛthagvaktavyānītyarthaḥ| nacānyatamenānyatamasya siddhiḥ; satyapyekasminnitarābhāvasya darśitatvāditi| nanu svarūpabhede pṛthagabhidhānāpekṣāyāmapi kathaṃ tritayaṃ sambhūya na pravṛttyaṅgamiti tatra vyatirekamukhena pravṛttihetutvaṃ darśayati -- tāni ca trīṇyapi pravṛttyaṅgam; nāpuruṣārtha ityādinā|| nanu vaktavyamapi tritayaṃ prasiddhāprasiddhapakṣayoranupapannamityuktamiti, tatparihārāyottarabhāṣyasyā''dhikaraṇaparisamāptestātparyamāha -- tatra vipratipattyaikāntataḥ prasiddhatāmityādinā|| tatra prasiddhimātreṇa vicāravidhānopapattiḥ, uddeśanasambhavāt, ekāntaprasidhyabhāvādvicārajanyajñānasyānanyasādhāraṇateti| vipratipattiśabdo brahmaśabdavyutpatterapyupalakṣaṇārthaḥ| nanu evamapi vicāraśāstrasya viṣayasaṃbandhau na samarthitāviti codayati nanu brahma vedāntānāmiti|| nanu "brahmajijñāse"ti śāstrasyāpi sa eva viṣayo nirdiṣṭaḥ, netyāha -- śāstraṃ ca teṣāmiti|| sūtravākyāni nyāyā viṣayāṇi, nyāyāśca pramāṇaprameyasambhāvanādiviṣayāḥ| nanu sambhāvanāvagama eva tarhi prayojanamiti, netyāha -- prayojanaṃ tviti|| praṇāḍyeti paramparayāpītyarthaḥ| dharmārthābhyāṃ sukhameva prāpyata iti tayostatparatā| nanu karaṇetikartavyatayorekameva prayojanamiti nirṇītaṃ prathame tantre, tathāhi "āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ" "upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati" "agnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālami"ti paurṇamāsyāṃ karmatrayam, tathā "āgneyo'dṛṣṭākapālaḥ" "aindraṃ dadhi" "aindaṃ payaḥ" iti darśe trayamityāgneyādayaḥ ṣaḍyāgāḥ| teṣāṃ karaṇabhūtānāṃ dvividhānyaṅgāni nirūpitāni -- arthakarmāṇi saṃskārakarmāṇi ceti| phalopakāryaṅgāni prayājādīnyārādupakārakāṇyarthakarmāṇi, prokṣāṇādīni tu dravyadvāreṇa yāgasvarūpopakāritayā sannipatyopakārakāṇi saṃskārakarmāṇi| tatrobhayavidhānāmapyaṅgānāṃ pradhānāpūrvadvāreṇa svargasiddhireva prayojanamiti| evaṃ śabdaśaktitātparyavicārasya saṃskārakarmavacchabdapramāṇasvarūpopakāritayā, arthasvarūpabrahmavicārasya ca brahmāvagamaphalopakāritayā, avagamyamānabrahmaviṣayatvamubhayavidhavicārasya yujyata ityapasiddhāntī codayati -- nanu āgneyādīnāmityādinā||nanu vedāntā eva brahmāvagatisamarthāḥ, tatra kathamitikartavyasyāvagamaphalatayā brahmaviṣayateti tatrāha -- tena yadyapi vedāntā eveti|| nanu kathaṃ saṃbhāvanābuddhihetutayā tadviṣayasya vicārasya brahmāvagamajanakatayā tadviṣayatā nahyanyaviṣayo vyāpāro'nyaviṣaya iti, tatrāha -- nahi chetturiti|| dvividhaṃ hi karmakārakam -- kiṃcidavyavadhānatayā vyāpārajanyātiśayavat, yathodyamananipātanavyāpārasyordhvādhodeśasaṃyogavibhāgātiśayaviśiṣṭaḥ kuṭhāraḥ kartṛvyāpārasyāvyavadhānena karmakārakaṃ bhavati, kiñciduddeśyaphalatayā karaṇavyāpāravyavadhānena karma bhavati; yathā dvaidhībhūto vṛkṣa iti| tatra kartṛvyāpāraḥ karaṇavyāpāravyavahito'pi vṛkṣādvaidhībhāvaphala ucyate; "vṛkṣaṃ chinattī"ti kartṛvyāpārasya tatkarmatāvagamāt, sa eva vṛkṣaḥ kuṭhāravyāpārasya sākṣātkarma bhavati; avyavadhānāt| nanu karaṇasya kuṭhārasya kathaṃ kartṛteti ucyate -- sarvāṇi khalu svavyāpārāpekṣayā kartṛṇi| sarvakārakavyāpārāṇāṃ ca phalaṃ karmatayā sādhyam| tatra kartṛkaraṇakarmabhedo'vāntarabhedāpekṣayā bhavati| tatra kartā sādhananiyogena vā dhātunā viśeṣyavyāpāratayā vā svatantravyāpāraḥ| karaṇaṃ phalaṃ prati sannipatyopakārakam| phalasamavāyi karmakārakamiti| "kāṣṭhāni pacantī"tyādivyapadeśaḥ svavyāpārakartṛtvāpekṣayā, nāvāntarabhedāpekṣayeti| tasmāt kartṛvyāpārasya karaṇavyāpāravyavadhānena vṛkṣakarmatā; evaṃ vicāravyāpārasyāpi pramāṇaprameyasambhāvanāvagamadvāreṇa brahmāvagamoddeśyatvād avagamahetoravagamyaviṣayatvād brahmakarmatā na virudhyate| athāvyavahitameva karma, noddeśyamiti, tatrāha -- anyathā'nyatra kartṛvyāpāra iti|| atretikartavyeṣu dvividhaṃ pramāṇam -- āgamo'nvayavyatirekau ca| prayājādīnāmāgamāt, mṛtkulālādīnāṃ kartṛvyāpārasya cāṅkurakumbhadvaidhībhāvāṅgatā'nvayavyatirekābhyām, atra tu śabdopalabdhisaṃbandhajñānasaṃskārasahakṛtācchabdādarthāvagame sati vicārasyāṅgatā nānyatarapramāṇenāpyavagatā; śabdādeva vicārānapekṣādavagamajananādītyapasiddhāntinaṃ pariharati pūrvavādī -- viṣama upanyāsa iti|| nanu yathā cakṣurādayaḥ samyagjñānahetavo'pi doṣasaṃyogātsaṃśayaviparyāsau janayanti, punaḥ samyagjñānajanmani ca doṣāpakarṣamapekṣante; evaṃ śabdaḥ śaktitātparyājñānatadviparyayajñānadoṣāt saṃśayādijñānamutpādayati, tatra doṣāpanayanena viparyāsādinivṛttaye śaktitātparyavicāro'ṅkabhāvamaśnuta iti codayati -- nanu saṃśayaviparyāsanirāsadvāreṇeti|| tatra kiṃ śabda eva doṣavaśādanyathājñānaṃ janayati, vicāraśca tadapanayanena tathā pramitihetutāṃ pratipadyate kiṃ vā śabdaḥ samyagjñānasyaiva hetuḥ, kāraṇāntarādanyathājñānam, vicāraśca pratibandhamātraṃ nirācaṣṭe, nivṛtte ca pratibandhe śabdādevārthanirṇaya iti tatra na tāvad viparyāsādinirāsenārthanirṇayahetutā vicārasyetyāha -- naitatsāram; yatra hyanekamiti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- na śabdasamavāyī kaściddoṣo'sti, puruṣendriyasamavāyitvād doṣāṇām| ataḥ śabdo na viparyāsādijñānahetuḥ, kintu śabdānāṃ prayogāntareṣvanyathānyathāśaktitātparyonnayanadarśanādihāpi tathā tathā viditvā sāmānyato darśanenārthavirodhibudhyā ca puruṣadoṣeṇānyathājñānānyutpadyante| śabdācca tattvajñānamevotpadyate| tataśca śabdāt puruṣadoṣācca bahuṣu parasparavirodhiṣu jñāneṣu jāteṣu śabdaśaktitātparyāvadhāraṇaṃ puruṣadoṣāpanayanena pratipakṣajñānāntaramātraṃ nivartayati, nivṛtte ca pratibandhe śabdādeva tattvajñānaṃ jāyate, jātaṃ vā niścalamavatiṣṭhate| tasmānna vicāraḥ karaṇetikartavyatayā brahmaviṣaya iti|| evamapasiddhānte niraste pūrvavādinā, siddhāntayati -- atrocyate yadyapi vākyārthajñānamityādinā|| tatra sāmānyatodṛṣṭanibandhaneneti|| prayogāntareṣvanyathānyathāśaktitātparyadarśanādihāpi tathābhāvabudhyā tathāvidhārthasya ca loke'nyathābhāvadarśanādihāpyanyathābhāvabudhyetyarthaḥ| ayamāśayaḥ -- pratibandhanivṛttau satyāmevārthanirṇayāt pratibandhanirāsino'pyupacāreṇa brahmanirṇayahetutvādvicārasya brahmaviṣayateti| atredaṃ vicāryam -- kiṃ tātparyamarthapramiti hetuḥ kiṃ vā pratibandhanirāsaheturiti kecitpramitihetutāmāhuḥ| tatra kiṃ vijñātaṃ tātparyaṃ pramitihetuḥ avijñātaṃ vā na tāvadavijñātaṃ pramitihetuḥ ; tātparyāvagamaphalavicārānapekṣatvaprasaṅgāt, tātparyaviṣayādanyatra budhyanutpādaprasaṅgācca| tathāca kaścit sthānajighṛkṣayā kañcidutthāpayannāha "pitrā tvamāhūtaḥ" iti| sa ca piturāhvānaṃ pratipadya samuttiṣṭhati, itarastu tatra niviśate, samutthitaśca sannitaro jānāti sthānajighṛkṣayedamuktamiti| nanu -- na piturāhvāne tātparyahīne saṃsargabuddhiriti -- cet; na; utthānādipravṛttidarśanāt, pravṛtteśca saṃsargajñānapuraḥsaratvābhāve pravṛttyā saṃsarge śabdaśaktitātparyakalpanāyogāt| nanu śabdo na mithyājñānamutpādayati, naiṣa doṣaḥ; satyapi piturāhvāne tathābhūtajñāne ca tātparyaṃ vakturanyatretyetāvaddarśitam| tasmānnājñātatayā tātparyaṃ pramitihetuḥ| atha jñātatayā tarhi kutra tātparyamavagamyate śabdasyātra tātparyamityāśrayaḥviṣayasāpekṣatvāttātparyasya| na tāvatpadārtheṣu tātparyam; vākyārthajñāne'nupayogāt| saṃsargaścānavagato na tātparyaviśeṣaṇatayā'vagantuṃ śakyate|| syādetat -- padāvagateṣu padārtheṣu parasparānvayayogyatānimittaḥ saṃsarga utprekṣayā'vagamyate| tadviṣayā ca tātparyāvagatiriti| na tāvat smṛtisaṃśayaviparyāsānāmanyatamaḥ saṃsargāvabodhaḥ| tatra pariśeṣācchabdajanyatayā saṃsargabodhaḥ pramāṇameva syāt| naca śaktiriva sāmānyopādhau tātparyam; prativākyaṃ viśeṣatātparyabhedāt| kiṃca padārthavatsaṃsarge'pi śaktimātranibandhanāvagamaḥ, na tātparyanibandhana ityanumātuṃ śakyate| śabdānāṃ ca padārthapradarśanamukhena tātparyopādhyupayogitayā'nyathāsiddhatvāt tātparyamātrāvagamādhīnaḥ saṃsargabodho na śabdanibandhanaśca syāt| tasmāt padānāmeva saṃsargapratipādanasāmarthyānmukhyalakṣaṇādvāreṇa pramāṇāntarāviruddhe saṃsarge pratipanne doṣāntaranimittasaṃśaya viparyāsādijñānanirākaraṇāya tātparyāvagama iti siddham| taccedaṃ trayamapyavaśyami"tyārabhya -- alamativistareṇetyataḥ prāktanena granthenoktamarthaṃ nigamayati samarthanaṃ pradarśayitum| asti tāvaditi spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu -- na brahma sāmānyenāpi loke pratipattuṃ śakyam, pramāṇāntarāgocaratvāt; nāpyāgamasāmarthyāt, tatra prayujyamānasya brahmaśabdasyānavadhṛtārthatvāt, naca padamātrodevārthāntarasiddhiḥ; jātyādyarthāntareṣu prasiddhatvāt, tasmānna prasiddhamuddiśya vicāravidhānopapattiriti codayati -- kathamiti|| tatra śrutisūtrayorbrahmaśabdaprayogasāmarthyādeva jātyādivyatiriktaṃ kiṃcid vastu pratipattuṃ śakyata ityata āha -- brahmaśabdastāvadityādinā|| nanu arthāntarasadbhāve kiṃ pramāṇamiti prayogārthāpattiḥ, ityāha -- ato nūnamanyadeveti|| nanu śrautaprayogānupapattirnāpūrvamarthaṃ gamayati; laukikaprayogādhīnatvācchrautaprayogasyeti, tatrāha -- tena svargāpūrvadevateti|| "apūrvami"ti "tāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsanni"tyādau vede dharmaśabdaprayogo'bhipreyate| nanu vākye prayuktaṃ padaṃ pramāṇāntarānadhigatamarthaṃ na pratipādayati, padārtho'śe'nuvādamātratvādityāha -- naitatsāramiti|| na pratyakṣavat, saṃbandhagrahaṇābhāvānnānumānādivaccetyarthaḥ| nanu darśitaṃ svargādivaditi, netyāha -- svargādyartho'pīti|| sannihitānekavākyārthasāmarthyalabhyaḥ svargādipadārtha ityarthaḥ| tatra vākyārthapramitivivakṣayā prasiddhārthaiḥ padāntaraiḥ sahāprasiddhārthapadaprayogānupapattireva pratipādyena saṃbandhagrahaṇānapekṣayā pūrvapadārthaṃ padavācyatvena pratipādayatīti pariharati -- yasmin vākya ekaṃ padamiti|| vipralambhabhrāntyādidoṣarahitavedasūtravākyārthanirṇayasyāvaśyalabhyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu sahaprayogānupapattirniyāmakābhāvād yaṃ kañcidarthamupasthāpayatīti, tatrāha -- tatra nigamanirukteti|| nigamo nāma prasiddhārtha tadavayavau parityajya śabdasya śabdaikadeśānugamenārthāntare vṛttiḥ, yathā dehātmādiśabdānāmupacitavastusantatagamanavatpadārthādāvekadeśānugamena vṛttiḥ; prasiddhārthatadavayavopādānenārthāntaravṛttau lakṣaṇāguṇavṛttiprasaṅgāt| niruktaṃ nāma śabdasya sarvāvayavārthānugamena prasiddhādarthādarthāntare vṛttiḥ, yathā somaśabdasya pārvatīsahitamaheśvare vṛttiḥ| vyākaraṇampratyayavidhānasāmarthyadarthaniścayaḥ, yathā vādīti tācchīlyai ṇinipratyayavidhānasāmarthāyadvadanaśīlo gamyate| nanu prasiddhibalenāprasiddhamupādīyate, nacāprasiddhena prasiddhaṃ tyajyata ityatra ko viśeṣa iti tatrāha -- nahi prasiddhiraprasidhyati|| aprasiddhirnaisargikaprāgabhāvaḥ| prasiddhapadārthaiḥ saha vākyārthanirṇayāya prayogānupapattirevāgantukī tasya prāghabhāvasya nivṛttiheturiti bhāvaḥ| nanu avayavārthasāmānyānugamānāṃ sarvato viprasṛtisambhavādupādeyārthaniyamāyogād vākyārthapratipattiniyamo na syāditi codayati -- nanu nigamādivaśeneti|| atra nigūḍhābhisandhiruttaramāha -- na tarhi nigamādīnāmiti|| rūḍhisāmarthyādeva sarvatra vākyārthaniyame lokaprasiddhaṃ vṛttyantaramanarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| pūrvavādī nigamādīnāmarthavattāmāha -- bhavatyarthavatteti|| svārthādanyatreti-arthāntaravivakṣayetyarthaḥ| viniyogāditi|| vākyārthasaṃsargaṃ nimittīkṛtyetyarthaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- vākyārthanirṇayaṃ nimittīkṛtya padāntaraiḥ saha prayogānupapattireva nigamādivaśenārthamādadānā sannihitapadārthasaṃsargayogyatayā prayojanaparyantameva padārthamādate, iti vākyārthaniyamasiddhiriti| siddhāntī nigūḍhābhisandhiṃ vivṛṇoti -- evaṃ tarhyekārthaniyamāyeti|| prathamaprayogānupapattirnigamādyanugṛhītā phalaparyantavākyārthānvayipadārthākāṅkṣānugṛhītā ca niyatapadārthopādānahetubhāve rūḍherna viśiṣyata ityarthaḥ| nanu evamapi kathaṃ brahmaśabdasya jātyādivilakṣaṇe niratiśayapuruṣārthe mumukṣorjijñāsāyogye vastuni nigamavaśād vṛttiriti tadāha -- tadatra brahmaśabde vyutpādyamāna iti|| nanu evamapi yatkiṃcidāpekṣikamaṃśatvasaṃpannaṃ vastvanugamyatāmiti, netyāha -- prayogānugame cāsatīti|| tatra hetuḥ -- vākyārthānvayīti|| tatrālpatvaṃ nāma vastuno deśakālavastuparicchedaḥ, tadvyāvṛttirnniratiśayamahattvam, tatropapadādisaṅkocakābhāve jijñāsyasya puruṣārthatayā vākyārthānvayasambhave ca tadapi brahmapadenānugamyata ityāha -- tataśca kālakṛtāvacchedanimittasyetyādinā buddhatvaṃ cetyataḥ prāktanena granthena|| bhāṣye nityaśabdena trividhamapi mahattvaṃ darśitamityarthaḥ| nanu buddhatvādayo guṇā na brahmatvopayoginaḥ, tat kathaṃ brahmapadādanugamyante iti codayati -- kathamiti|| naiṣa doṣaḥ guṇato'prakṛṣṭe'pyalpabuddhidarśanāt| tathāhi -- guṇahīnaṃ doṣabhūyiṣṭhaṃ ca vastvalpamavidyamānasamaṃ manyante, guṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ doṣahīnaṃ ca mahāntaṃ kathayanti| ato guṇo'lpatvanirākaraṇena mahattvaṃ darśayituṃ bodhaguṇahīnasya guṇato'pakṛṣṭatayā'lpatvād buddhatvamanugamyata ityāha -- abodhātmakaṃ vastvityādinā|| tathā cetanasyāpi saṃsāritve doṣabhūyiṣṭhatvād guṇato'pakarṣānniratiśayamahattvādisiddheḥ sarvadoṣarahitatayā muktatvotkarṣo'pyanugamyata ityāha -- muktamiti cāvidyākāmakarmaparatantraṃ iti|| cetanasyāpi muktasya sarvakāryaniyamanādiśaktyabhāve ca pariśiṣṭajñeyakāryaviṣayajñānaniyamanaśaktyabhāvāt tato'pakarṣādalpatā syāt, tadvyāvṛttyarthamāha -- sarvajñaṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitaṃ ca tadityādinā|| nanu brahmaśabdaprayoge'pi jātijīvakamalāsanaśabdarāśiṣu naitāvānarthaḥ pratīyate, tatra kathamanugamādapyetādṛśasyārthasya pratipattiriti tadāha -- siddhe hi vastuni prayoga iti|| pramāṇāntaragṛhīte'rthe prayogasāmarthyādevārthapratipattāvalpaṃ vā mahadvā yathā pramāṇāntareṇa pratipadyate, tathaiva śabdārthaḥ pratipattavyaḥ| yadā punaḥ prayogasāmarthyamanapekṣya śabdāvayavasāmarthyādevārtho'nugamyate, tadā pramāṇāntaropapadaprakaraṇānāṃ saṅkocahetūnāmabhāvād yathāsāmarthyaṃ mukhya evārthaḥ pratipattavya iti bhāvaḥ| ukte'rthe bhāṣyamavatārayati -- tadetadāheti|| nanu -- sautrasya śabdasyārtho'nugamyate kiṃ vā śrautasya na tāvat sautrasya; pauruṣeyaprayogasya pramāṇāntarāpekṣatvāttadabhāvāt, nāpi śrautasya; "satyaṃ jñānam" "yato vā imānī"tyādiśāstre nirṇīyamānārthatvādanugamānapekṣaṇāt -- iti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; śrutipramāṇāvagataviṣayatayā tanmūlasyaiva sautrasya brahmaśabdaprayogasyottarasūtrapratipādyaśrutipramāṇagamyabrahmasvarūpamanapekṣyaivārthānugamamukhenārthopādānāt, uttarasūtrasādhyasiddhavatkāreṇārthopādānānupapatteśca| śrautasya vā'yaṃ brahmaśabdasyārthānugamo varṇyate, vākyārthānvayitayā prayuktasya brahmaśabdasya vākyapramāṇamanapekṣyaivānyataḥ siddhervaktavyatvādanugamāpekṣaṇāt| nanu tarhi padānugamasya varṇitaviśiṣṭārthaviṣaye sambhāvanāmātrabuddhihetutvātpramāṇāntarānadhigatasya padārthasya kathaṃ vākyānvayitayā tatra nirṇayahetutvam iti codayati -- nanu evamapi|| vyutpattyanusaraṇeneti|| tatra jijñāsāpadasya sannihitasyānirṇītajijñāsyavastusāpekṣatvāttadapekṣitārthasamarpaṇasya brahmaśabdasyānirṇītapratipannavastumātrasamarpaṇena vākyārthanirṇayahetutvaṃ na virudhyata iti pariharati -- satyamevam, ata eveti|| sarvasyātmatvācceti bhāṣyatātparyārthamāha -- idamaparaṃ brahmaśabdārthasyeti|| nanu ātmanyapi na pramāṇam, pratyakṣādyaviṣayatvāt, prāmāṇikasya ca dvicandrādivadavastutvāditi, tatrāha -- sarvo hyātmāstitvamiti|| nanu śūnya evāyamātmā pratibhāsate, kathamātmāstitvasiddhiḥ iti śūnyavādamāśaṅkyāha -- yadi nātmāstitvaprasiddhiḥ syāditi|| nanu ātmapadārthe pratyakṣāvagate kathaṃ brahmapadārthasya prasiddhiriti ata āha -- ātmā ca brahmeti|| nanu anādivṛddhavyavahāre brahmaśabdasyātmani prayogādarśanāt kathaṃ brahmaśabdenātmā jijñāsyatvenopādīyate iti codayati -- kathaṃ punarātmā brahmeti|| laukikaprayogābhāve'pi vaidikaprayogasāmarthyāt "sa vā ayamātmā brahme"tyādau brahmaśabdenātmā jijñāsyatvenopādīyata iti pariharati -- vedānteṣviti|| nanu brahmaśabdābhidheyo'yamātmā nāhaṃpratyayavedyaḥ, kiṃtvāgamaikasamadhigamya iti, netyāha -- ātmānameveti|| tataśca pratipannamuddiśya vicārasambhavācchakyapratipādyatā siddhetyāha -- tadevamahaṃpratyaya eveti|| nanu -- vedānteṣu sañjñāparatayā nātmani brahmaśabdaḥ prayujyate, kiṃtvātmano brahmaśabdārthatādātmyābhiprāyeṇa; tataścātiriktārthatvād brahmaśabdenātmopādīyata ityuktam -- iti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; atiriktabrahmasvarūpanirṇayavivikṣayā prasiddhāśasya brahmaśabdenopādānāt, ekasminnapyarthe bimbapratibimbādivat pratibhāsāpratibhāsopapatteḥ|| evaṃ tarhi pratyakṣagocaratayā'nanyasādhāraṇatvābhāvād viṣayatvaṃ na sidhyatītyākṣipati -- yadi tarhi loke brahmātmatveneti|| samādhatte -- na ; tadviśeṣaṃ prati vipratipatteriti|| bhāṣyārthe vivṛṇoti -- satyam; ahamityātmani pratyaya ityādinā|| nanu anyasmin vipratipanne kathamanyannirṇīyata iti tadāha -- tāśca vastuta iti|| nanu prasiddhe padārthe kathaṃ vipratipattiriti tadāha -- tataḥ sāmānyata prasiddhamapīti|| nanu apratipannaviśeṣaṃ vastu svayamapratipannameveti kathamuddiśyavidhānābhāve śakyapratipādyateti tatrāha -- sāmānyataḥ siddhatvācca śakyata iti|| nanu nāsti brahmaṇi sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ, satyam; śarīrendriyamanobuddhiśūnyakartṛbhoktṛsarvajñabrahmātmanāṃ parāgvyāvṛttapratyagdharmānugamena siddhiḥ sāmānyam, tatra pratyagdharmānugamena siddhiḥ sāmānyam, tatra pratyagdharmānugamena sidhyan viśuddhasvarūpo'pi sāmānyataḥ siddha ityucyate| tataḥ pratyaktvānuraktaviśeṣāntarairvipratipadyate| tatra viśeṣāntarānurāgavirodhinā'sādhāraṇasvarūpeṇa nirṇīyata iti| kathaṃ vipratipattiḥ tāṃ darśayati -- dehamātramityādinā|| kathaṃ punaḥ pratyakṣasiddhapadārthe jāyamānasya prayujyamānasyāhaṃpratyayasya tacchabdasya cānekārthasādhāraṇyāśaṅkayā vipratipattiriti tatra dṛṣṭāntamāha -- tadyathā gośabdasyeti|| jātirvaidakaiḥ pratipannā, vyaktiḥ saṃkhyādibhiḥ, ubhayaṃ vaiyākaraṇaiḥ ākṛteravayavasaṃsthānamārhatādibhiḥ, tritayamapi naiyāyikaiḥ, kriyāguṇasaṃsthānādayo'pi yathādarśanam, iti yathā gośabdaprayoge jātyādīnāmanvayavyatirekaniyamādekasyāpi vyabhicārābhāvācchabdārthatvāśaṅkā, tathā śarīrādīnāmanvayavyatirekaniyamādātmatvāśaṅketi bhāvaḥ|| spaṣṭamūrtākāratayā sthūlamūrtatāramtayānnirāsakramasiddheśca śarīramārabhya vipratipatti darśayati -- tadāha dehamātraṃ caitanyaviśiṣṭamiti|| śarīrasyātmatvāśaṅkāyāṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇamāha -- tathāhi manuṣyo'hamiti|| dehaśabdārthamāha -- dehamātramitīti|| tvagindriyasya nirapekṣādhāraḥ śarīraṃ nāma| tatrāvayavāntareṣu chidyamāneṣvapi prāyeṇa tvagindriyaṃ tiṣṭhati, na śiraścheda ityabhiprāyeṇa saśirasketyucyate| nanu bhūtacatuṣṭayatatvavādināṃ pañcamaṃ caitanyaṃ tattvamavaśiṣyata iti, tannivṛttyarthamāha -- mātraśabdena dehātiriktamityādinā|| pakṣāntaramāha -- indriyāṇyeveti|| nanu yasmin vijñānamutpadyate, sa cetanaḥ| nahīndriyāśrayaṃ vijñānamutpadyate; "manuṣyo'haṃ jānāmī"tyavagamāt| tatra kathaṃ teṣāṃ cetanatvamiti tatrāha -- indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādimanaḥparyantānāmiti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- satyapi śarīre viṣayajñānānāmindriyairanvayavyatirekavattvāt karaṇatayā'nvayavyatirekavatvakalpanādāśrayatā'nvayavyatirekakalpanasyābhyarhitatvādindriyāṇyeva vijñānāśrayāṇīti| nanu ekasmin śarīre bahūnāmindriyāṇāṃ cetanatve "rūpamadrākṣam" "idānīṃ śrṛṇomī"ti pratyabhijñā na syāt, bhoktṛtvaṃ ca rūparasādiṣu yugapat syāt, na krameṇeti, tadāha -- krameṇa varagoṣṭhīvaditi|| ekaśarīrāśrayatvameva pratyabhijñākramabhogayornimittam, naikatvamityarthaḥ| nanu -- cetanatve'pyahaṃpratyayālambanasyaivātmatvam, tadabhāvānnendriyāṇāmātmatvamiti, tatrāha -- tathācendriyadharmasāmānādhikaraṇyamahaṃpratyayasyeti|| śarīrasyāpyahaṃpratyayālambanatvavijñānānvayavyatirekayorindriyātmanāmāśrayatvenāpyupapatteriti bhāvaḥ|| pakṣāntaramāha -- mata eva cetanamiti|| kimatra prāpakaṃ pramāṇamiti tadāha -- dṛśyate hi svapna iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- svapne cakṣurādyabhāve'pi kevale manasi vijñānālambanatvāhaṃpratyayaviṣayatvayoravikalayordarśanāt, rūpādivijñānānāṃ cakṣurādyāśrayatve tadabhāve kevale manasi rūpādismṛtyanupapatteḥ, āśrayāntare cāsiddhe cakṣurādīnāṃ jñānānvayavyatirekayoḥ karaṇaviṣayatayā'pyanupapatteḥ, ahaṃpratyayasya ca deha iva karaṇe kartṛtvopacārāt siddheḥ, pratyabhijñāyāḥ śarīrādāvivaikatvanibandhanatvāt, ekāśrayatvātpratyabhijñāyāmekaprāsādasamāśritānāmapi tatprasaṅgāt| tasmāccakṣurādikaraṇaśarīrādhāraṃ mana evātmeti|| pakṣāntaramāha -- vijñānamātraṃ kṣaṇikamityeka iti|| varṇatrayaśabdena varṇatrayābhidheyaṃ vijñānamātramucyate| tena ca vijñānāśrayasyātmano'bhāva ucyata iti| katham śarīrendriyāṇāṃ tāvadvijñeyatvādavijñānasyānātmatvād manasaśca samanantarapratyayavyatirekiṇo'bhāvādāśrayāntarādarśanāditi| kastarhyātmeti tadāha tena vijñānameveti|| tarhi sāṃkhyādīnāmiva vijñānamevānādinidhanamātmeti, tadāha -- svarasabhaṅguramiti|| kathaṃ tarhi pratyabhijñānenaikatvāvagama iti tadāha -- aviratodayamiti|| jvālānāmiva saṃtatavijñānodayasādṛśyāt pratyabhijñetyarthaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi karmajñānabandhamokṣāśrayatvaṃ kṣaṇikasyeti tadāha -- akhilalokayātrānilayamiti|| vijñānānāṃ hetuphalasantānamātrādeva karmaphalasambandha ityarthaḥ| nanu sthāyinyātmanyekasmin sarvametanmukhyamupapannamiti, tatrāha -- anubhavabhagnapakṣāntaramiti|| pakṣāntaramāha -- śūnyamiti|| vijñānavyatiriktānāṃ tāvadātmatvaṃ vijñeyatvāt pratyākhyātam| na ca vijñānasyātmatvamasti; suṣupte śūnyatā'vagamāt| vidyata eva tatrāpi vijñānapravāha iti cet, na; viṣayāvabhāsābhāvāt, nirālambanajñānāyogācca| sākārajñānānāmeva sālambanatvaṃ na sauṣuptikānāmiti cet, na; viśeṣābhāvāt, aviśeṣānumānācca| utthitenāsmaryamāṇavijñānatvācca suṣupte vijñānābhāvaḥ| kiṃca savikalpakasya svaviṣayaviparītanirvikalpakālambanatvavannirvikalpakasyāpi satpratyayatvāt svaviṣayaviparītaśūnyālambanatvānumānādutthānapratyayaḥ śūnyālambana iti gamyate| tadetadāha -- suṣupte vijñānaleśasyāpyabhāvāditi|| mā bhūdvijñānaleśaḥ, tataḥ kimiti tadāha -- akasmādeveti|| utthānapratyayasya pūrvasamanantarapratyayaśūnyatayā kāraṇaśūnyatā syāditi bhāvaḥ| mā bhūt kāraṇamiti cet, tadāha -- akāraṇasya kādācitkasyeti|| tasmācchūnyālambano'sadavabhāso'yamiti|| vipratipattyantaramāha -- asti dehādivyatirikta iti|| kathaṃ punarvijñānaśūnyavyatiriktasyātmanaḥ siddhiriti tadāha -- ahamullekhaśūnyasya bhoktṛtvasyeti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- ahamityavabhāsamāno viṣayasaṃvidāśrayatvena bhoktā na kadācidapi mamapratyayālambano bhoktṛtvamanubhavati| sa cābādhitapratyabhijñāgocaro na suṣupte'bhāvamanubhavitumarhati| tataḥ śūnyaḥ kṣaṇikavijñānavyatirikto bhoktā; pratyabhijñayā suṣupte'pi sattāvagamāt, jñānecchādveṣaprayatnasukhaduḥkheṣu cāśrayaikatvāvagamāt| tathāhi -- pravṛttinimittabhūtamabhilaṣitasādhanajñānamutpadyamānamitthamutpadyate -- prathame vastuni dṛṣṭe, tadupabhogānantaraṃ sukhasaṃvedane ca dvitīye sañjāte, punarvastvantaradarśane tṛtīye samutpanne, caturthe ca dṛṣṭasya vastunaḥ pūrvasukhasādhanasāmānyāsaṃdhāne, pañcanyāmavasthāyām -- idaṃ sukhasādhanamiti jñānamutpadyate| tataḥ pañcasvavasthāsvekamātmānamantareṇedaṃ jñānamanupapannam; anyadṛṣṭe'nyasya sukhānubhavābhāvāt, anyānubhūte'nyasya vyāptyanusaṃdhānābhāvāt, anyānusaṃhite'nyasya sukhahetujñānābhāvāt, saṃtānabhedeṣvadarśanāt| tathā duḥkhahetutājñānamapi pañcāvasthamātmānaṃ kalpayati| tathā hitāhitajñānapūrvakau rāgadveṣau ṣaṣṭhāvasthau ṣaḍavasthamātmānaṃ kalpayataḥ| rāgadveṣābhyāṃ ca hānopādānaprayatno jāyamānaḥ saptāvasthamātmānaṃ kalpayati| tathā prayatnānantaramaṣṭamyāmavasthāyāṃ sukhaduḥkhe jāyamāne aṣṭāvasthamātmānaṃ kalpayataḥ| naca kṣaṇikeṣvātmasu saṃtānabhedeṣvivāyaṃ vyavahāraḥ sambhavati| tathā nāhaṃ jñānamityahamullekho vijñāneṣu, kiṃ tu mama jñānamiti| naca mamātmetivadupacāraḥ; bādhābhāvāt, itaratra saṃbandhapratyayasyātmaśabdena bādhāt| tasmādahamullekhapratyabhijñābhyāṃ śūnyavijñānavyatirikta ātmā| tathā tābhyāmeva hetubhyāṃ mano'pi nātmā; suṣupte manaso'bhāvepyātmani pratyabhijñānāt, "ahaṃ manaḥ" ityanavagamāt, "mama manaḥ" iti ca pratibhāsāt, jñānāyaugapadyena karaṇatayaiva tasya kalpanāt| tathā tābhyāmeva hetubhyāṃ nendriyāṇyapyātmānaḥ; rūparasādivijñānapañcake draṣṭuḥpratyabhijñānāt, svapne cakṣurādivyavahārābhāve'pyahamityātmani paripūrṇapratyayāt, "mamendriyāṇī"ti cāvagamāt, indriyāṇāmahamullekhavyatirekāt| tathā śarīramapi nātmā; svapne śarīrākārāvabhāsābhāve'pyahamityātmani paripūrṇapratyayāt, ahamullekhavyatirekāt, śarīrākārasaṃsargaśunye'pya"hami"ti draṣṭari pratyayaḥ śarīrādātmano bhede pratyakṣapratyayo bhavati; "mama śarīrami"ti ca vyatirekapratyayāt| nanu "ahaṃ kāṇo'haṃ manuṣyaḥ" iti ca śarīrendriyeṣvahamullekhādupacāro bhedapratyayaḥ, ahamullekha evopacāraḥ kiṃ na syāt kastarhi nirṇayaḥ ahamullekhasyaivopacāro yuktaḥ; vyatirikte'pyātmanyadhyāsanibandhanatvopapatteḥ| nacādhyāsād dvicandrādivad bhedapratyayaḥ dvitīye'pi candre candrākāravat svapne'pi "paśurahami"ti pratibhāse manuṣyaśarīrādyākārapratyayaprasaṅgāt| tathā jātamātrasya jantorbhayaharṣaśokādirutpādyamāno dṛṣṭanimittābhāve'smadādivatpūrvānubhūtanimittānusmṛtiṃ kalpayati| tataścāsyaivātmano bhayādinimittadarśanavattayā pūrvajanmasaṃbandhasiddhiḥ; pratyabhijñānāt| tadevamahamullekhapratyabhijñābhyāṃ śarīrendriyamanobuddhiśūnyavyatirikta ātmā siddhaḥ|| nanu sthāyitve'pi kadācidabhāvaḥ syāt, na tāvatparato vināśaḥ; niravayavasya hetuparāgābhāvāt, svasaṃsargiṇaśca svakarmaphalasādhanatayopāttasya phalahetutayā''tmanaḥ sthitihetutvādavināśakatvāt, nāpi svata ityāha -- sthirasya cāvadhihetutvānupalabdheriti|| svasattāprayuktavināśahetutvānupapatteḥ, kṣaṇikasyaiva tadbhāvādityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punastasya kartṛtvabhoktṛtve iti tatpratipādayati -- nirvikārasya bhogāsaṃbhavādityādinā|| "kathaṃ punastadvyatiriktatvami"ti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| tatra naiyāyikā manyante -- pārthivā''pyataijasavāyavyāni bhūmyantarikṣasvargabrahmalokeṣu vyavasthayā śarīrāṇi, nānekairbhūtairekaṃ śarīramārabdhamiti| tatrāsmadādiśarīraṃ pārthivameva; "pārthivaguṇāntaropalabdheri"tyakṣapādasūtrāt, śarīre gandhaviśeṣopalabdherityarthaḥ| naca rūparasasparśā bhūtāntarasamavāyaṃ gamayanti; pārthivasyāpi teṣāṃ guṇatvāt| nanu kledanapācanavyūhanāvakāśānāṃ śarīre darśanād bhūtapañcakārabdhatvaṃ śarīrasyeti, na; dṛtivastrodakādivad bhūtāntasaṃyogādapi vyūhanādyupapatteḥ| śrutiśca "pārthivīṃ śarīrami"ti pārthivatvameva śarīrasya darśayati| vaiśeṣikāstu -- pratyakṣāpratyakṣavṛtterapratyakṣatvāt pañcātmakaṃ na vidyata iti, vāyvākāśayorapratyakṣatvāt pañcātmakaṃ śarīramapratyakṣaṃ syāt, tasmātpārthivameva śarīramiti -- kalpayanti|| tān pratyāha -- bhūtasaṃghātastāvaccharīramiti|| vastre kledanasya, jale pākasya, hatau vyahanasya jalāgnipavanavigamādapāye'pi vastrādīnāmapacayādarśanāccharīrasya ca jalādivigame tantvapacayātpaṭāpacayavadapacayadarśanāt sarvatantvārabdhapaṭavatsarvabhūtārabdhaṃ śarīramiti gamyate| "annamaśitaṃ tredhā vidhīyate" ityādiśrutismṛtivādāśca bhūtapañcakaṃ śarīraṃ kathayanti; pratyakṣāpratyakṣayorapratyakṣatve sarvāvayavināṃ pratyakṣāpratyakṣāvayavavṛttīnāmapratyakṣatvāpātaḥ| tasmād bhūtasaṃghātaḥ śarīramiti|| atrāvayavavyāpārambhamanapekṣya saṃghātamātrasya bhoktṛtvābhāvaṃ darśayituṃ vibhajate -- tatra vyastānāmiti|| vyavastānāṃ bhoge'pi yugapat krameṇa vā bhogaḥ na tāvad yugapadityāha -- yadi tāvad vyastānāmiti|| tatra dūṣaṇamāha -- tataḥ svārthaprayuktatvāditi|| mā bhūdaṅgāṅgibhāva ityata āha -- na cāṅgāṅgibhāvamantareṇeti|| ekaikasya bhoktṛtve saṃghātādanyatrāpi bhogaḥ syādityāha -- tasmānna vyasteṣu bhoga iti|| astu tarhi kramaḥ| nanu kramapakṣe'pi bhoktṛṇāṃ na saṃghātāpattiriti, tatrāha -- virodhādvaragoṣṭhīvaditi|| parihartuṃ dṛṣṭāntād vaiṣamyamāha -- naitadevamiti|| dārṣṭāntikaṃ vibhajate -- iha punariti ayamatrāśayaḥ -- yadi tāvad rūparasagandhasparśānāmanyatamo'pi caturṇāṃ bhoktṛṇāṃ viṣayaḥ, tadā sādhāraṇe viṣaye kramabhoge kāraṇaṃ nāsti, yadi rūpādiṣu pratyekaṃ bhūtānāṃ bhoktṛtvaviṣayavyavasthā, tadā'pi yugapat sarvaviṣayasannidhāne kramānupapattiḥ| yathaikasmin muhūrte pratyekaṃ bhogyakanyāvastuni sannihite varāṇāṃ guṇapradhānatayā saṃghātābhāvaḥ, tadvad bhoktṛṣu ca pratyabhijñānupapattiriti| astu tarhi samūhasya bhoktṛtvam| nanu ekasmin bhūte'vidyamānaṃ caitanyaṃ kathaṃ saṃghāte janyata iti tadāha -- tilajvālāvaditi|| tatra vaktavyam -- kiṃ saṃhatānāṃ bhoktṛtvam āhosvid bhoktṛṇāṃ saṃhatiriti saṃghātasyāvastutvād bhoktṛtvānupapatteḥ, vastutve'pi bhūtebhyo bhede pañcamatattvābhyupagamaprasaṅgāt, abhede bhūtānyeva saṃghāta iti teṣāmeva bhoktṛtvāt| tatra saṃhatānāṃ bhoktṛtve saṃhatiheturvaktavyaḥ| āgāmī bhoga iti cet, taṃ prati bhūtānāṃ samānatvād guṇapradhānabhāvena saṃghātānupapattirityāha -- naitadevaṃ bhogeṣu samūhāsambhavāditi|| nanu bhogānvayāt prāg bhūtānāṃ kartṛtvāt kartṛṇāṃ bhoge guṇabhāvena saṃghātopapattiriti codayati -- kathamasaṃbhava iti|| anyonyaṃ guṇapradhānatvābhāvād bhogaṃ pratyapi prādhānyād bhoktṛṇāṃ na saṃghāta iti pariharati -- bhokturbhogaṃ prati prādhānyāditi|| nanu bhoge śeṣiṇi tādarthyena samūho dṛśyata iti codayati -- nanu bhoge'pīti|| tatra śarīravyatiriktayorevātmanorbhoktrostādarthyena śarīrayorguṇapradhānabhāvenānvayaḥ, na bhoktrorevetyabhipretya pariharati -- naitatsāramiti|| nanu jvālāyāṃ tilānāṃ guṇābhāvavad bhoge saṃghāta iti, netyāha -- tilajvālāyāṃ tu viparītamiti|| ata eva bhoktṛṇāmeva saṃhatipakṣo'nupapannaḥ| nanu ko'yaṃ saṃghāto nāma naca vanavadekadeśatāmātram ; tadvyāpīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ sarvatra vidyate, iti sarvatra caitanyabhogayoḥ prasaṅgāt| nacāvayavyārambhaḥ; tasya bhūtebhyo bhede tattvasaṃkhyātirekāt, abhede ca bhūtamātratayā saṃghātābhāvāt, bhedābhedānaṅgīkaraṇāt| nanu svatantraṃ bhūtacatuṣṭayameva; avayavyādīnāṃ pāratantryāt saṃkhyātirekābhāvāt, tarhi na bhūtānāṃ bhoktṛtvam, kiṃtvayavavina eva| tatra bhūtavyāpārānapekṣayā svayameva bhokturavayavinaḥ paratantratā'bhāvāt saṃkhyātirekaḥ syāt, jalādeśca pṛthivyāditantratvānnyūnā ca saṃkhyā syāt| nacaikadravyabudhyālambanayogyatāpattiḥ saṃghātaḥ; arthasvabhāvenaikatvāpattyayogāt, anekeṣvekatvabuddherbhramatvāt| nacaikārthakriyāyāṃ yugapadanvayaḥ saṃghātaḥ; kāṣṭhāśrayeṇa vahninā vāyusamudbhūtena jale dahyamāne'pi saṃghātād bhogaprasaṅgāt| nacāgnyayaḥ piṇḍavatsaṃśleṣaḥ saṃghātaḥ; śarīre vāyostathā saṃśleṣābhāvāt, vahnivyāpte cāyaḥpiṇḍe samāpītajale vāyusaṃyukte ca bhogaprasaṅgāt| tasmānnāsti bhoganimittaḥ saṃghāta iti|| evaṃ tarhyekasyaiva bhūtasya bhoga ityāha -- astvekasya tarhi niyata iti|| rūparasagandhasparśeṣu bhogyeṣu kaṭhinamṛdupākacalanaguṇavati bhūtasaṃghāte ca bhogānvayini paridṛśyamāne kasyaikasya bhoga ityanavadhārito bhogaḥ syāditi dūṣayati -- na tatrāpīti|| nanu yasya kasyacid bhogaḥ syāt, tāvataiva śarīravyatiriktabhoktṛrabhāvo vivakṣitaḥ siddha ityāha -- kimavadhāraṇeneti|| pariharati -- yadyevamiti|| caturṇāṃ bhogānvayadarśanād viśeṣanirdhāraṇābhāvāccaturṣu bhoktṛṣu saṃghātānupapannerayuktaṃ śarīrātmakeṣu bhūteṣu bhoktṛṣvanniti| indriyāṇyeva bhūtātmakānyātmeti lokāyatabhedaḥ, tatroktaṃ dūṣaṇajātamatidiśati -- evaṃ kāraṇātmakeṣvapīti|| yadyekaikabhūtārabdhānyekaikendriyāṇi, tatra pratyabhijñānābhāvādayo doṣāḥ| yadi bhūtacatuṣṭyārabdhakaikendriyam, tadā saṃghātānupapattyādayo doṣāḥ, iti kāryakāraṇātmakaḥ saṃghāto bhoktetyanye lokāyatikāḥ, tatrāha -- tayobhayātmaka iti|| pratyabhijñāsaṃghātānupapatteriti|| nanu kānīndriyāṇi nāma golakamātrāṇīti sugatāḥ; tacchaktaya iti mīmāṃsakāḥ; tadvyatiriktāni dravyāntarāṇītyanye sarve| na tāvadgolakamātram; sarpādīnāṃ tadvirahiṃṇāmapi śabdārthāpalabdheḥ, "śarīrajaiḥ karmadoṣairyāti sthāvaratāṃ naraḥ"| "tasmātpaśyanti pādapāḥ" ityādiśāstrād vṛkṣādīnāṃ golakavirahiṇāṃ karmaphalabhogasthānāvagamena śabdārthopalabdhyabhyupagamāt, vṛkṣādihiṃsāpratiṣedhācca prāṇitvāvagamāt| ata eva na tacchaktayaḥ; śaktimaddravyāntarakalpanāllaghīyaḥ pratipannasthāneṣu śaktikalpanamiti cet, tarhyātmana eva sarvajñānasāmarthyaṃ kramakāri kalpyatām; sarvagatasyāpyātmanaḥ śarīrapradeśe jñānapariṇāmavadgolakapradeśeṣu jñānapariṇāmāt, golakapradeśeṣu jñānapariṇāmād golakānāṃ jñānānvayavyatirekopapatteḥ, anindriyatve'pi śarīravat| santu tarhīndriyāṇi golakavyatiriktāni śaktimanti dravyāṇi sthānaviśeṣasambandhāccakṣurādiśabdavācyāni, na; teṣu pramāṇābhāvāt| rūpādyupalabdhaya eva kartṛvyāpārāḥ karaṇānumāne liṅgamiti cet, na; svavyāpārākartṛṣu karaṇeṣu karaṇāntarābhāvādanaikāntikatvāt, karaṇaviṣaye ca tatpreraṇālakṣaṇe kartṛvyāpāre karaṇāntarābhāvāt| "sarve prāṇā anūtkrāmantī"tyāgamagamyānīndriyāṇīti cet, na; āgamasaṃskāravirahiṇāmapīndriyāpratipatteḥ| naca manovatsākṣivedyānīndriyāṇi; kāryabhāvābhāvavyatirekeṇendriyabhāvābhāvānavagamāt| tasmānna satīndriyāṇi| ucyate -- āgamāvagamātprāk sthānaviśeṣu cakṣurādīndriyavyavahāraḥ pravartate, maṇḍalādiṣvādityādivyavahāravat, āgamāvagatau tu sthānaviśeṣādhiṣṭhātṛṇi cakṣurādīndriyāṇyādityādi devatātmavadityavagamyate| tāni punarvyatiriktānyapyāhaṅkārikāṇīti sāṃkhyāḥ, tadayuktam; pramāṇābhāvāt| na tadāvadadhyātmāhaṅkārajanyādīndriyāṇītyanvayavyatirekāvagamo vā dṛśyate| naca kṛtsnakāryavyāpī bhūtendriyāṇāṃ prakṛtiḥ kaścidahaṅkāro vidyate; mānābhāvāt| āptavacanaṃ mānamiti cet, na; atīndriyatvāt| nanu purāṇavākyānyeva santi, satyam "annamayaṃ hi saumya manaḥ" ityādibhūtavikārārthe mayaṭśrutivirodhādahaṅkārādhīnatāmātramindriyāṇāṃ tatra kalpyata iti na virodhaḥ|| bhautikānīndriyāṇīti vaiśeṣikādayaḥ, tadapyayuktam; mānābhāvāt| bhautikāni, indriyāṇi, madhyamaparimāṇatvena sāvayavatvāt; ghaṭādivat, iti cet, na; hetorasiddhatvāt, aṇuparimāṇatvopapatterindriyāṇām| tarhyaṇuparimāṇa eva viṣayāvabhāsaḥ syāt na; aṇuparimāṇeva manasā vistṛtātmādivastudarśanāt| nanu bhautikāni, indriyāṇi, rūparasagandhasparśānāṃ niyamenābhivyañjakatvāt; pradīpāsyodakadiṅgvādidravyavyajanavāyuvat, ityanumānāntareṇa pratyekabhūtārabdhāni pratyekendriyāṇyanumīyanta iti, na; śabdādivyañjake śrotre śabdaguṇavadākāśānārabdhe'naikāntikatvāt, karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnākāśamātrasya śrotratvābhyupagamādanārabdhatvāt| manasaśca bhūtacatuṣṭayārabdhatvaprasaṅgaḥ; tadabhivyañjakatvāt| ātmākāśādīnāmapi sādhāraṇatvānmanaso na bhūtārabhyatvamiti cet, saṃkhyāparimāṇasaṃyogavibhāgajātiviśeṣasamavāyādīnāmapi sādhāraṇatvādindriyāṇāṃ na bhūtārabhyatvasiddhiḥ| asādhāraṇaviṣayārabhyāṇīndriyāṇīti cet, tarhyātmārabhyaṃ manaḥ syāt; asādhāraṇaviṣayatvāt| ekadravyārabdhaṃ na dravyamiti cet, na; sāvayavamanekadravyārabhyamityetāvat, niravayavaṃ tu mano niravayavātmā''mārabhyaṃ kiṃ na syāt tasmādāgamādeva bhautikatvasiddhiḥ|| tāni sarvagatānīti yogāḥ pratipedire, tadapi mānahīnam| ātmendriyamanāṃsi, sarvagatāni, sarvatra dṛṣṭakāryatvādākāśavaditi cet, na; hetorasiddhatvāt| yatra śarīram, tatra sarvatra dṛṣṭakāryatvāditi cet, śarīre'nekāntaḥ| paropādhigamanatvādākāśavaditi cet, na; śarīrāvayavānāmapi paropādhigamanāt, sarvagatatve ca yugapat sarvaviṣayopalabdhiśca syāt| śarīra eva vṛttilābhānneti cet, tarhi bahirindriyasadbhāvakalpanā na pramāṇāprayojanamatī|| tānyaprāpyakārīṇiti sugatāḥ, tadayuktam; dūrata eva sparśarasagandhopalabdhiprasaṅgāt| yogyadeśāvasthānamapekṣitamiti cet, na; indriyadeśaprāptivyatirekeṇa yogyadeśānirūpaṇāt| sparśanarasanaghrāṇendriyavat cakṣuḥśrotrayorapi prāpyakāritvamanumīyate, tejasaścātidūraśīghragamanadarśanāccakṣuṣo dhruvādiprāptiraviruddhā| śabdasya ca dūradeśopalabdherna vīcīsantānavat paramparayā śrotrasamavāyaḥ| tasmād bhautikāni paricchinnāni prāpyakārīṇīndriyāṇīti siddham| kiṃ tarhi mano nāma nityaṃ nirayavayavamaṇuparimāṇamiti vaiśeṣikādayaḥ saṃgirante| na tāvannityam; paricchinnatvāt| niravayavadravyatvādātmavannityamiti cet, na; karaṇatvenendriyavat sāvayavatvānumānāt, annamayatvaśruteśca| mūrtadravyānabhighātānniravayavamiti cet, na; manaso bahirnirgamanābhāvāt| utkrāntirindriyāṇāmapi samānā| saṃyogavibhāgavatvānna ghaṭādivadaṇuparimāṇatā| sarvagatatve ca yugapat sarvendriya saṃyogāt sarvajñānaprasaṅgaḥ| madhyamaparimāṇatvena sāvayavatve'vayavopacayāpacayasambhavānna sthūlasūkṣmadehapratipattivirodhaḥ| samanantarapratyaya evottarajñānakāraṇatayā mana iti śākyāḥ pratipedire, tanna; jñānasya jñānāntarahetutve vyāptisāpekṣatvāt| śābdajñānamapi vyāptijanyamiti te matam| viśiṣṭajñānamapi saṃyogajanyaṃ na viśeṣaṇajñānajanyam| samanantarapratyayāduttarasya jñānākāralābha iti cet, na; vastusvabhāvasyānanyādhīnatvāt| tasmātsāvayavamanyadeva mana iti|| kaścāyamātmā sarvagato jaḍa kecit| na tāvatsarvatra dṛṣṭakāryatvaṃ sarvagatatve heturityuktam| vyavahitadeśe'dṛṣṭanimittanṛttyādikriyārambhāt tasya cādṛṣṭavadātmasaṃyogāpekṣatvātsarvagata iti cet, na; atra samavetādṛṣṭasya svarge bhogodayādadṛṣṭavatpradeśāsaṃyogāt, kevalātmapradeśasaṃyogasya phalāhetutvāt| tasmādāgamādeva sarvagatatvasiddhiḥ| naca jāḍyam; svayaṃprakāśatāvagamāt| pratyakṣastāvatsuṣupte'vabhāsaḥ| anumānamapi -- svayaṃprakāśaḥ, ayamātmā, svasattāyāṃ prakāśavyatirekābhāvāt, pradīpasaṃvedanavat| ātmā, svayaṃprakāśaḥ, viṣayaprakāśakartutvāt; pradīpavat| tathā ātmā, svayaṃprakāśaḥ, viṣayaprakāśāśrayatvāt; ālokavat| ajanyaprakāśaguṇaścātmā, prakāśaguṇatvāt; ādityādivat| ātmā, svayaṃprakāśaḥ, anindriyagocaratve satyaparokṣatvāt; saṃvedanavat| āgamaścātra darśitaḥ| sa caikaḥ; sarvaśarīreṣu sarvatrāhamityekākārapratyakṣavedanīyatvāt; gotvavat| śarīrabhedādevātītaśarīrādāviva na bhogānusandhānaprasaṅgaḥ| nacaikasminnapi parimāṇabhedātpratikṣaṇaṃ śarīrabhedo yuktaḥ; pratyabhijñāvirodhāt; ananusandhānaprasaṅgācca, jvālāyāṃ sūkṣmadarśane pratyakṣata eva bhedādarśanāt| tasmādekaḥ svayaṃprakāśa ātmeti siddham| tasmādityupasaṃhāraḥ| pakṣāntaramāha -- bhoktaiva kevalamiti|| kartṛtvaṃ hi kriyāveśaḥ| naca sarvagatasya niravayavasyātmanaḥ parispandapariṇāmalakṣaṇakriyānvayaḥ sambhavati| naca buddheḥ kartṛtvamātmano bhavati; tādātmyādhyāsābhāvāt, akhyātivāditvāt| hetvantaramāha -- karomi jānāmi bhuñje ceti|| na caitanyavat kriyāveśo'pyātmanaḥ svabhāvadharmaścet, ātmapratibhāsaṃ na vyabhicaret, nacāgantuko niravayavadravyasya hetūparāgeṇa kaściddharma utpādayituṃ śakyata iti|| nanu ātmapratibhāsavyabhicārātkartṛtvavad bhoktṛtvamapi na syāditi codayati -- nanu bhoktāpīti|| pariharati -- naitadevamiti|| dṛśyāvabhāsamātraṃ bhoktṛtvam, na sukhaduḥkhānvayaḥ| tataścāvasthātraye'pi dṛśyāvabhāsavyabhicārābhāvād bhoktaiva kevalamiti|| pakṣāntaramāha -- asti tadvyatiriktaḥ iti|| bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- tasmādapi dehādivyatiriktādanyaḥ siddha īśvara ityuttareṇa saṃbandhaḥ|| atreśvare vaiśeṣikānumānaṃ darśayati -- śarīriṇāṃ manasā'pītyādinā|| vivādagocarāpannaṃ bhūta bhautikalakṣaṇaṃ tanubhuvanaviracanakāryam, svarūpopādānasaṃpradānaprayojanopakaraṇādiviṣayavijñānavatkartṛpūrvakam, vividhavinyāsarūpakāryatvāt; prāsādādivat, iti kalpanālāghavādekakartṛkatvopādānāt sarvajñatvādisiddhiriti| sāṃkhyayogānumānaṃ darśayati -- sātiśayānāṃ kāṣṭhāprāptiriti| vivādagocarāpannā jñānaiśvaryaśaktayaḥ, kvacitsarvaviṣayajñānaiśvaryaśaktyavinābhūtāḥ, taratamabhāvenotkṛṣyamāṇaviṣayavyāpidharmatvāt; svaviṣayadeśavyāpiparimāṇadharmavaditi| kāṣṭhāprāptirasarvaviṣayatve'pi sambhavatīti sarvaviṣayamiti vetyuktam; anumāne tathaiva darśitatvāt sadā siddha īśvara iti| naiyāyikādyanumāne darśayati -- vivādagocarāpannāni dharmādharmaphalāni, karmatatphalasaṃpradānopakaraṇādivijñānavatā pradīyamānāni, vyavahitakarmaphalatvāt; sevādiphalavaditi| tasmātsiddha īśvaraḥ|| nanu pratyagātmano vipratipattyālambanasya sambandhitayā skandhabhedadarśanaṃ vipratipattiḥ; naca vyatirikta īśvaraḥ pratyagātmano viśeṣaskandhaḥ; ato'sau na śarīrādivat skandhaviśeṣatayā pratipādanīya iti codayati -- nanvahamiti sarvo loka ityādinā|| ucyata ityādiparihārasyāyamarthaḥ -- brahma hi vipratipattyālambanam| tacca pratyagātmavyatiriktamavyatiriktaṃ veti vipratipattiṃ darśayituṃ vyatirikteśvarapakṣo'pi darśanīyaḥ| kimiti tarhyātmani vipratipattiḥ pradarśyata iti tadāha -- ahaṃpratyayaviṣayavipratipattyā'pīti|| kimidamuktaṃ bhavati pratyagātmā tāvat pramāṇāntareṇoddiśya śarīrendriya mano buddhiśūnyakartṛtvabhoktṛtvādiviśeṣaparyudāsenādvitīyajñānānandasvabhāvena pratipadyate; evaṃ pratipādane saṃsāranivṛtteḥ puruṣārthalābhācca| ataḥ pratyagātmā sarvajñatvādiguṇakād brahmaṇo'nyo'nanyo veti vipratipattiḥ darśayituṃ tadvyatirikta īśvaraḥ sādhitaḥ; vipratipattiskandhatvāt|| atra kaścidāha -- neha pratyāgātmā'sādhāraṇasvabhāvavivakṣayā brahmaśabdena jijñāsyatvenoddiśyate, kiṃtvīśvara eva brahmaśabdenoddiśya vicāryate; janmādisūtre jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇābhidhānāt| na hi pratyagātmanyetallakṣaṇamupapadyate| tasmādātmavipratipattipradarśanamasañjasamiti, ucyate; yadi brahmaśabdeneśvaro'bhidhīyate, kimiti tarhi jagatkāraṇe vipratipatti darśayati -- pradhānameke, paramāṇūnapara ityādinā| nahīśvare'rthāntare jijñāsākarmaṇi brahmaśabdopādāne'rthāntare jagatkāraṇe vipratipattiryuktā darśayitum| jagatkāraṇādīśvarasyābhinnatvāt tadvipratipattirīśvaravipratipattiriti cet, tarhīśvaraḥ pradhānaṃ paramāṇurveti vipratipattirdarśitā syāt| na tathā saṃśerate tu pratyagātmano brahmaśabdābhidheyaviśeṣasvarūpasya śarīrendriyādiṣu saṃśayaḥ; teṣāmātmani tādātmyāvabhāsāt| kiñca pratyagātmānamuddiśya tasya viśeṣasvarūpe brahmaṇi jijñāsyamāne yad jagajjanmākāraṇam, tad brahmetyukte vidhūtaśarīrādibhedaḥ pratyagātmā jagatkāraṇatayā sarvātmabhūtaḥ pratipādito bhavati| jagatkāraṇe tu vipratipadyamāne kiṃ tajjagatkāraṇamiti vīkṣāyām -- yad brahma tajjagatkāraṇamiti brahmoddeśena jagatkāraṇatvaṃ vidheyaṃ syāt, na jagatkāraṇamuddiśya brahmavidhānamiti vaiparītyamāpadyate| brahmaśabdena jagatkāraṇamabhidhīyata iti cet, na ; īśvaro'bhidhīyata iti svavacanena virodhāt| kiñca -- īśvare jagatkāraṇe pratipādite puruṣasya kimāyātam upāsanamiti cet, na ; āropitarūpeṇāpi sambhavātpratipādanavaiyarthyāt| tasmāt pratyagātmānamuddiśya tasya vedāntavihitabrahmaśabdābhidheyabubhutsāyāṃ yajjagajjanmādikāraṇaṃ satyajñānānandādilakṣaṇaṃ tatpratyagātmabhūtaṃ brahmeti pratipādayitumātmani vipratipattipradarśanaṃ yuktam, iti jagatkāraṇe vipratipattiḥ saṃpradāyaparicayaśūnyatayā śāstrārthapradveṣāt sarvasaṅkaravādinā darśiteti| pakṣāntaramāha -- ātmā sa bhokturityapara iti|| yathā satyajñānānandaṃ niravayavaṃ brahma, pratyagātmā'pi tathā| tatra vivādagocarāpanno jīvaḥ, brahmaiva sannupādhiparicchinnavibhāgaḥ, brahmaṇā samānasvabhāvatayā niravayavadravyatve satyupādhiparāmarśādhīnaparicchedapratibhāsatvāt; yad yena samānasvabhāvatayā niravayavadravyatve satyupādhiparāmarśādhīnaparicchinnapratibhāsam, tattadātmakatve satyupādhiparicchinnabhedaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā ghaṭākāśamiti| bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- yo'yamiti|| nanu saṃsāriṇaḥ kathamasaṃsāriṇaikatvamiti tatrāha -- tasyāhaṃpratyayasiddha iti|| nanu evamahamiti sāmānyataḥ pratipannasya śarīrādiviśeṣamithyātve paramārthabhūto viśeṣo vaktavyo'hamitthaṃbhūta iti, tadāha -- paramārthatastviti|| "ahaṃ brahmaive"ti viśeṣopasaṃhāraḥ| na śarīrādītyatra kiṃ pramāṇamiti tadāha -- evamasau bṛṃhatyarthānvayāditi|| nanu jīvebhyo bhede'pi bṛṃhatyarthalābhaḥ; deśakālavyāpitvāditi, tadāha -- itarathā tadrūpavikalpasyeti|| upasaṃharati -- evaṃ bahava iti|| kiñcit-śarīrādi|| brahmeti-pratyagātmeti, vipratipannā ityarthaḥ| nanu -- na vipratipattimātrād jijñāsyaṃ bhavati, kintu pramāṇamūlā hi tattvajñānāditi|| brahmatattvajñānaṃ ca brahmamīmāṃsāvicārajanyamiti brahmamīmāṃsā''vaśyakītyarthaḥ|| vipratipattirnirākartavyeti, tatrottaram -- "yuktivākye"tyādi bhāṣyam, tad vyācaṣṭe -- yukti pramāṇānāmityādinā|| kasmin pakṣe yuktivākye, kva vā tadābhāsāḥ iti vibhajate yuktivākyābhyāmantyaṃ pakṣaṃ niścitavanta iti|| nanu yathā baṃhatyarthānvayād yuktivākyābhyāṃ ca brahmaiva bhoktā, tathā sukhaduḥkhatatsādhanaprapañce'pi brahmaivetyapuruṣārthatayā na jijñāsyaṃ brahma syāt| nahi katipayasukhaduḥkhatatsādhanasaṃsargamapyasahamāno nikhiladuḥkhādimattāmaṅgīkuryāt| nanu -- vakṣyamāṇajñānānandādilakṣaṇena puruṣārthatayā jijñāsyameva kiṃ na syāt na; kṣunnivṛttisādhanatayā puruṣārthe'pi viṣamiśrite'nne'narthahetutayā prekṣāpūrvakāriṇāmupekṣādarśanāt| "na lipyate lokaduḥkhena bāhyaḥ" ityādiśāstrānnāpuruṣārthateti cet, na; "ātmaivedam" ityādisarvatādātmyaśruterupādānakāraṇatvācca| sarvajñatayā'jñānamithyājñānābhāvād nānarthasambandha iti cet, na; tattvata eva prapañcatādātmyādajñānādyanapekṣaṇāt| karmanimittassukhaduḥkhādisaṃbandhaḥ, tadabhāvād na brahmaṇyanarthasaṃbandha iti cet, na; karmavyatirekeṇāpi svabhāvādevākhilasukhaduḥkhāditatsādhanānāṃ svānvayitayā brahmaṇo'parokṣatvāt, karmādīnāmapi tāvanmātrahetutvāt| nahi duḥkhādyāparokṣyavyatirekeṇa saṃsāro'nyo dṛśyate; karmāvidyādīnāmapi bṛṃhatyārthānvayādeva brahmaṇi tādātmyāt tannimitto'pi saṃsāraḥ sutarāmupapanna iti| brahmaṇi tattvajñānena bādhitatvānnānarthasaṃbandha iti cet, na; prapañcātmabhāvasyāpi tātvikatvāt| naca kāraṇākāraṇabrahmabhedena kāryakāraṇabrahmabhedena vā saṃsāravimuktyavasthā; bṛṃhatyarthānvayābhāvaprasaṅgāt| tasmād bṛṃhatyarthānvayenādvitīyasarvajñatvajīvatvādyapagamenājijñāsyaṃ brahma prāptam, ucyate; satyapi sarvasyāparokṣatayā brahmasaṃbandhe māyānimittatayā pratibimbaśyāmatvādivad māyāvigatavyāghratvādivacca tattvajñānena bādhitatvāt, bimbasthānīyabrahmaṇo nityasarvajñatayā tattvajñānaniyamānna tatrātmānubandha iti| viśuddhivākyānāmeva ca balavattaratvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ| yuktivākyābhāsamūlatā kasyeti tadāha -- itare tu yuktaya ivetyādinā|| kathaṃ punaryuktyābhāsatā śarīrātmabhāvasyeti tadāha -- yuktyābhāsatvamiti|| nanu naitāvatā yuktyābhāsatvasiddhirdehādiṣviti, tatrāha -- itareṣāṃ yuktyābhāsasiddhatvamiti|| kiñca darśitā eva yuktyābhāsāḥ, na tatrānyāpekṣetyāha -- darśitañca leśata iti|| nanu "sa vā eva puraṣo'nnarasamayaḥ" "sa vā ayamātmā brahma" "pṛthivīmaya āpomayastejomayo vāyumayaḥ" ityādīni śarīrātmavāde vākyāni| "te ha vācamūcuḥ, tebhyo vāgudagāyadi"tyadīnīndriyātmavāde| "mana udagāyadi"ti manovāde| "katama ātmeti yo'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ" ityādi vijñānavāde| "asadvā idamatra āsīt" "asadevedami"ti śūnyavāde| "anumantā boddhā kartā vijñānātme"ti kartrātmavāde; "tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattīti" buddhiviṣayatvāt| "anaśnannanyaḥ" iti bhoktrātmavāde| "ya ātmani tiṣṭhannātmānamantaro yamayatī"ti vyatirikteśvaravāde vākyāni vidyante| kathaṃ nirmūlatā pakṣāntarāṇāmiti tatrāha -- vākyābhāsatāṃ tviti|| nanu -- evamapi yasya yasmin rucirutpadyate sa taṃ pakṣamāśritya puruṣārthaṃ sādhayet, kiṃ vicāreṇeti tatrāha -- tatrāvicārya yatkiñciditi|| bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- tatraivaṃ sthita ityādinā|| nanu mā bhūdantyātpakṣādarvācīneṣu pakṣeṣu tattvajñānābhāvād niḥśreyasalābhaḥ, anarthaḥ kimiti prāpyata iti tatrāha -- andhaṃ namaḥ praviśantīti|| nanu ātmahananaṃ tatrānarthaheturukto na tattvāpratipattiriti, tatrāha -- anātmadarśanenātmano'satkalpatvāpādanarūpasyeti|| sūtravākyārthamupasaṃharati -- tasmād brahmajijñāsopanyāsamukheneti|| bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- brahmajijñāsopanyāsavyājeneti|| jijñāsāpadenāntarṇītaṃ vicāramupalakṣya tatkartavyatāparaṃ sūtramityuktaṃ bhavati| yojanāntaramāha -- athaveti|| jijñāsā kartavyetyukte jñānamiṣyamāṇaṃ sādhyatayā kartavyamiti sūtrārthaḥ saṃpadyate| tatra jñāne kartavye'pyarthāt tatsādhanakartavyatāpyavagamyate| ato'rthasiddhavicārakartavyatāparasūtramiti| kiṃprayojanetyādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| kathaṃ punarvicārasya niḥśreyasaṃ prayojanam, vicārajanyabrahmāvabodhasādhyatvāditi cet, kiṃ tanniḥśreyasam kartṛtvabhoktṛtvadoṣasaṃyogādhyāsapravāhopādānasyājñānasya nivṛttiriti cet, na; nivṛtte'pyajñāne dvaitadarśanasyānapāyāt| na hi pṛthivyādiprapañcaḥ kartṛtvādyadhyāsanivṛttimātrānnivartate, ucyate -- satsvapi pṛthivyādiṣvantaḥkaraṇādhyāsanivṛttau pramātṛtvābhāvādātmacaitanyasya svato viṣayoparāgābhāvād dvaitadarśanaṃ na prāpnoti; anindriyasyeva rūpādidarśanamityekaḥ pakṣaḥ| itarastu sarvadvaitanivṛttipakṣaḥ samanvayasūtre vakṣyate| tasmānnirastasakalakartṛtvādyadhyāsam, apākṛtadvaitadarśanam, anatiśayānandaprakāśamānabrahmatvarūpāvasthānaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ vedāntavicārasya prayojanamiti ramaṇīyam|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakānanyānubhavapūjyapādaśiṣyasvaprakāśānubhavabhagavataḥ kṛtau pañcapādikāvivaraṇe viṣayaprayojanākṣepaparihāranirūpaṇaṃ nāma turīyavarṇakaṃ samāptam|| <5> atha pañcamaṃ
