varṇakam jagajjanmasthitidhvaṃsā yataḥ sidhyanti kāraṇāt| tat svarūpataṭasthābhyāṃ lakṣaṇābhyāṃ pradarśyate|| vṛttasaṅkīrtabhāṣyasyāntarṇītaṃ vicārāpthopādānenārthaṃ kathayati -- brahma jijñāsitavyamityuktamityādinā|| nanu brahmavicārapratijñāyāṃ sādhanādivicāraṇāmapratijñātatvādasādhyateti, ata āha -- yadaivedamityuktamityādinā|| nanu pañcānāṃ vicārāṇāṃ pratijñātatve kimiti svarūpameva prathamaṃ vicāryate phalabhūtatayā prādhānāyāditi cet, na; sādhanādyadhīnatvātsādhyasiddhesteṣāmeva prathamaṃ vicāraḥ kriyatāmiti, ata āha -- tatra svarūpasyābhyarhitatvāditi|| brahmapramāṇaṃ brahmayuktirbrahmasādhanaṃ brahmaphalamiti viśiṣṭavicārāṇāṃ brahmaviśeṣaṇasāpekṣatvād brahmasvarūpanirṇayasya cānanyāpekṣatvāt, prādhānyena sādhyatvāccetyarthaḥ|| vṛttaṃ saṅkīrtyottareṇākāṅkṣāpuraḥsaraṃ sambandhamāha -- kiṃlakṣaṇaṃ taditi|| jijñāsyapuruṣārthabrahmasvarūpapradarśananimittamācārye pūjayati -- bhagavāniti|| nanu asyedaṃ lakṣaṇamidaṃ vā'nena lakṣyamiti lakṣyalakṣaṇayoravyāptyativyāptiparihāreṇāvinābhāvaḥ pramāṇayuktivyatirekeṇa na sidhyati tatkathaṃ svarūpalakṣaṇaparameva sūtramiti || tatrāha -- yuktirapi lakṣaṇanirṇaye'rthāditi|| apiśabdāt pramāṇamapītyarthaḥ| atra tu sūtritayorbrahmaṇi pramāṇayuktyoradhyāyadvayena nirṇayaḥ kriyate| janmotpattirityārabhya tṛtīyaliṅgetyataḥ prāktanaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| tadguṇasaṃvijñāna iti|| viśeṣyaikadeśameva viśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā samāsa ityarthaḥ| nanu evamapi janmasthitibhaṅgāstrayo'pi viśeṣyāḥ, tatkathamekatvanirdeśa iti ata āha -- tṛtīyaliṅgeti|| janmādīnāmādimadhyāvasānamākṣipati -- nanu ādiriti|| pariharati -- janmanaścāditvamiti|| bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- yadanena sūtreṇeti|| nanu sarvaṃ janitvaiva naśyati, na kiñcitkālaṃ tiṣṭhati; svasattāprayuktatvādvināśasyetyata āha -- kṣaṇikatvanirākaraṇāditi|| ato janitvetyādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| nanu idaṃśabdaḥ kiñcideva sannihitaṃ gamayati nākhilaṃ jagadityata āha -- tathāhi sarvatreti|| nanu janmādīnāṃ jagataśca kaḥ sambandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vivakṣita iti tadāha -- sarvaṃ eveti|| nanu jagajjanmasthitibhaṅgaṃ kiṃsambandhitayā lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati na tāvat kākavallakṣyasambandhitayā; jagadāśrayatvāddharmāṇāmiti, kāraṇasambandhitayetyāha -- yata iti kāraṇanirdeśa iti|| nanu jagajjanmādikāraṇatvamapi lakṣaṇāntargatam āhosvillakṣyasvarūpāntargatam iti vaktavyam| nanu gṛhasya kākādhikaraṇatvaṃ nāma dharmaḥ kasminnantarbhavati lakṣya iti cet, kākādhikaraṇatvaṃ ca gṛhaśabdārthaḥ syāt| tataśca kākavigame gṛhaikadeśabhaṅgabuddhiḥ syāt| lakṣaṇāntargatamiti cet, kāraṇatvamapi tathā| nahi nānāvidhakāryākriyāveśātmakatvaṃ tatprasavaśaktyātmakatvaṃ vā jijñāsyaviśuddhabrahmāntargataṃ bhavitumarhati| tasmād jagajjanmādikāraṇatvamevopalakṣaṇamiti|| nanu nimittakāraṇatvamupādānakāraṇatvamubhayaṃ vopalakṣaṇatvenocyate na tāvannimittakāraṇatvameva brahmopalakṣaṇam; jagadabhinnasyopādānakāraṇasya bhedenāvasthānād brahmaśabdasya svārthānvayābhāvaprasaṅgāt| nāpyupādānakāraṇatvamupalakṣaṇam; nimittakāraṇasya sarvajñasya bhedenāvasthānād "yataḥ sarvajñāt sarvaśakteri"ti vyapadeśo na syāt; upādānakāraṇasya loke'cetanatvāt| "satyaṃ jñānamanantami"ti ca svarūpalakṣaṇasyobhayatrāyogāt| nāpyubhayakāraṇatvaṃ brahmopalakṣaṇam; ekasyobhayakāraṇatve pramāṇābhāvāt| pramāṇāntarasiddhaṃ hi lakṣaṇamanadhigatalakṣyasvarūpādhigamāyālam| na tāvadekasya jagannimittopādānatvamanumānenāvagantuṃ śakyam; dṛṣṭānte bhedadarśanāt| mahābhūtapañcakavyatirikteṣu padārtheṣu nānāvidhanimittopādānadarśanānna tadanuvādena brahma vidhātuṃ śakyam| bhūtapañcakanimittopādānatvamekasyāprasiddhamiti, tatrāha -- prakṛtitvanibandhanā pañcamīti|| nimittatvasyāpyupalakṣaṇametat; ubhayatra pañcamīvidhānāt| bhūtapañcakasya tāvadekā prakṛtiranumīyate; sadvastvekasvabhāvānugamāt|| tathāhi -- mahābhūtāni, sadvastuprakṛtikāni, satsvabhāvānuraktatve sati, vividhavikāratvāt; mṛdanusyūtaghaṭādivat| dravyatvādyabhedā api prakṛtisvabhāvā eva sāmānyavadavabhāsante, sadvastu punaḥ sarvānugamātsarvavikāraprakṛtiḥ| bhautikānāṃ ca bhūtopādānatvaṃ dṛśyamānaṃ mūlaprakṛtyadhīnatāmeva sarvasya gamayati| ataḥ sarvakāryopādānamekameva lāghavāt, iti nyāyānugṛhītānumānena siddham| tasyaiva ca nimittakāraṇatvamanumānena kalpyate| tathācedaṃ jagat, abhinnanimittopādānaṃ bhavitumarhati, prekṣāpūrvajanitakāryatvāt; ātmagatasukhaduḥkharāgadveṣādivat| naca ghaṭādiṣvanaikāntikatā; tathāpyabhinnanimittopādānatvakalpanāt| adṛṣṭādinimittabhedo dṛśyata iti cet, na; upādānādhiṣṭhātrorevaikatvānumānāt| tasmādanumānenaiva prasiddhamekasyobhayakāraṇatvaṃ lakṣaṇatvena nirdiśyate| sṛṣṭivākyaprasiddhaṃ caikasyobhayakāraṇatvaṃ lakṣaṇatvena nirdiśyate|| tatra kecitpariṇāmavādamavatārayanti| taistatra pramāṇaṃ vaktavyam| sṛṣṭiśrutaya iti cet, na; tatrapariṇāmaśabdāśravaṇāt| satyato'nyathābhāvaḥ pariṇāmo brahmaṇo'pi satyataḥ prapañcāpattiṃ pratipādayatīti cet, na; tāsu satyaśabdāśravaṇāt| svataḥprāmāṇyāt tathābhūtaiva sṛṣṭiriti cet kimidaṃ tathābhūtatvaṃ nāma satyatvamiti cet, na; "mithyedaṃ rajatami"ti viśiṣṭe'rthe pramāṇagamye svapnasṛṣṭāvapi satyabudhyabhāvāt| svopādhau svaviṣayābhāvavirodhiteti cet, na; māyātmakatve'pi samānam| sṛṣṭeśca svopādhāvabhāvavyāvṛttatvāt sarve ca sopādhikadharmāḥ svāśrayopādhāvabādhyatayā satyā bhavanti, sṛṣṭirapi svarūpeṇa na bādhyate, kintu paramārthasatyatvāṃśena|| nanu mithyāsṛṣṭiviṣayatve vākyasyāprāmāṇyaṃ syāt, na tat; pramāṇavyāpārānabhijño devānāṃ priyaḥ| pramāṇaṃ hi prameyābhāvaṃ na sahate, nāprameyābhāvam| naca sṛṣṭiśrutiḥ paramārthasatyatāṃ pramimīte; tadabhidhānābhāvāt| yathā "ghaṭaḥ" ityukte bhāvābhāvayoḥ sādhāraṇo'vabhāsate, anyatārābhidhānābhāvāt, tadvat| na hi svapnaviṣayā sṛṣṭiśrutistatsatyatāṃ pratipādayati| prayojanaśūnyatayā tātparyahīnatvācca na brahmaṇaḥ prapañcāpattiṃ pratipādayati; anarthahetutvācca duḥkhatatsādhanapariṇāmasya| naca karmakāṇḍasya pratyakṣādervā siddhiḥ prayojanam; jagannityatayāpyupapatteḥ, sṛṣṭiśrutyavagamātprāgeva siddhatvācca| abhedasyāpi sattvādirūpeṇa siddhātvācca śabdāpekṣeti cet, keyamativyākulatā sarvasaṃkaravādinaḥ| na hi nityaśuddhabuddhamuktaniratiśayānandaprakāśamānasarvajñā'dvitīyapratyagātmabhūtaṃ brahmāvagamāt prāgeva sidhyati| kiṃ tarhi sṛṣṭiśruteḥ prayojanam| pratyakṣādisiddhaprapañcasya brahmaṇyevotpattivināśavattayā'nyatrābhāvamupavarṇya, tatrāpi pratiṣidhya, mithyātvāpādanena pramāṇāntarāviruddhatayā'dvitīyabrahmasvarūpasiddhiḥ prayojanam; tenaikavākyatvāt, anyathā śeṣivirodhāt| sṛṣṭyābhāsatvād rajatābhāsavat tajjñānasyāprāmāṇyamiti cet, na; satyarajatavanmukhyasṛṣṭyantarābhāvāt, tasyā eva mukhyasṛṣṭitvāt tajjñānavat prāmāṇyāt| "devadatto vyāghro'bhavat" "māyā hyeṣā mayā sṛṣṭe"tyādau mithyākārye'pi tadbhāvasṛṣṭiśabdayoḥ śravaṇāt|| kutaḥ punaḥ satyamithyāsādhāraṇyāṃ sṛṣṭau mithyātve pakṣapātaḥ "nāsadāsīnno sadā''sīttama āsīt" "āsīdidaṃ tamobhūtam" "māyāṃ tu prakṛtimi"tyādau sadasadvilakṣaṇānirvacanīyaprakṛtitvaśravaṇāt tadātmakatvācca vikārasya "tamo moho mahāmohastāmisro hyandhasaṃjñitaḥ| avidyā pañcaparvaiṣā prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ"|| iti smṛteḥ, tamo'vidyā māyānāṃ paryāyatvāt| tadevaṃ śrutyavagatāyāṃ mithyāsṛṣṭau satyatvakalpanāyāṃ śrutibādhaprasaṅgāt| tathāca "asti ghaṭaḥ" ityastyarthopādhau pratipannasya ghaṭasya tadupādhāveva nāstīti pratyakṣeṇaiva bādho dṛśyate, deśakālayordeśakālāntarābhāvāttayordvayornirupādhikaniṣedhāt, astyarthasyānuyāyino niṣedhābhāvāt| ato deśakālatadupādhighaṭānāmastyarthe brahmasvarūpe pratipannopādhau pratyakṣeṇaiva bādhānmithyātvasiddhiḥ| evaṃ sarvabhāvapratyayagocare brahmaṇi svarūpopādhāvastyarthe kālādyupādhibhiḥ sahābhāvapratyakṣeṇa bādhānmithyaiveti siddham| anyābhāvaviśiṣṭavastvantarajñānasya pratyakṣatvāt|| anumānamapi -- sarve vikārāḥ, svānubhūta ekasmin vastuni parikalpitāḥ, pratyekamekasvabhāvānuviddhatve sati vibhaktatvāt; candrabhedavat| jaḍatvāt, kāryatvāt, bhedatvāt; rajatavat, candrabhedavacca| pratipannopādhāvasthūlādivākyaiḥ pratiṣidhyamānatvāt; dehātmabhāvavat| virodhikāraṇasvabhāvānupamardena virodhikāryāpattilakṣaṇatvāt; māyāvyāghravat| pralayāvasthāyāṃ saha kālena svopādhau śūnyatvāt; dehātmabhāvavat|| arthāpattirapi -- prapañcajanmavināśāvanupapannau tasya mithyātvamantareṇa; amithyābhūtayorbrahmaśūnyayorajanmavināśitvāt| naca brahmajñānasyāpi prapañcajñānavanmithyātvānumānam; "tatsatyaṃ sa ātme"ti vacanavirodhāt| nacāsthūlādivākyaiḥ sthūlādibhyo'nyatvamātramucyate; kāryakāraṇatādātmye satyevaṃpratiṣedhānupapatteḥ| yathā śuklāyāṃ gavyanyatvavivakṣayāpyaśuklā gauriti pratiṣedho na dṛśyate; tathā ca pratiṣedhe śuklatāsvarūpamātraniṣedhadarśanāt| tarkāpratiṣṭhānānna mithyātvānumānamiti cet, na; vicāraśāstrānārambhaprasaṅgāt| śabdamūlatvād brahmaṇi na virodhabuddhiriti cet, tarhi -- "asadvā idamagra āsīt" "sadeva saumyedamagra āsīdi"tyādiśrutidvayasāmarthyāt kāraṇasya sadasattve syātām| śrutyarthasya tarkāgocaratvāt sarvaśaktitvād brahmaṇaḥ sarvamupapannamiti cet, na; brahmaṇi virodhaparihārāya vicārānārambhaprasaṅgāt| ata evāsatyatāpi brahmaṇaḥ kadācit kiṃ na syāt| tasmātpratyakṣānumānārthāpattibhiḥ prapañcasya mithyātvāvagamāt praśāntatvācca brahmaṇo niṣprayojanā na sṛṣṭiśrutirvivarta eveti| naca sadbudhyanugamavirodhaḥ; adhiṣṭhānatvāttasya| ghaṭādiviśeṣāṇāmeva mithyātvāditi siddham|| lakṣaṇamanūdya lakṣyasvarūpaṃ kathayitumuttaraṃ bhāṣyamityāha -- asya jagata iti|| nanu na tāvadidaṃ viśeṣaṇalakṣaṇam; prapañcajanmādikāraṇatvasya prapañcopādhitvāt, nirupādhikabrahmasvarūpalakṣaṇakathanamantareṇa sopādhikadharmapratipattyayogāt, nāpyupalakṣaṇametat; lakṣyasya brahmaśabdārthatvāyogādavacchedāditi, tatrāha -- dvividhaṃ hi lakṣaṇamityādi|| upalakṣaṇatve'pi nādvitīyasvarūpalakṣaṇavirodhaḥ; yadrajatamityabhāt sā śuktiritivad mithyābhūtenāpi prapañcakāraṇatvenopalakṣaṇayogāt| asādhāraṇasaṃbandho hi lakṣaṇanimittam, -- na lakṣaṇasatyatvam; kākādīnāmasaṃbaddhānāṃ gṛhopalakṣaṇatvadarśanāditi| kāryaprapañcaṃ keciditi|| ayamarthaḥ -- nāmarūpakarmātmakamiti vedāntinaḥ| dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyātmakamiti vārtikakārīyāḥ| kāryakāraṇayogavidhiduḥkhāntāḥ pañceti śaivāḥ| dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyāḥ ṣaḍiti vaiśeṣikāḥ| jīvājīvāsrava saṃvara nirjarabandhamokṣāḥ sapteti kṣapaṇakāḥ| dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣaśaktipāratantryaniyogā ityaṣṭau prābhākarāḥ| pramāṇaprameyasaṃśayaprayojanadṛṣṭāntasiddhāntāvayavatarkanirṇayavādajalpavitaṇḍāhetvābhāsacchalajātinigra hasthānāni ṣoḍaśeti naiyāyikāḥ| jñānendriyakarmendriyabhūtatanmātramahābhūtamano'haṅkāramahadavyattaḥ puruṣā iti sāṃkhyā iti| kastarhi siddhāntaḥ tadāha -- tadvyudāsāyetyādi|| yadyapi rūpyata iti rūpeṇetthaṃbhūtaṃ jagad vyākriyate| kathaṃ nāmnā rūpitavatpādyata iti tatrāha -- vyākriyamāṇaṃ hi vastviti|| ayamarthaḥ -- loke ghaṭaṃ cikīrṣuḥ kulālaḥ prathamaṃ ghaṭaśabdādikalpitaṃ pṛthubudhnodarākārarūpavikalpitaṃ ca svabuddhāvāvirbhāvayati, paścād yathāvirbhūtaṃ ghaṭaśabdālambanayogyaṃ pṛthubudhnodarākārarūpitaṃ ca ghaṭaṃ nirvartayati| evameva mūlakāraṇamapi nāmarūpābhyāṃ svabuddhāvāvirbhūtameva sarvaṃ paścādvyanakti, iti nāmarūpābhyāmitthaṃbhūtaṃ vyākṛtamityucyate| "anekakartṛbhoktṛsaṃyuktasye"tyārabhya nanvanye'pi pariṇāmādayo bhāvavikārā ityataḥ prāktanaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| nanu kimatropalakṣitasya brahmaṇaḥ svarūpalakṣaṇamucyate| naca svarūpalakṣaṇamantareṇa kasyicidvastunaḥ pratipattirasti| naca yatra śākhāgraṃ sa candra ityetāvatā prakṛṣṭaprakāśātmapratipattimantareṇa candrāvagatirasti| naca svarūpalakṣaṇamantareṇa kasyacidvastunaḥ pratipattirasti| naca yatra śākhāgraṃ sa candra ityetāvatā prakṛṣṭaprakāśātmapratipattimantareṇa candrāvagatirasti| na tāvatsarvaśaktitvaṃ brahmāsādhāraṇalakṣaṇam| pradhānādīnāmapyaviśeṣāt| sarvajñatvamiti cet, na; tasya sarvopādhikadharmatvānnirupādhikabrahmasvarūpāpratipattiḥ|| kathaṃ cedaṃ sarvajñatvamiti vaktavyam -- na tāvatpratyakṣānumānāgamopamānārthāpattyabhāvapramāṇaiḥ sarvaṃ vetti; teṣāmayugapatpravṛtteḥ sarvasya ca pratyakṣatāhānāt, satsvapi teṣvasmākaṃ sarvajñatā'bhāvāt, indriyāṇāṃ ca deśa kālavastuviprakṛṣṭārthagrāhitvābhāvāt, saṃyuktasamavāyāt saṃyuktasaṃyogāt saṃyuktaviśeṣaṇatayā vā sarvārthapratyakṣatve'smākamapi prasaṅgāt| mānasamapi jñānamātmano'nyatrendriyādisāpekṣam, iti sarvaṃ na mānasapratyayagamyam| naca dharmātiśayavaśādapīndriyairayogya vastu gṛhyate; mārjārādidṛṣṭīnāmapi yogyarūpādiṣvevātiśayavattvadarśanāt| naca kṛtsnaparibhāvanāsaṃskārajanyaṃ mānasaṃ sarvajñajñānaṃ kṛtsnārthaṃ grāhayati; prathamaṃ kṛtsnārthaṃ grahaṇābhāve tatra paribhāvanā'yogāt tajjanyakṛtsnagrāhijñānāyogāt| paribhāvanāyāḥ prāgapi kṛtsnārthagrahaṇe'smākamapi prasaṅgāt| atītānāgatavartamānārthānāmiyattānavadhāraṇācca sarvagrahaṇānupapattiḥ| etāvadidam, nātaḥ paramastyajñātamityanavadhāraṇāt| naca svarūpajñānenaiva sarvajñatā; tasya pradīpaprabhāvadatītānāgatārthagrāhitvābhāvāt| tasmānnāsti sarvajña iti|| ucyate -- sarvasya kartṛtvādeva vartamānasvakāryasarvaviṣayajñatā tāvat siddhā| evaṃ tattatkāle'tītasarvaviṣayāvagamādanubhūtaviṣayā'saṃpramoṣā smṛtiḥ svamāyāpariṇāmopādhiranāvaraṇā sarvaviṣayā kalpyate| tathā sṛṣṭeḥ prāgapi sṛjyamānapadārthāvadhāraṇasya kulālādiṣu dṛṣṭatvād āgāmisarvaviṣayajñānaṃ svamāyāpariṇāmopādhikalpyata iti yuktā sarvajñatā| "yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavidi"ti ca jagatkāraṇe sarvajñapadaprayogātsarvajñānaṃ pramīyata iti śrutiyuktibhyāṃ yuktā sarvajñatā| nanu sopādhikadharmatvānna svarūpalakṣaṇamityuktam, na; anena sarvajñaśabdena sarvāvabhāsakṣamaṃ vijñaptimātramādityādiprakāśavadaviṣayopādhikaṃ vijñānameva brahmasvarūpalakṣaṇaṃ vivakṣyata ityavirodhaḥ| nanu anye'pītyādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu niruktavākyameva mūlīkṛtya sūtre'pi ṣaḍ bhāvavikārā gṛhyantā iti codayati -- nanu ṣaḍ bhāvavikārā iti| yāskaparipaṭhitānāmityādeḥ parihārasyāyamarthaḥ ārṣeyasya vākyasya mūlapramāṇaṃ pratyakṣam, āgamo vā bhavati; anumānāderasmākamapi pravṛttervākyānapekṣaṇāt| tatra pratyakṣamūlatve yāskavākyasya bhautikadharmā eva bhāvavikārāḥ pratyakṣeṇāvagantuṃ śakyante, na mahābhūtaviṣayāḥ| tatra bhautikavikārakāraṇe brahmaṇi gṛhyamāṇe bhūtapañcakameva brahma gṛhītaṃ syāt, śrutau tu mūlapramāṇānapekṣatvād yatkiñcidbhavanadharmavat tasya mūlakāraṇaṃ brahma grahītuṃ śakyata iti| kiṃca śrutyarthaparatvāt sūtrāṇāṃ śrutireva janmādisūtramūlamityāha -- tadarthanirṇayārthatvāditi|| nanu bhūtabhautikamūlakāraṇaṃ na brahmeti pratipattuṃ yuktam; māyāyā api mūlakāraṇatvāt, "māyāṃ tu prakṛtami"ti śruteḥ| prakriyate'nayeti prakṛtiriti karaṇamātraṃ māyeti cet, na; prakṛtiśabdasyopādāne rūḍhatvād vyutpādanāyogāt| "ātmana ākāśaḥ" iti prakṛtyantaraśravaṇād vyutpādyata iti cet na; tulyaśrutitvānmāyāprakṛtitvavirodhāt, nimitte'pi pañcamī prayogāt, dṛśyamānajāḍyānusāreṇa ca māyopādānatvaniyamopapatteḥ| "indro māyābhiri"ti tṛtīyaiva śrūyata iti cet, satyam ātmano bahutvāpattau karaṇatā bhavati; prapañcopādānatve kā hāniḥ, nirapekṣaprakṛtidvayānupapattiriti cet, tarhi parasparaviśiṣṭatayā dvisūtrarajjuvatprakṛtitā syāt| ato jagatkāraṇe brahmaṇi māyāyā api brahmatvaṃ lakṣitaṃ syāt| māyet prajñā'bhidhīyate| sā ca brahmacaitanyamevetyavirodha iti cet, na; anvayavyatirekavirodhāt| paridṛśyamānahastyaśvarathādau pratipannopādhau bādhite ca vṛddhavyavahāre'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ māyāśabdaḥ prayujyamāno dṛśyate| lokasaṃvedanavirodhācca| nahi prajñātiśayavantaṃ māyāvinaṃ vadanti| garhanti ca viduṣi māyāśabdaprayogam| buddhiviṣayatvānmāyāśabdasya na brahmacaitanyaprajñāya| prasaṅgaḥ| svapnādivividhamāyākārapratibhāsanādvā buddheḥ kāryavādinau māyāśabdasyopacārātkaraṇe prayoga ityanavadyam| api ca "bhūyaścānte viśvamāyānivṛttiḥ" "māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te" "devī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā" "māyayā'pahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ"| iti nivartya tartavyatvaguṇamayatva jñānāvaraṇatvaliṅgācca na brahmacaitanyaṃ māyā| buddhireva māyeti cet, na; prakṛtiśabdavirodhāt| mantrauṣadhādimāyeti cet, na; dṛśyamānagandharvanagarādau māyāśabdaprayogāt, mantrauṣadhādau tadaprayogāt| tathā'pi jaḍātmikā māyāśaktiḥ pāramārthikīti cet, na; nāsadāsīnno sadāsīttama āsīdi"ti jagatprāgavasthāyāḥ sadasadvilakṣaṇānirvacanīyatvaśravaṇāt| loke ca hastyaśvarathādiṣu vyabhicāriṣu mithyāvastumātre'nuyāyini māyāśabdaprayogāt| "taratyavidyāṃ vitatāṃ hṛdi yasminniveśite| yogī māyāmameyāya tasmai vidyātmane namaḥ"|| iti māyā'vidyayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyācca| tasmādanirvacanīyamāyāviśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ brahmeti prāptam, tatrāha -- ato yadavaṣṭambho viśvo vivartata iti|| traividhyamatra sambhavati -- rajjvāḥ saṃyuktasūtradvayavanmāyāviśiṣṭaṃ brahma kāraṇamiti vā, "devātmaśaktiṃ svaguṇairnigūḍhami"ti śrutermāyāśaktimatkāraṇamiti vā, jagadupādānamāyāśrayatayā brahma kāraṇamiti veti| tatra viśiṣṭapakṣe tathaiva brahmatvenopalakṣitasya jñānānandādisvarūpalakṣaṇena māyāniṣkarṣāllakṣaṇadvayena viśuddhabrahmasiddhiḥ| uttarapakṣayostu māyāyā brahmaparatantratvāttatkāryamapi brahmaparatantraṃ bhavati; yathāṃ'śutantratantvārabdho'pi paṭoṃ'śutantraḥ pratīyate| tataścotpadyamānakāryasya yad āśrayopādhi jñānānandalakṣaṇaṃ ca, tad brahmeti śuddhabrahmalābha iti, tadāha yadavaṣṭambha iti| kecittu -- brahmaiva jagadākāreṇa pariṇamate mṛdiva ghaṭākāreṇeti -- vadanti, tad vyāvartayanti -- viśvo vivartata iti|| ekasya tattvādapracyutasya pūrvaviparītāsatyānekarūpāvabhāsau vivartaḥ| ekasya pūrvarūpaparityāgena satyarūpāntarāpattiḥ pariṇāmaḥ, tatra brahma na vivartate, kiṃtu pariṇamata eveti taistatra pramāṇaṃ vaktavyam| sṛṣṭiśruteḥ pariṇamata iti cet, sā khalu sṛṣṭiśrutiḥ jñānānandasatyaniravayavāparicchinnabrahmasvarūpasya pūrvasiddhasya parityāgena jaḍaduḥkhamithyāsāvayavaparicchinnakāryāpattiṃ brahmaṇo bravīti āhosvitpūrvasiddharūpāparityāgenaiva tadviparītakāryarūpāpattiṃ brahmaṇo bravīti iti vaktavyam| tatra pūrvaparityāge brahmasvarūpocchedātkāryamātrameva syāt| punaḥ pralayāvasthāyāṃ jñānānandādirūpeṇa pariṇamata iti cet, anirmokṣaprasaṅgāt| "aja ātmā mahān dhruvaḥ" "na jāyate ce"tyādiśrutivirodhaśca syāt| atha pūrvaviparītabrahmasvarūpāparityāgenaiva kāryarūpāpattiṃ brūyāt sṛṣṭiśrutiḥ, evaṃ tarhi vivartaṃ pratipādayati; śuktikārajatamāyāvyāghrādiṣu vivartasya tallakṣaṇatvāt| atha sṛṣṭiśrutiḥ sṛṣṭimātraviṣayā, na pūrvasvarūpaparityāgāparityāgayorvyāpriyata iti cet, tathā'pi vyavasthitabrahmavākyairekavākyatvāt tatsvarūpāparityāgenaiva kāryarūpāpattiṃ brahmaṇo bruvāṇā vivartameva darśayatītyanavadyam|| yo'pi kaścidāha niravayavamapi pariṇamata iti| tathāhihemadravye rūcakakāreṇa pariṇamamāne tadavayavā api pariṇameran navā iti vaktavyam| yadi pariṇameran, tarhi tadavayavā api tathā, iti niravayavaparyantaḥ pariṇāmaḥ syāt| atha na pariṇameran, tarhyavayavī na pariṇameta; āśrayavikāramantareṇāśritavikārāyogāt| tasmād yathā saṃyogo'vayavyekadeśasamavetaḥ paramparayā niravayavaparamāṇusaṃyogapuraḥsaraḥ, tathā niravayavapariṇāmapuraḥsaro'vayaviparaṇāma iti|| sa vaktavyaḥ -- kaścāyaṃ pariṇāma iti yadi tāvat svāvayavānāṃ pūrvasaṃyogāt saṃyogāntarāpattyā vā'vayavāntarasaṃyogena vā saṃmūrchitāvayavatvaṃ pariṇāmaḥ, na tarhi niravayave pariṇāmaḥ; svāvayavābhāvānniravayavasya| nacāvayavānāṃ saṃyogāntareṇa saṃmūrchitatvamantareṇāvayavinaḥ pariṇāmo'vasthāntaraṃ vā'nyathābhāvo vā nirūpayituṃ śakyate| naca vastuno vastvantarasaṃyogo vā parispando vā guṇāntarodayo vā pariṇāmaḥ; brahmaṇi teṣāmabhāvāt| ākāśe ca vastvantarasaṃyogini parispandamāne ca bhramare lauhityodaye ca ghaṭe dravye pariṇāmabuddhyabhāvāt| atha tadanuṣaktadravyāntarotpattiḥ pariṇāma iti, tatra kiṃ hemāvayavānāṃ rucakarūpeṇaiva pariṇāmaḥ kiṃ vā dravyāntararūpeṇa na tāvat dravyāntarūpeṇa; tatra rucakadravyātiriktakāryadravyādarśanāt, nāpi rucakākāreṇaiva; tasyāvayavipariṇāmatvāt, avayavānāṃ ca rucakānugamasya rucakānugatāvayavyanugamenaivānyathāsiddhatvāt| naca rucakāvasthāvyatirekeṇa hemāvayavānāmavasthāntarāṇi dṛśyante yena pariṇāmabhedaḥ syāt| naca saṃyogabheda evāvayavapariṇāma ityuktam| nacāvayavi dravyaṃ vinā hemāvayavā rucakākāreṇa pariṇamanta iti yuktam; ārambhavādaprasaṅgāt| athādṛśyamāno'pyavayavapariṇāmo'vayavipariṇāmānupapattyā kalpyate; āśrayavikāramantareṇāśritavikārānupapatteḥ,naitatsāram; avayavijanmavināśayoravayavānāmapi tattantrāṇāṃ janmavināśaprasaṅgāt, avayavigamane'vayavānāṃ gamanavat| pariṇāmo'pi bhaviṣyatīti cet, na; avayavini ghaṭatvajātisamavāyinyavayavānāṃ ghaṭatvajātisamavāyābhāvāt| nanu avayavānāmanyathābhāvamantareṇa kathamavayavinonyathābhāvaḥ nahi dravyasyāvasthāntaradravyāntarāpattivad nailyaṃ guṇāntaramāpadyate'vasthāntaraṃ vā| nacāvayavikāryavyatirekeṇāvayavānāṃ kāryaṃ dṛśyata ityuktam| na hi paṭe kāryāntarāvabhāse'pi tantavo'tantvātmanā'vabhāsante| paṭakārye tantvanugamaḥ svānugatānugamādanyathāsiddha ityuktam| kiṃca avayavipariṇāmopādhāvevāyavapariṇāmo dṛṣṭaḥ, iti na nirupādhiniravayavātmapariṇāmasiddhiḥ|| yattu niravayavasaṃyogavatpariṇāma iti, tatrāpi dṛśyamāno'vayavisaṃyogo na paramāṇusamavetaḥ; tadgatarūpādivadapratyakṣatvaprasaṅgāt| nāpyavayavyekadeśasaṃyogena niravayave saṃyogaḥ kalpayituṃ śakyate; avayavinyeva jātisamavāyavadavayavasaṃyogamantareṇāvayavinyeva saṃyogopapatteḥ| avayavānāṃ saṃyogānugamasyāvayavyanugamenānyathāsiddhatvāt| avayaveṣveva saṃyogo nāvayavinīti cet, na; avayavibhyāmasaṃyuktābhyāṃ kāryāntarānārambhaprasaṅgāt| tasmādavayavinyeva saṃyogo nāvayaveṣu| avayavisamavāye saṃyogasya kṛtsnavṛttitā saṃyogasya prāpnotīti cet, tarhi niravayavasaṃyoge'pi kṛtsnavṛtteḥ pracayābhāvaprasaṅga iti| kathaṃ punarbrahmaṇo niravayavatvalābhaḥ ucyate; avayavāvayavinoḥ svayaṃprakāśatve satītaretarāviṣayatvānna sāvayavatva brahmaṇā svātmanyanubhavituṃ śakyam| anyatarasyāsvayaṃprakāśatve'nyatareṇa vedyatvād ghaṭātmanoriva nāṃśāṃśibhāvasiddhiḥ| śrutiśca "niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyaṃ śāntami"ti kriyāvayavaśūnyatāmāha| niyantṛtvādikriyā'pi śrūyata iti cet, tarhi parasparavirodhe sati māyayā tattvātattvavyavasthā kalpanīyā| "māyābhiḥ pururūpa īyate" iti pravṛttermāyānibandhanatvaśravaṇāt cetanasya suṣupteḥ puruṣārthatvāvagamād brahmaṇaḥ svata pravṛttiprayojanābhāvācca viparītasvarūpāparityāgena viparītakāryāpatteśca vivarta eveti siddham|| nanu jagadutpattikāraṇatvaṃ na siddhavad brahmalakṣaṇatvenopādātuṃ śakyam, bhūtapañcakasya kāryatvāsiddheḥ, bhautikānāṃ ca bhūtopādānatvāditi codayati -- nanu śrutinirdiṣṭagrahaṇa ityādinā|| "ucyate" ityādeḥ parihārasyāyamarthaḥ| pṛthivyaptejovāyavo vivādapadāni, janmavināśavantaḥ, pṛthivyaptejovāyubuddhigocaratvāt; ekadeśapṛthivyaptejovāyuvaditi| nanu pratyanumānamastipṛthivyādayaḥ, na jāyante, mahābhūtatvāt; ākāśavat, ākāśaśca, na jāyate, niravayavadravyatvāt; ātmavaditi viśeṣato darśanameva balīya ityanavadyam| "na yathoktaviśeṣaṇasye"tyādibhāṣyatātparyamāha -- yuktirapi brahmasvarūpanirṇayetyādinā|| asya jagata ityādi bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- nānyataḥ paraparikalpitāt pradhānāderiti|| ayamarthaḥ -- sarva eva hyādhyātmikā bhāvāḥ, sukhaduḥkhamohasāmānyaprakṛtikāḥ, sukhaduḥkhamohasāmānyena niyamenānvitasvabhāvatvāt; ye vikārā yadanvitasvabhāvāste tatprakṛtikā dṛṣṭāḥ, yathā mṛdanvitāḥ śarāvādayaḥ| tathā sarve vikārāḥ, avibhaktaikaprakṛtikāḥ, parimitānekavikāratvāt; ye parimitānekavikārāḥ, te'vibhaktaikaprakṛtikāḥ, yathā mṛtpiṇḍaprakṛtikāḥ śarāvādayaḥ, iti jaganmūlakāraṇaṃ pradhānamanumimate sāṃkhyāḥ| tathā'ṇuvādinaścānumimate -- sarve kāryadravyam, svaparimāṇādaṇutaraparimāṇasaṃyogasacivasamānajātīyānekadravyārabdham, kāryadravyatvāt; yatkāryadravyam, tattathā, yathānekadravyārabdhaḥ paṭaḥ, iti niravayavaparamāṇuparyantamanumānapravṛtteḥ paramāṇavo mūlakāraṇamiti| tathā śūnyavādinaśca -- sarvaṃ kāryam, abhāvapuraḥsaraṃ bhavitumarhati, yogyatve satyanupalabhyamānapūrvāvasthatvāt; yathā paraparikalpita ātmeti śūnyālambanatvaṃ sarvatra -- vadanti| yogāḥ śaivāśca -- hiraṇyagarbha paśupatiṃ cāgamasāmārthyājjagatkāraṇaṃ kalpayanti| tān pakṣān vyāvartayati -- nānyataḥ paraparikalpitādityādinā|| tatra prathamaṃ tāvat pramāṇapūraṇaṃ sambhāvayati -- acetanāttāvadityataḥ prāktanena granthena| katham sāṃkhyānumāne tāvatsukhaduḥkhamohānvayo bhāvānāmasaṃpratipannaḥ; antarbahirbhāvenopalabdheḥ| syādetat -- sarve vikārāḥ, sukhaduḥkhamohātmakāḥ, cittoparaktatve sati tatra tadākārapratibhāsahetutvāt; darpaṇoparaktatayā mukhākārapratibhāsahetubimbavaditi bhāvānāṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānvayo'numīyata iti, na; antarbahirbhavabhedapratayakṣavirodhāt, ekaṃ ca śabdamupalabhamānānāṃ pratyekaṃ sukhaduḥkhamohatritayopalambhaprasaṅgācca, adṛṣṭena ca vastusāmarthyaniyamāyogāt, ato'siddho hetuḥ, anaikāntikaśca; guṇasāmānyairapyaprakṛtibhirdravyāṇāṃ samanvayāt| yattu parimitatvāditi, tatrāpi vastutaḥ parimitatve hetorguṇapuruṣeṣvanaikāntikatā| deśakālaparimitatve ghaṭahimakarakādiṣu pratyakṣadṛṣṭabhinnaprakṛtiṣvanekāntaḥ| vaiśeṣikānumāne'pi svaparimāṇādaṇutaraparimāṇārabhyatve dīrghavistīrṇadukūlaiḥ kriyamāṇarajjudravyasya hṛsvasyāpi kāryatvadarśanādanaikāntiko hetuḥ, pratyanumānaduṣṭaśca| na kiñcidapi kāryadravyam, niravayavadravyasaṃyogapurassaram, pracayātmakatvāt, yat pracayātmakam, na tad niravayavadravyasaṃyogapurassaram, yathā ghaṭaḥ| śūnyānumāne'pi ghaṭasya pūrvāvasthā, pratyakṣadṛṣṭā, mṛdityanupalabhyamānapūrvāvasthatvāt, ityasiddho heturiti| idānīmarthadūṣaṇamabhipredyāha -- acenanāttāvadacetanatvādevetyādinā|| mā bhūdanīśvarāt pradhānād vicitrakāryaracanā, paramāṇuvāde tu punaradhiṣṭhāturīśvarasya vidyamānatvāt tadbuddhisāmarthyādeva vicitrajagatkāryaracanā bhaviṣyati, ityāśaṅkyāha -- cetanādapīti|| ayamarthaḥ -- kulālādidṛṣṭāntenānumīyamānasyeśvarasya śarīrendriyaparicchinnajñānaśaktatvāt tenaiva dṛṣṭāntena paricchinnajñānaśakteśca jagadracanānupapattiḥ, iti ghaṭādiṣu kartṛdvayaprasaṅgād mūlakāraṇe'pi tadanumānamiti|| yattu śūnyālambanaṃ jagaditi, tatrāha -- abhāvātpunariti|| naca nirupākhyopādānatā jagataḥ; sadanvayāditi| kiṃca nirupākhyasya kāraṇatve pūrvakalpasya niranvayavināśāt saṃskārābhāvāt punaḥ sajātīyakāryotpādaniyāmakābhāvād viśiṣṭasaṃsthānapaśvādikāmitayā'nuṣṭhitakarmaṇāṃ kalpāntare tathāvidhapaśvādyanupapatteḥ, śabdārthasambandhatadvyavahāriṇāṃ ca "nākasya pṛṣṭhe taṃ kālaṃ divi sūrya iva rocate| tataḥ kṛtayugasyādau brahmapūto mahāśayāḥ| sarvajño dhṛtimānṛṣiḥ punarājāyate smaran||" ityādiśrutipratipannānāṃ niranvayavināśāt, kalpāntare pūrvakalpavyavahārānusandhānena vyavahārapravṛttyabhāvād apūrvasaṅkete ca, dharmasya pramāṇāntarāgocaratvād gopadārthasyāpūrvasādhanatvaṃ pramāya tatra ca gośabdaṃ prayujya "gavā yajeta" iti vākyaracanānupapatteśca karmatatphalatatpramāṇavyavahāroccheda ityāha -- atītakalpasaṃskārābhāvādityādinā|| atra svabhāvavādī jalpati -- na kāraṇāpekṣamidamutpadyate| nanu svayameva svasya nimittamityuktaṃ bhavati kiṃvā nirnimittamutpadyata iti nirnimittamiti brūmaḥ| nanu tarhi ghaṭasya bhāvābhāvau yugapat syātām; kramakārinimittanirapekṣatvāt, ucyate; kāraṇasya kramakāritvaṃ svabhāva iti cet, svabhāvavādaprasaṅgaḥ, nimittāntarasāpekṣatve'navasthāpātaḥ| kālabhedena kramakāryavastheti cet, sa kālakramaḥ svābhāvikaścet, svabhāvavādaḥ, nimittāntarāpekṣatve'navasthā| tasmāt sarvaṃ kāryaṃ vicitraṃ kramavarti ca yathādarśanaṃ svabhāvenaiva jāyata iti, tatrāha -- na svabhāvata ityādinā|| svataḥsiddhasāmarthyānāmapi bhāvānāṃ parasparopakāryopakārakabhāvaḥ pratyakṣasiddha ityarthaḥ| ata ityupasaṃhāraḥ| nanu anumānenaiva yathoktaviśeṣaṇamīśvaraṃ tārkikā vyavasthāpayanti, kiṃ yuktisahitenāgameveti ata āha -- etadevānumānamityādinā|| yuktirhi saṃbhāvanābuddhimātramutpādayati, anumānaṃ punararthaṃ niścāpayati| vyāptyanupapattyābhāsa udāharaṇamātrapradarśanaṃ yuktiḥ, avyabhicāriṇī vyāptiranumānam| tatra kulālādidṛṣṭāntairna sarvajñeśvarakāraṇatvaṃ niścetuṃ śakyate; viparītodāharaṇasaṃbhavāt, kintu pramāṇāntare sati kulālādidṛṣṭāntaiḥ saṃbhāvayituṃ śakyate| ato yuktirevaiṣā| tatrājñānādarthaniścāyakamanumānaṃ manyanta iti| kiṃ tadanumānamiti ucyate -- sarvaṃ kāryam, svarūpopādānopakaraṇa saṃpradānaprayojanasāmarthyaviṣayavijñānavatkartṛkam, vividhavinyāsakāryatvāt; ghaṭādivat, iti vaiśeṣikānumānam| sāṃkhyayogāḥ -- jñānaiśvaryaśaktayaḥ krameṇotkṛṣyamāṇāḥ, kvacit sarvaviṣayajñānaiśvaryaśaktimati paryavasyanti, taratamabhāvenotkṛṣyamāṇadharmatvāt; parimāṇavat -- ityanumimate| naiyāyikāstu -- sarvaṃ karmaphalajātam, karmatatphalatadbhoktṛdeśakālādiviśeṣavijñānavatā pradīyamānam, karmaphalatvāt; sevādikarmaphalavat -- ityanumimate|| tatra vaiśeṣikānumāne jagato bahukartṛtvaparicchinnajñānaiśvaryādimatkartṛtvānumāneṣūdāharaṇasaṃbhavād yuktimātrametat| yogānumāne'pi jñānaiśvaryaśaktīnāṃ kvacit kāṣṭhāprāptimātre'numīyamāne lakṣyapadārthaviṣayajñānādiṣu paryavasānasiddheḥ kutaḥ sarvajñatvādisiddhiḥ sarvaviṣayajñānādyanumāne gurutvarāgadveṣadukhabhrāntyādiṣvanaikāntikatā, iti yuktimātrametat| naiyāyikānumāne'pi karmaphalasya śarīrendriyādimadbahudātṛtvadarśanādekeśvarāsiddheḥ śrutipratipannasarvakāraṇasarvajñasarveśvarasarvaphaladātradvitīyabrahmapratipattāvudāharaṇamātreṇa saṃbhāvanābuddhihetutvād yuktimātram, ityajñānād kiṃ taditi niścāyakamanumānaṃ manyante| nanu vākyeṣu satsu kiṃmityanumānaprayāsa iti anumānasiddhārthānuvādakatvādityāha -- janmādīti|| nanu sūtre'pyetānyevānumānāni svātantryeṇārthaniścāyakatvena sūtritāni, tat kathamāgamaguṇabhūteyaṃ yuktiḥ iti codayatinanvihāpi tadevopanyastamityādinā|| pariharati -- na vedāntavākyagrathanārthatvādityādinā|| kiṃcānumānamātrāt kāraṇasadbhāvamātraṃ sidhyati, nādhikam, iha tu satyajñānānantasarvajñapratyagātmabrahmāvagatirvivakṣitā| nacāgamamātreṇa sāmānyamātraviṣayānumānādeva viśiṣṭārthasiddhirityāha -- samanvayasūtrapramukhopāttairityādinā|| na tarhi yuktiratra sūtritā; āgamenaiva viśiṣṭārthasiddheriti, tatrāha -- satsvu tviti|| na dharmajijñāsāyāmi"tyādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| śrutiḥ padāntaranirapekṣaḥ śabdaḥ| liṅgam śrutasyārthasyārthāntareṇāvinābhāvaḥ| anekapadasāmarthyaṃ vākyam|| vākyadvayāsāmarthyamārabhyādhītaviṣayaṃ prakaraṇam|| kramavartināṃ padārthānāṃ krama vartibhiḥ padārthairyathākramaṃ sambandhaḥ sthānam|| saṃjñāsāmānyaṃ samākhyā|| nanu śabdena brahmasvarūpe'vadhārite nānubhavena kṛtyamasti| naca śabdaprameyamanubhavituṃ śakyamiti, tatrāha -- anubhavāvasānatvādityādinā|| nanu dharmajijñāsāyāmityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| kimiti dharmasyānubhavānapekṣeti codayati -- kathamiti|| dharmasyānubhavāyogyatvādanapekṣitānubhavatvācca na śabdādanyāpekṣeti darśayati -- kartavyaṃ hītyādinā| nanu siddhasvabhāvasyānubhavayogyatve'pi kimityanubhavo'pekṣyata iti tatrāha -- iha tu siddhasyeti|| nanu vedaprameyatvāviśeṣānmanananididhyāsanānubhaveṣu dharmavad brahmaṇyapi mā bhūdapekṣā, brahmavadvā dharme'pi syādapekṣetyata āha -- nahi kartavyasiddhārthaniṣṭhayoriti|| astu puruṣecchāvaśanirvartyatvamapīti, tatrāha -- tato vidhipratiṣedheti|| yajeta na bhakṣayeditivad brahmaṇo vidheyatvaṃ pratiṣedhyatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ| vikalpeti|| "vrīhibhiryavairvetivad brahma vā sthāṇurvetīcchāvikalpaḥ"| samuccayetiṣaḍ‌yāgasamuccayaḥ, iha brahma sthāṇuścetyarthaḥ| utsargāpavādeti|| "na hiṃsyātsarvā bhūtāni" "agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta" "āhavanīye juhoti" "pade juhotī"tivat sāmānyapratipannabrahmaṇo viśeṣe'pavādaḥ| bādhābhyuccayayeti|| prakṛteratidiṣṭānāṃ kuśamayabarhiṣāṃ vikṛtāvupadiṣṭaśaramayabarhirbhirbādhavad brahmaṇo'pi kvacid prāptasya padārthāntareṇa bādhaḥ| prākṛtānāṃ pañcanāriṣṭahomānāṃ vaikṛtairupahomaiḥ samuccityānuṣṭhānavad brahmaṇo'pyatidiṣṭasyopadiṣṭena samuccityānuṣṭhānamabhyuccayaḥ| "pañca prayājān yajatī"tiprakṛtervikṛtāvatidiṣṭānāṃ vikṛtau"ekādaśa prayājān yajatī"tyupadiṣṭena samuccityāvṛttyā ṣoḍaśaprayājānuṣṭhānavad brahmaṇo'pyatidiṣṭasyopadiṣṭena samuccityānuṣṭhānamabhyuccayaḥ| vyavasthitavikalpa iti|| "udite juhotyanudite juhotī"ti śākhābhedena vyavasthāvat kvacid brahma bhavati na bhavatīti vyavasthā| astvevaṃ dharmasāmyaṃ brahmaṇa iti cet, netyāha -- na vastunīti|| tadeva prapañcayati -- tathācaikasminniti|| aparaḥ paricodayatītyataḥ prāktanaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| punaranumānavādinaścodayanti -- nanu bhūtavastiviṣayatva iti| nanu anumānasūcanaparaṃ sūtraṃ na pratibhātīti, ata āha -- pūrvasūtreṇeti|| jñānānandapratyagbhūtabrahmaṇaścakṣurādinā sāmānyamātraviṣayānumānaiśca bhūtavastutve'pi nānubhāvaḥ kartuṃ śakyata iti pariharati -- nendriyādiviṣayatva ityādinā|| ataḥ ityupasaṃhāraḥ|| nanu evaṃ satīti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| ucyata ityādeḥ parihārasyāyamarthaḥ -- jñānānandasarvajñapratyagātmabhūtaṃ brahma niścāpayitumasamarthā api yuktayaḥ śabdāvagate brahmaṇi sāmānyadvāreṇa saṃbhāvanābuddhihetavo bhavanti| katham jagadupādāne'dvitīyaśabdāvagate mṛdādidṛṣṭāntairupādānavyatirekeṇa kāryasyānirūpaṇādadvitīyā saṃbhāvyate| spaṭikalauhityapratibimbarajjusarpaghaṭākāśadṛṣṭāntairātmani kartṛtvāderāroritatvaṃ jīvabrahmaikyaṃ brahmavyatiriktaprapañcasvātantryābhāvo'saṅgatvadvāreṇa viśuddhādvitīyapratyagātmatā ca saṃbhāvyata iti| kiṃ punastad vedavākyamiti bhāṣyasyākṣepārthamāha -- sarvatra vedāntavākye brahmapadasyetyādinā|| yeṣāṃ vedāntavākyānāmityādeḥ parihārasyāyamarthaḥ -- satyajñānānandapratyagātmādvitīyabrahmapadārthe'prasiddhe'pi bṛhattvamātrasya prasiddhatvāt tadanuvādena sannihitapadārthasaṃsargasāmarthyād viśiṣṭabrahma pratipattuṃ śakyate, iti brahmapratipādanaparaṃ satyādivākyam, arthāttadeva lakṣaṇam, iti na satyajñānānandabrahmasvarūpalakṣaṇasya siddhānuvādaprasaṅga iti| nanu svādhyāyapāṭhakrameṇa nārthapratipattiḥ, kintu vaiparītyena; "prasiddhānuvādenāprasiddham" iti nyāyāt| tathāca kāraṇasya prasiddhatvāt yasmādākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ sa ātmā satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahmeti vākyavṛttiḥ; tathā yasmādetad brahma nāma rūpamannaṃ ca jāyate, sa sarvajñaḥ sarvaviditi; tathā yasmātprāṇādi jāyate, sa divyo hyamūrtaḥ puruṣa ityādi; tathā yo bhūtayoni, tadadreśyamagrāhyamityādi; yasmāttejovannāni jāyante, tatsadadvitīyamaṇimā tatvamasītyādikāraṇamātrānuvādena tadviśeṣaḥ pratipādyata iti, satyam; adhikārijñākartavyatābrahmātmapratipādanānāṃ kramamabhipretyedamuktam, tadāha -- tathaivodāharaṇamiti|| nanu jagatkāraṇe nānātvasyāpi pratipatteḥ kathaṃ tadanuvādena brahma pratipādanīyamiti codayati -- kathamiti|| pariharati -- pūrvoktenetyādinā|| ayamarthaḥ -- jagatkāraṇamātrānuvāde'pi tasya nānātvaśaṅkāyām -- "yataḥ" ityekatvanirdeśādekatvamapi pramīyate| nanu anuvāde pramitiranupapannā, na; jagatkāraṇa ekatvapurovādābhāvādanuvādasāmarthyādevaikatvaṃ pramīyate; anyathā'nuvādavaiyarthyāt| nanu ekatve brahmalakṣaṇe ca pramīyamāṇe vākyabhedaḥ syāt, na; ekatvasya brahmapratipattirguṇabhūtatayaikavākyatvāt| athavā -- ekatvamapi lakṣyāntargatameva bhavati, na lakṣaṇāntargatam| tathāhi -- jagatkāraṇamātrānuvādenaikaṃ brahma vidhīyata iti| tataḥ kimāyātamiti tadāha -- arthātsarvajñamiti|| na saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhaparaṃ vākyam, kiṃtvarthapratipādanaparam| ārthikastu saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandha ityāha -- punastadvijijñāsasvetyādi|| ekaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvaśakti sarvato'navacchinnaṃ ca jagatkāraṇam, tacca brahmaśabdābhidheyamityarthaḥ|| nanu nirupādhikabrahmasvarūpakathanamantareṇa sopādhikānāṃ sarvajñatvādīnāṃ kasyacid dharmatayā pratipattirna yuktā, tanna; "yat suṣiraṃ tadākāśam" "prakṛṣṭaprakāśaścandraḥ" ityādivat svarūpalakṣaṇameva kiṃcid vaktavyam| brahmaśabdābhidheyameva svarūpalakṣaṇamiti cet, na; bṛhatvadharmamātrābhidhānāt| mahān ghaṭa ityukte mahattvasya nirupādhirghaṭo dharmitayā pratīyate, tathehāpi vaktavyaṃ sacchabdābhidheyaṃ lakṣaṇamiti cet, na; mahāsāmānyamātrābhidhānāt| sannityukte ghaṭa ityavāntarasāmānyavyaktirmahāsāmānyaparyavasānatvenāpekṣyate, tathehāpyavāntarasāmānyavyaktirvaktavyā| vijñānameva bṛhatvasarvajñatvādidharmavattayā nirupādhi brahmasvarūpalakṣaṇamiti cet, na; tasya sukhaduḥkharāgadveṣādimahāsāmānyatvāt tasyāpyavāntarasāmānyavyaktau paryavasānaṃ vaktavyamiti, tadāha tasya ca nirṇayavākyamānandāddheyaveti|| ānanda eva hi brahmatvasarvajñatvakāraṇatvādidharmavattayā nirupādhi brahmasvarūpaṃ nirṇīyate| tathāhi -- "yatra nānyatpaśyatī"tyārabhya "yo vai bhūmā tatsukhami"ti sukhasyaiva bṛhatvadharmavattāmāha| vijñānaṃ tarhi nirupādhikabrahmaguṇa iti cet, kiṃ vijñānānandayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nīlotpalavad guṇaguṇibhāvāt kiṃ vā dravyaṃ ghaṭa itivatparāparasāmānyabhāvāditi na tāvad guṇaguṇibhāvāt; "sākṣī cetā kevalo nirguṇaśce"ti śruteḥ "ekadhaivānudraṣṭavyaṃ neha nānāstī"ti ca guṇaguṇibhāvabhedapratiṣedhāt, guṇasya guṇino'nyatvānanyatvābhyāmanirūpaṇāt|| atra sarvasaṅkaravādī na nirguṇaṃ dravyamastīti jalpati| mā bhūnnirguṇaṃ dravyam, brahma tu na dravyam; pramāṇābhāvāt| samavāyikāraṇatvād dravyamiti cet, na; ārambhavādānabhyupagamāt| upādānakāraṇatvād dravyamiti cet, na; guṇādīnāmapi grahaṇadharmatvādidharmopādānatvāt| na nirguṇaṃ vastviti cet, antyaguṇeṣvanekāntaḥ| tasmāttatvajñānapradveṣamātrametad na nirguṇaṃ brahmeti| tasmād "dravyaṃ ghaṭaḥ" "san ghaṭaḥ" itivatparāparasāmānyanibandhanaṃ vijñānamānandamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyam| tasmād vijñānasāmānyālambanamānandaviśeṣo brahmeti| tatra sarvajñādvitīyatvādidharmāṇāṃ prapañcopādhitayā'nirvacanīyatvānna tairbrahma saguṇaṃ sadvitīyaṃ vā bhavati| vijñānasāmānyamapi duḥkharāgādiprapañcopādhitayā'nirvacanīyaṃ sad brahmaṇi vijñānaśabdapravṛttimātraheturbhavati| vijñānaguṇatvābhāve na vijñānaṃ brahmeti cet, na; vijñānasāmānyālambanasya vijñānavyavahāragocaratvāt, vijñānaprayuktārthakriyākāritvācca| sāmānyasyābhāsatvāt tadālambanaṃ brahmajñānaṃ mithyājñānamiti cet, na; mukhyasāmānyāntarābhāvāt, asyaiva ca mukhyatvāt| tasmādvijñānasvabhāva ānando brahmetyānandasyaiva brahmatāṃ pratipādayati -- prasiddhāvadyotakenetyādinā|| tasmāt sarveṣu vedāntavākyeṣu pāṭhavyatyāsena jagatkāraṇamātrānuvādena tasya brahmatvaṃ pratipādyata ityupasaṃharati -- tasmād brahmapara iti|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakānanyānubhavapūjyapādaśiṣyasvaprakāśānubhavabhagavavaḥ kṛtau pañcapādikāvivaraṇe janmādyadhikaraṇaṃ nāma pañcamavarṇakaṃ samāptam|| <6> atha ṣaṣṭhaṃ varṇakam|| śabdopādānabhāvād dhvanigataviṣayadyotanāḥ śaktayo'mūrbrahmaṇyevāsuragnerviṣayaviṣayiṇī dīpaśaktiḥ khalūccaiḥ| draṣṭuśca jñānaśaktirnnanu na karaṇatā, kintu dīpaprabhāvat saṃyuktadyotanaivetyaparamiha punaḥ sādhyate sarvavittvam|| brahmaṇo lakṣaṇadvayābhidhānapare'pi sūtre sarvajñatvaṃ pradhānādikāraṇavailakṣaṇyasya siddhaye jagadviracanopapattaye ca śrutiyuktibhyāṃ prādhānyena pradarśitam| tadeva hetvantareṇa sādhayati; prādhānyāt, athavā -- sarvajagatkāraṇatvena sarvajñatvaṃ na sambhavati; vedānāmakartṛkatvādityāśaṅkya, sambandhamāha -- ayamapara iti|| vedasya tāvat sarvaviṣayasāmarthyaṃ darśayati tadupādānatayā brahmaṇā'pi tad darśayitum -- anekanānāvidhaviṣayavidyāsthāneti| nanunāsti vedasya sarvajñatā; arthajñānakaraṇatayopayogāditi, satyam; ata eva kalpapratyayaprayoga iti| nanu vedasya sarvaviṣayajñānasāmarthyo'pi brahmaṇaḥ kathaṃ sarvajñateti ata āha -- tataśca tasya kāraṇamiti dṛśyata ityādi dṛṣṭāntaḥ| ayaṃ prayogaḥ -- vedaḥ, svaviṣayādadhikataravijñānavatpraṇīto bhavati, vākyapramāṇatvāt; pāṇinyādiśāstravaditi| nanu kimatrānumānena prasādhyate yadi tāvadupādhyāyasyādhyāpanoccāraṇavacchāstraśabdopalakṣitānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ brahmaṇyapyuccāraṇaṃ sādhyate tadā nopādhyāyavat sarvajñaṃ brahma bhaviṣyati| atha sakalavākyārthaṃ pramāṇāntareṇopalabhya tatpratipattyarthaṃ parasmai vākyaṃ viracayati prāptaṃ tarhi pauruṣeyatvam; tallakṣaṇatvātpuruṣavacasām, iti codayati -- nanvevaṃ satīti|| atra kecitparihāramācakṣate -- pramāṇāntareṇārthamupalabhya vivakṣitvā parasmai viracitaḥ śabdaḥ pauruṣeya ityucyate| tatredamanena kartavyamiti vakturabhiprāyabhedo rāgaḥ puruṣavacasāmarthaḥ| dvividhaśca rāgaḥ -- nityo'nityaśca| tatrānīśvarāṇāmabhilaṣitasādhanajñānasyānityatayā tajjanyarāgasyāpyanityatvāt tadviṣayāṇāṃ puruṣavacasāṃ pramāṇāntarasāpekṣatayā pauruṣeyatvamaṅgīkriyate, īśvarasya punarnikhileṣṭasādhanaviṣayajñānānāṃ nityatayā tanmūlarāgasyāpi nityatvādīśvarapraṇītānāmapi vaidikavacasāṃ nityarāgaviṣayatayā pauruṣeyatā na jegīyate -- iti, naitatsāram; īśvare sakalābhilaṣitasādhanajñānanityatve pramāṇābhāvāt, anumānānāṃ cātadgocaratvasya darśitatvāt| śabda iti cet, na; itaretarāśrayāpātāt -- nityajñānamulanityarāgajanyatve śabdasyānapekṣaṃ prāmāṇyam, anapekṣe ca śabde nityajñānasiddhiriti| "rāgaśca nityaḥ", "nityābhilaṣitasādhanajñānamūlaḥ" iti ca vyāhanyate| kutaścaitad labdham -- nityānityābhiprāyabhedena puruṣavacasāmapi satāṃ sāpekṣatvānapekṣatvavibhāgo vidyata iti naca puruṣābhiprāyaḥ śabdārtha iti ca vakṣyate| tasmādasamañjasametat|| anye tu saṅgirante -- vyāsādyabhiprāyabhedatātparyavatāmapi bhāratavacasāmidānīntanavācakavadadhyayanavidhitātparyatāmeva vedānāṃ sṛṣṭikāle samuccāraṇamīśvarasya vedapraṇayanaṃ nāma| tataśca rāgatātparyābhāvād vedaprāmāṇyamīśvarasya sarvajñatā cet, atra vayaṃ pṛcchāmaḥ -- sṛṣṭisamaye kiṃ pramāṇāntareṇārthamupalabhya vedavākyaṃ vyanakti yathā pāṇinyādiḥ, āhosvidupādhyāyavat pūrvasiddhavākyamuccārayati tatra pūrvasmin kalpe pauruṣeyatā''pattiḥ, uttarasminnupādhyāyavadevāsarvajñatāpattiḥ| abhiprāyatātparyābhāvādapauruṣeyateti cet, upalabhya racanāyāṃ kuto rāgatātparyābhāvaḥ pūrvameva vidhitātparyāditi cet, tathāpītaranna vihanyate| na cobhayatātparyamupapadyate; satyapi vidhitātparye'vagamyārthaṃ racanaiva sāpekṣatve nimittaṃ samadhigatam| nacopalabhya racanāyāṃ vidhitātparyamupapadyata iti yatkiñcidetat|| apare tu manyante -- nirvikalpajñānapūrvakāṇi kila vedavākyāni na sāpekṣatvadoṣamaśnuvate; brahmasvarūpajñānasya nirvikalpakatvāt, laukikavacasāṃ tu savikalpajñānapūrvatvātsāpekṣatā -- iti, nāyamapi vibhāgaḥ sidhyati; upalabhya racanāyā eva sāpekṣatvanimittatvāt, svarūpajñānasyāpyabhilaṣitasādhanoparāge savikalpakatvāt| tasmānnaiva parihārāḥ|| syāttarhi vedānāṃ pauruṣeyatā nanu apauruṣeyo vedaḥ; avicchinnavyavahāre satyasmaryamāṇakartṛkatvāt; ātmavadityapauruṣeyatānumīyata iti, na; ciravṛtteṣvapīdānīmanumānapramīyamāṇakartṛkeṣvanaikāntikatvāt, vedānāṃ ca kartṛranumānāgamābhyāṃ pramīyamāṇatvāt| tathāhi viśiṣṭabahujñapuruṣapraṇītaḥ, vedaḥ, bahvarthaviṣayavākyapramāṇatvāt; bhāratavat, "idaṃ sarvamasṛjata" "ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmānī"tyāgamaḥ| tasmātpauruṣeyo veda iti| atra pṛcchāmaḥ -- kathaṃ pauruṣeye vede prāmāṇyaṃ labhyata iti kapilakaṇādākṣapādānāmiti sarvajñapraṇītatayeti cet, na tāvadanumeyaḥ sarvajña ityuktam| āgamāccetsiddhiḥ, na; itaretarāśrayāt -- sarvajñe siddhe tatpraṇītatayā vedaprāmāṇyam, tataśca sarvajñasiddhiriti| syādetat -- mahājanaparigrahād vedaprāmāṇyamiti, na; sugatādyāgamānusāriṇāmeva deśaviśeṣeṣvānantyaśravaṇāt| naca dehātmabhāvacandraprādeśatvādīnāṃ mahājanaparigṛhītānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ dṛśyate| naca mahājanaparigrahaḥ pramāṇapakṣapātī| tasmānna prāmāṇyalābhaḥ|| kiñca puruṣo vā kena pramāṇenopalabhya dharmādharmau, vedavākyaṃ viracayet na tāvadindriyapañcakena; rūparasagandhasparśaśabdatattatsamavetaviśeṣagrāhitvāt, vartamānagrahaṇaniyamācca, dharmasya ca sādhyatvāt| nanu ātmasamavāyī dharmastadgrahaṇenaiva jñānena tadguṇatayā manasaiva cakṣurādinā vā gṛhyata iti, kimiti tarhi na gṛhṇīmaḥ naca viśiṣṭaḥ puruṣo gṛhṇāti; tadindriyāṇāmapyetādṛśatvāt, yogajadharmasāmarthyādviśiṣṭāni tadindriyāṇīti cet, tathā'pi mārjārādidṛṣṭivatsvaviṣaye'tiśayamātraṃ gṛhṇīyuḥ, nāviṣayaṃ dharmam| "divyaṃ cakṣurdadāmyaham" "prādātteṣāṃ sa bhagavan divyaṃ cakṣurjanārdanaḥ" iti smaraṇādasti yogināṃ divyaṃ cakṣuriti cet, na; tasyāpi viśvarūpādisvaviṣayātiśayadarśitvāt| na cātmasamavetatayā'pi dharmo vartamāno bhavati, yena pratyakṣaḥ syāt| kalpāntarīyo'nuṣṭhito dharmo'smin kalpādau vartata iti cet, na; kalpāntarīyadharmopadeśāyogāt| tato'pi kalpāntarānuṣṭhitadharmaṃ pratyakṣeṇopalabhyopadiśatīti cet, andhaparamparā syāt| tasmānna pratyakṣamūlo vedaḥ| nāpi śabdamūlaḥ; anavasthānāt| tasmātprāmāṇyahānānna pauruṣeyo veda iti|| mā bhūt pramāṇyamiti sugatārhatāḥ| tairidaṃ vaktavyam -- pratyakṣānumānadṛṣṭavyatiriktaḥ karmaphalasaṃbandho vidyate naveti vidyate cet kathamapauruṣeyāgamamantareṇa tasya siddhiḥ sarvajñasugatapraṇītāgamāditi cet, kiṃ kapilādayaḥ sarvajñā na bhavanti sarve tīrthakarāḥ sarvajñā iti cet, dharmādharmayorvivādaḥ kathaṃ syāt nacaikaḥ sarvajño netara iti pramāṇamasti| naca sarve sarvajñapraṇītā dharmā eveti yuktam; anyonyadharmanirākaraṇāt| nacāpauruṣeyā eva sugatādyāgamā iti yuktam; anusmaryamāṇakartṛkatvāt| apauruṣeyatve ca na vivadāmaḥ -- uditānuditahomavad vyavasthopapatteḥ|| āha lokāyataḥ -- mā bhūt pratyakṣadṛṣṭātiriktaḥ karmaphalasaṃbandhaḥ, pauruṣeyatā tu vedasyānumānasiddhā na nivāryata iti| sa vaktavyaḥ -- kiṃ laukikavacāṃsi pramāṇāni na veti na cet, na mayā te vādo yuktaḥ, śabdaireva parasparaviruddhārthapratipādanarūpatvādvādasya| atha laukikavacāṃsi pramāṇāni, vedavacobhistarhi kimaparāddham nanu pauruṣeyatvaṃ vedasyānumānāt tasya ca mūlapramāṇābhāvādaprāmāṇyamuktam, na; svābhāvikatvācchabdānāmarthāvabodhasāmarthyasya puruṣapratyayānusāritvābhāvāt, anyathā sāgaraṃ vivakṣanmeruśabdaṃ brūyāt| svabhāvasiddhaśabdasāmarthyānusāreṇa hi laukikāḥ śabdaṃ prayuñjate, satyam; kadācitsarvābhidhānasaṅketasāmarthyāt| idānīṃ vyavasthayā'bhidhānāmiti cet, tanna; vivādagocarāpannaḥ pūrvatanaśabdārthasaṃbandhavyavahāraḥ, tathāvidhapūrvapūrvavyavahāraparamparānibandhanaḥ; abhidhānābhidheyavyavahāratvāt; idānīntanatadvyavahāravat, ityanāditānumānāt| sāṅketikaśabdeṣvanaikāntika iti cet, na; abhidhānābhidheyaviṣayatvādanumānasya| jātimātrābhidhāyino vā sarvadeśeṣvabhidhānatayā saṃpratipannā vā yasminnutpadyamāne kvacid gṛhītasaṃbandhā evoparajyante śabdāḥ, tāni cābhidhānāni, naivaṃ sāṅketikāḥ śabdā iti| mā bhūt tarhyabhidhānasaṅketaḥ, vedavākyaracanā tu puruṣanibandhanaivetyata āha -- na syād brahmavadanāditvāditi|| vivādagocarāpannaṃ sṛṣṭikālīnaṃ vedādhyayanam, pūrvapūrvatathāvidhavedādhyayanānusmṛtinibandhanaṃ bhavitumarhati, vedādhyayanatvāt, idānīntanavedādhyayanavaditi viśeṣatodṛṣṭānumānena vākyatvādbhāratavaditi sāmānyatodarśanād balīyasā vedasyānāditvasiddheḥ kutaḥ pauruṣeyatā nanu sarveṣvapi grantheṣvidamanāditvānumānamanuviśati, na; taireva granthaistattatkartṛṇāṃ pratipādanāttadāgamavirodhāt, ihāpi śrutyaiva vedasya kartā pratipādyata iti cet; na tāvat "sa tayā vācedaṃ sarvamasṛjata ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmānī"ti śrutiḥ prajāpativiṣayā satī tasya pramāṇāntareṇārthamupalabhya śabdaracanāṃ bravīti; "yo brahmāṇāṃ vidadhāti pūrvaṃ yo vedāśca prahiṇoti tasmai" iti śrutau prāgeva vedasadbhāvāvagamāt| "asya mahato bhūtasye"ti śrutirīśvaraviṣayā'pi satī prakaraṇasāmarthyādvedopādānatvameva bravīti|| kiṃ cedaṃ pauraṣeyatvaṃ sādhyate yadi tāvat puruṣanirvartyatāmātram, saṃpratipannameva; tattatkramaviśiṣṭānāmeva varṇānāṃ vedaśabdābhidheyatvāt kramasya tūccāraṇopalabdhyoranyatarasya pratikṣaṇanirvatyatayā tadviśiṣṭavarṇānāmapi pratyuccāraṇaṃ janyatvāt, pūrvapūrvakramānusmaraṇena tatsadṛśottarottarakramanivartanāt, kramasādṛśyaparamparāyāścānidaṃprathamatayā tadviśiṣṭavarṇanityatvābhidhānāt| atha vedaḥ svārthapravṛttapramāṇāntarajanyo bhavati, asarvajñavacanatvābhāve sati dharmādharmabrahmapramāṇatvāt; paraparikalpiteśvarabuddhivaditi| adhyayanasyedaṃprathamatā vedasya pauruṣeyateti, na; adhyayanasyānāditvānumānasya darśitatvāt| tasmānnāsti vedasya pauruṣeyatvamiti|| nanu āptena pramāṇāntareṇārthamupalabhya parapratipattaye tatra prayujyamānaḥ śabdaḥ pramāṇaṃ bhavati, tadabhāvādanāptavākyavadapramāṇaṃ vedaḥ prasajyate, nanu anāptena bhrāntyotprekṣayā vā'rthābhāsamupagamya parapravṛttaye tatra prayujyamānaḥ śabdaḥ prāmāṇyātparihīyate, tadabhāvādāptavākyavadvedaḥ pramāṇaṃ kiṃ na syāt nanu āptavākyamanāptapraṇītatvābhāvātpramāṇam kiṃ vā'ptapraṇītatvāt iti vivektavyam, nobhayathā'pīti brūmaḥ| katham śabdānāṃ tāvatsaṃsṛṣṭārthāvabodhanasāmarthyaṃ svārasikameva madhyamavṛddhaprayogapratyayābhyāmāptānāptapratyayavyatirekeṇāvagatam| tatrānāptasya bhrāntyutprekṣājñāne tanmūlaviracitaśabdakāraṇadoṣatayā śabde'pi doṣaṃ prasañjayataḥ| tataśca duṣṭakāraṇajanyavijñānamayathārthamapramāṇam, iti svataḥsiddhaśabdasāmarthyaprayuktaprāmāṇyasya pratibandhakatayā'nāptajñānamavatiṣṭhate| āptapramāṇaṃ ca pratibandhabhrāntyutprekṣādidoṣanirāsitayā saṃpadyate| tataścāptatvajñānaṃ ca śabdaprāmāṇaayahetuḥ, vede tu puruṣasaṃbandhābhāvānna pratibandhatannirāsāpekṣā, iti nāptapraṇītatvamatropayujyate| nanu āptaprayogānapekṣatve'gniparvatatatsaṃbandhaśabdeṣu smaryamāṇeṣu tebhya evāgnimānparvata iti pramitirutpadyeta, satyam; parvatasyāgnimattāmātraṃ pramīyata eva, purovartini tu pramāṇāntaravirodhānna pramīyata iti| athavā -- dvividhaḥ prayogaḥ prāmāṇyahetuḥ, -- arthopalabdhinibandhanaḥ pauruṣeye, pūrvaprayogānusmṛtinimitto vede, tadubhayābhāvātsuptādivākyeṣvivāprāmāṇyamiti, athavā -- tātparyābhāvāt kevalebhyaḥ śabdebhyo nārthapramitiḥ, vede punaradhyayanavidhitātparyādāptaprayogābhāve'pi pramitirutpadyate; adhyayanavidhivākyasyāpi svenaiva tātparyasiddheḥ| ato'nādirveda iti| anāditve'pi purāṇavākyavadanyathāsanniveśapraṇayanamāśaṅkyāha -- kūṭasthanityatvāditi|| anādivedasya kathaṃ brahmakāraṇatā iti śaṅkate -- kathaṃ punariti|| atra śāstraśabdopalakṣitasarvaśabdānāṃ varṇānāmekapadārthabuddhyavacchedakavarṇaniyāmakakramaviśiṣṭapadānāṃ vākyārthabudhyavacchedakavākyaniyāmakakramaviśiṣṭavākyānāṃ mahāvākyārthabudhyavacchedakavākyaniyāmakakramaviśiṣṭaprakaraṇānāṃ paripūrṇapuruṣārthasādhanabuddhyavacchedakānekaprakaraṇaniyāmakakramaviśiṣṭaśāstrāṇāṃ ca pravāharūpeṇa brahmopādānatayā kāryatvamastītyāha -- tatparatantratvādityādinā|| nanu "rajjusarpavadi"ti vedasya mithyātvaṃ kathaṃ nidarśyate nanu ko'yaṃ vedo nāma na tāvad varṇamātram| kramaviśeṣavanto varṇā iti cet, nāsti deśakālanibandhano varṇakramaḥ; nityatayā sarvagatatvāt, nāpi vastunibandhanakramaḥ, virodhāt, na hyekadaiva rājā jareti jakārasya rephātpūrvāparībhāvo yuktaḥ| uccāraṇasamaveta eva kramo varṇeṣūparajyata iti cet, na; apratyakṣatvāduccāraṇatatkramayoḥ, pratyakṣastu kramaviśiṣṭavarṇātmā vedaḥ| athopalabdhikramavanto varṇā vedaśabdabhāja iti, na; anyakramasyānyadharmatvānupapatteḥ| athopalabdhidharma eva kramo varṇeṣu samāropyata iti cet, tarhyakhyātivādinaḥ kramamātrasya varṇamātrasya vedaśabdānarhatvād viśiṣṭapratyayābhāvādavivekamātrameva veda ityarthāvabodho na syāt, anyathākhyātau punarviśiṣṭapratyayamātratvād viśiṣṭārthābhāvādvijñānātirikto vedo na syāt| naca -- upalabdhikramopalakṣitā varṇā vedaḥ, na viśiṣṭā iti -- yuktam; kramaviśiṣṭavarṇapratyayasya pratyakṣatvāt| anirvacanīye tu punarviśiṣṭārthatatpratyayayorbhāvād vijñānavyatirekeṇārthasyānirvacanīyatve'pyarthakriyāsamarthatayā tucchavyāvṛttyabhyupagamādastyevārthāvabodhasamartho veda iti niravadyam|| nanu pāṇinyādidṛṣṭāntena yadi sarvaśabdopādānataiva brahmaṇo vedasya pauruṣeyatvaparihārāya gīyate, tadā kathaṃ tāvatā sarvajñatvam iti codayati -- nanvevaṃ sati kathaṃ sarvajñateti|| pariharati -- tasyaiva jñānaśaktivivartātmakatvānnāmaprapañcasyeti|| asti tāvad varṇānāṃ kramasaṃkhyādibhedabhājāṃ mukhyalakṣaṇādidvāreṇa sarvārthaprakāśanasāmarthyam; avyapadeśyasya vastuno'bhāvāt| tatra kāryagatamarthaprakāśanasāmarthyamupādānakāraṇadharma eva bhavati; pradīpagataprakāśanasāmarthyasya vahnidharmatvadarśanāt, kāryopādānayoḥ śaktidvayakalpanā'yogāt| evaṃ sarvārthaprakāśanasamarthatvāt sarvajñaṃ brahma| nanu samarthasyāpi nityavajjñānasaṃyogo na bhavati, naiṣa doṣaḥ; yathā prakāśadravyasya pradīpasya svasannihitāśeṣavastuprakāśitā,evaṃ prakāśasvarūpasya brahmaṇaḥsarvopādanatayā sarvasaṃsargiṇaḥsvasannihitāśeṣavastuprakāśitā, nityavad bhavatīti yuktaṃ sāmarthyānusāreṇa sarvajñatvam| kathaṃ karaṇasāmarthyāni kartṛsāmarthyāni bhavantīti cet, na; brahmaṇo viṣayāvagamaṃ prati śabdasya karaṇatā'bhāvāt| nanu svayaṃprakāśatayā sarvasaṃsargitvādeva sarvajñatā sidhyati, na; vāyvākāśarasagandhādivyāpino'pi sāvatṛkiraṇasya tatprakāśanāyogyatvadarśanāt| tasmāt sarvārthaprakāśanasamarthasarvaśabdopādānatayā sarvajñaṃ brahma| tadetadāha -- nāsataḥ prādurbhāvāditi|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakānyānubhavapūjyapādaśiṣyasvaprakāśānubhavabhagavataḥ kṛtau pañcapādikāvivaraṇe brahmaṇaḥ sarvajñatvanirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaṃ varṇakaṃ samāptam|| <7> <8> atha aṣṭakaṃ varṇakam|| jñānānandaikarūpaṃ nikhilajagadupādānamīśaṃ prabhūṇām sarvajñaṃ brahma nityaṃ viśadamatitarāṃ nirguṇaṃ niṣkriyaṃ ca| etatkāryāvamṛṣṭiṃ nikhilabhavavatīṃ samyaguddhūya viddhvā tvaprāmāṇyaṃ śrutīnāṃ śrutibhiridamajaṃ jñeyamityucyate'smin|| jagato janmādikāraṇaṃ jñānānandaṃ brahmeti ca lakṣitam| tatra vedāntāḥ pramāṇamiti pratijñātam| tatredaṃ nirūpaṇīyam -- kiṃ bhūte'pyarthe śabdaḥ pramāṇam na veti neti tāvadāha -- kathaṃ punarbrahmaṇa iti|| nanu ākṣepaḥ kiṃnibandhanaḥ sūtraprāmāṇyādityāha -- yāvatā''mnāyasyeti|| nanu vedāntānāmānarthakyamucyate kiṃ vā kriyāparatvamiti na tāvatkriyāparatvam; ādimadhyāvasāneṣu tātparyeṇa brahmaikyaparyavasānāditi, tatrāha -- yadyapi pradarśitānīti|| tathā'pi tatra na sambhavati prāmāṇyamityarthaḥ| nanu yatra śabdasya śaktitātparye vidyete, tatra śabdaḥ pramāṇam, na viṣayaviśeṣāpekṣaṃ śabdasya prāmāṇyam; viṣayasya śābdapramitihetutvābhāvāditi, tatrāha -- tatra pariniṣṭhite vastunīti||abhūdasti bhaviṣyatītyavagamye vastuni, asādhyasvabhāve vā vastunītyarthaḥ| nanu pariniṣṭhito'pi raso na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate, nāpi jihvayā gandhaḥ, tadvatpariniṣṭhite brahmaṇi pramāṇāntarānadhigamyatayā śabdaikagamyatvaṃ kiṃ na syāt na; cakṣurādīnāmitaretaraviṣayavyabhicāravadāgamaṃ vyatiriktapramāṇānāṃ pariniṣṭhite vastuni vyabhicāradarśanād bhūtaṃ cetpramāṇāntaragamyameveti niścīyate| nanu tucchavyāvṛtte'pi vastuni pramāṇāntaragamyatāyā vyabhicārābhāvāt kāryamapi pramāṇāntaragamyaṃ kiṃ na syāt na; sādhyasvabhāvatayā pratyakṣānadhigamyatayā sambandhāgrahaṇāt, anumānādīnāmanavagamyatvāt tucchavyāvṛttaṃ pramāṇāntarayogyamiti ca grahaṇād varaṃ bhūtaṃ vastupramāṇāntarayogyamiti grahaṇam; prayojakasya nirupādhikatvalābhāt| nanu rūpādihīnatvād brahmāpi pramāṇāntarānadhigamyameva, tathā'pi pariniṣṭhitavastitvāt pramāṇāntarayogyatvāśaṅkā na vyāvartate| asti ca pramāṇāntaraṃ brahmasvarūpavijñānam; atastatsaṃvādādapramāṇaṃ vedāntāḥ|| nanu puruṣavacāṃsi pramāṇāntarasāpekṣatvāt tatsaṃvādavisaṃvādābhyāṃ prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyaṃ vā'śnuvāte, vedavacasāṃ tu puruṣasambandhābhāvāt pramāṇāntarānadhigamyaviṣayatayā cakṣurādivadanapekṣameva prāmāṇyamiti codayati -- nanvapauruṣeyatvāditi|| pariharati -- satyaṃ tathāpīti|| ayamarthaḥ -- anapekṣapramāṇayorapi cakṣuḥsparśanayorarthe visaṃvādādanyatarasyāprāmāṇyavat, brahmaikatvaśruteḥ "ahaṃ manuṣyaḥ" iti pratyakṣasya ca parasparavyāghātāt śabdasyāprāmāṇyamiti| kiṃcāptaḥ khalu loke pramāṇāntareṇārthamavagamya parasmai śabdaṃ prayuñjānaḥ śrotuḥ sākṣādvā paramparayā vā prayojanaparyantamarthaṃ vivakṣitvā prayuṅkte; prayojanānabhisandhāne tātparyādarśanāt| tacca prayojanaṃ sādhyasvabhāvam, iti pariniṣṭhitaṃ vastu svayaṃ na prayojanam, nāpi kriyāmanapekṣya prayojanasādhanam, iti na tatra tātparyahīnaḥ śabdaḥ prāmāṇyamaśnuta ityāha -- kiṃñca puruṣārthaśūnyatvādityādinā|| "tato na kvicidi"tyupasaṃharati| kiṃñca vidhāyakapadavyatiriktānāṃ padānāṃ sambhūya pramāṇāntarānadhigatavastupratipādanaṃ na sambhavati; pramāṇāntarānadhigataviṣaye sambandhagrahaṇāt, yathāsambandhagrahaṇamarthapratipādanāt, kāryasya tu pramāṇāntarānavaseyatayā tatsaṃsṛṣṭapadārthānāmatadgocaratvād yuktā śabdebhyaḥ pūrvārthapramitiriti darśayati -- kiñca pratyakṣādyaviṣaya ityādinā|| yasmāt sūtrakāravacanād bhūtavastupratipādanāyogāt prayojanaśūnyatvād anadhigatārthatā'bhāvācca na brahmaṇi vedāntāḥ pramāṇam, tasmādanarthakā vedāntā ityupasaṃharati -- tasmāditi|| yatpunarbhāṣyakāreṇetyāderayamarthaḥ -- na tāvad vedāntāḥ kasyacitkarmaviśeṣasya prakaraṇe samadhigatāḥ, yena "so'rodīdi"tyādivad vidhisamanvayaḥ syāt| nanu sarvakarmavidhāyivedaikadeśatvāt sarvakarmaprakaraṇaṃ syāt, na; sarveṇa vedavākyenaikasya vastunaḥ pratipādanābhāvādekavākyatā'yogāt, dharmasāmānyasyāpratipādyatvāt| astu tarhi parṇamayīvākyavat kartṛdvāreṇa sarvakratuśeṣabhūto'rthavāda iti, naitadyuktam; stutau pratipādane copayogo nāsti; viparītaṃ ca| na hi karmaṇāṃ kartā nityaśuddhabuddhamuktasvabhāvo nirguṇo niṣkriyo'naśnannanyo'bhicākaśītiti stavaḥ, pratipādanaṃ vā karmasu pravṛttāvupakaroti; viparītaṃ ca syāt| tasmānna karmasu vedāntānāṃ samanvayaḥ, kiṃtu svaprakaraṇagatasaguṇopāsanāsu sambandha iti bhāṣyārthamanūdyākṣipati -- tadayuktamiti|| tathā'pi viśiṣṭabrahmasvarūpāsiddhirityarthaḥ| na khalūpāsanāśeṣatayā brahmasvarūpasiddhirbhāṣye'bhipretā, kintūpāsye guṇaprakṣepadvāreṇa vedāntānāṃ samanvayo vivakṣita iti pariharati -- satyamanumāneneti|| nanuvedāntavākyānāṃ saguṇopāsanaprakaraṇādapi vyutthitānāṃ svarūpamātraparyavasitānāṃ nopāsanāsambandhaḥ, nāpi svātmanyupāsanā kalpayituṃ śakyate; aśrutatvāditi, tatrāha -- evaṃ cādhyayanavidhīti|| phalaṃ ceti|| rātrisatrāṇāmiveti śeṣaḥ|| sūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe -- tad brahma sarvajñatvādītyādinā|| tatra tātparyeṇeti|| ayamarthaḥ -- tātparya nāma tadarthapramitiśeṣatā śabdadharmaḥ| katham vivakṣātātparyamiti cet, arthapramitiṃ vivakṣitvā tādarthyena prayujyamānatvaṃ śabdadharma eva| tatrāpi tātparyaṃ na vivakṣāmātram| tacca tātparyaṃ yasminnarthe vākyasyopakramopasaṃhāraikarūpyam, yasya cārthasya punaḥpunarabhyāsaḥ, yasminnarthe phalaviśeṣasaṅkīrtanam, apūrvārthaprameyatā ca, yatna cārthavādopādānamupapattibhirupapādanaṃ cetyādīni liṅgāni bhavanti, tasya vākyasya tasminnarthe tātparyamiti gamyate| naca prameyasya sādhyataiva tātparyaliṅgam; "putraste jātaḥ" ityādiṣu tātparyadarśanāt, sādhyasya ca prameyatve tātparyasiddhiḥ, tātparye siddhe sādhyasya prameyatetītaretarāśrayāt| sādhye'rthe pramite pratibandhanirāsitayā paścāttātparyamavagamyata iti cet, tathā'pi sādhyatā na tātparyaliṅgam; "jartilayavāgvā vā juhuyādi"tyādiṣvadarśanāt| tasmāduktāni tātparyaliṅgāni vedāntānāṃ brahmaṇi dṛśyante| tathāhi -- "sadeva saumyedamagra āsīdekamevādvitīyam" "aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tattvamasī"tyupakramopasaṃhārayoraikarūpyeṇa pratyāgātmādvitīyarūpaṃ brahmāvagamyate| tathā "aitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tattvamasī"ti navakṛtvo'bhyasyate| pramāṇāntareṇa cānadhigatamadvitīyaṃ brahmātmatvaṃ pratipādyate| "ācāryavān puruṣo veda tasya tāvadeva ciraṃ yāvanna vimokṣye" iti ca niratiśayapuruṣārthāvāptirbrahmavijñānaphalamavagamyate| "anena jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya" "yenāśrutaṃ śrutami"tyādibrahmaṇyarthavādaścopādīyate| mṛllohataptaparaśugrahaṇādidṛṣṭāntaiḥ svapitināmanirvacanena ca sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāraiśca brahmātmaikatvaṃ pratipādyata iti|| tathā taittirīyake -- "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma" "sa yaścāyaṃ puruṣe yaścāsāvāditye sa ekaḥ" ityupakramopasaṃhārayoḥ pratyagadvitīyaṃ brahmāvagamyate| tathā "sacca tyaccābhavad yadidaṃ kiṃca tadātmānaṃ svayamakuruta yato vāco nivartante" iti ca pratyagadvitīyaṃ brahmābhyasyate| pramāṇāntareṇānadhigataṃ ca pratipādyate| "sa sarvān kāmān samaśnute" ityādi ca phalaṃ brahmavijñāne'vagamyate| sṛṣṭiśrutayaścādvitīyabrahmapratipattyarthavādabhūtā dṛśyante| tathā kośapañcakopanyāsena prāṇanādivyāpāraliṅaiśca brahmātmaikatvaṃ pratipādyata iti| evaṃ sarveṣu vedānteṣu brahmātmaikatvapramito tātparyaliṅgāni draṣṭavyāmi| evaṃ tātparyeṇa samanvayād brahmaiva vedāntaprameyamiti|| samyaganvaya ityādinā sūtrabhāgaṃ vyācaṣṭe| padānāmanvaya iti sambandhaḥ| tatra kriyākārakasaṃsargaviṣayatayā padānāmanvayaṃ vyāvartayati -- parasparānavacchinnārthānāmiti|| tatrodbhidādiśabdasya yajatisāmānādhikaraṇyenodbhidyāgamātravartinorudbhidyāgaśabdayoranavacchinnārthatve'pi niyogākāṅkṣā vidyate, tathehāpi syāditi, netyāha -- ananyākāṅkṣāṇāmiti|| evaṃ śabdānāṃ kriyāvākyebhyo vailakṣaṇyamuktvā'rthavailakṣaṇyaṃ darśayituṃ tatra kriyākārakasaṃsargebhyo vailakṣaṇyamāha -- avyatirikteti|| nanu nīlotpalavad bhedābhedaviṣayatayā'pyabhidheyāvyatireka iti, netyāha -- ekaraseti|| tatrodbhidyāgaśabdayoryāgaviśeṣaikarasārthavartinorapyarthasya niyogākāṅkṣāvadihāpyanyākāṅkṣeti, netyāha -- prātipadikārtheti|| tatrāpi liṅgasaṃkhyayoravaśyābhyupagamanīyateti, netyāha -- mātrānvaya iti|| jagatkāraṇasāmānyānuvādena tatra jñānānandaśabdāvānandaviśeṣaṃ gamayataḥ| ekasatyānantaśabdā bhedamithyātvadvaitābhāvābhidhānadvāreṇa tatra lakṣaṇayā vartante| "sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktiri"tyādiśabdāścānirvacanīyaprapañcopādhitayā tatra vartante| "ayamātmā tattvamasī"tyādiśabdāśca mukhyalakṣaṇābhyāṃ brahmaṇyeva vartanta iti|| sarve jagatkāraṇaviṣayāḥ śabdā mukhyalakṣaṇopādhibhirekarasameva brahma pratipādayanti| nacānirvacanīyabhedābhāvayoḥ śabdapravṛttanimittayoḥ paramārthasatyaikarasabhedanimittateti|| anekeṣāṃ padānāṃ lakṣaṇādidvāreṇaikarasavṛttitāyāmudāharaṇamāha| tatra dvividhā vākyapravṛttiḥ -- ekā brahmātmanorekatvaviṣayā, aparā satyajñānādilakṣaṇabrahmaviṣayā| tatra prathamaṃ brahmātmaikatve dṛṣṭāntamāha -- so'yamityādivākyasthapadānāmiveti|| tatra "so'yaṃ devadattaḥ" iti padatrayasyaikasmindevadatte paryavasānaṃ dṛśyate|| tathāhi -- pratyabhijñāyāmadhigatamekatvaṃ parasmai pratipādayati -- "so'yaṃ devadattaḥ" iti| tatra na taddeśakālayoretaddeśakālayāṃśca parasparaikyaṃ pratyabhijānāti; bhedapratyayāt| ata eva viśiṣṭayorapyaikyaṃ na pratyabhijñāyate, kintu so'yamiti viśiṣṭadvayopalakṣitaḥ pratyabhijñāgocaraḥ| pratyabhijñātaṃ cārthaṃ parasmai "so'yami"ti viśiṣṭābhidhāyibhyāṃ padābhyāṃ svārthaikadeśaparityāgenaikadeśalakṣaṇayā devadattasvarūpaikyameva pratipādayati| nanu "so'yami"ti padārthayoryadaikyam, tadeva vākyenāpi pratipādyate cet, anuvādaprasaṅgaḥ| naca devadattasyaikyadvayamasti, yena vākyaprameyamaparamaikyaṃ syāt, pratyabhijñāyāṃ tarhi katham na hyabhijñayoravagatadevadattaikyamasti| ekasya kāladvayasaṃbandhaḥ pratyabhijñāgocara iti cet, kāladvayasaṃbandhipadārthābhijñayoreva siddheḥ pariśeṣāttadaikyaṃ pratyabhijñāviṣayaḥ| tatra cānuvādo darśitaḥ|| syādetat -- kṣaṇikatvaparihārāya tatpratyabhijñāprāmāṇyaṃ tāvad vaktavyam| tatra kāladvayaparāmarśena tatsaṃbandhipadārthaikye pratyabhijñāviṣaye'pi padārthabhedapratibhāsavirodhitaiva pramāṇaphalam, nājñātārthādhigatiḥ| tatra kāladvayaparāmarśena tatsaṃbandhipadārthaikyamevāvalambamānā padārthabhedapratibhāsavirodhitayā prāmāṇyamaśnute pratyabhijñā| evaṃ tarhi "so'yami"ti vākyasyāpyevameva prāmāṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati|| tathā tattvamasivākyasyāpi tvaṃpadārthaikadeśaparityāgena tvaṃpadena lakṣyamāṇadraṣṭusvarūpasya pārokṣyaparityāgena tatpadābhidheyabrahmasvarūpaikye vākyajanyajñānagocare'pi jīvabrahmapadārthapratītisamaye pratipannaikyaviṣayatayā'nuvādaprāptāvapi bhedapratibhāsavirodhitayā prāmāṇyamupapadyata iti|| nanu padārthayoḥ pratyekamasādhāraṇamaikyaṃ padārthapratyayagocaraḥ, padārthayoritaretaraikyaṃ vākyagamyam, ityastyeva prameyabhedaḥ, naitat sāram; bhinnadravyayoraikyapratipādane tathā syāt| yadaikameva dravyaṃ bhinnopādhiparikalpitabhedapratibhāsavyudāsena pratipādyate, tadā nivartyaviśeṣādeva prāmāṇyam, na prameyaviśeṣāt| taduktam -- "siddhaṃ tu nivartakatvādi"ti| iha tu kāryakāraṇadravyavyatiriktatve sati dravyābhidhāyipadayoḥ sāmānadhikaraṇyaṃ "so'yami"tivadekasya dravyasyopādhiparikalpitabhedavyudāsenaikadravyaparyavasāyītyavagamyate| nanu tattvaṃpadābhyāṃ lakṣyamāṇapadārthayorapi bhedo vidyate na vā vidyate cet, aikyapramitirna syāt| na ced bhedaḥ, vākyārtha eva padārthaḥ syāt, satyam; vākyārtha eva padārthaḥ| sa ca lakṣaṇayā pratipādyate; mukhyābhidheyaikyāyogāt| tasmāt tattvaṃpadābhyāmekameva brahmopādhiparāmarśena pratipādyata iti siddham|| atra kecidāhuḥ -- lakṣyamāṇayorapi jīvabrahmaṇorbhedābhedaviṣayaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyam; anyathā padārthavākyārthayoḥ sāṅkaryāt| asti jīvabrahmaṇorbhedo'pi; "ya ātmani tiṣṭhanni"tyādiliṅgāt, naitadyuktam; bhedābhedaviṣayeṇa vākyajanyajñānena tadabhyāsajanyāparokṣajñānena vā sa bhedo nivartyate vā na veti nivartyate cet, kathaṃ vijñānasya svaviṣayanirāsitā tṛtīyajñānenābhedamātraviṣayeṇa bhedo nivartayata iti cet, na; yathāpramāṇamabhyāsajanyasyāpi jñānasya bhedābhedaviṣayatvāt, anyathāpramāṇe'nyathābhyāsajanyajñāne ca bhedābhedapramāṇavaikalyāt| jñānanivartyena bhedasyāpi vidyāvanmithyātvamapi syāt| jñānenājñānaṃ nivartyate, bhedastu karmabhirvinaśyatīti cet, na; "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavatī"ti jñānaprayuktatvādevakārābhidheyabhedanirāsasya| yenaiva cākāreṇa jīvasya bhedaḥ, tenaiva cedabhedo'pi, bhedanivṛttāvabhedo'pi nivarteta| ākārāntareṇa cedabhedaḥ, tadā niravayavadravyasyaikadeśo na karmaṇā nivartayituṃ śakyate, iti bhinnābhinna eva muktāvapi jīvaḥ syāt| naca bhedābhedau śāstreṇa pratipādanīyau; lokasiddhasāmānyato darśanenaiva siddheḥ| yadi ca bhedākāraviśiṣṭo jīvaḥ, tannāśena naśyet| atha bhedavinirmukto jīvaḥ, brahmasvarūpameva jīvaḥ, ityekadravyaniṣṭaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ syāt| atha viśiṣṭo jīvo viśeṣaṇanāśe'pi svarūpāvasthānānmucyata iti, tarhi yo muktimanubhavati, sa eva pūrvamapi jīvaḥ saṃsārī, ityekameva vastu sāmānādhikaraṇyālambanamityuktaṃ syāt| tasmādabhidheyaparāmarśenaikasmin vastuni lakṣaṇayā vṛttiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti| yo'pi lakṣyamāṇajīvabrahmaṇoratirekanimittaṃ padārthāpaunaruktyaṃ kalpayati, tasyātireko bhedavannirākartavyaḥ, "ekadhaivānudraṣṭavyaṃ neha nāne"ti śruteḥ| tasmādekasya dravyasyopādhijanitabhedāvabhāsaparāmarśenaikadravyaparyavasāyi sāmānādhikaraṇyamityekarasaṃ brahmeti siddham|| idanīṃ satyajñānādivākyasyodāharaṇamāha -- prakṛṣṭaprakāśaśabdayoriveti|| tayorekārthaniṣṭhatāmeva darśayati -- tathāca vyaktiviśeṣa iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- prakāśaśabdaḥ sāmānyābhidhānamukhena vyaktiviśeṣe vartate| prakṛṣṭaśabdaśca lakṣaṇayā prakarṣaguṇābhidhānamukhena prakāśaviśeṣe vartate| tatra guṇasāmānyayoścandrapadābhidheyatvābhāvājjahallakṣaṇayā tadubhayaṃ vyudasya tatsamavāyiprakāśaviśeṣa eva candrapadābhidheyatayā samarpyate, iti prakṛṣṭaprakāśacandraśabdānāmekārthavṛttitā siddhā| nanu guṇaguṇyanvayaḥ kriyākārakānvayo vā kiṃ na syāditi tatrāha -- evaṃ ca sati nīlotpalavaditi|| "ekamevādvitīyamekadhaivānudraṣṭavyaṃ neha nānā'sti kiñcana" "udaramantaraṃ kurute atha tasya bhayaṃ bhavatī"tyādipratiṣedhādityarthaḥ| "tathāvidhānyudāharatī"tyārabhya "yatpunari"tyataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| "yatpunaḥ siddhe vastunī"tyuktārthamanuvadati| pariharati -- tadrūpādyasaṃbhavāditi|| ayamāśayaḥ -- kiṃ pramāṇāntarayogyatve sati tadanutpattau viṣayasyābhāve niścite tatra śabdasya mithyātvamāśaṅkyate kiṃ vā pramāṇāntarasaṃbhinnārthaviṣayatvātpauruṣeyavacovatsāpekṣaṃ prāmāṇyamiti kiṃ vā pramāṇāntarayogyārthaviṣayatvāt tatsiddhārthānuvādāśaṅketi tatra na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ; pramāṇena hi pramīyamāṇasyārthasya pramāṇāntarānutpādau mithyātvaṃ nāvahati; sarvapramāṇānāmanadhigatārthagantṛtvāt, anyathā cakṣuṣā gṛhyamāṇasya rūpasya dravyasya vā sparśenāgrahaṇānmithyātvaśaṅkā syāt| kathaṃcitsāpekṣapramāṇasya puruṣavacasaḥ pramāṇāntarābhāve mithyātvāśaṅkā syāt, na tvapauruṣeyasya vedavacasaḥ; anapekṣatvāt|| nāpi dvitīyaḥ kalpaḥ; pramāṇāntarasaṃbhinnārthatā'bhāvāt| bhūtārthaviṣayatvena nadītīraphalasattāvākyavat pramāṇāntarasaṃbhinnārthateti cet, na; pauruṣeyavacanaprayuktatvāt sambhedasya| bhūtārthatvaprayuktatve pratyakṣādīnāmapi saṃbhedaḥ syāt| nanu bhūtārthasmṛtau saṃbhedo dṛśyata iti cet, tarhi svārthapravṛttajñānāntarajanyatā saṃbhedahetuḥ; kāryabhūtārthaniṣṭhayorlaukikavacasostathā darśanāt| puruṣo hi pramāṇāntareṇārthamupalabhya tannimittaṃ parasmai śabdaṃ viracayati, natu vedavacasaḥ pramāṇāntarajanyatā, ityanapekṣā| kiñca tucchavyāvṛttamātraṃ pramāṇāntarayogyam, iti vidhivākyānāmapi saṃbhinnārthatayā sāpekṣatā syāt; laukikavidhīnāṃ pramāṇāntarayogyatādarśanāt, ayogyatve vā tatra saṃbandhāgrahaṇāt vede'pyarthapratipattirna syāt| nanu kāryasya sādhyasvabhāvatvānna pramāṇāntaragamyateti, brahmāpi tarhi rūpādihīnatvānna pramāṇāntareṇa gamyate| svarūpajñānameva pramāṇāntaramasti, atastatsaṃbhinnatayā sāpekṣateti cet, na; śabdajanyaviṣayasthacaitanyatayā pramāṇaphalarūpatvāt, caitanyajñānasaṃbhinne vā brahmaṇi śabdasyānapekṣaprāmāṇyasiddhiḥ| puruṣāntaratatsaṃvedanaviṣayaṃ puruṣāntarānumānaṃ svayaṃprakāśaviṣayamapi saṃbhinnārthatayā na sāpekṣamiti| tasmādanapekṣamapauruṣeyaṃ vacaḥ|| nāpi tṛtīyaḥ kalpaḥ; sparśajñānayogyadravyaviṣayasya cakṣuṣo'nuvādakatvādarśanāt| śabdaviṣayo'yaṃ niyama iti cet, vidhivākyasyāpi syāt; tasyāpi laukikasya mānāntarayogyatvāt, śabdāvagatasya vā pramāṇāntaramanuvādaḥ kiṃ na syāt tasmād bhūtārthaniṣṭhamapi vaidikaṃ vaco'napekṣaṃ pramāṇamiti| tatra codayati -- nanvindriyāgocaratvāditi|| atra pṛcchāmaḥ -- kiṃ pramāṇāntaragṛhīto'rthe saṃbandhagrahaṇamātramucyate kiṃ vā pramāṇāntaramapi śabdārtha iti pūrvastvaṅgīkṛta ityāha -- yadyapi śabdamātrasyeti|| nāpi dvitīyaḥ kalpaḥ; ityāha -- vyutpattā tu kathamiti|| nanu pramāṇāntaragṛhīte'rthe prayogapratyayadarśanāt tatsaṃbhinnārthajñāne śabdasāmarthyaṃ gṛhyata iti, netyāha -- śrotṛvyavahāro hi mūlamiti|| ayamarthaḥ -- śabdādarthaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ śrotā kiṃ svakīyapramāṇasaṃbhinnaṃ pratipadyate kiṃ vā vyutpattuḥ pramāṇasaṃbhinnam āhosvidvaktuḥ pramāṇasaṃbhinnamiti na tāvatpūrvo pakṣau; śabdādarthapratipatteḥ prāgubhayorapi tasminnarthe pramāṇānutpādāt| pramāṇāntareṇopalabhya tatra śabdaprayogād vaktuḥ pramāṇasaṃbhinne'rthe śrotuḥ śābdapramitiriti, vyutpattā'pi tatraiva śabdasāmarthyaṃ śrotuḥ pravṛttyā pratipadyata iti cet, tatrāha -- sa ca śroturjñānāntarānimittatāpariśuddha iti|| ayamarthaḥ -- vyutpattā tu pratyakṣādivyavahāre pravartitavyārthamātrajñānāt pravartamānamātmānaṃ paśyati; na pramāṇāntarasaṃbhinnārthajñānāt| tataśca svenaiva dṛṣṭāntena śrotuḥ pravṛttiliṅgādarthamātrajñānamanuminīte| na vaktuḥ pramāṇasya viṣayaviśeṣaṇatayā'vagamyatvena pravṛttihetutāṃ kalpayati; dṛṣṭāntābhāvāt| ataḥ pramāṇāntarasya viṣayaviśeṣaṇatvenānavagamyamānatayā pravṛttiṃ pratyanimittatayā pariśuddhaḥ śroturvyavahāraḥ, kevalārthajñānajanya ityarthaḥ| tataḥ śabdasyārthamātrajñāne sāmarthyapratipatterna pramāṇāntarasaṃbhinnaḥ śabdārtha ityāha -- ato na pratipatturjñānāntarasiddhārthāvabodhakatvamiti|| nanu mā bhūcchrotuḥ pramāṇāntarasaṃbhinno'rthaḥ pratipannaḥ, tathā'pi vyutpattā saṃbhinne'rthe śabdasāmarthyaṃ pratipadyata iti, netyāha -- tenānavagamyaiva tadviṣayamiti|| pravṛttihetujñānaviṣayatayā svātmānumānenānavagatasya mānāntarasya ca śabdasāmarthyaviṣayatā pratipattuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ| nanu arthamātre sambandhagrahaṇe'pi vyutpattyuttarakālaṃ saṃbhinno'rtho bodhyata iti, netyāha -- yathāvagamaṃ ceti|| nanu kāryaviṣayād vākyādasaṃbhinne'rthe yuktaḥ sambandhagrahaḥ, kāryapadavyatiriktasya tu śabdamātrasya saṃbhinne'rthe sambandhagraha iti, na; teṣāmapi kāryavākye'rthamātrasambandhagrahaṇāt| atra kecidāhuḥ -- arthāsaṃsparśī śabda iti| tathāhi -- "aṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamāste" ityādau na kaścidarthaḥ pramīyate| yatra na pramīyate, tatrāpi mānāntaranibandhanā pramitirna śabdanibandhaneti|| atra kecitparihāramācakṣate -- puruṣavacasāṃ tu nārthasaṃsargaḥ prameyaḥ, kintvevamayaṃ vedeti vaktṛjñānameva pramīyate, pramīyamāṇavaktṛjñānasāmarthyāccārtho niścīyate| sarvatra cāṅgulyādivākyeṣu bhrāntimutprekṣāṃ pramāṇaṃ vā vaktṛjñānaṃ śabdaḥ prameyaṃ na vyabhicarati| tasmādarthasaṃsparśī śabda iti, tadayuktam; vaktṛjñānasyānumānagamyatvācchabdaprameyatvābhāvādityāha -- yadā punarvyutpannaḥ sanniti|| ayamarthaḥ -- gṛhītasambandho'pi san pramāṇāntareṇārthamupalabhya vivakṣitvā parasmai śabdaṃ prayuñjānamātmānaṃ paśyati| tena dṛṣṭāntena pūrvamapi madhyamavṛddhebhyaḥ prayoktāraḥ prayuñjānāḥ pramāṇāntareṇopalabhya vivakṣitvā prayuñjata ityanumimīte| nanvevamapi śābdasāmarthyaviṣayatayaiva pramāṇāntaramanumimīta iti, netyāha -- kevalamiti|| śabdaprayoganimittatāmeva vivakṣāmānāntarayoḥ svātmani paśyannanyatrāpi tathaivānumimīta ityarthaḥ| prakaraṇārthamanūdyopasaṃharati -- tasmānna śabdasyetyārabhya -- apicetyataḥ prāktanena granthena|| kiṃca yadi laukikavacāṃsi vaktṛjñānameva gamayanti, tadā saṃsṛṣṭārthapratipādanasāmarthyāpratipattervede śabdādarthādhigamo na syāt| kiñca na tāvadvaktṛjñānamātraṃ śabdārthaḥ; arthe vyavahārānudayaprasaṅgāt| nāpyarthavyāvṛttaṃ jñānam; arthasyaiva śabdaprameyatvaprasaṅgād jñānasyānumeyatayā'nyathāsiddhiḥ| jñānābhidhāyiśabdābhāvācca na tasya vākyārthatā; padārthasyaiva vākyārthatvāt| nanu padebhyaḥ padārthāḥ pratīyante, saṃsargaścotprekṣayā'vagamyate| tena ca vyāvṛttaṃ vaktṛjñānaṃ śabdārtha iti, tadidaṃ śrotuḥ saṃsargajñānaṃ vaktṛjñānaviśeṣaṇārthaviśiṣṭatayā prathamotpannaṃ smṛti saṃśayaviparyāsāyogātpramāṇajñānameva pariśiṣyate, śabdānāṃ ca padārthajñānopakṣayādvaktṛjñānādhīnaiva saṃsargapramitiriti vede saṃsargaḥ śabdārtho na syāt| tasmācchābdī saṃsargapramitiḥ, vaktṛjñānaṃ tvanumeyamiti siddham| kastarhi śabdānāmarthāsaṃsparśasya parihāra iti ucyate -- pratyakṣe'pi tulyametaccodyam; śuktirajatādijñānānāmarthavyabhicārāt| aduṣṭakāraṇajanyajñānānāmarthasaṃsparśa iti cet, śabde'pi yogyetarasaṃsṛṣṭābhidhāyinyarthaniyamo vidyate; aṅgulyagrādīnāṃ saṃsargāyogyatvāditi| kiñca apauruṣeyasya śabdasyānapekṣamāṇatvānmānāntarasaṃvādavisaṃvādābhyāṃ na kiñcitparihīyata ityāha -- apica apauruṣeyamiti|| nanu uktamiti spaṣṭārtham|| na tatsadhūktamiti parihāragranthasyāyamarthaḥ -- nirapekṣajñānayorapi parasparaviruddhayoranyatarasya kāraṇadoṣasaṃbhāvanayā bādho nirūpyate| tatrādvitīyapratyagātmapratipatterātmani dvaitapratyakṣasya ca virodhe dvaitāvabhāsasya dehātmapratyayavad duṣṭakāraṇajanyatvaṃ kalpyate; śabdasya svayaṃdoṣarahitatvāt, dvetāvabhāsahetūnāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ saṃbhāvitadoṣatvāt, "indro māyābhiḥ" "māyāṃ tu prakṛtim" "avidyāyāmantare" ityādidoṣajanyatvaśravaṇācca, svapnaddoṣajanyatve'pi vyavahāravisaṃvādāt prāmāṇyalābhāt, śabde tu punardoṣakalpanāyāṃ vyavahārātītaviṣayatvād doṣavattayā ca tattvātpracyuterubhayavidhamapi pramāṇyaṃ na syāt| naca dvaitāvabhāsasya doṣajanyatvācchuktirajatajñānavad vyavahāravisaṃvādaḥ kalpayituṃ śakyaḥ; pratyakṣavirodhāt, āgamena ca dvaitasya tattvāṃśabādhāt, vyavahārabādhābhāvāt, advitīyātmapratipatteśca śabdādīnāmarthakriyāsāmarthyalabhyatvāt| tasmādadvitīyātmapramitiraparokṣapratyayarūpā ca dehātmapratyayamiva dvaitāvabhāsaṃ bādhate; anyathā dehātmabhāvasyāpyabādhaprasaṅgāditi| nanu prameyagatadoṣādeva citranimnonnatādijñānavad brahmajñānamapi mithyeti, netyāha -- prameyasya punarna jñānahetutva ityādinā|| ataḥ ityupasaṃharati|| apica bhūtārthaniṣṭhatvātpramāṇāntaravirodha ucyate saṃvādo vā'pekṣyata iti virodhe'nyatarasya bādho darśitaḥ| saṃvādo'pekṣita iti cet, netyāha -- naca saṃvādalakṣaṇamiti ajñātārthāvagama eva pramāṇalakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| tataḥ kimāyātamiti tadāha -- ato yathaiva vidhivākyānāmiti|| nanu sūtravacanavirodha iti codayati -- nanu vidhivākyānāmeveti|| "netaretarāśrayatvādi"ti parihāraḥ| nanu sūtrakāraprāmāṇyādevāmnāyasya kriyārthatvaṃ siddhamiti, netyāha -- nahyekamapyanyata iti|| kastarhyāmnāyārtha iti tadāha -- ato yadavagamayatīti|| nanu prameyaviśeṣādeva prāmāṇyam, nāvabodhāt, na; kāryasyāpyavabodhanibandhanatvādityāha -- tasmādyathā kāryamiti|| na tarhi brahmaṇi śabdebhyaḥ pratītiriti, netyāha -- pratītiśceti|| nanu pravartanālakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyam, na bodhalakṣaṇamiti, netyāha -- pratyakṣādiṣvapīti|| nanu bhinnameva pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣādiṣu vastumātrāvabodhaprāmāṇyalakṣaṇam, pravṛttinivṛttī tu vastusvabhāvānurodhinyau na pramāṇaphalam, śabde tu punaḥ pravṛttinivṛttiphalaparyanta eva pramāṇavyāpāraḥ; śrotuḥ puruṣārthamuddiśya śabdaprayogāt| ataḥ pravṛttinivṛttiśūnye bhūte vastuni na śabdaprāmāṇyamityāha -- yuktamityādinā -- ucyata ityataḥ prāktanena granthena|| ucyate ityādiḥ parihāraḥ|| idaṃ nirūpaṇīyam -- puruṣaḥ khalviṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihāramātraṃ prārthayate kiṃ vā tayoḥ pravṛttinivṛttisādhyatāmapīti tatra pravṛttinivṛttisādhyeṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihāraprārthanākalpanāllaghīyasī hitāhitaprāptiparihāraprārthanākalpanetyāha -- puruṣo hyetāvadapekṣata iti|| nanu sarvo bādhyasvabhāvameva puruṣārthaṃ prārthayata iti, netyāha -- nattvitthamanyathā veti|| phalameva hi mukhyaṃ prārthayate, nāntarīyakā sādhanaprārthanetyarthaḥ|| nanu sādhyasādhyāvapi puruṣārthau sādhyāveṣa karotīti, netyāha -- na cāsya svayamīṣṭa iti|| nanu sarvaḥ sādhya eva puruṣārthaḥ, na tu siddhasvabhāvaḥ; prepsāgocaratvābhāvāditi, tatrāha -- dvividhaṃ ceṣṭamiti|| nanu dvividhe'pi puruṣārthasādhyasvabhāvatā na vyāvartata iti, netīti vibhajya darśayati -- tatra prāptaparihāryayoriti|| nanu jñānamātrasādhyaḥ puruṣārtho na labhyata iti, tatrāha -- itarayostu bhrāntimātravyavahitatvāditi|| nanu hastagatavismṛtasuvarṇasya tattvajñānātprāptimāropitasarpādibhāvasya tattvajñānānnivṛttiṃ puruṣārthatayā nānumanyate ; kriyāsādhyasyaiva puruṣārthatāprasiddheriti, netyāha -- evamapi labhyamānamiti|| sādhanasādhyajñānalabhyasyātiśayena puruṣārthatāmāha -- sutarāṃ cābhinandatīti|| nanu brahmātmaikatve pratipādyamāne na kriyāsdhāyaḥ puruṣārthaḥ, nāpi jñānalabhya iti, tatrāha -- anekānārthakaluṣitamiveti|| kiṃca śabdasya prāmāṇyaṃ pratyakṣādivatprameyamātrāvabodhanibandhanaṃ kiṃ na syāt naca pravṛttinivṛtti sākṣāt phalam; avagate vastuni prayojanādyanusmṛtinibandhanatvātpravṛttinivṛttyoḥ| naca te puruṣārthatayā'kāṅkṣite; sukhaduḥkhaprāptiparihāralakṣaṇatvāt prayojanasya| tataśca nityanaimittikavākyānāṃ prayojanaśūnyatayā prāmāṇyaṃ na syāt| akaraṇe pratyavāyaparihāraḥ prayojanamiti cet, na; pratyavāyasyāpi tannibandhanatvāt| tataśca nityavidhayo'nuṣṭhānānanuṣṭhānayoranarthameva prāpayantīti na tadvākyānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ yuktam| ato bodhalakṣaṇameva prāmāṇyam, na pavṛttilakṣaṇamiti| tasmātsiddhaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śāstrapramāṇatvamiti|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakānanyānubhavapūjyapādaśiṣyasvaprakāśānubhavabhagavataḥ kṛtau pañcapādikāvivaraṇe vedāntānāṃ brahmaṇi samanvayanirūpaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭakaṃ varṇakaṃ samāptam|| <9> atha navamaṃ varṇakam loke padānāṃ yogyetarasaṃsṛṣṭasvārthapratipādane sāmarthyamaṅgīkṛtya bhūte'pyarthe prāmāṇyopagamena laukikavacasāṃ bhūte'rthe pramāṇāntarānusāreṇa prayojanaparyantaṃ prāmāṇyamaṅgīkṛtya vedavacasāṃ tu pramāṇāntarābhāvādvidhyanusāreṇaiva prayojanaparyantaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ vaktavyamityāśaṅkya neti pratipāditam| idānīṃ kāryasaṃsṛṣṭasvārthe śabdasāmarthyamiti manvānāḥ kāryaśeṣatayaiva bhūte'pyarthe prāmāṇyamiti pratyavatiṣṭhanta ityāha -- atrāpare pratyavatiṣṭhanta iti| nanu laukikavacasāṃ bhūte'pyarthe prayogapratyayadarśanāt tadanusāreṇa ca yogyetarasaṃsṛṣṭe śabdasāmarthyapratipatteḥ kuto vidhisaṃsparśa ityākṣipati -- kasmādevamiti|| pariharati -- anyathā śabdaprayogānupapatteriti|| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- śrotuḥ sādhyameva kiṃcitprayojanamuddiśya pravṛttiṃ vivakṣitvā pravartakajñānāya prayoktā śabdaṃ prayuṅkte| tataḥ pravartakaniṣṭhaṃ vākyaṃ śrotuḥ pravartakajñānameva janayati| pravartakajñānena ca śabdasamanantarabhāvinā'nanyathāsiddhānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdasya saṃbandhaṃ vyutpattā pratipadyate| tacca pravartakaṃ pratyakṣādivyavahāreṣu śabdavyutpatteḥ prāk kāryamiti jñānātsarvatra pravartate, iti kāryameva śrotuḥ śābdajñānagocaraṃ kalpayati| tatra kāryasaṃsṛṣṭeṣu padārtheṣu padasamudāyasya prathamaṃ sāmarthyaṃ kalpayitvā punaḥ prayogāntareṣvāvāpodvāpābhyāmekaikasya padasya kāryasaṃsṛṣṭasvārtheṣu saṃbandhaṃ pratipadyate; prathamaprayoge kāryasaṃsṛṣṭapadārtheṣu sāmarthyapratipatteḥ| nanu bālasya svavyavahāre'bhilaṣitasādhanatājñānātpravṛttiḥ, na kāryajñānāt| tataśca śrotuḥ śabdasāmarthyaviṣayatayābhilaṣitasādhanajñānameva pravṛttyā'numimīte, na kāryajñānamiti, naitadyuktam; abhilaṣitasādhane'pi kāryamitijñānasya pravṛttyānantaryāttadeva pravartakamanumīyate| naceṣṭasādhanajñānaṃ pravartakam; atītānāgatavartamāneṣṭasādhanajñānānāmapravartakatvāt| tasmātkāryasaṃsṛṣṭasvārtheṣuśabdasāmarthyamiti| nanu sarvatra kāryavyabhicārābhāvesaṃsṛṣṭasvārtheṣu śabdasāmarthyamiti yuktaṃ pratipattum, kāryasaṃsṛṣṭasvārtha iti viśeṣaṇāyogāt, anyathā pramāṇāntaragṛhītakāryasaṃsṛṣṭasvārthaṃ ityavyabhicārātkalpyeta, naitat yuktam, saṃsṛṣṭasyārthaṃ ityukte kena saṃsṛṣṭaḥ ityapekṣāyāṃ kāryasaṃsṛṣṭa iti viśeṣapratipattimantareṇa prayojakasyānirūpaṇātpramāṇāntaragṛhītatvasya śabdasāmarthyapratipattikāle'pratipatterna tatra śabdasāmarthyamityuktam| nanu kāryasaṃsṛṣṭa ityukte kāryasya kāryāntarābhāvāt kāryapadasyānyasaṃsṛṣṭa iti prayojakabhedo vaktavyaḥ syāt, na; dhātvarthasyāpi kāryatvāttatsaṃsṛṣṭaniyoge kāryapadasāmarthyāt| nanu loke'tītānāgatavartamānārthaniṣṭhavākyebhyo'tītādyarthapratipattikāryadarśanāt tadanusāreṇa saṃsṛṣṭasvārthe sāmarthye niyamyata iti, na; sambandhagrahaṇādhīnatvādarthapratipattestayā sambandhagrahaṇaniyamāyogāt| atītādivākyānāṃ caivamavadhāryatāmiti niyoganiṣṭhatvāt| tasmānna kāryasaṃsparśamantareṇa bhūte'pyarthe śabdaprāmāṇyamiti| api ca pravṛttinivṛttisādhyaprayojanamantareṇa vākyaprayogānupapatteḥ prayojanasya niyogasāmarthyādhīnatvād niyogaparyavasitameva vākyamityāha -- puruṣecchāsamutthāpito hīti|| nanu nedaṃ kālāntarabhāvi naiyogikaṃ phalam, yena niyogādhīnā phalapratipattiḥ syāt, kintu samyagjñānaphalaṃ prāptabrahmaprāptilakṣaṇamavidyānivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ ca hastagatavismṛtasuvarṇaprāptivadanvayavyatirekasiddhamiti, netyāha naca vismṛtasuvarṇāropitasarparaśanāpratipattāviveti|| nanu anvayavyatirekaviruddhametat, yad brahmātmatattvajñānād brahmaprāptyanarthanivṛttī na sta iti, na; pratyakṣavirodhādityāha -- pūrvavatsaṃsāritvopalabdheriti|| api ca -- śabdajñānavyatirekeṇa brahmātmani jñānasādhanāntaravidhānāt prayatnāntarasādhyaṃ prayojanaṃ na jñānamātrasādhyamityāha -- pratītyuttarakālaṃ ceti|| nanu loke bhūtārthaniṣṭhatayā prayojanaparyantatā dṛśyate, tadvadihāpi syāditi, netyāha -- tasmātsantu nāma loka iti|| nanu dharmajijñāsā brahmajijñāseti ca jijñāsyayordharmabrahmaṇoḥ siddhasādhyabhedena vailakṣaṇyaṃ darśitam, naca brahmaṇi jijñāsākarmaṇi śabdapratipattividhyādayaḥ śāstreṇa pratipādyā iti yuktaṃ pratipattum, sūtravirodhāt, ityata āha -- tasmādyadyapīti|| tathā'pi pratipatyādividhiśeṣatayaiva brahma jijñāsyamityarthaḥ| kathaṃ punarbrahmapratipādanaparāṇāṃ vākyānāṃ brahmapratipattividhiśeṣatayā samanvaya iti tadāha -- so'nveṣṭavya ityādi -- yaḥ punastasmādityādiḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| tatra niyogamukhena brahmaṇo'vagatimicchato niyogabrahmaṇī na pramāṇena pramātuṃ śakyeti, ityetat prathamaṃ darśayati -- atrocyata iti|| tatra vidheyābhāvāttadvyāvṛtto vidhiḥ pramātuṃ na śakya ityāha -- kimidaṃ jñānamiti|| tatra tāvacchābdaṃ brahmaviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ vidhātuṃ na śakyata ityāha -- na tāvacchabdajanyamiti|| gṛhītapadapadārthasyādhīyamānādvākyādvidhivākyādiva vidhyarthe brahmaṇi vijñānamutpadyate, tadeva ca vicāreṇa pratiṣṭhāpyata iti| na cānyathāsiddhakāryamantareṇa niyoga upapadyate| śabdāvagate brahmaṇi tatsamānajātīyasmṛtisantāno, vidhīyatāmiti śaṅkate -- atha śabdajanyasyaiveti|| tatra smṛtisantānavidheḥ prayojanaṃ na tāvadadṛṣṭam; svargādivanmokṣasya karmajanyatvaprasaṅgāt, dṛṣṭaphalatve'pi na kiñcitphalaṃ nirūpyata ityāha -- na tasya prayojanaṃ paśyāna iti|| nanu mardanasukhavat pratyakṣaṃ sukhamityāha -- nanu iṣṭaviṣayasyeti|| tarhyanvayavyatirekasiddhasādhanatvānmardanādivat smṛtisantāno na vidheya ityāha -- yadyevamiti|| astu tarhi smaryamāṇasya sākṣātkaraṇaṃ smṛtisantānavidheḥ prayojanamiti śaṅkate -- atha punariti|| kiṃ
