sākṣātkaraṇaṃ smṛtisantānasyādṛṣṭaṃ prayojanam dṛṣṭaṃ vā bhavati nacādṛṣṭam; vastvāparokṣyasya cakṣurādipramāṇasāmagrīsādhyatvādadṛṣṭamātrājanyatvāt| adṛṣṭasahakṛtājjanmāntarīyapramāṇakāraṇājjanyata iti cet, tarhi janmāntare yathā śabdādipramāṇakāraṇaṃ vidhimantareṇa brahmāvagatiṃ janayiṣyati, tathehāpi syāt| atha dṛṣṭameva brahmasākṣātkaraṇaṃ prayojanamiti, na; anupalabdherityāha -- naitadyuktamiti|| anupalabdhivirodhameva darśayati -- nahi laiṅgiko'rtha iti|| śābdajñānasmṛtisantānānnāparokṣajñānamātramutpadyate, kiṃ tu tajjananasamarthaṃ vijñānāntaramutpadyate| tadvijñānaphalāya smṛtisantāno vidhīyata iti śaṅkate -- mā bhūcchābdajñānādeveti|| tadapyaparokṣaphalaṃ vijñānaṃ nādṛṣṭatayā vidhiphalam; pramāṇādhīnatvādavagamasya, nāpi dṛṣṭatayā; smṛtisantānasya pramāṇatvābhāvāt, nāpi tadvidhijñānaphalatve pramāṇamastītyāha -- netthambhāve pramāṇamastīti|| mā bhūt smṛtisantānavidhiḥ, śabdāvagate brahmaṇi dhyānaṃ vidhīyate| nanu ko viśeṣaḥ smṛtisantānād dhyānasya tatra smṛtisantāno nāma pramāṇāvagate vastuni tata eva pramāṇātsajātīyapratyayapravāho vastutattvaviṣayaḥ| dhyānaṃ nāma vastutattvamanapekṣyāropitaviṣayatayā'pi manaḥsaṃkalpapravāhaḥ, sa vidheya ityāha -- astu tarhi śabdāt pratipannasyeti| nanu tasyāpyadṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vā prayojanaṃ vaktavyam| na tāvadadṛṣṭam; naiyogikatvena svargādivadanityatvaprasaṅgāt, nāpi dṛṣṭaṃ dṛśyata ityākṣipati -- kimarthamiti|| nanu dhyeyasākṣātkaraṇāya tadapi nādṛṣṭaṃ phalam; pramāṇajanyatvādarthānubhavasya, dṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ cet; na; anupalabdhivirodhādityāha -- na tasya sambhava ityādi|| nanu dhyānābhyāsapracayasāmarthyādvinaṣṭaputrādyāparokṣyaṃ dṛśyata iti codayati -- nanu dṛṣṭamiti|| na hi vinaṣṭaputrādīnāmidānīmavidyamānatvāttadāparokṣyaṃ sambhavati, kiṃtu yatpurodeśe putrādyavabhāsate, tad bādhyamānatvādavidyātmakam, ato na vastvāparokṣyamiti pariharati -- maivam; na tad dhyāyamānamiti|| nanu brahmātmani dhyāyamāne dhyānaprakarṣād dhyeyāparokṣyaṃ tāvat putrādivatsidhyati, dhyeyasya ca vastutvaṃ śabdapramāṇātsidhyati, ato vastvāparokṣyaṃ dhyānātphaliṣyati, yathā svapne catuṣpathe hastijñānamutpannaṃ tathābhūtajāgaraṇasaṃvādena samyag jñānaṃ bhavatīti, naitatsāram; aparokṣajñānasya śabdapramāṇasāmarthyāttathābhūtajñānatvena saṃvādātprāmāṇyaṃ syāt| naca svapnajñānaṃ pramāṇam; avidyātmakatvāt, saṃvādastu sādṛśyabhramāditi| na hi cakṣurādipravṛttimantareṇa vastudarśanaṃ sambhavati|| nanu vidhyuddeśasāmarthyādeva dhyeyasākṣātkaraṇaṃ dhyānaphalaṃ gamyate, kimanvayavyatirekābhyāmityāha -- nanu draṣṭavya iti|| tatrāpi kiṃ naiyogikaṃ phalam āhosvid dṛṣṭamiti naiyogikatve svargādivadupacayāpacayātmako mokṣaḥ syāt, dṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ cet, tadāha -- uktametaditi|| vidheyasadbhāvamaṅgīkṛtya śabdānāṃ dhyānavidhiparatve brahmātmaikatvaṃ na sidhyatītyāha -- athāpi bhavatu dhyānāditi|| nanu śabdo brahmātmaikatvaṃ pratipādayatīti, netyāha -- śabdastāvaditi|| nanu jñānavidhivākyavyatiriktānāmavāntaravākyānāṃ brahmaṇi samanvayādvastusiddhirityāha -- satyaṃ tathā'pi tattvaṃ sidhyatīti|| pariharati -- viṣama upanyāsa iti|| tasmādvidhiparatve nāsti vastusiddhiriti| sarvavidhibhedeṣvatidiśati -- pūrvokteṣvapīti|| smṛtisantānadhyānayorniyogo nirākṛtaḥ, idānīṃ tṛtīyajñāne'parokṣaphale niyogamāśaṅkate -- yatpunaḥ kaiściducyata iti|| tatra vadāmaḥ -- vidhīyamānajñānasya pratyakṣānumānaśabdajanyatvābhāvāddarśapūrṇamāsavadalaukikakaraṇetikartavyatāviṣayavidānaiḥ saha darśanaṃ vidheyam, na tad dṛśyata ityāha -- tatpunaḥ kiṃsādhanamityādinā|| śaṅkate tametaṃ vedānuvacaneneti|| śravaṇamanananididhyāsanaiḥ karaṇairvedānuvacanayajñadānatapo'naśanaśamadamādyanugṛhītermokṣakāmo brahmaṇyaparokṣaphalaṃ jñānaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ| pariharati -- pramāṇāntarasya tarhi pramāṇamiti|| ayamarthaḥ| setikartavyaṃ sādhikāraṃ ca brahmaṇyaparokṣaphalaṃ vijñānaṃ pramāṇāntaram| tat kartavyatayā śabdaiḥ pramīyate cet, na brahmaṇi pramāṇaṃ śabdaḥ, kiṃtu brahmapramāṇe pramāṇam| tataśca kalpanālāghavād brahmaṇyeva prāmāṇyaṃ yuktamiti| nanu vidhiviṣayamantareṇa brahmamātre prāmāṇyaṃ na yuktamiti, netyāha -- kāryagamyamiti|| gṛhītasambandhasya vedāntavākyebhyo brahmaṇi niścitapramitikāryagamyaṃ vedāntaprāmāṇyam| tatra pramitijananād viṣayasya vidheyatvagamye prāmāṇye'gnihotravākyaṃ darśapūrṇamāsavidhiniṣṭaṃ kiṃ na syāt tatra śabdasāmarthyābhāvātpramityanudayāditi cet, ihāpi "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma" "tattvamasī"tyuktena vidhau sāmarthyapramitirvā gamyata iti brahmaṇyeva prāmāṇyaṃ yuktamiti| nanu laukikaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ kāryagamyameva, śāstrīyaṃ tu vidhigamyamiti, netyāha -- taduktamiti|| atra laukikānāṃ śabdānāṃ mukhyārthābhidhānamukhena vaidikārthapratipādanāsambhave kiṃ vede pṛthaksambandhaṃ gṛhṇīmaḥ, kiṃ vā vṛttyantaradvāreṇāpi laukikādeva sambandhādarthaṃ pratipādyāmaha iti viśaye laukikameva pratipattuṃ yuktam; alaukikakalpanādityāha -- guṇādvāpyabhidhānaṃ syāditi|| evaṃ laukikameva prāmāṇyaṃ yuktam; alaukikakalpanādityarthaḥ| tasmānna dṛṣṭaphalatayā niyogaparyavasitāni vedāntavākyāni|| nanu ko'yaṃ niyogo nāma nanu ācāryaniyoga ityādau prasiddhaḥ, satyam; tatrotkṛṣṭasya puruṣasyāvarapuruṣapreraṇātmako'bhiprāyabhedo niyogaḥ, nāsāvapauruṣeye vede bālasya pratyakṣādivyavahāre ca saṃbhavati| nanu kāryabuddhigamyaṃ vastu niyoga ityākhyāyate pravartakatvasāmānyāditi, kimidaṃ kāryaṃ nāma yadi kṛtiyogyatāmātram, na tataḥ pravṛttiḥ; prāgabhāvavatāṃ sarveṣāṃ kṛtiyogyatvāt| atha kṛtisaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kāryam, na; kṛtisaṃsargasyaiva nimittatvopagamātkāryabuddheḥ| atha kṛtiyogyamevālaukikaṃ kiñcidvastu kāryamiti, tarhyavyutpannasya ghaṭenodakāharaṇaṃ kartavyamityādipratyakṣavyavahāre kriyākārakavyatiriktamalaukikaṃ kiṃcitpratipannam na vā iti vaktavyam| pratipannaṃ cet, nālaukikaṃ kiñciditi| nidarśanīyaṃ ca śabdāntareṇedamitthamiti| nanu kāryamiti pratipadya pravartate| tataśca pravartakākāratā kāryasya kriyākārakaphalebhyo vailakṣaṇyamiti, na; dhātvarthasyaivābhilaṣitasādhanatayā pravartakatvāt tasyaiva ca kāryabuddhigocaratvāt| nanu anyat kāryamanyadabhilaṣitasādhanam, satyam; abhilaṣitasādhanameva kṛtiyogyatayā pravartakaṃ kāryamucyate| naca śreyaḥkṛtipratiyogibhedamātrādubhayabudhyālambanaṃ sādhanaṃ bhidyate| naca kṛtiyogyeṣṭasādhanavyatiriktaṃ kāryaṃ nāma pravṛttinimittaṃ paśyāmaḥ| nanu phalamapi kāryatayā pravṛttisamarthaṃ dṛśyate, na viśiṣṭapravṛttihetutvābhāvātphalakāryatvasya| abhilaṣitasādhanaṃ kāryameva sambandhagrahaṇaliṅgabhūtāyāḥ pravṛtterhetuḥ; phalasya tvicchāmātrahetutvāt| naca kāryaṃ nāmālaukikaṃ kiñcilloke dṛśyate| na tāvatpratyakṣeṇāvagantuṃ śakyam; asiddhasvabhāvatvāt| sambandhāgrahaṇānnānumānena| avyutpannatvānnāgamena| alaukikakāryamantareṇānupapattyabhāvānnārthāpattyā kāryamavagantuṃ śakyam| pravartakatvamanupapanna iti cet, na; kṛtiyogyādabhilaṣitasādhanādapi pravṛtteḥ| naca sādhanatvamapi kāryavatpramāṇaśūnyam; tatphalodayānvayavyatirekābhyāmavagamāt, ananubhūte'pi sāmānyatodarśanena sādhanatvasiddheḥ| nacātītādisādhaneṣu pravṛttiprasaṅgaḥ; kṛtiyogyeṣṭasādhana iti viśeṣaṇāt| tasmādavyutpannasya vyavahāre pramāṇāntareṇa yatpravartakatayā vartate, tadeva śroturapi śābdabuddhigocaratayā pravartakamanumīyata iti siddham| tatra brahmātmaikatvavijñāne vidhisambandho nāma phalasādhanasāmarthyam| tatrāvidyānivṛttivyatirekeṇa mokṣaphalasyābhāvāttasya cānvayavyatirekasiddhatvāttatvajñānasya mokṣasādhanatvamanvayavyatirekagamyaṃ na śabdaprameyamiti brahmaṇyeva pramāṇaṃ śabda iti siddham| idānīṃ jīvabrahmaṇorbhedamaṅgīkṛtya brahmaṇaśca pradeśāntaravartitvaṃ sarvagatatvaṃ cābhyupagamyāhaṃ brahmāsmītyāropitarūpeṇa vidhīyamānādupāsanād yāgādiva svargo mokṣaḥ phaliṣyatīti ye manyante, tannirāsāyottaraṃ bhāṣyamityāha -- athāpyatha yadataḥ paro divo jyotirityādinā|| nanu evamapyupāsanāvidhiparatve śabdasya brahmasvarūpāsiddhirityata āha -- devatāvigrahavatvanyāyeti|| naca pramāṇāntaravirodhaḥ; vikārasaṃsparśitvād, brahmaṇaḥ sadvitīyatvāt| nanu naiyogikaphalatve mokṣasya svargādivadanityateti, netyāha -- na ca sādhyatve'pīti|| nanu śrutiranityatvānumānaviruddhā kathamanāvṛttiṃ sādhayediti ata āha -- na hyeṣa iti| nanu anumānāgamayorviruddhāvyabhicāritvātsaṃśayahetutvamiti, tatrāha -- śabdagamyasyeti|| anumānādāgamo balavānityarthaḥ| asya parihāratvena bhāṣyamavatārayati -- na karmabrahmavidyāphalayorityādinā|| bhāṣyasya tātparyārthamāha -- asyāyamarthaḥ saṃkṣepata ityādinā|| nanu nāsti phalavailakṣaṇyam; mokṣasyāpyupāsanāsādhyatayā karmajanyatvāt, tataścopacayāpacayaśarīrendriyādimattā'pi syādityata āha -- śrutito nyāyataśceti|| "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavati" "vidyayā'mṛtamaśnute" "brahmasaṃstho'mṛtatvameti" "athāyamaśarīro'mṛtaḥ prāṇo brahmaive"tyādiśrutito brahmātmatā'śarīrāmṛtatvalakṣaṇo mokṣo darśitaḥ| nyāyataśca mokṣasya nityatvaṃ gamyate, punarāvṛttau punarbandhānmokṣaśabdasyopacaritārthatāprasaṅgāt abhyudayaniḥśreyasayośca bhedapratipatteḥ| anāditvamapi śrutiḥ -- nyāyābhyāmavagatam| "vimuktaśca vimucyate" "brahmaiva san brahmāpyetī"ti śruteḥ, sāditve cāntavattvaṃ syāditi nyāyāt| tataśca na kriyāsādhyo mokṣa iti| kriyāsādhyatve'bhyudayaphalavaccharīrendriyādisambandhakṣayiṣṇutopacayāpacayavattvaṃ ca mokṣasya syādityāha -- yadi sandhyopāsanavadityādinā|| nanu yathaivopacayāpacayavatkṣayiṣṇu śarīrendriyādibhogyaṃ ca karmaphalam, evaṃ tadviparītamaśarīrāmṛtabrahmalakṣaṇaṃ ca niḥśreyasaṃ karmaphalameva syāt, karmaṇāṃ paśvādivividhaphalahetutvadarśanāditi, ata āha -- na cāśarīratvameva dharmakāryamiti|| kimidaṃ svābhāvikamaśarīratvam kiṃ vā naimittikamiti śarīrātmanormithyājñānasambandhavyatiriktasya sarvaprakārasambandhasyātyantikābhāvaḥ svābhāvikamaśarīratvam, mithyājñānasambandhānnaimittikaṃ śarīritvamiti| tatra samyagjñānasādhyasya mithyājñānasambandhanivṛttilakṣaṇasyāśarīratvasya karmasādhyatvābhāvāt sambandhāntaranivṛttilakṣaṇasyāśarīratvasya svābhāvikatvānna dharmasādhyo mokṣa iti| nanu yadidamaśarīrāmṛtabrahmalakṣaṇaṃ phalam, tadanyathā karmabhiḥ pariṇamyata iti, netyāha -- tathāpi kathaṃcidityādinā|| nanu bhavatu svābhāvikāśarīrāmṛtadhruvalakṣaṇo mokṣaḥ sadaikarūpaḥ; tathā'pyupāsanāsantānād vidhīyamānādbhaviṣyati; jñānalakṣaṇatvādupāsanasyetyatrāha -- tatra yadi hastagatavismṛtasuvarṇavadityādinā|| nanu kimiti yāgaphalavadupāsanāsādhyatve mokṣasyopacayāpacayakṣayiṣṇutāśarīrasambandhaḥ syāt ucyate -- mokṣaphalāya vidhīyamānasyopāsanasya svarūpataḥ kālataḥ saṅkhyāto vā parimitirasti vā na vā iti vaktavyam| asti cet, sāṅgadarśapūrṇamāsaparimitivadetāvadidamityupāsanāparimitiḥ pradarśanīyā| naca tathā dṛśyate| nāpi saṅkhyātaḥ parimāṇamasti; sahasaṃ lakṣaṃ vā pratyayānāṃ mokṣasādhanamiti niyāmakādarśanāt| nāpi kālataḥ parimāṇamasti; ekaṃ śataṃ sahasraṃ vā saṃvatsarāṇāmupāsīnasya mokṣa iti niyame pramāṇābhāvāt| maraṇamevāvadhiriti cet, tathā'pi darśapūrṇamāsavadekākārasādhanaparimitirna labhyate; ekena daśabhiḥ śatena sahasreṇa vā kālena kasyacinmaraṇātpuruṣabhedeṣūpāsanopacayāpacayaprasaṅgāt| upāsyāparokṣyamavadhiriti cet, tathā'pi kasyacitkenacitkālenāparokṣātsādhanopacayāpacayau tadavasthau| ato nopāsanalakṣaṇamokṣasādhanaikarūpyaṃ labhyate| nacāropitāparokṣānubhava eva mokṣasādhanam; avihitatvānmithyājñānatvācca| atha mā bhūdaikarūpyam, deśakālasaṅkhyāparimāṇabhedādagnihotrābhyāsavatpuruṣabhedeṣu sādhanopacayāpacayātmatā bhaviṣyatīti, na tarhi sarveṣāmekarūpo mokṣaḥ syāt; kāṣṭhopacayād jvālopacayavadagnihotropacayāt svargopacayavaccopāsanopacayānmokṣopacayāpacayopapatteḥ| atha sādhanavaiṣamye'pi phalaikarūpyamucyeta, anuṣṭānavaiphalyaṃ syāt| atha upāsanā'pi vidhīyamānā niyāmakābhāvādupacayāpacayarūpiṇī, phalaṃ ca śāstrādekarakūpamiti; naitatsāram; upāsanāto'vidyātatsaṃskārakāmakarmasu kṣīyamāṇeṣu cittaikāgryādaparokṣasamyagjñānodayopapatteḥ, kṣīyamāṇakarmādivaiṣamyādaparokṣajñānopapatteśca| tasmāt svargādiphalavadupacayarūpiṇī muktiḥ syāt, iti vidhīyamānopāsanāsādhyatvāt sukhaduḥkhasyeva śarīrendriyādidṛṣṭasāmagrīsādhyatvaṃ sādhanakṣayātkṣayiṣṇutā ca syādityupasaṃharati -- ato na kartavyaśeṣatveneti|| nanu śrutyanumāne sāmānyāvalambinīṃ -- "tadyatheha karmacitaḥ" "yat kṛtakam, tadanityami"ti, apunarāvṛttiśrutistu mokṣaviṣayā balīyasītyuktārthamanuvadati -- yatpunarna ca punarāvartata iti|| tatra tāvadvidhiparatve vedāntānāṃ phalaśrutayo'rthavādāḥ; parṇamayītvādivat, nacārthavādairapunarāvṛttiḥ pramātuṃ śakyate; dravyaguṇasaṃskārakarmaphalaśrutivat| nanu nārthavādatvātphalaśrutayaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ jahati, kiṃtu vartamānāpadeśitvena yogyatānupalabdhivirodhāt, ihāpi tarhi "naca punarāvartate" ityaprāptapratiṣedhānnārthavādānāṃ naca prāmāṇyam| tathāhi -- "brahmalokamabhisaṃpadyate naca punarāvartate" ityabhisaṃpattisamaye punarāvṛttiraprāptā pratiṣidhyate| nanu punarāvartiṣyata iti bhāvinī punarāvṛttiḥ pratiṣidhyata iti vākyārthaḥ kalpyata iti cet, na śrutārthaparityāgenāśrutārthakalpanāyām -- yatkṛtakam, tadanityam, "tadyatheha karmacitaḥ" iti śrutyanumānavirodhāt| evamapunarāvṛttivākyāntareṣu yojayitavyam| tasmādarthavādamātrametat| sāmānyaśrutyanumānābhyāṃ sādhyasya mokṣasyānityatā darśitā, idānīmapunarāvṛttiviśeṣaṇasāmarthyādevāntamattāmāha -- kiṃca teṣāmiheti|| "imamihe"ti viśeṣaṇaṃ mānavāntare svataḥ prāptāmāvṛttiṃ darśayati| nanu asmin kalpe'nāvṛttiṃ pratipādayato vākyasya kalpāntare punarāvṛttipratipādane dvaiyarthyādvākyabhedaḥ syāditi, anabhijño'yaṃ sarvasaṅkaravādī devānāṃ priyaḥ, yataḥ sarveṣāṃ saviśeṣaṇavākyānāmidaṃ codyamavatarati| atha saviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyaṃ viśiṣṭamarthaṃ mukhataḥ pratipādayati, arthāttu viśeṣyāntaravyāvṛttiḥ pramīyata iti na vākyabhedaḥ, tarhi ihāpyetatkalpaviśeṣitā'nāvṛttirmukhataḥ pratipādyate, arthādapunarāvṛttirasya kalpāntare nivāryate, iti na vākyabhedaḥ| nanu kalpāntare'pi śrutisāmānyādiha na punarāvṛttiriti pratiṣedhastulyaḥ, satyam asmākaṃ tāvadasmin kalpe pratipannānāṃ kalpāntare punarāvṛttirviśeṣaṇasāmarthyātpramīyata idānīm, kalpāntarapratipattṛṇāmapi tasminnanāvṛttipramitiścet, syāt itthaṃ vyavasthā kalpyate; -- asmin kalpe pratipannānāṃ kalpāntare punarāvṛttiḥ, kalpāntare pratipannānāṃ tatrānāvṛttiriti; anyathā viśeṣaṇavaikalyāditi|| apica "abhyupetye"tyārabhya "tathā taddhaitadi"tyataḥ prāktanagranthasyāyamarthaḥ -- śabdādavagate brahmaṇi sukhasaṃvedanatvādabhyāsenāparokṣīkṛte vidhimantareṇa yatsākṣātkāraṇam, tad brahmavedanamityucyate| tasminnutpanne'nantaramevāvidyādidoṣanivṛtteryuktam brahmasaṃvedanena samānakālatvaṃ phalasya| yadā punarupāsanaivādhyāropitātmaviṣayā vidhīyamānā brahmasaṃvedanamucyate, tadā naiyogikaphalasya kālāntarabhāvitvānna yuktaḥ samānakālatā nirdeśaḥ| ataḥ śabdādapi viditasya brahmaṇaḥ svayamevāparokṣajñānāya pravṛtteḥ phalajananātprāk na kāryānupraveśa iti| "tathā taddhaitatpaśyanṛṣirvāmadevaḥ" ityādiḥ "kiñce"tyataḥ prāktano granthaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| api ca brahmavidyāphalamavidyānivṛttiṃ darśayati| sa cāparokṣādhyāsalakṣaṇatattvāparokṣajñānamantareṇa na nivartate| yadā punarupāsanaivāropitarūpā tattvajñānaṃ syāt, na tenāvidyā nivarteta| atastattvajñānameva pramāṇajanitamavidyānivartakam, ityavidyānivṛttiphalaśravaṇād brahmātmani vedāntāḥ pramāṇamityāha -- kiṃca tasmai mṛditakaṣāyāyetyādi|| nanu avidyānivṛttiriha na śrūyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ ; "tarati śokamātmavidi"ti śokataraṇanimittamātmajñānaṃ prakramya "tamasaḥ pāraṃ darśayatī"tyupasaṃharan yadi tamonivṛttimeva na bravīti, tadā śokādyadhyāsanivṛttyupakramo na syāt| ataḥ śokādyupādānānādyavidyānivṛttireva "tamasaḥ pāraṃ darśayatī"tyukteti gamyate| tathā "avidyāyāḥ paraṃ pāraṃ tārayasī"tyavidyātikrameṇa brahmaprāptiṃ bruvannatikramānupapatternivṛttimeva darśayatīti śrutyanusāreṇāvidyānivṛttiphalasiddhaye tattvajñānaniṣṭhaṃ vedāntapramāṇamityuktam|| idānīṃ tarkaśāstrānusāreṇāpi mithyājñānanivṛttiphalaṃ tattvajñānamiti darśayati -- itaścaitadevamiti|| ayamarthaḥ -- duḥkhajanmapravṛttidoṣamithyājñānānāmuttarottarāpāye tadanantarābhāvādapavarga iti| ātmaśarīrindriyārthabuddhimanaḥpravṛtidoṣapretyabhāvaphaladuḥkhāpavargeṣu dvādaśasupadārtheṣu yadidamanādipravṛttaṃ mithyājñānam, tasyātmaparamātmaśarīrendriyādidvādaśapadārthatattvadarśanavaimalyādapāye teṣu rāgadveṣamohā notpadyante| tataḥ pravartakābhāvātsukhaduḥkhaphale pravṛttinivṛttī nopajāyete| tataḥ pravṛtinivṛttidvāropacitaśubhāśubhavyāmiśrakarmaśūnyatayā brahmādisthāvarānteṣu yonibhedeṣu na jāyate; śarīrasambandhaṃ na pratipadyata ityarthaḥ| tataḥ śarīrābhāve sukhaduḥkhe notpadyete, iti mithyājñānāpāyameva mokṣaṃ darśayati| tathā vaiśeṣikerapi dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyeṣu sālakṣaṇyavailakṣaṇyābhyāṃ tattvāparijñānādanādipravṛttaṃ mithyājñānaṃ tattvaparibhāvanayā nivartyate; tataścottarābhāvādapavarga ityuktam| tathā sāṃkhyayogairapi darśitam -- draṣṭṛdṛśyāvivekalakṣaṇā'vidyā'nādipravṛttā tattvajñānena nivartyate| tataścāvidyā'smitārāgadveṣābhiniveśāḥ kleśāḥ prahīyante| tataḥ prakṣīṇakleśasya pravṛttyanudayādapavarga iti| sugatairapyuktam -- anusandhānakalpanayā rāgadveṣādidoṣaiḥ pravṛttitatphalodayaparyantairviṣayavibhramaiśca dūṣitāni vijñānāni| taiṣu ca tattvaparibhāvanayā nivṛtteṣu vibhrameṣu, viśuddhavijñānacaramakṣaṇodayo mokṣa iti| tadevamavidyānivṛttau mokṣe pramāṇajanitaṃ tattvajñānaṃ vihāya kathamupāstikriyā mokṣasādhanaṃ kalpyata iti nanu pradarśitamanyadeva mithyājñānanivartakaṃ tattvajñānam| tathāhi -- dvādaśapadārtheṣu tattvaparibhāvanājanitena samyagjñānenāvidyā nivartyate| pūrvopacitāni ca karmāṇi tattvaparibhāvanājanitasaṃkleśena tatprakarṣajanitenāndena vartamānasya copabhogena nivartyante| tataśca kaivalyamiti naiyāyikairuktam| vaiśeṣikairapi padārthaṣaṭkaparibhāvanājanitena tattvajñāneneśvarābhidhyānānugṛhītena mithyājñānaṃ nivartyate, tato rāgādayaḥ krameṇa parihīyante, tataśca pūrvopacitaduritānāṃ padārthaparibhāvanāparikleśaphalānāmatyantocchedaḥ, sukṛtānāṃ ca tattvadarśanavaimalyānandena nivṛttiḥ, tataḥ kaivalyamiti darśitam| yogāstu pratipedire -- asaṃprajñātasamādhijanitena prakṛtipuruṣavivekajñānena puruṣākāramātraparyavasitenāvidyā'smitā rāgadveṣābhiniveśeṣu kṣīyamāṇeṣu pūrvopacitakarmasu caikabhavikanyāyena kṣīyamāṇeṣvapavṛjyata iti| sugataiḥ pratipannamkṣaṇikasvalakṣaṇaduḥkhamārgāsatyabhāvanājanitaviśuddhajñānalakṣaṇacaramakṣaṇodayena hīyamāneṣu sthāyitvākāryasya pravṛttiviṣayavibhrameṣu santānocchedo mokṣa iti; tadevaṃ bhinnavijñānasādhyo mokṣa iti, tatrāha -- mithyājñānāpāyaśca brahmātmaikatvavijñānāditi|| nanu pradarśitatattvadarśineṣvapi mithyājñāne pratipakṣeṣu brahmavijñānameva kimiti nivartaka gṛhyate iti codayati -- kathaṃ gamyata iti || bhedadarśanasyā mithyājñānavilasitatvena tatpratipakṣeṇādvitīyabrahmātmadarśanenaiva tannivṛttiḥ, na yathoktabhedadarśanairiti pariharati -- indro māyābhirityādinā|| nanu advitīyabrahmātmaikatvaparaṃ na śāstram; tatra tātparyābhāvāt, kintu jīvavilakṣaṇe pramāṇāntarāviruddhe brahmaṇi śāstrapratipanne saṃpadādiviṣayāṇi tādātmyavākyānīti pūrvapakṣayati -- athāpi syādityārabhyātrottaramityataḥ prāktanena granthena| granthastu spaṣṭārthaḥ| tatredaṃ vaktavyam -- kiṃ pramāṇāntaravirodhātsaṃpadādiparaḥ padasamanvayaḥ kiṃ vā'rthe tātparyābhāvāditi na tāvatpramāṇāntaravirodhaḥ; tayostadagocaratvāt| bhedāvabhāse'pi bimbapratibimbanyāyāvatārāt| naca tātparyābhāvādarthaparatvābhāva ityāha -- saṃpadādirūpe hītyādinā|| tathāhi -- "tattvamasī"ti navakṛtvo'bhyastasya "anena jīvenātmanānupraviśye"tyekātmyasiddhaye'rthavādau gṛhyate| "atha ye'nyathā'to viduranyarājānaste kṣayalokā bhavantī"ti bhedadarśanaṃ nindyate| tathā -- "ahaṃ brahmāsmī"tyasya "sa eṣa iha praviṣṭaḥ" ityādyarthavādaḥ| "atha yo'nyāṃ devatāmupāste'nyo'sāvanyo'hami"tyādibhedapratiṣedhaśca tātparyaheturupādīyate| tathā -- "eṣa ta ātme"ti bahukṛtvo'bhyastasya "nānyo'to'sti draṣṭe"tyādibhedāpavādena tātparyaṃ jñāyate| tathā "sa yaścāyaṃ puruṣe yaścāsāvāditye sa ekaḥ" ityasya tat sṛṣṭvā tadevānuprāviśadityarthavādaḥ| tathā -- "udaramantaraṃ kurute'tha tasya bhayaṃ bhavatī"ti bhedadarśanāpavādaḥ| tathā "etadeva puruṣaṃ brahma tatamamapaśyadi"tyasya "sa etameva sīmānaṃ vidāryaitayā dvārā prāpadyate"tyarthavādaḥ| tadevaṃ sarvavedānteṣu tatra tatrāvasthātrayaparyudāsena brahmātmaikatvaṃ pratipādyamānaṃ draṣṭavyam| na hi bhedadarśanāpavādena brahmaṇa eva jīvātmanā praveśārthavādena ca brahmātmaikatvaṃ tatra tatrābhyasyāvasthātrayasaṃbandhavirodhanirākaraṇena ca| pratipādyamānaṃ tātparyahīnamiti yuktaṃ vaktumiti| kiṃca avidyānivṛttirbrahmātmabhāvaśca vidyāphalaṃ śrūyate| naca saṃpadādiparatve tadupapadyate; anyasyānyātmatāvirodhāt, apramāṇatvācca| ataḥ phalavacanasāmarthyādapi brahmātmaikatvaparaḥ padasamanvaya ityāha -- tadavagamanimittaṃ ceti|| upasaṃharati -- tasmānna saṃpadādivaditi|| atra kaścidāha -- brahmaṇo bhinnābhinno'yaṃ jīvaḥ| tataśca brahmaṇo nityamuktatā jīvasya ca nityabaddhatā vyavasthāmaśnute, atyantābhede tu brahmaiva svasaṃsārāya kathaṃ jagadutpādayet viruddhā ca viśuddhasyāśuddhatāpratipattiriti, atrocyate; kimātmikeyaṃ bhinnābhinnatā na tāvajjātivyaktiguṇaguṇikāryakāraṇaviśiṣṭasvarūpāṃśāṃśibhāvanibandhanā; jīvabrahmaṇosteṣāmabhāvātprakārāntareṇa bhedābhedadarśanāt| "mamaivāṃśo jīvalokaḥ" iti smṛteraṃśāṃśiteti cet, na; "niṣkalaṃ niṣkriyami"tiśrutivirodhāt| "pādo'sya sarvā bhūtānī"ti cālpatāmātravivakṣayoktam; vākyasya brahmānantyapratipādanaparatvāt, sāṃśatve ca paṭādivadavayavārabhyatvaprasaṅgāt| nanu svābhāvikī niravayavatā, budhyādyupādhinimittaṃ sāṃśatvamiti cet, na tāvadupādhinā vidārya pṛthatkriyate jīvaḥ; khaṅgadhārāsamāviddhe'pyākāśe niravayave bhedanādarśanāt| upādhibhiśca svātmānaṃ vidārya saṃsāramanubhāvayatā brahmaṇā svātmani vyāmoha eva prakaṭitaḥ syāt| nacopādhīnāmanyārthatayā sṛṣṭiḥ; anyābhāvāt, prāgabhinnānāṃ jīvānāmanyatvābhāvāt, dravyeṇaiva dravyavidāraṇātkarmāvidyāsaṃskārāṇāṃ satāmapyanupādhitvāt|| atha bhedo'niṣpanno'pyaupādhiko vyajyata iti, tarhyanādireva bhedaḥ| sa ca jātivyaktibhāvādinibandhano brahmaṇi jīve ca na syāt| nīlapītādivatsvābhāviko bhedo dravyatvādijātinibandhanaścābheda iti cet, tarhi tadvadeva -- "ayamātmā brahme"ti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt, tasyaiva praveśaśrutayaśca bādhyeran| ekatvānumānaṃ ca darśitam| na niṣpannaḥ, nāpyanādiḥ, kiṃtūpādhinibandhanastatra prakāśate bheda iti cet, sa tarhyatasmiṃstadāropo vibhrama eva syāt| naca pratyakṣādibhirjīvabrahmabhedo gṛhyata ityuktam| āgamaśca "nānyo'to'sti draṣṭe"ti bhedaṃ pratiṣedhati| abhedavacanāni tānīti cet, maivam; "eṣa ta ātme"tyādinā'bhedaṃ pratipādyaiva punarbhedasya tatraiva pratiṣedhāt, kathaṃ vā satyapyabhede'vidyākāmakarmavyavasthā na hyākāśaṃ ghaṭenāvacchidya tadantardhūmādisamāveśane satyākāśasya dhūmādiyogaḥ parihartuṃ śakyate| nanu bhedād vyavasthā'pi vidyate, tarhi brahmaṇyavidyādisaṃsargo'saṃsargaścetyubhayamapi syāt| nanu viruddhamidamāpādyate, ko'yaṃ bhedābhedavādino virodho nāma ekopādhāvekasyaiva bhāvābhāvopagamādabhedo nābhāvaḥ, kintvaikyameva dharmāntaramiti cet, tathā'pi -- "ahaṃ manuṣyo" ṭhadvau candrāvi"tyādāvaikyabhedayorbhedaikyajñānābhyāṃ bādhadarśanādbhedābhedau viruddhāvekatrābhyupagacchatā kimiti bhāvābhāvāvidānīṃ brahmaṇi nābhyupagamyeyātām kiṃca pratyekaṃ dehapaṭāvayaveṣu malasaṃsṛṣṭeṣu malinaḥ paṭo'haṃ malina iti vā'vayavini malasaṃsarganiścayāt phalavacanānāṃ ca vartamānāpadeśināṃ pratyakṣaviruddhatayā'rthavādatvāt, satyapi bhede jīvasamavāyibhirmalairavayavi brahma malabhūyiṣṭhameveti niścīyeta| kiṃca brahmaṇyavidyādimalasaṃsargamapyasahamāno'tibhaktivilasitāntaḥkaraṇaḥ kathaṃ taireva malairabhedaṃ sahate!!! niravadyaśrutivirodhānnābheda iti cet, na; sarvātmatvaśruteḥ| ata eva pāpīyānayaṃ pakṣa ityuktam| nanu upādhibhedena vyavasthāpyate, na; arthato bhedanābhāve paramārthasatyasya saṃsārasambandhasyābhede sati vyavasthānupapatteḥ| mithyābhedena tu mithyāsaṃsāravyavasthā yujyate, bimbapratibimbayostathā darśanāt| kiṃca brahma sarvān jīvānātmatvena paśyati vā na vā na cet, sarvajñatāhāniḥ| paśyati cet, svātmanyeva saṃsāraṃ paśyet| nanu bhedamapi paśyati, tarhi brahmā''tmani saṃsāraṃ paśyati, na paśyatīti syāt| kiṃca satyapi bhedadarśane mithyātādātmyābhimānād dehadharmānātmani paśyati, kimu vaktavyaṃ satyenābhedābhimāneneti na hyabhedāparokṣye sati bhedo'pyaparokṣo'vabhāsamāno dṛṣṭaḥ|| kiṃca sarvaṃ ca satyatayaivātmanyaparokṣatayā sarvādhārasya sarvajñasya paśyato brahmaṇaḥ sarvasaṃsārasambandhaḥ syāt| kiṃca jñānadhyānasamādhibherekasminnupādhāvekasya jīvasyapralīyamāne'pi na kiṃcitprayojanamasti; pariśiṣṭasarvopādhitaddharmasaṃbandhapratibhāsanāt| naca sarvopādhivinirmokṣa kenacidapi kartuṃ śakyate| mama punarekopādhiparityāgena bimbabhūtabrahmātmatāparokṣāvabhāsino'pi pratibimbaśyāmatvādibhiriva jīvasaṃsārairna saṃbandhaḥ; mithyātvena tattvajñānapratihatatvāt| svapnādivacca tattvajñānena sarvopādhivinirmokṣaśca yujyate; vāmadevādimuktyedānīṃ saṃsārānupalabdhiḥ syāditi cet, ekaikamuktāvapyanantaireva yugairanantānāṃ jīvānāṃ muktatvāttulyedānīṃ saṃsārānupalabdhiḥ| idānīṃ saṃsāradarśanaṃ tu parasyāpi tulyam| anupapattiścāvayoḥ samānā| ato nirupādhikacaitanye tvayi brahmaṇi pratyakṣe bandhāvabhāse sopādhikacaitanyeṣu tava muktatāvabhāso vibhramaḥ| tadviṣayaśrutyādīnāṃ pratyakṣāviruddhatayā'rthavādatvād nirupādhikacaitanyapratibhāse tvayi sopādhikacaitanyabhedānāṃ kalpitatvāt kasyaikasya bandhamokṣāviti tava tāvatsaṃdeho na jāyate; sopādhikacaitanyeṣu muktatābhramāt, tadvacanānāṃ cārthavādatvāt| evaṃ pratyekamātmano na saṃdehaḥ| tasmātsarvasaṅkaravādino vibhramo'yamasmatpakṣe vyavastheti| tadevaṃ brahmāvagame vidhimantareṇaivāparokṣaphalaparyante sādhyāntarābhāvānna vidhisambandha ityāha -- tatraivaṃ satīti || kiṃ tarhi pramāṇaphalamiti tadāha -- ato mithyaiveti|| nanu prayojanābhāvād brahma na vidhikarma bhavati āhosvit kārakatvābhāvāditi prayojanaṃ tu sādhyo mokṣo vakṣyate, na karmakārakatvābhāvāt, vidikriyākārakatvādityāha -- nanu vidikriyākarmeti|| na ceti bhāṣyameva parihāraḥ| nanu vidikriyākarmatvābhāve śāstrajanyajñānaṃ vyāvartakatvābhāvānna śāstragamyaṃ brahmaiti codayati -- so'yaṃ śāntikarmaṇīti|| svayaṃprakāśamānatayā svaviṣayaprakāśajananānapekṣasyāpi brahmaṇaḥ śāstrajanyajñānākāratayā tadvyāvartakasyāvidyādidoṣanivṛttiphalavattayā śāstraprameyaṃ brahmeti pratipādayati|| atrottaram -- nāvidyākalpitetyādi|| nanu anadhigatārthaprakāśamantareṇa na pramāṇavyāpārasya phalavattetyatrāha -- śāstraṃ hi so'yamityādīti|| nanu tatra vā viṣayādhigamamantareṇa kathaṃ nivartyamātre pramāṇavyāpāra iti ata āha -- tathāhīti|| uktametad devadattaikyasyābhijñāyāmeva siddhatvāttadākeṇa pratyabhijñāvākyābhyāmupajanitena jñānenopādhiparikalpitabhedanirāsena pratyabhijñāvākyayoḥ prāmāṇyamiti| nanu brahmatmani viparyayābhāvānna tannirāsenāpi prāmāṇyamityata āha -- tathā tvaṃpadārtho'pīti|| kena tarhi pramāṇākāreṇa viparyāsanirāsa iti tadāha -- tatpadārthaikatāmupagacchanniti|| tattvaṃpadābhyāṃ lakṣyamāṇaṃ brahmātmaikatvaṃ vijñānākāra ityarthaḥ| kiṃ tarhi tadākārajñānena nivartyata iti tadāha -- ahamātmakedamaṃśopādhikṛteti|| pramāṇavyāpāro viṣayākārodaya eva pramīyamāṇavastumārthyādviparyāsanirāsa ityāha -- arthāditi|| nanu jñātṛsamavāyinī jñeyākārā saṃvitpramāṇaphalam, anena ca viparyāso nirasyate; prakāśasyaivāprakāśavirodhitvāt, nitye ca caitanyaprakāśe na pramāṇaphalamastītyata āha -- avacchidyamānānidaṃprakāśaḥ pramāṇaphalamiti|| pramāṇena viṣayīkṛtārthagataṃ caitanyaṃ pramāṇaphalamucyate, na pramāṇajanyam ; loke'pyajanyatvāt| ataḥ pramātṛpramāṇaprameyāvacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ pramātrādi nivartayati; avaccheda nivṛttyoḥ pūrvottarakṣaṇatayā virodhābhāvāditi| nanu phalaṃ cennivartakam, nivarttyānantarabhūtatvāt| tarhi phalaṃ yāvatkālameva sthāsyatīti, netyāha -- tadapyavacchedakavināśa iti|| nanuśāstrajanyajñānena na prakāśyate ced brahma, na śāstragamyaṃ syādityata āha -- tena pramāṇādicatuṣṭayasyeti|| nanu kimityavidyānivṛttireva pramāṇaphalamucyate viṣayaprakāśo'pi pramāṇaphalamucyatāmiti, tatrāha -- tathā caivaṃvidhasyeti|| "avijñātaṃ vijānatām" yato vāco nivartanta ityādi|| nanu "manasaivānudraṣṭavyam""tantvaupaniṣadaṃ puruṣamiti" jñānakriyākarmatvamapi śrūyate, naiṣa doṣaḥ vedāntajanitāparokṣajñānasyākārasamarpakatayā vyāvartakatvaṃ śāstraprameyatvaṃ nāma, jñānajanyaprakāśātiśyaśūnyatvamaviṣayatā nāmeti vyavasthopapatteḥ| nahi prakāśaguṇe punaḥ prakāśaguṇāntarodaya iti| nanu avidyānivṛttirapi jñānasādhyatvād mokṣasyānityateti, netyāha -- evaṃ ca nityamukteti|| nanu ko'yaṃ jīvo nāma yasya svarūpaṃ tvaṃpadaṃna lakṣyamāṇaṃ brahmaiva vākyārthaḥ saṃpadyate| brahmaivāvidyāpratibimbitamiti vadāmaḥ| tataśca tvaṃpadenāśeṣopādhinirākaraṇenā''tmasvarūpameva lakṣyamāṇaṃ tatpadopalakṣyaṃ brahmaiva padadvayasāmarthyātsaṃpadyate| nacaitadupādhidvayanirākaraṇena viśuddhabrahmātmajñānamekenaiva padena labhyate; virodhānutpatteḥ| nanu bhinnābhinnatā vākyārthaḥ kinna syāt na; tathā sati śarīrendriyaviśiṣṭasyaiva tvaṃpadārthasya brahmaṇo bhinnābhinnatvāttathaiva vākyārthasiddherlakṣaṇayā brahmātmajñānenādhyāsabādho na syāt, vartamānāpadeśināṃ phalavacanānāṃ yogyānupalabdhibādhāt, satyapi tattvajñāne na śāstradvandhanivṛttyavagamaḥ| bhinnābhinne ca vākyārthe na tattvajñānād bhedāṃśanivṛttiḥ; tasya svaviṣayānāśakatvātkarmopāsanāparokṣānubhavānnivṛttikalpanā bhinnabhinnaviṣayāgamaviruddhā, āgamasya sarvakālaṃ bhedābhedaviṣayatvāt| yattvabhedāṃśena jñānamokṣādivyavahāro bhedāṃśena karmavidyādivyavahāra iti vyavasthā kalpyate; tanmandacetanopacchandanamātram| tathāhiyadi bhedābhedābhyāmaṃśī jīvo'bhedāṃśaśca brahmaiva syāt, tadā sāvayavo jīvāṃśaśca brahmeti paṇḍitammanyasya hi parīto'rthaḥ saṃpadyeta| bhedāṃśasyābrahmatve'tyantabheda eva syāt| nacāṃśadvayasamudāyo jīvaḥ ; avastutvaprasaṅgāt| na cābhedāṃśa eva jīvaḥ; brahmaṇa eva jīvatvaprasaṅgāt| nacobhāvaṃśau; jīvadvayaprasaṅgāt| na ca bhedāṃśa eva jīvaḥ; atyantabhedaprasaṅgāt| tatra tattvajñānamokṣādivyavahārā'siddhiḥ| bhedābhedāṃśāvabhinnau jīva iti cet, yadyabhinnāveva| jīvaḥ; tarhi brahmaiva jīva iti kuto bandhamokṣavyavahāravyavasthā atha bhedābhedāṃśau parasparaṃ bhinnābhinnāviti matam, naivam; bhedādyanavasthāprasaṅgāt| kiṃcāṃśino vāṃśadvayasamudāyasya vā parasparābhinnāṃśadvayasya vā jīvatve brahmaṇo jīvāṃśatvaṃ parihartuṃ na śakyate| kiṃca kasyāyaṃ śāstropadeśaḥ na tāvadabhedāṃśasya; tasya brahmasvarūpatayopadeśānapekṣatvāt, nāpi bhedāṃśatvopadeśaḥ; "ahaṃ brahmāsnī"tipratipattyayogāt| naca bhedāṃśasya punarabhedaḥ sambhavati; virodhāt, brahmaṇyeva saṃsāraprasaṅgācca| kasyayācamavidyādoṣaḥ na tāvadabhedāṃśasya; brahmaṇyeva prasaṅgāt| nāpi bhedāṃśasya; upādhijanāt prāg bhedābhāvāt| svata eva bhedāṃśe'śini vā jīve bandhadoṣa iti cet, tadvināśe jīvanāśaḥ syāt; mokṣe bhedāṃśavināśāt, abhedāṃśasya nityamuktatvāt|| kasyāyaṃ mokṣa upadiśyate| tatrāpi bhinnābhinnaṃ cet, "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavatī"tyevakāravirodhaḥ saṃsārādaviśeṣaśca syāt| kiṃcāyaṃ sarvatra saṃkīrṇaṃ vastu pratipadyamānaḥ svarganarakabandhamokṣādīn sāṃkaryeṇa vyavasthāpayituṃ pravṛttaḥ kathaṃ vyutpannamatiṣu nāpatrapeta| bhedenaiva sarvaṃ vyavasthāpyate cet, kimanena bhedena bandhyāyamānena svaprayuktakāryānimittena kalpitena dharmipratiyorivyatirekeṇa bhedopādherabhāvāt| upādhibhedena bhedābhedavyavasthā tvekasya bhedābhedau nivārayati dharmipratiyogibhedāt| śāstraṃ punaḥ -- "nānyo'to'sti draṣṭe"ti bhedopamardenaivābhedaṃ pratipādayati -- "eṣa ta ātme"ti ca| naca sattvādisāmānyadvāreṇa jīvabrahmaṇorabhedaḥ; anumānenaiva tatsiddheḥ śāstrānapekṣaṇāt| nanu atyantābhedāvādinastavaiva sarvaṃ saṃkīryeta, na mama; bhedasyābhyupagamāt, naivam; kāryaprapañcasyānirūpitasvabhāvatayā yathāvabhāsaṃ bhedādivyavasthopagamāt, atmana evābhedopagamāt| tasmānmandamatisantoṣamātraprayojanatayā bahuveṇubhārapīḍitacetasā'yaṃ bhedābhedapakṣaḥ samādīyata iti| tasmādidameva brahma devadattavadupādhibhedanimittavibhādaparāmarśena pratyastamitavibhāgaṃ vākyena pratipādyata iti śobhanam|| "yasya tūtpādyo mokṣaḥ" ityādinottarasya bhāṣyasamudāyasya tātparyamāha -- nanu brahmaṇo'pi kārakatvasambhavāt kathaṃ na sambhavati kriyetyāha -- kathamiti|| tatredaṃ vaktavyam -- kiṃ yāgādivatkartṛsamavetāpūrvādiphaladānāya jñānaṃ vidhīyate kiṃ vā karmākarakātiśayaphalāyeti na tāvat pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ; "na karmabrahmavidyāphalayorvailakṣaṇyādi"tyārabhya nirastatvāt; nāpyuttaraḥ kalpa ityāha -- yadi tāvadutpādya ityādinā|| atra kecidāhuḥ -- utpādyatve'pi mokṣasya nānityatādoṣaḥ; kriyāsādhyasyaivānityatvāt, mokṣasya jñānamātrasādhyatvāt, naca jñānamātrasādhyasyānityatvaṃ dṛṣṭam; nacāvidyānivṛttimātrameva jñānasādhyam; brahmabhāvasyāpi sādhyatvāt| nanu jīvasya brahmabhāvaḥ svābhāviko na sādhanīyaḥ, na; tādātmyasyaiva svābhāvikatvāt| bhedatāvanmātravirodhastādātmyaṃ nāma| tadbhāvastu brahmatāvanmātratājīvasya jñānena sādhyate; "tarati śokamātmavit" "brahma veda brahmaiva bhavatī"tyubhayavidhaśrutisāmarthyāditi, atrocyate -- kiṃ śāstrajanitasamyagjñānena tādātmyaviṣayeṇa mokṣaḥ sādhyate kiṃ vā tadbhāvaviṣayeṇeti na tāvattadbhāvaviṣayeṇa; tasya nityasiddhatāprasaṅgāt| yadi tādātmyaviṣayeṇa tatrāpi nivṛtte tādātmye tadbhāvaḥ sādhyate vā na iti vaktavyam| nivṛtte cet, jñānasya svaviṣayavināśakatvaṃ darśitaṃ syāt| jñānanivartyatve cājñānameva tādātmyamāpadyeta, anivṛtte tu tādātmye tadbhāvo nopapadyate| na hi tāvanmātratā tadvirodhitā ca yugapat syātāmiti|| kiṃca tādātmyanivṛttireva tadbhāvaḥ kiṃvānya iti vaktavyam| nivṛttireva cet, avidyānivṛttireva mokṣa ityuktaṃ syāt, anyaścet, tarhi tādātmyaṃ tadbhāvaṃ cāntareṇa rūpāntaraṃ vaktavyam| na hi jīvabrahmaṇostādātmyatadbhāvavyatirekeṇātyantabhedādanyad rūpāntaraṃ śakyate nirūpayitum| kaścāyaṃ tadbhāvo nāma na tāvad brahmaiva; asādhyatvāt| ata eva na jīvo'pi; naca tṛtīyaścetano'cetano vā tadbhavo nirūpayituṃ śakyaḥ| kiṃca yadi tādātmyalakṣaṇātirekaviśiṣṭaścejjīvaḥ, tadvināśe vināśamiyāt| niṣkṛṣṭatādātmyaścejjīvaḥ, brahmamātrameva syāt; atyantabhedānaṅgīkārāt| tasmāttattādātmyasya tadbhāvaḥ śāstrayuktihīnaḥ| naca tattvaṃpadābhyāṃ lakṣyamāṇayorjīvabrahmaṇostādātmyaṃ pratīyate; bhinnopādhiparāmarśenaikasya vastuno lakṣyamāṇatvāt| nacaikenaiva padena tasya lakṣaṇāyāṃ bhedāvabhāso nivartate| phalaśrutayaścāvidyānivṛttau yojayituṃ śakyante| naca jñānasādhyasya nityatālābhaḥ; saṃskārasya tajjanyasyānityatādarśanāt| naca saṃskārasyāpi kriyājanyatā; saṃskārāntaravatsmṛtihetutvāyogāt, anvayavyatirekavirodhācca| abrahmajñānasya sādhyatvāt kriyājanyateti cet, na; kriyāyāmanaikāntikatvāt| tasmādabhūtvā bhavanamevānityatāheturiti| tarhi tṛtīyaṃ phalaṃ kriyāsādhyamiṣyatāmiti śaṅkate -- athānityatvaparihārāyeti|| tatredaṃ vaktavyam -- kiṃ brahmapratyagātmabhūtam vyatiriktaṃ vā vyatireke'pi sarvagataṃ vā pradeśāntaravarti vā brahmeti tādātmye dūṣaṇamāha -- tadapi neti|| vyatireke sarvagataṃ cet, saṃyogavyatiriktaprāptyabhāvātsaṃyogo nityasiddha ityāha -- vyatireke'pīti|| pradeśavartitvaṃ śaṅkate -- atha vikāravartina iti|| tatra vaktavyam -- kiṃ vikārasaṃsparśaparihārāya pradeśavartitvamucyate kiṃ vā śāstrasāmarthyāditi| śāstraṃ punaḥ sarvagatatvameva darśayati, naca sarvagatatve'pi vikārasaṃsparśa ityāha -- na vākīradeśe'pīti|| atha sarvagatatvasyaupacārikatvātpradeśaviśeṣavartyeva brahmeti śaṅkate -- atha vikārāvartyeveti|| na; madhyamaparimāṇasya vastunaḥ pṛthivyādivadatsāvayavatvāt| dūṣaṇavibhāgajñānāya vikalpayati -- sā tarhi tatprāptiriti prathame kalpe dūṣaṇamāha -- tadā svarūpanāśa iti|| kathaṃ tatra tāvajjīvasya brahmabhāvaḥ brahmaiva vā jīvo vā na saṃbhavati; asādhyatvāt| nāpi jīvabrahmabhyāmārabhyamāṇaṃ dravyāntaram; vināśitvaprasaṅgāt, sarvagatasya brahmaṇo'vayavitvāyogāt| nāpi jīvabrahmaṇostādātmyaṃ nāma kaścitsaṃbandhaḥ; bhinnadravyayoḥ saṃyogātiriktasaṃbandhābhāvāt| nāpi jīve'ṇuparimāṇe'vasthite brahmasvarūpāpattiḥ; virodhāt, anavasthite ca parimāṇe dravyasvarūpanāśa iti| dvitīye'pi kalpe dūṣaṇamāha -- saṃyogasyeti|| nanu śāstrasāmarthyādapunarāvṛttau kathaṃ tarkeṇa punarāvṛttiḥ sādhyate tatrāha -- nacāpunarāvṛttiśrutiriti|| yathāśrutārthe'prāptapratiṣedhāt, nāvartiṣyata iti kalpanāyāḥ kṛtakatvānumānavirodhāt, tasyaiva svarūpeṇāvasthāne "sa svarāṭ bhavatī"tiśruteranekeśvaraprasaṅgāt| tasmānna pradeśāntaravartibrahmaprāptiriti|| nanu "tayordhvamāyannamṛtatvametī"ti śrūyate| tarhi pratīkālambanānāmapi mūrddhanyanāḍyaivā''mānavapuruṣād gacchatāmamṛtatvaṃ syāt; aviśeṣaśravaṇāt| nanu "sa enān brahma gamayatī"tyarcirādinā gacchatāṃ brahmaprāptiḥ śrūyate, na; kāryabrahmaviṣayatvāt| nanu brahmaśabdārthasya mukhyatvātparameva brahma gamyate, na; yadi tāvad vṛddhavyavahāre prayogānmukhyatā'bhidhīyate, tarhi kāryabrahmaṇyapi rūḍha evāyaṃ śabdo bhavati| athāvayavārthānugamenārthamukhyatā'bhidhīyate, naivam; ekasya śabdasya yugapadrūḍhiyogavṛttidvayopādānāyogāt| prayogamukhyatve kāryabrahmaiva gamyate| kiṃca "sa enān brahmālokān gamayatī"ti brahmalokaśabdād bahuvacanāt, "teṣu parāvato vasantī"tyadhikaraṇadhikartavyatāśravaṇāt, "tasmin vasanti śāśvatīḥ samāḥ" iti kālaparicchedaśravaṇāt, "tṛtīyasyābhito divī"ti saṃkhyādyuśabdayoḥ śravaṇāt, "tathairaṃmadīyasya saraso'śvatthasya somasavanasya, aparājitāyāśca puro hiraṇmayasya ca veśmano'rasya ṇyasya cārṇavasya paryaṅkādeśca bhogyavastubhedasya śravaṇād, prajāpateḥ sabhāṃ veśma prapadye" iti prajāpatisabhāveśmanāṃ kāryabrahmaivārcirādinā gamyata iti pratīyate| naca brahmaiva loka iti samāsaḥ; brahmalokaśabdasya satyaloke rūḍhatvāt, yaugikatve'pi tatra prathamatarabuddhihetutvād brahmaṇi lokaśabdavirodhāt| nacaiteṣāṃ kāryabrahmaliṅgānāmapabādhayā brahmaśabdasyaikasya prayogamukhyatvātiriktamarthamukhyatvamapyupādātuṃ yuktam; prajāpatiśabdasya kāryabrahmaṇi rūḍhatvāt, lokaśabdasya ca bhogabhūmiviśeṣavācitvāt|| kiṃca pañcāgnividāmapi parabrahmaprāptirasmin pakṣe syāt| naca -- "sa enān brahma gamayatī"tyetacchabdaḥ pañcāgnividatiriktān parāmṛśatīti -- yuktam; pañcāgnividāmeva prādhānyena prakṛtatvāt, teṣāmanirdiṣṭaphalatvaprasaṅgāt| kiñca gāyatrī śāṇḍilyaṣoḍaśakalopakosalavaiśvānarabhūmadaharaparyaṅkavidyānāmekarūpaiva brahmaprāptiḥ phalam āhosvidupacayāpacayarūpam iti vaktavyam| ekarūpaphalatve guṇopacayāpacādupāsanopacayāpacayau vyarthau syātām| na hyagnihotrādyanuṣṭhānopacayāt phalopacayo na jāyate| atha phalopacayāpacayāvapīṣyeyātām, tarhi na vikārāsaṃsparśabrahmaprāptiḥ; tatra tadabhāvāt| kiṃca vaiśvānaropāsanāphalaṃ trailokyāpattiriṣyate vā na vā iti vaktavyam| iṣyate cet, vikārāsaṃsṛṣṭe brahmaṇi kathaṃ trilokyātmatāphalaprāptiḥ na cediṣyate, "taṃ yathā yathopāsate" iti śrutivirodhaḥ syāt| kiṃca pitrādisaṃkalpairvikārāsaṃsṛṣṭe brahmaṇyupabhogaḥ syāt na vā iti vaktavyam| na cet, pitrādisaṃkalpaśrutivirodhaḥ| syāccet, vikārāvarti brahma pitrādiyuktaṃ syāt| kiṃca vikāravarti brahma prāpto'pi brahmaiveti "manasaitān kāmān paśyan ramate tena pitṛlokena sampanno mahīyate" iti brahmaṇa eva sādhanabhogo darśitaḥ syāt| tataścāptakāmatāvirodhaḥ svārthaprayuktā ca sṛṣṭiḥ syāt| kiṃca vikāravarti brahma prāptasya liṅgaśarīramasti vā na vā iti vaktavyam| asti cet, kalāpravilayaśrutirbādhyeta| na celliṅgaśarīram, "manasaitān kāmāni" ti śrutirbādhyeta| kiṃca tatra liṅgaśarīravilaye nimittaṃ vaktavyam| vidyaiva cet, ukrāntikāle syāt; tadārambhakakarmakṣayāt| amānavakarasparśaścet, vidyutsthāne syāt| nacopariṣṭhātkālāvilayananimittaṃ śrūyate| kiṃca aupādhikajīvapakṣe na jīvasya vikārāvartibrahmagamanaṃ sambhavati; niravayavāvacchedasya ghaṭākāśasyovoddhṛtya nayanāyogāt| uddharaṇe ca brahmaśūnyo'yaṃ pradeśaḥ syāt| upariṣṭācca brahmopacayaṃ prāpnuyāt| tasmādupādhigamanādātmani gamanavibhramaḥ| nanu upādherapi gamanaṃ na sambhavati; tadupādānasya brahmaṇaścalanaśūnyatvāt, na hi mṛdi niścalāyāṃ ghaṭasya gamanamastīti, evaṃ tarhi svapnagamanavanmāyāvijṛmbhito gamanādipratibhāsaḥ| nanu na pitrādisaṃkalpairbrahmaṇi bhogo'bhidhīyate, kintu yāvāṃstatra bhogaḥ, tasya nityānandaprāptāvantarbhāvādaiśvaryabhedaḥ kathyataiti, na; ekasya brahmaśabdasya yaugikārthabhaṅgabhayād bahvīnāṃ phalaśrutīnāmupacārakalpanāyogāt, śāstrāntyapādavaiphalyaprasaṅgācca| tasmāt pradeśāntaravartibrahmaprāptaye kriyāvidhānamityanupapannam|| saṃskārapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha -- saṃskāryatvamapīti|| doṣāpanayanena vidyamānasya brahmabhāvasyābhivyaktiḥ saṃskāra ityāśaṅkate -- atha vidyamānasyeti|| tatra vaktavyam -- kimātmāśrayakriyayā doṣāpanayaḥ kiṃ vā'nyāśrayayeti na tāvadātmano niravayavasya parispandapariṇāmāvityāha -- nātmanaḥ kriyārahitatvāditi|| nacānyāśrayakriyayā; kriyāvaddravyasaṃyogābhāvāttatrātiśayāyogādityāha -- pratyagrūpatvāditi nanumantradevatābhidhyānād viṣanirāsavadīśvarābhidhyānāddoṣāpanayaḥ syāditi codayati -- nanvīśvarābhidhyānāditi|| "ucyate" ityādi parihāraḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu śāstrīyakarmabhirātmano guṇādhānalakṣaṇaḥ saṃskāraḥ śrūyata iti, netyāha -- naca snānādikriyayeveti|| ayamarthaḥ -- yaḥ sādhanāni śarīrendriyamanāṃsi prerayati, sa kartā, bhoktā, saṃskāryaśca| sa ca caitanyasaṃvalito'haṅkāraḥ; "vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute" iti śruteḥ| sa cā''saṃsārasamāpteravicchinno vartata iti bhogaśca saṃbhavati| tatra ca dharmādharmātiśaya utpadyate na nirvikārātmani| tatastasya na saṃskāryatvamupapadyata iti| tasmānna saṃskārya ityādi -- nanu ityataḥ prāktanaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| "nanu jñānasyāpī"tyārabhyedamaparamityataḥ prāktanau codyaparihārau pūrvoktavapyavasaraprāptatvātpunarihānītau spaṣṭārthau|| janyājanyaphalatvena kriyājñānayorvailakṣaṇyamuktam, idānīṃ puruṣecchāprayatnasādhyā hi kriyā, tadanapekṣamātmajñānamiti kāraṇato vailakṣaṇyamāha -- idamaparaṃ vailakṣaṇyamiti|| codanājanyaṃ puraṣecchāprayatnajanyaṃ na bhavati, jñānamanicchato'pi durgandhādijñānadarśanādityarthaḥ| nanu śabdajanyasya jñānasya viṣayajanyatvābhāvānna vastuparatantratā, tataścodanājanyatvamiti śaṅkate -- athāpīti|| tatrāpi vidhijanyapuruṣecchāprayatnanirapekṣameva liṅgādijanyameveti pariharati -- tatrāpīti|| nanu saṃyogavibhāgapracayātirekiṇī keyaṃ kriyā nāma nanu calatīti pratyakṣamevaitaccalanam| satyam; tadapi saṃyogavibhāgālambanameva calanam| nanu sthāṇāvapi śyenasaṃyogavibhāgavati calatīti prasaṅgaḥ, na; svadeśasaṃyogavibhāgālambanatvātpratyayasya, sthāṇośca śyenadeśatvābhāvāt| sarvasya cākāśadeśatvāditi cet, na; bahalāndhakārāvṛte tamasyapratīyamāne'pi khadyote calanabuddhidarśanāt| naca deśamapratītya tatsaṃyogavibhāgāḥ pratīyanta iti| tasmātsaṃyogavibhāgātiriktakriyālambanaścalatīti pratyayaḥ| yastu svadeśasaṃyogavibhāgābhyāṃ kriyāmanumimīte; katham dravyajanitau saṃyogavibhāgau, svāśraye kādācitkātiśayapurassarau; vyavasthitadravye kādācitkatvāt, saṃyogavibhāgajanyakāryavaditi| tasya makarādiṣu jalapravāhādhāreṣu sthirācalāvayaveṣu svadeśajalasaṃyogavibhāgayoḥ satorapi teṣu kriyājñānābhāvādanaikāntikatā hetoriti| kiṃca saṃyogavibhāgaheturatiśayaḥ kriyābhidhānīyaḥ sthirādeva dravyādutpadyate atiśayāntaravato vā pūrvasminnavyavasthitadravyādeva kriyājanmavattata eva saṃyogavibhāgajanma syādityanaikāntikaḥ| atiśayāntarakalpanāyāmanavasthāpātaḥ| pādāśrayasya karmaṇo hi svāśrayāsambandhibhūtasamavāyipādasaṃyogārambhavat prayatnavadātmapādasaṃyogasyāpi bhūpādasaṃyogārambhasiddherna pādāśrayakarmātiśayāvakāśaḥ| tasmātpratyakṣaḥ kriyāpratyayaḥ|| nanu kṣaṇikasya karmaṇaḥ kathamindriyasaṃyogajñānalakṣaṇakṣaṇadvayāvasthānam śabdavidyudādivadityavirodhaḥ|| tasmādasti kriyājñānavilakṣaṇeti| kiṃceti spaṣṭārthaḥ|| kiṃca "vedāntavijñānasuniścitārthāḥ" iti niścitārthaviṣayatattvajñānameva mokṣasādhanamuktam, tacca pramāṇajanyatve saṃbhavatītyāha -- evaṃ samyagjñānatvopapatteriti|| dārṣṭāntikamāha -- evaṃ satīti|| nanu brahmajñāne vidhayaḥ śrūyante, tatkathaṃ tarkeṇa nirasyanta iti atrāha -- ataḥ śrūyamāṇā apīti|| nanu anuṣṭheyābhāvādvidherabhāve śabdasya vaiyarthyaṃ syāditi, netyāha -- ato'rthavādatayaiveti|| nanu arthavādāntaravatstāvakatve vidhipadamarthaśūnyaṃ syāditi, netyāha -- tadunmukhīkaraṇāditi|| "tathāta śravaṇaṃ nāme"tyādinā yaiḥ śravaṇādibhirātmā saṃstūyate| tān vibhajya darśayati| nanu śravaṇādibhiḥ kiṃ śreyaḥ kriyate yenotkarṣavadbhireterviṣayīkaraṇādātmā stutaḥ syāditi, tadāha -- ato vākyārthe sthairyāditi|| nanu vidheyasyaivārthavādasaṃbandhaḥ; stute pravṛttiphalatvāt, na siddhavastunaḥ, ityākṣipati -- kaḥ punariti|| phalapraśaṃsāyā api pravṛttyupayogitvāt phalabhūtātmapraśaṃsāyā api śravaṇādipravṛttyupayogitvamupapadyata ityabhipretyāha -- idamatra prastutamityādi|| granthastu spaṣṭārthaḥ|| nanu samyagdarśanasya phalarūpatvāt pramāṇādhīnatvāccāvidheyateti yuktā tasyārthavādatā, śravaṇādayastu kriyārūpatvātsamyagdarśanasya dṛṣṭadṛṣṭopakāritayā vidheyā eveti, tadāha -- etacca sarve prathamasūtreṇaiveti|| manananididhyāsanopabṛṃhitasya śravaṇasya samyagdarśanāya vidheyatvamaṅgīkṛtya prathamasūtraṃ pravṛttamityarthaḥ| vidhīnāmapi satāṃ stāvakatvamuktam, idānīṃ śabdasyārthāntaramāha -- apica naivāyamiti|| nanu mā bhūvan jñānavidhayaḥ, upāsanāvidhistu śrūyata iti, netyāha -- tenātmetyevopāsītetyādi|| sarvatraivakāraviśeṣaṇaśravaṇāt, ahamitisvabhāvaprāptapratyayāvṛttyanuvādena viṣayaviśeṣaḥ pratipādya iti -- ato hānopādānaśūnyetyupasaṃharati|| bhāṣyaṃ vivṛṇoti -- tasyāyamartha iti|| uktametanmokṣaphalavidheyajñānabrahmarūpanirūpaṇāyāṃ vidhinirapekṣameva brahmaṇi vedāntāḥ pramāṇamiti dvitīyena varṇakena prathamena ca varṇakena pramāṇāntarānapekṣaṃ brahmaṇi prāmāṇyamuktam, idānīṃ tadubhayavarṇakārthamākṣipya samādhatte -- yadapi kecidāhurityādinā|| katham kimahaṃpratyayāvaseya evātmā vedāntaiḥ pratipādyate kiṃ vā tadvyatiriktaḥ yadyādyaḥ, tadā tasya kriyāyāmaṅgatvādvidhivākyairvedāntānāmekavākyatā syāt| atha tadvyatiriktaḥ pratipādyate, tadā kiṃciduddiśya kiṃcitpratipādyamityuddeśatā'bhāvātpratipādanaṃ na syāt| tasyāpi cetanatve karmānaṅgataiva syāt| tasmātkriyāyāmeva vedāntāḥ pramāṇam| tathāca karmaṇyeva kṛtsnasya vedasya prāmāṇyamāpastambho darśayati -- traividyavṛddhānāṃ tu vedāḥ pramāṇamiti niṣṭhā| tatra yāni śrūyante vrīhiyavapaśvājyapayaḥ kapālapatnīsaṃbandhānyuccairnnīcaiḥ kāryamiti, tairviruddha ācāro'pramāṇamiti manyata iti| tathā "cāgnihotraphalā vedāḥ śīlavṛttaphalaṃ śrutami"ti|| tatrottaramāha -- tannopaniṣadasyetyādinā|| ahaṃpratyayāvaseyādviśiṣṭātmano'nya eva kriyākārakasaṃsargaśūnyaḥ, na sa karmāṅgatayā vedāntānāṃ vidhiśeṣatāṃ nayatītyarthaḥ| nanu asāvapi cetanaścedahaṃpratyayagamyatayā karmāṅgamiti, netyāha -- na sa kenaciditi|| nanu śāstragamyasyāpi karmāṅgatā kiṃ na syāditi ata āha -- na hi pramāṇāntarāsiddha iti|| adhikāriṇaṃ kartāraṃ ca pramāṇāntarasiddhāvanūdya vidhimātrapratipādanānyathā vākyabhedāditi| nanu cetanaḥ pramāṇāntarāgamyatvācchāstreṇāpi na gamyata iti, netyāha -- naca sa na pratīyata iti|| nanu sarvo vedo dharme viniyuktaḥ smṛtikārairityuktam, ata āha -- ata evaupaniṣadatveti|| aupaniṣada iti taddhitapratyayo brahmaṇi vedāntānviniyuṅkte| tathā "sarve vedā yatpadamāmananti" "vedaiśca sarvairahameva vedyo vedāntakṛdi"tiśrutismṛtibhyāṃ brahmaparā vedāntā iti gamyate| nanu padasamanvayād brahmaṇi pratīyamāne'pi pratyakṣādibhirbādhānmithyājñānamiti, netyāha -- naiṣa pratīyamāno'pīti|| nanu uddeśābhāvādupādeyaṃ pramātuṃ na śakyata ityata āha -- itaśca na śakyata iti|| nanu ahaṃpratyayagamyamātmānamuddiśya tasyādvitīyaniratiśayajñānānandabrahmātmapratipādane'pyātmano'vastutvānnirālambanatvamiti, netyāha -- ātmānaścānirākāryatvādityādinā|| prakaraṇārthamupasaṃharati -- ato'vacchedatrayaśūnya ityādinā|| nanu sūtrakāravacanasāmarthyātkṛtsno vedaḥ kriyāyāmeva viniyukta iti codayati -- nanvāmnāyasyeti|| nanu pauruṣeyavacanātkathamanādervaidikapadasamanvayasyārthanirṇayaḥ ucyate; anādipravṛttāt kriyārthatayaiva prayogapratyayavyavahārādetadavagamyata ityāha -- tasmātpravṛttinivṛttīti|| nanu śabdaśravaṇānantaraṃ bhūte'pyarthe pratītirupajāyata iti, netyāha -- na tato vastvavagama iti|| nanu ajñātabrahmāvagamaḥ kathaṃ vibhramaḥ syāditi tatrāha -- ata eva tanmithyeti|| śabdasāmarthyābhāvātsaṃvādābhāvāccetyarthaḥ| nanu bhūte'pyarthe pramitirupajāyate cet, naiva tatra śabdasāmarthyaṃ kalpyatāmiti codayati -- kathaṃ punariti|| pariharati -- śabdasya tatreti|| nanu dhūmasya sāmānyena gṛhītasaṃbandhasya viśeṣabodhakatvavatkriyārthe gṛhītasaṃbandho'pi bhūtamarthaṃ gamayediti, netyāha -- nacāgṛhītasāmarthya iti|| tarhi bhūte'pyarthe saṃbandho gṛhyatāmiti, netyāha -- sāmarthyagrahaṇaṃ ceti|| nanu bhūte'pyarthe pravṛttyā jñānānumānena sāmarthyaṃ gṛhyatāmiti, netyāha -- tadabhāve kuta iti|| sādhye pravṛttirna bhūtārtha iti| ucyate naiva sūtrakāretyādiḥ parihāraḥ|| katham laukikanyāyamanusaratā vārtikakāreṇedaṃ pratipāditam -- "abhihitānvaya iti"|| padebhyaḥ pratipannānāṃ padārthānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭaparasparārthāvabodhanamabhihitānvayo nāma| tatra śrotuḥ pravṛttyā viśiṣṭasaṃsargajñānaṃ śabdakāryatvenānumāya śabdasamudāyasyārthasamudāye sāmarthye pratipadyate| tatra "gāmānaya" "gāṃ badhāne"tyādiprayogabhedeṣvāvāpoddhārābhyāmānayanatatsaṃsargavyabhicāre'pi gomātrānvayād bandhane'pi gośabdasya gomātre saṃbandhaḥ pratipadyate, nānayanatatsaṃsargayoḥ; vyabhicārāt| evaṃ sarvapadānāṃ padārthasvarūpamātreṣu sāmarthyapratipatteḥ saṃsargabodhaḥ kiṃnibandhanaḥ iti vīkṣāyāmananyathāsiddhānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdāvagatapadārthanibandhana iti kalpyate| tataḥ padebhyaḥ padārthāḥ, padārthebhyaḥ saṃsarga ityabhihitānvayavādinā matam| tatra yadyakriyābhidhāyināṃ padānāmālambanābhāva ucyate kiṃ vā prayojanābhāva iti yadyālambanābhāvaḥ, tatrāha -- paśyati bhavān devadatta gāmabhyājeti|| atha nālambanābhāvaḥ, kiṃ tu prayojanābhāva iti vaktavyamityāha -- pratīyate cediti|| athākriyārthānāṃ prayojanābhāva iti, na; kriyāyāḥ prayojanatvābhāvādityāha -- prayojanaṃ cānantaramiti|| atha kriyādvārameva prayojanamiti, satyaṃ keṣāñcidityāha -- atastadarthakriyānupayogyarthavācināmiti|| nanu sarvaṃ kriyādvārameva prayojanamiti netyāha -- brahmātmatvāvagatīti|| ato'bhihitānāṃ padārthānāṃ prayojanavadarthasaṃsṛṣṭasvārthapratipādane'pi bhūtavastupratipādanaṃ saṃbhavatīti| atra prābhākaraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate -- kāryasaṃsṛṣṭasvārthe padasāmarthyaṃ na padārthamātra ityāha -- syādetadyadyapīti|| nanu bhūtārthe sāmarthyaṃ pratīyate ced bhūtasaṃsargo'pi pramīyatāmiti, netyāha -- tathāpi nāpratipanna iti|| bhūtārthaviśiṣṭaṃ kāryameva pramīyata ityarthaḥ| nanu saṃsṛṣṭasvārthe śabdasāmarthyaṃ ced bhūte saṃsargaḥ pramīyatāmiti, netyāha -- kriyārthatayaiveti|| niyogasaṃsṛṣṭatayaivetyarthaḥ| nanu kāryasaṃsṛṣṭasvārthasāmarthye'pyanvitasvārthasya tatrāntarbhāvāttenaiva prayojakena bhūte'pi saṃsargaḥ pratīyatāmiti, netyāha -- na hi gopadāttadartha iti|| ayamāśayaḥ -- "gāmānaya śuklāṃ daṇḍene"ti śabdaśraṇānantaraṃ śroturgavānayane pravṛttimupalabhya gavānayanakartavyatā'nena śabdātpratipanneti bhūtārthasaṃsṛṣṭe kārye śabdasamudāyasya sāmarthyaṃ pratipadyate| punaśca "gāṃ badhānāśvamānaye"ti prayogāntareṣu gośabdasyānvaye kāryasaṃsṛṣṭagavākṛteranvayāttaduddhāre ca kāryasaṃsṛṣṭagavākṛterevoddhārāt kāryasaṃsṛṣṭāyāṃ gavi padasāmarthye kalpyate; ānayanatatsaṃsargavyabhicāre'pi kāryasaṃsargāvyabhicārāt| evaṃ ca prathamāvagatasaṃsargabuddhihetutvānapavādācchabdānāṃ madhye ca padārthatacchaktivyavadhānakalpanāgauravaparihārāt padānāmeva saṃsargapratipādanasāmarthyakalpanā; lāghavācca| tasmātkāryasaṃsṛṣṭasvārtheṣu śabdasāmarthyamiti| tadetannirācaṣṭe -- viṣama upanyāsa iti|| na hi prayogabhedeṣu kāryasaṃsarga eva gavākṛterniyamena pratīyate, kintu guṇavyaktikriyākārakasaṃsargaśca| tathāhi "śuklāṃ gāmānaye"tyukteḥ guṇakārakakriyāsambandhāḥ pratīyante kriyādvāraśca kāryasambandhaḥ| tatrāvyavahitasambandhopādānasiddhaye'nyānvitasyārthe sāmarthyaṃ gṛhyate| krameṇa ca guṇakriyādisaṃsargo yathāyogamavabhāsamāno yāvadantyapadoccāraṇasamāpti, paścātsaṃbhūya sarvaireva padairekaprayojanāvacchinno mahāvākyārthaḥ pramīyata iti nānyonyasaṃsargavirodhaḥ| pramāṇāntaragrāhyatvavatakāryamapi pravṛttiliṅgahetutayā niyamenānveti, na sarvaśabdasāmarthyaviṣayatayā| tasmāllāghavādanvitasvārthe sāmarthyamityanyathānuvādaprasaṅgātkāryānvitasvārtheṣu pramāṇāntareṇa śabdasāmarthyapratipattau śabdādapi tāvanmātrabodhe'nuvādaḥ syāt| naca kāryeṇa sarvapadārthanāmavyavahitaḥ sambandhaḥ, yena tatsaṃsṛṣṭe sāmarthyaṃ syāt| asti śeṣaśeṣitālakṣaṇasambandha iti, keyaṃ śeṣaśeṣitā nāma na tāvatsvāmitā; cetanaviṣayatvāt tasyāḥ, nāpi devadattavadaṅgāṅgitā; tadavayavatvābhāvāditareṣām| atha sādhyataiva śeṣitā; kriyaiva tarhi guṇakārakasādhyeti saiva śeṣiṇi syāt| atha paramasādhyatā svarga eva, tarhi śeṣīti kimanena kāryeṇāntargaḍunā| tasmād guṇānāṃ dravyairanvayo dravyāṇāṃ vibhaktyarthasaṃsṛṣṭānāṃ kriyayānvayaḥ, tasyāśca kāryeṇeti vyavadhānādanyānvitasvārthe sāmarthyaṃ samañjasam| kiṃca kāryasya kāryāntarānvayābhāvādanyānvayo vaktavyaḥ| dhātvarthena kāryeṇa kāryasyānvaya iti cet, na; niyogānvayanimittatvāddhātvarthekāryatāyāḥ| niyogasya tu dhātvarthena kevalenānvayo na kāryeṇa; uttarakālatvāt tatkāryatvasya| ato'pyanyānvite śabdasāmarthyamiti|| kiṃca pramāṇāntaragrāhyatvamapyarthasya śabdasāmarthyaviṣayaḥ syāt; avyabhicārāt| prayoganimittatayā'nyathāsiddhiranvayasyeti cet, kāryatvasyāpi pravṛttiliṅgahetutayaivānvayaniyamaḥ, na sarvapadasāmarthyaviṣayatayaiveti| kiṃca bhūtasaṃsarge'pi śābdī pramitiranubhūyate loke -- devadatto bhuktvā nirgata ityādau| tatra kiṃ prativākyaṃ kāryapadamadhyāhriyatām śabdavyatiriktapramāṇāntaraṃ vā kalpyatām bhrāntitvaṃ vopeyatām āhosvidanyānvite śabdasāmarthyaṃ pratipadya prāmāṇyaṃ vā vyavasthāpyatāmiti abādhitabhūtārthavyavahārākalpanālāghavāccāgṛhītaprayojanānāṃ vipratipannaprayojanānāṃ ca sambandhagrahaṇādevārthapratipatternirūpaṇīyametat| kiṃca nighaṇḍuvyākaraṇopadeśaiḥ kāryapadārthamapratipadyaivārthāntarasaṃsṛṣṭasyārtheṣvavyabhicārācchabdasāmarthyaṃ pratīyate, kvacitkāryasaṃsargadarśanādanyatrāpi tadanumīyata iti cet, na; anyatrānyasaṃsargamātradarśanena kāryasaṃsṛṣṭe'pyanyasaṃsargamātraprayaujakakalpanopapatteradṛṣṭāprayojakopasaṃharād dṛṣṭaprayojanasyaiva yuktatvāt| tasmādanyasaṃsṛṣyasvārthe śabdasāmarthyamiti siddham|| nanu gopadasyāpyānayanasaṃsargādibahvarthapratipādakatvādānayanapadasyāpi gosasaṃsargādyanekakāryābhidhāyitvāt padābhyāṃ pratipādyasaṃsarganiyamo na syāt, naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekaikapadoccāraṇe yāvānarthaḥ pratīyate, tāvatāmeva saṃsargaḥ saṃbhūyoccāraṇe pratīyata iti niyamopapatteḥ| nahyekaikapadoccāraṇātsarve saṃsargāḥ pratīyante; sahakāripadāntaranimittatvātsaṃsargapratīteḥ| nanu evaṃ paryāyatā syāt, tathāhi -- gopadasyāpyānayanasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ gotvamarthaḥ, ānayetipadasyāpi gosaṃsṛṣṭamānayanamarthaṃ iti, naitatsāram; ekasmātpadādyāvānarthaḥ pratīyate, tāvāneva cet padāntarādapi pratīyāt, syādeva paryāyatvam| yadā punaritaretarasaṃsṛṣṭau padārthau padābhyāṃ saṃbhūya pratīyete, tadā kutaḥ paryāyateti nanu gopadoccāraṇe gavākṛtireva kimiti pratīyate na sāmarthyaviṣayabhūtaṃ sarvamiti anvayavyabhicārāt saṃskārabhūyastvādbhavākṛteḥ itareṣāṃ vyabhicārādityanavadyam|| nanu abhihitena padārthāntareṇa saṃsṛṣṭaṃ gotvaṃ pratipādayati cet, gopadamānayatipadamapyabhihitenaiva gopadena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ svārthaṃ pratipādayatītītaretarāśrayatā syāt -- gotve'bhihite tatsaṃsṛṣṭānayanābhidhānam, tasminnabhihite tatsaṃsṛṣṭagotvābhidhānamiti, naiṣa doṣaḥ; krameṇa padeṣūccāryamāṇeṣu krameṇaiva padārthā avyabhicāriṇaḥ pratīyante; antyapadoccāraṇānantaraṃ ca saṃbhūyaikasmṛtigamyāni padānyabhihitāneva padārthān saṃsṛṣṭatayā pratipādayantītyabhihitenaivānvayopapatteḥ| padārtheṣvapi saṃsargapratipādakeṣu tulyau codyaparihārau| padānāmeva saṃsṛṣṭasvārthapratipādanamanvitābhidhānaṃ nāma| tadevaṃ kāryamanapekṣyaiva bhūte'pyarthe śabdasāmarthyaṃ siddham| tadetatsarvamabhipretyāha -- gopadasyābhidheyasambandhenetyādinā|| vede'pi kāryamanapekṣyaiva saṃsargapramitiraṅgīkṛtetyāha -- tathā ca vaṣaṭkarturityādinā|| nanu kartavya iti padaṃ tatrāpyadhyāhṛtya tenaikavākyatvopagamena vākyārthaḥ pramīyata iti -- tatrāha yastu kartavya iti|| nanu sūtrakāreṇaiva vṛddhavyavahārānusāriṇā kāryānvitasvārthe śabdasāmarthyaṃ darśitam, "tadbhūtānāṃ kriyārthene"ti, tatrāha -- yattu tadbhūtānāmityādi|| bhāṣyakāreṇaiva guṇaguṇyādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyādibhāvena samanvayo darśita ityarthaḥ| nanu kriyārthenetivacane kathaṃ guṇaguṇyādisāmānādhikaraṇyasambandha iti ata āha -- kriyārtheneti|| tathāca bhaṣyakāro'pītyārabhyāta evetyataḥ prāktanaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ|| kiṃca kimiti jaiminīyasūtravacanād vedāntānāṃ kāryaniṣṭhatvamiṣyate bādarāyaṇasūtrairbrahmaniṣṭhatvamiṣyatān, ityāha -- ata eva pūrveṇa tantreṇeti|| nanu arthabhedābhāve kathaṃ pṛthagārambha iti tatra vibhāgamāha -- tatra hi vedasyetyārabhya mukhyaḥ pradarśita ityantena granthena|| nanu prātipadikārthānāmekarasabrahmaparatayā'nvaye'pi prathamāvibhakteravyabhicārāt tadarthakārakatvānvaya iti, netyāha -- tathāca bhagavān pāṇiniravyatirikta iti|| tatra liṅgasaṃkhyādayastvarthātpratīyanāmā api prajñānaghana evādvitīyamityādiśabdavirodhādanirvacanīyā bhaviṣyantītyarthaḥ| nanu kriyāntaravirahe'pi prātipadakārthānvaye -- "astirbhavantīparaḥ prayoktavyaḥ prathamapuruṣe'gamyamāne" iti kātyāyanasmaraṇādastyarthaniṣṭhaḥ samanvaya iti, netyāha -- nāstikriyākartaryeveti|| nanu astikriyāmapyapahāya samanvayo na dṛśyata iti, tatrāha -- dṛśyate ca phalitā iti|| nanu tatrāpyastikriyānvayaḥ kalpyatāmiti, netyāha -- nātrāpi ye phalitā iti|| kutra tarhi vākyaṃ paryavasitamiti, tadāha -- evaṃ sāmānyataḥ siddhasyeti|| uktaṃ tāvatpadānāmarthāntarasaṃsargamātre sambandhagrahaṇāt kriyāmapahāyāvyatiriktaikarasaprātipadikārthānvayo yukta iti, idānīṃ kriyānvayābhidhānavādināmapi bhūte'rthe niṣedhavākyasamanvayo vaktavya ityāha -- kiṃca brāhmaṇo na hantavya iti|| nanu brāhmaṇahananābhāvo'pi svayaṃ kriyā kriyārtho veti netyāha -- na kriyā kriyārtho veti|| prāptakriyānivṛttilakṣaṇatvādityarthaḥ| nanu "nekṣetodyantamādityami"tyādāvīkṣaṇavirodhinī "nekṣe" iti saṃkalpakriyā vidhīyate, evaṃ "na hanyāmi"ti hananavirodhinī saṃkalpakriyaiva vidhīyatāmiti netyāha -- vrataśabdasamanvayāditi|| ayamarthaḥ saṃsṛjyamānā'bhāvameva mukhyayā vṛttyā nañśabdaḥ pratipādayati| anuṣṭheyābhidhāyivrataśabdopakramātsaṃsṛjyamānavirodhini kriyāntare lakṣaṇayā vartate, na tathehāpavādakaṃ kiṃcidasti, yena nañ‌śabdasya saṃsṛjyamānavirodhisaṃkalpakriyāyāṃ lakṣaṇā syāditi| nanu saṃsṛjyamānāttadanyatadvirodhinorapi mukhya eva nañ‌śabda iti, netyāha -- na nañaḥ samanvayamātrāditi|| atra prābhākaraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate -- atra trayo'rthāḥ pratīyante -- brāhmaṇaḥ, hananam, pratyayārthaśceti| tatra na brāhmaṇena pratiṣedhānvayaḥ; pratyakṣavirodhāt| naca hananābhāvaṃ pratipādayati; tasya pravṛttatvāt| nāpi pratyayārthābhāvam; phalaprārthanāyāḥ pravṛttihetoḥ kāryabuddhervā pratyakṣatvāt; tataḥ svabhāvaprāptahantyarthānurāgeṇa tadvirodhinī saṃkalpakriyaiva nañā pratipādyate| sā ca pratyayena vidhīyate| nacābhāvo nāma bhāvāntaravyatirekeṇa kaścidasti, yena tatparyavasitaṃ vākyaṃ syāt| ato bhāvāntaravidhiparaṃ vākyamiti, tadetadāha -- svabhāvata eva rāgādinimittādityādinā|| pariharati -- nacaitadyuktamiti|| nacābhāvastadbuddhigocaro nivartayituṃ śakyaḥ| naca bhāvāntaramevābhāvaḥ; tasya sapratiyogikatvāt| abhāva eva ca naño mukhyo'rthaḥ; arthāntaravirodhinorabhāvasambandhinorlakṣaṇayā'pi pravṛttisaṃbhave rūḍhikalpanāyogāt| nanu -- "nāmadhātvarthayoge tu naiva nañ pratiṣedhakaḥ| vadatyabrāhmaṇādharmāvanyamātravirodhinau"|| ityarthāntare'pi nañśabdo darśitaḥ, satyam; tatrāpi mukhyārthānvayena lakṣaṇayā'rthāntare'pi buddhiniyamo darśita ityavirodhaḥ| āha prābhākaraḥ -- hananābhāve niyogaḥ, tataśca niyogaparyavasitaṃ vākyamiti, tadāha -- nanu nañarthaniyoga iti|| dūṣayati -- vārtametaditi|| bhāvārtho dadhyādiguṇo vā vidhiviṣayatayā tannivṛttihetuḥ, na hananaprāgabhāvaḥ; anādisiddhatayā niyogasyānanuṣṭheyatvāt| dūṣaṇāntaramāha -- evaṃ pratiṣedhasyeti|| vidhipratiṣedhavibhāgavyavahāro laukiko na syādityarthaḥ| tasmānna kāryaparyavasitamityupasaṃharati -- tasmātsaṃsṛjyamāneti|| prakṛtyarthasya hananasyaiva nañ‌śabdānvayamaṅgīkṛtya bhāvo'rthāntaraṃ vā na vidheyamityuktam; idānīṃ pratyayārtha eva nañā sambadhyate, prakṛtyarthasyānyopasarjanatvātpradhānena cetareṣāmanvayādityāha -- tacca saṃsṛjyamānamiti|| pratyakṣādivyavahāreṣu puruṣāntaranibandhanatvābhāvādvidhyādīnāmasaṃbhave pratipādyadharma ityanuṣṭheyatā svadharma ityarthaḥ| pratiṣidhyamānakriyāphaleti|| nivartyamānakriyāphaletyarthaḥ| tataśca hananasya yadiṣṭasādhanatvaṃ pravartakam, tadeva pratyayenānūdya pratiṣidhyate brāhmaṇahananamiṣṭasādhanaṃ bhavatīti|| nanu pratyakṣamiṣṭasādhanatvaṃ hananasya nādṛṣṭāvirodhi dṛṣṭaprayojanasyeṣṭaśabdatvādidamadṛṣṭāvirodhi, dṛṣṭa prārthyata iti prārthanā; phalasādhanamityarthaḥ| tataśca hananasya yadiṣṭasādhanatvaṃ pravartakam, tadeva pratyayenānūdya pratiṣidhyate brāhmaṇahananamiṣṭasādhanaṃ na bhavatīti|| nanu pratyakṣamiṣṭasādhanatvaṃ hananasya nādṛṣṭavirodhi; dṛṣṭaprayojanasyeṣṭaśabdatvādidamadṛṣṭavirodhi, dṛṣṭa prārthyata iti prārthanā; phalasādhanamityarthaḥ| tataśca hananasya yadiṣṭasādhanatvaṃ pravartakam, tadeva pratyayanānūdya pratiṣidhyate -- brāhmaṇahananamiṣṭasādhanaṃ na bhavatīti|| nanu pratyakṣamiṣṭasādhanatvaṃ hananasya nādṛṣṭāvirodhi; dṛṣṭaprayojanasyeṣṭaśabdatvāt, idamadṛṣṭavirodhi dṛṣṭasādhanaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ| sarvatra cārthānarthasaṃyogādanayādadhiko'rthaḥ puruṣārtha ityucyate, arthāccādhiko'nartho'puruṣārtha iti, tatra puruṣārthasādhanaṃ na bhavati hananamityukte'narthādadhiko'rtho nāstītyuktaṃ bhavati| tataścārthādanartha syādhikyādarthādanarthamityuktam| tadevaṃ pratyayārthapratiṣedhasyānanuṣṭheyatvaṃ siddhamityāha -- saca prāgabhāva iti| kiṃ tarhyanuṣṭheyamiti puruṣārthasādhanavibhramādrāgādyudbodhaprasaktau tannimittapradhvaṃso'nuṣṭheya ityāha -- tatsaṃskārodbodha iti|| sa eva tarhi vākyena vidhīyatāmiti, netyāha -- sa ca yadyapi sādhya iti|| hananamiṣṭaṃ na bhavatyaniṣṭaṃ cetyavagatau hananodbodhanimittanirodhasyānvayavyatirekābhyāmevānuṣṭheyatvād na tatra śabdāpekṣeti| nimittanirodhakartavyatāyāṃ vākyasyāsāmartyāccetyāha -- tatpratipādaketi|| nanuB aniṣṭasādhanaviṣayaśabdasāmarthyāccennimittanirodhaḥ, so'pi tarhi śabdārtha iti, netyāha -- yaścārthādartha iti|| aṅgīkaroti -- atha punariti|| dūṣayati -- bhavatu; tathāpīti|| tathā'pyanuṣṭheyāṃśasyānvayavyatirekasiddhatvācchabdo nānuṣṭheyaniyogaparyavasita ityarthaḥ| nanu pratyayenāpūrvaṃ pratipādyate, tatkathamananuṣṭheyaṃ syāt kvaitad gṛhītasambandham na tāvalloke; tasyādarśanāt| nanu svargakāmino yāgakartavyatā svargasādhanamantareṇānupapannā| tacca sādhanatvaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅginaḥ karmaṇo madhyavartikāyamantareṇānupapannamiti -- śrūtārthāpattyā'pūrvaṃ gamyate, tatra śabdasya sāmarthyaṃ gṛhyata iti, so'yaṃ bakabandhaḥ| śabdāllaukikasāmarthyānusāreṇa kriyākartavyatā'bhihitā cetpunastatsāmarthyalabdhe'pūrve kimiti sambandho gṛhyate atha nābhihitā kriyākartavyatā, na tarhyapūrvameva labhyata iti kutaḥ sambandhagrahaḥ nanu yāgakartavyatā'bhihitā'nupapannā sā'pūrvābhidhānamantareṇeti, tarhi tadapyanupapannam; śarīrendriyaviṣayasambandhamantareṇa svargasyāsiddheḥ| ataḥ pratyayena śarīrādyabhidhānaṃ syāt, arthāpattigamyatvānna śabdāpekṣeti cet, apūrve'pi tulyam| tasmāddhātvarthakartavyatālakṣaṇamiṣṭasādhanameva pratyayārtha iti| tadevaṃ vṛddhavyavahārānusāreṇetyārabhyātrottaramityataḥ prāktanaḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ| prathamotpannaṃ śābdajñānaṃ tāvanna vidhīyate, tatsantānaśca sukhānubhavakāmasya na vidheyaḥ; tābhyāmeva ca svayaṃ pravṛttābhyāmaparokṣajñānamutpadyate| tadevamutpannāparokṣajñānamadhikṛtyottaramāha -- nāvagatabrahmātmabhāvasyeti|| nanu karmādinimittaḥ śarīrasambandhaḥ, tataśca saṃsāraḥ, kimaparokṣajñānena ita āha -- na karmanimittastāvadityādinā sukhaduḥkhānubhava ityantena granthena|| uktamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tattvajñānenāvidyānivṛttau saṃsāranivṛttiriti, athedānīṃ tatraivāgamapramāṇamāha -- tathā ca śrutismṛtivādā iti|| te hi brahmātmaikatvaṃ sākṣādanubhavanto'pi dvaitadarśanābhāsaṃ darśayanti|| nanu aparokṣajñānānmithyājñāne nivṛtte kuto dvaitadarśanamiti tatrāha -- vaiṣayikastviti|| nanu karmaṇāmapi nivṛttatvāt kathaṃ tannimittaṃ dvaitadarśanam naiṣa doṣaḥ; "tasya tāvadeva cirami"ti jñānavyatiriktāvadhyantakaraṇāt kañcitkālaṃ śarīrendriyādyavasthānakalpanayā tannimittakarmāvasthānakalpanāt| nanu sarvakarmakṣayaśruteḥ śrutyarthāpattiḥ kathamekadeśabādhikā syāt arthāpattyanudaye śrutasyaiva bādhaprasaṅgāditi vadāmaḥ | tasmāt śrutyādeva sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvena vyavastheti|| nanu aparokṣajñānena kṛtsnavidyānivṛttau kutaḥ karmaṇāmavasthānamiti ucyate; tattvajñānameva svakāraṇebhyo jāyamānaṃ śrutyavagatārabdhakarmāvasthānapratibandhāttadapekṣitadvaitapratibhāsanivartanapāṭavaśūnyamitarakarmāvidyārāgādernivartakaṃ cotpadyate| nanu brahmātmānubhavadvaitadarśanayoḥ kutaḥ sāhityamucyate na vayaṃ sāhityaṃ brūmaḥ; kadācidasaṃprajñātātmaikatvadarśanaṃ kadācidārabdhakarmopasthāpitadoṣanimittadvaitadarśanaṃ cet| nanu nāstyeva saśarīrasyāparokṣadarśanam, na, ārabdhakarmavyatiriktapūrvottarakarmavināśanimittadarśanābhyupagamāt| nacāparokṣadarśanamantareṇa kṛtsnakarmavināśaḥ| prārabdhakarmavataśca tattvadarśanaṃ saśarīrasyaiva saṃbhavati| vyāsādīnāṃ ca saśarīrāṇāmevāparokṣadarśanaṃ śrūyate|| nanu tattvadarśino'pi dvaitadarśanaṃ cet, niyogānuṣṭhānamapi syāt, na; niyatadeśakālādhikārakartṛtvapratipattyadhīnatvādanuṣṭhānasya| tattvadarśinastvārabdhakarmanimittadoṣodbhavasya deśakālaniyamābhāvāt, prārabdhānuṣṭhānaparisamāptiparyantamavasthānāyogāt, punaḥpunastatvadarśanenānuṣṭhitakarmaṇāṃ bādhādanuṣṭhāne prayojanābhāvāt, pratyavāyasya ca tattvadarśanenaiva nivṛtteḥ| nanu tattvadarśinaḥ śāstraniyamābhāve yatheṣṭācaraṇaṃ syāt, na; hitāhitaprāptiparihāraprārthanānimittatvādācaraṇasya svātmanyeva niratiśayānandamaśeṣānarthanivṛttiṃ ca sākṣādanubhavataḥ sādhyapuruṣārthaprārthanābhāvātkuto yatheṣṭācaraṇaprasaṅgaḥ kathaṃ tarhi śarīrayātreti cet, ārabdhakarmadoṣavaśādityuktam| nacāpūrvakarmopacayasyāvidyārāgādinimittaṃ saṃbhavati; nivṛttatvāt, ārabdhakarmaṇāṃ ca svaphalamātrahetutvāt| tasmāttattvadarśino'pi dvaitadarśanābhāsa upapadyata iti|| nanu śravaṇajñānavyatirekeṇa manananididhyāsanavidhānāt sādhyāntaramastītyuktamiti, netyāha -- manananididhyāsanayośceti|| uktaṃ ca manananididhyāsanayostattvaṃdarśanahetutvam, idānīṃ varṇakadvayoktamarthamanuvadati -- tadevaṃ siddhasya vastuna ityārabhya -- ato vidhinirapekṣaṃ svatantrameva brahma śāstrapramāṇakaṃ vedāntavākyasamanvayādityantena granthena|| api ca vidhinirapekṣabhūtavastupratipādane śāstrārambhabhedasiddhirityāha -- evaṃ ca sati padānāmiti|| nanu pravartakaviśeṣa eva pṛthakśāstrārambhanimittamiti, netyāha -- anyathātreti|| nanu anyadevabhedakamasti, śarīrendriyanirvartyā vidhibhedāḥ karmakāṇḍe nirūpitāḥ, iha tu kevalamānasasādhyo vidhirnirūpyata iti, tadāha -- athāpyabahiḥsādhana iti|| dūṣayati -- tathāpyathātaḥ pariśiṣṭadharmajijñāseti|| adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati -- tadevaṃ brahmātmāvagamātprāgiti|| brahmātmāparokṣadarśanāduttarakālamantaḥkaraṇasaṃpiṇḍitapramātṛbādhāt, prameyasanbandhāsiddhernivartata eva pramātṛpramāṇaprameyakartṛkarmakāryabhoktṛbhogalakṣaṇo vyavahāra iti|| nanu bhedābhedarūpatvānnādvaitadarśanena dvaitadarśanabādhaḥ, na tarhi dehātmabhāvaḥ; sukhaduḥkhādirapi bādhyeta; bhedābhedarūpatvāt| bhedābheda iti ca svavacanavirodhaḥ; pūrvapakṣasiddhāntaniyamabhāvaśca; sarvasāṅkaryāt|nanu tavāpyadvaite sarvasāṅkaryaṃ samānam, na; prapañcasya yathādarśanameva bhedena vyavasthitatvāt, brahmaṇa evādvitīyatvāt| nanu dṛśyate bhinnābhinnaṃ vastu pratyakṣeṇa, kiṃ tat pratyakṣam na tāvat khaṇḍo gauriti bhinnābhinnaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam; tathā pratibhāsābhāvāt| nanu itaretarātmanaivābhedaḥ pratibhāsate, tarhītaretarānātmanābhedo'pyavabhāseta| nanu rūpabhedena bhedo'vabhāsate tarhi rūpaikyādebhedo vaktavyaḥ| athetaretarātmatvādabhedaḥ, rūpabhedād bheda iti, kva dṛṣṭamitaretarātmatvamabheda iti na tāvadeko ghaṭa ityatra dṛśyate| tasmātkhaṇḍo gauriti na bhedābhedāvabhāsaḥ|| syādetat -- khaṇḍo gauriti pratyayābhyāṃ bhedābhedāvabhāsa iti, na; jñānayoḥ saṃbhūya pramāpakatvābhāvāt, pratyabhijñāmantareṇaikasyobhayasambandhāsiddheḥ| tarhi pratyayatrayeṇārthād bhedābhedasiddhiriti, pratyakṣaṃ tāvat parāhatam| khaṇḍasya gośca tadubhayālambanapiṇḍasya ca trayāṇāṃ pratyakṣe'vabhāsanātsamānādhikaraṇyasya ca tadubhayāśrayapiṇḍālambanatvāt| na cārthāpattirapi; "hṛsvo'kāraḥ" "dīrgho'kāraḥ" "sa evāyamakāraḥ" iti pratyayatrayeṇāpi bhedābhedāsiddherbhrāntimātratvopagamāt| tasmānna bhinnābhinnaṃ vastu| nāpyātmani bhedaḥ pramātuṃ śakyaḥ; vivādagocarāpannāḥ, sthāvarajaṅgamaśarīravyaktayaḥ, prativādiśarīravyaktyātmanaivātmavatyaḥ, śarīravyaktitvāt; prativādiśarīravyaktivadityekātmatvānumānāt; yugapajjananamaraṇādiviruddhadharmāśrayatvādagnyudakādivaddharmibhedo'numīyata iti cet, na; śarīrāśrayatayā vyadhikaraṇāsiddhatvāt| pratiśarīraṃ sukhaduḥkhādyanubhavānanusandhānānanusandhānairdraṣṭṛbhedaiḥ kalpyata iti cet, na; śarīrabhede satyekasyāpyātmano janmāntarīyānanusandhānādidarśanāt, satyapyekatve pratibimbabhedeṣu varṇasaṃkarādarśanāt| naca jīvabrahmabhedo'pi pratyakṣasiddhaḥ, viruddhadharmāśrayatvād bhedānumāne bimbapratibimbayoranaikāntikatvāt| niyantṛniyantavyeśitrīśitavyadraṣṭṛdṛśyādīnāṃ bhedaliṅgatvājjīvabrahmabheda iti cet, na; "nānyo'to'sti draṣṭe"tyādiśrutyaiva bhedapratiṣedhe liṅgād bhedānumiterayogāt, atulyapramāṇatvācca bhedābhedakalpanāyogāt| "dvā suparṇā" iti dvitvasaṃkhyā śrūyata iti cet, na; "yaścāyaṃ puruṣe yaścāsāviditye sa ekaḥ" ityekatvaṃsaṃkhyāśravaṇād bhrāntisiddhadvitvānuvādādekatvam; nānātve pramāṇābhāvāt| pratyakṣeṇa bhedagrahaṇe bhedasya dharmipratiyogikatvavyavasthāpekṣatvāt tadvyavasthāyāśca bhedāpekṣatvāditaretarāśrayatvāt| tasmānna bhedābhedau, ityadvaitadarśanena dvaitadarśanabādhaḥ| pratyakṣabhramasya cāptavacanena bādhadarśanātphalavacanānāṃ ca vartamānāpadeśitayā yogyānupalabdhivirodhād dṛṣṭadvāreṇa bandhanivṛttireva mokṣa iti|| apicāhuriti ślokatrayasya tātparyamāha -- gauṇamithyātmana ityādinā|| ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- tadetaddraḍhayannāheti|| dvitīyaślokasya tātparyamāha -- kathamidānīmasya prāmāmaṇyamityādinā|| tṛtīyaślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- advitīyaniratiśayānandacaitanyaikatānasarvajñasarveśvarasarvaśaktiniravayavasvacchāsaṅgapratyagbhūtabrahmātmanyaparokṣānubhavātprāg dehātmapratyayavat sarvo vyavahāro yathādarśanamupapadyate| tasmiṃścāparokṣe'vabhāsamāne pramātṛtvādibādhāt sarvo vyavahāro nivartata iti ślokārthaḥ|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakānanyānubhavapūjyapādaśiṣyasvaprakāśānubhavabhagavataḥ kṛtau pañcapādikāvivaraṇe samanvayādhikaraṇaṃ nāma navamaṃ varṇakaṃ samāptam||
